after: Or the Olympic stadiums. Around the globe, cities build these under great contestation with massive resources, but after the games go, they can't often get absorbed into the city.
ru: Колоссальное количество материалов, ресурсов потрачено на то, что скоро станет не нужным.

quote: The problem with this approach is that it would take a tremendous amount of time.
before: Naïve solutions are helpful ways to analyze problems, and work as stepping stones to better solutions. In this case, a naïve solution is to approach a pile of blocks, try all the arrangements, and see if one is a palindrome by reading it forward and then backwards.
after: If Hedge tried one combination every second, a stack of just 10 different blocks would take him 42 days to exhaust. That’ s because the total time is a function of the factorial of the number of blocks there are.
ru: Проблема этого метода в том, что это займёт огромное количество времени.

quote: The Recorded Crime Statistics also have a significant amount of accompaning metadata.
after: Relevant legislation for each offence, together with caveats and interpretation notes for each parameter accompany these statistics. Users can now interpret these statistics for themselves, rather than relying on other agencies interpreting, or possibly misinterpreting, their requirements.

quote: Zoology just isn't a skillset we absolutely need we all know about animals.
before: But even if you had a harp, as far as the survival of the species goes, harp playing is not crucial so who votes to give Russell a slot? Fuck it.
after: A carpenter is basic, how can we not have a carpenter? If we are going to repair broken equipment we obviously need an electrician.
ru: Без зоолога легко можно обойтись? Мы и так много знаем о животных.

quote: It is the practice animal on which we are to learn the basic moves.
before: He will be lucky to survive more than a few days in the Bull Court. What is that?
after: Before you face the bull, you must first learn to leap. Only when each of you has leapt the bull will the dance be over.
ru: Это животное для практики, на котором мы будем отрабатывать основные движения.

quote: It's a man who wants to be an animal.
before: Ah! It's not an animal.
after: Does he believe he's an animal? It's not what he believes;
ru: Это человек, который хочет быть животным.

quote: Ataktos Fuse, or Bestia Festiva, loosely translated means "party animal."
before: Yeah, we think he's responsible for two very different crimes. We just haven't been able to connect them.
after: - Party animal? Really? - Yeah, that's what it says.
ru: Ataktos Fuse или Bestia Festiva, что переводится как "животное на вечеринке".

quote: So how do animals cope with these very incongruent needs between the sexes?
before: Eggs are very expensive to make, so it makes sense for females to be very choosy about who she shares them with. Sperm, on the other hand, is abundant and cheap, so it makes more sense for males to have a more-sex-is-better strategy when it comes to siring members of future generations.
after: I mean, if a female doesn't choose a particular male, or if she has the ability to store sperm and she simply has enough, then it makes more sense for her to spend her time doing other biologically relevant things: avoiding predators, taking care of offspring, gathering and ingesting food. This is, of course, bad news for any male who has yet to make a deposit in her sperm bank, and this sets the scene for some pretty drastic strategies for successful fertilization.
ru: Как же справляются животные с такими несоответствующими друг другу потребностями полов?

quote: Now, fish farming is by far the best animal farming available to humankind.
before: If you feed salmon soy with nothing else, it literally explodes. Salmon is a carnivore, it has no way to digest soy.
after: But it's had a really bad reputation. There's been excessive use of chemicals, there's been virus and disease transfered to wild populations, ecosystem destruction and pollution, escaped fish breeding with wild populations, altering the overall genetic pool, and then of course, as just mentioned, the unsustainable feed ingredients.
ru: Разведение рыбы, несомненно, — лучший вид животноводства из доступных человеку.

quote: So all the animals were drawn to the water.
before: I went specifically during the peak migration to hopefully capture the most diverse range of animals. Unfortunately, when we got there, there was a drought going on during the peak migration, a five-week drought.
after: I found this one watering hole, and felt if everything remained the same way it was behaving, I had a real opportunity to capture something unique. We spent three days studying it, and nothing could have prepared me for what I witnessed during our shoot day.
ru: Поэтому все животные потянулись к воде.

quote: She said her family had been extremely frightened when her animals suddenly died.
before: Fan Litan, a peasant woman from Fantu village, about 2 miles from Yantan, lost many of her ducks, and chickens and also a dog; she has attributed these deaths to the acts of hooligans.
after: "We were scared to death," said Fan, standing next to a red sign posted on the outside wall of her home that said: "Prevention and control by the masses is basic for people." Fan said ducks and chickens are all healthy but she admitted that she had stopped eating poultry.

quote: Thank you for coming to the 1 st annual New Directions regionals set list nominations party.
before: Nobody wants any pizza? All right, well, uh, let's get started.
after: What's the point, Mr. Schue? Coach Sylvester is one of the judges.
ru: Спасибо, что пришли на первую ежегодную вечеринку Новых Направлений по выбору песен на Региональные.

quote: With an annual fatality rate 28 times higher than any other job.

after: What? Dude, it's like working with forrest gump.
ru: Ежегодный уровень смертности в 28 раз больше, чем на любой другой работе.

quote: That sounds lovely, but Gabby is having her annual barbecue on Saturday.
before: Coming from a man who's on a first-name basis with half the hookers in Fairview, that's quite a compliment, Detective. Hey, I was thinking, maybe this weekend we could head up to that place in the mountains, just the two of us.
after: Am I invited? Of course you are. Why wouldn't you be?
ru: Звучит заманчиво, Но Габи же устраивает свою ежегодную барбекю-вечеринку

quote: Are you ready for some annual social services versus goon squad football?
before: Now, can I see your selection of downstairs replacements? Okay, everybody, I got one question for you:
after: I love a good football game. Thanks, Twayne. My team is gonna need some of that spirit to avoid what happened last year.
ru: готов ли наш отдел к ежегодному футбольному состязанию, против жуткой команды головорезов? Обожаю футбол! Спасибо, Твейн.

quote: That's almost twice the country's annual health and education budget combined.

Now, the Africa Progress Panel, led by Kofi Annan, they've calculated that Congo may have lost more than 1.3 billion dollars from these deals.
after: And will the people of Congo, will they ever get their money back? Well, the answer to that question, and who was really involved and what really happened, well that's going to probably remain locked away in the secretive company registries of the British Virgin Islands and elsewhere unless we all do something about it.
ru: А это почти в 2 раза больше, чем годовой бюджет страны в области здоровья и образования.

quote: Why a marriage contract and not any other reason for regular annual action?
before: What does that mean? Well, an explanation is an assertion about what's there, unseen, that accounts for what's seen; because the explanatory role of Persephone's marriage contract could be played equally well by infinitely many other ad hoc entities.
after: Here's one: Persephone wasn't released. She escaped, and returns every spring to take revenge on Hades, with her spring powers.
ru: Почему именно брачный договор, почему не какая-то другая причина ежегодного события?

ru: Я буду говорить о ежегодных беременностях и о ВИЧ-инфицированных матерях.

quote: This will be the fifth annual Exit festival.
before: The biggest music festival in South Eastern Europe, Exit Festival, will start tomorrow. The festival is organized on Petrovaradin fortress in Novi Sad, Serbia and Montenegro, and will last from July 7 to July 10.

quote: Remember they were saying, will there ever be another Keith Floyd?
before: Yeah. If you can make me one. Ready?
after: After the aborted lunch stop, the going started to get really tough. Oh... This is a bit much for the little Fiat here.
ru: Вспомни, как они говорили, будет ли когда-нибудь другой Кит Флойд?

quote: I do think these three are related to the killer, possibly another half-brother.
before: Are we back to the half-brother Brendan? No, none of them.
after: And Ray Marino fathered them all? I can't be sure.
ru: Думаю, эти трое имеют отношение к убийце. возможно, еще один сводный брат.

quote: Because Miss Cortez is prepared to provide information on another case.
before: For your own sake, I'd encourage you to stop what you're doing and let her go. And why would I do that?
after: A case Wayne Lowry is certain that you don't want the district attorney reopening. I represented Carlos Mejia on an aggravated assault charge.
ru: Потому что мисс Кортез готова предоставить информацию по другому делу.

before: Maybe she knows what's going on. What's wrong?
after: Jesus. What the hell is going on?
ru: Один из коридоров заполнен туманом, и там ещё одно тело.

after: Arabic is the mother tongue. Research says that mastery of other languages demands mastery of the mother tongue.
ru: Но есть и другая, более важная, о которой мы должны задуматься.

quote: All of modern history can be thought of as one spurt of acceleration after another.
before: That's slow thinking. Two psychologists, Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky, started pointing this out back in 1974, and we're still struggling to do something with their insights.
after: It's as if we think if we just speed up enough, we can outrun our problems. But we never do.
ru: Вся современная история — это один рывок ускорения за другим.

quote: So when one-liners were really popular, everybody stole them from one another.
before: (Laughter) This is not unlike the world of comedy. I don't know if you know that jokes also can't be copyright protected.
after: But now, we have a different kind of comic. They develop a persona, a signature style, much like fashion designers.
ru: а потому в период популярности афоризмов, все их друг у друга крали.

quote: Another price service reported $3.05 as the U.S. average.
before: Meanwhile, gas prices dropped elsewhere and rose elsewhere. Saturday morning California had the highest reported price at GasPriceWatch.com.

after: Timothy, I wish you'd use the waste-paper basket. We don't want pencil shavings in our rissoles.
ru: Я отвела миссис Уимблиш в сторону после занятий, но она была по-прежнему очень тревожна, даже после того, как мы поговорили.

before: What if I said I saw a shrink? I had an inkling.
after: I'm in my kitchen. All of a sudden I can't breathe, right? I'm suffocating.
ru: - Время от времени мне... тревожно. Просто так, без причины.

quote: But when she showed up, she was stressed, she was anxious.

after: But when she got in, she kind of looked around, and she settled in. And she turned to the coordinator and said, " I feel comfortable here — at ease.
ru: Но один раз она пришла, в стрессовом, тревожном состоянии.

quote: Tony learns about the ontologically promiscuous, the epistemologically anxious, the ethically dubious, the metaphysically ridiculous.
before: Turns out, Tony's got the philosophy muscle. His body is in prison, but his mind is free.
after: That's Plato, Descartes, Nietzsche and Bill Clinton. So when he gives me his final paper, in which he argues that the categorical imperative is perhaps too uncompromising to deal with the conflict that affects our everyday and challenges me to tell him whether therefore we are condemned to moral failure, I say, " I don't know.
ru: Тони изучает онтологически беспорядочное, эпистемологически тревожное, этически сомнительное, метафизически смешное.

quote: It's such a shame that that woman-- anyone, really, dying from an elective surgery?

after: Well... Why would someone have a surgery they don't need?
ru: Такая жалость, что та женщина, вообще, кто угодно, умирает от плановой операции?

after: I was going to be a doctor. Help people.
ru: Они ведь могли выбрать кого угодно, но выбрали меня.

Is there anything you want to say to me?

ru: Прежде чем ты что-нибудь скажешь, я купил его на свои деньги.

after: But these are really high-performance athletic animals. I don't know what this kind of stuff will do in their gills.
ru: Они обычно не любят заходить в мутную воду все равно.

ru: Но мы с Питом все еще живем врозь.

before: Yeah, well, here's the really puzzling thing. Common sense says they were around 40 when they died.
after: I want someone posted outside that facility At all times. Nobody comes in until after the thermal cleaning. Let's get the bodies ready for transport.
ru: Но судя по данным, биологический возраст - около 80-ти лет.

quote: They're the filters through which we see the world around us.
before: That's not what I'm saying. We all have our biases.
after: I'm not accusing anyone, bias is not an accusation. Rather, it's something that has to be identified, acknowledged and mitigated against.
ru: Это фильтры, через которые мы смотрим на мир вокруг нас.

quote: My goal is not to find technology to kill the new microscopic life around us.
before: Now, my dad is my biggest fan, so in that crushing moment where he wanted to kill my new little life form, I realized that actually I had failed him, both as a daughter and a scientist. In my years toiling away in labs and in people's backyards, investigating and cataloging the microscopic life around us, I'd never made clear my true mission to him.
after: My goal is to find new technology from this life, that will help save us. The diversity of life in our homes is more than a list of 100,000 new species.
ru: Я не стремлюсь найти технологию уничтожения микробов вокруг нас.

quote: We're standing around with watering cans, when what we really need is the fire brigade.
before: Africa is a continent in flames. And deep down, if we really accepted that Africans were equal to us, we would all do more to put the fire out.
after: You see, it's not as dramatic as the tsunami. It's crazy, really, when you think about it.
ru: Мы стоим вокруг этого пожара с лейками, но тут нужна пожарная бригада.

quote: Typical fees from customers were around £40 but some may have paid as low as £10.
after: Around half of each fee went to the Nejloveanus and half to the brothel. Police launched raids, rescuing the women after receiving a tip-off.

quote: She works at the new hotel, and she wouldn't appreciate our little arrangement.
before: What's her name? Carla.
after: No wonder it was so good. It was our last time.
ru: Она работает в новом отеле и вряд ли оценит нашу маленькую договоренность.

quote: What kind of arrangement do you suppose they have?
before: Funny thing about that massacre: not only did Dr. Bloom survive, she got rich. Lecter's living in the lab under her care.
after: Complicated arrangement. Couldn't be more complicated than your relationship with Hannibal.
ru: Какого рода договоренность между ними?

quote: I know he was unhappy with the arrangement you guys had with the big guy.
before: - He was in the pool hall... - Hey! He had words with Mr. O. a couple of days ago. I know my uncle was getting restless.
after: And I'm wondering, do you think Patton found out about that? - Why would you think that?
ru: Я знаю, что ему не нравились договоренности, что были у вас с боссом.

quote: You will forgive me for observing that the arrangement seems to have a flaw.
before: You do make the most refreshingly elliptical conversation, Miss Price. So Lizzy has gone to Hammersmith to see you, but you have come to Longbourn to see her.
after: - Oh, dear, are you quite well? - I do feel a bit... unusual.
ru: Вы простите меня за наблюдение, что в договоренности есть некоторый изьян.

quote: But now that marriage is a romantic arrangement, infidelity threatens our emotional security.
before: And never has infidelity exacted such a psychological toll. When marriage was an economic enterprise, infidelity threatened our economic security.
after: Ironically, we used to turn to adultery — that was the space where we sought pure love. But now that we seek love in marriage, adultery destroys it.
ru: Сейчас, когда брак — это романтическая договорённость, неверность угрожает нашей эмоциональной безопасности.

quote: This was an arrangement which was totally understandable from the corporation's point of view.
before: They did so not just in collaboration with national and local governments but also with a television company and with a major multinational soda company. In exchange for less than one million dollars, that corporation received the benefits of a months-long promotional campaign including a 12-hour telethon all using the company's logo and color scheme.
after: It enhances the reputation of the company and it creates brand loyalty for its products. But in my view, this is profoundly problematic for the intergovernmental agency, an agency that has a mission to promote sustainable living.
ru: Это была договорённость, абсолютно естественная с точки зрения самой корпорации.

quote: And what's shown there is one possible arrangement.
before: What you see on the left hand-side is the early schematics in my design, showing both a bird's-eye view and also one stacking variant. A stacking variant means that the entire product is consisted of different individual parts that have to work in unison.
after: So what exactly is this? So I had gone on to testing my sensors and as all scientists have stumbles along their work, I also had a couple of problems in my first generation of sensors.
ru: И то, что там показано, является одним из возможных расположений.

quote: No details about the cause of death or the funeral arrangements were immediately clear.
He’s reckless, and even if he is arrogant and conceited and bad-tempered, he’s awfully generous.”
before: “But George isn’t saving.
ru: Он безрассудный, и пусть он высокомерный, самодовольный и вспыльчивый, зато ужасно щедрый.

quote: Yes, you want me on board even though I'm a selfish, arrogant neurosurgeon with a great ass.
before: Simon, I called you in here because, if I put him on blood thinners to dissolve a clot and he has a brain bleed... Yes.
after: And apparently, great hearing. This one is an odd duck.
ru: Да, тебе нужен я. Хотя я и эгоистичный высокомерный нейрохирург с классной задницей.

quote: Then you will tell him tonight that the King is arrogant, pigheaded and paranoid.
before: You're sure Thomas suspects nothing? I have him eating from my perfumed palm.
after: Shouldn't be too dificult. You will say that I am losing my grip on reality, rejecting all reasonable advice and you wish to leave Versailles for good.
ru: Хорошо, тогда сегодня вечером ты скажешь ему, что король - высокомерный, упрямый параноик.

quote: I think that's extremely arrogant on his part.
before: They actually do. I think there's also an amazing arrogance to the idea that he knows better than the framers of the Constitution in how the government should be designed and work for separation of powers and the fact that the executive and the legislative branch have to work together and they have checks and balances on each other, and then the judicial branch, which oversees the entire process.
after: CA: Can you give a specific example of how he put people's lives at risk? RL: Yeah, sure.
ru: Я считаю, что это крайне высокомерно с его стороны.
source_ru: Его самонадеянность в этом отношении не знает границ.

quote: I look at that now, I think, "What an arrogant jerk!"
before: You said, " I can say this with absolute certainty because I know how markets work. " Ray Dalio: I can say with absolute certainty that if you look at the liquidity base in the corporations and the world as a whole, that there's such reduced level of liquidity that you can't return to an era of stagflation. "
after: (Laughter) I was so arrogant, and I was so wrong. I mean, while the debt crisis happened, the stock market and the economy went up rather than going down, and I lost so much money for myself and for my clients that I had to shut down my operation pretty much, I had to let almost everybody go.
ru: Глядя на это сейчас, думаю: «Какой напыщенный зазнайка!»

quote: And I always say to the students and post-docs I lecture to, don't be arrogant, because arrogance kills curiosity.
before: And before I get to the next slide, I have to tell you that there are so many additional discoveries to be made. There is so much mystery we don't know.
after: Curiosity and passion. You need to always think, what else needs to be discovered?
ru: На лекциях я всегда говорю своим студентам и аспирантам: «Не будьте высокомерными, потому что высокомерие убивает любознательность».

quote: Judge Jackie Glass, however, described Simpson as arrogant and ignorant.
after: "Everything in this case was on tape and it was your own words that have brought you here because we heard it all and what came out on the tapes [gave] evidence in this case was overwhelming," she said. "That was a violent event, guns were brought, at least one gun was drawn, the potential for harm in that room was tremendous," she continued.
ru: Однако судья Джеки Гласс назвала Симпсона высокомерным и невежественным.

quote: You need to convince a customer to buy a 12-volume art encyclopedia.
before: May we film you? Yes.
after: We've hired an actor, who waits for you next door. It will help us to estimate your ability to improvise.
ru: Вам нужно убедить клиента купить 12-томную энциклопедию по искусству

quote: If there is any threat today, it is to the art of the theatre.
before: This time, with feeling. Now that my mother is gone... oh, my God, you're just deplorable.
after: Once again. Ahem! Now that my mother is gone, I am an orphan.
ru: Если сегодня и есть какая-то угроза, это угроза театральному искусству.

quote: You know, fencing is defined as the art of using the sword scientifically.
before: Well, I didn't know that rich people had their own Stormtroopers. It is popular across all classes.
after: It's been around since the 12th century. The only fencing I ever heard about when I was little involved stereos, two guys named Luigi, and a getaway car. Well, this kind won't get me arrested, but it will help my brain build new neural pathways.
ru: Фехтование - это искусство использования меча с научной точки зрения.

quote: Mm-hmm. Its culture, and the art of thawing meat.
before: Well, this has been a great night. I've learned so much about-about bowling,
after: Yeah, night's not over. You still haven't met the steamer.
ru: О его традициях, и об искусстве размораживать мясо.

quote: Art is not supposed to change the world, to change practical things, but to change perceptions.
before: (Applause) This image of three men wearing gas masks was taken in Chernobyl originally, and I pasted it in Southern Italy, where the mafia sometimes bury the garbage under the ground. In some ways, art can change the world.
after: Art can change the way we see the world. Art can create an analogy.
ru: Искусство не способно изменить мир в практическом смысле, но оно может изменить восприятие.

quote: Now, there are some skeptics that believe that art just belongs in an art museum.
before: Now, I've seen the Washington Monument in person thousands of times, well aware of the change in the color of marble a third of the way up, but I had never really looked at it out of context or truly as a work of art. And here, Georgia O'Keeffe's painting of this architectural icon made me realize that if we put our mind to it, it's possible to see everyday things in a wholly new and eye-opening perspective.
after: They believe that it has no practical use beyond its aesthetic value. I know who they are in every audience I teach.
ru: Есть скептики, полагающие, что место произведений искусства — в музее.

quote: And in the visual arts, the same thing happened.
before: This is a way in which modernism infiltrated this country and became perhaps the most popular, or promiscuous typeface, of the twentieth century. " Less is more, " right, these are the aphorisms of modernism.
after: Let's focus on the essentials, focus on the basic shapes, focus on geometry. So Futura actually holds this to its core.
ru: Это относится и к визуальным видам искусства.

quote: What is it that you’re saying now in your art?
When this is all over, I'm gonna write an article about it.
before: So am I. Congratulations. Thanks. Thanks, Rod.
after: After all, sex sells. Seriously.
ru: Когда все закончится, я напишу об этом статью.

quote: But I made some notes when Letitia first talked about doing an article.
before: He was bald and plump, with a moustache. Well, Mrs Opie didn't catch his name, and Mr Bell can't recall meeting him at all.
after: 'Barber By The Bay.' The photograph that you gave Miss Prout, it was of you, in the war?
ru: Но я сделала несколько заметок, когда Летиция впервые заговорила о написании статьи. Вот они.

quote: I've written some articles on plants, but I do fine on the loader.
before: Haven't you been able to work on this here? No, not really.
after: What do you get for this? -A one year membership. One year? -Indeed.
ru: Но я написал пару статей о том, как удобрять гольф-поля в Исландии.

quote: Man, someone was just telling me about this crazy article.
before: - I don't like the energy here. Jeez.
after: - Yeah. - By someone, I mean the Internet.
ru: Чёрт, кто-то мне тут рассказывал об одной невероятной статье.

quote: Tell us about your article and why there.
before: And so far, the FBI has never really responded to these charges that it's really not catching terrorists so much as it's catching mentally ill people that it can dress up as terrorists in these types of sting operations. TR: So The Intercept is that new investigative journalism website, that's cofounded by Glenn Greenwald.
after: TA: The Intercept seemed to be the most logical place for this because my article is really leveraging the fact that a source had leaked to me transcripts of these private FBI conversations that a federal judge had sealed based on the government's claim that their release would irreparably damage the U.S. government's law enforcement strategy. So a place like The Intercept was set up to protect journalists and publish their work when they're dealing with very sensitive matters like this.
ru: Расскажите нам о своей статье и почему вы разместили её именно там.

quote: In the article they reminded me, his nickname was Dirty Waters.
before: Those of you who know football, Andre Waters was someone I grew up watching. Former Philadelphia Eagles strong safety, [44] years old, a Division II football coach when he decided to put a gun to his head.
after: He was known for leading with his head, so I thought I'm just going to look up did he ever talk about the concussions he had. And I found a quote from 1994 where Andre Waters said, " I stopped counting my concussions at 15.
ru: В статье мне напомнили, что его прозвали Грязный Уотерс.

quote: A couple of researchers asked a few hundred people to read a scientific article.
before: Trial or no trial, these claims are front and center on their label right next to a picture of a brain. And it turns out that pictures of brains have special properties.
after: For half the people, the article included a brain image, and for the other half, it was the same article but it didn't have a brain image. At the end — you see where this is going — people were asked whether they agreed with the conclusions of the article.
ru: Двое исследователей попросили несколько сотен человек прочитать научную статью.

quote: When she refused, they tied her up and snatched the articles through the glass planes themselves.
before: The masked robbers initially demanded a female employee to hand over the articles.

quote: Meantime, Scarlet's working with a sketch artist on Beau's attacker.
before: No, I'm just, you know-- you know, working the case. Speaking of which, we're still trying to track down Tiffany Shaw, but no luck so far.
after: When it's done, send it off to hospital emergency rooms. If she did as much damage as she claims, then he would've sought medical attention.
ru: Тем временем, Скарлет работает с художником над эскизом нападавшего на Бо.

quote: Frustrated artist relegated to teaching 'cause nobody buys his stuff.
before: Used to do restoration work at Bennington. Now he's an adjunct art professor at a Community College.
after: Yeah, the only art he can sell are forged master works. I bet you 20 million bucks this guy killed our thief, or he can lead us to who did.
ru: Обиженный художник, низведённый до учителя, так как никто не покупает его мазню.

quote: Why'd you give up on becoming an artist?
before: No. I don't believe that.
after: Because I'm too cynical to be an artist. I think that to be really, really good, you have to come from someplace inside that I'm just not sure I have.
ru: Почему ты передумала становится художником?

quote: Yeah, and thank you for being our artist in residence.
before: ♪ Forever young ♪ Thanks for being our roadie.
after: Of course. So, you went on stage tonight as Champagne Enema.
ru: И спасибо за то, что ты наша художница.

quote: I was eager and motivated and surrounded by artists, always going to openings and events.
before: (Laughter) So it was going well. I was finding my way.
after: I was having some success and recognition and I moved into an apartment with more than four outlets. My mom and I would stay up very late talking about our latest ideas and inspiring each other.
ru: Я была активна и мотивирована, была окружена художниками, часто посещала различные мероприятия.

quote: As an artist, connection is very important to me.
after: Through my work I'm trying to articulate that humans are not separate from nature and that everything is interconnected. I first went to Antarctica almost 10 years ago, where I saw my first icebergs.
ru: Как художнику для меня очень важна взаимосвязь.

quote: And I'm happy to sign it for you with any name of any artist.
before: (Laughter) So I'm — yeah, actually I'm kind of finished at that moment. And for those who want to see more, I've got my book downstairs in the bookshop.
after: (Laughter) But before leaving I would like to show you, I'm working right now on another — in a related field with my tidying up art method. I'm working in a related field.
ru: И я буду счастлив подписаться в ней именем любого художника.

quote: A caricature artist was also present, selling custom drawn caricatures of attendees.
before: Comic collector Kevin Dutton was on hand, offering for sale his collection of 28,000 comic books. A broad array of 'geek-related' items were also available including: custom Lego mini figures, specialty knives, Pokémon merchandise, fantasy game merchandise and more.

quote: As long as they don't kill us, they keep us safe and warm.
before: Start her on co-trimoxazole. We all need some secrets.
after: I'm... I'm gonna be okay?
ru: До тех пор, пока они нас не убивают, нам от них приятно и тепло.

quote: "As long as I carry it, every living thing I meet will love me dearly."
before: You seem to be enjoying it yourself. "The wonderful love magnet.
after: That would make your election easier, wouldn't it? Certainly cheaper.
ru: Пока он со мною, все на свете будут меня обожать."

quote: As long as I'm carrying this baby, I can't leave New Orleans.
before: You should have run the second your realized Elijah was gone. Well, the witches have put some sort of hex on me.
after: If I do, they kill me. Well, knowing Klaus, he's planning a box for you the second you give birth to whatever's cooking in your tum.
ru: Пока я ношу этого ребенка я не могу покинуть Новый Орлеан.

quote: As long as you don't doubt yourself, everyone else will eventually fall in line.
before: You saved Charlotte from being Ultra's guinea pig. That's a win you should feel good about.
after: - (HIGH-PITCHED SCREECHING) - (FAINT SCREAMING) CARA:
ru: До тех пор, пока ты не сомневаешься в себе, все остальные рано или поздно тебе подчинятся.

quote: As long as we're around, DNA is around, and we'll find a way to sequence it.
before: How many of you even have a disk drive in your laptop, never mind a floppy drive? This will never be the case with DNA.
after: Archiving the world around us is part of human nature. This is the progress we've made in digital storage in 60 years, at a time when we were only beginning to understand DNA.
ru: Пока существуем мы, существует и ДНК, и мы найдём способ её секвенировать.

quote: So as long as activism is that simple, it's pretty easy to get away with.
before: Now there's a couple — there's a couple of lessons that you can take from this. And the first lesson, which I think is a worthwhile one, is that you cannot go wrong asking people to be active online, so long as activism just means retweeting a phrase.
after: The other thing you can take from this, by the way, is that there are a lot of Brazilians on Twitter. There's more than five million of them.
ru: До тех пор пока активность настолько проста, она довольно легко сходит с рук.

quote: And as long as you teach them that, you can teach them anything else you like.
before: So what I'm proposing is, just as we require reading, writing, arithmetic, American history, so we should have a curriculum on facts about all the religions of the world — about their history, about their creeds, about their texts, their music, their symbolisms, their prohibitions, their requirements. And this should be presented factually, straightforwardly, with no particular spin, to all of the children in the country.
after: That, I think, is maximal tolerance for religious freedom. As long as you inform your children about other religions, then you may — and as early as you like and whatever you like — teach them whatever creed you want them to learn.
ru: И пока вы учите их этому, вы можете учить их всему, чему пожелаете.

quote: Hey, Callie, call me as soon as you get this message.
before: Hey, I can't take your call. Leave a message.
after: Callie? Who's Callie?
ru: Привет, Кэлли. Перезвони мне, как только ты это получишь.

quote: Oh, he screams the place down as soon as he sees them.
before: It's a whole new game of soldiers with their artificial arms. How's Philip getting on?
after: And what's worse, they keep running out of gas and getting jammed, in the most awkward positions. Can't wait for our turn, can we, Bernie?
ru: Он издаёт громогласный клич, как только видит их.

quote: As soon as I'm finished, I'll come and talk to you.
before: Right through here. How are you doing today?
after: - Thank you. - Thanks.
ru: Как только я закончу, приду и поговорю с вами.

quote: We're heading back to Collingwood to collect his things as soon as I get changed.
before: I think that's a very good idea. I'll make up the guest room.
after: Paddy, this is Constable Collins. If you treat him nicely, he won't bite.
ru: Съездим обратно в Коллингвуд за его вещами, только сначала я переоденусь.

quote: As soon as his plane touches the ground, she takes off, this time flying east.
before: He'll be alone for a while. In the meantime, Orokana has been anxiously awaiting Fugōri's return, her plane fully refueled and ready to go.
after: At this point, exactly 180 minutes have passed and the professor is at the halfway point of his journey with 90 kiloliters of fuel left. For the next 90 minutes, the professor and Orokana's planes fly towards each other, meeting at the three-quarter mark.
ru: Как только его самолёт касается земли, она взлетает, но теперь на восток.

quote: Now as soon as I pop the teat, sterile drinking water is going to come out.
before: Okay? That's all that's necessary.
after: I've got to be quick. Okay, ready?
ru: Теперь, как только я сниму затычку, польётся чистая питьевая вода.

quote: As soon as it touches the water -- you should hear a sound of running air.
before: It sucks in air normally, but when it swallows water, it feels the resistance of it. So, imagine that the animal is walking towards the sea.
after: (Sound of running air) Yes! So if it doesn't feel, it will be drowned, OK?
ru: Как только оно касается воды, вы должны услышать как бы звук движущегося воздуха.

quote: Well, I've hardly completed my assessment, but I do have some concerns.
before: I'm saying we're dead already. So, what's the verdict?
after: Such as? Well, you know how long it took to get the first Icarus base up and running?
ru: Ну, я едва ли закончила оценку, но у меня есть некоторые сомнения.

quote: Well, first, I don't think that's a fair assessment.
before: Dickie Bennett killed a woman. That's not what he's in for, and I can't keep him in prison for the rest of his life because he whupped your ass.
after: Regardless. Second, what if I give you a reason to at least push the hearing back?
ru: Ну, во-первых, я не думаю, что это справедливая оценка ситуации.

quote: But she's going to need a psych assessment.
before: Is there any treatment for that? Therapy, maybe medication to control the depression.
after: That's the problem. I don't think we'll be able to get her to see a psychiatrist.
ru: Но она нуждается в психологической оценке.

quote: Do you agree with Chairman Bernanke's rosy assessment about financial future?
before: Robin, do you have any thoughts? No, I don't.
after: I do, Barry, but it's also important that we discover the causes of our current situation. And the first step is the formation of an impartial investigatory committee.
ru: ¬ы согласны с председателем Ѕернейком в его оптимистичной оценке будущего?

quote: Be reasonable in your assessment; I'm not talking about your Facebook friends.
before: Now, think of your relationships, of the people who shape your days. To whom do you speak at least once a week, be it face to face or on FaceTime?
after: I'm speaking of the people who shape your weekly emotional experience. My mother in Accra, my twin sister in Boston, my best friends in New York: these relationships are home for me.
ru: Будьте разумными в своей оценке; я не говорю о ваших друзьях в Facebook.

quote: As the meeting transpired, Jen's assessments of people added up like this.
before: It has a list of a few dozen attributes, so whenever somebody thinks something about another person's thinking, it's easy for them to convey their assessment; they simply note the attribute and provide a rating from one to 10. For example, as the meeting began, a researcher named Jen rated me a three — in other words, badly — (Laughter) for not showing a good balance of open-mindedness and assertiveness.
after: Others in the room have different opinions. That's normal.
ru: По ходу встречи оценки, которые Джен поставила другим людям, были такими.

quote: The prediction is astonishingly accurate, especially considering the fact that these games weren't built for assessment.
before: This is a subset of the children's standardized math scores. And this is the computer's prediction of each child's score, based on playing some Curious George games.
after: The team that did this study believes that games like these can teach us more about a child's cognitive learning than a standardized test can. What if games could reduce testing time in the classroom?
ru: Прогноз удивительно точный, особенно учитывая тот факт, что эти игры не были задуманы для оценки навыков.

quote: "Everyone's very well behaved" in his assessment and the atmosphere is "very positive".
before: A policeman I ask is very polite but noncommittal about the change in route. "The students are getting the message out", he says, so there's no problem.
after: Another protestor, a sign-carrying university student from Sheffield, half-heartedly returns the compliment: today, she says, "the police have been surprisingly unridiculous."

quote: Okay, if Wyler's old crew attempt to gain access to the house, we'll see them coming.
before: How are we doing, Harold? Almost finished, boss.
after: Vaughn's been smart so far. Cops couldn't find the evidence on the SUV to point to a culprit.

after: When you drive away, your car feels as if it drives better. (Laughter) And the reason for this — unless my car valet mysteriously is changing the oil and performing work which I'm not paying him for and I'm unaware of — is because perception is, in any case, leaky.

quote: Other transportation efficiency is as important as cars and trucks.

after: Renewables at the current levels of technological efficiency can make this much difference. And with what Vinod, and John Doerr and others, many of you here — there are a lot of people directly involved in this — this wedge is going to grow much more rapidly than the current projection shows it.
ru: Эффективность других видов транспорта не менее важна, чем эффективность машин!

quote: Deputy leader, Gerry Brownlee, said: "If it was a new car I wouldn't buy it."

after: So a meal at a restaurant might be an issue. I don't know. [bell ringing]
ru: Она просто очень внимательно смотрит, что она ест.

after: There's not a lot of evidence to support that. Not your kind of evidence.
ru: Так вы сказали, но я изучала Панцера очень внимательно.

before: Get up. I want to talk to you.
after: I don't know how well you can remember the last months that I was with your mother You remember anything?
ru: Хочу, чтобы ты меня внимательно выслушала.

quote: 'Listen carefully, because there's some things that you need to know.
before: Well, not everyone's as blessed in the brains and trouser department as I am, are they? 'Hi, it's me.
after: 'I know this sounds weird, but... ..'you're gonna have a baby. 'Oh, he's beautiful.

quote: Actually, Linus didn't look at them that carefully.
before: So he didn't have it. But there was ones in the literature.
after: But about, oh, 15 months after I got to Cambridge, a rumor began to appear from Linus Pauling's son, who was in Cambridge, that his father was now working on DNA. And so, one day Peter came in and he said he was Peter Pauling, and he gave me a copy of his father's manuscripts.
ru: На самом деле, Лайнус не так внимательно их изучил.

quote: Now please listen carefully to what I am about to say.
before: All those of you who cannot swim, line up on the left wing of the aircraft, and I will speak to you from the water. " So they do everything he says, and they see finally a little captain in a rubber boat rowing to the front of the aircraft, and he has a loudspeaker, and he says, " Ladies and gentlemen, again, I congratulate you for following my instructions.
after: First, those of you on the right wing of the aircraft, New York is this way. (Laughter) It is only three nautical miles, the water is warm, and the current is with you.
ru: Теперь, пожалуйста, внимательно выслушайте меня.

quote: And if you look carefully, you can see that there's a black blush right there.
before: And we're about two and a half years into a five-year study. This was the only modality that can see the inner lining of the heart.
after: And that is microvascular obstruction. The syndrome, the female-pattern now is called microvascular coronary dysfunction, or obstruction.
ru: И если вы посмотрите внимательно, то увидите в этом месте чёрный участок.

quote: The Hursti experiments have demonstrated that such access need not leave any trace if done carefully.
before: Such access, they claim, requires "a high degree of inside access", but represents a "hasty or clumsy" intrusion.

quote: Well, that's the case with the left hand.
before: That's correct. Well, we assumed both hands were removed postmortem to prevent identification or possibly taken as trophies.
after: The injury here is definitely postmortem. In both instances, the method was crude.
ru: В случае левой руки - это верно.

quote: In that case, the court ruled the flight attendant overstepped her authority.
before: Would you call that a threat? I'm not sure.
after: Now, it's important to be vigilant but not paranoid or vindictive. I think it's pretty clear the charges against

quote: Surely, in any case, Roger will tell his father?
before: It was the one thing I stipulated for: secrecy. But why keep it secret from the family?
after: No, he won't, because I made him promise, and I think he's one to respect a promise. Well, let's give him a chance, then, shall we?
ru: В любом случае, Роджер скажет отцу? Нет. Не скажет.

quote: In that case, you pour the fizz and I'll go upstairs and get my box.
before: I'd love to see a picture of her. Would you?
after: She kinda looks like me, right height, right hair... She's Japanese, Shoo.
ru: В таком случае, вы разливайте шампанское, а я схожу наверх и принесу коробку.

quote: In our case, it was Washington, D.C., Houston, Tucson.
before: Actually, you didn't even live together. MK: We had one of those commuter marriages.
after: Sometimes we'd go clockwise, sometimes counterclockwise, to all those different places, and we didn't really live together until that Saturday morning. Within an hour of Gabby being shot, I was on an airplane to Tucson, and that was the moment where that had changed things.
ru: В нашем случае между Вашингтоном, Хьюстоном и Тусоном.

quote: In that case, I would answer with my social identity, and check the box for "black."
before: I wasn't quite sure how to answer the question. Was it aimed at measuring the diversity of research participants' social backgrounds?
after: But what if the researchers were interested in investigating some association between ancestry and the risk for certain genetic traits? In that case, wouldn't they want to know something about my ancestry, which is just as much European as African?
ru: В этом случае я бы ответила, что я — чернокожая: такова моя социальная идентификация.

quote: In this case, we've grown a corner block.
before: But it's much faster than conventional farming. The last step, of course, is application.
after: A major Fortune 500 furniture maker uses these corner blocks to protect their tables in shipment. They used to use a plastic packaging buffer, but we were able to give them the exact same physical performance with our grown material.
ru: В данном случае мы создали угловой блок.

quote: Similar cases were reported in media reports from Hong Kong.
before: Between January and May 2008, 149 men and one woman between 19 and 97 (mean age 51) were admitted to five public hospitals for unexplained low blood sugar.
after: Seven Singaporean patients remained in a coma because of prolonged sugar starvation of the brain, and four subsequently died. The diabetes drug glyburide was found in blood and/or urine samples in 85% of cases; 30% admitted having used illegal sexual performance enhancers.

quote: Cash came from a trust fund account set up for Lyla Cutwright by her great aunt.
before: Withdrawal happened last November. But it was not made by the lance corporal.
after: Cutwright gained access to it when she turned 19. Account didn't show up with her other records because it was closed before being linked to her name.
ru: Наличные поступили с трастового фонда, учрежденного для Лайлы Катрайт ее двоюродной бабушкой.

quote: His wife said he liked to carry cash.
before: What have you found? Well, firstly, it seems Mr Powell took out cash from his personal account regularly, 2,000 at a time.
after: Yes, but then I checked the marine reserve account. And?
ru: Его жена сказала, он любил держать при себе наличные.

quote: They carry the cash so we won't have to.
before: All that cash, through tubes? These tubes are linked to the airport.
after: We walk right out and straight to where the money is waiting for us, here. This is all going down now!
ru: Они перенесут наличные, так что нам не нужно будет этого делать.

quote: What's a government accountant doing with cash like that?
before: Milton? That's over 100 grand in cash.
after: That's getaway money. You had to show 'em the money.
ru: Что правительственный работник делает с такой суммой наличных?

quote: We have a couple of other things, a little bit of cash.
before: So we'd love to give you this lovely watch as a gift. (Laughter) Hopefully it matches his taste.
after: And we have a few other things, these all belong to you, along with a big round of applause from all your friends. (Applause) Joe, thank you very much.
ru: А также несколько других вещиц: немного наличных и ещё вот это.

quote: They make you pay more in withholding just to help their cash flow out.
before: They borrow money. They're not supposed to, but they figure out a way.
after: They sell off the assets. They defer the payments.
ru: Они заставляют вас платить больше, задерживая выплаты, просто чтобы вывести свои наличные.

quote: These were money taken out in suitcases or in containers, in cash of course.
before: Now, when I went to look at the figures of the U.S. money supply, the U.S. money supply is the amount of dollars that the Federal Reserve prints every year in order to satisfy the increase in the demand for dollars, which, of course, reflects the growth of the economy. So, when I went to look at those figures, I noted that since the late 1960s a growing number of these dollars was actually leaving the United States, never to come back.
after: These were money taken out by criminals and money launderers. These were money taken out to fund the growth of the terror, illegal and criminal economy.
ru: Эти деньги были вывезены в чемоданах или контейнерах, наличными, конечно же.

quote: NTL has agreed to pay $23.93 for each Telewest share, in cash and NTL stock.
after: Current Telewest shareholders will own approximately 25 percent of the combined company. While both companies operate exclusively in the UK, they are listed in New York on the U.S. NASDAQ exchange.

quote: Those injuries are obscuring the cause of death.
before: Thank you. Mm-hmm. Sharp-force trauma accounts for almost all the injuries postdating the remodeled fractures the victim sustained in the explosion six years ago, congruent with multiple strikes from the air-conditioning unit blades.
after: We need to ask ourselves, what injuries match the height of the blood spatter in the hotel room? Two and a half to three meters.
ru: Эти травмы маскуют причины смерти.

quote: Sir, did you form an opinion as to the cause of death?
before: - No. Sit and zip it.
after: Massive internal damage. Injuries consistent with being struck by a car.
ru: Сэр, вы установили причину смерти жертвы?

quote: There must have been a cause, a reason for you to do such a thing.
before: Well, then. I think you have all the relevant information. There must be something more.
after: What sort of cause? I don't know.
ru: Должны быть какие-то причины, чтобы пойти на такое.

quote: Your Grace, I bring you the cause of England's troubles.
before: Is the court assembled? They await Your Grace's favor.
after: The money wasted, the lives lost, bringing you here. And all for what?
ru: - Ваше Величество, я привезла вам причину английской смуты.

quote: Just as autism is a spectrum, there's a spectrum of etiologies, a spectrum of causes.
before: So the question remains, what does cause autism? In fact, there's probably not one single answer.
after: Based on epidemiological data, we know that one of the causes, or one of the associations, I should say, is advanced paternal age, that is, increasing age of the father at the time of conception. In addition, another vulnerable and critical period in terms of development is when the mother is pregnant.
ru: Так как существует много разновидностей аутизма, то существует и целый ряд теорий, целый набор причин.

quote: That means the spinning Gravitometer can’t be the cause of any particular malfunction.
before: So let’ s look at Slate’ s last two notes, since they give direct information about those. The Gravitometer spins in both cases, but the results are different.
after: If it were, the same thing would happen each time. So we can conclude that a glowing Fuel gauge makes the reactor leak, while a rattling Helium tank makes the Ignition explode and depletes the Oxygen levels.
ru: Это значит, что гравиметр не может быть причиной какой-либо конкретной неполадки,

quote: He learns his whys and wherefores, his causes and correlations, his logic, his fallacies.
before: Socrates died in prison, his philosophy intact. So Tony starts doing his homework.
after: Turns out, Tony's got the philosophy muscle. His body is in prison, but his mind is free.
ru: Он изучает свои «что» и «почему», свои причины и взаимосвязи, свою логику, свои заблуждения.

quote: Pogue's cause was reportedly helped by Rick Santorum, who mentioned Pogue's conviction to Trump.
before: Trump granted Paul Harvey Pogue a full and unconditional pardon. Pogue, the founder of Pogue Construction, was convicted of submitting a false tax return in 2010 in the Eastern District of Texas.

quote: I used to be satisfied being cautious and neutral, being Switzerland.
before: Its cautious respect for precedent and neutrality has, at times, saved our country. But I came here a different judge, a different man.
after: I am not anymore. The job of a justice is to preserve the status quo, to be a referee, to settle fights.
ru: Я довольствовался осторожностью и беспристрастностью, был Швейцарией.

quote: I was being overly cautious and overly protective.
before: You don't need to. You were right.
after: I already lost one friend this week, I didn't want to lose my best one on top of that. So we're besties.
ru: Я переборщила с осторожностью и заботой.

quote: That's exactly when you need to be cautious.
before: I just... I don't like the way he speaks to you, that's all. Especially now, when everything's going our way.
after: Can you please turn that down? Your mom don't like music.
ru: Именно тогда и нужно быть осторожным.

quote: Look, Singleton, we have to be extra cautious at this time.
before: Go on. I'm listening.
after: This is disappointing. I was hoping you wouldn't take the bait and dig further.
ru: Послушай, Синглтон, в этот раз мы должны быть предельно осторожны.

after: I have to really follow best journalistic practices and make sure that these powerful stories are built with integrity. If we don't capture the material ourselves, we have to be extremely exacting about figuring out the provenance and where did this stuff come from and is it authentic?
ru: Это, безусловно, означает, что мне нужно быть очень осторожной при создании таких сюжетов.

quote: Partly because they believe that scientists will be very cautious and responsible about using them.

after: (Laughter) So far, that's been true. But gene drives also have some actual limitations.
ru: Отчасти из-за уверенности, что учёные будут очень осторожно и ответственно применять его.

quote: Constrained peptide design is a cutting-edge technology, and the drug development pipeline is slow and cautious.
before: Some of these new drugs have been tested in preclinical trials with laboratory animals. And so far, they're all safe and highly effective.
after: So we're still three to five years out from human trials. But during that time, more constrained peptide drugs are going to be entering the drug development pipeline.
ru: Проектирование пептидов — это новейшая технология, а процесс производства лекарств медленный и осторожный.

quote: Officials urged residents to be cautious since Koppu may still cause landslides and flash floods.
before: The typhoon weakened as it moved over land, and weather improved in some regions.

quote: Which one do I use to kill brain cells?

after: Buy me one of each of them. - I'm buying? - I'm totally poor.
ru: Какой выбрать, чтобы разрушить клетки мозга?

ru: Видишь, как эти клетки приклеились вместе?

after: A lot of conversations, I bet. He liked to keep the dialogue going.
ru: Решетка между нашими клетками, была как телефонная связь.

quote: And they're gonna use him to roll up the rest of the cell.
before: I understand you have some information on the gateway bombing. The Occupation arrested the man who loaded the bomb onto the truck.
after: The people responsible for that action used to be affiliated with us, but they splintered off when we discovered that we had a difference of, um... philosophy. But they know who you are.
ru: И они воспользуются им, чтобы накрыть всю ячейку.

quote: Like embryonic stem cells, they, too, can become any kind of cell in the body.
before: A third kind of stem cells is called induced pluripotent stem cells. These are regular skin, fat, liver, or other cells that scientists have changed to behave like embryonic stem cells.
after: While scientists and doctors hope to use all of these kinds of stem cells to create new tissue to heal your body, they can also use stem cells to help understand how the body works. Scientists can watch stem cells develop into tissue to understand the mechnanisms that the body uses to create new tissue in a controlled and regulated way.
ru: эмбриональных стволовых клеток. Подобно эмбриональным, они таким же образом могут

before: Dendritic cells, or macrophages, capture the virus and display pieces of it. Memory cells generated by the HIV vaccine are activated when they learn HIV is present from the front-line troops.
after: Memory B cells turn into plasma cells, which produce wave after wave of the specific antibodies that latch onto HIV to prevent it from infecting cells, while squadrons of killer T cells seek out and destroy cells that are already HIV infected. The virus is defeated.
ru: Эти клетки памяти немедленно мобилизуют конкретное необходимое оружие.

quote: So you could fit 10 human cells across the diameter of a human hair.
before: It's about a tenth of a millimeter. And as we go smaller again, about ten times smaller than that, is a cell.
after: So when we would look at cells, this is how I really got involved in biology and science is by looking at living cells in the microscope. When I first saw living cells in a microscope, I was absolutely enthralled and amazed at what they looked like.
ru: Получается диаметр человеческого волоска это десять человеческих клеток.

quote: These reproductive cells were not merely more plentiful in ABVD patients.
after: They also appeared immature, "new" in the words of lead researcher Evelyn Telfer. This challenges the conventional belief that girls are born with all the ova they will ever have and the numbers can only go down as the cells are either used up by the reproductive cycle or succumb to damage or natural aging.

quote: After all these centuries, it is finally time.
before: Then I would tell you there's one more thing that you should know. The full moon is tomorrow, brother.
after: I have been to see the witches. They believe they may have found a way to spare the doppelganger.
ru: После всех этих столетий наконец пришло время.

quote: He left me cursed to wander through the centuries alone and weak.
before: Shakespeare broke my staff. He drowned my book.
after: You still have to play by the rules of your story. A story writ when magic was dying, almost gone.
ru: Он обрек меня скитаться сквозь века одинокого и слабого.

quote: To keep living century after century, she carries with her the first body she inhabited.
before: The countess has our son on board. But for all her power and knowledge, she does not know you even exist.
after: Find it, destroy it, and the bitch can be run through with a dull blade. That, I can do.
ru: Чтобы сохранять свою жизнь столетие за столетием, она сохраняет своё первое тело.

quote: Have you sold any late 19th century revolvers recently, Mr. Childan?
before: Of course. Certainly.
after: Uh, no, sir. It is not an area of specialization for me.
ru: Вы продавали недавно револьверы 19-го века... М-р Чилдан?

quote: Centuries ago, our ancestors would burn cats alive as a form of popular entertainment.
before: In particular, can it explain a momentous historical development that I spoke about five years ago here at TED? Namely, we seem to be getting more humane.
after: Knights waged constant war on each other by trying to kill as many of each other's peasants as possible. Governments executed people for frivolous reasons, like stealing a cabbage or criticizing the royal garden.
ru: Столетия назад сжигание кошек живьём было популярным развлечением у наших предков.

quote: In the 17th century, Robert Boyle came up with an idea for a self-watering pot.
before: With a low center of mass, the wheel just swings back and forth like a pendulum, then stops. What about a different approach?
after: He theorized that capillary action, the attraction between liquids and surfaces that pulls water through thin tubes, might keep the water cycling around the bowl. But if the capillary action is strong enough to overcome gravity and draw the water up, it would also prevent it from falling back into the bowl.
ru: В XVII веке Роберт Бойль предложил идею самонаполняющегося сосуда.

quote: And he thinks that civilization has only a 50 percent chance of surviving this century.
before: All it takes is for a supernova to go off a few light-years away, and we'll all be dead! Martin Rees has recently written a book about our vulnerability to all sorts of things, from astrophysics, to scientific experiments gone wrong, and most importantly, to terrorism with weapons of mass destruction.
after: I think he's going to talk about that later in the conference. Now, I don't think that probability is the right category to discuss this issue in, but I do agree with him about this: we can survive and we can fail to survive.
ru: И он думает, что человеческая цивилизация имеет только 50% шансов выжить в этом веке.

quote: The six vaults containing the treasure have been undisturbed for over a century.
before: The Hindu temple was built in the 16th century by the kings of the then Kingdom of Travancore to serve as a royal chapel for the rulers of Travancore.
after: Assessment of the treasure began on June 27 after a lawyer concerned about the security of the treasure petitioned India's Supreme Court, which then appointed a seven-member panel of experts to inventory the treasure. The panel does not have the power to determine to whom the treasure will belong.

quote: Yet there are others who reasonably wish to observe certain protocol.
before: I was hoping you could stand by my side as I present blue energy, technology that could offer answers to some of your world's most pressing concerns. Many here are very excited to see the gifts you have to present.
after: You understand, of course. May I ask what camp you're in, Mr. Chima?
ru: Но есть и другие, которые в силу известных причин желают, чтобы был соблюден определенный протокол.

quote: Do you want to agree that certain things between us never happened?
before: As much as I hate to do this, I have to ask you a direct question.
after: No. I wouldn't take back anything.
ru: Ты хочешь согласиться с тем, что определенные вещи между нами никогда не случались?

quote: As you know, working at the CIA gives me certain privileges too.
before: I almost forgot. You'll need this.
after: And they include summoning a federal prisoner whenever I damn well please. Fair enough.
ru: Как вам известно, работа в ЦРУ тоже даёт мне определённые преимущества.

quote: You even garnered some respect in certain circles.
before: Yeah well, we had our reasons. As cut-throat mercenaries you filled a niche, you had a role to play.
after: You can't afford to have people think you've gone soft. We could send you back to your ship without your tongue.
ru: Даже заслужили уважение в определённых кругах.

quote: It confuses the difficulty of being certain with the impossibility of truth.
before: That can seem like a bracing bit of realpolitik to people, or liberating, because it allows each of us to discover or make our own truth. But actually, I think it's a bit of self-serving rationalization disguised as philosophy.
after: Look — of course it's difficult to be certain about anything; we might all be living in " The Matrix. " You might have a brain chip in your head feeding you all the wrong information.
ru: Она выдаёт сложность достижения высокой степени уверенности за невозможность истины.

quote: And, like all grasses, at a certain point it puts out seeds.
before: But what's wheat? Wheat is a grass that grows in the field.
after: And we harvest those seeds, and those are the wheat kernels. Now, in order to harvest it — I mean, what's harvesting?
ru: Как все травы, в определённый момент она даёт зёрна.

quote: And government has certain benefits it can uniquely bestow on these markets.
before: So it's on a par with the water supply or the road network. And it's a series of markets for low-level trade that can be fulfilled by a person or a small company.
after: It's about public spending going through these markets to buy public services at the local level. It's about interfacing these markets direct into the highest official channels in the land.
ru: И от этого правительство имеет определённую прибыль, оно может уникальным образом награждать такие рынки.

quote: Many continue to exclude certain groups from participation in public life.
before: In his speech, Mr Annan praised the progress in development across the continent since 1997 saying,"Despite elections, many Governments continue to suppress opposition parties and a free press.
after: Many continue to practise or tolerate large scale corruption," in his last address to the AU.

quote: I don't know, Mom, but I'm certainly not telling you.
before: What college? Are you talking about Dartmouth?
after: I am tired of running away from my future. It's about time that I start running towards it, no matter how far from here it is!
ru: Я не знаю, мама, но, конечно же, тебе я ничего не скажу.

quote: It certainly is a very fascinating case you've chosen to investigate.
before: Oh, yes, of course. He kept insisting this was the kind of material you were looking for for your yearbook.
after: But if we're to consider it there are one or two mistakes which will have to be dealt with. Of course.

quote: And those planetary systems are going to be very common.
before: So, my first bold prediction is that, is that in the universe, life is going to be everywhere. It's going to be everywhere we look — where there are planetary systems that can possibly support it.
after: So, what about life on Mars? Well, if somebody had asked me about a dozen years ago what I thought the chances of life on Mars would be, I would've probably said, a couple of percent.
ru: А эта планетарная система весьма обычна, судя по всему.

quote: We hope not, or maybe we just hope to make miracles a little more common.
before: And then, after they get that care — like the mouse, like the skier, like the 65-year-old woman — they'll wake up. A miracle?
after: Thank you very much. (Applause)
ru: Мы надеемся, что нет, или мы просто хотим сделать чудеса чем-то чуть более обычным.

ru: Мы слышали Ксилидина было довольно вокал феминистка в рамках сообщества.

ru: Собираться как члены одного сообщества действительно полезно.

before: I think of this woman named Islan Nettles. She's from New York, she's a young woman who was courageously living her truth, but hatred ended her life.
after: Our suicide rate is nine times higher than that of the general population. Every November 20, we have a global vigil for Transgender Day of Remembrance.
ru: Для большинства людей нашего сообщества это и есть страшная правда жизни.

quote: I believe in accountability and that we should all be safe in our communities.

ru: Я верю в ответственность и в то, что в наших общинах мы должны находиться в безопасности.

quote: And so the method that arose organically within the community is the Votes For Deletion page.

ru: Каждое животное находит свой способ выживания в условиях конкуренции джунглей.

quote: There was always a competition between Niels and myself.
before: Until I find out who killed Peter. Why is she so angry with you if you don't mind me asking?
after: A sort of power balance. Lisa was always daddy's little girl.
ru: Всегда существовало соревнование между мной и Нильсом.

quote: Listen up everyone, from Monday we will start the dance competition.
before: What the hell is your problem? They do this in villages, during festivals.
after: Every couple will get points each week and then the top ten couples will compete in the finals and whoever wins will be proclaimed the best dancing pair in Amritsar. Thank you Madonna madam.
ru: Слушайте все, в понедельник начнутся танцевальные соревнования.

quote: And of course, we had beautiful SpaceShipOne, which made those two flights and won the competition.
before: We offered 10 million dollars in cash for the first reusable ship, carry three people up to 100 kilometers, come back down, and within two weeks, make the trip again. Twenty-six teams from seven countries entered the competition, spending between one to 25 million dollars each.

ru: И, как известно, мы получили прекрасный корабль SpaceShipOne, который сделал те два полёта и выиграл соревнование.

quote: So the temptation to avoid competition is powerful.
before: But the problem is that sometimes, for businesses, competition can be inconvenient, because competition means that the race is never over, the game is never won. No matter how well you were doing in the past, there's always someone who are out there wanting to take your place.
after: It's rooted in motives as old as Adam and Eve: in greed for yet more money, in fear of losing your position in the market and all the benefits it brings. And when greed and fear are linked to power, you have a dangerous mix.
ru: Поэтому искушение избежать конкуренции велико.

quote: And the reason is, we have an army of students who participate in competitions.
before: It's not quite on par with Google after seven years of Google work, but it's getting there. And it took us only two engineers and three months to do this.

ru: Причина в том, что у нас целая армия студентов, которые участвуют в соревнованиях.

quote: See above, but we don't really feel like we are in competition with other projects.

ru: Но они должны были полностью истратиться при контролируемом взрыве.

quote: I am going to be completely honest with you.

after: I admire you. YOu have created something unique.

ru: Кафедра химии полностью отрезала нам путь.

quote: And this opens up completely new kinds of risks to us all.
before: We estimate that just the electricity bill for running this data center is going to be in the tens of millions of dollars a year. And this kind of wholesale surveillance means that they can collect our data and keep it basically forever, keep it for extended periods of time, keep it for years, keep it for decades.
after: And what this is is that it is wholesale blanket surveillance on everyone. Well, not exactly everyone, because the U.S. intelligence only has a legal right to monitor foreigners.
ru: Здесь мы сталкиваемся с совершенно новыми рисками:

quote: For myself, of course, I have to completely trust my body language.
before: We now have a more democratic view and way of making music — a two-way street. I, as the conductor, have to come to the rehearsal with a cast-iron sense of the outer architecture of that music, within which there is then immense personal freedom for the members of the orchestra to shine.
after: That's all I have at the point of sale. It's silent gesture.
ru: Что касается меня, безусловно, я должен полностью доверять языку своего тела.

quote: And here he is, paralyzed completely, unable to breathe and move, over this time journey.
before: Here he is walking down the aisle, but he can barely walk now, so it's impaired. And he could still hold his wife's hand, but he couldn't do buttons on his clothes, can't feed himself.
after: These stories of his life, converted to data. He renovated my carriage house when he was completely paralyzed, and unable to speak, and unable to breathe, and he won an award for a historic restoration.
ru: На этом снимке он полностью парализован, не в состоянии самостоятельно дышать или двигаться- вот такой путь.

quote: When firefighters arrived, Apt. #4 was completely engulfed in flames.
before: At approximately 4:30 p.m. (Eastern time) firefighters were called to the building after initial calls reported that an oven had caught on fire after grease had spilled in Apt. #4.

before: A battle simulation. Exactly.
after: Well, it's interesting, but what's it got to do with the ship dropping out? Look closer. Something about this program is overriding normal operations.
ru: Чрезвычайно сложное, смоделированное до мельчайших деталей, и всегда с неблагополучным результатом.

quote: We are stating, plainly, that this is a highly complex, logistical programme.

after: The vans ARE coming to London. Where to?
ru: Мы заявляем прямо, это очень сложная логистическая программа.

quote: Greenfield's not the only one who can get into complex systems.

after: I can help them if you fill me in, Root. Not now, John.
ru: Не только Гринфилд может проникать в сложные системы.

ru: Кто-то пытался навредить тебе, и он проделал удивительно сложный маршрут, чтобы сделать это.

quote: Emergence is a basic property of many complex systems of interacting elements.
before: It's like an accident that happens over and over again, allowing fish all across the ocean to reliably avoid predation. And it's not just fish.
after: For example, the specific way in which millions of grains of sand collide and tumble over each other almost always produces the same basic pattern of ripples. And when moisture freezes in the atmosphere, the specific binding properties of water molecules reliably produce radiating lattices that form into beautiful snowflakes.
ru: Эмерджентность — основное свойство многих сложных систем связанных элементов.

quote: They are not nearly as complex as hollow organs.
before: But they are really acting mostly as conduits. You're allowing fluid or air to go through at steady states.
after: Hollow organs have a much higher degree of complexity, because you're asking these organs to act on demand. So, the bladder is one such organ.
ru: Они и близко не такие сложные как полые органы.

quote: It is more complex than this, but this will do.
before: And the lawyers do not provide a picture, so I made one. These are the two main sort of binary oppositions within the logic of copyright law.

ru: Конечно, всё сложнее, но эта иллюстрация вполне сгодится.

after: So I thought it would be easier to just mess around with someone who wouldn't decorate my locker and who doesn't know my mom has cancer. Oy.

ru: Он слишком стар, чтобы иметь сложный пароль.

after: Shall we? It doesn't make any sense.
ru: А вы у меня в долгу, что может повлечь за собой сложности.

quote: But our understanding of time started getting complicated thanks to Einstein.
before: Is time something that physically exists, or is it just in our heads? At first the answer seems obvious — of course time exists; it constantly unfolds all around us, and it’ s hard to imagine the universe without it.
after: His theory of relativity tells us that time passes for everyone, but doesn’ t always pass at the same rate for people in different situations, like those travelling close to the speed of light or orbiting a supermassive black hole. Einstein resolved the malleability of time by combining it with space to define space-time, which can bend, but behaves in consistent, predictable ways.
ru: Однако наше представление о времени благодаря Эйнштейну стало намного сложнее.

quote: An architect can use computer-assisted design software to design bigger, more complicated buildings.
before: Sometimes they complement human beings directly, making them more productive or more efficient at a particular task. So a taxi driver can use a satnav system to navigate on unfamiliar roads.
after: But technological progress doesn't just complement human beings directly. It also complements them indirectly, and it does this in two ways.
ru: Благодаря системам автоматизированного проектирования архитектор может разработать более сложный и замысловатый дизайн сооружения.

quote: They're all different in complicated and unique ways.
before: So it turns out hospitals have to be open 24 / 7. And patients — well, they're all different.
after: The average hospitalized patient is seen by 60 or so different caregivers throughout his stay. They come from different shifts, different specialties, different areas of expertise, and they may not even know each other's name.
ru: У каждого своя сложная, уникальная ситуация.

before: "They will be able to see the difficulties of the operation... The place is difficult [to access], there are trees of up to 40 meters (130 feet) tall," a spokesman said.

after: I gave her the one-word test. 'Always pointless.

ru: Не он наша главная забота сейчас, но продолжай копать.

after: In fact, the evidence is quite low and very few cases of date rape probably involve GHB. You can smell it.
ru: Было беспокойство по поводу использования его при изнасилованиях во время свиданий.

quote: The three greatest concerns of people all around the globe typically are jobs, violence and health.
before: Yes, yes, I know, I know, our world is based on fossil fuels, but we can adjust our society to run on renewable energy from the Sun to create a more sustainable and secure future. That's good for the little creatures here, the plankton, and that good for us — here's why.
after: A job means food and shelter. Look at these creatures, they're swimming around, they're looking for a place to eat and reproduce.
ru: Три основных повода для беспокойств всех людей на планете: работа, жестокость и здоровье.

quote: Well, November, Christmas video games come out, and there may well be an upsurge in the concern about their content.
before: If we look closer, we see those peaks occur at the same month every year. Why?
after: But April isn't a particularly massive month for video games. Why April?
ru: В ноябре, перед рождеством, выходят новые игры, и они, скорее всего, вызывают всплеск беспокойства по поводу их содержания.

quote: So this is not just a concern about lions; it's a concern about communities in Africa as well.
before: If they disappear, whole ecosystems in Africa disappear. There's an 80-billion-dollar-a-year ecotourism revenue stream into Africa.
after: If they disappear, all of that goes away. But what I'm more concerned about in many ways is that, as we de-link ourselves from nature, as we de-link ourselves spiritually from these animals, we lose hope, we lose that spiritual connection, our dignity, that thing within us that keeps us connected to the planet.
ru: Таким образом, все это не только беспокойство о львах, это беспокойство и обо всех сообществах Африки.

quote: She called her Russian counterpart Sergei Lavrov to express her concern.

United States Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice also criticized Russia's decision.
