before: Yes, I will. - Sustained.
after: I saw a man wearing a black mask On top of a girl. He held his hand over her mouth And a knife to her throat.
ru: Не делая заключения, опишите пожалуйста в точности, что вы видели на лестнице?

quote: But, really, two conclusions we can draw from this.
before: APPLAUSE I mean, well done, James.
after: One, all identical cars aren't necessarily identical. Some of them do have pubic hairs in them and poo.
ru: Но, действительно, мы можем сделать из этого два вывода.

quote: I look at the numbers, I examine the science, and I draw a conclusion.
before: Not to give my personal opinion, but my medical opinion. I don't pass judgment on my employers.
after: It's not up to me what they do with the information that I give them. That sounds like a lot of ethical gymnastics.
ru: Я смотрю на цифры, изучаю научные данные, и делаю выводы.

before: Jesus isn't looking for a religious experience, he wants to spend the weekend with his girlfriend. I'm sure he'd rather be going to Disneyland.

ru: Но прежде, чем перейти к каким-либо выводам, давай поговорим об этом с Ривьера, хорошо?

quote: With metadata, who knows what the conclusions are that are drawn?
before: It's who they wrote to and when, and so forth. But it's been argued, and someone here in the audience has talked to a former NSA analyst who said metadata is actually much more invasive than the core data, because in the core data you present yourself as you want to be presented.
after: Is there anything to that? RL: I don't really understand that argument.
ru: Кто знает, какие выводы можно сделать по метаданным?

quote: So we're faced with this astounding conclusion: The decimal numbers cannot be put on a list.
before: It doesn't contain my decimal number. And, no matter what list you give me, I can do the same thing, and produce a decimal that's not on that list.
after: They represent a bigger infinity that the infinity of whole numbers. So, even though we're familiar with only a few irrationals, like square root of two and pi, the infinity of irrationals is actually greater than the infinity of fractions.
ru: Так мы пришли к такому поразительному выводу: невозможно составить полный список десятичных дробей.

quote: How had the other come to such outrageous conclusions about the world?
before: They would be understandably confused and caught off guard, but then a conversation would ensue. And it was civil — full of genuine curiosity on both sides.
after: Sometimes the conversation even bled into real life. People I'd sparred with on Twitter would come out to the picket line to see me when I protested in their city.
ru: Как другой человек дошёл до столь диких выводов по поводу окружающего мира?

ru: В ужасных условиях, где люди страдают и испытывают боль.

before: Hardly ever would we offer people what they desperately need to survive: a safe prescription for opioids. Starting with abstinence is like asking a new diabetic to quit sugar or a severe asthmatic to start running marathons or a depressed person to just be happy.
after: What makes us think that strategy would work for something as complex as addiction? While unintentional overdoses are not new, the scale of the current crisis is unprecedented.
ru: В остальных состояниях здоровья мы бы никогда не начали с самого экстремального варианта.

before: And you would speculate that the people who love Legos would build more Legos, even for less money, because after all, they get more internal joy from it. And the people who love Legos less would build less Legos because the enjoyment that they derive from it is lower.

source_ru: Цены на электронику снижаются, а не растут.

ru: Наша работа -сделать шаг в сторону и пусть покупатель выбирает.

quote: You know, a society where politicians are corrupt and consumers are poor?

after: But then, the more I learned about the relationship between innovation and corruption, the more I started to see things differently. Here's how this played out in sub-Saharan Africa as the region developed its telecommunications industry.
ru: Общество, в котором политики коррумпированы, а потребители бедны?

quote: And the thing is, is that oil is really an abstraction for us as the American consumer.

after: We're four percent of the world's population; we use 25 percent of the world's oil production. And we don't really understand what oil is, until you check out its molecules, And you don't really understand that until you see this stuff burn.
ru: И дело в том, что нефть для нас как для американских потребителей -- полная абстракция.

quote: We recognize that we are all part of the global food network: producers and consumers, you and me, and every farmer.
before: We use SMS because it is retentive. Farmers store their messages, they write them down in books, and in effect, we're drip-feeding agricultural manuals into the fields.
after: We're focusing now on trying to bring together producers and consumers to take action and take responsibility for not only food security, but for food safety. This beautiful animal is an African-Asian Sahiwal crossed with a Dutch Fleckvieh.
ru: Мы осознаём, что все мы — часть глобальной продовольственной сети: производители и потребители, вы и я, и каждый фермер.

This, in the Complaints Board's view, significantly diminished the offer of '3 GB data', to the extent that the offer could be considered to be 'exaggerated'.
ru: Поэтому комиссия по жалобам заявила, что это, скорее всего, введёт потребителя в заблуждение.

after: He's negligent, as we've established. He cares for nobody but himself.
ru: Дело здесь не в сословии Джорджа Моттерсхеда, а в содержании его характера.

quote: With his students watching he ate the contents of a baby calf's intestines with a spoon.

quote: I already had the lyrics, I had the form -- the Décima -- and the content.

after: When it's on top of the paper board, which is the opposite, it forms this. So even if you don't know anything about this book, you are forced to consider a single person straddling two planes of existence.

That's your big contribution is it, being there?

ru: Твой бонус, как обычно, будет зависеть от вклада в фирму.

ru: Хотя нормандцы в итоге исчезли как отдельный народ, их вклад сохранился.

And when the eyes spot something they like, our instinct is to move closer so the other senses can investigate.
after: It's able to pick up on natural chemical signals known as pheromones. These not only convey important physical or genetic information about their source but are able to activate a physiological or behavioral response in the recipient.
ru: Вклад обоняния в романтику больше чем просто способность чувствовать запах парфюма.

quote: Again, you can get the playback and personal contribution.

after: ~ You don't have to. ~ Oh, I think I do.
ru: Я приглашу твоих родителей в гости в любое удобное время.

after: Well, if this ends badly, you emerge the victor. Stefan dies through no fault of your own.

ru: Ты смотришь с той стороны, откуда тебе выгоднее, идешь наиболее удобным для себя путем.

ru: То есть, во-первых, это должно быть удобнее обычной машины.

What silk biologists do is we try to relate these sequences, these amino acid sequences, to the mechanical properties of the silk fibers.
after: This makes testing spider silk really, really easy to do in the laboratory, because we're actually, you know, testing it in air that's exactly the environment that spiders are using their silk proteins. So this makes quantifying silk properties by methods such as tensile testing, which is basically, you know, tugging on one end of the fiber, very amenable.
ru: Очень удобно, что пауки используют шелк только вне своего тела.

There was a time when this corner of the galaxy was without light.

" And I did what any obsessed parent would do, which is immediately started hitting the " back " button to see what else he'd been searching for.

before: Oh, are you pregnant? No!
after: The management training program. I took the test.
ru: Девушка, как по твоему я могу забеременеть одевая эту униформу, две смены в день?

quote: It was their second day, and Bassem was getting very weak.
before: A refugee's stay is supposed to be temporary. Back to Doaa and Bassem in the water.
after: And now it was Doaa's turn to say to Bassem, " My love, please hold on to hope, to our future. We will make it. "
ru: Второй день после атаки. Бассем сильно ослаб.

quote: That day, Americans tanks started arriving in Baghdad.
before: It was April 8, 2003. I was in Baghdad, covering the war in Iraq.
after: We were just a few journalists in the Palestine Hotel, and, as happens in war, the fighting began to approach outside our windows. Baghdad was covered in black smoke and oil.
ru: В тот день американские танки вошли в Багдад.

quote: We could change it and make it Seattle-Florida, that day, in real time.
before: So, it's fairly easy — If you say I'm going to be really good at one specific route, that's one thing, but it should be able to go, really be very good, certainly once you enter a highway, to go anywhere on the highway system in a given country. So it's not sort of limited to LA to New York.
after: So you were going from LA to New York. Now go from LA to Toronto.
ru: Мы можем его поменять, например, Сиэтл — Флорида, в тот же день, в режиме реального времени.

quote: The order lasts 28 days, and Nowak is anticipated to be back in court later.
before: Following the private court appearance, Sheriff Peter Hammond sent Nowak to the Murray Royal, a mental hospital, for assessment.

quote: There's a reason the dead didn't come back to life and start raiding our cupboards.
before: He's not going for it. Maybe 'cause a canned ham don't kick and scream when you try to eat it.
after: We need live bait. Have I mentioned that I really like your new haircut?
ru: Он прав. Ведь мертвецы почему-то восстали не для того, чтобы шарить по нашим кухням.

quote: It is quite a feat to kill that which is already dead.
before: My services are not for sale. And the word you are looking for is "Destroy."
after: But you don't understand. My mother was murdered.
ru: А убить того, кто уже мертв, довольно сложно.

quote: I've been dead inside ever since I found out that vamper killed my parents.
before: Try it. Boy, you think I'm afraid of dying?
after: So you gonna tell me where Warlow is or we both die. Either way works for me.
ru: Я мертв уже с тех пор, как узнал, что этот Варлоу убил мою семью.

quote: A.C. is so dead, it should be embalmed.
before: Nobody got into this deal to build another Atlantic city, Ben. Please don't talk to me about Atlantic City.
after: That is the past. This, right here... this is the future, and the flamingo is only the start, the first seed of what will be a mighty forest.
ru: Тот город настолько мертв, что его пора бальзамировать.

quote: See her dancing, summoning the dead, resurrecting new life.
before: Feel her spinning, spanning several lifetimes. Hear her speaking, sparking alarm.
after: Heaven hears her knocking on the door, safely transporting the ones who call for her assistance. Wild women, they open portals to new worlds, new speech, new dreams.
ru: Смотрите, как она танцует, вызывая мёртвых, воскрешая новую жизнь.

quote: Nine years later, 12 of them were dead and 30 had become disabled.
before: The problem is that this can cause real harm. In the 1950s, a psychiatrist named Eliot Slater studied a cohort of 85 patients who had been diagnosed with hysteria.
after: Many had undiagnosed conditions like multiple sclerosis, epilepsy, brain tumors. In 1980, hysteria was officially renamed " conversion disorder. "
ru: Через девять лет 12 из них были мертвы, а 30 стали инвалидами.

quote: They're no longer being taught to babies, which means, effectively, unless something changes, they're already dead.
before: Every language is an old-growth forest of the mind, a watershed, a thought, an ecosystem of spiritual possibilities. And of those 6,000 languages, as we sit here today in Monterey, fully half are no longer being whispered into the ears of children.
after: What could be more lonely than to be enveloped in silence, to be the last of your people to speak your language, to have no way to pass on the wisdom of the ancestors or anticipate the promise of the children? And yet, that dreadful fate is indeed the plight of somebody somewhere on Earth roughly every two weeks, because every two weeks, some elder dies and carries with him into the grave the last syllables of an ancient tongue.
ru: На этих языках больше не обучают детей, а это означает, что, если ничего не изменится, то они уже мертвы.

quote: A gunman shot Burundi environment minister Emmanuel Niyonkuru dead early on Sunday, local time (UTC+2).
The city's on edge as the deadline approaches for Mayor Kane...
before: I work all day. Where am I supposed to put my children?
after: They got here this morning before I did. What do you think he's doing about all this?
ru: Город на грани, поскольку приближается крайний срок для мера Кейна...

quote: And tomorrow's my deadline for telling them yes or no, so you gotta tell me tonight.
before: Sweetheart, I don't mean to pressure you, but the Caesars people have offered me a roulette pit of my own in Atlantic City. That's a big break.
after: Will you come with me? That's not what you mean when you say, "come with me."
ru: А завтра крайний срок, нужно дать ответ: да или нет. А сегодня жду ответа от тебя.

quote: Make the arrival of the Chinese your deadline.
before: I can't very well kill my brother while our guest are here. Then do it before.
after: Otherwise, this will go on forever. And how will the plan go away?
ru: Пусть прибытие китайцев станет твоим крайним сроком.

quote: I assume you've heard of deadlines?
before: Now! Now!
after: I've got Lockett warming up in the bullpen if you're not up to it. Excuse me.
ru: Думаю, ты слышала про крайние сроки?

quote: So to get work done, you've got to set a deadline, right?
before: With brainstorming we make you happy, we play games, and we say, " No criticism, " and you get all these weird, neat ideas. But in fact, if that's how you always were you'd never get any work done because you'd be working along and say, " Oh, I got a new way of doing it. "
after: You've got be anxious. The brain works differently if you're happy.
ru: Так что, чтобы завершить что-нибудь вам обязательно нужен крайний срок, да?

quote: So I had a very short deadline for a competition.
before: So I bought a month's worth of classes. (Laughter) And proceeded to look at — I wanted to set competition so I'd have a deadline — Parkinson's Law, the perceived complexity of a task will expand to fill the time you allot it.
after: I got a female instructor first, to teach me the female role, the follow, because I wanted to understand the sensitivities and abilities that the follow needed to develop, so I wouldn't have a repeat of college. And then I took an inventory of the characteristics, along with her, of the of the capabilities and elements of different dancers who'd won championships.
ru: Так что я поставил очень короткий крайний срок,

quote: That's sort of the deadline that the environmental models have shown us that we have to meet.
before: CA: So, in your mind, timescale and likelihood of actually taking something like this live? BG: Well, we need — for one of these high-scale, electro-generation things that's very cheap, we have 20 years to invent and then 20 years to deploy.
after: And TerraPower — if things go well, which is wishing for a lot — could easily meet that. And there are, fortunately now, dozens of companies — we need it to be hundreds — who, likewise, if their science goes well, if the funding for their pilot plants goes well, that they can compete for this.
ru: Это – крайние сроки, которые нам диктуют разработанные модели изменения окружающей среды

quote: The initial deadline for the peace talks was Sunday at midnight, but was extended thrice.
before: Rebel negotiators faced intense pressure to accept the amended deal, as diplomats from the United States, Britain, Canada and the European Union struggled to find common ground.
after: The peace plan was prepared by mediators from the African Union and was amended after the rebel groups did not agree at an early draft. International negotiators, including U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Robert Zoellick, Nigerian President Olusegun Obasanjo and British International Development Secretary Hilary Benn, said the deal was the best hope for peace in Darfur.

quote: So much for our deal with the Ursini.
before: Theoretically, yes. We've been tricked.
after: We just got a message from the seed ship. What does it say? "Target the command vessel."
ru: Вот вам и сделочка с Урсини. Пришло сообщение с установщика.

quote: Do you remember when you told us about one of your first gun deals, the Yakuza?
before: Oh. The same way that you almost did.
after: It was my first deal. The bullet that you used to shoot the Oni.
ru: Помнишь, когда ты рассказал нам о своей первой сделке с оружием, Якудзу?

quote: The way we remember it is, we had a deal, Eric.
before: You gave me tits, you're taking them out. Chocolate, boys?
after: Fuck the deal. You hustled me, motherfucker.
ru: Как мы помним это, Мы заключили сделку, Эрик.

quote: The deal you make is to sell the shares you buy on the same day.
before: ...and we've been there... Sorry, I have a dental appointment, okay?
after: And you'll earn money? - Enough to paint, anyway.
ru: Сделка состоит в том, что ты продаешь акции в тот же день, когда ты их купил.

quote: A company flies in, does a deal with a minister.
before: And the first step in that is selling the rights to resource extraction. You know how rights to resource extraction are being sold at the moment, how they've been sold over the last 40 years?
after: And that's great for the company, and it's quite often great for the minister — (Laughter) — and it's not great for their country. There's a very simple institutional technology which can transform that, and it's called verified auctions.
ru: Компания прилетает на самолёте, делает сделку с министром.

quote: And I thought that was the best deal in town, so I accepted it immediately.
before: And he thought I did very well — and I did, too — in the arts: this was my passion. And he said " If you go to MIT, " to which I had been given early admission, " I will pay for every year you're at MIT, in graduate or undergraduate — as much as you want — I will pay for an equal number of years for you to live in Paris. "
after: And I decided that if I was good in art, and I was good in mathematics, I'd study architecture, which was the blending of the two. I went and told my headmaster that, at prep school.
ru: Посчитав, что это выгодная сделка, я сразу же согласился.

quote: If you're wired to make deals, you make deals.
before: If you're wired to be an anthropologist, you'll be an anthropologist. If you're wired to be an undersea explorer, you'll be an undersea explorer.
after: If you're wired to paint, you paint. Did you know that God smiles when you be you?
ru: Если ты создан для того, чтобы заключать сделки, ты заключаешь сделки.

quote: They keep making a big deal about playing against Israel.
before: Yeah.
after: But the funny thing is that that tournament was in 2017 but in 2015, we both played against Israel in another tournament and nobody seemed to care, in the old tournament. I don't understand why they make it such a big deal.

quote: Rosalie, my dear, we're so happy to have you here with us.
before: Rhubarb pie! Your mother made it.
after: - We really missed you. - I'm happy too.
ru: Розали, дорогая, мы так рады, что ты сегодня с нами.

quote: I swore an oath to the care and nurturing of a dear friend.
before: You should just get out of here, baby. This ain't your problem.
after: Boop. Where did you come from?
ru: Я дала клятву, что буду заботиться о дорогом друге.

quote: You clearly no longer possess the power to arouse, dear Piers.
before: I am sure it does. It appears I am as limp as a wet palm frond.
after: How can you rally the king when you cannot even excite a simple, dirt-born rod? Bind the little French bitch.
ru: Ты утратил свою способность возбуждать, милый Пирс.

quote: What it's like to lose someone dear to you.
before: Takuma won't die and leave me behind. Don't make light of his life!
after: If you're going to be devastated then... It pains me to watch you. Let go of me.
ru: принцесса. каково это - потерять дорогого человека? оставив тебя одну?

quote: Sleep, actually, is something very dear to my heart, because my sleep is a disaster.
before: So what else can we sense about people using wireless signals? Sleep.
after: (Laughter) So one thing is when you start working on some physiological signal and you discover that yours sucks. (Laughter) So you can see why we can capture sleep, because the person walks and the device sees him as he walks to bed, when he stops tossing around in bed, when he steps out of bed, and that measure of sleep is what people call actigraphy.
ru: Сон — то, что дорого моему сердцу, поскольку я очень плохо сплю.

quote: She sings this song. It's called "Dear Heart."
before: In this scene, she sits at home. The phone is ringing, her friends are calling, but she doesn't know how to talk to them.
after: (Guitar) When I was dreaming, I took my body to beautiful places I'd never been. I saw Gibraltar, and stars of Kentucky burned in the moonlight, making me smile.
ru: И она начинает петь песню. Она называется «Дорогой друг».

quote: A good example of that light and color is a show I designed called "Dear Evan Hansen."
before: It's important to remember that, because when we design the world for you, the therapy is important. It tells you that emotion is going to become light and color.
after: (Cheers) " Dear Evan Hansen " exists — oh my God — " Dear Evan Hansen " exists in a world of almost all light and color. So I chose a color: inky-black darkness.
ru: Хороший пример света и цвета — мюзикл, над которым я работал, — «Дорогой Эван Хэнсен». (Звуки восторга)

quote: A 23-year-old Tokoroa man has been arrested for the murder of a school teacher, Lois Dear.
after: Dear's body was found on July 16 (Sunday) in her classroom at Strathmore Primary School, one day before term three of the New Zealand primary school year was to start.

quote: Did you say I act like my job is life and death?
before: Well, I-I tried to talk about it this morning, but I'm busy now. Uh-huh. I'm sorry.
after: Well, excuse me, my, my job is just death. Yeah, that's right.
ru: Ты сказала, что я отношусь к работе, как будто это вопрос жизни и смерти?

quote: Illness, old age, and death will be things of the past.
before: The Ultimate Serum. All forms of life will be invulnerable.
after: Mere memories. A more admirable goal than creating invincible soldiers, isn't it, Grandad?
ru: Болезни, старение, смерть окажутся в прошлом.

quote: It is a house of death for Maurice.
before: Lindy, you said this was a house of death for Maurice. Is it still?
after: Not his death. There's someone here.
ru: Это дом смерти для Мориса.

quote: You, me, an evil scheme, a little death.
before: Your cruelty is as sweet as this coffee I'm dumping this sugar into. Oh, Georgina, I missed this.
after: La petite Mort. You know I love it when you speak Spanish.
ru: Ты, я, кошмарный заговор, немного смерти.

quote: It had to do with death and disease and lots of other things.
before: Being someone who had had a very difficult childhood, a very difficult adolescence — it had to do with not quite poverty, but close. It had to do with being brought up in a family where no one spoke English, no one could read or write English.
after: I was a little prone to depression. So, as things got worse, as we really began to hate each other, I became progressively depressed over a period of a couple of years trying to save this marriage, which was inevitably not to be saved.
ru: Я видел смерть, болезни и кучу всего такого.

quote: Heart disease is the leading cause of death worldwide.
before: As we speak, there are 117 or so clinical trials researching the use of stem cells for liver diseases. What lies ahead?
after: 1.1 million Americans suffer heart attacks yearly. 4.8 million suffer cardiac failure.
ru: Заболевания сердца – главная причина смертности во всём мире.

quote: And I was on death row at that time.
before: That was then. But when Alexander came in, he was a young 20-year-old boy.
after: And we took him under our wing. It was an honest trust issue.
ru: А я в то время находился в камере смертников.

quote: The death toll was yesterday finalised at 71.
before: Four foreign men have today gone before a court in Hungary on suspicion of people smuggling. Their detention relates to Thursday's discovery of a lorry full of corpses in Austria.

quote: That he takes inches off a waist, and a decade off a jawline.
before: Sit on the chaise. People say Mr Beaton does a bit afterwards.
after: Do you suppose that's true? I know it's true.
ru: Что он убирает дюймы с талии, и десятилетия с подбородка.

quote: You're chastising yourself for failing to make a futile gesture a decade ago.
before: "Wise"? Does that matter?
after: Anyway, your feelings are trivial 'cause we have a murderer to catch. The bite mark, timeless expression of the frustration of impotence.
ru: Конечно, важно. Ты коришь себя за то, что не совершила бесполезный поступок десятилетие назад.

quote: For decades, terrorists have been fighting us, getting knocked down, rebuilding, then coming back at us.
before: It's logical. It's brilliant.
after: But if a U.S. nuke hits a Russian city-- they're gonna sit back and watch us destroy each other. There's only one way to fix this.
ru: На протяжении десятилетий, террористы пытались уничтожить нас, но безрезультатно.

quote: Although it didn't change much throughout the whole decade.
before: Whatever you need, I'm here. And then these are from the early '70s, so he probably wouldn't have arrived here yet.
after: This is one of the bedrooms. He, um... He would have stayed in a room just like this.
ru: Хотя он не сильно изменится на протяжении всего десятилетия.

quote: He pushed his pain agenda for decades, before it finally took hold in the mid-'70s.
before: He recast the very purpose of medicine. The goal wasn't to make patients better; it was to make patients feel better.
after: Hundreds of pain clinics sprung up all over the world. But as they did — a tragic twist.
ru: Он продвигал программу боли десятилетиями, пока она не окрепла в середине 70-х годов.

quote: The decades ahead will see dramatic advances in disease prevention, general health, the quality of life.
before: Find out what they are. You'll find your own way to discover, to learn, to teach.
after: All of humanity depends on the knowledge and practice of the medicine and the science behind it you will master. You have chosen a calling that will come in steps to give you satisfaction, at its conclusion, of a life well lived.
ru: В ближайшие десятилетия мы значительно продвинемся в вопросах профилактики заболеваний, общего здоровья, уровня жизни.

quote: Worldwide incomes have grown at a faster rate in the past decade than ever in history.
before: And that's just the United States. The global news is even better.
after: If anything, all these numbers actually understate our progress, because the new machine age is more about knowledge creation than just physical production. It's mind not matter, brain not brawn, ideas not things.
ru: Доходы по всему миру росли быстрее за последнее десятилетие, чем когда-либо в истории.

quote: The cost of education has increased far faster than inflation over the past several decades.
before: Higher education has been protected from price competition for many decades. The more government subsidizes education, the higher the price charged for that education with the result that the students and their parents end up paying as much as before.
after: From what I've seen and read, most university professors are grossly underworked. They need to spend more time teaching; there needs to be more innovation in teaching to keep the cost down (like online education, but certainly not limited to that).

quote: It just seems like an iffy decision at best.
before: -No, I don't mean that. I just mean with my mom in the other room dying.
after: -Honestly, I think she wanted this to happen. -Oh man.
ru: Мне просто кажется, что это не лучшее решение.

quote: Captain, I believe you have made the right decision.
before: All right. Let's go get this son of a bitch. Kirk out.
after: If I can be of assistance, I would be happy to accompany you on the away team. You?
ru: Капитан, я полагаю, вы приняли верное решение.

quote: Yeah, let's waste time discussing a decision I've already taken.
before: Man-bag and disruptor. Still reckon you'd be better off with the robot.
after: Tatty- bye. Boss on the move.
ru: Да, давай подискутируем на тему решения, которое я уже принял.

quote: You have a problem with my decision, you can take it up with him.
before: Number 10 Downing Street, London, SW1.
after: Mr. Menzies! Mr. Menzies!
ru: У вас есть проблемы с моим решением, Вы можете взять его с собой.

quote: I thought, maybe there's some earthly basis for moral decisions.
before: As an altar boy, I breathed in a lot of incense, and I learned to say phrases in Latin, but I also had time to think about whether my mother's top-down morality applied to everybody. I saw that people who were religious and non-religious were equally obsessed with morality.
after: But I wanted to go further than to say our brains make us moral. I want to know if there's a chemistry of morality.
ru: Я подумал, что может есть какая-то мирская основа для нравственных решений.

quote: I made a lot of mistakes and dumb decisions, of course.
before: (Laughter) And then I went home that night, and I had an even larger emotional meltdown, which I'll say more about in a minute. And this was all actually quite shocking to me, because prior to this moment, I had prided myself on having absolutely no regrets.
after: I do that hourly. But I had always felt like, look, you know, I made the best choice I could make given who I was then, given the information I had on hand.
ru: Я сделала много ошибок и приняла много глупых решений, конечно же.

quote: Now these decisions vary in the number of choices that they offer per decision.
before: Here's a German car manufacturer that gives you the opportunity to completely custom make your car. You've got to make 60 different decisions, completely make up your car.
after: Car colors, exterior car colors — I've got 56 choices. Engines, gearshift — four choices.
ru: Каждое из этих решений имеет разное количество вариантов выбора.

quote: Judge Duch Kimsan said he will announce his decision in the near future.
before: The trial took place behind closed doors and lasted a day. Lines was tried on charges of procuring an underage child for sex.

quote: Hey, Karsten's connections run deep, and none of the individual charges is a home run.
before: Seriously? I gave you assault, tax fraud, bribery...
after: 5 to 10 will be a win. 18 years' worth of testimony, and all you can pin him on is 5 to 10?
ru: Эй, связи Карстена имеют глубокие корни, и никакие личные обвинения не гарантируют полный успех.

quote: And I spoke to the bands that used to record at deep rock sound.
before: Where do we stand with our mysterious song? Well, we're not much closer than when we started, but we do have a partial name and former employment.
after: They remembered him and thought he was a great guy, but nobody knows what happened to him. And the cowbell guy said...
ru: Я говорил с группами, что записывают глубокий рок.

quote: Deep gash at the base of the skull. Two broken teeth. May I?
before: There you go. Get me the caretaker now.
after: "On absence without longing "On naked solitude On the steps of death
ru: Глубокая рана под волосами в затылочной части, 2 зуба сломаны.

quote: Gonna pick you up, and I want you to take a big, deep breath, okay?
before: Okay. Sorry.
after: - Biggest breath you can. - All right. And then hold it.
ru: Я возьму тебя и хочу, чтобы ты сделала глубокий вдох, хорошо?

quote: So let's think big and let's think deep.
before: And instead of getting taken to the natural history museum or an aquarium, you get taken out to the ocean, to an underwater Noah's Ark, which you can access through a dry-glass viewing tunnel, where you can see all the wildlife of the land be colonized by the wildlife of the ocean. Clearly, it would blow your mind.
after: Who knows where our imagination and willpower can lead us? I hope that by bringing our art into the ocean, that not only do we take advantage of amazing creativity and visual impact of the setting, but that we are also giving something back, and by encouraging new environments to thrive, and in some way opening up a new — or maybe it's a really old way of seeing the seas: as delicate, precious places, worthy of our protection.
ru: Так будем же думать масштабно и глубоко.

quote: In thinking about biofluorescence, I wanted to know, how deep does it go?
before: And here in the Solomon Islands, there's only a few thousand breeding females of this species left, and this is one of the hotspots for them. So it shows us how much we need to really protect these animals while they're still here, and understand them.
after: Does this go all the way to the bottom of the ocean? So we started using submarines, and we equipped them with special blue lights on the front here.
ru: Размышляя о биофлуоресценции, я хотел знать, как глубоко она проникает?

quote: And I've been fueled by a deep scientific curiosity, and a passion to change these statistics.
before: And this is exactly what I've been doing. For the past three years, I've been developing technologies that could ultimately aid clinicians with rapid, early-stage cancer diagnostics.
after: Last year however, this fight became much more personal when my wife was diagnosed with breast cancer. It was an experience that added a strong and unexpected emotional dimension to these efforts.
ru: Мною движет глубокая научная любознательность и страстное желание изменить эту статистику.

quote: People needed to walk in around one meter deep water or evacuate in trucks.
before: Some shops and the train services in the adjacent Chiang Mai city closed.
after: Authorities closed several major roads and contacted residents downstream advising to either evacuate or prepare to imminent floodings.

quote: Well, we only ended up there because of your defense.
before: Good work on your deal. Dorfman keeps everything he knows under wraps and you turn over the murderer.
after: Look, we can work with Dorfman, share your business. No thanks.
ru: Ну, так вышло лишь благодаря вашей защите.

quote: I've all but destroyed his king's pawn defense.
before: I didn't realize you two were so chummy. Oh, this isn't chummy.
after: - Whatever. - Mm.
ru: Я планирую разрушить его пешечную защиту короля.

ru: И существует несколько проектов, которые намеренно подражают экосистемам.

before: Why didn't I know about this? In my defense, the pet mortuary I get the dog meat from is very respected! Bye, Mort! You don't know me!
after: Now I don't even know if I can finish this one. Nope, I can. I guess this is for you. Hugo, let me talk to him. Maybe I can smooth this over.
ru: Хьюго, я каждый день ел хот доги из собак?

quote: You seven stick out like a dog in a manger.
before: Let me rephrase that. Tell me when y'all from.
after: Like he said, we're not from around here. You think you're the first time travelers I've ever come across?
ru: Вы всемером как собака на сене.

quote: There was a dog in the girl and a girl in the dog.
before: Previously On Dirk Gentlys Holistic Detective Agency. Todd saw Todd.
after: Are you Lidya Spring. Crazy bad guys.
ru: В девочке была собака, а в собаке — девочка.

quote: And if you think of dogs for example, dogs are now intentionally-designed creatures.
before: Now we actually have been doing it for a long time. We started selectively breeding animals many, many thousands of years ago.
after: There isn't a dog on this earth that's a natural creature. Dogs are the result of selectively breeding traits that we like.
ru: И если взять собак, например, собаки - это существа, созданные по плану.

quote: Tybalt thinks that the Montagues are nothing but cowardly dogs, and has no respect for them.
before: Tybalt basically calls out Benvolio, and in order to keep his honor, Benvolio has to fight. This dialogue gives us a good look at the characterization between these two characters.
after: Once again, adding dramatic tension to the scene. Okay, now here's a spoiler alert.
ru: Тибальд считает, что все Монтекки не кто иные, как трусливые собаки, и он их презирает.

quote: And everybody's dogs at home have an autobiographical self to a certain degree.
before: It's the autobiographical self which some species have, I think. Cetaceans and primates have also an autobiographical self to a certain degree.
after: But the novelty is here. The autobiographical self is built on the basis of past memories and memories of the plans that we have made; it's the lived past and the anticipated future.
ru: И все ваши собаки дома тоже в какой-то мере обладают автобиографическим «Я».

quote: The unnamed dog handler police officer stabbed in the head is in his 30s.
after: He was stabbed 3 times in the head and face and is currently being treated for his injuries.

quote: That's pretty big talk for somebody who's got a half a dozen domestic violence call-outs.
before: You have a prescription for that drug. We're talking about whores, not schoolgirls.
after: If you think my wife is gonna press charges, you must be dreaming. All due respect, Fred, you know what I think.
ru: Какие рассуждения от того, на кого было полдюжины звонков о домашнем насилии.

quote: You and your friend Eli responded to domestic disturbance regarding a Hans Schroeder.
before: If I was working, then yeah. You were working.
after: - Who? - Hans Peter Schroeder.
ru: Вы и Ваш друг Илай отреагировали на внутренние беспорядки, в коих был уличен и Ганс Шредер.

quote: This is a domestic garden, and there are adjacent residences.
before: Excuse me, Mr Amanjit! Mr Amanjit.
after: I do not consider your actions to be safe. And you would know all about safety wouldn't you.
ru: Это – домашний сад, и вокруг есть другие дома, где живут люди.

quote: She flips out, calls the cops, cries domestic abuse.
before: Stone freak. I ended up banging these other two.
after: I'm pretty sure I never laid a hand on her. Lew Ashby.
ru: Она разозлилась, вызвала полицейских и орала насчёт домашнего насилия.

quote: That one incident would be the end of the domestic robot industry.
before: (Laughter) So then what happens? Well, it happens like this: " Deranged robot cooks kitty for family dinner. "
after: So there's a huge incentive to get this right long before we reach superintelligent machines. So to summarize: I'm actually trying to change the definition of AI so that we have provably beneficial machines.
ru: Этот инцидент положил бы конец производству домашних роботов.

quote: Domestic violence incidents were down, as were mental health complaints.
before: The school performance of kids improved substantially. The hospitalization rate decreased by as much as 8.5 percent.
after: And people didn't quit their jobs. The only ones who worked a little less were new mothers and students — who stayed in school longer.
ru: Случаи домашнего насилия стали происходить реже. Уменьшились и жалобы на психическое здоровье.

quote: In the face of extreme immorality, domestic workers can be our moral compass.
before: So really important progress is being made. But I would argue tonight that one of the most important things that domestic workers can provide is actually what they can teach us about humanity itself and about what it will take to create a more humane world for our children.
after: And it makes sense, because what they do is so fundamental to the very basics of human need and humanity. They are there when we are born into this world; they shape who we become in this world; and they are with us as we prepare to leave this world.
ru: Домашние работники могут быть нашим моральным компасом перед лицом крайней аморальности.

quote: There is an ongoing domestic debate whether soldiers should continue to keep their firearms at home.
after: According to a study by Martin Killias, a criminologist at the School of Forensic Sciences and Criminology in Lausanne, army-issued firearms are responsible for 300 deaths annually in Switzerland and two-thirds of suicides-by-firearm are committed with army-issued firearms.

quote: They can't take anything unless you open the door.
before: - I appreciate it. Next time, don't open the door.
after: So, when do you think the cops are gonna question this guy? It's like I said, these cops, they're swamped.
ru: Они не смогут ничего забрать, если не открывать дверь.

quote: I, uh, get to his door, and I could hear music inside.
before: Sir. Call it in, get her out of here.
after: Like squeaky voices. And I thought, you know, maybe, uh... I knocked on his door.
ru: я у его двери и слышу из-за неё музыку.

quote: How did the killer get through the locked back door?
before: Too many unanswered questions. Like the number nine?
after: Thomas. Thomas?
ru: Как убийца прошёл сквозь запертую заднюю дверь?

quote: Please open the door if you're in there.
before: - You did good. - Thanks. Did we find Laurel?
after: Laurel! I'm gonna kill you if you're alive in there!
ru: Пожалуйста, открой дверь, если ты там.

quote: At last -- a long corridor, a stair and a door.
before: And you've been shuffling down long corridors, past statues, frescoes, lots and lots of stuff. You're heading towards the Sistine Chapel.
after: You're at the threshold of the Sistine Chapel. So what are you expecting?
ru: И наконец — длинный коридор, лестница и дверь.

quote: We've just opened the door, and it's for all of you to step through it.
before: And we have a — I have a little something here. Now I do want to say that, you know, Ugobe is not there yet.
after: We did include some things that are hopefully useful. Excuse me, Pleo.
ru: Мы лишь открыли дверь, и вы все можете зайти через неё.

quote: They are focusing on the revolving door, opening and shutting.
before: So on that frame, the children who are typical are watching this, the emotion of expression of that little boy as he's fighting a little bit with the little girl. What are the children with autism doing?
after: Well, I can tell you that this divergence that you're seeing here doesn't happen only in our five-minute experiment. It happens moment by moment in their real lives, and their minds are being formed and their brains are being specialized in something other than what is happening with their typical peers.
ru: Они смотрят на крутящуюся дверь, как она открывается и закрывается.

quote: The unidentified gunmen reportedly kicked down the doors of five houses and fired shots inside.
after: The dead include five children, four men, and two women. Three people were wounded by the gunshots and taken to a hospital for treatment.

quote: Double load of iron and silver. Not the most pleasant way for a fae to pass.
before: aah! aah!
after: You don't really think that you can keep him, do you? We handed over our evidence.
ru: двойная порция железа и серебра не очень приятная смесь для фейри

quote: Okay, so that's a double almond mocha latte, no whip, for Taylor.
before: Ladies and gentlemen, there is life out there. And now... it's here.
after: Aliens. What's next, right?
ru: Хорошо, это двойной миндальный мокаччино, без сливок, для Тейлора.

quote: And a double order of guac and chips, por favor.
before: - Dos Equis. - Just water, please.
after: Excuse me, Miss. You recognize this man?
ru: И двойные чипсы с гуакомоле, пожалуйста.

quote: They'll have a double shot almond milk latte to go.
before: What can I get you? I know what you're having.
after: Do I know you? Name on that's Taylor Amber Mason.
ru: Двойной латте с миндальным молоком, с собой.

quote: Women experience the double whammy of ageism and sexism, so we experience aging differently.
before: A culture that tells us that getting older means shuffling offstage. That's why the World Health Organization is developing a global anti-ageism initiative to extend not just life span but health span.
after: There's a double standard at work here — shocker — (Laughter) the notion that aging enhances men and devalues women. Women reinforce this double standard when we compete to stay young, another punishing and losing proposition.
ru: Женщины испытывают двойной стресс: эйджизма и сексизма, поэтому мы ощущаем старение по-другому.

quote: You mix them together and they make a rigid double helix.
before: We want to look at individual strands and not think about the double helix. When we synthesize it, it comes single-stranded, so we can take the blue strand in one tube and make an orange strand in the other tube, and they're floppy when they're single-stranded.
after: Now for the last 25 years, Ned Seeman and a bunch of his descendants have worked very hard and made beautiful three-dimensional structures using this kind of reaction of DNA strands coming together. But a lot of their approaches, though elegant, take a long time.
ru: Но если их перемешать, они составят негнущуюся двойную спираль.

quote: So it was one of those really superior double bluff kind of things that took place.
before: Those of us who are, sometimes you feel like you're a little bit on your own doing some of this work. That passage of the law and the repeal of the law fortified the case of the Piarco Airport accused.
after: But what were they accused of? What was it that they were accused of?
ru: Это был один из тех случаев, когда был использован двойной блеф.

quote: Ogilvy didn't win purely by Mickelson's double bogey, though.
after: He saved par on the 17th with a chip-in from the rough, and overcame a few tough shots to save par at the 18th. His last two US Opens resulted in a missed cut in 2003 at a tie for 28th last year.

quote: When I rang you a month ago, I must admit, I had my doubts.
before: Why won't you listen? Why call me in if you won't listen to me? !
after: The Ironsides seemed too good to be true. Yes! Right! So destroy them!
ru: Когда я звонил тебе месяц назад, должен признать, у меня были сомнения.

quote: A generous offer, no doubt, but I'm afraid too little too late.
before: A gold sovereign for every infidel you sent to a watery grave. And more to come, as you ply your destructive trade for the Kingdom of Naples.
after: Leonardo has been in my employ now for considerable time. And in many ways, he is more brother to me than aide.
ru: - Это щедрое предложение, без сомнений, но, боюсь, вы немного опоздали.

quote: All that struggling and surviving has tired him, no doubt.
before: Just wait there. He's a little slow tonight.
after: Please, Mr Oxenby. Outmoded hypocrite.
ru: Ну да, вся эта "Борьба за выживание" измотала его, без сомнения.

quote: Forensic tests prove beyond a doubt that she has.
before: Your husband said that Abigail had never been in his car. I'm afraid to say that he wasn't telling the truth.
after: Well, there must be some kind of mistake. Your husband smokes Marlboro Lights, doesn't he?
ru: Экспертиза доказывает, что, без сомнения, она была.

quote: And that doubt leads to questioning, and that questioning leads to quitting.
before: So that was fun. (Laughter) So really, for most circumstances, for most teenagers and most people, when they get criticized, it leads to doubt.
after: Because, when you have a topic that you're interested in, or a movement that you want to be a part of, and you're taking a stance and saying what's true, good ideas don't avoid criticism. And for especially young people, they have a hard time dealing with that, and these important discussions that need young people to take a part in, it takes a lot of commitment.
ru: Сомнение ведёт к вопросам, и вопросы заставляют сдаваться.

quote: And there is no doubt that fast catch up can take place.
before: You see, Japan did it like that. We add Japan to it.
after: Can you see here what Japan did? Japan did it like this, until full catch up, and then they follow with the other high-income economies.
ru: И нет сомнений, что можно наверстать быстро.

quote: Now, Tsarnaev is guilty, there's no doubt about that.
before: Now, when a jury has to make the decision between life in prison and the death penalty, they base their decision largely on whether or not the defendant feels remorseful for his actions. Tsarnaev spoke words of apology, but when jurors looked at his face, all they saw was a stone-faced stare.
after: He murdered and maimed innocent people, and I'm not here to debate that. My heart goes out to all the people who suffered.
ru: Да, Царнаев виновен, в этом нет сомнений.

quote: The ruling cast doubt on the reliability of evidence against Lahcen, who was released on bail.
before: Describing conditions at the Cuban detention centre as "impossible to explain, much less justify", Hamed — better known as the "Spanish Taliban" — saw a July 2006 ruling by the country's Supreme Court annul his six-year prison sentence, granting him an immediate release.

quote: Look, I'm not saying that this offer is without its downsides.
before: But they still haven't changed their mind about stopping Savage? Well, according to them, he's part of the natural course of history, terrible as that course may be.
after: If we abandon our plan now, then I still lose my wife and son. So why throw in the towel?
ru: Послушайте, я не говорю, что у этого предложения нет недостатков.

quote: Only downside is, it burns off all the alcohol.
before: - Wow! - Not done.
after: Looks amazing. Yeah, you don't have to kill yourself for me.
ru: Единственный недостаток в том, что весь алкоголь испарился.

quote: I should say that, obviously, there are downsides.
before: - I love your website by the way. You're so clever and sorted.
after: Relationships become impossible. You work strange hours.
ru: Я должна сказать, очевидно, о недостатках.

quote: Downside of my diet-- getting hit actually hurts.
before: Ow. [coughs] ow. That hurt.
after: [groans] whew. I'm impressed, Stefan.
ru: Недостаток моей диеты.. При ударах действительно больно.

quote: However, there are also some downsides to this.
before: Since then, the Internet has transformed the way we communicate, the way we do business, and even the way we live. In many ways, the ideas that gave birth to Google, Facebook, Twitter, and so many others, have now really transformed our lives, and this has brought us many real benefits such as a more connected society.
after: Today, the average person has an astounding amount of personal information online, and we add to this online information every single time we post on Facebook, each time we search on Google, and each time we send an email. Now, many of us probably think, well, one email, there's nothing in there, right?
ru: Тем не менее, существуют и недостатки.

quote: The downside is, we don't really understand what the system learned.
before: Now, the upside is: this method is really powerful. The head of Google's AI systems called it, " the unreasonable effectiveness of data. "
after: In fact, that's its power. This is less like giving instructions to a computer; it's more like training a puppy-machine-creature we don't really understand or control.
ru: Минус в том, что мы не знаем, что именно система выучила.

quote: It's a whole new way of doing things, which includes new downsides.
before: And I use that word advisedly. It's a revolution in that it's a change in equilibrium.
after: In the United States right now, a woman named Judith Miller is in jail for not having given to a Federal Grand Jury her sources — she's a reporter for the New York Times — her sources, in a very abstract and hard-to-follow case. And journalists are in the street rallying to improve the shield laws.
ru: Это абсолютно новый способ делать что-то, и ему присущи принципиально новые недостатки.

quote: Are there any downsides of using a non-destructive ZooMS procedure?
Look, I typed up a draft plea offer for you.
before: If you're thinking of going not guilty, that's a murder trial! The Crown's going to be all out for your blood.
after: This is a choice. You've got life, with a minimum of 20 years for murder, or sign the offer, do six years and see your son finish school, instead of missing the whole thing.
ru: Смотри, я набросала тебе образец признания.

quote: It took me four drafts to get it right.
before: Uh, here is my token of gratitude, per your request. Now, when you copy that out, do not change a word.

before: And do you, Luann, take Kirk-- despite the fact that he is fundamentally the same man that you said in court was unfit to load your dishwasher? Whose very touch repulsed you? - Uh, your... - Whose many annoying...
after: Just say "I do." I do.
ru: Вы читаете черновой вариант наших брачных клятв.

quote: The rough draft that we prepped with you last week is in play.
before: Here is your final copy. ... the details, the very existence of this project must be so carefully protected.
after: This is starting to look pretty good. I can't even tell them apart. Which one is the new one?
ru: Черновик, который мы подготовила, уже в игре.

quote: So this is the main idea, but science is a rough draft.
before: And the reason why it's so hot goes back to the previous slide. The extreme gravity of these systems is accelerating particles of gas to great speeds, and great speeds means great temperatures.
after: There are many basic properties about this plasma that still confuse us, still puzzle us, and still push our understanding of the physics of the very hot. Third thing: probing the very small.
ru: Вот основная идея, но наука представляет собой черновик.

quote: OK, so what's on the first draft of the moral mind?
before: Nature provides a first draft, which experience then revises. ' Built-in' doesn't mean unmalleable; it means organized in advance of experience. "
after: To find out, my colleague Craig Joseph and I read through the literature on anthropology, on culture variation in morality and also on evolutionary psychology, looking for matches: What sorts of things do people talk about across disciplines that you find across cultures and even species? We found five best matches, which we call the five foundations of morality.
ru: Отлично, так что насчёт черновика нравственности?

quote: Creating a good cartoon involves repeated failures, draft after draft.
before: (Speaks Spanish) We have lost the space for nuanced debate, we have no time, so we simply respond with approval or disdain, and we let algorithms take over. (Speaks Spanish) But a cartoon is born from a space of deep, nuanced thinking.
after: And a cartoonist must shed their own taboos to spark a conversation, rather than a confrontation, through their work. (Speaks Spanish) In the year 2013, President Chavez died, and I had to think about what to draw as the cartoon of the day at " El Universal. "
ru: Создание успешной карикатуры включает многочисленные ошибки и бессчётные черновики.

quote: Initial reports show the draft constitution will be supported.
before: The historic Iraqi vote on the proposed draft constitution ended on Saturday, and ballots are now being tallied.
after: Security during voting day was tightened, although the U.S. military has announced that five American soldiers and a marine were killed by a bomb blast on the day of the referendum, bringing the U.S. death toll in Iraq to 1,971.

quote: I feel like it's a once in a lifetime opportunity to pursue my dream.
before: - I'm gonna stop you right there. David, this documentary is going to air in two weeks.
after: Uh-huh. But-- Every minute that I spend here is time not spent making audition videos for reality dating, cooking, or singing shows.
ru: И я чувствую, что это шанс всей моей жизни, чтобы следовать за мечтой.

quote: It's just been kind of a dream until now.
before: - Have you written others? - No. No, this is my first.
after: Any other dreams I can help you with? So, what's it about?
ru: До сих пор это было только мечтой.

quote: The man had a magnificent chin and a dream.
before: Then why are you building a DeLorean? Because I always admired John DeLorean.
after: To build a car company from the ground up. I just wanted to capture a little piece of that magic.
ru: У него был величественный подбородок и мечта.

quote: I never told you because I thought it was a dream.
before: I'm sorry, daddy. Thanks for meeting me.
after: And I wanted it to be, but it wasn't. Now, now, now, now, now, slow down.
ru: Я никогда не говорила тебе, так как думала, что это был сон.

quote: Even as a child, it seemed, Lincoln dreamed heroic dreams.
before: He had a huge ambition. But it wasn't simply for office or power or celebrity or fame — what it was for was to accomplish something worthy enough in life so that he could make the world a little better place for his having lived in it.
after: He somehow had to escape that hard-scrabble farm from which he was born. No schooling was possible for him, except a few weeks here, a few weeks there.
ru: Ещё в детстве у Линкольна были большие мечты.

quote: In my dreams I fantasize of wreaking vengeance on you guys.
before: It's not enough your software crashed my Mac, and it constantly hangs and bombs — it erased my ROMs! Now the Mac makes the sounds of silence.
after: Say your motorcycle crashes. Blood comes gushing from your gashes.
ru: Я закрываю глаза и мечтаю о страшной и сладкой мести.

quote: Now, it's been one of those dreams that's always seemed about 20 years in the future.
before: Now, in those situations, wouldn't it be great if there was a button on your dashboard that you could push, and the car would get you home safely? Now, that's been the promise of the self-driving car, the autonomous vehicle, and it's been the dream since at least 1939, when General Motors showcased this idea at their Futurama booth at the World's Fair.
after: Now, two weeks ago, that dream took a step forward, when the state of Nevada granted Google's self-driving car the very first license for an autonomous vehicle, clearly establishing that it's legal for them to test it on the roads in Nevada. Now, California's considering similar legislation, and this would make sure that the autonomous car is not one of those things that has to stay in Vegas.
ru: И эта мечта почему-то всегда оказывалась где-то на 20 лет впереди.

quote: They kicked off the show with a performance of Boulevard of Broken Dreams.
before: Green Day arrived at the event in their rusted green convertible from the Holiday and Boulevard of Broken Dreams music videos.

quote: What if the other driver was wearing gloves?
before: If we can rule out other drivers, then we can build a pretty good case. Right.
after: Helping or hindering, Wendy, which one's it going to be? I am helping.
ru: А что, если водитель был в перчатках?

quote: I'm a driver and attaché for Mr. Gerald Lydon of Lydon Industries.
before: Oh. You say "we." All I see is a you.
after: You know the company? You make everything from Scotch Tape to diamond-tipped drill bits.
ru: Я водитель и атташе мистера Геральда Лайдона из Лайдон индастриз.

quote: But she didn't see the driver, or the plate.
before: The witness said Craig was knocked over by a black sedan. Hit-and-run.
after: Jesus, is there really so much cash involved they're prepared to kill for it? It would seem that way.
ru: Но она не разлядела ни водителя, ни номера.

quote: The reports said that it was likely a drunk driver.
before: Yeah. Did you know that Nick's parents died in a car accident? Yeah. He was 12, hit-and-run.
after: - They never found him. - Uh-huh. But Nick was in the accident.
ru: В отчете сказано, что водитель, скорее всего, был пьян.

after: If people are working, we've surveyed them. And what we know, in terms of their happiness: workers all want the same things.
ru: Мы опрашиваем руководителей, полицейских, водителей грузовиков, поваров, инженеров.

quote: For millions of drivers in many parts of Africa, this is the norm.
before: Imagine if your daily commute involved tens of kilometers on these kinds of roads, driving this kind of vehicle, without any nearby service stations or breakdown assistance.
after: Since over 90 percent of passenger cars are imported, often used, they're just not designed for local usage. High import duties often compound the problem, sometimes doubling the price of a car.
ru: Для миллионов водителей во многих частях Африки это обычное дело.

quote: You're really a driver or a passenger -- to use a Volkswagen phrase.
before: And again, think about it. You're makers of food; you're makers of shelter; you're makers of lots of different things, and partly what interests me today is you're makers of your own world, and particularly the role that technology has in your life.
after: Makers are in control. That's what fascinates them.
ru: И вы на самом деле -- либо водитель, либо пассажир, если использовать фольксвагенскую фразу.

quote: Robert Kubica (BMW Sauber) was the only driver to gain a substantial amount of places.
after: He started in 11th but finished on the podium in third place.

before: Man... we have patrolled every inch of this city. We sure have. Look.
after: Yeah, I knew something was fishy. Too many junkies were taking romantic rides around the duck pond. You're a damn good cop, 'cause you're the one who figured out that he was hiding the drugs in the manure bag.
ru: Парк, где мы арестовали извозчика, торговавшего наркотиками.

before: Let's hope he's not a cop, too. I don't get it.
