before: So they took their money and their projects to others who would serve them better. Well, it didn't take long for business to drop like a rock.
after: It was down to just the two of us, and we were about to go under. And that was great.
ru: Мой партнёр Томас и я распустили всех работников.

quote: By this point, I was definitely not going to be an employee.
before: I would collect for the papers — he could just deliver them. Because then I realized I could make money.
after: (Laughter) My dad owned an automotive and industrial repair shop. He had all these old automotive parts lying around.
ru: В этот момент я точно не собирался быть наемным работником.

quote: You offer 50 funds -- 10 percent fewer employees participate than if you only offer five.
before: A colleague of mine got access to investment records from Vanguard, the gigantic mutual fund company, of about a million employees and about 2,000 different workplaces. What she found is that for every 10 mutual funds the employer offered, rate of participation went down two percent.
after: Why? Because with 50 funds to choose from, it's so damn hard to decide which fund to choose, that you'll just put it off till tomorrow, and then tomorrow and then tomorrow and tomorrow, and, of course, tomorrow never comes.
ru: Если вы предложите 50 фондов, то будут участвовать на 10% меньше работников, чем в случае, если вы предложите только пять.

quote: Casino inspectors, who are state employees, are no longer working.
before: All 12 casinos in Atlantic City locked their doors for the first time in the 28-year history of legalized gambling in New Jersey.
after: While the casino floor is shut down, many casinos have remained open for hotel, restaurant, and entertainment business.

quote: What, am I not good enough to hang out with the rest of you now?
before: I heard from Clementine you were having a little party. I had to hear it from her.
after: Oh, no. Come on in.
ru: Что, я не достаточно хороша для того, чтобы потусоваться с вами?

quote: Long enough to know that I'm extremely impatient to read your book.
before: Thank you. Um, have you been her doctor long?
after: I was pleased last night when you didn't ask the question everybody else always does. What question's that?
ru: Достаточно долго, чтобы с нетерпением ждать возможности почитать вашу книгу.

quote: It seems to me that Mr Norrell has done enough.
before: It did not say that you would visit her. It did not say that you had any rights over her.
after: I do not know what Mr Norrell has done. He will not tell me.
ru: Мне кажется, мистер Норрелл достаточно натворил.

quote: It is enough that his people conspire to overthrow me.
before: We don't know he's gonna strike against us. He's yet to do anything.
after: This is harsh, but necessary. I take no pleasure in killing the boy.
ru: Достаточно того, что его народ устраивает заговор, чтобы свергнуть меня.

quote: Maybe all of us, if you live long enough.
before: (Laughter) But the real reason, I think, I was a misfit, is that my daughter died the day she was born, and I hadn't figured out how to live with that story yet. After my daughter died I also spent a long time homeless, living under an overpass in a kind of profound state of zombie grief and loss that some of us encounter along the way.
after: You know, homeless people are some of our most heroic misfits, because they start out as us. So you see, I'd missed fitting in to just about every category out there: daughter, wife, mother, scholar.
ru: Может быть, даже все мы, если живём достаточно долго.

quote: But during all of this, he realizes he doesn't really know enough about taxonomy.
before: So immediately, Darwin starts making notes. Now, of course, he's still working on the theory of evolution and the development of the human infant.
after: So he starts studying that. And in the end, he spends eight years becoming the world's leading expert on barnacles.
ru: Но во время всего этого он сознаёт, что на самом деле не достаточно знает о таксономии.

quote: I don't think the solutions that I proposed are good enough or smart enough.
before: And in the novel, a particular one named Alvin is created. And he says, maybe this isn't the best way, and wrecks the whole system.
after: I think the big problem is that we're not smart enough to understand which of the problems we're facing are good enough. Therefore, we have to build super intelligent machines like HAL.
ru: Не думаю, что предлагаемые мною решения достаточно правильны или достаточно умны.

quote: "If Billy can not earn enough to live, then taxpayers are effectively subsidising business," she said.
Dominated the fight the entire way, but he falls prey to a very technical finish.
before: And Midnight Le is shocked. He thought he'd get a free pass into the second round, but, instead, he's going home.
after: A very technical finish, but that's a fluke. -I don't care what anybody says. That is a...
ru: Он доминировал почти весь бой, но стал жертвой весьма техничного финиша.

quote: He will take this entire city down with him.
before: I can help you win. He's not gonna go down without a fight.
after: * Satan, your kingdom must come down * * Satan, your kingdom must come down *
ru: Он утащит за собой на дно весь этот город.

quote: Contractor says the entire sub level is flooded, though.
before: Or... So they told me. I could never get that stupid door to open.
after: It was a water main break. A super hacker is trying to take over the city and I'm worried about you.
ru: Хотя подрядчик сказал, что весь нижний этаж затоплен.

quote: We can't have the entire town aware of this.
before: So what do we do? Just keep it quiet.
after: We need to find him before he finds us. Hey, man.
ru: Нельзя, ..чтобы весь город знал.

quote: It took up the entire fairing of a rocket just to launch it.
before: This one weighs three tons. It's six meters tall, four meters wide.
after: One satellite, one rocket. It cost 855 million dollars.
ru: Чтобы его запустить, понадобился целый головной обтекатель ракеты.

quote: It took an entire year's work to get Christopher on the record.
before: And he told me how this company, that worked for both Trump and Brexit, had profiled people politically in order to understand their individual fears, to better target them with Facebook ads. And it did this by illicitly harvesting the profiles of 87 million people from Facebook.
after: And I had to turn myself from a feature writer into an investigative reporter to do it. And he was extraordinarily brave, because the company is owned by Robert Mercer, the billionaire who bankrolled Trump, and he threatened to sue us multiple times, to stop us from publishing.
ru: Понадобился целый год для того, чтобы убедить Кристофера заговорить.

quote: Pink's squad and another squad spent their entire day outside the wire.
before: But the thing that I know you all have heard a lot of times, American soldiers saying, " Why don't they talk about the good stuff that we do? " OK, this is a perfect example.
after: They didn't have to go outside the wire. There were not Americans hurt out there.
ru: Отряд Пинка и еще один отряд провели весь день по ту сторону забора.

quote: It was funny to see the entire band, including two drum sets, in a small stage!
before: That makes me very happy and delighted. There was a good spirit.
after: But our crew managed to make us fit there… I am sure that things are getting better from now on. As for the first show, Berlin was amazing beginning for us.

quote: I was raised in a dysfunctional home environment.
before: I torture all my friends. It's how I show love.
after: You killed my mom! Did I?
ru: Я рос в нездоровой домашней обстановке, знаешь ли.

quote: See, I knew he didn't develop a passion for the environment.
before: Really? However, as of at least noon today, there is no associate named Scott McGreevy at GreenWorld in Mobile.
after: What is he up to? Well, I did find a law firm in Mobile that does have an associate named S. McGreevy.
ru: Я знал, что его не обуяла страсть к окружающей среде.

quote: Mattie? I believe this to be an improper environment.
before: My name's Leo. Where are you?
after: They're my friends, you're just going to help us with a science project for school. Why don't you come and sit down, Anita?
ru: Мне кажется, что это обстановка нам не подходит.

quote: Iva suits are designed for controlled temperatures, controlled environments, controlled pressures.
before: What's wrong? Nothing.
after: You know what has none of those? - Space.
ru: Скафандр рассчитан на определенную температуру, окружающую среду и давление.

quote: They live, they breathe, they die, they eat things from the environment.
before: They do all sorts of great things like moving around on the floor; they go into our gardens and they eat our crops; they climb trees; they go in water, they come out of water; they trap insects and digest them. So they do really interesting things.
after: Our current robots don't really do that. Now, wouldn't it be great if you could use some of those characteristics in future robots so that you could solve some really interesting problems?
ru: Они живут, дышат, умирают, добывают пищу из окружающей среды.

quote: This stuff will cure cancer, heal our environment and stop our cruel treatment of other creatures.
before: And I say this, having spent countless hours interviewing global leaders in synbio and also researching their work for science podcasts I create. I have come to fear their work, in case I haven't gotten that out there yet — (Laughter) but more than that, to revere its potential.
after: So how do we get all this without, you know, annihilating ourselves? First thing: like it or not, synbio is here, so let's embrace the technology.
ru: Благодаря им мы сможем победить рак, поможем окружающей среде и перестанем плохо обращаться с братьями нашими меньшими.

quote: And it uses these sensors to build a map of the environment.
before: And what if there's no GPS? So this robot is actually equipped with a camera, and a laser rangefinder, laser scanner.
after: What that map consists of are features — like doorways, windows, people, furniture — and it then figures out where its position is, with respect to the features. So there is no global coordinate system.
ru: Он использует датчики для построения карты окружающей среды.

quote: "Mr. Baird, you are the minister of the environment, not the minister of finance," Suzuki said.
after: "Your job is to protect the environment."

quote: Niklaus, your manners are, as always, without equal.
before: Fled Europe and survived the seas. Would you rather I arrive hungry on the shores of our new homeland?
after: Sir, would you be so good as to tell us where it is that we have arrived? The French colony of Louisiana off the shores of a town they've named New Orleans.
ru: Никлаус, твои манеры как всегда не имеют себе равных.

quote: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.
before: Saving our men from a harsh fate won't spare you from yours, Robert. Did you really think General Howe would countenance your insubordination of last month's prisoner exchange?
after: Or consequence, if you prefer. Inspector General Innes has granted me full authority to overhaul our provincial forces before they become, and I quote,
ru: Для каждого действия есть равное по силе противодействие.

quote: Kate, Paul may not see you as an equal, but, perhaps, you've contributed to that.
before: - I'm not saying you're a monster, Paul. In fact, if you'll listen, I'm not even saying it's all you.
after: Maybe it's how you wanted to be seen. It's what was comfortable for you.
ru: Пол не видит тебя как кого-то, равного себе, но, возможно, ты способствовала этому.

quote: God does not give all of us equal happiness.
before: If you are not happy with him. If you don't love him then come along with me.
after: Some of us have to snatch our share of happiness from him. You also snatch your share.
ru: Бог не дает всем равного счастья.

quote: It says that something is equal to something else, and that's two different perspectives.
before: We've seen this over and over, and we represent it like this. But think about it: this is an equation.
after: One perspective is, it's a sum. It's something you plus together.
ru: В нём говорится: что-то равно чему-то ещё, и это два разных угла зрения.

quote: We have to change it so that people have equal opportunity.
before: And if you look at the economy, it really is only providing opportunities now to people with a better education. And we have to change this.
after: We have to change it so that the country is strong and stays at the forefront of things that are driven by advanced education, like science and mathematics. When I first learned the statistics, I was pretty stunned at how bad things are.
ru: Мы должны изменить это, чтобы у людей были равные возможности.

quote: A real education has to give equal weight to the arts, the humanities, to physical education.
before: I'm not here to argue against science and math. On the contrary, they're necessary but they're not sufficient.
after: An awful lot of kids, sorry, thank you — (Applause) One estimate in America currently is that something like 10 percent of kids, getting on that way, are being diagnosed with various conditions under the broad title of attention deficit disorder. ADHD.
ru: В настоящем образовании должно уделяться равное внимание изобразительному искусству, гуманитарным наукам, физической культуре.

quote: Though ball possession was equal the telling statistic was the shot total.
after: Ukraine had 19 shots; nine on target. Saudi Arabia had six shots; none on target.

quote: Take out equipment from the outrigger and then sink it.
before: Put the gun down, Benjamin. Go to the dock.
after: - You got it. - She's not going anywhere.
ru: Забери все оборудование со шлюпки, а потом пусти ее ко дну.

quote: And it's a terrible thing when you have such a desire and the equipment doesn't work.
before: And I've had implants. I've had quite a drive, you know, as well and... you know, I've had problems.
after: It's like wanting to sing and being tone deaf. And no one knows.
ru: Так ужасно, когда у тебя такое сильное желание, а оборудование подводит.

quote: This was plan B, damage the transmission equipment.
before: So he hired you... To make sure the UN speech didn't happen. He has me recruit some protestors to rough Carlos up, but it didn't scare him off.
after: Why? So the speech won't be heard in Russia until tomorrow.
ru: Был запасной план, испортить передающее оборудование.

quote: You mean a platform at the entrance to store the machines, equipment, etc?
before: Initially, I just need to establish a base to prepare things. A base?
after: Yeah, a platform. Do you have the plans or should we use the old ones?
ru: Вы имеете в виду площадку у въезда, где будут стоять машины, оборудование и прочее?

quote: Virtually none. All of our equipment, including film equipment, was charged by the sun.
before: We were burning about 8,500 a day, so we needed it. How many batteries do you carry for all the equipment that you have?
after: And do you get along? I certainly hope so, because at some point or another on this expedition, one of your teammates is going to have to take a very big needle, and put it in an infected blister, and drain it for you.
ru: Нисколько. Всё наше оборудование, включая камеру, заряжалось от солнца.

quote: Just basically though, it is a basic piece of equipment.
before: What's interesting about high falls is that although we use airbags, and some airbags are quite advanced, they're designed so you don't slip off the side like you used to, if you land a bit wrong. So, they're a much safer proposition.
after: It's a bouncy castle with slats in the side to allow the air to escape. That's all it is, a bouncy castle.
ru: Проще говоря, это достаточно примитивное оборудование.

quote: Largely through globalization, a lot of this equipment has got a lot cheaper.
before: They work at their leisure, if you like. They take their leisure very seriously: they acquire skills; they invest time; they use technology that's getting cheaper — it's not just the Internet: cameras, design technology, leisure technology, surfboards, so on and so forth.
after: More knowledgeable consumers, more educated, more able to connect with one another, more able to do things together. Consumption, in that sense, is an expression of their productive potential.
ru: Главным образом из-за глобализации, большинство этого оборудования стало существенно дешевле.

quote: On side streets, large containers were also parked housing broadcasting equipment.
before: Preparation for the festivities started on the weekend, during which workers had set up stages, sound systems, and displays for the event. Between 42nd and 48th Streets and beyond, equipment for the event was set up by production crews.

quote: Strange, I never forget a face. Especially a pretty face.
before: I don't think so. Are you sure?
after: Good day! Good evening I mean.
ru: Странно, я никогда не забываю лица, особенно красивые.

quote: Well, hairdressers know everything, especially local hair-associated facts.
before: Did they, indeed? Oh, yeah, and I also called the village hairdressers about Mrs Webb and asked about her wig.
after: Well, childbirth. All of her hair fell out when she gave birth to Megan.
ru: Ну, парикмахеры знают все, особенно местные связанные с волосами факты.

quote: I mean, especially for a young man with your skill set.
before: - Yeah. Tyler, the truth is there's not much to this job.
after: You're gonna be bored out of your mind. Thank you, sir, but it doesn't mix with my meds.
ru: Особенно для парня с такими способностями.

quote: And you do well with the classics, especially in the soft rock mode.
before: "I'll Stand By You" by the Pretenders. It's in your wheelhouse, and I know you know it from the radio because it's a classic.
after: Yeah, I do like that song, but... how is it going to make me feel better again? By singing it out.
ru: А у тебя отлично получается классика, особенно в рок-стиле.

quote: And this is a big concern, especially considering where we are now.
before: As you know, there are already more than a billion hungry people on this planet. We're expecting that problem to get worse as world population grows to nine billion or 10 billion by midcentury, and we can expect to have greater pressure on our food resources.
after: Now we know that our arable land per capita is already on the decline in both developed and developing countries. We know that we're headed for climate change, which is going to change rainfall patterns, making some areas drier, as you can see in orange, and others wetter, in blue, causing droughts in our breadbaskets, in places like the Midwest and Central Europe, and floods in others.
ru: Это серьёзная проблема, особенно учитывая, где мы сейчас.

quote: I'm a scientist, and I'm a big fan of Star Trek, especially of Mr. Spock.
after: Mr. Spock is a scientist as well, and at the same time, he's the first [officer] of the starship Enterprise, and during the adventures of the Enterprise crew, he and his colleagues are dealing a lot with the presence or absence of Mr. Spock's emotions. Mr. Spock is half-human and half-Vulcan, and Vulcans are an alien race who learn to control and suppress their feelings and to act purely out of logic.
ru: Я — учёный, а также большой фанат «Звёздного пути», особенно господина Спока.

quote: Sometimes it's hard to breathe, especially carrying all the heavy filming equipment.
before: But at 15,000 feet, it's tough. It's freezing cold, and that thin air really gets you.
after: And that pounding head just feels like a constant hangover. But the advantage of that wonderful thin atmosphere is that it enables you to see the stars in the heavens with amazing clarity.
ru: тяжело дышать, особенно когда тащишь тяжёлое кинооборудование.

quote: It is especially the latter I'm most satisfied with.
after: In 3D movie production the compositing stage creates a giant content bottleneck. By transparently integrating this in our render-pipeline, a very efficient workflow has been achieved.

quote: My team has been reduced to essential personnel, and the floor is being cleared now.
before: Per the multiple nondisclosure agreements you've signed. Yeah, and despite my objections, your procedure has been listed as minor outpatient surgery.
after: My team will make sure of that. Of course.
ru: Ассистентов сократили до самых необходимых, и весь этаж очищают от посторонних людей прямо сейчас.

quote: They may be essential. But I'm not going after Ramse.
before: Is she alive again? Those injections are essential for this mission!
after: With whatever time is left, he should be a father to that boy. You know, you're right about one thing.
ru: Может и необходимы, но я не пойду за Рамси.

quote: This is my Bunsen burner, essential kit for testing urine.
before: And don't forget, spread the word. You tell one woman to paint her windows, she tells five of her pals, and before you know it, every family in Poplar is prepared for a nuclear attack.
after: What might I be testing it for? - Protein?
ru: Это моя бунзеновская горелка, необходимый комплект для тестирования мочи.

quote: Sound ideas in theory, but each defeated by an essential flaw in the human psyche.
before: For thousands of years the human mind has been at war with itself: religion, Marxism, fascism, capitalism.
after: What flaw? Human selfishness and vanity are ingrained, indelible.
ru: В теории звучат хорошо, но каждую из них уничтожил существенный недостаток человеческой психики.

quote: Was that essential to sort of maintain the quality of what was being built?
before: CA: But during the actual development of Linux itself, that stubbornness sometimes brought you in conflict with other people. Talk about that a bit.
after: How would you describe what happened? LT: I don't know if it's essential.
ru: Была ли упёртость необходима для поддержки качества сделанного?

quote: We make up language if we don't have it, and in mathematics, this is essential.
before: And by " pattern, " I mean a connection, a structure, some regularity, some rules that govern what we see. Second of all, I think it is about representing these patterns with a language.
after: It's also about making assumptions and playing around with these assumptions and just seeing what happens. We're going to do that very soon.
ru: Мы придумываем язык, если у нас его нет, а в математике это просто необходимо.

quote: This stage is essential for developing long-lasting material for the likes of, say, a t-shirt.
before: Cellulose goes on to make up over 90% of the fiber’ s weight. The more cellulose that gets deposited, the denser that secondary layer becomes — and this determines the strength of the final fiber.
after: The garment’ s capacity to withstand years of washing and wear is largely determined by the density of that secondary cell wall. On the other hand, its softness is strongly influenced by the length of the fiber, established with the remodeling of the primary wall layer.
ru: Данный этап необходим для формирования долговечности материала таких изделий, как, скажем, футболка.

quote: It's essential that we understand the mentality of these killers.
before: On Saturday, in the State Dining Room after the meeting, Bush alluded to the challenges facing the U.S. “This is a different kind of struggle than we've ever faced before.
after: And so therefore we worked with Congress to protect — pass the Protect America Act, which everybody knows has expired.”

quote: I don't even remember going to bed last night.
before: I blacked out... That's never happened before.
after: I don't remember a thing. You don't remember anything?
ru: Даже не помню, как дошел до кровати.

quote: Even I know that, and I'm an intern.
before: All right, enough. You know that live nerves are better than dead ones.
after: And you. You put me in a really awkward position today.
ru: Даже я знаю это и я интерн.

quote: They didn't even exist when Ethan was built.
before: Uh... That's impossible. We're still fine-tuning the ethical adaptor algorithms.
after: He learned right and wrong from us, this Humanich's learning from an equation. Okay, Julie, I am sympathetic to your situation but if I don't show my superiors some progress, they will find someone else who can deliver.
ru: Они даже не существовали, когда был построен Итан.

quote: Bowel obstructions, even partial ones, can become life-threatening situations.
before: - Everything okay? He wants to leave.
after: We can't discharge you until it's cleared. - It doesn't hurt anymore.
ru: Обтурация кишечника, даже небольшая, может стать угрозой для жизни.

quote: They called themselves Chekists, and even the emblem was very similar, as you can see here.
before: It evolved later into the well-known KGB. The Cheka was the idol of the Stasi officers.
after: In fact, the secret police of Russia was the creator and instructor of the Stasi. When the Red Army occupied East Germany in 1945, it immediately expanded there, and soon it started to train the German Communists to build up their own secret police.
ru: Они называли себя чекистами, и даже эмблема выглядела похоже, как можно видеть здесь.

quote: Even in the face of threats, he stayed authentic.
before: And, yeah, there are some people out there who do it and they feel that they are doing a religious obligation. JC: David wasn't ashamed of who he was.
after: LD: At the opposite end of the spectrum is Argentina. Argentina's a country where 92 percent of the population identifies as Catholic.
ru: Даже перед лицом угроз он оставался верен себе.

quote: The patients even called it "The Chemo Trail."
before: They were too nauseous, so they'd walk back to their hotels. This desire path that you see diagonally, formed.
after: Now, when the hospital saw this originally, they tried to lay turf back over it, ignore it. But after a while, they realized it was an important need they were meeting for their patients, so they paved it.
ru: Пациенты даже дали ей имя «След химиотерапии».

quote: Even though a technology will bring advantages or disadvantages for different sectors.
before: As of WiMAX, although it's the future trend of networking technology, but many companies just looked on its advantages rather than its potential threats which information security companies mostly concerned. "Prevention is better than cure."

quote: After your reaction Saturday evening, who else would write such grotesque threats?
before: - It came from your computer? I didn't write it.
after: I didn't write it, period. The first lapse, the first slip-up in your work, and I will use it to fire you.
ru: После твоего поведения в субботу вечером, кто ещё мог написать такие страшные угрозы

quote: You wrote and said she saw Vera on the evening of the day of her death.
before: Whatever the reason, it's over. The point is someone has to question Mrs Bartlett.
after: That's right. She went for a walk.
ru: В письме ты сказала, что она видела Веру вечером в день ее смерти?

quote: You're telling me you would rather spend the evening in Larry's box?
before: Larry's friend, Jeff, will be joining him in his luxury box at the Laker game tomorrow night. I just have to cancel my plans with Lyndsey.
after: - Hey. - Hey. - How'd the acting class go?
ru: Ты хочешь сказать, что лучше проведешь вечер в ложе Ларри?

quote: This evening, we look deeper into Sarah Keaton, the young woman tragically murdered three weeks ago.

ru: потому что моя нога как будто бы стоит на земле.

before: There stands matters of more pressing concern. Let us sweep city for Ulpianus and the others.
after: Gratitude. There's more over here.
ru: Не хватало нам ещё римлян, путающихся под ногами и жаждущих посильнее нам навредить.

quote: One foot on the ledge, and the other on the void.
before: Come on, that's it. Welcome to my world.
after: Fuck man, that's fucked up. There's no reception in this house.
ru: Одна нога на уступе, а другая в пустоте.

before: It's not quite the TED Prize, but it is an exclusive t-shirt from our lab. So please send me your ideas about how to design a foot.
after: We have to first know what a foot is. If we go to the dictionary, it says, " It's the lower extremity of a leg that is in direct contact with the ground in standing or walking " That's the traditional definition.
ru: Значит, если мы хотим разработать ступню, что нужно сделать?

quote: But when he entered the king’s chamber, he was dismayed to see Death settled at the foot of the bed.

after: The doctor desperately wanted the glory of saving the king — even if it meant deceiving his Godfather. And so, he swiftly spun the bed around and reversed Death’ s position, leaving the doctor free to administer the antidote.
ru: Но когда он вошёл в палаты короля, то с ужасом обнаружил, что Смерть стоит у него в ногах.

quote: My right leg will be unburdened, my right foot will freely meet the wire.

ru: Тогда правая нога окажется свободной, и вторая ступня без препятствий коснётся каната.

The stolen vehicle then bounced off the guardrail on the right shoulder and impacted a Ford pickup truck before coming to rest.

after: This may look and sound - GRRR!
ru: Но в SLS - это нечто большее, чем грубая сила.

quote: And don't worry, the Force is strong in this one.
before: I'm so jealous. Enjoy, while we sort this out.
after: Ah, no idea what that means, but I'm pumped. Well, have fun.
ru: И не беспокойся, Сила пребудет с нами.

quote: That's the driving force at the core of every human being.
before: We're not infected and we're not sick. The person who pulled the curtain on me all they were trying to do was survive a little bit longer.
after: Forget morality and ethics and all the other bullshit they say they're striving for. The living just care about surviving as long as humanly possible.
ru: Вот сила, что движет самой сутью каждого человека.

quote: First, there's physical force and a capacity for violence.
before: Our focus is on the civic arena, where power means getting a community to make the choices and to take the actions that you want. There are six main sources of civic power.
after: Control of the means of force, whether in the police or a militia, is power at its most primal. A second core source of power is wealth.
ru: Первый — физическая сила и готовность к применению насилия.

quote: Words, like numbers, express fundamental relationships between objects and events and forces that constitute our world.
before: Let's have a look at the third question. It's a line from a poem by John Keats.
after: It stands to reason that we, existing in this world, should in the course of our lives absorb intuitively those relationships. And poets, like other artists, play with those intuitive understandings.
ru: Слова, как и числа, выражают базовые отношения между объектами, событиями и силами, которые составляют наш мир.

quote: And we, all of us, we are life force.
before: Life moves inexorably toward more life, toward healing, toward wholeness. That's a fundamental ecological truth.
after: On the face of it, the primary link between women, girls and a warming world is not life but death. Awareness is growing that climate impacts hit women and girls hardest, given existing vulnerabilities.
ru: И все мы — это жизненная сила.

quote: Prior to today's incident and after Wednesday's alleged chemical attack, government forces heavily bombed the area.
before: The seizure comes just days after government forces were accused of carrying out a large-scale chemical attack in the Ghouta region of Damascus on Wednesday. Reports say anywhere between 100 and 1,300 people were killed in the attack.

quote: "We go live to Patrick Dartmouth, Katie's father, and former foreign minister."
before: At least until we've sent it to Iraqi intelligence and police. OK. See if they can identify him before we open it to the public.
after: "This is very sudden and shocking news. Katie always knew..."

before: I would not mind a little one-on-one session with Jenna Kaye. The thought does stimulate my imagination, too.
after: Why do you do that? I had a little fantasy worked out.
ru: Юридически, ЦРУ может допрашивать, только иностранных граждан.

before: They tore Miranda's apartment up, looking for it. You know, but this guy, this fake Drexler, he's...
after: Miss Stiles, I'd like you to accompany one of my agents back to your apartment. Make an account of the damage while Dr. Pierce and I retrace his steps, see if we can find this man.
ru: Возможно, он агент иностранного правительства.

quote: I won't talk to a single nobleman or foreign diplomat.
before: Mary, I thought I was clear. You cannot be a part of this.
after: Not Narcisse or the Germans, no one who knows or cares who I am. But... but what will you...
ru: Я не стану разговаривать с одним дворянином или иностранным дипломатом.

quote: Foreign direct investment has poured into Africa in the last 15 years.
before: Does anyone recognize this? In fact, they do.
after: Back in the' 70s, no one touched the continent with a barge pole. And this investment is actually Western-led.
ru: Иностранные прямые инвестиции приходили в Африку в последние 15 лет.

quote: I was finally there, although I had nothing to do -- I was a foreign expert.

So I was arrested quite early in Stalin's purges, and spent 16 months in a Russian prison.
ru: Я в конце концов оказалась там, хотя собственно дела не было – я была иностранным экспертом.

quote: Government cut through all the red tape, we got foreign vets on it. It was great.
before: So, people talk about political will. During the die-off of the gharial we did galvanize a lot of action.
after: So, we can do it. But if you stroll down to the Yamuna or to the Gomati in Lucknow, or to the Adyar river in Chennai, or the Mula-Mutha river in Pune, just see what we're capable of doing to a river.
ru: Правительству удалось обойти бюрократию и нам прислали иностранных ветеринаров.

quote: Foreign travel advisories are warning tourists of an increased threat of terrorist attacks in Turkey.
Look, I know you had a rough night, but I'm on top form.

after: I want to get you out of this. Thank you.

after: You shouldn't pull that kind of dangerous prank! Can you register a marriage using a registration form signed ten years back?
ru: У меня до сих пор сохранился тот бланк. Я хотел им воспользоваться.

quote: Anyone who resists will simply serve in a less-conscious form.

after: What does that mean? You'll find out soon enough, because your family will be first in line if you refuse our offer.
ru: Любой, кто сопротивляется будет просто служить в менее сознательной форме.

quote: Form 1 means that she's a, a danger to herself and possibly to other people.
before: It's just, it's just the way they-they keep track. Dad, I came all the way here.
after: So she's in the hospital involuntarily. So is it as bad as it's ever been?
ru: "Форма 1" значит, что она представляет угрозу для себя и, возможно, окружающих.

quote: So this is the world's first synthetic life form.
before: (Laughter) It only took us four years and 40 million dollars to be able to take this picture. (Laughter) And what we did is we took the full gene code out of a cell — not a gene, not two genes, the full gene code out of a cell — built a completely new gene code, inserted it into the cell, figured out a way to have the cell execute that code and built a completely new species.
after: And so what do you do with this stuff? Well, this stuff is going to change the world.
ru: Итак, это первая в мире синтетическая форма жизни.

quote: And much of what I do is either wearable or somehow related to the human form.
before: (Laughter) So just to give you a bit of context, as June said, I'm an artist, a technologist and an educator. I teach courses in physical computing and wearable electronics.
after: And so anytime I talk about what I do, I like to just quickly address the reason why bodies matter. And it's pretty simple.
ru: Большинство моих творений либо можно носить на себе, либо они как-то связаны с человеческой формой.

quote: We've seen that it can affect matter and cause form within matter.
before: And there's not many people working in this field. But consider for a moment that sound does have form.
after: Then sort of take a leap and think about the universe forming. And think about the immense sound of the universe forming.
ru: И мы видели, что он может влиять на материю и создавать формы из материи.

quote: Malaysia has strict media laws but they function less effectively on newer forms of electronic media.
after: Leading members of the ruling coalition, Barisan Nasional (the National Front) have suggested making amendments to its media laws, such as to punish bloggers who publish materials that are deemed controversial and "anti-government".

quote: You're a former spy who faked her own death 20 years ago.
before: What kind of son hires a P.I. to keep tabs on his mother? Okay, let's be honest, we're not exactly the Waltons.
after: I got issues, Mom. I got trust issues.
ru: Ты - бывшая шпионка, инсценировавшая свою смерть 20 лет назад.

quote: What's a former mvp doing with our ambulance chasing Pitbull?

after: You just got benched. I think we may just have dug our own graves.
ru: Как бывший лучший игрок связан с навязчивым адвокатом Питбулем?

quote: This is Angela, former Special Agent Dresser's ex-wife.

after: We need to find your ex-husband. I heard.
ru: Это Анжела, бывшая жена специального агента Дрессера.

quote: He's a former senator, he's respected on both sides of the aisle.
before: And I ask this committee to assign a special prosecutor... If someone is to prosecute, I nominate Lawrence Boch.
after: I have my disagreements with Boch, but I can overcome them in the spirit of bipartisanship. What bipartisanship?
ru: Он бывший сенатор, уважаемый обоими сторонами.

quote: So I spent the next two years interviewing convicted terrorists, jihadis and former extremists.
before: Men that I've been afraid of most of my life. Men that I've also deeply disliked, for many, many years.
after: What I already knew, what was very obvious already, was that religion, politics, Europe's colonial baggage, also Western foreign policy failures of recent years, were all a part of the picture. But what I was more interested in finding out was what are the human, what are the personal reasons why some of our young people are susceptible to groups like this.
ru: В течение следующих двух лет я брала интервью у осуждённых террористов, джихадистов и бывших экстремистов.

quote: It's a little alarming to have a former neo-Nazi say, "Hey, how are you?"
before: If you want to talk, I'm here. " Now, we kind of expected death threats from this sort of interaction.
after: But actually, we found that around 60 percent of the people reached out to responded, and of that, around another 60 percent had sustained engagement, meaning that they were having conversations with the hardest people to reach about what they were going through, planting seeds of doubt and giving them alternatives for talking about these subjects, and that's really important. So what we're trying to do is actually bring unlikely sectors to the table.
ru: Немного пугает, когда бывший неонацист пишет тебе: «Привет, как дела?»

quote: Others were uncomfortable with his former communist affiliation.
before: In spite of his decades of service, Rustin’ s positions on certain political issues were unpopular among his peers. Some thought he wasn’ t critical enough of the Vietnam War, or that he was too eager to collaborate with the political establishment including the president and congress.
after: But ultimately, both his belief in collaboration with the government and his membership to the communist party had been driven by his desire to maximize tangible gains in liberties for black Americans, and to do so as quickly as possible. Rustin was passed over for several influential roles in the 1960s and 70s, but he never stopped his activism.
ru: Другим не нравилась его прежняя причастность к коммунистам.

ru: Видел, сколько тяжелой артилерии движется вперед?

after: Colonel Ismat is the leader of the Democratic faction, dedicated to freeing the Syrian people. And since Secretary Durant is temporarily sidelined, I'm stepping in today because the American government supports any concrete steps toward stability.

ru: Но забросить работу мы не можем, нужно продвигаться вперед, нужно создать синтез.

ru: Она врач. Одна бесплатная бариевая клизма, и моей маме уже всё равно, что она не еврейка.

quote: And we expect to do so for free.

after: Shiny towers are an invasive species and they are choking our cities and killing off public space. We tend to think of a facade as being like makeup, a decorative layer applied at the end to a building that's effectively complete.
ru: И мы ожидаем, что это будет бесплатно.

quote: It's about whether it's actually possible to have a free and fair election ever again.
before: And it's bigger than any of us. And it is not about left or right or " Leave " or " Remain " or Trump or not.
after: Because as it stands, I don't think it is. And so my question to you is, is this what you want?
ru: Вопрос в том, возможно ли теперь свободное и честное голосование в принципе.

quote: We have a choice. We've been blessed, or cursed, with free will.
before: We just want to try and create that awareness because, sure, changing a light bulb isn't going to change the world, but that attitude, that awareness that leads you to change the light bulb or take your reusable coffee mug, that is what could change the world. I really believe that we stand at a very important point in history.
after: We can choose a greener future, and we can get there if we all pull together to take it one stroke at a time. Thank you.
ru: У нас есть выбор. Свободная воля -- наше благословение и проклятие.

after: I guess I just wanted to thank you for making me believe again. Mum...
ru: Бороться со всем и всеми, кто лишает нас свободы.

ru: Если вам нездоровится, незамедлительно посетите ваш местный медицинский центр Свободы.

before: They achieve autonomy. The price to pay, however, is leaving the garden.
after: Again, marketers tell us that big data and social media are not just a paradise of profit for them, but a Garden of Eden for the rest of us. We get free content.
ru: Так и тайна частной жизни, в некотором роде и возможность и цена, которую нужно платить за свободу.

quote: That's what technology is bringing us: choices, possibilities, freedoms.
before: Those are all basically the same thing. And those are the things that technology brings us.
after: That's what it's about. It's this expansion of room to make differences.
ru: Вот что технология приносит нам: варианты выбора, возможности, свободы.

quote: We have curtailed their opportunities and their freedoms.
before: NDB: By telling girls that no deed can be kept secret, that their bodies will reveal them no matter what, we have endowed them with fear. Girls are afraid of ruining themselves, either through sport, play, tampon use or a sexual activity.
after: It's time we put an end to the virginity fraud. It's time we break the myths about the hymen once and for all.
ru: Тем самым мы ограничиваем их возможности и их свободу.

quote: This was followed by chants of "Libertad", the Spanish word for freedom.
before: "We want freedom for everyone," said Betancourt while speaking to a crowd of thousands in Paris, France.

before: No one did. I was locked upfor 12 years.
after: Do you have any idea how stupid that sounds? We need to be careful.
ru: Знаешь, мне был нужен свежий воздух.

before: - A gimlet, um... - Well, obviously he can't.

ru: Вы предпочитаете свежие лаймы, сэр, или ликёр?

after: You must be longing for a walk after your journey. Do you have any outdoor shoes?
ru: Я подумала, что вместо аудиенции в кабинете мы можем подышать свежим воздухом.

before: Almost certainly happened before he hit the ground. Dead men don't bruise.
after: What if it came from our killer's foot? Which he got when he was kicked in front of the bus.
ru: И я не вижу никакой свежей смоли на улице или на его ботинках.

quote: The fresh air clears his mind and help him think better.
before: One of the best known of Zeno's problems is called the dichotomy paradox, which means, " the paradox of cutting in two " in ancient Greek. It goes something like this: After a long day of sitting around, thinking, Zeno decides to walk from his house to the park.
after: In order to get to the park, he first has to get half way to the park. This portion of his journey takes some finite amount of time.
ru: Свежий воздух очищает его разум и помогает сосредоточиться.

quote: His music never ceases to sound fresh and surprising to me.
before: I didn't hear the boundaries. I still start every day practicing playing Bach.
after: But as I was moving away from the traditional classical repertoire and trying to find new ways of musical expression, I realized that with today's technological resources, there's no reason to limit what can be produced at one time from a single string instrument. The power and coherency that comes from one person hearing, perceiving and playing all the voices makes a very different experience.
ru: Его музыка никогда не прекращала звучать для меня свежо и удивительно.

quote: He said, "If I keep tossing myself off I get fresh sperm being made."
before: Sperm that sit around in the body for a week or more start to develop abnormalities that make them less effective at head-banging their way into the egg. British sexologist Roy Levin has speculated that this is perhaps why men evolved to be such enthusiastic and frequent masturbators.
after: Which I thought was an interesting idea, theory. So now you have an evolutionary excuse.
ru: Он решил: «Если я то и дело буду рукоблудить, то будет вырабатываться свежая сперма».

quote: And so those scars were still like, really fresh.

before: When you put them together, they behave like one high-performance quadrocopter. If anything goes wrong, however — a motor fails, a propeller fails, electronics, even a battery pack — the machine can still fly, albeit in a degraded fashion.
after: (Applause) This last demonstration is an exploration of synthetic swarms. The large number of autonomous, coordinated entities offers a new palette for aesthetic expression.
ru: Мы сейчас это покажем, выведя из строя одну из его половин.

quote: If kids lose five months of learning every single year, that's half of their education.
before: That's five months. The school year in the United States is only 10 months.
after: Half. If kids were in school over the summer, then they couldn't regress, but traditional summer school is poorly designed.
ru: Если дети теряют пять месяцев обучения каждый год, то это половина их образования.

quote: In fact, they've accounted for half of all civil wars.
before: The record on post-conflict recovery is not very impressive. 40 percent of all post-conflict situations, historically, have reverted back to conflict within a decade.
after: Why has the record been so poor? Well, the conventional approach to post-conflict situations has rested on, on kind of, three principles.
ru: Половина всех гражданских войн – это именно такие ситуации.

quote: The first half ended with a 0–0 score.
before: Peru won a penalty kick in the 44th minute, conceded by Yussuf Poulsen which was confirmed by the video assistant referee. But Peru's Christian Cueva missed from the spot kick as the ball went over the cross bar.

quote: The climate and energy minister is waiting for you in the Hall of Mirrors.
before: I may stay the night there. Okay?
after: Thank you. Good morning.
ru: Министр энергетики и экологии ждет вас в Зеркальном зале.

quote: They have left their bright halls to see us.
before: Can you feel it, Gyda? Can you sense the presence of the gods gathering here?
after: They are here for sure. They walk among us. And make their judgments on us.
ru: Они оставили свои светлые залы, чтобы увидеть нас.

quote: Well, there were people running in the hall.
before: - Who else lives in this house? - How should I know?
after: You must have seen them. The only person I've met in this house is you.
ru: Здесь были люди, бегущие по залу.

quote: Tales of your deeds will honor these halls for longer than you can imagine.
before: I'm never gonna call you that, buddy. Thank you, Amaya.
after: The honor is mine, Your Grace. Hey. So you're staying?
ru: Рассказы о твоих подвигах будут удостаивать честью эти залы гораздо дольше, чем ты думаешь.

quote: She came out in the hall to chat with me for a few minutes.
before: It was almost midnight when I got to his room. He was asleep, but I found his mother reading by flashlight next to his bed.
after: It turned out that what she had been reading was the protocol that the chemotherapy doctors had given her that day. She had memorized it.
ru: Она вышла в коридор на несколько минут поговорить со мной.

quote: The clients have asked us to produce a great chamber music hall.
before: But what I wanted to do was take a couple of seconds that I have left to just talk about the hall itself, which is kind of where we're really doing a massive amount of work. So, the hall is a multi-purpose hall.
after: Now, that's really tough to do with a hall that has 1,100 seats. Chamber and the notion of chamber has to do with salons and small-scale performances.
ru: Заказчики попросили нас создать большой зал камерной музыки.

quote: It's very fashionable to talk about human trafficking, in this fantastic A-C hall.
before: And there is a long pause. And then she says, " Not one of our girls. "
after: It's very nice for discussion, discourse, making films and everything. But it is not nice to bring them to our homes.
ru: Сейчас очень модно говорить о торговле людьми, в этом красивом зале.

quote: Hall notably presented UK game show It's a Knockout.
after: He has recently been featuring as an association football commentator on BBC Radio 5 Live, although the corporation said he was not scheduled to present at the station this weekend. Hall was awarded an OBE in the last New Year Honours for services to charity and broadcasting, having had a broadcasting career lasting fifty years.

quote: There was just something about building that house. It was just so hands-on and rewarding.
before: Thank you. I'll look.
after: A little addicting, huh? Yeah, a little bit. I would love to do more.
ru: Просто было что-то в постройке того дома, что-то практическое и стоящее.

quote: All right, you need hands-on training, a crash course in security hacks.
before: I can do this. If we pull it off, we follow the trail right back to Whelan's boss.
after: Well, that I can help with. I think I can get her up to speed.
ru: Хорошо, тебе нужна практическая тренировка, ускоренный курс взлома сигнализаций.

quote: Dallas was taking a new, hands-on approach to life.
before: It's okay. Ever since her breakup with George,
after: Can I help you? Oh, I can damn sure help myself!
ru: Даллас старалась применять к жизни практический подход.

quote: Anatomy was fun but less hands-on than I expected.
before: In cubicles. With two weeks vacation. By the way, did I tell you I'm switching my major?
after: I'm sorry, Cap. About what? The fact that I don't have a "plan"?
ru: Анатомия была забавной, но мене практической, чем я ожидал.

quote: Our rural field officers deliver practical, hands-on training to farmers in the field every two weeks.
before: Farmers pay us little by little over time, covering most of our expenses. And then we surround all that with training.
after: Wherever we deliver our services, farmers use these tools to climb out of poverty. This is a farmer in our program, Consolata.
ru: Наши сотрудники обеспечивают практическое обучение фермеров на их земле каждые две недели.

quote: There's a nobility of real, hands-on, dirt-under-your-fingernails work.
before: There's space to experiment and to weld and to test things. We have an amazing advocate in Dr. Zullinger.
after: But beyond our personal reasons for wanting to be there, there is a huge need. There is a total vacuum of creative capital in Bertie County.
ru: Здесь масса реальной, практической, иногда грязной работы.

quote: The documentation and the hands-on teaching methodology is also open-source and released as the Creative Commons.
before: So, you know, I like this idea that hardware becomes like a piece of culture that you share and you build upon, like it was a song or a poem with Creative Commons. Or, the software is GPL, so it's open-source as well.
after: Just the name is protected so that we can make sure that we can tell people what is Arduino and what isn't. Now, Arduino itself is made of a lot of different open-source components that maybe individually are hard to use for a 12-year-old kid, so Arduino wraps everything together into a mashup of open-source technologies where we try to give them the best user experience to get something done quickly.
ru: Документация и методика практического обучения также доступна и выпущена Creative Commons.

quote: Chiao and Sharipov briefed Krikalev and Phillips on day-to-day operations and gave them hands-on opportunities at Station maintenance.
before: Krikalev and Phillips will have light duty for the next two days, as they rest after completing a busy handover period. For the past week, they have been learning about Station operations from the two men who called the ship home since October.
after: Chiao and Phillips restored the Quest airlock to working order for future spacewalks and practiced operating the Canadarm2 robotic arm.

quote: Tomorrow he'll be happy because my four coins will be a million.
before: Take those four coins to your poor father. He's desperately worried.
after: He who promises great riches for free, is not to be trusted; that's certain!
ru: Завтра он будет счастлив, я дам ему миллион монет!

quote: You get to be happy with felix. Liam gets to be happy.
before: You forbid me? Mm-hmm. What right do you have to forbid anything?
after: When is it my turn? Hey, are you okay?
ru: Будь счастлива с Феликсом, Лиам будет счастлив.

quote: You know, you don't seem too happy about it.
before: Fine. Um, his younger self is in the hospital, so our Ray is healing rather quickly.
after: I'm not unhappy. I'm...
ru: Знаешь, не похоже, что ты очень счастлива.

quote: I feel like the universe is just magically smacking me down from being happy.
before: I just went kind of went crazy and... I just...
after: That's it? You gotta give me more than that.
ru: У меня такое чувство, как будто вселенная магическим образом не даёт мне стать счастливой.

quote: I've even had enough hearing about happy countries because in the end that's still selfish.
before: I've had enough hearing about competitive countries. I've had enough hearing about prosperous, wealthy, fast-growing countries.
after: That's still about us, and if we carry on thinking about us, we are in deep, deep trouble. I think we all know what it is that we want to hear about.
ru: О счастливых странах я тоже слышал не раз — это, в конце концов, тоже эгоизм.

quote: And then you find these things and you're happy or unhappy.
before: It's this record of who you are, your persona. You have your Google search, where you say, " What is Mena Trott? "
after: But then you also find people's blogs, and those are the records of people that are writing daily — not necessarily about the same topic, but things that interest them. And we talk about the world flattens, being in this panel, and I am very optimistic — whenever I think about blogs, I'm like, " We've got to reach all these people. "
ru: А затем находите ответ, и вы счастливы либо несчастливы.

quote: And the fish also were happy to be there.
before: There were still fishes. They were still kind of happy.
after: So nothing has changed, but everything has changed. My third little story is that I was an accomplice in the introduction of trawling in Southeast Asia.
ru: И рыба тоже была счастлива быть там.

quote: Two smaller groups said they were not happy with the terms of the deal.
after: The Justice and Equality Movement (JEM) said it wanted fundamental changes to the document. The group's chief negotiator, Ahmed Tugod, reiterated the rebels' demands for the post of vice-president in the Khartoum government, to have the allocation of 6.5 percent of Sudan's national income to a Darfur development fund, and for greater representation in national institutions.

quote: Shouldn't be too hard to find one of the girls who used to work there.
before: Got shut down. After the shooting.
after: The girls from The Star Hotel reckoned you'd gone up in the world. Charlie Tyner.
ru: - Не трудно будет разыскать девочек, которые там работали.

quote: I think it's gonna be a hard no on García, but let's just keep going.
before: - No kicker? - Straight up.
after: - What else you thinking? - What are we doing?
ru: Я думаю, по Гарсии всё же твёрдое "нет", но ты продолжай.

quote: And that was hard for me because I didn't do anything wrong.
before: I am still going out with your friends. But I apologized.
after: Shelly, I hung out with you in enough dusty lecture halls while you were growing up. I wanna go sightseeing. So why don't you have some pancakes, get dressed and come with us.
ru: И это было трудно, потому что я не сделал ничего плохого.

quote: I guess wouldn't have been hard to subdue him, especially if he was drunk.
before: I'm not weak. No, you're a fighter, aren't you?
after: And then all you had to do was put the car in drive. Speaking of which, I didn't find the truck or the.25-caliber auto when I served the search warrant at your house.
ru: Полагаю, с ним было не так уж трудно справиться, особенно, если он был пьян.

quote: Now, people who don't exercise their normative powers in hard choices are drifters.
before: You might decide to be a pink sock-wearing, cereal-loving, country-living banker, and I might decide to be a black sock-wearing, urban, donut-loving artist. What we do in hard choices is very much up to each of us.
after: We all know people like that. I drifted into being a lawyer.
ru: Те, кто не прибегает к способности создавать собственные правила, делая трудный выбор, плывут по течению.

quote: It's hard to conceive, and begs more questions.
before: In change and development and growth. How does this in-ness, this innerness, this interiority of God work?
after: Is God just another name for the universe, with no independent existence at all? I don't know.
ru: Это трудно постичь, и порождает всё новые вопросы.

quote: It's awfully hard to team if you inadvertently see others as competitors.
before: Now, I don't think too many organizations welcome newcomers that way anymore, but still, many times people arrive with that message of scarcity anyway. It's me or you.
after: So we have to overcome that one as well, and when we do, the results can be awesome. Abraham Lincoln said once, " I don't like that man very much.
ru: Трудно работать в команде, если видишь в коллегах соперников.

quote: The demand for Japanese automobiles was hit particularly hard, plunging by 69%.
after: Demand for electronic goods also dropped substantially.

quote: There's hardly any members of the Astronomical Society left.
before: Lawrence was furious. He's convinced you leaked to the press and you and the village amateurs are hell-bent on bringing him and the observatory down.
after: They've all been murdered. I think I know who by.
ru: Да от Астрономического общества уже почти никого не осталось.

quote: I can hardly interfere in the running of an Old Bailey trial.
before: The trial starts tomorrow. I hope you've got something up your sleeve.
after: Pull the other one, it's got bells on. What's your risk assessment, Heather?
ru: Едва ли я могу вмешиваться в процесс суда Олд Бэйли.

quote: You've hardly talked to him since the riot.
before: Does Duncan know? Yes. Well, he could have said.
after: We're a team, remember that. You wanna stay on the case, you see the counsellor.
ru: Ты с ним почти не говорила с тех пор, как он приехал.

after: I'd like to call on you more often, make sure that you're well. That won't be necessary.
ru: Я почти что не виделся с тобой с тех пор, как вернулся из Китая.

quote: Hardly anything contained more than one ingredient, because it was an ingredient.
before: Fats, carbs, proteins — they weren't bad or good, they were food. You ate food.
after: The cornflake hadn't been invented. (Laughter) The Pop-Tart, the Pringle, Cheez Whiz, none of that stuff.
ru: Почти все продукты содержали не более одного ингредиента, потому что сами были ингредиентами.

quote: While you can hardly move, they're running around having all kinds of fun.
before: People say, " Oh, snap out of it! " Oh yeah, that's easier said than done.
after: Sometimes I think it's better just to sink way down in your funky mood' til you can rise up humming these steel guitar blues. Now, you can try to keep it all inside with drink and drugs and cigarettes, but you know that's not going to get you where you want to get.
ru: Пока ты едва можешь шевелиться, все бегают вокруг и веселятся как могут.

quote: Always that erotic murmur, I'm hardly myself if I'm not in a state of incipient desire.
before: 60 nearly, yet these hardly tangible, hardly better than harlots, can still stir me. Maybe a coming of age in the American sensual darkness, never seeing an unsmudged nipple, an uncensored vagina, has left me forever infected with an unquenchable lust of the eye.
after: God knows though, there are worse twists your obsessions can take. Last year in Israel, a young ultra-orthodox Rabbi guiding some teenage girls through the Shrine of the Shoah forbade them to look in one room.
ru: Этот постоянный эротический шепот, я почти не я, если я не нахожусь в состоянии зарождающегося желания.

quote: She's hardly going to announce anything world-changing, is she?
before: Church told a British radio show "We asked Paris to be on the program because I could take the mick out of her and not feel at all bad about it — she's such a complete airhead. But she demanded a ridiculous amount of money — like the price of a big house just to say a few stupid things.
after: It's absolutely pathetic, isn't it?"

quote: You don't need to know every thought in my head.

after: - I have relationships that don't involve... - What are you doing? I'm too young to be a grandmother.
ru: Тебе не обязательно знать всё, что у меня в голове.

before: Publicity is a two-edged sword. Today, they use it to knight you.

ru: Завтра она же снесет тебе голову с плеч.

ru: Так ты не умрешь, если упадешь и ударишься головой.

ru: И как главный по моим персональным делам, вы займетесь этим лично.

after: Nathan: My life is tangled. (Laughter) GG: And then he's going to show her a bunch of pictures from four different categories.
ru: Натан начнёт с подсоединения электродов к голове Кристи.

quote: So this guy has been transplanting hundreds of mouse heads.
before: If you don't substitute two amino acids, if you don't say ATXY, if you say ATCG + XY, then you go from 20 building blocks to 172, and all of a sudden you've got 172 building blocks of amino acids to build life-forms in very different shapes. The second experiment to think about is a really weird experiment that's been taking place in China.
after: Right? And why is that an interesting experiment?
ru: Этот парень пересадил сотни мышиных голов.

quote: But my head unwraps around what appears limitless, man's creative violence.
before: All holy history banned. Unwritten books predicted the future, projected the past.
after: Whose son shall it be? Which male child will perish a new day?
ru: Но моя голова занята другим, тем, что время не ограничивает, тому, как изобретательно зло.

quote: They were all killed by gunshots to the head.
before: Damir Voschion, 46, has reportedly killed five members of his family in Pula, Croatia on Thursday night around 7:00 p.m. CET (UTC+1).
after: The victims include Damir's two-month-old nephew, his seven-year-old niece, his brother, sister-in-law and then his father. The massacre took place in the family's home.

quote: Oh. So this is more of an official heads-up.
before: Is this my unofficial heads-up? Lou, you had a relationship with a murder victim, you worked the case, and you didn't think you should have recused yourself?
after: Well, Vance claimed that there was a rush to judgment. That you guys didn't even look past him for the real killer.
ru: О, так это больше официальное предупреждение.

quote: You know the heads-up that you gave me about Amanda?
before: Thanks, Emily. I'm glad someone appreciates that these parties don't just throw themselves.
after: I wanted to return the favor before anybody else gets hurt. Amanda's foster brother?
ru: Знаешь, то предупреждение которое ты мне дала по поводу Аманды?

quote: But only because I got a heads-up.
before: It was just my face. Okay, I may have given you a look.
after: Ray tried to renegotiate his deal. What does he want?
ru: Но только потому, что я получил предупреждение.

before: She's nothing if not independent. I don't even want to think about Pete, let alone talk about him.
after: I'm just so angry. You know, what he got away with, and... and... and now he's making money off of me?
ru: Ну, хорошо, что они заранее тебя предупредили вместо того, чтобы огорошить тебя в эфире.

ru: Я без понятия какие проблемы со здоровьем может вызвать всё это.

ru: Клиники Лучшего способа для здоровья и долголетия.

before: - Fine. Everything's fine.
after: No. She's better, certainly better.
ru: Ты по-прежнему обеспокоен ее психическим здоровьем?

quote: Mother said she was sending me to a health spa to rejuvenate.
before: That man was a tyrant. I see that you've overpacked.
after: If you're worried that I might cut you in your sleep, I'm not crazy.
ru: Мать сказала, что отправляет меня в санаторий поправить здоровье.

quote: And I decided to focus my career on improving maternal health care.
before: Or maybe it was my residency training, where I saw firsthand how poorly so many low-income women of color were treated by our healthcare system. For whatever the reason, I felt a responsibility to stand up, not just for myself, but for all women, and especially those marginalized by our healthcare system.
after: So what's killing mothers? Cardiovascular disease, hemorrhage, high blood pressure causing seizures and strokes, blood clots and infection are some of the major causes of maternal mortality in this country.
ru: И я решила посвятить себя улучшению материнского здоровья.

quote: Here's Dr. Venkataswamy in India, who's figured out how to do mass-produced health.
before: This woman will expose herself to toxic phosphorous, release four pounds of toxic lead into her childrens' environment, which is from copper. On the other hand, we see great signs of hope.
after: He has given eyesight to two million people for free. We see in our material flows that car steels don't become car steel again because of the contaminants of the coatings — bismuth, antimony, copper and so on.
ru: Это доктор Венкатасвами из Индии, создавший систему массового воспроизводства здоровья.

quote: And we thought, you know what, there's nothing for men's health.
before: We need to legitimize this so we can get away with it year on year. " (Laughter) So we started thinking about that, and we were inspired by the women around us and all they were doing for breast cancer.

ru: И мы поняли, что для мужского здоровья ничего подобного не делается.

ru: Рейф, Квентин, здесь не место здоровым людям.

after: Yeah, selling out's her specialty. How's Officer Walsh?
ru: Да, было очень вкусно, но ты похоже подзабросила свои идеи о здоровом питании.

before: Don't make me crush you. So, this recovers lost memories?
after: And Werner's anything but. Anoxic brain trauma.
ru: Но эта процедура опасна для здорового объекта.

quote: In a few days I hope to see a nice and healthy baby.

after: Sae-hee. Thank you for being born as a healthy baby.
ru: На днях я жду здоровую и красивую малышку.

quote: Beyond the obvious pain and struggle, there was a healthy dose of laughter and accomplishments.
before: I started paying closer attention to women's lives in Gaza. Because of my gender, I had access to worlds where my colleagues were forbidden.
after: In front of a police compound in Gaza City during the first war in Gaza, an Israeli air raid managed to destroy the compound and break my nose. For a moment, all I saw was white, bright white, like these lights.
ru: Помимо очевидных боли и борьбы, присутствовала здоровая доля смеха и достижений.

quote: All of this works to promote a healthy connection between ourselves and our bodies.
before: As a lover of human anatomy, I'm so excited that we're finally putting our bodies at the center of focus. Through practices such as preventive medicine, patient empowerment and self-monitoring — down to now obsessing over every single step we take in a day.
after: Despite all this focus on the healthy self, general public knowledge of the anatomical self is lacking. Many people don't know the location of their vital organs, or even how they function.
ru: Всё это способствует формированию здорового взаимодействия с нашим организмом.

quote: You get wealthier faster if you are healthy first.
before: Because it's not everyone that's going to benefit from a mission. Health is wealth, in the words of Hans Rosling.
after: So, here we are, mission. Big trouble.
ru: Вы можете разбогатеть быстрее, если вы здоровы.

quote: A family without work is not happy, not healthy, not free.
before: Fair Trade ought to be a freedom that we can count on. The freedom to compete on a level playing field, but the big boys have bought those in control and have advertised the phrase Free Trade and all our best jobs get shipped overseas with Unfair Trade.
after: Our greatest loss of freedom has been loss of jobs. I’d get them back starting with Fair Trade and a level playing field with the biggest economic enemy of our great nation----China.

quote: His heart started racing when Morgan told him about Declan.
before: He's a master manipulator. See his carotid?
after: The tightness in his forehead, his darting eyes, are signs of real concern. Well, if he didn't take his son, then who did?

ru: Могу только представить боль в твоем сердце.

after: I am dying here inside this flower. It is OK.
ru: Это голубое сердце — дом, в котором ты можешь стоять.

We all go back so far, and in this present moment, on this day, all the people you meet, all that life from generations and from so many places all over the world flows together and meets you here, like a life-giving water, if you only open your heart and drink.
after: You flip a switch, and there is electric light. You turn a faucet, and there is warm water and cold water, and drinkable water.
ru: (Музыка) Пусть ваше сердце преисполнится благодарностью за те невероятные дары, которые даёт нам цивилизация.

ru: Клопы - насекомые-кровососы, их привлекает углекислый газ, тепло и аромат тела.

ru: Изображение с тепловизора показывает один объект, излучающий тепло на конспиративной квартире. Итак мы знаем, что он один.

ru: Тепло топит масло, а яйцо делает твёрдым.

quote: So they are not losing more heat to space.
before: They move to the colder upper reaches of the atmosphere, and this means that even as the planet heats up, high clouds don't. They remain at roughly the same temperature.

ru: Они не выделяют больше тепла в космос.

ru: Одна из причин для беспокойства - это огромный теплопоглощающий бассейн, который нагревает Гренландию с севера.

ru: И все это сопровождается невероятными транспортными проблемами - такими как жара и пробки.

ru: Тяжёлая конструкция, много вращающихся острых деталей.

ru: Это было тяжёлое вступление со множеством действительно важных данных.

ru: Мы здесь, чтобы получить назад деньги для американского народа.

quote: It's an honor to be here. Thanks very much.

I left, Minna and the kids woke up, it was summer holiday.
