ru: Да, но главное в том, что я предупреждаю тебя заранее.

quote: The students went there in advance, and arranged that they'd all order Feynman sandwiches.
before: You could get a Marilyn Monroe sandwich. You could get a Humphrey Bogart sandwich.
after: One after another, they came in and ordered Feynman sandwiches. Feynman loved this story.
ru: Студенты пришли туда заранее, и договорились, что они все закажут сэндвичи Фейнмана.

quote: Sign up for an app that lets you make savings decisions in advance.
before: We want you to be able to harness that same power. So take a moment and think about the ways in which you can sign up your future self for something that you know today will be a little bit hard.
after: The trick is, you have to have that binding contract. Number two: use transition moments to your advantage.
ru: Загрузите приложение, которое помогает заранее принять решение о накоплениях.

quote: There's no grid, there's no system, there's nothing set up in advance.
before: This is some work from Ray Gun. And the point of this magazine was to read the articles, listen to the music, and try to interpret it.
after: This is an opener for Brian Eno, and it's just kind of my personal interpretation of the music. This is rockstars talking about teachers they had lusted after in school.
ru: Нет верстки, нет системы, ничего не предустановлено заранее.

quote: Any income except from the sale of art crafts?
before: - You look younger. - Everyone says so.
after: Our needs are modest. I'll check their teeth.
ru: Есть у вас какие-нибудь доходы, кроме этих, от продажи народных промыслов?

quote: Are you aware of Living Robotics' three income streams?
before: Lamar. Come with me.
after: Consumer electronics, next generation prosthetics, unmanned military applications. Prosthetics division showed tremendous growth over the last 10 years.
ru: Вам известны три источника дохода "Живых роботов"?

quote: Svetlana's been going over our bills and income from the bar.
before: Fiona, I want to go to military school. You serious?
after: Our yield on gross revenues are shit. You know that the woman who owns this place dropped out of high school, and now she owns, like, half the South Side?
ru: Светлана просматривает наши счета и доход о бара.

quote: Okay, now remember, we're targeting models, gays, and upwardly mobile millennials with discretionary income.
before: - Yeah? - Oh... Caroline, get the hose.
after: Basically anyone better than us. Were you talking to me that whole time?
ru: Помни, нам нужны модели, геи, и очень активное поколение двухтысячных с независимым доходом.

quote: Most people when they speak about universal basic income, they actually mean national basic income.
before: But this is a problem. I mean, I think it's a good start, but it's a problematic idea because it's not clear what " universal " is and it's not clear what " basic " is.
after: But the problem is global. Let's say that you have AI and 3D printers taking away millions of jobs in Bangladesh, from all the people who make my shirts and my shoes.
ru: Для большинства людей понятие универсального базового дохода совпадает с национальным базовым доходом.

quote: There are other sources of income for artists, however.
before: I believe the system is flawed and far from being fair, and I want to help change that. I want to live in a society where artists are more valued and have more cultural and financial support so they can focus on creating arts instead of being forced to drive Ubers or take corporate jobs they'd rather not have.
after: There are private foundations, grants and patrons who give money, except a vast majority of artists don't know about these opportunities. On one side you have institutions and people with money.
ru: Однако для художников есть и другие источники доходов.

quote: And in Scandinavian countries, fathers' income is much less important.
before: Basically, it's asking: do rich fathers have rich sons and poor fathers have poor sons, or is there no relationship between the two? And at the more unequal end, fathers' income is much more important — in the U.K., USA.
after: There's more social mobility. And as we like to say — and I know there are a lot of Americans in the audience here — if Americans want to live the American dream, they should go to Denmark.
ru: А в Скандинавских странах доход уже намного менее значим.

quote: Among U.S. states, Louisana and Mississippi have the fourth and third lowest median incomes, respectively.
before: The new bankruptcy law affects anyone whose income (as of the six months before filing) was over the state median income. Democratic legislators point out that many hurricane victims who manage to find work will be suffering from wage reductions, making them unable to effectively deal with their previous debts.
after: Democrats also feel that it is unfair to require repayment by bankrupted Hurricane Katrina victims while citizens in other states with similar incomes would pay nothing.

quote: Indeed, Sir Richard gave the defendant a commission in his regiment.
before: Sir Richard has a seat in the House of Commons, he is a privy counsellor and governor of the Isle of Wight. Mr Bisset, as he was commonly known, became friends with the plaintiff at the time of his election to the House of Commons and the greatest intimacy grew between them there after.
after: The defendant had the confidence and trust of the plaintiff, both in friendship, as neighbours and in military matters until, that is, the unhappy event took place.
ru: На самом деле, сэр Ричард дал ответчику полномочия в своём правлении.

quote: "Eww," indeed. Danny, aren't you ashamed, disappointing singing children like that?
before: I did it for a girl. (all) Eww.
after: You make me sick. You know, when you were dying, we all loved you.
ru: Действительн,о фу, Дэнни, тебе не стыдно так расстраивать поющих малышей?

quote: Indeed, I would say it is an excellent likeness.
before: What do you think of this? Well, I see nothing wrong with it, Ma'am.
after: Really? But you are here on business, Sir Robert.
ru: На самом деле, я бы отметил точное сходство.

quote: We need to make sure the swing votes we I.D.'d will indeed swing.
before: So, what's the plan? The registry is on track for an 8:00 p.m. vote, so we have little time to stop it.
after: Oh, Sasha's here. Credentials came through.
ru: Нам нужно убедиться, что те, кто колебался в своем выборе, действительно выберут то, что нам нужно.

quote: What we need to do is reconnect with who we really are, and that's thrilling indeed.
before: What do you think, honey? " If it doesn't work, take it down.
after: Thank you very much. (Applause)
ru: Нам нужно восстановить связь с тем, кто мы есть на самом деле, и от этого дух захватывает. Большое спасибо.

quote: And the good news is we can actually, indeed do it.
before: And that potential, that powerful potential, is also our potential, of you and me. And if we are to be stewards of our planet Earth and its biosphere, we'd better understand the cosmic significance and do something about it.
after: And let's do it. Let's start this new revolution at the tail end of the old one, with synthetic biology being the way to transform both our environment and our future.
ru: Хорошие новости в том, что мы можем действительно это сделать.

quote: These are, indeed, the chronic disorders of young people.
before: But what really drives these numbers, this high morbidity, and to some extent the high mortality, is the fact that these start very early in life. Fifty percent will have onset by age 14, 75 percent by age 24, a picture that is very different than what one would see if you're talking about cancer or heart disease, diabetes, hypertension — most of the major illnesses that we think about as being sources of morbidity and mortality.
after: Now, I started by telling you that there were some good-news stories. This is obviously not one of them.
ru: Это, на самом деле, хронические заболевания молодежи.

quote: Indeed, Amnesty International has created a similarly passable fake boarding pass for their AirTorture fundraising site.
before: Fake boarding passes are quite easy to create in Microsoft Word; assuming you have access to a old boarding pass for comparison.

quote: We just finished making a charming independent movie.
before: - Shut up. And if the tape does get out?
after: For it to work, we need to take it to a major film festival. We need people focusing on your great film, Julian, not a sex tape.
ru: Мы только что закончили снимать замечательный независимый фильм.

quote: If you're so independent, why didn't you get the right bus home?
before: I was trying to be independent, Dad. Well, how did that work out for you?
after: I've no money left. You spent the whole lot, the whole 20 quid. On what?
ru: Если ты такая независимая, почему не поехала домой на автобусе?

quote: He says that you're quite the independent thinker.
before: Vigorously. Jack Thompson thinks very highly of you.
after: I'm sure he meant that as an insult. perhaps.
ru: Он говорит, что вы достаточно независимая личность.

quote: Well, as of this morning, I'm officially an independent.
before: Garrett's testimony did not make me any friends. Not in your party, no.
after: I think the GOP can find me a place on judiciary. - Okay, Alex.
ru: На данный момент а я официально независимый.

quote: He had a website, La Blogothèque, dedicated to independent music.
before: And actually, why do we record? Well, it is with such simple questions in mind that I started to make films 10 years ago, first with a friend, Christophe Abric.
after: We were crazy about music. We wanted to represent music in a different way, to film the music we love, the musicians we admired, as much as possible, far from the music industry and far from the cliches attached to it.
ru: У него был веб-сайт, La Blogothèque, посвящённый независимой музыке.

quote: Independent analysis from anonymous employees on their surveys.
before: And you can say, " Well how do you know they're happy? " Well we did win, every year that we entered, one of the rankings for best employer for small business.
after: It does, and it can, work in Bulgaria. There's nothing holding us back, except our own mentality about play.
ru: В независимом анализе анонимных сотрудников, по их опросам.

quote: Each of those is an independent life-support system, keeping us alive in its own way.
before: So when it comes to reasons for studying physics, for example, here is the best reason I can think of: I think that each of us has three life-support systems. We've got our own body, we've got a planet and we've got our civilization.
after: And they all run on the fundamental physical laws that you can learn in the kitchen with eggs and teacups and lemonade, and everything else you can play with. This is the reason, for example, why something like climate change is such a serious problem, because It's two of these life-support systems, our planet and our civilization, kind of butting up against each other; they're in conflict, and we need to negotiate that boundary.
ru: Каждая из них независима и по-своему поддерживает в нас жизнь.

quote: Channel 4 has no production facilities itself; all television programmes are commissioned from independent companies.
before: The crew were freelancers filming a new comedy show for Channel 4.

quote: This could withstand a 9.0 quake or an industrial thermal lance.
before: TD-9000-- brand-new technology, can be used on any size vault. More than a dozen interlocking composite-steel bolts, reinforced receiving cups, ten-gear release mechanism.
after: Yes, but our witnesses said they got in with a glass of water. Th-They did what?
ru: Это может выдержать землетрясение в 9,0 баллов или да же промышленный газовый резак.

quote: This is Agent Knox, we got an old industrial building here.
before: Team, on me. This is Agent Weller, what have you got?
after: Looks vacant. My team's standing by to breach the doors on your say-so.
ru: Это агент Нокс, у нас тут старое промышленное здание.

quote: We made a proposal to the Minister of Industrial Development.
before: I had to travel to Russia just to meet the man and ended up with his brilliant daughter. My brilliance is like the Moon next to your sun.
after: Canada could lead the world in space exploration. Imagine a Canadian flag planted on the Moon.
ru: Мы сделали предложение министру промышленного развития.

quote: The world's worst industrial accident is being remembered in India today.
before: - And you're watching ^IBBC World.^I Our main headlines.
after: It's 20 years since deadly gas leaked from the Union Carbide chemical plant in the city of Bhopal. At least 18,000 deaths are attributed to the leak, and many local people say that contamination has never been properly cleared up.
ru: Худший промышленный инцидент, сегодня все еще помнят в Индии.

quote: Now we are experiencing another metamorphic change: the industrial Internet.
before: First, the Industrial Revolution brought us machines and factories, railways, electricity, air travel, and our lives have never been the same. Then the Internet revolution brought us computing power, data networks, unprecedented access to information and communication, and our lives have never been the same.
after: It brings together intelligent machines, advanced analytics, and the creativity of people at work. It's the marriage of minds and machines.
ru: Сейчас мы переживаем ещё одну метаморфозу: Интернет промышленного размаха.

quote: Palm oil is used to manufacture a wide range of consumer and industrial goods.
before: We made an oil that was similar to a citrus oil, which can be used for flavoring and for fragrances, but it also can be used as a biodegradable cleaner or even as a jet fuel. And we made an oil that's similar to palm oil.
after: We began working with manufacturers to scale up this technology, and we're currently working with them to bring some of these products to market. We believe this type of technology can indeed help us profitably recycle carbon dioxide into valuable products — something that's beneficial for the planet but also beneficial for business.
ru: Пальмовое масло используют в производстве широкого спектра потребительских и промышленных товаров.

quote: Industrial trawlers and draggers are scraping the sea floor like bulldozers, taking everything in their path.
before: All of these parts are part of our life support system. We kill using long lines, with baited hooks every few feet that may stretch for 50 miles or more.
after: Using Google Earth you can witness trawlers — in China, the North Sea, the Gulf of Mexico — shaking the foundation of our life support system, leaving plumes of death in their path. The next time you dine on sushi — or sashimi, or swordfish steak, or shrimp cocktail, whatever wildlife you happen to enjoy from the ocean — think of the real cost.
ru: Промышленные траулеры и драги выскабливают морское дно как бульдозеры, забирая все на своём пути.

quote: One of the oldest mines in Poland, it is centrally located in the industrial Silesia region.
before: The Halemba mine, located in Ruda Slaska, has produced coal for nearly 50 years, has been fraught with safety concerns and has a track record of serious accidents.

quote: And this laid the foundations for chemistry, physics and modern industry.
before: A new age where electricity ceased being a mere curiosity and started being genuinely useful. With constant flowing current electricity, new chemical elements could be isolated with ease.
after: Volta's pile changed everything. The pile made Volta an international celebrity, feted by the powerful and the rich.
ru: И это заложило основы химии, физики и современной промышленности.

quote: Our proprietary designs keep us at the forefront of the industry.
before: Looks that way. Any idea why China might be interested in Rylatech?
after: Maybe they want to steal our work. Or sabotage it.
ru: Благодаря нашим собственным разработкам мы были лидерами отрасли.

quote: You're the one that invited half the record industry.
before: Open bar per person we're looking at that. That's 400 people.
after: I know you're in the business, but our house band, Karisma, you're hearing them over the speakers. You won't do better anywhere.
ru: - Ты сам пригласил половину своей отрасли.

quote: What those in the tech industry might call an "incubator."
before: Who is that? He's a venture capitalist of sorts, for criminals.
after: And you really believe that if we find McGrath, he'll lead us to Kirk? Not us.
ru: В отрасли высоких технологий это называют "инкубатором".

quote: And beyond medicine, biofabrication can be a humane, sustainable and scalable new industry.
before: This is biofabrication, where cells themselves can be used to grow biological products like tissues and organs. Already in medicine, biofabrication techniques have been used to grow sophisticated body parts, like ears, windpipes, skin, blood vessels and bone, that have been successfully implanted into patients.
after: And we should begin by reimagining leather. I emphasize leather because it is so widely used.
ru: Кроме медицины биофабрикацию можно было бы использовать в качестве гуманной, устойчивой и масштабируемой новой отрасли.

quote: Now, this scarcity fueled widespread corruption in the industry.
before: In the late 1990s, fewer than five percent of people in sub-Saharan Africa had phones. In Nigeria, for example, the country had more than 110 million people but fewer than half a million phones in the whole nation.
after: I mean, public officials who worked for the state-owned phone companies demanded bribes from people who wanted phones. And because most people couldn't afford to pay the bribes, phones were only available to those who were wealthy.
ru: Такой дефицит способствовал распространению коррупции в отрасли.

quote: It could also be novel ways of organizing firms and industries.
before: Instead, innovation, if you remember, some of you may have read the famous economist Schumpeter, he said, " Innovation is novelty in how value is created and distributed. " It could be new products and services, but it could also be new ways of producing products.
after: Once you take this, there's no reason to restrict innovation, the beneficiaries of innovation, just to end users. When you take this broader conceptualization of innovation, what we found was, India is well represented in innovation, but the innovation that is being done in India is of a form we did not anticipate, and what we did was we called it " invisible innovation. "
ru: Это могут быть также новые способы организации фирм и отраслей промышленности.

quote: The industry publication stated the aircraft overran the runway and broke through a perimeter barrier.
before: The Aviation Herald reported the failed landing at Fath, which has a much shorter runway than Payam, was a mistake and the jet was supposed to land at Payam.
after: It cited the Air Force as stating Saha Airlines owned the plane, and claimed a reported sixteenth death.

quote: Change is inevitable and necessary, like the seasons, Mr. Palmer.
before: I suppose with changes in my personal life, I could always count on a stable work environment. And now, suddenly, things seem to be changing for you as well, and I...
after: I suggest you embrace it. I will.
ru: Изменения неизбежны и необходимы, как времена года, мистер Палмер.

quote: It's inevitable, so it's better you hear it from me.
before: I haven't been completely honest with you... about why I'm going away. I'm... well, I've been scared to tell you the truth, but I guess you're gonna find out anyway.
after: What are you talking about, Pop? I got Alzheimer's.
ru: Это неизбежно, так что, лучше услышать вам это от меня.

quote: But if it doesn't, we've delayed an inevitable operation.
before: What's TPA? It's a clot-busting medicine that could help.
after: That could cause a stroke or MI. Surgery is the best option here.
ru: Если нет, то мы запоздаем с неизбежным вмешательством.

quote: The blue hand marks a surrender to the inevitable.
before: Blue hands. They represent a portal, a gateway from one understanding to another.
after: Raynaud. Here we go.
ru: Синяя рука показывает, что человек покорился неизбежному.

quote: We thought that becoming senile was a normal and inevitable part of getting old.
before: Because here's what few people know but everyone should: Alzheimer's is a disease, and we can cure it. For most of the past 114 years, everyone, including scientists, mistakenly confused Alzheimer's with aging.
after: But we only have to look at a picture of a healthy aged brain compared to the brain of an Alzheimer's patient to see the real physical damage caused by this disease. As well as triggering severe loss of memory and mental abilities, the damage to the brain caused by Alzheimer's significantly reduces life expectancy and is always fatal.
ru: Мы думали, что старческий маразм — естественная и неизбежная часть старения.

quote: In our research, people accepted acceleration as inevitable, both the thrills and the lack of control.
before: Will a faster future make us more secure and productive? Or will it make us more vulnerable?
after: They fear that if they were to slow down, they might run the risk of becoming obsolete. They say they'd rather burn out than rust out.
ru: Согласно нашему исследованию, люди восприняли ускорение как неизбежность, включая волнение и потерю контроля.

quote: But it's inevitable that we will be two to three billion more.
before: And we will be just 10 billion in this world, if the poorest people get out of poverty, their children survive, they get access to family planning. That is needed.
after: So when you discuss and when you plan for the resources and the energy needed for the future, for human beings on this planet, you have to plan for 10 billion. Thank you very much.
ru: Неизбежно то, что нас станет на пару-тройку миллиардов больше.

quote: The United States said "this now looks inevitable."
before: European diplomats have said that they will hold an emergency IAEA meeting to consider referring Tehran to the UN for further action and or sanctions.

quote: Use your influence to anoint her the new "It Girl."
before: Well, you need to replace yourself. Find a new Serena.
after: Retain control but stay out of the spotlight yourself. Okay. Well, where do I start?
ru: Используй свое влияние, чтобы короновать её как новую светскую львицу.

quote: Joffrey needs a male influence in his life, okay?
before: Look, when we were little, I was the one who had to hold the family together. I didn't ask for any help from you, but I am asking for it now.
after: Okay. I-I'm here for you, and I'll get comfortable watching you breastfeed.
ru: Джоффри в жизни необходимо мужское влияние, хорошо?

quote: But Abraham's influence has been both crucial and definitive at every turn.
before: Abraham may have given you the idea to come to America, but you put in action. Well, I wish that were the case.
after: My friend, you have made a bold choice. And, in doing so, I have deserted my nation.
ru: Но влияние Авраама было решающим и ключевым на каждом шагу.

quote: Well, now is the perfect time for you to exert some of your influence.
before: Weapons have never been part of that equation. Bullshit.
after: That's easier said than done, Madam Ambassador. Why is that?
ru: Что ж, сейчас прекрасное время для вас, чтобы оказать некое влияние.

quote: If they multiply, their influence will grow in the overall Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
before: I believe that the most important thing is to understand that if we don't pay attention to these efforts, they are invisible, and it's as if they never happened. But I have seen first hand that if we do, they will multiply.
after: And theirs is the kind of influence that can finally unblock the situation. These leaders have proven that nonviolence works in places like Budrus.
ru: Если они умножатся, их влияние будет расти во всём израиле-палестинском конфликте.

quote: But it's the largest Arab country and it's also one with a great deal of influence.
before: I'm going to focus a lot of my talk on Egypt. It has nothing to do with the fact that I was born there, of course.
after: But I'm going to end by widening the lens to the entire region to look at the mundane topics of Arab views of religion and politics and how this impacts women, revealing some surprises along the way. So after analyzing mounds of data, what we discovered was this: Unemployment and poverty alone did not lead to the Arab revolts of 2011.
ru: Но зато это самая крупная страна Арабского мира, а также страна с огромным влиянием.

quote: This allowed us to assign a degree of influence to each shareholder.
before: So this means that, with each euro he invested, he was able to move 26 euros of market value through the chain of ownership relations. Now what we actually computed in our study was the control over the TNCs' value.
after: This is very much in the sense of Max Weber's idea of potential power, which is the probability of imposing one's own will despite the opposition of others. If you want to compute the flow in an ownership network, this is what you have to do.
ru: что позволило определить степень влияния каждого акционера.

quote: During Giuliani's tenure, Washington was in charge of the cleaning up the market of mafia influence.
before: Rudy Washington, deputy to former mayor Rudy Giuliani, said that a plan by the city to open the fish unloading operations to a bidding process at the new facility could lead to mafia control.

quote: Except my initial theory of collective heart failure is probably incorrect.
before: Any theories, Dr. Bishop? Oh, no.
after: I'll need to take some of these bodies back to the lab. Six or seven should suffice.
ru: Разве что моя первоначальная версия массового сердечного приступа. Но она скорее всего неверна.

quote: The key to successfully bribing someone who resists in initial approach is research and observation.
before: Oh, it's my strap of my silly shoe. Allow me.
after: You need to know as much as you can about your target -- his principles, his weaknesses, his dreams. With most by-the-book targets, it's usually just a matter of making them feel like they're not being paid to do something wrong -- they're being rewarded for doing something right.
ru: Ключ к успешному подкупу кого-либо, кто отклонил первоначальное предложение, - это исследование и наблюдение.

quote: Okay, how do you explain the pilot's initial exchange with air traffic control?
before: Could've ended up in the water. Well, nothing else seemed to.
after: He says, and I quote, "Three souls aboard." Three.
ru: И к тому же, как вы объясните первоначальную оговорку пилота, когда он общался с диспетчером?

quote: Because my initial time of death was correct.
before: Okay. So why'd you call me?
after: The commander was dead before the crash. Most definitely.
ru: Потому что первоначальное время смерти было определено правильно.

quote: Instead it has four different letter forms: initial, medial, isolated and final.
before: It also uses an entirely different system of punctuation and diacritics. But most importantly, Arabic has no capital letters.
after: I want to introduce the Arabic language to young learners, foreign speakers, but most importantly help refugees integrate to their host societies through creating a bilingual learning system, a two-way flow of communication. And I called it " Let's Play. "
ru: Вместо этого у каждой буквы есть четыре варианта написания: для начальной, средней, конечной позиции и отдельно стоящей буквы.

quote: For that, we use an initial measurement unit.
before: We have perception, computation and non-visual interfaces. Now obviously the driver cannot see, so the system needs to perceive the environment and gather information for the driver.
after: So it measures acceleration, angular acceleration — like a human ear, inner ear. We fuse that information with a GPS unit to get an estimate of the location of the car.
ru: Для этого используется первоначальный измеритель параметров.

quote: Shaffi Mather: I just have to get through the initial days where I don't get eliminated.
before: Thank you. (Applause) Chris Anderson: Shaffi, that is a really exciting business idea.
after: (Laughter) CA: What's on your mind? I mean, give us a sense of the numbers here — a typical bribe and a typical fee.
ru: Шаффи Матер: Главное пережить начальный этап чтоб меня не убрали.

after: And 100 years ago, it would have been unthinkable for all of us to fly here from around the world for a five-day conference. But we did, and most of us probably without a second thought.

quote: Changing weather patterns have also affected large migratory animals.
Yeah, and last weekend, you didn't want to ruin the basketball tournament.

after: Look, I really don't think you should make a big deal out of this. I just happen to be a descendant of a guy.

quote: Kashmir Hill: So for my birthday last year, my husband got me an Amazon Echo.
after: I was kind of shocked, actually, because we both work in privacy and security. (Laughter) And this was a device that would sit in the middle of our home with a microphone on, constantly listening.
ru: Кашмир Хилл: На прошлый день рождения мой муж подарил мне смарт-динамик Amazon Echo.

quote: Just last year, activists invaded and destroyed a field trial in the Philippines.

after: When I heard about the destruction, I wondered if they knew that they were destroying much more than a scientific research project, that they were destroying medicines that children desperately needed to save their sight and their lives. Some of my friends and family still worry: How do you know genes in the food are safe to eat?
ru: В прошлом году активисты ворвались и уничтожили тестовое поле на Филиппинах.

quote: It was dying well before he did, and now it's on its last legs.
before: He didn't so much appropriate it as kidnapped it and debased it and corrupted it and turned it into something it was never meant to be, and then persuaded all of us that it always was a global jihad. But the good news is that the global jihad is almost over, as bin Laden defined it.
after: Opinion polls from all over the Muslim world show that there is very little interest among Muslims in a global holy war against the West, against the far enemy. The supply of young men willing to fight and die for this cause is dwindling.

ru: В последнее время она какая-то беспокойная. Бегом бежит встречать почтальона.

ru: Мне просто кажется, что в последнее время трудно сказать кому принадлежит ваша преданность.

quote: It's not like we've broken any rules lately.

after: Well, any more than usual. It's true. But wouldn't you rather know what kind of attack we have to defend ourselves against?
ru: Мы же в последнее время ничего не нарушали.

quote: I've been mending a lot of emotional fences lately.

after: I can't work for you anymore. I have to be my own man.
ru: Я много боролся с эмоциональными проблемами в последнее время.

before: The death of Anna Nicole Smith. This story eclipsed every country except Iraq, and received 10 times the coverage of the IPCC report.
after: So, why don't we hear more about the world? One reason is that news networks have reduced the number of their foreign bureaus by half.
ru: И этот цикл продолжается; как известно, в последнее время Бритни появлялась частенько в новостях.

quote: How's your genome today? Have you thought about it lately?
before: Then we go along and create the Internet and connect the world together; we flatten the world. We've seen so much change, and we've given ourselves these tools now — these high-powered tools — that are allowing us to turn the lens inward into something that is common to all of us, and that is a genome.
after: Heard about it, at least? You probably hear about genomes these days.
ru: Как ваш геном сегодня поживает? Вы не задумывались об этом в последнее время?

quote: Lately we are going wild, charging seven percent from time to time.
before: Just quickly on the results. Over these 10 years, 40 million dollars in affordable financing, average interest rate five percent to six percent.
after: We do it in 17 countries of the developing world. And here is the most stunning number.
ru: В последнее время мы вообще с цепи сорвались, время от времени берём 7 процентов.

quote: Lately, the issue of a Tamil family in immigration detention has been a topic of debate.
after: The Murugappan family has been held in immigration detention for 2018 after their request for protection was rejected, after 5 years of living in the Queensland town of Biloela. They've now been reunited in Perth, where four year old Tharnicaa is being treated after a serious blood infection.

quote: And then evil got over the wall, and we looked to the law for justice.
before: She was 5 years old! We were good, civilized people.
after: And the law let us down. No, no.
ru: И когда зло пришло к нам домой, мы обратились к закону за правосудием.

quote: He's changed the laws of Venezuela, and they just happen to impact a lawsuit here.

ru: Он изменил законы Венесуэлы, и они дали возможность повлиять на судебный процесс здесь.

quote: Yes, sadly, oh king, no one is above the law.

ru: Да, к сожалению, о царь, никто не может быть выше закона.

quote: Your towering respect for law is just astounding as always, John.
before: All right, all right. Get out of here.
after: Oh, I see you managed to steal from the cop as well. Eh, it's a campus cop, mate, big difference.
ru: Твое высочайшее уважение к закону как всегда поражает, Джон.

quote: The laws of physics dictated the absolute minimum-sized telescope that we could build.
before: We would have to build something larger than the original breadbox, now more like a mini-fridge, but we still wouldn't have to build a pickup truck. So now we had our constraint.
after: What came next was making the rest of the satellite as small and as simple as possible, basically a flying telescope with four walls and a set of electronics smaller than a phone book that used less power than a 100 watt lightbulb. The big challenge became actually taking the pictures through that telescope.
ru: Законы физики предъявили абсолютный минимум размеров для телескопа, который мы могли построить.

quote: And decided that it was worth taking the time to write this down as a law.
before: Someone must have seen a black person and a white person playing checkers with someone in some town square. And maybe the wrong person was winning or they were having too good of a time, but whatever it was that this person saw, with this black person and this white person playing checkers, they felt the entire foundation of Southern civilization was in peril.
after: This caste system was so arcane that in courtrooms throughout the South there was actually a black Bible and an altogether separate white Bible to swear to tell the truth on in court. The very word of God was segregated in the caste system of the Jim Crow South.
ru: И решил, что стоит потратить время на то, чтобы прописать это в законе.

quote: Law is like riot gear on a police officer.
before: We lawyers are usually expensive, first of all, and we tend to focus on formal court channels that are impractical for many of the problems people face. Worse, our profession has shrouded law in a cloak of complexity.
after: It's intimidating and impenetrable, and it's hard to tell there's something human underneath. If we're going to make justice a reality for everyone, we need to turn law from an abstraction or a threat into something that every single person can understand, use and shape.
ru: Закон похож на спецснаряжение у полицейских.

quote: The Illinois House of Representatives voted 61–54 yesterday to approve a law allowing for same-sex marriage.
after: Governor Pat Quinn is expected to sign the bill and ceremonies for same-sex couples are expected to start in June of next year.

quote: How can you run a business and not know how lawyers work?
before: - I didn't know. - You run a business.
after: Up. Let's go.
ru: Как можно заниматься бизнесом и не знать, как адвокаты работают?

quote: I knew that Skip's lawyer would spread it, and it'd land in the news.

after: And if you treat me that way, they'll all fear you. That's what you need right now.
ru: Я знал, что адвокат Скипа проболтается, и об этом заговорят в новостях.

quote: I knew something about genetics, but I wasn't even a lawyer, let alone a patent lawyer.
before: Who can we sue? " (Laughter) Now Chris is a really brilliant lawyer, but he knew almost nothing about patent law and certainly nothing about genetics.
after: So clearly we had a lot to learn before we could file a lawsuit. First, we needed to understand exactly what was patented when someone patented a gene.
ru: Я кое-что знала о генетике, но я даже не была юристом, не говоря уже о патентном праве.

quote: And he was like, "Why? You know, we don't need another lawyer in the United States."
before: He called me to his office and said, " What do you want to do when you grow up? " I said, " I want to be a lawyer. "
after: And he tried to talk me out of it, but it was like, " OK, I know nothing about applying to law school, I'm poli-sci Ph.D. But, you know, let's figure out what I need you to do, what I need to do to help you out. "
ru: А он спросил: "Почему? Ты знаешь, нам в США не нужен очередной адвокат".

quote: Lawyers are crucial in that fight, no doubt, but we can't leave it to lawyers alone.
before: It's intimidating and impenetrable, and it's hard to tell there's something human underneath. If we're going to make justice a reality for everyone, we need to turn law from an abstraction or a threat into something that every single person can understand, use and shape.
after: In health care, for example, we don't just rely on doctors to serve patients. We have nurses and midwives and community health workers.
ru: Роль юристов в этой борьбе, несомненно, важна, но мы не можем всё свалить на них.

Did the organism evolve to mildness in a place like Chile, which has some of the most well protected water supplies in Latin America?
after: And Peru's got something sort of in between. And so, with funding from the Bosack-Kruger Foundation, I got a lot of strains from these different countries and we measured their toxin production in the lab.
ru: И изменились ли они в более опасных в местах, таких как Эквадор, где меньше всего защищена вода?

quote: But he needed money and ammunition, which forced him to confide in at least 13 people.

ru: Это не вопрос о левых и правых.

quote: And on the left, liberals, you're talking about economics, it's always about income inequality.
before: Why is that dangerous? Because when we talk in this country about economics, on the right, conservatives, you're always talking about taxes and regulations and big government.
after: Right? Now those are important things, really important to me, really important to you.

after: So basically I'm in a wheelchair most of the time. SC: John's just told us he's in a wheelchair most of the time.
ru: У меня появилась слабость в руках и ногах.

quote: By staying in motion, that leg is storing some of the momentum of the turn.

after: When the leg comes back in towards the body, that stored momentum gets transferred back to the dancer's body, propelling her around as she rises back onto pointe. As the ballerina extends and retracts her leg with each turn, momentum travels back and forth between leg and body, keeping her in motion.
ru: Пребывая в движении, эта нога несёт долю момента импульса всего вращения.

after: The bumper of the car hit my throat, slicing it open. I ended up with blunt chest trauma.

ru: А они законны и их всё время принимает множество детей.

after: So we might not even be the target. They may just be looking for something in our files.
ru: У них нет юридических обязательств говорить вам о цели расследования, пока не будут предъявлены обвинения.

quote: Once firewater became legal, they lost their bloodthirstiness-ness.
before: How long did the violence last? Until the passage of the 21st amendment.
after: Until Clark Matthias brought it back. The new underground market brought back old rivalries to the surface.
ru: Как только огненная вода стала законной, они утратили свою кровожадность.

after: - Like a restraining order? - I don't know.
ru: Ты имеешь в виду в юридическом смысле "запретил"?

before: And so are books you might have or the cars you own. They're all legal things.
after: Now, I can do that to a legal thing. I can do whatever I want to my book or my car.
ru: Человекообразные обезьяны, которых вы видите за мной, — тоже юридические предметы.

quote: They're terrified of the social, legal, emotional, economic consequences of divorce.

after: So I came to realize that I don't think this is recklessness; I think it's caution. Today's singles want to know every single thing about a partner before they wed.
ru: Они боятся социальных, юридических, эмоциональных, экономических последствий развода.

quote: Because civil society is key to raising awareness among vulnerable groups of their legal rights.
before: We can retool prisons so that HIV prevention and harm reduction is available to prisoners. The key to all this is reinforcing civil society.
after: But awareness needs action. And so we need to ensure that these people who are living with HIV or at greatest risk of HIV have access to legal services and they have equal access to the courts.
ru: Потому что гражданское общество — ключ к росту осведомлённости незащищённых групп населения об их законных правах.

quote: Legal and religious groups have also called for the bill to be dropped.

They had asked Hong Kong Chief Executive Carrie Lam, who is supported by the mainland Chinese government, to resign from her position, but this has been dropped from the list of demands.

quote: But there is another kind of length, a length in time.
before: All physical objects, even my wheelchair, exist in three dimensions. Everything has a width, and a height, and a length.
after: While a human may survive for eighty years, these stones will last much longer. For thousands of years.
ru: Но есть и другой вид длины - длина во времени.

quote: He was always taking care of my side-burns to be at the exact same length.
before: He was the only one to cut my hair. No one else.
after: Both of them. - Are they now at the same length?
ru: Он всегда заботился о моих бакенбардах, чтобы они были одинаковой длины

quote: Right, Nico, gather the supplies and cut the ropes into lengths of eight paces.
before: Unless we stop them in their tracks. There's no time. We have a head start.
after: Go! You're locking us in?
ru: Верно, Нико, собери припасы и раздели веревки на отрезки, каждый длинною восемь шагов

before: Thank you, nephew. That is obvious.
after: Times velocity of conductor. I don't need a physics lesson.
ru: - Энергия равна магнитному полю, умноженному на длину проводника.

quote: Seven inches difference in height, these men have the same length legs.
before: Here you see Michael Phelps, the greatest swimmer in history, standing next to Hicham El Guerrouj, the world record holder in the mile. These men are seven inches different in height, but because of the body types advantaged in their sports, they wear the same length pants.
after: Now in some cases, the search for bodies that could push athletic performance forward ended up introducing into the competitive world populations of people that weren't previously competing at all, like Kenyan distance runners. We think of Kenyans as being great marathoners.
ru: При разнице в 18 сантиметров у обоих ноги одинаковой длины.

quote: How long is it? Well, it's billions of these subunits in length.
before: It's composed of four subunits: A, C, G and T, we call them. And it's the sequence of those subunits that defines that blueprint.
after: A haploid genome — we actually have two copies of all of our chromosomes — a haploid genome is around 3.2 billion nucleotides in length. And the whole thing, if you add it all together, is over six billion nucleotides long.
ru: Какова же длина этой цепи? Молекула ДНК состоит из миллиардов таких оснований.

quote: The length of the road doesn't matter, because the longer the road, the more biofuel plantation.
before: That's true of European biofuels. And let's imagine the cars are spaced 80 meters apart from each other, and they're perpetually going along this road.
after: What do we do with these numbers? Take the first number, divide by the other three, and get eight kilometers.
ru: Длина дороги не имеет значения, потому что чем длиннее дорога, тем больше у нас будет плантаций с биотопливом.

before: They brought this back, after Clarissa's death. I thought you might want to have it, as you were more parent to her than I.
after: I asked them to mark it with a cross, but it's unhallowed ground. What will become of her soul, I wonder?
ru: Они похоронили ее в безымянной могиле рядом с озером, там, где кончается Северная дорога.

quote: This was taken at 2:10 am by a surveillance camera near the accident.
before: Are you this car's owner? Yes.
after: We'll get to the bottom of this eventually. Like I said before, I swear I was in bed at the time.
ru: Снимок сделан в 2:10 ночи камерой видеонаблюдения рядом с местом происшествия.

quote: This is in the Mandara mountains, near the Nigerian border in Cameroon, Mokoulek.
before: And of course the spirit people have a little miniature village in their village, right? So it's just like Georg Cantor said, the recursion continues forever.
after: I saw this diagram drawn by a French architect, and I thought, " Wow! What a beautiful fractal! "
ru: Это горы Мандара, рядом с нигерийской границей Камеруна, Мокулек.

quote: But in fact, the gulls are looking for food in the dump near the prison.
before: You can see the sky. Seagulls fly overhead, and you feel like you're next to the sea, that you're really close to the beach.
after: I went farther inside and I suddenly saw inmates moving across the corridors. Then it was as if I stepped back and thought that I could have very well been one of them.
ru: Но на самом деле, чайки ищут еду в мусорной куче рядом с тюрьмой.

quote: And the answer is, until we get near to zero, the temperature will continue to rise.
before: I asked the top scientists on this several times: Do we really have to get down to near zero? Can't we just cut it in half or a quarter?
after: And so that's a big challenge. It's very different than saying, " We're a twelve-foot-high truck trying to get under a ten-foot bridge, and we can just sort of squeeze under. "
ru: Ответ в том, что пока мы не дойдём до уровня, близкого к нулю, температура будет продолжать расти.

quote: The accident occurred at Kindel Air Field, which is located south of Berlin, near Eisenach.
after: The aircraft involved was a Zlin Z-37 Cmelak, a Czech built single-seater plane which had been used by authorities in former East Germany as a cropduster.

quote: From the Prussians, from Frederick the Great, I have nearly nothing.
before: I would love to have it. Have you seen something here?
after: Let's go play soccer now. Let's wait a bit. Till Rosenbaum is gone.
ru: Прусская, времён Фридриха Великого, таких почти не осталось.

quote: You nearly got killed tonight, Barton, For sitting in a car.
before: You think Margaret and Vivian will stand by you... When this all comes out? It's not going to come out.
after: You can do your shirt up. - I can go again.
ru: Бартон, сегодня вечером ты почти был убит на сидении автомобиля.

quote: It was a lesson that took me nearly 30 years to unlearn.
before: Well, at least I still got my hot dogs. No!
after: Where could Barney be? Oh, relax. He always finds his way home.
ru: Прошло почти 30 лет, но тот урок меня так ничему и не научил.

quote: It looks like the bullets took nearly identical exit paths, judging from the spray.
before: Yeah, they are that close together. It's very impressive shooting.
after: And this was all topped off by a final shot to the head. She was mozambiqued.
ru: Судя по брызгам, пули прошли почти по одинаковой траектории.

quote: But the travel options are very limited; plane tickets cost nearly half of their monthly salary.
before: Over the 40-day travel period of Chinese New Year, three billion trips are taken, as families reunite and celebrate. Now, the most strenuous of these trips are taken by the country's 290 million migrant workers, for many of whom this is the one chance a year to go home and see parents and their left-behind children.
after: So most of them, they choose the train. Their average journey is 700 kilometers.
ru: Но возможности перемещения для них очень ограничены: билеты на самолёт стоят почти половину их месячной зарплаты.

quote: Now we can make nearly instantaneous, emotionally charged symbols out of something that's brand new.
before: It's never going to happen again, I think, because we are living on the verge of the greatest revolution in architecture since the invention of concrete, of steel, or of the elevator, and it's a media revolution. So my theory is that when you apply media to this pendulum, it starts swinging faster and faster, until it's at both extremes nearly simultaneously, and that effectively blurs the difference between innovation and symbol, between us, the architects, and you, the public.
after: Let me show you how this plays out in a project that my firm recently completed. We were hired to replace this building, which burned down.
ru: Мы научились почти мгновенно создавать эмоционально заряженные символы из чего-то совершенно нового.

quote: I saw Jason nearly every day, sometimes twice a day.
before: Jason started at DARPA on March 18th, 2010. He was with our transportation team.
after: And more so than most, he saw the highs and the lows, the celebrations and the disappointments. And on one particularly dark day for me, Jason sat down and he wrote an email.
ru: Я встречалась с ним почти каждый день, иногда по несколько раз.

quote: The death toll is the highest reported incident in Iraq for nearly one month.
before: Most of the dead were police recruits, yet civilians and other serving officers were also injured or killed. At least 57 people were injured in the attack.

quote: So a little Wget magic is all that's necessary to download the entire Kirkland facebook.
before: Let the hacking begin. First up is Kirkland. They keep everything open and allow indexes in their Apache configuration.
after: Kids' stuff. Next is Eliot.
ru: Теперь Wget. Это всё что нужно, чтобы полностью скачать весь фотоальбом Кёркленда.

quote: What we do is necessary for the greater good.
before: One of my agents is dead, and your sister's going home. What kind of positive message is that?
after: There's nothing good about this. Excuse me for the interruption, sir.
ru: То, что мы делаем необходимо для более великих хороших дел.

quote: I promise you we won't keep you a moment longer than necessary, Mr Murran.
before: I wonder if we could have a quick word. I'm already late for a meeting.
after: I've been Sam Harper for 25 years. The Murrans are a bad bunch.
ru: - Обещаю, мы не задержим вас дольше, чем необходимо, мистер Марран.

quote: I want no more upheaval for the family than absolutely necessary.
before: The parents are staying with the next-door neighbours. I'm not sending CSIs in, unless something significant comes out of the post-mortem.
after: Pete, speak to the hospital. I want to know if there was something other than the child's injuries that made medical staff suspicious.
ru: Не будем беспокоить семью, если в этом нет необходимости.

quote: He told himself it was necessary to make them from scratch.
before: All the movements stopped at falsifying. But demand was ever-growing and it was difficult to tamper with existing documents.
after: He started a press. He started photoengraving.
ru: Он решил, что нужно их целиком делать самим.

quote: Yes, fear is part of the human condition, as well as being necessary for survival.
before: We all feel fear. But we can all avoid being recruited using the resources we have — our principles, unity, faith.
after: But above all, it's the guide by which each of us builds our identity, our personality. It's true, I was 41 years old the first time I felt fear, and feeling fear was not my decision.
ru: Разумеется, страх — это часть нашей жизни, и он необходим для выживания.

quote: A typical example being, "Sometimes it is necessary to tell lies."
before: I simply took those questions where I got 50 percent yeses and 50 percent noes — so I was able to get a collection of 16 such statements. These were areas where the children were clearly confused, because half said yes and half said no.
after: They don't have a way to determine which way to answer this question; perhaps none of us do. So I leave you with this third question.
ru: Вот пример такого вопроса: "Иногда необходимо соврать".

quote: This is necessary as a deterrent for such outrageous, uncivilised behaviour.
before: "It is time to stamp out these barbaric, feudal practices which are a slur on the nation.
after: All persons who are planning to perpetrate honour killings should know that gallows await them," Justice Katju said.

quote: Four people, four brownies, a ton of negative energy.
before: Good God! You know, I think this was fate.
after: I think we should all just have one. Not a chance.
ru: Нас четверо, пирожных тоже и тонна отрицательной энергии.

quote: Echo was negative, but he has severe abdominal pain.
before: You just did. What happened?
after: Ultrasound didn't suggest any intestinal blockages, but he's severely constipated. No spores, clostridium, or organic toxins in the kitchen samples.
ru: Эхограмма отрицательна, но у него сильная боль в животе.

quote: Use the negative prongs first or she'll short out.
before: About 25 minutes. Quickly.
after: Start with a trickle of DC and let it calibrate. No more. Pretty.
ru: Сперва используем отрицательные заряды, иначе её мозг закоротит.

quote: The baby's blood was AB negative, the same as yours.
before: That's why you had to hide the body, because of the scandal. She botched her own abortion -and you couldn't clean it up.
after: You must have thought it was a long shot that anybody would put two and two together, but you couldn't take the chance, could you? I'm going to give you 30 seconds to get out of this building.
ru: У ребенка была группа крови четвертая отрицательная, как и твоя.

quote: In study two, we incorporated the two values, a positive and a negative.
before: Study one explored how infants would engage with a novel toy if there were no values or instructions provided. So we simply showed infants how to activate the toy robot, but didn't assign any values, and we also didn't tell them that they could play with the remote, providing them with a really ambiguous situation.
after: And in the last study, we had two experimenters and one remote. One experimenter expressed a negative value towards pressing the remote, saying, " Yuck, the toy moved, " while the other experimenter expressed a positive value, saying, " Yay, the toy moved. "
ru: Второй группе детей мы показали два пульта и обе реакции — положительную и отрицательную.

quote: Africa has had a mixed affair with organized religion, with both positive and negative consequences.
before: And I said... " Yes he could, yes he could, but he sent us here as change agents, light of the world, salt of the earth, and we are failing. "
after: The Christian missionaries educated most of our political elite, like Senghor and Nkrumah, built many of our first hospitals and schools. Similarly, Islam has introduced commerce and mathematics across the continent.
ru: У Африки неоднозначные отношения с религией. С положительными и отрицательными последствиями.

quote: Those who are HIV-negative must know how to stay negative.
before: (Video) Female Narrator: There is hope, hope that one day we shall win this fight against HIV and AIDS. Each person must know their HIV status.
after: Those who are HIV-infected must know how to take care of themselves. HIV-positive pregnant women must get PMTCT services in order to have HIV-negative babies.
ru: ВИЧ-отрицательные должны знать, как оставаться отрицательными.

quote: Are there columnists where you receive consistently positive or consistently negative responses to?
before: thumb|250px|Columnist [[w:Herbert Kornfeld (character)|Herbert Kornfeld was murdered in an episode of white-on-white violence. "There was almost a Notorious B.I.G.-like upset [amongst readers]," according to Chet Clem.Image source: The Onion.]] DS: Are there certain columnists who are reader favorites?

quote: Neighbors knew everything that happens in the area.
before: And the father-abbot. And, of course, our father became much more bearable here than in the valley.
after: Life in this small community, seemed like a prison. Up here, it was the opposite - complete freedom.
ru: Соседи знали все, что происходит в округе.

quote: Neighbor had to come to help with birth.
before: He didn't want to leave his mother's belly. Smart, huh?
after: They had to cut her open to take out. No doctor, no hospital...
ru: Сосед должен был прийти, чтобы помочь с рождения.

quote: One of our neighbors, Alejandro Rubio, is dead.
before: Beverly Hills is under attack. Twice in the last month, residents of our street have been brutalized by home invaders.
after: The time has come for us to meet this threat head-on. What exactly are you suggesting?
ru: Наш сосед, Алехандро Рубио, мертв.

quote: Neighbor across the street said she kept to herself.
before: - Well, let's just try to be detectives. - Victim is Mona Evans, lived alone.
after: Spent most of her time with the dog. She's got three shelves of dog show trophies in there and a bunch of pictures of man's best friend.
ru: Сосед сказал, что она была на своей волне.

quote: And she was next door to a very wealthy, oil-rich neighbor.
before: In this game we had a little girl, and she was the Defense Minister of the poorest nation. And the Defense Minister — she had the tank corps and Air Force and so forth.
after: Without provocation, suddenly she attacked, against her Prime Minister's orders, the next-door neighbor's oil fields. She marched into the oil field reserves, surrounded it, without firing a shot, and secured it and held it.
ru: И они были соседями с другой, очент богатой страной-добытчиком нефти.

quote: Refugees are joining our communities, they're becoming our neighbors, their children are attending our children's schools.
before: We're bombarded with images daily of statistics and of photos, and that's not surprising, because by last month, over one million refugees had reached Europe. One million.
after: So we've adapted the leaflet to meet the needs of European refugees, and we have them online, open-access, in areas with a really high refugee influx. For example, the Swedish healthcare uploaded it onto their website, and within the first 45 minutes, it was downloaded 343 times — really highlighting how important it is for volunteers, practitioners and other parents to have open-access, psychological first-aid messages.
ru: Беженцы вливаются в общество, они становятся нашими соседями, их дети ходят в школы с нашими детьми.

quote: He saw his neighbor, he saw his common humanity.
before: And then finally, my grandmother said, a good Samaritan came by, saw the man on the side of the road and looked and saw not centuries of hatred between Jews and Samaritans, looked and saw not his fears reflected, not economic anxiety, not " what's going to happen to me because things are changing. " But looked and saw a reflection of himself.
after: He didn't just see it, he did something about it, my grandmother said. He got down on one knee, he made sure the man was OK, and I heard, even gave him a room at that nice Fairmont, the Pan Pacific one.
ru: Он видел своего соседа, он увидел человечность.

quote: A 13-year-old female neighbor accused him of molesting her and punching her repeatedly in the head.
before: Gardner is also under investigation in the February 2009 disappearance of 14-year-old Amber Dubois in Escondido. In May 2000, Gardner was convicted of a forcible lewd act on a child and false imprisonment.

quote: But a neighbour said he had music blaring till all hours.
before: What about your Mister Nimmo? No-one's seen him around his flat.
after: Opera, by the sound of it. The entire lease on his lodgings is conducted through a solicitor.
ru: Но соседка сказала, что у него музыка играет без остановки в любое время дня и ночи.

quote: Get Uniform to check on the neighbour, see if she's batty or not.
before: Gemma's fiancee. Just round this corner, I think.
after: Look at this. Is that him hanging on the back wall?
ru: Пошли патрульных опросить соседей, посмотрим, в уме она или нет.

quote: The neighbours said they heard someone poking around in here.
before: Perhaps Badger wasn't working alone that night. Can I be of assistance?
after: I'm still looking for Ned. I thought I saw something in here.
ru: Соседи сказали, что они слышали, будто здесь кто-то рыщет.

quote: Well, it's just you said you had a neighbour who used to babysit called Nancy.
before: What exactly did the name Nancy remind you of? How do you mean?
after: Yes, but she wouldn't remind me of a boat! She was...
ru: Вы ведь говорили, что у вас была соседка по имени Нэнси, работавшая у вас няней.

quote: At around 3:15PM a neighbour took some lunch round to his house.
before: At a police press conference yesterday, Detective Superintendent Richard Baker appealed for any witnesses who may have been in the vicinity of the murder scene to come forward, while describing Davis' last movements: "[H]e was seen at 9AM on Sunday 1 April in his front garden, where he stopped and chatted to passersby.
after: At 6PM concerned neighbours who were unable to rouse Bill gained access to his property and found him." A statement from the force suggests Davis' murderer would have departed from his house with a "heavily blood stained" appearence.

quote: Neither of which applies to your case.
before: You got in my way. A fracture like that is from violent twisting or direct impact.
after: I want you to go back to hospital. Why?
ru: Ни то, ни другое к вашему случаю не применимо.

quote: The cops either need the support of the community or their fellow officers, which this guy has neither.
before: On paper. But police corruption has been a problem in Buenos Aires.
after: So I wouldn't be surprised if his sense of loyalty is colored... Look, look, unless you have something solid on this guy, all right, I'm gonna give him the benefit of the doubt, you know?
ru: Полицейским нужна либо поддержка общества, либо их сослуживцев, а у него не было ни того, ни другого.

quote: Neither, they're just words I like.
before: Wait, I'm confused. Do those words hypnotize me or dehypnotize me?
after: Okay. As you continue to gaslight Rachel Berry, phase two will incorporate the tormenting of Will Schuester. You will start by stealing his utility bills from the mailbox in front of his condo.
ru: Ни то, ни другое, они мне просто нравятся.

quote: or unquestionable beauty and you clearly have neither.
before: The King! Admittance only with a personal invitation, now.
after: My dear! Welcome to Paradise!
ru: Очевидно, у вас нет ни того, ни другого.

quote: But neither gives us what we really want: both at the same time.
before: And this is pretty much where we are as a field right now. We can choose between good spatial coverage with airborne radar sounding and good temporal coverage in one spot with ground-based sounding.
after: And if we're going to do that, we're going to need totally new ways of observing the ice sheet. And ideally, those should be extremely low-cost so that we can take lots of measurements from lots of sensors.
ru: Но на самом деле мы хотим и то, и другое одновременно.

quote: "To do two things at once is to do neither."
after: It's a great smackdown of multitasking, isn't it, often attributed to the Roman writer Publilius Syrus, although you know how these things are, he probably never said it. What I'm interested in, though, is — is it true?
ru: «Делать две вещи одновременно — это не делать ни того, ни другого».

quote: And the problem is that neither side is listening to the other.
before: They point to the successes of aid: the eradication of smallpox, and the distribution of tens of millions of malaria bed nets and antiretrovirals. Both sides are right.
after: Even more problematic, they're not listening to poor people themselves. After 25 years of working on issues of poverty and innovation, it's true that there are probably no more market-oriented individuals on the planet than low-income people.
ru: Но проблема в том, что ни та, ни другая сторона не слушают друг друга.

quote: Tactically, things were little changed as neither team changed their defensive game.
before: The Australians tied the game 34–34 with 1:54 left in the third quarter. China's answer to the closer game was to start substituting players.
after: The game was tied again at 9:01 left in the fourth with a score of 38–38. Australia was up 42–38 at 7:14 left in the fourth.

quote: Better to have schtupped and lost then never to have schtupped at all.
before: Even if it was based on lies. Most happiness is.
after: We can't smoke in here. We also can't summon people into the clinic based on a lie motivated by a petty bet.
ru: Поиметь и потерять лучше, чем не поиметь вообще никогда.

quote: You mention this meeting to anyone, and you'll never see your sister alive again.
before: One more step and it's all over. Next time we meet, you bring your manners, and I'll bring an offer.
after: Good-bye, Mr. Mathis. Well, since it looks like we're gonna be here a while, I'd be happy to grind up some of those fine columbian coffee beans for you officers.
ru: Скажешь кому-нибудь об этой встрече, и ты никогда больше не увидишь свою сестру живой.

quote: If I hadn't ratted you out, we would have never spent two years sharing a bunkie.
before: Now, aren't you happier that I finally told you the truth? What the hell, man?
after: And now, we're closer than cousins. We're best friends.
ru: Если б я тебя не сдал. мы б никогда не провели два года в одной камере.

quote: If I'd missed his funeral, I never would be able to forgive myself.
before: You were right, Donna. About what?
after: Good luck making up with your mom. How did you know?
ru: Если бы я пропустил похороны, я бы никогда себя не простил.

quote: Most people live as if they're never going to die.
before: The final problem that David knew he could not solve was death. Many commentators have said that death is the forbidden subject of our generation.
after: Technology projects the myth of control over our mortality. We see people on our screens.
ru: Большинство людей живут так, как будто никогда не умрут.

quote: The problem is most people never really think it through.
before: And you are responsible — that's my worldview. And so, you need to understand what your worldview is.
after: They never really... codify it or qualify it or quantify it, and say, " This is what I believe in.
ru: Проблема в том, что большинство людей никогда по настоящему об этом не задумываются.

quote: And worst of all, we will never know.
before: Has it done any good? And, sadly, we don't know.
after: And the reason is that — take Africa for example. Africans have already got a lot of aid.
ru: Хуже всего то, что мы никогда не узнаем.

quote: Netherlands has never had a reported case of H5N1 before.
So never mind, somebody told us about this bar, OK?
before: But there was... The only gap in the fence where you could see, Audi, as a marketing thing, had parked a Q3 there, so we couldn't see.
after: So 12th-story bar, and it overlooked the Kremlin and Red Square and Basil's. We thought big picture windows, we'll have a look.
ru: Таким образом, неважно, кто рассказал нам об этом баре, ладно?

quote: Asleep, switched off by the Wi-Fi, never mind them!
before: Is this the plane, the actual plane? Are they all dead?
after: What is going on? Is this real?
ru: Заснули, отключились из-за Wi-Fi, неважно!

quote: Never mind the fact that her knee was all bloody.
before: And one day she fell on the playground and ripped it. And I burst into tears.
after: It was humiliating. Everybody laughed at me, except for Lexi.
ru: - Было неважно, что ее коленка была в крови

quote: Never mind. I'll pick up something for Suzette.
before: I don't suppose you've ever thought of birth control? Control?
after: Our involvement in Austria has depleted our resources. The King is not inclined to fund another foreign adventure, but I'm here to play chess, not to debate politics, and I will have you in three moves.
ru: Неважно, я подберу что-нибудь для Сюзетт.

quote: There was a long and awkward silence, and then finally, "OK, sweetie, never mind, thank you for coming in, bye!"
before: " No, no, do it in English, just sound Latina. " " Well, I am a Latina, so isn't this what a Latina sounds like? "
after: It took me most of the car ride home to realize that by " sound more Latina " she was asking me to speak in broken English. And I couldn't figure out why the fact that I was an actual, real-life, authentic Latina didn't really seem to matter.
ru: Последовала длинная и неловкая пауза, а затем она сказала: «Хорошо, дорогая, это неважно, спасибо, что пришла, пока!»

quote: Nevertheless, you are going to have to abrogate and egress from the premises.
before: Jonathan? Yes, that is tremendously amusing.
after: Don't touch me! This way.
ru: Тем не менее, тебе придётся взять свои слова назад и покинуть это помещение.

quote: Nevertheless, she kept her promise, and she saved your life.
before: Correct. We've done nothing but doubt Freya.
after: We certainly haven't demonstrated the same kindness towards her. So what the bloody hell do we do now?
ru: Тем не менее, она сдержала свое обещание. И спасла твою жизнь.

quote: Nevertheless, I do feel obligated to point out to you that she did not reject you.
before: The woman rejected me. Okay,look,I think that you have as much of a chance of having a sexual relationship with penny as the hubble telescope does of discovering at the center of every black hole is a little man with a flashlight searching for a circuit breaker.
after: You did not ask her out. You're right.
ru: Тем не менее, я обязан обратить твое внимание на то, что она не отвергала тебя.

quote: 'A French plastic one, but a touring car nevertheless.
before: 'Come on, Stig. 'Look at that. It looks like a touring car!
after: 'Look at that, look at the brakes, it shows they're working well. 'Brilliant-looking thing. 'Now, coming up to Chicago.
ru: Французская пластиковая тачка, но тем не менее туринговая.

quote: But nevertheless, my level of motivation still didn't change before he died.
before: He said, " You're not my son anymore. " I was only 11 or 12, but it hurt me deeply.
after: So in America, it was kind of ridiculous that they said I should go to high school. I didn't even go to middle school.
ru: Но тем не менее, мой уровень мотивации по-прежнему не изменился до его смерти.

quote: Nevertheless, from this time on, our results continued to improve rapidly.
before: In the graph, you can see how the lifetime, which is a crucial measure for the durability of our devices, developed over time. In 2015, just half a year into the project, we were told to scale down, to stop working on the project as soon as possible and to start over in other jobs.
after: How did that happen? After the announcement, pretty quickly, colleagues started leaving the team, and soon, we were left in a small group, all pretty much sharing the same attitude of, " I'm going to be the last person leaving the ship. "
