quote: It's a compound containing neat's-foot, Stockholm tar, saligari, silicone and eucalyptus oil.
before: Really? After all this time, you expect me to know what this stuff says?
after: Those are all generic terms, and not at all scientific. Don't make me beg.
ru: Это состав, содержащий костяное масло, Стокгольмскую смолу, салигари, силикон и эвкалиптовое масло.

quote: We found his body under an oil drum.
before: I remember it well. And it's impossible to forget!
after: The drum was cut in half and the body was under it, like this... His head and feet were covered by sacks but one foot poked out like this.
ru: Мы нашли его труп под нефтяной бочкой.

quote: It's too much of a coincidence, what, to be an oil lamp she's left on?
before: He must have burnt that flat out. I don't care what the fire service says, it's just...
after: Come on, he was burning evidence and that is so different from... Well, that is someone who knows her.
ru: Слишком большое совпадение. Она оставила масляную лампу?

quote: Not to mention the oil, squirted between each layer.
before: Made-to-measure suits. The body goes here and the machine wraps it in 200 layers of bandages.
after: What kind of oil is it? No idea, but it worked a treat.
ru: Не говоря уже о масле, которым смазывался каждый слой.

quote: Imagine Van Gogh being born before the technologies of cheap oil paints.
before: And I think it's really important. Because if you can imagine Mozart before the technology of the piano was invented — what a loss to society there would be.
after: Imagine Hitchcock before the technologies of film. Somewhere, today, there are millions of young children being born whose technology of self-expression has not yet been invented.
ru: Представьте, что Ван Гог родился до технологий дешевых масляных красок.

quote: The world's most common fluids like water, oils and alcohols respond to force linearly.
before: Or a liquid? The answer is, it depends.
after: If you push on them twice as hard, they move twice as fast. Sir Isaac Newton, of apple fame, first proposed this relationship, and so those fluids are called Newtonian fluids.
ru: Самые распространённые жидкости, как вода, масло и алкоголь отвечают на воздействие линейно.

quote: So it actually hastens oil getting into the body easily and readily.
before: The solvents in them do that very efficiently. So they break down lipid membranes in our body, starting with cells of the skin, the cells of organs.
after: Oil contains hundreds of hydrocarbon compounds and other compounds that are toxic to every organ in the body. And so with the dispersants combined, you have this very synergistic combined toxicity.
ru: Поэтому этот процесс с лёгкостью ускоряет попадание нефти в наш организм.

quote: I have never traded or benefited from any oil deals with Iraq.
before: I've now had a chance to read the report which was compiled without this Senate committee asking me a single question about these absurd allegations. I repeat once more.

quote: The night Rolf died, I was in new Orleans, visiting an old friend.
before: So where were you the night your brother died? Whoa, whoa, whoa. This is not getting any better.
after: Does your old friend have a name? - Adam haupfman.
ru: Ночью, когда умер Рольф, я была в Новом Орлеане, в гостях у старого друга.

quote: So you pulled an old man out of the rubble?
before: I was nearby. I heard an explosion, came over to see what happened.
after: Tourniquet on an arm? Splint another man's leg.
ru: Так вы вытащили старика из под обломков?

quote: To sing in front of old people. Mm-hmm.
before: Get this. So he takes me to a nursing home...
after: So I'd be a star but in a comfortable environment, 'cause otherwise i would freak out. It was the whole works. He had the red carpet, he had the car, suit.
ru: Привез меня в дом престарелых, чтобы я спела старикам.

quote: The least you can do is set that old man's mind to rest.
before: Time to go home. Your people think you're dead.
after: He thinks I'm dead? He wasn't much wrong.
ru: Как минимум, ты должна успокоить своего старика.

quote: For that I won a big old plaque -- Man of the Year in Education.
before: And last year I put 88 percent of those kids in college and I've averaged over 80 percent for 15 years. We've made a fascinating discovery: there's nothing wrong with the kids that affection and sunshine and food and enthusiasm and Herbie's music can't cure.
after: I beat out all the Ph.D.'s because I figured that if you treat children like human beings, it increases the likelihood they're going to behave that way. And why we can't institute that policy in every school and in every city and every town remains a mystery to me.
ru: За это я получил большую старую табличку — Человек года в образовании.

quote: How do they treat their young and their old?
before: Where do the inhabitants live and work and go to school? What do they eat and how do they play?
after: What relationships do they have with the animals and plants of the world? And what do those animals and plants look like?
ru: Как они обращаются с детьми и стариками?

quote: We're still living with the old paradigm of age as an arch.
before: That's an entire second adult lifetime that's been added to our lifespan. And yet, for the most part, our culture has not come to terms with what this means.
after: That's the metaphor, the old metaphor. You're born, you peak at midlife and decline into decrepitude.
ru: Мы всё ещё живём согласно старой парадигме, где возраст рассматривается как дуга.

quote: He moved to Chicago when he was eight years old.
before: Terkel was born in New York City in 1912.
after: He was mostly known for his oral histories, but he was also host of his own radio show, an author of several books, and an activist.

quote: I got a messy situation going on on my end, too.
before: I'm getting a divorce. Yeah, I know how that goes.
after: Had to let my guy go. Had to cut him loose.
ru: У меня тут тоже неприятная ситуация.

quote: That's gonna be a problem on my end.
before: The remaining 12 will be arriving in your territories. We need a search of each one.
after: Colombian port officials are bought off by the cartels, and drugs are going in and out. They're not just gonna open the doors for the FBI.
ru: С моей стороны возникнут проблемы.

quote: Didn't quite go that well on my end.
before: And Sage is over the moon. Well, I'm happy to hear that.
after: First of all, Deacon told Maddie that he proposed. So, what?
ru: С моей стороны не все нормально.

quote: Now, who I choose to do business with on my end is not your problem.
before: You could charge twice the current rate for what I provide, and your customers would pay it. Hands down.
after: You won't see him. You won't interact with him.
ru: с кем я хочу делать бизнес с моей стороны - не ваша проблема.

quote: She believed he'd pushed his blocks under Milan's feet on purpose.
before: -When Milan died, Eugenia was somehow convinced it was little Peter who killed him,
after: After that she just stayed in the bedroom with Peter, watching over him. Day and night she just sat there watching him, holding his hand.
ru: Она была уверена, что он специально подложил под ноги Милана блоки конструктора.

quote: Why are they putting you in a coma on purpose?
before: Just want to get a sense of where we stand. If I have any questions, I'll ask you later.
after: Your... your brain seems fine. It's not like you think you're Napoléon.
ru: Зачем им специально погружать тебя в кому?

quote: I dropped the keys on purpose so she'll lead us here.
before: It was all just talk, but she... What the hell happened?
after: And what happened? You guys stopped for a smoothie?
ru: - Я бросил ключи нарочно, чтобы она привела нас сюда.

quote: You're gonna ask your own son to lose on purpose?
before: All we got to do is take those bets and get Chris to take a dive! Wait, hold on, Peter.
after: Damn, Quagmire! Your fridge gives you water from the door?
ru: Ты хочешь попросить своего собственного сына проиграть нарочно?

quote: So allow me to express that if I make you laugh, it's usually on purpose.
before: A muscle memory that overcomes even the most bitter of times, my memory is spotted with days of laughing until I cried, or crying until I laughed. Laughter and tears are both involuntary human reactions, testaments to our capacity for expression.
after: And if I make you cry, I'll still think you are beautiful. This is for my cousin Zeinab, bedridden on a random afternoon.
ru: Позвольте мне выразить себя: если я заставляю вас смеяться — это нарочно.

quote: Did I check it on purpose or just casually glance at the clock?
before: Was I hungry? Was I late?
after: And this is the key part — representing the details of my days and my personality through my data collection. Using data as a lens or a filter to discover and reveal, for example, my never-ending anxiety for being late, even though I'm absolutely always on time.
ru: Специально ли я смотрела на часы или просто взглянула мельком?

quote: It hurts more if you believe somebody is doing it to you on purpose.
before: The first shock hurts like hell. The second shock hurts just as much, and the third and the fourth and the fifth.
after: The most extreme example of this is that in some cases, pain under the right circumstances can transform into pleasure. Humans have this extraordinarily interesting property that will often seek out low-level doses of pain in controlled circumstances and take pleasure from it — as in the eating of hot chili peppers and roller coaster rides.
ru: Боль сильнее, если вы верите, что кто-то причиняет её специально.

quote: Once we get Barrett, we can go to the CIA, the FBI.
before: Just so we're sure here, you're not actually planning on turning this Barrett character over to Vaughn, right? No.
after: He's a pretty big card to play. You think it's enough to get Jesse back in?
ru: Как только мы получим Барретта, мы можем обратиться в ЦРУ, ФБР.

quote: And once he did that, how long do you think we'd keep breathing?
before: If general Monroe finds out that Jason went A.W.O.L., what would happen? He'd question our loyalty too.
after: Please. I'm doing this for you.
ru: И как только он сделает это, как ты думаешь, долго ли мы сможем продолжать дышать?

quote: I'll have you know, I once tossed a rabid bull off a cliff.
before: We'll be watching for your return. Now, are you sure you can hold me?
after: How is that even remotely relevant? I can hold you.
ru: Знаешь, однажды я скинул бешеного быка с обрыва.

quote: I told myself, once, once I had exposed Sixtus, relief would come.
before: Eventually even you won't be able to stop him. Would you have preferred I not?
after: And has it? I didn't do this for me.
ru: Я сказала себе, однажды, однажды, когда я разоблачу Сикста, облегчение придет.

quote: Well, the standard explanation was once summed up by the British Prime Minister, Margaret Thatcher.
before: The poor borrow more, save less, smoke more, exercise less, drink more and eat less healthfully. Why?
after: And she called poverty " a personality defect. " (Laughter) A lack of character, basically.
ru: Привычное объяснение было однажды высказано британским премьер-министром Маргарет Тэтчер.

quote: Colfax Avenue, here in Denver, Colorado, was once called the longest, wickedest street in America.
after: My office is there in the same place — it's a medical desert. There are government clinics and hospitals nearby, but they're not enough to handle the poor who live in the area.
ru: Улица Колфакс в Денвере, штат Колорадо, однажды была названа самой длинной неблагополучной улицей в Америке.

quote: But it has happened before once in history, right back at the dawn of science.
before: It's a difficult thing to do, however. We're talking about changing the culture of entire large parts of science.
after: Galileo, 1609: he points his telescope up at the sky towards Saturn, and he sees for the first time in history what we now know are the rings of Saturn. Does he tell everybody in the world?
ru: Но однажды в истории это уже случилось, ещё на заре науки.

quote: Once the acrobatic trick has been repeated a few times, the computer analyzes the data.
before: Stanford University has developed an artificial intelligence software that allows their model helicopters to learn complex aerial acrobatics simply by "watching" a human. The human controlled helicopter is monitored by a variety of sensors which funnel all the data into the AI software.
after: It is then capable of repeating, with greater accuracy than the human controller, the acrobatics. This system allows the helicopters to preform aerial maneuvers far more complicated than previously possible.

quote: Once in a blue moon, when we need to discuss meats.
before: You two talk often? No. No, I wouldn't say often.
after: Meat. Assorted meats.
ru: Раз в сто лет, когда нам нужно обсудить блюда.

quote: Happy to give self-righteous indignation an airing once in a blue moon.
before: Robert's involved with a little anti-racist group. All white, of course.
after: Isn't that right, Robert? Yes, darling.
ru: Которые счастливы поддаваться лицемерным заявлениям во всеуслышание раз в сто лет.

quote: Surely we're allowed to solve a case quickly at least once in a blue moon?
before: What? ! Oh, come on, Chief!
after: ! So who took her phone? Uh... Maybe she just lost it earlier in the day and didn't mention.
ru: Можем же мы хоть раз в сто лет так быстро раскрыть дело?

quote: Nope, just trying to get him to pay his bar tab every once in a blue moon.
before: Yeah, I see plenty of Henry. You two still trying to get back what you had in high school?
after: Hey, you remember that time that I caught you and Henry breaking into Dad's liquor cabinet? Y'all made me drink a coffee cup full of brandy just so I couldn't tell on you? No.
ru: Нет, пытаюсь заставить его оплачивать счет хоть раз в сто лет.

quote: I talk to my mother once in a blue moon on the telephone.
before: I feel, still, a very strong connection of love for all of these people and for the land. TD: And I still do get to keep in touch with my mother and father, albeit infrequently.
after: And my experience is that, when I'm talking to her, with every second that passes during our conversation, the feeling of love that binds us is bringing us closer and closer together. TD: So those were just a few remarks about my personal background.
ru: Очень редко я разговариваю со своей матерью по телефону.

quote: As of late, I find my perception is blinded by only one thing: Revenge.
before: By expectations... By experiences.
after: Things aren't what they seem. I can promise you,
ru: В последнее время я убеждаюсь, что мое сознание ослеплено одним единственным... местью.

quote: It was the only way I could see the truth.
before: I said I would never lie to you. I know that now, I know what you did what you did to Trick and Aife, you had to.
after: And the truth is, dad, we have a greater purpose. You're the only one I can trust.
ru: Это был единственный способ увидеть правду.

quote: You seem to only help people if it helps you.
before: I am just someone trying to help you. We have that in common.
after: I've seen what happens to the selfless. - Your parents?
ru: Вы кажетесь тем, кто помогает людям, только если они помогают вам.

quote: He's not only family but a favourite too.
before: Since when have the Red Guard had the authority to arrest and imprison a Musketeer? His Majesty appointed Feron as Commander of the Red Guard.
after: And this Marcheaux, he's bothered you before? - Marcheaux doesn't scare me.
ru: Он не только родственник, но и любимец.

quote: The barbers were not only willing to do it but they were damn good at it.
before: The next stop on my journey was Dallas, Texas, where we learned that barbers were not only willing but fully able to roll up their sleeves and participate in delivering needed health services to improve the health of their customers and their community. We teamed up with an amazing cadre of black barbers and taught them how to measure blood pressure and how to counsel their customers and refer them to doctors to help manage high blood pressure.
after: Over a three-year period, the barbers measured thousands of blood pressures resulting in hundreds of black men being referred to doctors for medical care of their high blood pressure. These barber-doctor partnerships resulted in a 20 percent increase in the number of men who were able to achieve target blood pressure levels and a three-point drop, on average, in the blood pressure of each participant.
ru: Парикмахеры не только были рады помочь, но и делали это чертовски хорошо.

quote: So, don’t look backwards. That’s my only recommendation here.
before: I’ m going to see how many of you at the back of the room can actually get those things onto the stage. So the way they work is, you know, you just put your finger in the thing, pull them back, and off you go.
after: I want to see how many of you can get these things on the stage. So come on!
ru: Так что не оглядывайтесь. Это единственная рекомендация.

quote: They are only one-seventh of the way up that tree.
before: There are two people climbing this tree, Gaya, which is thought to be one of the oldest Redwoods. There they are.
after: You do feel a sense of exposure. There is a small person right down there on the ground.
ru: Вот они. Они преодолели только одну седьмую часть пути вверх по дереву.

quote: Several others also exist, but they affect only animals.
before: They were looking for the way the parasites inhibit it and lead to the death of the victim. Of the several known parasite species, the two that can infect humans were chosen to study, called Trypanosoma brucei gambiense and Trypanosoma brucei rhodensiense.

quote: In your opinion, doctor, Was the defendant severely stressed at the time of the fire?
before: No. She wasn't. So who's he found to say that she was?
after: Based on my interviews with megan, I believe that her stress level Had risen to the clinical designation a.C.S.S. And what is that?
ru: По вашему мнению, доктор, была ли обвиняемая немного под стрессом во время пожара?

quote: Maybe you haven't cheated on her, but in my opinion, you will.
before: Write that down, please. Make a note of that.
after: In your mind, you already have. I love my wife.
ru: Может Вы и не изменяли ей, но, по-моему мнению, Вы можете так поступить.

quote: In your professional opinion, you think we got a shot?
before: ♪ Boyz II Men, ABC, BBD ♪ - Mm-hmm. - So, what do you think?
after: I mean, we're talking about Boyz II Men here. - We want to go and we want to win.
ru: По вашему профессиональному мнению, у нас есть шансы?

quote: Or maybe it's just that it's everyone's eloquent way of not having to heed my opinions.
before: Just worry about yourself right now, okay? Echoing the universal sentiment that Huntington's should occupy 100% of my thoughts.
after: Well, I'd like to know how you're feeling, Dad. Pretty much the same, sweetheart. Thank you.
ru: Или же это просто удобная причина для всех не учитывать мое собственное мнение

quote: And all of us have the opportunity to change public opinion and to change public policy.
before: I am open about my own recovery to change public opinion, to change public policy and to change the course of this epidemic and empower the millions of Americans who struggle with this journey to be open and candid about who they are. People are more than their disease.
after: All of us know someone who has an addiction, and all of us can do our part to change how we view people with addiction in the United States. So when you see someone with an addiction, don't think of a drunk or a junkie or an addict or an abuser — see a person; offer them help; give them kindness and compassion.
ru: И все мы имеем возможность изменить общественное мнение и государственную политику.

quote: Opinions varied, but the media focused on problematizing the removal of statues.
before: (Applause) Sethembile Msezane: On April 9, 2015, the Cecil John Rhodes statue was scheduled to be removed after a month of debates for and against its removal by various stakeholders. This caused a widespread interest in statues in South Africa.
after: On that — well, that year, I had just begun my master's at the University of Cape Town. During the time of the debate of the statue, I had been having reoccurring dreams about a bird.
ru: Мнения разошлись, но СМИ сфокусировались на создании проблемы из сноса статуй.

quote: How have we convinced ourselves that every opinion has to count?
before: That is what it is for knowledge to count. How have we convinced ourselves that in the moral sphere there is no such thing as moral expertise, or moral talent, or moral genius even?
after: How have we convinced ourselves that every culture has a point of view on these subjects worth considering? Does the Taliban have a point of view on physics that is worth considering?
ru: Как так получилось, что мы убедили себя в том, что необходимо учитывать любое мнение?

quote: Q: What are your opinions on Mississauga's congestion and public transit funding?
Only, in this case, I'm offering you the opportunity to become a Kingsman.
before: Well, you're full of surprises. Yes, like My Fair Lady.
after: A tailor? A Kingsman agent.
ru: Но в этом случае я предлагаю тебе возможность попасть в Kingsman.

quote: While touring the mountains, he took the opportunity to tell his life.
before: I know that you have sent from heaven. " Because according to legend Saraguros the gods, to the image of Christ, They return to Earth to see them, to observe and see who deserved heaven.
after: He firmly believed that I was there to observe them. And up there counting their behavior.
ru: Во время похода в горы, он воспользовался возможностью, чтобы рассказать про свою жизнь.

quote: A suspicious package, someone looking for an opportunity that never came.
before: Well, maybe there was, and we stopped it. Well, then we should see something.
after: Something. Wait.
ru: Подозрительный сверток, кто-то в поисках возможности, которая не подвернулась.

quote: I'm simply affording you the opportunity to apply for it.
before: I'm sorry, I believe you've misunderstood. I'm not giving you the job.
after: Have a seat; we'll get started with the interview. Wha...
ru: Я просто даю тебе возможность побороться за неё.

quote: This is an opportunity for families to use their energy savings to sponsor their future.
before: And for those with high energy burdens, it can help them reclaim 20 percent of their income — 20 percent of a person's income who's struggling to make ends meet. This is life-changing.
after: I think back to my great-grandmother and her neighbors, the impossible choices that they had to make and the effect it had on our whole community. But this is not just about them.
ru: Это возможность использовать сбережения от электроэнергии на благо своего будущего.

quote: And we used this opportunity to exploit the specific situation.
before: But how to address these hidden and disguised forces? With my colleague, Christoph Wachter, we accepted the invitation of the Swiss Embassy.
after: If people are spying on us, it stands to reason that they have to listen to what we are saying. (Laughter) On the roof of the Swiss Embassy, we installed a series of antennas.
ru: и решили воспользоваться возможностью сыграть на сложившейся ситуации.

quote: I'll be honest with you; we're into it for business growth opportunities.
before: We're into this over a billion dollars already, so I would hope people would think we're serious when we're spending that kind of money. And secondly, it's a fundamental business proposition.
after: We can't grow our business unless we solve these problems. The growth of the auto industry will be capped by sustainability issues if we don't solve the problems.
ru: Я буду честен с вами: мы занимаемся этим из-за возможностей роста бизнеса. Мы не можем развивать наш бизнес, не решив этих проблем.

quote: We can't get it wrong, we cannot bypass this opportunity.
before: Dick Hubbard, Mayor of Auckland, said: "In the past Auckland had missed too many opportunities.
after: Controversy is a good sign, a healthy sign – all the major projects around the world have had controversy. Today it's not about rugby, it is about boldness and vision against caution."

quote: There is another camera on the building opposite you.
before: - Yeah, I see it. - Watch...
after: Do you see it? And finally, at the top of the building on your right.
ru: На здании напротив вас – другая камера.

quote: He went in the opposite direction through the empty lot.
before: Gents. We worked the wrong end of this. The shooter didn't go over the bridge.
after: Let's go. Where? He's down there on his knees looking for something.
ru: Стрелок не переходил через мост. Он ушел в противоположном направлении через пустырь.

quote: Is this or isn't this the exact opposite of who I asked you to book?
before: - Don't say it. of a border control group called the "Citizens Militia."
after: God damn it, Jim! What the hell were you--
ru: Это разве не противоположность тем, кого я просила приглашать?

quote: What if it was the opposite of a desk?
before: - A desk? - But what if it wasn't?
after: I'm sorry, I'm still not exactly sure what you do. I'm the Chief Design Officer.
ru: Что если это противоположность стола?

quote: And it's funny, it's sort of the opposite feeling, because it doesn't come from getting attention.
before: And I'm grateful for that, because like I said, it's a powerful feeling. But there's another powerful feeling that I've also been lucky to experience a lot as an actor.
after: It comes from paying attention. When I'm acting, I get so focused that I'm only paying attention to one thing.
ru: И, что интересно, это противоположное чувство, потому что его испытываешь не от получения внимания,

quote: Now, the program says that the opposite of play is not work, it's depression.
before: (Laughter) This took a long time — I had to get Homer down and put him through the fMRI and the SPECT and multiple EEGs, but as a couch potato, his brain has shrunk. And we do know that in domestic animals and others, when they're play deprived, they don't — and rats also — they don't develop a brain that is normal.
after: And I think if you think about life without play — no humor, no flirtation, no movies, no games, no fantasy and, and, and. Try and imagine a culture or a life, adult or otherwise without play.
ru: А теперь, наша программа говорит, что противоположность игры — не работа, это депрессия.

quote: I've described to you the opposite of a success story.

before: How do they do that? Lower education... they limit culture... censor information... they censor any means of individual expression.
after: Okay. See you next week.
ru: И важно помнить, что.. это закономерность... которая повторяется на протяжении всей истории.

quote: Well, he's not adhering to any pattern now.
before: Almost there. One sec... One sec.
after: None whatsoever. All right, you two.
ru: Ну, теперь он не придерживается какой-либо закономерности.

quote: If Grams ever does get home, she won't be pleased to find out you've rubbed the pattern off her bowl.
before: To not hating each other. Cheers.
after: Joey, I appreciate whatever reasons you have for pretending you're fine but you don't have to do that with me. Do you miss me?
ru: Знаешь, если бабуля когда-то вернется домой, она не обрадуется тому, что ты стёрла узор на ее блюде.

quote: Behavioral researchers have identified consistent patterns that seem to guide this process of impression updating.
before: If so, you might choose to avoid him the next time you see him. That said, we can change our impressions in light of new information.
after: On one hand, learning very negative, highly immoral information about someone typically has a stronger impact than learning very positive, highly moral information. So, unfortunately for our new friend from the football game, his bad behavior at the game might outweigh his good behavior at the park.
ru: Бихевиористы обнаружили закономерности, управляющие процессом обновления впечатлений.

quote: So what do these patterns look like again?
before: So he sent a letter back to John saying, " It turns out you can generate these patterns using prime number theory. " And John went about and solved the sonar problem for the Navy.
after: Here's a pattern here. This is an 88-by-88-sized Costas array.
ru: Как же выглядят эти закономерности?

quote: It adds together the interference pattern from two raindrops that land near each other.
before: This is the " Double Raindrop. " Of all my sculptures, it's the most talkative.
after: Instead of expanding circles, they're expanding hexagons. All the sculptures move by mechanical means.
ru: Она соединяет вместе интерференционный узор двух капель, которые падают рядом друг с другом.

quote: The scientists suggested cross-pollination and changing farming patterns in Assam were likely the causes.
after: However, they still have to check other possible influences such as changing agro-climatic conditions.

quote: The goods are returned upon payment in person.
before: Pawn shop takes half a month interest even for a day. The principle 80,000 Won plus interest 1,600 Won.
after: Oh! Really, sir? Didn't know that.
ru: товар возвращается лично клиенту после полной оплаты кредита.

quote: So, when Liu gave me the drugs, I asked him about money, payments.
before: Something gnawing at me. What?
after: And Liu said-- and I quote-- "We'll talk finances later."
ru: Когда Лю отдал мне наркотики, я спросила его о деньгах, об оплате.

quote: Further commission payment can be made via mobile phone.
before: Due to the credit crisis brought on by Five/Nine, many private businesses cannot afford waste management services, which has sparked a cottage industry of roadside garbage burning at discounted rates. Due to the advance of Five/Nine, the Taxi and Limousine Commission asks that drivers now accept Ecoin.
after: Just download the Ecoin app from the Play Store or App Store, scan the QR code once you reach your destination, and the payment will be withdrawn from your Ecoin Wallet. You had me worried not answering my calls after all that went down.
ru: Оплата может быть произведена через мобильный телефон.

quote: My team uncovered a large payment to Tom Larsen from a bank account associated with Olivia.
before: The warrant I'm submitting to have Olivia Pope arrested. On what grounds?
after: It's all right there. I'm sure this isn't what it seems.
ru: Моя команда обнаружила огромный платеж Тому Ларсену с банковского счета Оливии Поуп.

quote: Now, the US spends over three billion a year on energy bill payment assistance.
before: We're connecting neighborhoods to community solar and spearheading community-led smart home research and installation programs to help families bring down their energy bills. We're even working directly with elected officials, advocating for more equitable pricing, because to see this vision of energy equity and resilience succeed, we have to work together sustainably.
after: And these programs do help millions of people, but they're only able to help a fraction of those in need. In fact, there is a 47-billion-dollar home-energy affordability gap, so assistance alone is not sustainable.
ru: США тратят более 3 млрд долларов в год на помощь в оплате электричества.

quote: It's a system that really ties together all the transportation assets into a single payment system.
before: Pedestrian zones and dedicated traffic lanes are going to be created, and all of this will cut down the average rush hour commute to get across town in New York from about an hour today at rush hour to about 20 minutes. Now if you look at Hong Kong, they have a very interesting system called Octopus there.
after: So parking garages, buses, trains, they all operate within the same system. Now shared car services are also springing up around the world, and these efforts, I think, are great.
ru: Это система связывает весь транспортный парк единой платежной системой.

quote: We accept payment for advertising, and we mark it as such.
before: The other thing I wanted to mention just briefly is that we have a tremendous ability and responsibility to provide people the right information, and we view ourselves like a newspaper or a magazine — that we should provide very objective information. And so in our search results, we never accept payment for our search results.
after: And that's unlike many of our competitors. And I think decisions we're able to make like that have a tremendous impact on the world, and it makes me really proud to be involved with Google.
ru: Нам платят только за рекламу, которую мы и продвигаем как рекламу.

quote: What were some of the items/services that required buying/payment?
before: You've said elsewhere that the production budget was about $800.

quote: Please, let me sit in peace with my uncle.
before: I've not betrayed you. I wish to be alone with my uncle.
after: It really is. It's wonderful.
ru: Прошу тебя, оставь меня в покое с моим дядей.

quote: War feeds our glory there is no place for peace.
before: And when he does pray doom does not fall upon your heads. Brave warriors!
after: Do you want them followed? We could kill them in their sleep... and feast on their flesh this very night.
ru: Война питает нашу славу. Там нет места для мира.

quote: Leave the devil in peace and let's concentrate on our task.
before: Shush, you're making my hairs stand on end. Sometimes I am not sure that we are not working for the devil himself.
after: Salvador told us that we would find everything necessary for the mission here and I don't see anything. Let's look in the rooms.
ru: Оставим дьявола в покое и сосредоточимся на наших делах.

quote: Men at war who were ordered to do appalling things and are now at peace.
before: Those are things I know nothing about but I do know about forgiveness and I've seen a lot of men who have confessed their sins admitted their guilt, and left their burdens behind them. Stronger men than you.
after: Well, I gotta hand it to you, Padre. You came here with your guns loaded this time.
ru: Людей, которым приказывали на войне делать ужасающие вещи которые теперь обрели покой.

quote: And then there's this beautiful statement: "We came in peace for all mankind."
before: This plaque is a beautiful object, and one that I want to talk to you a little bit about. First, you might notice that there's two globes, representing all of earth.
after: Now, at first, this is just nice poetic language, but it's also set in a typeface that's perfect for this moment. It seems industrial, it seems engineered.
ru: А ниже красивая фраза: «Мы пришли с миром от всего человечества».

quote: And donors are supposed to bring peace by building schools and roads.
before: This is a picture I took in 2005, walking on Fridays over the hills in Kabul, and for me it's a symbolic picture of an open future for a young generation. So, doctors prescribe medication.
after: Military collect weapons, and depression stays intact. Why?
ru: а благотворительные организации должны приносить мир: строить школы и прокладывать дороги.

quote: These are the ideals that a war-torn Libya needs desperately in order to achieve peace.
before: We need to start acting as agents of compassion and mercy. We need to develop a feminine discourse that not only honors but also implements mercy instead of revenge, collaboration instead of competition, inclusion instead of exclusion.
after: For peace has an alchemy, and this alchemy is about the intertwining, the alternation between the feminine and masculine perspectives. That's the real zipper.
ru: Это те идеалы, которые пострадавшая от войны Ливия срочно должна воплотить, чтобы достичь мира.

quote: The initial deadline for the peace talks was Sunday at midnight, but was extended thrice.
before: Rebel negotiators faced intense pressure to accept the amended deal, as diplomats from the United States, Britain, Canada and the European Union struggled to find common ground.
after: The peace plan was prepared by mediators from the African Union and was amended after the rebel groups did not agree at an early draft. International negotiators, including U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Robert Zoellick, Nigerian President Olusegun Obasanjo and British International Development Secretary Hilary Benn, said the deal was the best hope for peace in Darfur.

quote: People are really stupid. They didn't come to the funeral just because of how he died.
before: That would be nice. I should have practiced.
after: There was no one, only us and Nathalie. Why don't I feel sad?
ru: Какие всё-таки люди подлецы, никто не пришел на похороны, когда узнали, как он умер.

quote: I'm not all too interested in dying like these people.
before: You can't risk it, sir. Mission comes first.
after: Give me the gun, Sailor. Frankie, don't be stupid.
ru: Мне не слишком хочется умирать как те люди.

quote: Guys, we all have people we're worried about.
before: It was your truck from your contact that broke down. The only protocol that's worked so far on this mission are the sat phones-- technology designed by someone who's a lot more like me than you!
after: Including... this woman and child. This is why we're here.
ru: Парни, у нас всех есть люди, о которых мы беспокоимся.

quote: People would lose the goods they'd be coming to sell.
before: There was a road to a kingdom, and there was a rock in the road. And people would just avoid it, but horses would break their legs on it and die, wagon wheels would come off.
after: That's what happened to a little girl. The cask of beer her family brewed fell right off.
ru: Люди теряли товар, который собирались продать.

quote: But when people learned what her son was accused of, she didn't get that sympathy.
before: I knew I would find her someday, or we would find each other. Because, when people heard that my son was a victim, I got immediate sympathy.
after: But her suffering is equal to mine. So we met in November 2002, and Aicha will now tell you how that came about.
ru: Когда же же люди узнавали, в чем обвиняют ее сына, она этого сочувствия не получала.

quote: And then, the weekend came: events all over the city, people yelling "Happy Ceasefire Day!"
before: And so now what was happening was from the most beautiful corners of crack houses to the grimiest corners of politicians' offices, everybody — (Laughter) was talking about this thing Baltimore was doing together. Right?
after: Over 200 people got their records expunged and got jobs, and people went into drug recovery programs because of what was happening in our city that weekend. People were going, " But the air feels different in Baltimore.
ru: И вот наступают выходные: по всему городу шествия, люди кричат «С днём перемирия!»

quote: And I wondered what it was like for people who lived under the one-child policy.
before: Becoming a mother gave me a totally new perspective on my own childhood, and it brought back my memories of early life in China. For the past three decades, everyone in my family had to apply for a permission from the government to have a child.
after: So I decided to make a documentary about it. One of the people I interviewed was the midwife who delivered all of the babies born in my village, including myself.
ru: Я заинтересовалась, как жили люди при политике «Одна семья — один ребёнок».

quote: Many blogs received comments from people with similar circumstances, worldwide.
before: Another user replied to this posting, saying that they were even able to read the other, random user's inbox. Both a blogger who works at a computing company's office in Johannesburg, South Africa and a Norwegian news outlet reported similar troubles.

quote: Okay, so the lungs for Mark Wilson are perfect.
before: What's going on? We got 'em. We got the lungs.
after: Same with the heart, liver and kidneys, but those are going to other hospitals. Which means you're going to be tripping over a bunch of other teams in a crowded OR.
ru: Идеальные лёгкие для мистера Уилсона.

quote: I think that Jason became a perfect scapegoat because he's not here.
before: yeah, yeah, this is good, this is good. He was very hostile, refused to help in any way, and then he later left the drug rehabilitation centre and was found having died from a drug overdose.
after: He died, so he can't be questioned or, you know, anything. I mean, he can't, he can't even defend himself. It's kinda like a nightmare.
ru: Думаю, Джейсон стал идеальным козлом отпущения, потому что его больше нет.

quote: Gil, Ellie was saying what a perfect threesome we make.
before: Marry me, Shoo. I can't.
after: Eh? What's up?
ru: Гил, Элли говорит, что мы идеальная троица.

quote: So at least show me what you had planned for this perfect date.
before: Great. But how?
after: Okay, but promise not to laugh. You hired this guy?
ru: Хотя бы покажи мне, что ты еще запланировал для своего идеального свидания.

quote: The perfect robot will be indistinguishable from the human, and that scares us.
before: MT: We are intrigued by the possibility of creating a mechanical version of ourselves. We build them so they look like us, behave like us, and think like us.
after: In the first story about robots, they turn against their creators. It's one of the leitmotifs of science fiction.
ru: Совершенный робот будет неотличим от человека, и это нас пугает.

quote: And might I add that the "Cha-Cha Slide" provides a perfect short dance party.
before: And those difficult home experiences created real barbed-wire barriers to learning, and we had to figure out a way over it. So our teachers continued to practice with lesson plans, doing shorter lesson plans with a single focus, allowing kids to engage, and continued to incorporate these movement breaks, allowing kids to jump up and down in class and dance for two minutes straight, because we learned that taking breaks helps the learner retain new information.
after: (Laughter) I saw teachers say, " What happened to you? " instead of " What's wrong with you? "
ru: И хочу заметить, что «Ча-Ча Слайд» идеально походит для короткой дискотеки.

quote: This is not always good, because what is your perfect world?
before: Dean Koontz built this fabulous home theater, which is — I don't think accidentally — in Art Deco style. That symbolizes this sense of being safe and at home.
after: What is your ideal, and also, what has been edited out? Is it something important?
ru: Но это не всегда хорошо. Что означает «идеальный мир»?

quote: "Everything went perfect," Gevaert said, just after the race.
after: She also put things into perspective: "It's just sports." For Gevaert, who just turned 28, it is the summit of her career so far.

quote: Perhaps we think other things are more important.
before: It's probably why you and Roebuck click. He ran from the challenge of authority as well.
after: Lighten up, Sundance. It was just an observation.
ru: Возможно, мы считаем более важным другое.

quote: Well, perhaps while you're at it, you could ask Mr Evans a few pertinent questions.
before: Bloody, bloody hell. If you're to marry them, ~ you have to put them through their paces, give them advice. ~ Of course.
after: Mother put herself down for a cremation with the Co-op. No point dragging it out, we've got a wedding to think of.
ru: Может, когда будешь разговаривать, сможешь задать мистеру Эвансу несколько подходящих вопросов.

quote: Well, then, perhaps you'll allow me to examine your hand.
before: I am afraid not but my thanks, all the same. And for what you tried to do for the girl.
after: How long have you been taking mercury? Almost a week now.
ru: Тогда, возможно, вы позволите мне осмотреть вашу руку?

quote: Perhaps this doppelganger has different hair or a sense of primordial destiny.
before: Inside every man is another version of himself. What the Germans call a doppelganger.
after: I don't know. Maybe he holds a scepter.
ru: У этого двойника может быть другой цвет волос, он может осознавать свое предназначение...

quote: Perhaps you've heard about this in the news.
before: But eventually, bacteria were exposed to antibiotics so frequently they were forced to adapt. And survival is the key driver of evolution, and that's what we're talking about here: bacterial evolution.
after: It's referred to as " Antimicrobial Resistance. " The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention call antimicrobial resistance one of the greatest public health challenges of our time.
ru: Возможно, вы слышали он ней в новостях.

quote: But we can touch each other, taste each other perhaps, if we get close enough.
before: Isn't that amazing? Isn't that incredible that we can't read each other's minds?
after: But we can't read each other's minds. I find that quite astonishing.
ru: Но мы можем дотронуться друг до друга; возможно, попробовать друг друга на вкус, если мы достаточно близки.

quote: Let me be very clear, and perhaps controversial, that open government is not about transparent government.
before: But it's not limited to the local. British Columbia, Canada, is publishing a catalogue of all the ways that its residents and citizens can engage with the state in the cocreation of governance.
after: Simply throwing data over the transom doesn't change how government works. It doesn't get anybody to do anything with that data to change lives, to solve problems, and it doesn't change government.
ru: Позвольте мне выразиться очень ясно и, возможно, полемично: «открытое государство» не означает «прозрачное» государство.

quote: Now we'll be competing with them perhaps as one entity.
before: Air India's head Raghu Menon expressed concern about what the Kingfisher-Jet alliance meant for his own airline. "We were competing with both these airlines separately.
after: It'll be a challenge," he said.

quote: With regret we have to extend parole period.
before: I'm just kidding. And, uh. You know ... Stop talking. The police reported antisocial behavior.
after: Increased heart rate is detected. You take the pill?
ru: Мы обязаны продлить срок надзора.

quote: The great period of Greece, if you like.
before: - And where is it from, darling? - Greece.
after: In fact, during the Peloponnesian War in about 415 BC there was a terrible incident known as The Mutilation of the Herms when they were at war with Sparta, the Athenians, and every single penis had been hacked off. And they blamed this on the disastrous expedition to
ru: Из величайшего периода в Греции, если вас это устроит.

quote: If not, I'm gonna blow your backbone outta your belly, period.
before: We're gonna walk you up to the door, and you're gonna tell the dude to open up. If he opens up, cool.
after: You copy? Look, man, I don't know what...
ru: Если нет, то я буду дуть позвоночник сбился ваш живот, период.

quote: Here is a chart to the US national debt for the same period.
before: For in our financial system money is debt, and debt is money. Here is a chart of the US money supply from 1950 to 2006.
after: How interesting it is, that the trends, are virtually the same. For the more money there is the more debt there is.
ru: А это — график национального долга за тот же период.

quote: Eighty percent of the entire world's poverty alleviation during that period happened in China.
before: In just 30 years, China went from one of the poorest agricultural countries in the world to its second-largest economy. Six hundred fifty million people were lifted out of poverty.
after: In other words, all the new and old democracies put together amounted to a mere fraction of what a single, one-party state did without voting. See, I grew up on this stuff: food stamps.
ru: Сокращение всемирной нищеты на 80% в тот период произошло в Китае.

quote: This is the critical period for sound development, but what's going on up there?
before: The babies in the United States are getting a lot better, babies in Japan are getting a lot worse, but both of those groups of babies are preparing for exactly the language that they are going to learn. So the question is: What's happening during this critical two-month period?
after: So there are two things going on. The first is that the babies are listening intently to us, and they're taking statistics as they listen to us talk — they're taking statistics.
ru: Это период звукового развития, но что же в этот момент там происходит?

quote: It can't really make the difference that ought to be made in a period of crisis.
before: When the IMF was created in the 1940s, it was created with resources that were five percent or so of the world's GDP. The IMF now has limited resources, one percent.
after: So, we've got to rebuild the world institutions. And that's a big task: persuading all the different countries with the different voting shares in these institutions to do so.
ru: И это не может изменить ситуацию так, как это нужно в период кризиса.

quote: In the third period, Toronto captain Mats Sundin scored to tie the game at 2-2.
before: Brett McLean would give Florida a 2 goal lead going into the first intermission. Jeremy Williams, who had a goal in each of his other two NHL appearances, scored his first goal of this season 6:56 into the second period to put Toronto within one goal.
after: Rostislav Olesz would retake the lead for Florida 11:45 into the third, but Sundin scored his second of the night with 1:08 left in regulation to send the game to a shootout. Tomas Kaberle scored the only shootout goal, when his wrist shot beat Tomas Vokoun through the five-hole.

quote: We need every able-bodied person we can get.
before: Which is why you're arming women and teenage boys. But what chance do they have against 900 trained soldiers?
after: - King Philip's troops are still days away. - Can we hold off - Condé's army until then?
ru: Нам нужен любой дееспособный человек.

quote: And the only other person we know who died.
before: Someone filled it with dirt, and stuck in a tombstone for Jenny Hulce. The crew member who fell asleep at the wheel driving home after Jordan kept the crew shooting all night?
after: So, who cared enough to kill Jordan over that? Besides everyone who got a "Never Forget" tattoo?
ru: И единственный ещё один человек, кто умер.

quote: So I need to know if Greg Wakino is a good person.
before: But most people are not criminals. My last boss used my code to hurt people, and I just can't let that happen again.
after: Do you want me to run a background check on him? For money.
ru: Итак, мне нужно знать, что Грэг Вакино - хороший человек.

quote: He's a person, but at the same time, he's not!
before: No... I don't like him...
after: You're right, a lot of these guys aren't human. Shao May!
ru: Он человек... И в то же время нет!

quote: A person can be sick in bed and still infect tens, even hundreds of other individuals.
before: They can be transmitted from person-to-person contact, person-to-food-then-to-person contact, when somebody eats contaminated food, or they can be transmitted through the water. And when they're transmitted through the water, unlike the first two modes of transmission, these pathogens don't rely on a healthy host for transmission.
after: To sort of illustrate that, this diagram emphasizes that if you've got a sick person in bed, somebody's going to be taking out the contaminated materials. They're going to wash those contaminated materials, and then the water may move into sources of drinking water.
ru: Человек может быть болен и лежать в постели, но всё равно заразить десятки, даже сотни других индивидуумов.

quote: The physically stronger person was more likely to lead, and men, in general, are physically stronger.
before: In the recent US elections we kept hearing of the Lilly Ledbetter law, and if we go beyond the nicely alliterative name of that law, it was really about a man and a woman doing the same job, being equally qualified, and the man being paid more because he's a man. So in the literal way, men rule the world, and this made sense a thousand years ago because human beings lived then in a world in which physical strength was the most important attribute for survival.
after: Of course there are many exceptions. (Laughter) But today we live in a vastly different world.
ru: У физически сильного человека было больше шансов быть лидером, а мужчины в основном сильнее женщин.

quote: But that person could be identified as having a learning disability.
before: And this person is particularly interesting. I won't go into the intrascatter that's in the subtests, but they still had a neurologic issue.
after: And with accommodation, they went on to college and had a full life in terms of their opportunities. Second aspect: I still had crushing migraine headaches.
ru: Этот человек нарушения в способности к обучению.

quote: Heat-seeking devices and helicopters are being used by rescue workers to search for missing persons.
before: Four people are reportedly still missing.

quote: I took personal charge of his care, but I could not save him.
before: Lord Arryn? Oh, his death was a great sadness to all of us.
after: His sickness struck him very hard and very fast. I saw him in my chambers just the night before he passed.
ru: Я лично заботился о нем, но я не смог спасти его.

quote: I've spoken to Zeuthen's personal assistant, you've been granted an audience later today.
before: We agreed to move his things when my vacation came up. Kristian...
after: Ok, any news about the girl? No.
ru: Я говорил с личным помощником Сеутена, тебе дадут аудиенцию сегодня вечером.

quote: He likes to deal with this sort of thing up close and personal.
before: No. I have a strict mandate to bring the boy and the money back to Brantley.
after: So... So, one of us is gonna have to kill the other.
ru: Ему нравится разбираться с подобными вещами лично.

quote: The transition team will help you move any personal belongings.
before: I recommend you re-read it. Now, I will need your access key to the lab and computer passwords. Sir?
after: We will need you to clear the premises within the hour. W-we're not finished.
ru: - Сэр? Рабочая группа поможет Вам забрать любые личные вещи.

quote: I think my personal story is explained very simply on the slide, and it's access.
before: But I'm going to focus on the demo. There are a lot of stories about why we did this.
after: And I grew up in India. I had a great education — I'm not complaining — but I didn't have access to a lot of these museums and these artworks.
ru: Мне кажется, моя личная история очень просто объяснена на слайде, и она про доступность.

quote: Now it's time to demand that intimate justice in their personal lives as well.
before: It's a lot to ask, but it's not too much. As parents, teachers, advocates and activists, we have raised a generation of girls to have a voice, to expect egalitarian treatment in the home, in the classroom, in the workplace.
after: Thank you. (Applause)
ru: Теперь пора потребовать и этой интимной справедливости в их личной жизни.

quote: And we're always making decisions that are exceedingly personal and extraordinarily subjective.
before: That is not true journalism. Contrary to what many people think, journalists are making value judgments all the time, ethical and moral judgments.
