quote: What this really does is that it makes us think about our priorities.
before: Basically for the amount of money that we spend, we can do X amount of good in treatment, and 10 times as much good in prevention. So again, what we focus on is prevention rather than treatment, at first rate.
after: I'd like to have you look at your priority list and say, did you get it right? Or did you get close to what we came up with here?
ru: Это заставляет нас по-настоящему задуматься о своих приоритетах.

quote: Priorities of the conference include economic growth, peace and democracy and climate change.
before: The United Nations (UNFPA) organization United Nations Population Fund emphasized the importance of women's health in Africa at the 4th Tokyo International Conference on African Development (TICAD IV).
after: The three-day conference which ended Friday included representatives from over 80 countries.

quote: Brian Green will die in prison. That's enough. Oh, really?
before: It's not our fault you didn't pay the ransom. He didn't mean that.
after: You never said, 'As far as I'm concerned, they're as guilty as each other, and that witch cheated justice'? Come with me.
ru: Брайан Грин умрет в тюрьме, и этого достаточно.

quote: God knows I was beating myself up every day in prison while I was there.
before: Look, I don't blame you for wanting to move on and start anew. Alright?
after: So, you know, you, Fuzz, moving... It's of no value going over this now. I've moved on.
ru: Лишь Бог знает, как я казнил себя каждый день в тюрьме, пока я там находился.

quote: He wanted to know if he could go to prison for lying on the stand.
before: - That's a killer, man. - What did you two talk about?
after: Nothing worse for an ex-cop than going to prison. - He didn't lie.
ru: Он хотел знать, сядет ли он в тюрьму за ложь в суде.

quote: Survival is about being patient. I learnt that in a Spanish prison.
before: Another few inches would do it. Save your strength.
after: Five years in gaol. That must have been tough.
ru: Испанская тюрьма научил меня тому, что терпение - залог выживания.

quote: If we rely on just prisons to reduce crime, I'm afraid we'll never get there.
before: Reducing recidivism may be our ultimate goal, but it's not our only goal. To be honest with you, preventing crime takes so much more from so many more people and institutions.
after: But prisons can do some things we never thought they could do. Prisons can be the source of innovation and sustainability, repopulating endangered species and environmental restoration.
ru: Если мы будем полагаться лишь на тюрьмы в сокращении преступности, боюсь, мы никогда к этому не придём.

quote: He assumed the regency himself and threw the boys in prison.
before: The rest of Edward IV's reign was peaceful, but upon his death in 1483, the bloodshed resumed. Though his twelve-year-old son was due to succeed him, Edward's younger brother Richard III declared his nephews illegitimate due to their father's secret marriage.
after: Though no one knows what ultimately became of them, after a while, the Princes disappeared and Richard's power seemed secure. But his downfall would come only two years later from across the narrow sea of the English Channel.
ru: Он сам объявил себя королем и отправил мальчиков в тюрьму.

quote: Now, unless you're a prison guard, the sentence "Some jobs are jails" is literally false.
before: Because we cannot ignore the metaphorical meaning of words either. One of the sentences was, " Some jobs are jails. "
after: Sadly, it's metaphorically true. And the metaphorical truth interferes with our ability to identify it as literally false.
ru: Если вы не тюремный надзиратель, то очевидно, что предложение «Иногда работа – тюрьма» неверно буквально.

quote: Mangione was present for the decision, in his prison uniform and shackles, according to The Guardian.
Let's talk about the real reason you don't like private school.
before: She's 10 and you're counting her out already? It's over?
after: What? It's about you.
ru: Давай обсудим реальную причину. Ты не любишь частные школы.

quote: Should I try and stall the Colombian men who just flew in on a private jet?
before: This is a really bad time. I'm sorry.
after: - Cartel? - That would be my guess if I cared.
ru: Мне попросить колумбийцев на частном самолете подождать?

quote: "Private lessons in mathematics and physics, "given most thoroughly by Albert Einstein.
before: And I will do the right thing for you and this child. I promise.
after: Trial lesson free." Sounds promising.
ru: "Частные уроки математики и физики, тщательно излагаемые Альбертом Эйнштейном.

quote: Donald Strachey, private investigator, and you've just made it.
before: I think there's been a mistake. There has been a mistake,
after: What is it? They're back.
ru: Дональд Стрейчи, частный следователь, и вы только что её совершили.

quote: Now, all this private ownership of course had a public cost.
before: And that phenomenon had gone global. In China by 2011, there were more car sales happening in China than in the US.
after: In the US, we spend 7 billion hours a year, wasted, sitting in traffic. 160 billion dollars in lost productivity, of course also sitting in traffic, and one-fifth of all of our carbon footprint is spewed out in the air by those cars that we're sitting in.
ru: Конечно, владение частными авто дорого обходится обществу.

quote: We think these problems are the domain of NGOs or governments, not private companies.
before: So why aren't there more start-ups that are tackling these global problems that are faced by billions of people in developing economies? The reason is that investors and entrepreneurs are totally blind to the opportunity.
after: That's what we have to change. You may have noticed I left something out of the video that I showed you.
ru: Многие считают, что этими проблемами должны заниматься правительства и НПО, а не частные компании.

quote: And you need a strong government to do that, because you cannot respect private property rights.
before: This is an Oxford-trained economist steeped in humanistic values, and yet he agrees with the high-pressure tactics of Shanghai. So let me call it the Shanghai model of economic growth, that emphasizes the following features for promoting economic development: infrastructures, airports, highways, bridges, things like that.
after: You cannot be constrained by the public's opinion. You need also state ownership, especially of land assets, in order to build and roll out infrastructures very quickly.
ru: Чтобы построить всё это, вам нужно сильное правительство, потому что вы не можете себе позволить уважать права частной собственности.

quote: Getty images will arrange a private photo shoot for the baby.
after: "We are honored that the Jolie-Pitt family has recognized our long-term commitment to these critical issues, as well as our ability to use the power of imagery to make a difference in the lives of many," said Jonathan Klein, Getty's CEO and cofounder.

quote: Killer probably got cut dragging the body through the woods.
before: Died between 9:00 and 11:00 P.M. Also found blood on his right sleeve, but no wounds on the Vic.
after: Combed his hair, washed his hands and face, laid his hands across his body, and built a shrine. Somebody spent a lot of time getting this just right.
ru: Убийца, вероятно, порезался, пока тащил тело через лес.

quote: That being said, we should probably donate blood or something this year.
before: Pulled from the freshest cadaver I could find. But the pickings were slim.
after: (roaring) He's gonna need these.
ru: Поэтому нам, наверное, кровь нужно сдать или еще чего.

quote: Mikael is probably jonesing for a restorative snack about now.
before: Let me think about that. No, but you should probably get going, Nik.
after: Be a shame for you to find... Cami, is it? ...
ru: Майкл наверняка нестерпимо жаждет полноценно перекусить прямо в эту минуту.

quote: I had my eye on it, but it's probably too rich for my blood.
before: Rachel Maddox. Oh, and thank you very much for getting me the tickets. Thanks for the signed first edition for the auction.
after: My boyfriend Paul Reynolds. He's a huge fan.
ru: Я положил на это глаз, но это вероятно слишком для меня.

quote: In fact, you're probably sick of hearing the term big data.
before: In this case, it allows us to see what America's favorite pie is: not apple. Now, you probably all have heard the term big data.
after: It is true that there is a lot of hype around the term, and that is very unfortunate, because big data is an extremely important tool by which society is going to advance. In the past, we used to look at small data and think about what it would mean to try to understand the world, and now we have a lot more of it, more than we ever could before.
ru: Вы, вероятно, уже устали слышать термин «большие данные».

quote: It's a few million dollars, it fills a room, many people have probably been in one.
before: We're excited about it. This is an MRI machine.
after: I've spent a lot of time in one. It has a focus of about a millimeter — kind of chunky, compared to what I just showed you.
ru: Стоит пару миллионов долларов, занимает комнату, многие уже наверняка были в таком аппарате.

quote: We can probably make it for 50 cents if we put our mind to it.
before: It performs about equivalently to a system that's on the order of 100,000 dollars. It costs 50 dollars.
after: Why doesn't somebody do it? The answer is: How do you make a profit in a capitalist system, doing that?
ru: Мы можем снизить, наверное, до 50 центов, если хорошенько подумаем.

quote: It will probably be just a month or two.
before: It depends how many volunteers participate, and how fast they look at the 'focus movies'.

quote: Unfortunately, a letter wouldn't solve Jane's current problem.
before: Love, Xo. _
after: - I just really want you and Rafael to bond, and I think dinner together will help. Hey!
ru: К сожалению, письмо не может решить текущие проблемы Джейн.

quote: Then give the Piron keys back to the Alec who isn't a problem.
before: I just took care of the situation in my own creative way. Fine.
after: I'd love to, but the board doesn't know what we know and it might be a hard sell to them with the whole time travel doubles thing, you know. Paradoxically speaking.
ru: Ну так отдай ключи от Пайрона тому Алеку, который не создаёт проблем.

quote: The only problem is Mr. Ross never actually went to Harvard.
before: What are you talking about? Your honor, this is Mr. Ross' Harvard diploma.
after: The only place he did graduate from was danbury federal prison where he spent time for impersonating a lawyer. All right, that is inadmissible and irrelevant.
ru: Проблема только в том, что мистер Росс никогда не ходил в Гарвард.

quote: We got bigger problems to worry about than TV okay?
before: Why not ? Why should I ?
after: You're thinking about this in a very narrow way The idea is that everybody is gonna have a house, a car, a television the American dream.
ru: У нас есть проблемы и поболее, чтобы беспокоиться о телевизоре.

quote: Now, cities have been dealing with this problem for decades.
before: We even have skyscrapers built for cars. That's the world we live in today.
after: It's called mass transit. And even in a city like New York City, one of the most densely populated in the world and one of the most sophisticated mass transit systems in the world, there are still 2.5 million cars that go over those bridges every day.
ru: Города сталкиваются с этой проблемой на протяжении десятков лет.

quote: They do not have more problems than other kids.
before: It was about how special and how deeply loved their child was. And research so far shows that these children are doing fine.
after: Yet, these parents also wanted to justify their decisions through the tales they tell. They hoped that their children would understand their reasons for making the family in this way.
ru: У них проблем не больше, чем у других детей.

quote: If we invest about 12 billion dollars, we could make a severe inroad into that problem.
before: Not just malnutrition in general, but there's a very cheap way of dealing with malnutrition, namely, the lack of micronutrients. Basically, about half of the world's population is lacking in iron, zinc, iodine and vitamin A.
after: That would be the second best investment that we could do. And the very best project would be to focus on HIV / AIDS.
ru: Достаточно вложить 12 миллиардов долларов, чтобы серьёзно уменьшить эту проблему.

quote: The Ming Pao news agency also reported mechanical problems.
before: Shipping was unaffected. The New Zealand Herald quoted Hong Kong's Cable TV as saying that the rotorcraft performed an emergency landing on water after experiencing mechanical problems.

quote: Businesses should balance profit with preserving natural resources.
before: There should be enforced regulations on catching only bigger fish. Catching the smaller fish before they've matured lowers the overall number.
after: Without fish, we can't do business. However, that doesn't mean they should catch all the fish to the brink of extinction.
ru: Бизнес должен соблюдать баланс между прибылью и сохранением природных ресурсов.

quote: You have corporations funding political campaigns, and working on a quarterly profit calendars.
before: Every generation in history has had their own big challenge to deal with, and this one is ours. It's money.
after: And it's impossible to take you eye of that. A lot of comments I get revolve around people feeling badly.
ru: У вас есть корпорации, финансирующие политические кампании, и погоня за квартальными прибылями.

quote: Do you think this'll appease them, me giving up my profits?
before: How am I looking? Little more worried.
after: They're still coming after your seat. As long as the three are divided, I'm fine.
ru: Как ты думаешь, они успокоятся, если я перестану получать прибыль?

quote: What I wish for is for fair profit.
before: And what they are is too high, my benighted friend. Lower your price if you wish to transport our mormon workmen West.
after: I have consulted and prayed... And here is what I will pay.
ru: Чего я хочу - это достойной прибыли.

quote: Well, one line of thinking is, let's take this profit and redeploy it into social problems.
before: That's what business does when it makes a profit. Now what does this all have to do with social problems?
after: Business should give more. Business should be more responsible.
ru: Одна из точек зрения такова — давайте возьмём эту прибыль и перенаправим в социальные проблемы.

quote: The profit motive is transforming health outcomes in this world.
before: And actually, they know how to transform science and facts into compelling messages. Just for a minute, imagine when they put all their forces behind a message as powerful as handwashing with soap.
after: But it's been happening for centuries: the Lifebuoy brand was launched in 1894 in Victorian England to actually combat cholera. Last week, I was in Ghana with the minister of health, because if you don't know, there's a cholera outbreak in Ghana at the moment.
ru: Прибыльные мотивы преобразуют показатели здоровья в этом мире.

quote: The answer is: How do you make a profit in a capitalist system, doing that?
before: We can probably make it for 50 cents if we put our mind to it. Why doesn't somebody do it?
after: Interesting problem. So, let me finish by saying that we've thought about this as a kind of engineering problem.
ru: Ответ: «А как с этого можно получить прибыль в капиталистической системе?»

quote: No company is going to make a profit serving every community in the nation.
before: One good example is the post office department, you know, the post office department. There's no for-profit business that's ever going to make profit serving every community in the nation, you know.
after: And yet at the same time, they're going out of their way to destroy the United States Postal Office that basically services every community in the nation. And so, we have to go back in and look at that, so it's good.

quote: Now it's in your best interest to vacate my property on your own accord.
before: I just don't have the money right now. You are behind on your payments, Mr. Perry.
after: Well, What about my Wife and little boy? This is our home.
ru: Теперь это в ваших интересах добровольно освободить мою собственность.

quote: Badge or no badge, you got no right trespassing and seizing our private property.
before: Everybody stay calm. I'm an officer of the Law.
after: - We know the law. - Gentlemen...
ru: Есть у тебя значок или нет, ты не имеешь права вторгаться и захватывать нашу собственность.

quote: I'm going to give you ten seconds to get off my property.
before: We expect full payment for the damages. Then your son is a liar.
after: After that, I call the cops. - Mom!
ru: Я даю тебе 10 секунд, чтобы ты убрался с моей собственности.

quote: Seeing as you know how things work, well, how property move from place to place.
before: That's what you want us to be, friends? I want your help, yes.
after: You know, I... I got this.
ru: Вижу, что вы знаете, как все устроено, как имущество перемещается с место на место.

quote: Was it working days and nights trying to protect lives and property?
before: Was it working in the sun? Was it working to provide food for a family or a community?
after: Was it working alone or working on a project that wasn't guaranteed to succeed, but that might improve human health or save a life? Was it working to build something, create something, make a work of art?
ru: Работа день и ночь в попытках уберечь жизни и имущество?

quote: "White Woman Calls Police On Black Real Estate Investor Inspecting His Own Property."
before: (Applause) And I need to pause the game to remind us of the structure. A subject takes an action against a target engaged in some activity.
after: " California Safeway Calls Cops On Black Woman Donating Food To The Homeless. " " Gold Club Twice Calls Cops On Black Women For Playing Too Slow. "
ru: «Белая женщина заявила на чернокожего домовладельца, осматривающего свою собственность».

quote: And far and away the biggest trigger for all sibling fights is property.
before: And Bobby Kennedy, who grew up to have 11 children of his own, had a household with a whopping 91 dyads. This overpopulation of relationships makes fights unavoidable.
after: Studies have found that over 95 percent of the fights among small children concern somebody touching, playing with, looking at the other person's stuff. (Laughter) This in its own way is healthy if it's very noisy, and the reason is that small children come into the world with absolutely no control.
ru: В подавляющем большинстве случаев братья и сёстры ссорятся из-за собственности.

quote: More than half of that is in housing, in real estate property.
before: So, my house is my asset. In Ireland, each man, woman and child is worth something like USD180 thousand each, something like that, alright?
after: So we rely on our property for our wealth. So when your parents die or when your parents want to send you to university, they can borrow against the value of their house and send you to university, to get a loan based on the value of their house.

quote: Did the Pyongyang representative say anything about our proposal?
before: This means I may be the next person to get exposed. Contact your headquarters and hurry them to come up with a plan.
after: No, not yet. I hope they're not thinking something foolish with their nuclear weapons.
ru: Мы получили ответ на наше предложение от представителей Пхеньяна?

quote: This is a note from Harris on Danny's proposal.
before: They can even be affected by lunar phases, all right? Now, look at this.
after: "I strongly advise you to choose another subject. "The ideas here, while innovative and thoughtful, "border on pseudo-science.
ru: Это примечание от Харриса по предложению Дэнни.

quote: He thought perhaps you'd like to see the latest prisoner exchange proposal.
before: - "Sir," he says. I have an urgent report from the provost marshal.
after: Thank you, Corporal. - What is it?
ru: Возможно, вы захотите взглянуть на последнее предложение по обмену пленными.

quote: With that we reached to the last proposal.
before: Visionaries Club... Base.
after: The Changers. Here is the result.
ru: Так, таким образом мы дошли до последнего предложения.

quote: I'd encourage you to even be a little more specific on your proposal.
before: (Applause) Chris Anderson: You'd almost think people are surprised to hear a talk like this from the President of the World Bank. It's kind of cool.
after: There's many investors, entrepreneurs in this room. How will you partner with them?
ru: Я бы предложил вам внести немного конкретики в ваше предложение.

quote: And the proposal has been to build a lot more coal plants.
before: Oil is a problem, and coal is the most serious problem. The United States is one of the two largest emitters, along with China.
after: But we're beginning to see a sea change. Here are the ones that have been cancelled in the last few years with some green alternatives proposed.
ru: И предложение состояло в том, чтобы построить намного больше угольных заводов.

quote: She got to that bottom secret, his proposal to her.
before: He said, " But this time it seemed like it was taking her forever to get through each one. " But she finally did.
after: And he said, " She read it once and then she read it again. " And she turned to him and said, " Is that our cat? "
ru: Она прочитала последний секрет — его предложение.

quote: The European Commission currently has proposals on the table to extend performers' copyright terms.
after: Described by Professor Martin Kretschmer as the "Beatles Extension Act", the proposed measure would extend copyright from 50 to 95 years after recording. A vast number of classical tracks are at stake; the copyright on recordings from the fifties and early sixties is nearing its expiration date, after which it would normally enter the public domain or become 'public property'.

quote: I guess we can say your plan's opened us up to public scrutiny.
before: We don't hire illegals, so we're in the clear. But I think we're in for a nasty fight.
after: Nicki: You guys still there?
ru: Полагаю можно сказать, что твои планы привлекли к нам пристальное внимание общественности.

quote: He has to be abducting them in public.
before: We know this guy's good at being invisible. Both women were last seen leaving work and never made it back home.
after: Both were technically single. They could have been looking to meet new people. Maybe that was his in.
ru: Он должен был похитить их в общественном месте.

quote: It doesn't hurt that your testimony strongly swayed public opinion.
before: Willing to go to prison and being sanguine about it are two entirely different camps. They're citing extraordinary circumstances and the contribution to national security.
after: Russell took a snap poll. 82% think you were justified in your actions.
ru: И как будто им неважно, что твои показания сильно всколыхнули общественное мнение.

quote: Transporting enriched uranium on public buses would expose women and children to lethal levels of radiation.
before: Dangers? To what do you refer?
after: American women and children, not Japanese. It may not be necessary. Consider the alterna...
ru: Перевозка обогащенного урана в общественном транспорте подвергнет женщин и детей смертельному уровню радиации.

quote: If you take public transit, it's about two hours.
before: So Rio, like so many cities across the global South, is a place where you can go from northern Europe to sub-Saharan Africa in the space of 30 minutes. If you drive, that is.
after: And lastly, perhaps most importantly, cities, with the incredible wealth of relations that they enable, could be the ideal places for human happiness to flourish. We like being around people.
ru: На общественном транспорте это займёт около двух часов.

quote: So you went from public space to private space.
before: Things that they started doing themselves — like changing the floor going into the patient's room so that it signified, " This is my room. This is my personal space " — was a really interesting sort of design solution to the problem.
after: And another idea, again, that came from one of the nurses — which I love — was they took traditional, sort of, corporate white boards, then they put them on one wall of the patient's room, and they put this sticker there. So that what you could actually do was go into the room and write messages to the person who was sick in that room, which was lovely.
ru: Таким образом мы переходим от общественного пространства к личному.

quote: And what we call private public partnership you can add estate also.
before: Or, if you want to paint, you can paint it blue throughout because every roof which you see in this picture collects rainwater drops and deposit in the rooms. But apart from this system, they designed 52 beautiful water bodies around this town.
after: So, estate, public and private entrepreneurs work together to build this beautiful water body. And it's a kind of water body for all seasons.
ru: Это то, что мы называем частно-общественным сотрудничеством, плюс государство.

quote: Q: What are your opinions on Mississauga's congestion and public transit funding?
They give double miles every day for every purchase!
before: You can't do that. The Capital One venture card is amazing.
after: Or the cast could say something during goodnights. No, it has to be big enough that Liz will believe we planned it all along.
ru: Они начисляют вам двойные бонусы при каждой покупке!

quote: I'll execute the purchase orders once I'm at the office.
before: Which is precisely why we are investing in their infrastructure. These emerging governments need the financial backing of Western companies to facilitate reform.
after: They set me up, Victoria. Angola, Libya...
ru: Я выполню заказ на покупку как только буду в офисе.

quote: Is the purchase linked to a specific employee?
before: Hey, guys, get this. Ten days ago, Norris BioTech ordered the necessary elements to make white phosphorus.
after: The items were lumped into a larger cross-company order. Is it possible our boy's telling the truth?
ru: Покупка связана с конкретным сотрудником?

quote: First tip-off was the substantial purchase made on my debit card at XXX Video World.
before: How'd you find me anyway, man? Well, genius.
after: You do know they invented the internet, right? So then I figured your next stop would be to load up on cheap booze, and you did not disappoint, fake Laura Diamond.
ru: В первый раз ты сплоховал, когда оплатил моей картой покупки в салоне порно-видео.

quote: We are investing in sustainable transport and subsidizing the purchase of electric vehicles.
before: We are providing free electricity to our rural farmers. The idea is that, with free electricity, they will no longer have to use firewood to cook their food.
after: Similarly, we are subsidizing the cost of LED lights, and our entire government is trying to go paperless. We are cleaning up our entire country through Clean Bhutan, a national program, and we are planting trees throughout our country through Green Bhutan, another national program.
ru: Мы инвестируем в зелёный транспорт, субсидируем покупки электрических автомобилей.

quote: Is it OK if your sex robot has compelling in-app purchases?
before: Acknowledging this emotional connection to robots can also help us anticipate challenges as these devices move into more intimate areas of people's lives. For example, is it OK if your child's teddy bear robot records private conversations?
after: (Laughter) Because robots plus capitalism equals questions around consumer protection and privacy. And those aren't the only reasons that our behavior around these machines could matter.
ru: Или если у вашего секс-робота есть обязательные встроенные покупки?

quote: Only this time, my investigator friends, the game is painfully real.
before: Sadly, you're going to have to go back to Google and start your shopping search all over again, but you didn't get ripped off, so that's only a good thing. As the world's most famous fictional detective would say, " Watson, the game is afoot. "
after: So the next time you're shopping online, or perhaps wherever it is, look closer, question a little bit deeper, and ask yourself — before you hand over the cash or click " Buy, " " Am I sure this is real? " Tell your friend that used to buy counterfeit watches that he may just have brought the next attack one day closer.
ru: Вот только в этот раз, мои друзья-следователи, игра болезненно реальна.

quote: This was the first real test of the DMCA's applicability.
before: Blizzard Entertainment has won a federal ruling in the U.S. Court of Appeals against the programmers of bnetd, a software package that emulates Blizzard's Battle.net service. The court reaffirmed the original judgement, given in October, that the Digital Millennium Copyright Act and click-through EULA's prohibited the reverse engineering of Blizzard's software in order to improve their playability.

quote: Back to reality, I guess.
before: All right, that's cool. We'll stop and get some breakfast on the way to the airport.
after: Yeah. I just miss her so much, Terry.
ru: Назад в действительность, да?

quote: A substitute reality... because you don't want to deal with anything.
before: - Mentally divergent? - A - Whatever!
after: - I would love it if that was true. It can be dealt with, but only if you want to.
ru: Подмена реальности... в силу неприятия действительности.

quote: In reality we´d be far closer to the truth if we said that none of it actually existed.
before: Little Brother grew big, the sarcoma grew big. People are legion, and when they gaze up at the stars they may be tempted to call themselves "small".
after: Compared to the universe the sarcoma, Little Brother and the Kingdom are neither great nor small. Their aspirations, their stories and their pain are insignificant. If three people die in an aeroplane or a thousand of our worlds vanish in a flash of light it won´t make the man in the moon across the galaxy bat an eyelid.
ru: А в действительности мы были бы ближе к истине, если бы сказали, что всего этого на самом деле нет.

quote: There comes a time when one must face reality, my dear.
before: Really? I never saw you as the giving-up type.
after: Those people are gone and are never coming back. Well... my young friends I'd like to stay here and chat all day but I have dresses to make, trousers to mend.
ru: Приходит время, когда нужно взглянуть в лицо действительности, моя дорогая.

quote: We wanted to redesign the modem for the developing world, for our context, and for our reality.
before: Could we leverage these technologies to switch smartly whenever you travel from country to country? So we looked at the modem, an important part of the infrastructure of the Internet, and asked ourselves why the modems that we are using right now are built for a different context, where you've got ubiquitous internet, you've got ubiquitous electricity, yet we sit here in Nairobi and we do not have that luxury.
after: What if we could have connectivity with less friction? This is the BRCK.
ru: Мы хотели создать новый тип модема, подходящий для развивающихся стран, для наших условий, для нашей действительности.

quote: That's the reality of the United States.
before: Right? That's not the situation.
after: Now, that sounds pretty good. Here's the challenge.
ru: Это действительность Соединённых Штатов.

quote: In reality, trying to go from fundamental knowledge to its application is more like this.
before: Well, wouldn't it be nice if it was that easy? Unfortunately, it's not.
after: There are no shiny bridges. You sort of place your bets.
ru: В действительности, попытки пройти от теоретических знаний к их приложению выглядят примерно так.

quote: "The reality is, Kingsway was an eminently winnable seat," said the Conservative Minister.
before: Emerson cited this diversity after announcing he would not be running for a third term.
after: "Not because I'm a hugely popular fellow in Kingsway, but because of vote splits and the way the first-past-the-post system works."

quote: Did you really think I wouldn't find out that he killed your brother?
before: I did some reading up on Lawton. Lyla, listen--
after: That you were using me? I need to see this guy in a bag.
ru: Ты и правда считал, что я не выясню, что он убил твоего брата?

quote: I really thought I was gonna get the part.
before: - Well, can we join you? I mean, for the sitting part.
after: Annie, you got a part. You have a reason to celebrate tonight.
ru: Я действительно думала, что получу роль.

quote: That was really cool of you to fill for me.
before: - So, everything worked out ok? - Yeah, thank god.
after: If you hadn't, I would've been fired. Thanks.
ru: Было действительно здорово, что ты заменила меня.

quote: You really thought she was getting paid all that Just to play video games?
before: But Angela thought that it would be good for her. She wanted to fit in somewhere.
after: We were told Angela's work saved soldiers' lives. The money didn't matter.
ru: Вы правда думали, что ей платили все эти деньги просто за компьютерные игры?

quote: Well, it depends, really, on what your goals are.
before: For, in weather, we're not only dealing with forces of a far greater variety than even the atomic physicist encounters, but with life itself. Larry Brilliant: Should we feel good, or should we feel bad that 50 years of foreknowledge accomplished so little?
after: And I think, as my goals, I always go back to Gandhi's talisman. When Mahatma Gandhi was asked, " How do you know if the next act that you are about to do is the right one or the wrong one? " he said, " Consider the face of the poorest, most vulnerable human being that you ever chanced upon, and ask yourself if the act that you contemplate will be of benefit to that person.
ru: В действительности это зависит от поставленных целей.

quote: But it's really necessary to do it.
before: So we went there to build partitions with all the student volunteers with paper tubes, just a very simple shelter out of the tube frame and the curtain. However, some of the facility authority doesn't want us to do it, because, they said, simply, it's become more difficult to control them.
after: They don't have enough flat area to build standard government single-story housing like this one. Look at this.
ru: Но эти удобства действительно необходимы.

quote: The governments of the world are taking this really seriously.
before: Well, the Northwest Passage is already there. I think it's sort of funny; it's on the Siberian coast, maybe the Russians will charge tolls.
after: The military of the Arctic nations is taking it really seriously. For all the denial of climate change by government leaders, the CIA and the navies of Norway and the U.S. and Canada, whatever are busily thinking about how they will secure their territory in this inevitability from their point of view.
ru: Правительства мира относятся к этому очень серьёзно.

quote: According to the Greens, ACT is denying how important climate change really is.
before: The top party was themselves, Labour (Government) in second with Dr Norman saying they are "too frightened to do what needs to be done,", the Māori party in third, then National, United Future, New Zealand First and lastly, ACT, leaving out Jim Anderton's Progressive Coalition party from being ranked.

quote: All the more reason to entertain her privately.
before: We should have her up for dinner once she's settled. Jack Duncan made a good point about community acceptance.
after: Perhaps I'll ask Roy Briggs to join us. Your sense of humour is rather perverse.
ru: Еще одна причина встречаться с ней не у всех на виду.

quote: There's no reason his file would be in my house.
before: Please tell me you can give us something better than that. Callen, I had nothing to do with preparing Lieutenant Prietto's body.
after: Wait-- you went through my house? ! You brought me here so they could go through my stuff?
ru: Нет ни малейшей причины этим документам находится у меня дома.

quote: Finally, a reason to watch TV on Sundays.
before: Ooh, I love that show. Isn't it great?
after: Such great characters, like Buxton, the scheming larder-keep. Why can't Lady Cavendish see he's pilfering the aspic?
ru: Наконец-таки есть причина посмотреть телевизор по воскресеньям.

quote: For some reason, the progress has been slowed.
before: But why has it appeared now? The masks stopped the onset.
after: Why didn't you say anything? What difference does it make?
ru: По какой-то причине, распространение замедлилось.

quote: The reason for this is the way we make decisions.
before: And at the other end of the spectrum, we're doing an equally terrible job. The people who we find are the highest-risk offenders, the people who we think have the highest likelihood of committing a new crime if they're released, we see nationally that 50 percent of those people are being released.
after: Judges have the best intentions when they make these decisions about risk, but they're making them subjectively. They're like the baseball scouts 20 years ago who were using their instinct and their experience to try to decide what risk someone poses.
ru: Причина этого в том, как мы принимаем решения.

quote: So there are lots of reasons for eating this way that go beyond just your health.
before: And then, again, it's a spectrum: when you move in this direction, you're going to lose weight, you'll feel better, and you'll gain health. There are ecological reasons for eating lower on the food chain too, whether it's the deforestation in the Amazon or making more protein available to the four billion people who live on a dollar a day, not to mention whatever ethical concerns people have.
after: Now, we're about to publish the first study looking at the effects of this program on prostate cancer, in collaboration with Sloan Kettering and UCSF. We took 90 men who had biopsy-proven prostate cancer, who had elected, for reasons unrelated to the study, not to have surgery.
ru: Т.е. существует множество причин питаться правильно помимо нашего здоровья.

quote: And the reason is that they're not able to communicate.
before: They did. They were in sync for a while, but then they drifted apart.
after: Now, you might think that's a bizarre idea. How can metronomes communicate?
ru: И причина этого в том, что они не могли общаться.

quote: "They refuse to give us the hall for technical reasons."
before: There are no problems. And then they call us to say they are refusing, can't give us the hall any more," he continued.

quote: He's already using the affair to create reasonable doubt.
before: - This will ruin both of us. - Rick's clever.
after: That's not all he's doing. Remember I told you about the note?
ru: Он уже использует ваш роман, чтобы заронить разумное сонение.

quote: Ellen, what this impressive new guardian says seems reasonable.
before: - Right here, folks. Right here. But the number of female Dhampir guardians has gone down way too much to risk losing one with such potential.
after: We're so sorry, Headmistress. After the crash, I lacked a strong parental figure to confide in.
ru: Эллен, то, что говорит этот новый впечатляющий страж, звучит разумно.

quote: I don't want to pressure whomever, but for the area, the rent is very reasonable.
before: But I will be... I'll be spending a lot of time here. It's just that I love my place, and it's rent-controlled.
after: I've already had a lot inquiries. Oh. Well, we have that dinner tonight...
ru: Не хочу ни на кого давить, но для этого района, рента очень разумная.

quote: I came here today expecting to speak to a reasonable man, but obviously I misjudged you.
before: Mr. Patton, I'm gonna tell you what the truth is. The truth is, from this day forward, you and I are done, and the relationship that you and your organization has with me and my office is also terminated.
after: Yes. Yes, that's true.
ru: Я приехал сюда ожидая поговорить с разумным человеком, но очевидно я тебя недооценил.

quote: Be reasonable in your assessment; I'm not talking about your Facebook friends.
before: Now, think of your relationships, of the people who shape your days. To whom do you speak at least once a week, be it face to face or on FaceTime?
after: I'm speaking of the people who shape your weekly emotional experience. My mother in Accra, my twin sister in Boston, my best friends in New York: these relationships are home for me.
ru: Будьте разумными в своей оценке; я не говорю о ваших друзьях в Facebook.

quote: A reasonable choice would be the last 21 years of applications to Fox News.
before: Think about it. The data, what would the data be?
after: Reasonable. What about the definition of success?
ru: Разумно было бы проанализировать 21 год опыта приёма на работу в Fox News.

quote: People who we always thought were reasonable and intelligent seemed like strangers.
before: Caitlin Quattromani: The election of 2016 felt different. Political conversations with our family and friends uncovered a level of polarization that many of us had not previously experienced.
after: We said to ourselves, " How could you think that? I thought you were smart. "
ru: Люди, которых мы привыкли считать разумными и мудрыми, стали похожи на незнакомцев.

quote: I think it's perfectly reasonable that they would comment.
before: "He was his opposition leader and, as you know, came to power at the end of the Trudeau period when people wanted to make a change. I'll leave it to people who were there then to fight those battles.
after: I think these are debates that are best left to some of the people who were around then and academics."

quote: I read that your most recent equity issuance won't be approved.
before: I'm sorry I'm late. It's a bit hectic now.
after: Dad looked through your offer. Two years ago, we were the most profitable bank in Sweden.
ru: Я прочитал, что твои последние акции не будут одобрены.

quote: Well, I'm very pleased to hear my recent efforts are appreciated.
before: Everyone knows Ulysses is your man. If they see him acting without your approval, it could threaten everything you've done to elevate your status in this community.
after: For both our sakes, please help me find my sister. Take Alak inside.
ru: Я очень рад, что мои недавние действия были оценены по достоинству.

quote: Do you have some recent photos of Harper?
before: You're talking about the Troubles. We don't have those in our family.
after: - A Troubled 4-year-old? - Yeah, I know.
ru: У вас есть какие-нибудь недавние фото Харпер?

quote: Must have got himself snared for his most recent crime.
before: Oh. Desperate man taking desperate measures.
after: So he's trying to save his neck. But with what?
ru: Он сам попал в ловушку из-за своего недавнего преступления.

quote: I'll just tell you quickly about two stories drawn from recent headlines.
before: This is not some Game of Thrones empire-level set of questions. These are questions that play out in every single place on the planet.
after: In Boulder, Colorado, voters not too long ago approved a process to replace the private power company, literally the power company, the electric company Xcel, with a publicly owned utility that would forego profits and attend far more to climate change. Well, Xcel fought back, and Xcel has now put in play a ballot measure that would undermine or undo this municipalization.
ru: Я расскажу лишь две истории, взятые из недавних газетных заголовков.

quote: So in recent years, we have begun to learn about the happiness of the two selves.
before: The distinction between the happiness of the experiencing self and the satisfaction of the remembering self has been recognized in recent years, and there are now efforts to measure the two separately. The Gallup Organization has a world poll where more than half a million people have been asked questions about what they think of their life and about their experiences, and there have been other efforts along those lines.
after: And the main lesson I think that we have learned is they are really different. You can know how satisfied somebody is with their life, and that really doesn't teach you much about how happily they're living their life, and vice versa.
ru: Так, в последнее время мы начали изучать счастье через призму двух я.

quote: A recent class project had the task of addressing hearing loss in these elderly people.
before: The students are encouraged to engage with communities as they search for solutions to health-related problems. One of the communities that we work with is a group of elderly people in Cape Town.
after: The students, many of them being engineers, set out believing that they would design a better hearing aid. They spent time with the elderly, chatted to their healthcare providers and their caregivers.
ru: Задачей одного недавнего учебного проекта было решить проблему потери слуха у этих пожилых людей.

quote: Mr. Shinawatra's recent visit to the region was followed by further shootings.
after: In Narathiwat Province a 40 year old village worker was shot while helping a neighbour repair a fence. Friday saw the shooting of an assistant village head in Yala Province, and an elderly couple were shot in Pattani Province whilst returning from a local market.

quote: I've recently heard gossip about the time when I came to Downton with Kemal Pamuk.
before: "Face to face"? Gracious me!
after: Gossip that I believe has made life difficult for you. I've also heard it said that I am the source of these stories.
ru: Недавно до меня дошли слухи о том, что случилось, когда я приехал к вам с Кемалем Памуком.

quote: You buy anything more recently, like oxy- or hydrocodone? No.
before: When did you buy those? Uh, a couple weeks ago.
after: She wanted me to. Tanya ran out of pills, and she was jonesing.
ru: Ты покупал недавно что-нибудь еще типа Окси- или Гидрокодона?

quote: I recently acquired a large apartment full of furniture, sculptures, and antiques.
before: And elsewhere. I've recently purchased an apartment here in Vienna and haven't had a chance to decorate.
after: Some Flemish modernist painters, George Grosz, Wols, and a Paul Klee. I might be interested in acquiring the lot.
ru: А я недавно приобрела большую квартиру, забитую мебелью, скульптурами и антиквариатом.

quote: Torres's sister went to Argentina recently to look for him.
before: Or worse. He switched sides.
after: Few days later, somebody plants a bomb in her car. That's one hell of a coincidence.
ru: Сестра Торреса была в Аргентине недавно, чтобы разыскать его.

quote: I received a letter recently from a 13-year-old boy.
before: Before, effort and difficulty made them feel dumb, made them feel like giving up, but now, effort and difficulty, that's when their neurons are making new connections, stronger connections. That's when they're getting smarter.
after: He said, " Dear Professor Dweck, I appreciate that your writing is based on solid scientific research, and that's why I decided to put it into practice. I put more effort into my schoolwork, into my relationship with my family, and into my relationship with kids at school, and I experienced great improvement in all of those areas.
ru: Недавно я получила письмо от 13-летнего мальчика.

quote: And we stole recently a ship from the United States Navy.
before: Fortunately, we've been able to convince Congress. We begin to go on the Hill and lobby.
after: The Okeanos Explorer on its mission. Its mission is as good as you could get.
ru: И недавно мы украли корабль у Военно-морских сил США.

quote: The CEO of Netflix recently said, "our biggest competitors are Facebook, YouTube and sleep."
before: So what's missing in that equation is figuring out what our boundaries would be. You would want YouTube to know something about, say, falling asleep.
after: And so what we need to recognize is that the human architecture is limited and that we have certain boundaries or dimensions of our lives that we want to be honored and respected, and technology could help do that. (Applause) CA: I mean, could you make the case that part of the problem here is that we've got a naïve model of human nature?
ru: Недавно руководитель Netflix заявил, что «наши самые главные конкуренты — Facebook, YouTube и сон».

quote: Because the show is written six weeks in advance she appeared up until recently.
before: It is still currently unknown what she was admitted for. The script writers for the show had to write her out of storylines.

quote: Spoken like a true daughter of the red, white, and blue.
before: American made and American won. I don't care what they say -- that victory will be ours soon enough.
after: Speaking of the red, white, and blue... What's really up with the VRA?
ru: Девушка с манерами - настоящая дочь бело-красно-синего флага.

quote: It's the same red driveway gravel that I saw at Emma Pak's house.
before: You seem awfully sure. Yeah, and it's red, too, okay?
after: I'm bringing her in. The tree is a match and so are the teeth.
ru: Такой же красный гравий, что я видел у дома Эммы Пакс.

quote: There was, like, a red truck parked out front.
before: What was it again? Oh, Speedy Pump, a Speedy Pump.
after: So it's Speedy Bump with a red truck. Speedy Pump with a red truck.
ru: Кажется, там ещё красный пикап стоял.

quote: Line up the target with your finger and hit the red "fire" button.
before: Okay. Turn the console on.
after: You're a natural, Consul. Well, thank you, Jerry.
ru: Наведите пальцем на цель и нажмите красную кнопку.

quote: My son is leaving red ink. I am leaving green ink.
before: That's me and my son on the floor. And there's video analytics that are tracking our movements.
after: We're now on the couch, looking out through the window at cars passing by. And finally, my son playing in a walking toy by himself.
ru: Мой сын оставляет за собой следы красного цвета, а я - зеленого.

quote: The streets of Turin were covered with red posters announcing the slogan of the Olympics.
before: Only a fearless and determined heart will get the gold medal. It is all about passion.
after: Passion lives here. Isn't it always true?
ru: Улицы Турина были заполнены красными плакатами, провозглашающими девиз Олимпиады:

quote: In red, you see all of the countries represented by their trash in Sian Ka'an.
before: And so far, we've documented garbage from 58 different countries and territories on six continents, all washing ashore in this paradise in Mexico. Although I can never know where a product was dropped, I can, at times, based on the label, know where something was made.
after: Such as these Haitian butter containers in all shapes and sizes, Jamaican water bottles. Not surprisingly, a lot of the stuff is from neighboring Caribbean countries, but the stuff is from everywhere.
ru: Красным отмечены все страны, представленные мусором в Сиан-Каане.

quote: And White, Red and blue explosions of transformers.
before: Wind gusts up to 90MPH [~145 km/h]. And trees falling all over.
after: All around town.

before: Blind Data is just one of a number of companies I own. Onsite scrubbing, destruction of hard drives and backup devices.
after: Well is there any reason that Peter Dukette would need or want access to that company? No, none that I can think of.
ru: Мы отбираем избыточную информацию, и безопасно избавляемся от нее.

quote: I always found the use of both arms redundant.
before: I'm very sorry, Mr. Ross. It's no problem.
after: - How did you find me? - We have our ways...
ru: Я всегда считал использование обеих рук лишними.

quote: Your wife is in the maternity home and everything's going so well I'm quite redundant.
before: Not with Stella? The very opposite.
after: I heard you're a Spurs fan. So I thought I might try to keep you posted on how the Cup goes.
ru: Ваша жена в роддоме, и всё идёт настолько гладко, что я там совершенно лишний.

after: - You have relationships with client, that leverage. - Did you say something?
ru: Я делю свою работу с Кенни, я уже здесь лишний.

quote: A wheelchair necessitates a landscape of minimal slopes and redundant vertical circulation.
before: Those have such a wide turning radius, that we have to deploy an enormous amount of pavement, of asphalt, to accommodate them. Or take the critically important wheelchair.
after: So wherever there's a stair, there has to be an elevator or a ramp. Now, don't get me wrong, please — I am all for pedestrian safety, firefighting and certainly, wheelchair access.
ru: Им нужен ландшафт с минимальными уклонами и избыточной вертикальной циркуляцией.

quote: What you see here is that there's these redundant connections.

after: So if this piece of data or this piece of the data gets clobbered, it doesn't show up over here, these two pieces can activate the missing part with these redundant connections. So even when you go to these crappy devices where sometimes you want a one and you get a zero, and it doesn't show up, there's redundancy in the network that can actually recover the missing information.
ru: Вы здесь видите, что есть избыточные соединения.

quote: I hope it will be redundant soon because companies will have either added Mx or deleted their title fields.

before: For 9 long years, I have sat in my prison cell outlining this entire story in my mind. I've meticulously planned all of it with a little help from my friends.
after: But I must say very, very much going according to plan. We should leave now, sir.

before: I'll be in the study. There's more books I haven't gone through.
after: And have you stopped to consider that maybe it's just an old key? No.

after: This is Clara, a famous rhinoceros that was traveling Europe in the mid-1700s, at a time when seeing a rhino was an exciting rarity. Including her in this illustration was akin to celebrity sponsorship today.
