quote: You know, Psychology Today says eyewitness testimony isn't as reliable as we thought.
before: We took their statements. You let the eyewitnesses leave?
after: Psychology Today? You don't read it?
ru: Ну, согласно журналу "Психология сегодня", показания свидетелей не так надёжны, как раньше думали.

quote: We've borrowed him from the Bowmanville camp, and so far, his intel's been reliable.
before: - "Burgerschmidt"? We're trusting a German P.O.W.?
after: He worked in a Luftwaffe HQ. He gave us the location of a safe that contained hundreds of one-time codes.
ru: Мы позаимствовали его в лагере в Боуманвиле, до сих пор его информация была надёжной.

quote: You were supposed to provide a reliable candidate.
before: - You know why. Fatiq has disappointed me too, but we had a deal.
after: The human factor always implies risk. I can't control that.
ru: Вы должны были дать надёжного исполнителя.

quote: Now, it's very energy-dense, it produces solid, reliable power, and it doesn't make any CO2.
before: So we are trying different types of energy now, alternative energy, but it proved quite difficult to find something that's as convenient and as cost-effective as oil, gas and coal. My personal favorite is nuclear energy.
after: Now we know of two ways of making nuclear energy: fission and fusion. Now in fission, you take a big nucleus, you break it in part, in two, and it makes lots of energy, and this is how the nuclear reactor today works.
ru: Она даёт очень хорошую мощность при минимальных затратах, обеспечивает бесперебойный и надёжный источник энергии, и не выделяет CO2.

quote: The most reliable wealth is found in relationship.
before: It's good common sense, right? And yet, money has often made us dumb about reaching out.
after: The new better off is not an individual prospect at all. In fact, if you're a failure or you think you're a failure, I've got some good news for you: you might be a success by standards you have not yet honored.
ru: Самое надёжное богатство — это наши отношения.

quote: And it's not all that reliable, and it's costly, and it's time-consuming.
before: How do we know, for instance, whether drugs are safe before we give them to people? We test them on animals.
after: Suppose we could do this instead on human cells. You probably know, if you've been paying attention to some of the science literature that you can now take a skin cell and encourage it to become a liver cell or a heart cell or a kidney cell or a brain cell for any of us.
ru: Это не слишком-то и надёжно, дорого, и требует времени.

quote: How reliable do you consider your results to be?
And you should be relieved that you no longer have to lie on his behalf.
before: - No, you defended and excused him your whole life! He is not to be trusted...
after: You have my permission to leave my court. I wish you a long and happy retirement, your Excellency.
ru: А вы должны чувствовать облегчение, поскольку вам больше не придется врать за него.

quote: I believe it, and frankly I'm relieved about it.
before: Tom isn't going anywhere. His grip is firm and steady.
after: - And the kid? - Treasurer Zajac is on board.
ru: Я уверена в этом, и, честно говоря, для меня это облегчение.

quote: Honestly, I've never been more relieved in my entire life.
before: That was really sneaky, Ann. I know. I couldn't resist.
after: I didn't ruin it. I thought I ruined it, but I didn't ruin it.
ru: Если честно, то никогда в жизни я не испытывал такого облегчения.

quote: I was just relieved to know that I wasn't wrong about him.
before: - It felt good being with David. It felt good. - 752...
after: - 752... - That he really did love me,
ru: Это было таким облегчением знать, что я не ошибалась в нем.

quote: And I was so relieved to hear that he was OK.
before: I know that the doctors who worked on me, they saved my heart, but mindfulness saved my life. The presence of mind I had to stop the ambulance that ended up taking me to the hospital, " — himself, the clarity of mind he had to notice when there was fear and anxiety happening but not be gripped by it — he said, " For me, these were the gifts of mindfulness. "
after: But really heartened to see that he had transformed his own attention. He went from having a really bad boss — an attention system that nearly drove him off a bridge — to one that was an exquisite leader and guide, and saved his life.
ru: Огромным облегчением было узнать, что с ним всё хорошо.

quote: I was surprised but relieved.
before: And when I debriefed the event with my manager, I just knew that she was going to run down the list of every mistake I had ever made, probably from birth. But instead, she opened with a question: What was your intention?
after: She knew that I was already beating myself up, and that question invited me to learn from my own mistakes instead of damage my already fragile confidence. Curiosity invites people to be in charge of their own learning.
ru: Я была удивлена, но почувствовала облегчение.

quote: Now when I heard this, I was so relieved.
before: She was a 26-year-old woman named Alex. Now Alex walked into her first session wearing jeans and a big slouchy top, and she dropped onto the couch in my office and kicked off her flats and told me she was there to talk about guy problems.
after: My classmate got an arsonist for her first client. (Laughter) And I got a twentysomething who wanted to talk about boys.
ru: Услышав это, я испытала огромное облегчение.

quote: Two other police officers were relieved of duty and seven more are under investigation.
after: The Memphis Fire Department terminated three emergency medical technicians for not treating Nichols' injuries. The county sheriff suspended two deputies present at the beating.

quote: Gatsby and I in turn leaned down and took the small reluctant hand.
after: Afterward he kept looking at the child with surprise. I don’t think he had ever really believed in its existence before.
ru: Мы с Гэтсби по очереди наклонились и пожали маленькую, неохотно протянутую руку.

quote: Why are you so reluctant to make a commitment to me?
before: If you want to fight, fine. But let's talk about the real issue here.
after: I don't want to talk about this. Well, you never do, but you owe me an explanation.
ru: Почему ты так не хочешь связать наши судьбы?

quote: If you're reluctant, it would be better to just call it off.
before: I'm not happy about it, but I'll enter the competition! Are you sure you're okay with it?
after: Well I don't have a choice, do I? You don't have any other requests...
ru: Если тебе не хочется, лучше и не пытаться.

quote: People are really reluctant to answer their phones to pollsters, and also, shockingly enough, people might lie.
before: There are a lot of reasons why polling has become so inaccurate. Our societies have become really diverse, which makes it difficult for pollsters to get a really nice representative sample of the population for their polls.
after: But you wouldn't necessarily know that to look at the media. For one thing, the probability of a Hillary Clinton win was communicated with decimal places.
ru: Люди очень неохотно отвечают социологам по телефону, и что самое удивительное — могут лгать.

quote: But you know, many adults are pretty reluctant to engage with role-play.
before: But a place, I think, where the effort is really worthwhile is where people are wrestling with quite serious problems — things like education or security or finance or health. And this is another example in a healthcare environment of some doctors and some nurses and designers acting out a service scenario around patient care.
after: Some of it’ s embarrassment and some of it is because they just don’ t believe that what emerges is necessarily valid. They dismiss an interesting interaction by saying, you know, " That’ s just happening because they’ re acting it out. "
ru: Но, знаете, многие взрослые люди довольно неохотно участвуют в ролевой игре.

quote: People are reluctant to talk about it -- there's a fear associated with it.
before: And then someone says, " These are the recent AIDS deaths in our community. " HIV isn't like other medical conditions; it's stigmatizing.
after: And I'm going to talk about HIV today, about the deaths, about the stigma. It's a medical story, but more than that, it's a social story.
ru: Люди не хотят об этом говорить. Ему сопутствует страх.

quote: To the referendum question my position is a reluctant yes.
ru: По вопросу референдума моя позиция — неохотное «да».

quote: Pointless, absurd, repetitive activity very good for clearing the mind.
before: Golf. I don't get it.
after: All these stalls here, mental washing machines. Van Pelt, what do we got?
ru: Бессмысленная, абсурдная, повторяющаяся деятельность... Очень хорошо для очистки мыслей.

quote: Repetitive blows to the head can cause chronic traumatic encephalopathy, the symptoms of which are aggressive behavior and depression.
before: Aside from the crying, he's actually recovering nicely. Aside from the guy in the book depository, the Kennedys had a lovely trip to Dallas.
after: So your theory is that his aggressive behavior caused his aggressive behavior? He's not depressed, he's just bummed, because he knows he's a talentless moron who's only one lost fight away from being a barista.
ru: Повторяющиеся удары по голове могут вызвать хроническую травматическую энцефалопатию; её симптомы — агрессивное поведение и депрессия.
source_ru: Бесконечные удары по голове могут вызвать хроническую травматическую энцефалопатию, симптомами которой являются агрессивное поведение и депрессия.

quote: Daddy, I hate to be repetitive, but the man is our only lead.
before: Or Arkady leaving. If his work's done here, maybe they've told him, "Head for the Continent."
after: We should bring him in now, get him to talk. Three cars, three teams of two. But don't let him out of your sight.
ru: Папочка, не люблю повторяться, но он - наша единственная ниточка.

quote: But what you'll see is that all the animations in this game are very repetitive.
before: And what you can see is — it is actually a very good game. It's one of the most successful games of all time.
after: They pretty much look the same. I've made him run into a wall here, over and over again.
ru: Но, как вы сейчас увидите, анимация в этой игре очень однообразна.

quote: We've become dermatologists doing repetitive things, lawyers doing repetitive things.
before: We've become spreadsheet monkeys. And not just low-end labor.
after: I think we are at the brink of being able to take an AI, look over our shoulders, and they make us maybe 10 or 50 times as effective in these repetitive things. That's what is on my mind.
ru: Мы стали дерматологами, которые делают одно и то же, юристами, делающими одно и то же.

quote: Automator, a graphical scripting interface that enables non-programmers to automate repetitive tasks.
ru: Automator — графический интерфейс для сценариев, который позволяет не-программистам автоматизировать однообразные задачи.

quote: Even putting this report together, working right here next to him, he covers his tracks.
before: - Another dead copper? He's slippery.
after: - He's a good copper. - He's a killer.
ru: Я пишу этот отчет, работаю рядом с ним, - ...а он заметает следы.

quote: Here's the preliminary report from the shooting team.
before: I'm just saying, Frank... All right.
after: They still need a few days to dot the i's, cross the t's, but the bad news is ballistics confirms that the bullet came from Officer Blake's gun. Good news is they're ruling it an "accidental discharge without malicious intent."
ru: Вот предварительный отчет от спецкомитета.

quote: Yes, I want a full report on all the Lunar Module communication systems.
before: Grandpa! This isn't over!
after: Now! I don't care if the satellite needs to be reoriented!
ru: Мне нужен полный отчёт о системах связи лунного модуля!

quote: Also, the report on Torey Martin's crash came through first thing.
before: OK -- any joy with the prints on the pack? We got some partials but no more, sir.
after: Yes, what did it say? "In summary, there is no evidence of any mechanical malfunction "that might have led to this crash.
ru: Также пришёл отчёт о ДТП с участием Тори Мартина.

quote: In one of Mohammed's early medical reports, he was diagnosed with signs of PTSD.
before: He joked that since he doesn't have legs, some days he tries to walk on his hands. One of the worst yet invisible impacts of the weapon is the psychological scars it leaves.
after: He suffered from anxiety, poor appetite, sleep disturbance and showed signs of anger. The reality is Mohammed never received proper help to fully recover.
ru: В одном из ранних медицинских отчётов Мухаммеда ему поставили ПТСР.

quote: In February this year, I saw this report.
before: I wasn't ready to let a political stunt interfere with my beauty sleep. (Laughter) Now fast-forward 10 years.
after: This here report basically concludes that one-third of the ice on the Hindu Kush Himalaya mountains could melt by the end of the century. But that's only if, if we are able to contain global warming to 1.5 degrees centigrade over preindustrial levels.
ru: В феврале этого года я прочитал вот этот отчёт.

quote: Well, you need to read the details of your mammography report.
before: And although breast density generally declines with age, up to a third of women retain dense breast tissue for years after menopause. So how do you know if your breasts are dense?
after: Radiologists classify breast density into four categories based on the appearance of the tissue on a mammogram. If the breast is less than 25 percent dense, that's called fatty-replaced.
ru: Вы должны внимательно прочитать все детали отчета о вашем маммографическом исследовании.

quote: Instead of league tables showing test results, the government will produce report cards for secondary schools.
after: According to Ed Balls, the results from GCSEs will be adequate to judge the performance of schools by their test results.

quote: Is he the one true representative of this miracle age?
before: Today the story of Danes and the abandoned child truly went viral. As the White House stays silent we ask is Oswald Danes now becoming the voice of the people?
after: You are trending like never before, you clever bastard. Miss Kitzinger, you make it all sound planned.
ru: Неужели он - единственный настоящий представитель этой эры чуда?

quote: Let my intention be clear to the Pyongyang representative.
before: Especially if America, China, Japan and Russia find out we'll all be in the middle of maelstrom. Our priority is to lead North Korea to a decision to shut down their nuclear weapons development.
after: If they agree on the proposal, we'll disclose to them the nuclear energy technology. [Kim Ki Soo]
ru: Я хочу, чтобы мои намерения были предельно ясны для представителей Пхеньяна.

quote: You are now officially a representative of her majesty's police force.
before: What happens if I drop dead before then? Then we'll cancel the appointment.
after: I want you to imagine that this is in fact an escaped criminal. - Now it's your task to...
ru: Теперь ты официальный представитель полицейских сил Её Величества.

quote: Oh, a 10% commission on future profits as their union representative.
before: Well, so they can cast off the yolk of oppression, - and finally taste freedom. - No... ..what's in it for you?
after: You know, you do make a pretty good table. Well...
ru: А! Ну, 10% с их будущей прибыли, как представитель профсоюза.

quote: They brand themselves as representative of and protecting of the citizens of Michoacán against organized crime.
before: Michoacán is a geographically strategic state because it has one of the largest ports in Mexico, and it has very direct routes to the center of Mexico, which then gives you direct access to the U.S. The Knights Templar realized very quickly that they couldn't face the Zetas on violence alone, and so they developed a strategy as a social enterprise.
after: Their brand of social enterprise means that they require a lot of civic engagement, so they invest heavily in providing local services, like dealing with home violence, going after petty criminals, treating addicts, and keeping drugs out of the local markets where they are, and, of course, protecting people from other criminal organizations. Now, they kill a lot of people too, but when they kill them, they provide very careful narratives and descriptions for why they did them, through newspaper insertions, YouTube videos, and billboards that explain that the people who were killed were killed because they represented a threat not to us, as an organization, of course, but to you, as citizens.
ru: Они сделали из себя бренд как представителей и защитников граждан Мичоаканана против организованных преступлений.

quote: Folks who answer the phones, assistants who manage calendars, representatives from agencies who weren't always trusted.
before: But more than half of those, the originator of those ideas was someone who might have a hard time getting the ear of a policy advisor. Or who, because of their identity, might not be taken entirely seriously if they did.
after: Imagine if our news media did the same thing. You can kind of see it now — a weekly cable news segment with a big policy proposal on the table that doesn't call it liberal or conservative.
ru: Это были ребята, сидящие на телефоне, ассистенты, ответственные за повестку дня, представители агентств, которым не всегда доверяли.

quote: It may not look like it, but Susan is a representative of a $27 billion market.
before: So I'm going to introduce you to a lady I met with last week. Her name's Susan.
after: 27 billion dollars is what people like Susan spend every year on cell phone charging, flashlight batteries and kerosene to light their homes. So Susan is a proud owner of a small solar system.
ru: Возможно, это незаметно, но Сьюзен — один из представителей рынка стоимостью 27 млрд долларов.

quote: Eiland-Hall retained Randazza as his attorney after receiving threatening letters from legal representatives of Beck.
after: Randazza replied to WIPO on the 28th of last month, contending the site is "protected political speech", due to it's "satirical political humor". Randazza stated, "[e]ven an imbecile would look at this Web site and know that it’s a parody."

quote: I've put in a request to go after his files.
before: This is everything I could find on garrett fowler. Not much there --
after: I'm just waiting on the judge. We don't need much.
ru: Я отправила запрос на доступ к его данным.

quote: The senator made requests for classified intelligence 29 times last month.
before: Astrid must be there by now. If they've learned anything, I'm sure they'll call.
after: There's nothing here. Well, if he's like the other shape-shifters, he's gonna be careful.
ru: Сенатор запрашивал секретную информацию 29 раз за последний месяц.

quote: Should I call the ACC's office, sir, and put a request in.
before: That's a good idea, yes. Because the last person she had a drink with ended up with their neck snapped.
after: What for? Well, for an interview.
ru: Мне позвонить старшему следователю, сэр, сделать запрос?

quote: Events like these underscore the urgency of my request to Congress for a declaration of war.
before: The system that maintains our sewers has been tampered with. The perpetrators were targeting the government and their ultimate purpose, though foiled, was to disrupt all mid-Atlantic transportation networks.
after: Tonight, I can only suspect Congress will spend a dark night of the soul, after which they will reconsider their paralysis and choose to act. Capital East Telecom has informed me that it's repairing the network as fast as possible, but that it will take at least a couple more days to be fully restored.
ru: Такие события, как они подчеркивают актуальность моего запроса к Конгрессу для объявления войны.

quote: And so that's the request I have for everybody in this room.
before: The stories that we tell — what we push out — becomes who we are. People aren't simply projecting identity, they're creating it.
after: We are creating the technology that is going to create the new shared experience, which will create the new world. And so my request is, please, let's make technologies that make people more human, and not less.
ru: И у меня есть просьба ко всем сидящим в зале

quote: They come to us with a request for a loan.
before: That means that they have no sports; they have no latest news; circulation goes down. It's a kind of very nice, sophisticated way how to economically strangle a daily newspaper.
after: They want to — the only way for them to survive is to get a printing press. And we said, that's fine; let's meet; you'll bring us your business plan, which eventually they did.
ru: Они приходят к нам с просьбой о кредите.

quote: The simplest example of this is in the polite request.
before: You want to express the bribe, the command, the promise, the solicitation and so on, but you also have to negotiate and maintain the kind of relationship you have with the other person. The solution, I think, is that we use language at two levels: the literal form signals the safest relationship with the listener, whereas the implicated content — the reading between the lines that we count on the listener to perform — allows the listener to derive the interpretation which is most relevant in context, which possibly initiates a changed relationship.
after: If you express your request as a conditional — " if you could open the window, that would be great " — even though the content is an imperative, the fact that you're not using the imperative voice means that you're not acting as if you're in a relationship of dominance, where you could presuppose the compliance of the other person. On the other hand, you want the damn guacamole.
ru: Самый простой пример – вежливая просьба.

quote: This request is based on the U.S. Justice Department withdrawing charges against former Senator Ted Stevens.
before: The Republican Party of Alaska is requesting United States Senator Mark Begich, Democrat, to resign to pave way for a new election.

quote: Archer had never been more indifferent to the requirements of form; but his impulse to do Lawrence Lefferts a physical injury was only momentary.
after: The idea of bandying Ellen Olenska's name with him at such a time, and on whatsoever provocation, was unthinkable. He paid for his telegram, and the two young men went out together into the street.
ru: Арчер ещё никогда не был так равнодушен к требованиям приличий; но желание ударить Лоуренса Леффертса было лишь мимолётным.

quote: We never said anything about a residency requirement.
before: That's cheating. Eh, cheating is such an ugly word.
after: I think it's implied in the phrase "dorm triathlon." Oh.
ru: Мы ничего не говорили о требованиях к местожительству.

quote: Look, Mrs. St. Patrick, there may be a way to keep Tariq enrolled at this school, but the requirements will be severe.
before: Oh, I get it. The black kid gets expelled, but Michelle Batten and Jenny West don't, after they assaulted the girl on the lacrosse team with their sticks.
after: Oh, I wouldn't have expected it any other way. 'Riq, wait for me downstairs.
ru: - Послушайте, миссис Сэнт-Патрик, возможно, есть способ оставить Тарига в нашей школе, но требования будут очень жёсткие.

quote: Well, you've covered all the legal requirements, boss.
before: Then I'll keep you posted. Right now, we don't have anything but a tip, and we don't know much about what kind of information is allegedly being passed up.
after: The officer in question is assigned to your precinct. Kinda figured that.
ru: Ну, босс, все требования закона вы учли.
source_ru: Ну, босс, все законные требования вы прикрыли.

quote: But that's pretty much it for formal requirements.
before: So, the first thing that they tell you is that you need to have a certificate of burial before you can go ahead — you're not allowed to just murder people and put them under the patio. (Laughter) They also tell you that you need to keep a record of where the grave is.
after: Now, they do warn you that your neighbors might not like this, but, legally speaking, there's almost nothing that they can do about it. And just in case any of you still had that profit idea in your mind about how much those burial plots cost and how much money you might be able to make, they also warn that it might cause the value of your house to drop by 20 percent.
ru: Пожалуй, это всё, что касается формальных требований.

quote: The only two requirements were that they were studying at the university, and they spoke English.
before: And they're not necessarily, you know, great ways of looking at the entire world. So we actually invited 80 young people from all over the world to come and solve the same problem.
after: The majority of them were, first, from developing countries. They had all the same material but they could go vastly outside the scope of discussion, and they certainly did, to come up with their own lists.
ru: Было только два условия — чтобы они учились в университете и говорили по-английски.

quote: North American travelers will see a phased-in requirement to carry passports in the coming years.
after: In a multi-national initiative to restrict illegal immigration and travel, a passport layer of stricter identification will be introduced for travel throughout the continent by the year 2008. The US State Department announced the new American travel rules Monday.
ru: Для путешественников из Северной Америки в ближайшие годы поэтапно введут требование иметь при себе паспорт.

quote: I used to know that until I saw the research.
before: Um... the damage to your spinal cord's pretty severe. I think you know that.
after: Do you know how long the testing process takes for medical protocols like this? At least... 10 years... and- and that's before they even start human trials.
ru: Я знал это, пока я не увидел исследований.

quote: Alain encapsulated that research, and now he'll be sorely missed.
before: What sort of world is this? It's OK, I'll protect them.
after: Have you thought it over, Mr Vermillard? Shit!
ru: Ален занимался исследованиями. Нам его будет очень не хватать.

quote: The Patriot Act made my research at Thurn accessible to the government.
before: Men with guns always want to control the men with ideas. Is that why you left hithan tk Thurn-Tippett,
after: They rationalized that in a time of war, they needed access to anything that could help defeat terrorism. Defeat terrorism?
ru: По закону о борьбе с терроризмом правительство получило доступ к моим исследованиям.

quote: A guy like this, he wouldn't just stop registering his research because oliver let him go.
before: Schott is a pretty prolific inventor. He filed a lot of patents for s.t.a.r. Labs.
after: So maybe the patent office has a current address for him. If this guy's working for lex, we're dealing with a lot more than just some toy maker.
ru: И он явно не из тех, кто прекратил бы свои исследования только потому, что Оливер его уволил.

quote: My vision is to make genetic research more native, to indigenize genome sequencing technology.
before: Hawaii, for example, has the longest life expectancy on average of any state in the US, yet native Hawaiians like myself die a full decade before our non-native counterparts, because we have some of the highest rates of type 2 diabetes, obesity, and the number one and number two killers in the US: cardiovascular disease and cancer. So how do we ensure the populations of people that need genome sequencing the most are not the last to benefit?
after: Traditionally, genomes are sequenced in laboratories. Here's an image of your classic genome sequencer.

before: Globally, 75 percent of all mental illness cases can be found in low-income countries. Yet most African governments invest less than one percent of their health care budget in mental health.
after: Nigeria, for example, is estimated to have 200 — in a country of almost 200 million. In all of Africa, 90 percent of our people lack access to treatment.
ru: Что ещё хуже, в Африке у нас страшная нехватка психиатров.

quote: But we have a major shortage of organs.
before: Yet we're still dealing with a lot of the same challenges as many decades ago. Certainly many advances, many lives saved.
after: In the last decade the number of patients waiting for a transplant has doubled. While, at the same time, the actual number of transplants has remained almost entirely flat.
ru: Но мы испытываем огромный дефицит органов.

quote: WHO have previously warned that such travel restrictions increased the chance of food shortages.
before: The African Union also warned of the economic impact of the outbreak, urging a lifting of travel bans and border closures.
after: An agreement made yesterday is expected to lead to those restrictions imposed in the last few months being lifted.

quote: I don't want to be on the other side with unfinished business.
before: I died last night. I'm a ghost, and I want the same thing you want.
after: I want my parents to see my off to college, I want to decorate my dorm room with my best friends.
ru: Я н хочу быть на той стороне с незаконченными делами.

quote: You simply need to determine which side of history you want to end up on.
before: Oh, no. I'm the Rubicon.
after: Who are you, Mr. Jasper? A subordinate who remained slavishly obedient to his master, or the presumptive leader of an organization that will be far more powerful than it has ever been?
ru: А тебе лишь нужно определиться, на чьей стороне ты хочешь оказаться.

quote: He's got mainstream political ambitions and is keen to show a softer side.
before: How are you doing? Dmitry says he's changed since his days in the Slavic Union.
after: On the march that you got organised, I heard people chanting. "Russia for Russians" and "Keep Russia white", were you aware of that sort of chant happening?
ru: У него появились амбиции большого политика и он стремится показать себя с более мягкой стороны.

quote: I just want to get his side of it.
before: You are. Hero cop shoots Romeo in back.
after: You do not go near that kid. Oh, yeah?
ru: Я просто хочу занять его сторону.

quote: You know, one minute Holmes is on the other side from Lestrade.
before: It's one of the few times we see Holmes moved in the mysteries, and I find it very moving, this little scene, but it's also mysterious, right? It seems to treat jealousy as a problem of geometry, not emotion.
after: The next minute they're on the same side. Suddenly, Lestrade is letting himself admire this mind that he's resented.
ru: В какой-то момент Холмс и Лестрейд находятся по разные стороны баррикад,

quote: On one side you have institutions and people with money.
before: There are other sources of income for artists, however. There are private foundations, grants and patrons who give money, except a vast majority of artists don't know about these opportunities.
after: On the other side you have artists seeking funding, but the artists don't know about the people with the money, and the people with the money don't necessarily know about the artists out there. This is why I am very excited to share " Grantpa, " an online platform that uses technology to match artists with grants and funding opportunities in a way that is easy, fast and less intimidating.
ru: С одной стороны есть учреждения и люди с деньгами.

quote: It pulls much stronger on one side than the other and the cloud is stripped apart.
before: And what does the big black hole do? It strips that gas cloud apart.
after: In fact, we anticipated that star formation shouldn't proceed in that environment. So, you shouldn't see young stars.
ru: Она тянет с одной стороны гораздо сильнее, чем с другой, и облако разрывается на полосы.

quote: Fierce fighting has broken out and dozens of casualties are reported on both sides.
before: Pakistani officials say the military has launched its much anticipated ground offensive against the Taliban and al-Qaeda in the South Waziristan tribal region.

quote: They've been hiding among us in plain sight.
before: We need to figure out the full extent of their capabilities. It's not gonna be easy.
after: God only knows how far we've been infiltrated. Sorry.
ru: Они скрываются среди нас будучи на виду

quote: Well, look, we can stay out of sight and still be ready to back you up.
before: Puente thinks you're American tourists with a bad rental car. If he sees your faces again, he'll know we set him up.
after: Sam, you know this is the way they do things. Different teams have different jobs, for operational security.
ru: Ну, мы можем оставаться вне поля зрения и быть готовыми прикрыть тебя.

quote: If we let him out of our sight, you will never see him again.
before: You don't fall for this again! This is just more of his, eh, lies.
after: So come with me. He's the only one who knows where the alchemist's orb is.
ru: Если мы выпустим его из виду, то не увидим его уже никогда.

quote: Why, if you had your target in your sights, would you fire so wildly, hmm?
before: The murderer pursues the dead man to this outcropping; he tries to hide, it does him little good, and yet there are shotgun pellets on either side of his hiding place.
after: Maybe the killer was running? Have you ever tried to fire a shotgun while sprinting?
ru: Зачем, если твоя цель находится в поле зрения, так палить?

quote: You see, my clock only focuses on sight, and a little bit of touch.
before: Now in the middle of all this five senses work, I suddenly remembered the solar-powered clocks project from my youth. And I realized this theory also explains why Chris's clock is so much better than mine.
after: Here's Chris's clock. It's the first clock ever that uses smell to tell the time.
ru: Мои часы сосредоточены только на зрении и в меньшей степени на осязании.

quote: This truly is a scandal of epic proportions hidden in plain sight.
before: We secretly filmed some of the family of the former chief minister and a lawyer as they told our undercover investigator exactly how these dubious deals are done using such companies. And the awful thing is, there are so many other examples out there from all walks of life.
after: Whether it's the ruthless Mexican drugs cartel, the Zetas, who use anonymous companies to launder profits while their drugs-related violence is tearing communities apart across the Americas. Or the anonymous company, which bought up Americans' tax debts, piled on the legal fees and then gave homeowners a choice: Pay up or lose your home.
ru: Это воистину невероятных масштабов скандал, скрытый у всех на виду.

quote: All of these things and far more are linked in your brain to your sight.
before: Here's where it gets interesting. To create the experience of sight, your brain references your conceptual understanding of the world, other knowledge, your memories, opinions, emotions, mental attention.
after: These linkages work both ways, and usually occur subconsciously. So for example, what you see impacts how you feel, and the way you feel can literally change what you see.
ru: Все эти вещи и многие другие в мозге напрямую связаны со зрением.

quote: He said ferry services have improved "out of sight" over the past year.
before: Manager of Sydney Ferries, Geoff Smith defended the safety record of his services.

quote: Well, it's a good sign that she made it through the night.
before: Same old. I just wish I could make Tix better.
after: So I... I don't get where I am. I tried to do something stupid.
ru: Очень хороший знак, что она пережила эту ночь.

quote: But the sign say y'all close at 10:00.
before: Sure. Sorry, we're closed.
after: Look, I'm hungry. My boss, he's making me close up for the night.
ru: Но на табличке написано, вы закрываетесь в 10:00.

quote: Someone is out to get me, and all signs point to you.
before: You ought not to have come today. I look forward to seeing you.
after: You're the only one who knew it all. it has to be you. Six or seven days passed, and archer heard nothing from madam olenska.
ru: Кто-то пытается меня достать, и все знаки указывают на тебя.

quote: All Christian worship is drama, full of sign and symbol.
before: The way people communicate is not only through words, but through gestures, through the way, you know, the person is expressing himself through his body, or voice, tune or whatever. Now this is very different from how Western spirituality has developed, which was always through philosophy, so you always have theologians who are philosophers, but in the East, you always have theologians who are either poets, or maybe icon drawers or whatever.
after: But what Father Fady is claiming is that Eastern Christianity has made a priority of passing down gestures, which take you right back to the beginnings of the Church. When the priest lifts the communion bread for example, it symbolizes Jesus rising from the dead.
ru: Всё в христианском богослужении - драма, полная знаков и символов.

quote: As you can see, he's holding a sign, and his sign says he wants a job.
before: I get to be the mayor of a great American city, Albuquerque, New Mexico. I was at lunch on July 17, 2015, in my great American city, and on my way back to city hall, I saw this gentleman standing on a corner.
after: But if you look closer at the picture, you'll see he's standing underneath a blue sign, and that sign says, if you need help, if you need food or shelter or you'd like to donate, please call 311, our community service number. So why is this guy standing underneath my sign with his sign?
ru: Как вы можете заметить, он держит табличку, и эта табличка гласит, что ему нужна работа.

quote: There are Cornish language signs, ice-cream commercials, Wikipedia, and even memes.
before: From there, they organized weekly or monthly events where they could gather and speak in public. Today, some schools teach Cornish.
after: (Laughter) (Laughter) And with their language once again intact, the people of Cornwall have secured recognition as a Celtic nation alongside Ireland, Scotland and Wales. They stared down centuries of forced assimilation and said, " We're not a county in England.
ru: На корнском теперь есть знаки и вывески, реклама мороженого, Wikipedia и даже мемы.

quote: So, it's hard to create a new meaning for the existing sign.
before: That means that if there are five cars waiting, you have to wait till they all go, then you go. It lacks the notion of alternating, or taking turns, and it's always on the minor road, allowing the major one to have primacy.
after: You couldn't suddenly tell everyone, " OK, remember what you used to do at yield signs? Now do something different. "
ru: Тяжело создать новое значение существующему знаку.

quote: Is this a sign of things to come for the Vikeslandic Department of Aeronautics and Space?
before: Will Vikesland's flag be displayed in outer space again in the near future?

after: Let me get this straight. You want a second felony count for what the kid ate?
ru: У обвиняемого в крови было значительное количество кокаина.

quote: Harrow made significant contributions to a number of philanthropic organizations.
before: I've been going through Charles Harrow's books. It's a bit like falling down the rabbit hole, but I think I've found where the body might be buried.
after: - How significant? - Six zeroes significant.
ru: Харроу делал значительные пожертвования в ряд филантропических организаций.

quote: Raven, it appears that you have significant damage to the nerves in your left leg.
before: Raven, I want you to tell me when you feel something, ok? There.
after: Will it get better? For now, you'll need crutches, but you're alive, and you're not in pain anymore.
ru: Рейвен, похоже, что у тебя значительные повреждения нервов в левой ноге.

quote: They have helped us recover significant sums from parties who had fallen into deep arrears.
before: My Hand, Qyburn, has made overtures to the Golden Company in Essos. I know them well.
after: That's good to hear. I, too, would like them to recover some things that belong to me.
ru: Они помогли нам взыскать значительные суммы с наших клиентов, которые увязли в долгах.

quote: And it was very significant, because he wrote it using his eye gaze technology.
before: ALS robs the human of all their physical parts, but the brain stays intact. So July 4th, 2014, 75th year of Lou Gehrig's inspirational speech comes, and Pete is asked by MLB.com to write an article in the Bleacher Report.
after: Twenty days later, the ice started to fall. On July 27th, Pete's roommate in New York City, wearing a Quinn For The Win shirt, signifying Pat Quinn, another ALS patient known in New York, and B.C. shorts said, " I'm taking the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge, " picked up the ice, put it over his head.
ru: Это было очень важно, потому что он писал её, используя отслеживатель глаз.

quote: These investments offer significant benefits beyond just being ready for the epidemic.
before: Now I don't have an exact budget for what this would cost, but I'm quite sure it's very modest compared to the potential harm. The World Bank estimates that if we have a worldwide flu epidemic, global wealth will go down by over three trillion dollars and we'd have millions and millions of deaths.
after: The primary healthcare, the R & amp; D, those things would reduce global health equity and make the world more just as well as more safe. So I think this should absolutely be a priority.
ru: Подобные вложения обещают значительные преимущества не только в борьбе с эпидемиями.

quote: We have failed to achieve leadership in significant numbers.
before: Now, let's have a look at what happened in reality. It's not even close, which means I was so wrong and which means that my generation, your generation, the best-educated female generation in history, we have just not made it.
after: Education just did not translate into leadership. Now, that was a painful realization for me and made me realize, if we want to change this, we need to engage, and we need to do better.
ru: Нам не удалось добиться руководящих позиций в значительном количестве.

quote: Australia's previous warmest years on record were influenced by significant El Niño events, say the Bureau.
after: However, no such event occurred in 2005, making the record warmth even more unusual. Since 1979, all but four years have been warmer than average in Australia.

before: It's approximately three years old. An injury like this is most typical for professional baseball players.
after: Oh-for-11 as a utility infielder before being traded by the Royals... To the White Sox after successful surgery to repair his hamate.

before: All the predator's bones were found alongside the edge of an ancient stagnant lake. And all of them died at the same time.
after: And the killer - a fast-acting, naturally occurring deadly disease. Botulism.
ru: Похожие массовые вымирания случаются и сегодня, среди птиц.

quote: It's similar to the flecks we found in Markham's car and Henderson's bedroom.
before: The paint used for the graffiti at Dalhousie's farm. We should take a closer look at it.
after: There could be a link. That's a good idea.
ru: Она похожа на ту, частицы которой мы нашли в машине Маркэма и в спальне Хендерсона.

quote: Nope, but the effects appear similar to those from the Obelisk.
before: - All part of an Anti-HYDRA unit. Any idea what was used to carry out the attack?
after: Which we must assume is in HYDRA's possession. - Heard back from your navy contact?
ru: Нет, но эффект похож на тот, что дает Обелиск.

quote: This is very similar to what someone watching a video recording of our experience would see.
before: Let's focus on what happens on each rung of the ladder. On the first rung, we have the raw data and observations of our experience.
after: Moving up to the second rung, we filter in specific information and details from our experience. We unknowingly filter based on our preferences, tendencies, and many other aspects that we believe are important.
ru: Это похоже на то, как другие увидели бы наше событие в форме видеозаписи.

quote: The military and theater communities are actually very similar.
before: And when I was reflecting on my time in the military, I wasn't first thinking on the stereotypical drills and discipline and pain of it; but rather, the small, intimate human moments, moments of great feeling: friends going AWOL because they missed their families, friends getting divorced, grieving together, celebrating together, all within the backdrop of the military. I saw my friends battling these circumstances, and I watched the anxiety it produced in them and me, not being able to express our feelings about it.
after: You have a group of people trying to accomplish a mission greater than themselves; it's not about you. You have a role, you have to know your role within that team.
ru: Военное и театральное сообщества на самом деле очень похожи.

quote: A similar thing happened with the economy that you and I share.
before: But I will admit, fellow citizen, that I have discounted the burden of coping with the loss of status. I have forgotten that what is socially necessary can also be personally gruelling.
after: Just as I cannot and don't wish to turn back to the clock on equality and diversity, and yet must understand the sense of loss they can inspire, so, too, I refuse and could not if I wished turn back the clock on an ever more closely knit, interdependent world, and on inventions that won't stop being invented. And yet I must understand your experience of these things.
ru: Похожая ситуация получается с нашей с тобой общей экономической системой.

quote: A similar explanation for the phenomenon in Gujarat was given by Valsad District Collector D Rawal.
after: According to him, the reason for the water tasting less salty than usual was that because of the monsoon, two rivers Auranga and Banki were in spate and had been flowing into the sea in the region.

quote: You have a very simple view of the universe.
before: To strike an unarmed man is hardly the jedi way. You're a sith lord!
after: I am neither sith nor jedi. I am much more...
ru: У тебя слишком простое представление о мироздании.

quote: It's simple human nature to keep little secrets about ourselves.
before: It's exactly... as it should be. Oh, God.
after: We all do it. "I dye my hair."
ru: Это просто человеческая природа, хранить маленькие секреты о себе.

quote: It could be as simple as an ice bath.
before: Wait, wait, hold on. If we're planning a party, we haven't even talked about the most important thing. A hydration plan for people who overheat?
after: No, no, I'm talking about women. Oh, yeah, we definitely need some women there.
ru: Можно просто обойтись ванной со льдом.

quote: So the simple objective, ladies and gentlemen, stay on your feet.
before: Now, the next twelve hours we will dance the music from the seventies, eighties, nineties, and beyond. The longer you stay on your feet, the more money you make from your sponsors.
after: Because if you sit, you're out. If you stand still for too long you're out.
ru: Что же, цель проста, леди и джентльмены, оставайтесь на ногах.

quote: And when we have overwhelming problems in front of us, we tend to seek simple answers.
before: That's, to put it mildly, not what's on the table now. And it tends to feel a little overwhelming when we look at what is there in reality today and the magnitude of the problem that we face.
after: And I think this is what we've done with climate change. We look at where the emissions are coming from — they're coming out of our tailpipes and smokestacks and so forth, and we say, okay, well the problem is that they're coming out of fossil fuels that we're burning, so therefore, the answer must be to replace those fossil fuels with clean sources of energy.
ru: Находясь перед лицом гигантской проблемы, мы часто ищем простые решения.

quote: One simple fact: you couldn't try to call an Afghan at 8:30 in the evening.
before: India doesn't have a military mission there. You know what was India's biggest asset in Afghanistan in the last seven years?
after: Why? Because that was the moment when the Indian television soap opera, " Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, " dubbed into Dari, was telecast on Tolo T.V.
ru: Просто один факт: в 8:30 вечера дозвониться до афганца невозможно.

quote: But sometimes this kind of a metaphor is too simple.
before: But we also use a very simple metaphor, the cat and the mouse game, to describe in the past 15 years the continuing fight between Chinese censorship, government censorship, the cat, and the Chinese Internet users. That means us, the mouse.
after: So today I want to upgrade it to 2.0 version. In China, we have 500 million Internet users.
ru: нами, мышками. Но иногда эта метафора слишком проста.

quote: Minetest uses the CMake build system which is simple to use from the command-line.
before: Git of course. Sometimes python scripts.
after: All in all just the bread and butter Linux command-line environment, with my personal customization of course.

quote: I clung to the bizarre idea that Gunther is not dead, but simply went into isolation.
before: So, we are left by themselves. They just could not get up to us.
after: This could be, and quite like it. He always strove to loneliness.
ru: Я цеплялся за причудливую идею, что Гюнтер не умер, а просто ушел в изоляцию.

quote: Do you simply want to arrange it so that your father can have a Christian burial?
before: You've got it all wrong. Do any of you Catholics know exactly what good you think this priest will do?
after: Or do you want to keep him out of hell? I only want to be told.
ru: Хотите ли вы просто, чтобы ваш отец мог быть похоронен по христианскому обряду?

quote: We'll simply return it to its natural state.
before: Well... you're in luck. Magic can change forms, but never be destroyed.
after: Snowflakes. Magic similar to yours, dearie, though not quite the same.
ru: Мы просто вернем ее в естественное состояние.

before: But he's got over 700 horsepower. Yes, I know, but you remember Jaws: big metal teeth, huge man?
after: - Do you mind if I don't take part in this? I'll do it.
ru: Джеймс Бонд просто выкинул его из окна, это же я проделаю с ним.

quote: But there is something more that we can do than just simply helping refugees survive.

after: We can help them thrive. We should think of refugee camps and communities as more than just temporary population centers where people languish waiting for the war to end.
ru: Но есть нечто большее, что мы можем сделать, чем просто помощь беженцам в выживании.

quote: Either they have forgotten their way back to the hive, or they have simply disappeared.
before: It's full of untouched food stores and a brood of unborn larvae, suggesting that the adults vacated without waiting for them to hatch. But what's particularly eerie is that there's no tell-tale mass of dead or dying bees nearby.
after: These mysterious disappearances aren't new. Humans have been collecting honey for centuries.
ru: Получается, что либо они забыли путь к улью, либо просто исчезли.

quote: In places like India, those technicians simply don't exist.
before: Conversion Sound has developed a high quality, ultra-low-cost digital hearing aid for the developing world. Now, in the West we rely on highly trained technicians to fit these hearing aids.
after: So it took a team working in India with patients and community health workers to understand how a PDA and an application on a PDA might replace those technicians in a fitting and diagnostic service. Instead of starting with technology, the team started with people and culture.
ru: В таких странах как Индия таких специалистов просто нет.

quote: To put it most simply, it is right-doing.
before: "What is justice?

before: Because you'd be lying. This is his baby.
after: Now, if I'm right about your husband, I think that the father of your child is somewhere in here. Bob Atkins?
ru: Эти файлы о недавних нераскрытых убийствах мужчин, которых убили с тех пор, как Вы забеременели.

after: I do this thing where I'll take an ingredient and I'll make like seven dishes with it, just to really get to know it. I see you're in high school.

after: I have been on the road. That is my life now.
ru: Чем ты занимался с тех пор, как покинул Парадиз?

after: That's not true. It's not just me, you guys have been boring too.
ru: Я не был ураганом развлечений с тех пор как Трой уехал.

before: He apologized. And then he asked for help, honesty, and ideas in return.
after: So sacrifice your desire to be right or safe all the time. It's not helping anyone, least of all you.
ru: Выручка Starbucks удвоилась с тех пор, как вернулся Говард.

quote: And since then, I realized I just want to focus on solar.
before: And it was, until I read the book called the " Solar Revolution, " where it says that within one hour we receive enough sunlight to provide the world with enough electricity for an entire year. One hour.
after: Scientists all over the world have been focusing on making solar panels more efficient and cheaper. So the price of solar has dropped enormously.
ru: С тех пор я поняла, что хочу сосредоточиться на солнечной энергии.

quote: So ever since then, before I would go anywhere, I would call the FBI.

after: I would tell them, " Hey guys, this is where I'm going. This is my flight.

after: I've never seen her happier than these past couple months. I can't believe that my sister's dead.

quote: 'Cause guess who's single, hot, and still hung up on you.
before: The wedding kind. Frickin' relax.
