ru: Вот еще один уголок вне дома, немного более утонченный.

quote: It manages counterparty risk in incredibly sophisticated ways.
before: If you're a Wall Street trader, you now take it for granted that you sell your financial assets in a system of markets that identifies the most profitable opportunities for you in real time, executes on that in microseconds within the boundaries you've set. It analyzes supply and demand and pricing and tells you where your next wave of opportunities are coming from.
after: It's all extremely low overhead. What have we gained at the bottom of the economy in terms of markets in the last 20 years?
ru: Она управляет рисками контрагента невероятно изощрёнными способами.

quote: We know they didn't have anything sophisticated, like needles for sewing anything tailored.
before: Maybe turned into shoes of some sort. This clothing and footwear would be pretty simple.
after: But probably some sort of clothing, I would say.

quote: All that I know is that I felt really sorry for her.
before: - Everyone knows what. You don't have any thoughts about who or why?
after: I got away when I was 18 and I never went back. And she'd have done the same.
ru: Я знаю только одно, мне было очень жаль её.

quote: I'm sorry, I think I've used your deodorant.
before: No. Excuse me, miss.
after: And you probably have mine. It's a military-grade men's roll-on?
ru: Простите, я подумала, что попользовалась вашим дезодорантом.

quote: Uh. I'm sorry for staring, just you weren't quite what we expected.
before: Somebody murdered Dr. Cash. I don't even know how I feel about that.
after: Thank God for plastic surgery. Must have been expensive.
ru: Извините, что пялимся, но мы вас не такой представляли.

quote: I'm so sorry I didn't come in sooner.
before: Oh, Olivia. Olivia.
after: How are you holding up? We're managing.
ru: Прости, что не приходила раньше.

quote: He had written, "I'm sorry for my mistakes, I'm sorry for not being there for you."
before: And I thought to myself that as a teacher, I knew that a student could dramatically improve in a very quick amount of time, but I never thought that a student could dramatically regress. What even pained me more, was seeing what he had written to his daughter.
after: And this was all he felt he had to say to her. And I asked myself how can I convince him that he has more to say, parts of himself that he doesn't need to apologize for.
ru: Он написал: «Я сожалею о своих ошибках, прости, что я не с тобой».

quote: Sorry boys, but it's just a tiny little thing that makes you different.
before: (Applause) Chromosome one — top left, bottom right — are the sex chromosomes. Women have two copies of that big X chromosome; men have the X and, of course, that small copy of the Y.
after: So if you zoom in on this genome, then what you see, of course, is this double-helix structure — the code of life spelled out with these four biochemical letters, or we call them bases: A, C, G and T. How many are there in the human genome?
ru: Парни, извините, но всего лишь очень маленькая штучка делает вас другими.

quote: Sorry. I can't spend more than 10 million dollars.
before: Five years. Cost of development — 300 million dollars.
after: Looks absolutely audacious. Looks absolutely ridiculous.
ru: Извините. Я не могут потратить больше 10 миллионов долларов.

quote: Prepare yourself to be wowed by a Wall of Sound.
before: Attention Mr. and Mrs. Whatever-your-last-name-is. Why do they need a rehearsal?
after: Sound, sound. What was that?
ru: Приготовьтесь быть снесенными стеной звука.

quote: I don't think I'll ever forget that sound.
before: It's all about exclusivity. Just being invited means you're a somebody.
after: The screaming. Abigail,did you see anybody near the cab of the truck?
ru: Я никогда не забуду этот звук.

quote: I don't speak their lingo, But I recognize the sound. Have you met one?
before: Angels... they really exist? Unfortunately, yes.
after: Let's just table the angel talk, luv. It's the preacher we need to focus on here.
ru: Не понимаю их жаргона, но этот звук я где угодно узнаю.

quote: Prairie, my dear, toward the sound my voice.
before: All right, everybody, relax. Looking good.
after: Prairie? Prairie, toward the sound of my voice, honey.
ru: Прейри, дорогуша, в сторону звука моего голоса.

quote: And I'll never forget the comforting sound of water trickling down a stream.
before: I'll never forget the sound of laughing with my friends. I'll never forget the sound of my mother's voice right before I fell asleep.
after: Imagine my fear, pure fear, when, at the age of 10, I was told I was going to lose my hearing. And over the next five years, it progressed until I was classified as profoundly deaf.
ru: И я никогда не забуду умиротворяющий звук воды, журчащей в ручье.

quote: (Beeps) Somehow these sounds represent the word and the concept.
before: They represent the word " mathematics, " and these symbols also represent that word and this we can listen to. It sounds like this.
after: How does this happen? There's something amazing going on about representing stuff.
ru: (Звук) Эти звуки характеризуют это слово и идею.

quote: This can sometimes create a sound, but doesn't necessarily have to always.
before: This is because our small intestine is actually a huge neat freak, and it takes the time in between digestion to clean everything up, resulting in those eight meters of gut — really, seven of them — being very clean and hardly smelling like anything. It will, to achieve this, create a strong muscular wave that moves everything forward that's been leftover after digestion.
after: So what we're embarrassed of is really a sign of something keeping our insides fine and tidy. Or this weird, crooked shape of our stomach — a bit Quasimodo-ish.
ru: Иногда это сопровождается звуками, но не обязательно всегда.

quote: For programming we need capable gameplay, AI, sound and graphics programmers, proficient in C++ and/or JavaScript.
before: For other tasks, we do require some prior knowledge in fields such as software development, 3d animation etc. Our main personnel needs are in three fields: Programmers, artists and sound people. We have many applicants for sound contributors but need a manager to oversee them.
after: Finally, in the art department, we could use some more texture artists, 3D artists, animators, and illustrators to draw 2d icons for the game's user interface.

quote: Well, if she's the source, we may have a lead.
before: And that's because they weren't seeing her. They were seeing their fears.
after: Guess who was witness to Bob's attack on his wife. Bigfoot.
ru: Ну что ж, если она источник, то у нас возможно есть зацепка.

quote: The point is have we overlooked something, some source of revenue previously untapped?
before: Even Lloyd George can't want that. I'm not sure he's a good example.
after: If only we had some coal, or gravel, or tin. I can think of someone who's got plenty of tin.
ru: Суть в том, что может мы что-то упускаем из виду, какой-нибудь источник дохода, незамеченный ранее?

quote: We need to find the source of this cold-front before it freezes all of Motorcity!
before: Uhm, uhm, I'm working on it! Let's set out guys.
after: Oh, Claire, uuh, looks like I can't drive you home right now, you gonna be alright hanging around here for a while? Okay, like, exactly, how long do you mean by "a while"?
ru: Нужно найти источник этого холодного фронта, прежде чем он заморозит весь Моторсити!

quote: Megatron said that there was another Energon source here.
before: That I was obsessed! Me, can you imagine that?
after: - On Earth? On another source?
ru: Мегатрон сказал что есть еще один источник Энергона на Земле

quote: What we did was we found what were the locally available sources of biomass.
before: So we wanted to see if we could introduce this charcoal-making technology there. Well, unfortunately, they didn't have sugarcane and they didn't have cassava, but that didn't stop us.
after: And there was wheat straw and there was rice straw in this area. And what we could use as a binder was actually small amounts of cow manure, which they used ordinarily for their fuel.
ru: Что нам оставалось делать, так это найти местный доступный источник биомассы.

quote: These are potential sources for high-speed data transmission.
before: Look at your smart phone. It has a flashlight, an LED flashlight.
after: And then there's security. You would agree with me that light doesn't penetrate through walls.
ru: Это потенциальные источники высокоскоростной передачи данных.

quote: Well, one obvious source is dead sharks -- dead sharks, washed up.
before: They didn't get enough samples to really explore the genetics in enough detail. So, where do you get samples from for your genetic analysis?
after: We might get two or three dead sharks washed up in Ireland a year, if we're kind of lucky. Another source would be fisheries' bycatch.
ru: Мёртвые акулы — один из таких источников. Их выносит на берег. В Ирландии их может быть 2-3 в год,

quote: Official sources claimed four such hideouts were demolished.
before: In a separate incident, eleven suspected insurgents died when security forces, along with jets and helicopters, raided their hideouts.

quote: The storm might re-intensify once it moves over open waters of the South China Sea.
That has got to be the closest thing to going into space that you can do.
before: Built like a spacecraft, it's designed to explore the deepest depths of the ocean. And I'm lucky enough to have hitched a ride down to the sea floor, two kilometres beneath the surface.
after: And, given that I'm not going to go into space any time soon, I think it's the next best thing. See you in eight hours.
ru: Совершая подобное погружение, вы как бы отправляетесь в космос, оставаясь при этом на Земле.

quote: Understanding the nature of wormholes is gonna lead to new forms of space travel.
before: A little nervous. I know I can't use the bridge to go back, but there's something poetic about using a relic from the past to explore the future.
after: This ia first step. Here's to innovation.
ru: Понимание природы червоточин приведет к новым формам космических путешествий.

quote: That was my space and you know it.
before: Hey, who are you calling a clown, bucket list? I see you two have already met.
after: Tell it to my car. You know where to find it.
ru: Место на парковке было моим, и ты об этом знаешь.

quote: Lately, time and space has been the master of me.
before: I am the master of time and space. Well, I was.
after: Oh, is that my brain scan? - No.
ru: Потом, время и пространство стало управлять мной

quote: I'm not talking about space travel, merely about humanity's metaphorical journey into the future.
before: (Laughter) And there was total disagreement about what the role of humans should be, even at the most basic level, so let's take a closer look at possible futures that we might choose to steer toward, alright? So don't get me wrong here.
after: So one option that some of my AI colleagues like is to build superintelligence and keep it under human control, like an enslaved god, disconnected from the internet and used to create unimaginable technology and wealth for whoever controls it. But Lord Acton warned us that power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely, so you might worry that maybe we humans just aren't smart enough, or wise enough rather, to handle this much power.
ru: Я не говорю о космическом путешествии, не просто о метафорическом путешествии человечества в будущее.

quote: We created a space called the Young Girls Transformative Project.
before: Several years ago, a few friends of mine decided we needed to bridge the disconnect between our generation and the generation of young women. It's not enough to say you have two Nobel laureates from the Republic of Liberia when your girls' kids are totally out there and no hope, or seemingly no hope.
after: We go into rural communities and all we do, like has been done in this room, is create the space. When these girls sit, you unlock intelligence, you unlock passion, you unlock commitment, you unlock focus, you unlock great leaders.
ru: Мы создали место под названием «Преобразования для молодых девушек».

quote: I mean, a bird needs space to fly.
before: So I said, now it's okay. The room is too small.
after: It will go perfectly on the day of the walk. Now comes the day of the walk.
ru: Птице же нужно место, чтобы летать.

quote: Kopra's injury comes amidst technical troubles with Space Shuttle Discoverys external fuel tank.
after: While technicians work to solve the problems with the fuel tank, the rest of the STS-133 crew continue to train for their mission at the Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas.

quote: Let us remember that the teachers were not Hebrew speakers.
before: Because the Hebrew you speak, which you call Israeli, which seems a sensible idea, presumably was not the same as the one that was being developed? They were taught in the best Hebrew, which was available for their teachers.
after: Wasn't their first language. It was not their first language. They were not native Hebrew speakers.
ru: Нельзя забывать, их учителя не были носителями этого языка.

quote: And as your keynote speaker, I have prepared a few words.
before: Rogelio: Okay, stop it, stop it, it's not cheesy. And I think Rafael is right to want to mark this extraordinary occasion of Jane's graduation.
after: (Clears throat) Jane, it is an honor and a privilege for me to be here today. It's a moment that I've waited for the two-and-a-half months I've known you.
ru: И как главный оратор, я подготвил пару слов.

quote: Like when your cell phone rings and it makes your speakers buzz.
before: - Interference? - Yeah.
after: It's usually caused by poorly set-up equipment, so when I heard it for the first time a few weeks ago I just made a note to myself to talk to the station technicians, but then I realized something. Listen.
ru: Как когда звонит мобильник и колонки начинают фонить.

quote: Hotter than the pair of speakers I bought today off the back of a truck.
before: Behold, your fondue. But please, wait 30 minutes before eating, for it is far too hot for human consumption.
after: Hotter than three rats fornicating in a wool sock. Hotter than the burning flesh of Shel Silverstein in hell.
ru: С пылу, с жару, как те ворованные колонки, которые я сегодня приобрёл у наркоманов.

quote: And yet, performance anxiety also haunts public speakers, contestants in spelling bees, and even world-famous musicians.
before: That competitor just experienced the phenomenon known as " choking, " where despite months, even years, of practice, a person fails right when it matters most. Choking is common in sports, where performance often occurs under intense pressure and depends on key moments.
after: Most people intuitively blame it on their nerves, but why does being nervous undermine expert performance? There are two sets of theories, which both say that primarily, choking under pressure boils down to focus.
ru: Однако страх сцены также присущ ораторам, участникам различных викторин и даже всемирно известным музыкантам.

quote: So here are three speakers of the English language.
before: In his way, he speaks English as well. (Laughter) And here is Ms. Kardashian, and she is an English speaker, too.
after: What worldview do those three people have in common? What worldview is shaped through the English language that unites them?
ru: Итак, перед нами три носителя английского языка.

quote: However, this new generation of Cornish speakers was scattered across Cornwall and unable to use the language freely.
before: In the 1900s, Cornish activists fought for their culture. The language had been dormant for over 100 years, but they used old books and plays to teach it to their children.
after: By the 1990s, Cornish had reawakened, but it wasn't thriving. Then, in the early 2000s, Cornish speakers found one another online and leveraged digital spaces to speak on a daily basis.
ru: Однако это поколение носителей корнского языка было разбросано по Корнуоллу и не могло свободно использовать язык.

quote: National MP Lockwood Smith was unanimously elected Speaker.
before: The members were formally sworn in, and the National Party took control of the government benches.

quote: Try not to be bitter on Lola's special day.
before: They've spared no expense for Lola's wedding. Bares no resemblance to mine.
after: Kenna, Greer, I found you! Look at this necklace Julien just gave me.
ru: Попытайся быть менее печальной в такой особенный день для Лолы.

quote: Welcome to this very special rush evening of the new and improved Kappa Kappa Tau.
before: Red... Devil! _
after: I'm Zayday Williams, president, and this is my vice president, Grace Gardner. We would also like to thank Dean Munsch for allowing us to have a winter semester rush this year.
ru: Добро пожаловать на этот особенный вечер нового и улучшенного Каппа Каппа Тау.

quote: I'll be turning this briefing over to Lieutenant Lao of the special operations division of IA.
before: Any questions? Good.
after: What we discuss here must remain absolutely confidential. - Go ahead.
ru: Я передам этот инструктаж лейтенанту Лао из отдела специальных операций ОВР.

quote: This is my partner, Special Agent Tim McGee.
before: Hi. Uh, I'm Very Special Agent Anthony DiNozzo.
after: We're looking for... Me.
ru: Это мой напарник - специальный агент Тим МакГи.

quote: What is so special about the human brain?
after: Why is it that we study other animals instead of them studying us? What does a human brain have or do that no other brain does?
ru: Что же такого особенного в человеческом мозге?

quote: In the case of artwork, the history is special indeed.
before: That's not because, or it's not simply because, I'm a snob and want to boast about having an original. Rather, it's because I want something that has a specific history.
after: The philosopher Denis Dutton in his wonderful book " The Art Instinct " makes the case that, " The value of an artwork is rooted in assumptions about the human performance underlying its creation. " And that could explain the difference between an original and a forgery.
ru: С произведением искусства, история действительно особенная.

quote: So did we have a special tool? No.
before: Everyone was trying to figure out how this was possible. I thought it was luck, but after each new discovery, that became less and less likely.
after: Did we have a killer application that no one else had? No.
ru: Был ли у нас какой-то специальный инструмент?

quote: Rowling was released today to hundreds of special midnight parties at bookstores.
before: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince by J.K.
after: The book is expected to sell tens of thousands of copies in the first hour, and the waves of fans just keep on coming. As midnight spreads across the Atlantic and the North American continent, more and more stores will start selling.

quote: Doctor's too busy covering his ass to say anything more specific.
before: Was that it? Well, I think so.
after: Listen, Kate, I really appreciate you keeping me company on the way. Oh, sure, sure, I was more than happy to do that.
ru: Доктор слишком занят, чтобы сказать, что-то более конкретное.

quote: This is very broad, and it's not truly specific to exactly what you had done.
before: If they don't make money, why do you bring them in? Here is some literature just on the procedure you had.
after: You want to make sure you continue to eat well, but things to look out for that you would need to call your doctor is if you notice any separation. So it sometimes takes a little while for the body to process all that you've received.
ru: Они очень общие, не совсем конкретно о том, что у вас.

quote: Did he mention a specific area within the airport?
before: In the meantime, I want to review your encounter with Aziz. Whatever you need.
after: I think I would've said, Saul. Any indication the weapon might be arriving on an incoming flight?
ru: Он называл конкретное место в аэропорту?

quote: You're gonna have to be a bit more specific.
before: Killed him? I've killed lots of people.
after: What the hell happened to you? I really don't know.
ru: Тебе следует выражаться конкретнее.

quote: In math and science, symmetry has a different, and very specific, meaning.
before: If you are artistically inclined, you might think of the subtle modulations of a Mozart concerto, or the effortless poise of a prima ballerina. When used in every day life, the word symmetry represents vague notions of beauty, harmony and balance.
after: In this technical sense, a symmetry is the property of an object. Pretty much any type of object can have symmetry, from tangible things like butterflies, to abstract entities like geometric shapes.
ru: В математике и естественных науках, симметрия имеет другое, очень конкретное значение.

quote: But why do these gases absorb specific colors of light?
before: Before reaching our eyes, different gases absorbed those specific parts of the spectrum. For example, oxygen gas snatched up some of the dark red light, and sodium grabbed two bands of yellow.
after: This is where we enter the quantum realm. Every atom and molecule has a set number of possible energy levels for its electrons.
ru: Но почему же эти газы поглощают свет определённого цвета?

quote: He was convinced that each organ had a specific function.
before: Eventually, he would leave the arena to become the personal physician to four Roman Emperors. While his peers debated symptoms and their origins, Galen obsessively studied anatomy.
after: Since the Roman government largely prohibited working with human cadavers, Galen conducted countless dissections of animals instead. Even with this constraint, his exhaustive investigations yielded some remarkably accurate conclusions.
ru: По его убеждению, каждый орган отвечал за определённую функцию.

quote: In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
before: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters. Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process.

quote: That comes later, when Theo's brother gives his speech.
before: Is that some kind of joke? This isn't a time for humor, Francine.
after: "...the-the only two words you need to know as a husband are: 'Yes, dear.'" I'm not joking, Stan!
ru: Оно придет позже, когда брат Тео будет произносить речь.

quote: He wants to sit down with you before he gives his speech.
before: No, don't take it from me. Talk to the Vice-President yourself.
after: Now? I suggested that you might have some policy ideas for him.
ru: Он хочет встретиться с тобой до того, как произнесет речь.

quote: She said you gave a nice speech, though.
before: Oh, that's right. You haven't talked to her since the funeral.
after: Yeah. Nice speech.
ru: Она сказала, вы произнесли хорошую речь.

quote: The cameras are all trained on the plaza outside where the president's giving his speech.
before: Plaza team, what's your status? Plaza's clear.
after: Whatever's going down, that's where it'll happen. That's where we need to be.
ru: Все камеры обращены на площадь. снаружи здания, где президент выступает с речью.

quote: Until today, writing always had a much more restricted and private use than speech.
before: Institutions have always been the ones to establish the rules and propose changes. Why do I say this is a particularly appropriate moment?
after: But in our time, the age of social networks, this is going through a revolutionary change. Never before have people written so much; never before have people written for so many others to see.
ru: До настоящего времени письменная речь всегда подчинялась более строгим правилам, чем устная.

quote: And this is an interactive installation which presents the fiction that speech casts visible shadows.
before: So it occurred to me, what happens if we could run these backwards? And thus was born the project called Remark, which is a collaboration with Zachary Lieberman and the Ars Electronica Futurelab.
after: So the idea is you step into a kind of a magic light. And as you do, you see the shadows of your own speech.
ru: Этa интерактивная установка создаёт ощущение, будто речь производит видимые тени.

quote: It was such a great speech that the Athenian law courts let him off.
before: They won enumerable victories, but no one remembers what they are because they were all fought for selfish ends. The one battle that the Spartans fought that everybody remembers is the the battle of Thermopylae where they were butchered to a man, but fought for the freedom of Greece. "
after: He lived for another 10 years, then the Macedonian faction caught up with him. They cut out his tongue in mockery of his oratory, and no one knows what they did with his body.
ru: Эта речь так потрясла Афинский суд, что Гиперид был освобождён.

quote: Jimmy Wales gave a speech titled Freedom of speech, human rights, and free culture.
after: In his speech he made a comparison between the Freedom House rating with the size of the Wikipedia in that language. He found a link between the two in the cases he examined.

quote: I've always been taught to favor accuracy over speed.
before: Your conviction is admirable. But you can't possibly think you're faster than me.
after: Bull's-eye. Air supply terminated.
ru: Меня всегда учили ценить точность превыше скорости.

quote: Instead, let's say it gets close, just shy of that ultimate speed.
before: To approach the speed of light means circling the Earth pretty fast. Seven times a second. But no matter how much power the train has, it can never quite reach the speed of light, since the laws of physics forbid it.
after: Now something extraordinary happens. Time starts flowing slowly on board, relative to the rest of the world.
ru: Вместо этого, положим, что скорость поезда стала почти равна скорости света.

quote: He's gotta keep the train at top speed so they can't get off.
before: Okay that's it, we're stopping. - Frank, this is George, we gotta... - Give me that!
after: So tell him to keep it floored. I will do no such thing. Okay then here, hold this?
ru: Дай сюда! Ему нужно держать предельную скорость, чтобы они не смогли слезьть.

quote: Donald Campbell's heroic attempt at the speed record on Coniston Water ended in tragedy.
before: We are also of a view that further investigation into other, extraneous, matters would not be in the national interest. To which end, all investigative materials relating to Blenheim Vale Boy's Home are to be sealed for 50 years.
after: Upstairs. All change.
ru: Героическая попытка Дональда Кэмпбелла установить рекорд скорости на Конистон Вотер, закончилась трагедией.

quote: It can run the same speed without even that segment.
before: Without a foot, here's what it does. It doesn't even slow down.
after: No problem for the cockroach — they can grow them back, if you care. How do they do it?
ru: Он может бежать с той же скоростью и без сегмента лапы.

quote: That's the speed of the destruction that we are having.
before: That was when we shifted from deforestation of temperate forests to deforestation of tropical forests. So think of this: In 100 years, we lost the same amount of forest in the tropics that we lost in 2,000 years in temperate forests.
after: Now, Brazil is an important piece of this puzzle. We have the second largest forest in the world, just after Russia.
ru: Такова скорость уничтожения в наши дни.

quote: Because this only affects the surface, the waves are limited in size and speed.
before: The difference is in where this energy comes from. For normal ocean waves, it comes from wind.

after: If we do nothing to stop the problem, all of Egypt's sites will be affected by looting by 2040. Thus, we are at a tipping point.
ru: Таким образом, мы доказали, что грабежи — это полностью экономическая проблема.

quote: He'll recognize more objects and thus understand more words.
before: His mind is based in a cloud. That means Milo's mind, as millions of people use it, will get smarter and cleverer.
after: But for me, this is a wonderful opportunity where technology, at last, can be connected with, where I am no longer restrained by the finger I hold in my hand — as far as a computer game's concerned — or by the blandness of not being noticed if you're watching a film or a book. And I love those revolutions, and I love the future that Milo brings.
ru: Он будет распознавать больше объектов и, таким образом, понимать больше слов.

quote: "They asked questions about what we were doing, thus advertising Perplex City well.".
before: She felt "it was very team building as well, as we had to work together for the entire event." She noted that the music was "off-putting" as they were trying to concentrate on the puzzles, but they enjoyed the music as well as interesting some new players!

before: Listen, we all have to go. I mean, do you realize how lucky we are to have won?
after: Well, if we were really lucky, we'd have won five. Okay, we can think of this as a problem, or we can think of it as a probletunity.
ru: У Донахью может и новая машина, зато Хеки выиграли четыре билета до Нью-Йорка.

quote: My husband bought tickets to the opera this weekend.
before: Also, I'll need an extension. My parents are coming to town and they're very needy.
after: I mean, normally, I love the opera, but I got to tell you, it's been a hell of a week, and the thought of sitting in a dimly lit room with a bunch of people singing at me in Italian... it's just gonna make me fall asleep. I'm so sorry.
ru: Мой муж купил билеты в оперу на выходные

quote: And we still have her bus ticket into town.
before: I've requested call logs. Texts will take longer to retrieve.
after: We know she went into town but we don't know why. So that is your first point of call.
ru: И у нас её автобусный билет в город.

quote: But we'll pay our tickets like everyone else.
before: - Why, you can't? We'll come to cheer for you.
after: If I win the next bout, I'll treat you two to some katsudon. I'll have to!
ru: Но мы заплатим за билеты как и все остальные зрители.

quote: They call them Fast Track or VIP tickets.
before: If you go to an amusement park and don't want to stand in the long lines for the popular rides, there is now a solution. In many theme parks, you can pay extra to jump to the head of the line.
after: And this isn't only happening in amusement parks. In Washington, D.C., long lines, queues sometimes form for important Congressional hearings.
ru: Это называется экспресс- или VIP-билетами.

quote: And you can go there every night for free, no ticket needed.
before: (Applause) Thank you. ... hinting towards a future which should be energy friendly and linking up the local grounds as Van Gogh literally walked and lived there in 1883.
after: People experience the beauty of cycling through the starry night, thinking about green energy and safety. I want to create places where people feel connected again.
ru: И вы можете ездить там каждый вечер бесплатно, без всяких билетов.

quote: Sometimes we actually buy ourselves a second-class ticket to travel our social universe.
before: And you're creating that randomness, that luck that is going to cause you to widen your travels, through your social universe. But in fact, there's more to it than that.
after: We are not courageous when we reach out to people. Let me give you an example of that.
ru: Бывает, что когда мы отправляемся в путешествие по социальным мирам, мы покупаем себе билет в вагон второго класса.

quote: Apparently before he was "missing", he bought a one-way ticket to Australia.
before: Investigators in the Sheriff's Office were able to track him down to Cairns, Queensland.
after: Bryan Butas, the missing hiker, apparently had been under a great deal of stress and "got sick of it all", according to a telephone interview by the Associated Press.

quote: Oh, this stupid shoe has been hurting me all this time.
before: So what do we do? Let's wait a bit?
after: So what is it? The stupid coin!
ru: Да что за подкова в этом дурацком ботинке мне всё время мешает?

quote: Probably spent more time with him than his own parents.
before: Six years ago, I was a nanny in Honolulu for this beautiful two-year-old boy. I loved him.
after: One day I was in the park talking with another nanny. He wandered out of the sandbox into the street, into the path of a moving car.
ru: Пожалуй, проводила с ним больше времени, чем его собственные родители.

quote: If things work all the time, it means we can't make them better.
before: These are the opening times for Sea World. You know, this is good.
after: We have a saying here at Clovis. Dare to fail.
ru: Если бы вещи всё время работали, мы бы не смогли делать их лучше.

quote: Well, some of them, but, you know, I have a lot more free time now.
before: I was a high school English teacher for 41 years, but budget cuts-- I was pushed into retirement. I miss the students.
after: I'm actually learning to knit. Indeed.
ru: Ну, по некоторым из них, но у меня сейчас больше свободного времени.

quote: It took me some time to come to my senses.
before: She was a single woman about to go alone into a country, not even speaking the language, to travel alone by bus and boat to go to a beach she did not know or had never seen. I loved her, and then she went out into that strange, alien land.
after: I had my own " lost time " moment, where I woke up and suddenly realized it was very late in the day, almost dinnertime, and she had not come back. Nervous, I went down to the street to look for her.
ru: Потребовалось время, чтобы я пришёл в себя.

quote: For a long time, there was me, and my body.
after: Me was composed of stories, of cravings, of strivings, of desires of the future. Me was trying not to be an outcome of my violent past, but the separation that had already occurred between me and my body was a pretty significant outcome.
ru: В течении долгого времени существовали я и мое тело.

quote: That gives us a time series of how frequently this particular sentence was used over time.
before: It's four words; we call that a four-gram. We're going to tell you how many times a particular four-gram appeared in books in 1801, 1802, 1803, all the way up to 2008.
after: We do that for all the words and phrases that appear in those books, and that gives us a big table of two billion lines that tell us about the way culture has been changing. ELA: So those two billion lines, we call them two billion n-grams.
ru: Это даст временной ряд частоты использования именно этой фразы с течением времени.

quote: Kimi Räikkönen (Ferrari) won the first session, but showed third time in the third.
after: Robert Kubica and Nick Heidfeld (BMW Sauber) will be split by Heikki Kovalainen (McLaren) on the starting grid tomorrow.

quote: Wait, are they, are they the angry eye ones or the tired eye ones?
before: Holy crap, you speak Ebonics? No, no, Peter, it's Japanese.
after: Uh, I-I'm not sure I underst-- Uh, the first one, I guess.
ru: Стой, это какие, со злобными глазками или уставшими глазками?

quote: That's why they were always tired and hungry and poor.
before: I was their All-American girl. That's why they sacrificed.
after: But, that was okay, because their daughter was an American. There's nothing for me in Honduras.
ru: Поэтому они всегда были уставшими, голодными и бедными.

quote: I don't understand. What do you mean tired?
before: Mrs Hughes is very tired. I wonder if it might be possible for you to divert some of her work my way?
after: Cora... Carson?
ru: Я не понимаю, что значит "устала"?

quote: I don't care, though. I'm too tired to make a decision.
before: I don't even know what that is. Well, it sounds disgusting.
after: Well, at least you got a decision to make. - Oh, yeah?
ru: Хотя, мне все равно.Я слишком устала, чтобы что-то выбирать.

quote: I wrote it because I was tired of pretending I was all right when I wasn't.
before: I wrote this piece a year ago. It's a composite of my story and other women I know.
after: I was tired of faking normal. I wasn't seeing myself in the popular press.
ru: Я написала её, потому что устала делать вид, будто всё в порядке, когда на самом деле это было не так.

quote: And I call this strategy the "I'm tired of your foot on my neck" strategy.
before: This was a protest campaign against Montgomery, Alabama's segregation on their public transit system, and it began when a woman named Rosa Parks refused to give up her seat to a white person. The campaign lasted a year, and it galvanized the civil rights movement like nothing had before it.
after: So gays and lesbians have been in society since societies began, but up until the mid-20th century, homosexual acts were still illegal in most states. So just 14 years after the Montgomery bus boycott, a group of LGBT folks took that same strategy.
ru: Я называю эту стратегию «Я устал от твоей ноги на моей шее».

quote: To watch them move is a dance I'm never going to get tired of.
before: And you can't tell the story about pollinators — bees, bats, hummingbirds, butterflies — without telling the story about the invention of flowers and how they co-evolved over 50 million years. I've been filming time-lapse flowers 24 hours a day, seven days a week, for over 35 years.
after: It fills me with wonder, and it opens my heart. Beauty and seduction, I believe, is nature's tool for survival, because we will protect what we fall in love with.
ru: Я никогда не устаю смотреть, как они движутся в неведомом танце.

quote: "I'm pretty tired, actually," said Kevin Vallely, calling from Patriot Hills, Antarctica.
before: The trio were waiting out a storm before boarding a flight to Chile for Ottawa.
after: During the saga, Vallely was solely burdened with carrying the high-tech gear in his sled consisting of video cameras, satellite phones, hand-held computers, different kinds of solar panels, batteries and wires chargers. "Had we not brought all that stuff we probably would have got it done faster because we wouldn't have had to carry all that weight, but then it doesn't matter as much," he explained.

quote: Sounds like one of those job titles that only exists in cheesy tv shows.
before: This is my partner Juliet O'Hara and... Eh. Criminal profiler, huh?
after: No argument here. What is it that you do?
ru: Звучит похоже на одно из тех названий должностей которые существуют только в низкосортных тв-шоу.

quote: Right now it's "Midnight snack" is the title, the working title.
before: That's amazing. Is it titled?
after: I mean, you know, there's lots of titles. Um, it's really great to hear from you.
ru: На данный момент: "Полуночные закуски", рабочее название.

quote: And I suppose a nice raise comes along with a new title.
before: It would. I would be the network administrator managing the sales of the time, the hardware upkeep.
after: No raise. Let me show you that it works first.
ru: И, я полагаю, к новому званию прилагается повышение в зарплате.

quote: The original title of this was "a lively fisting".

after: But{\, you know,} they had to change it. For obvious reasons.
ru: Оригинальное название было "глубокий фистинг"

quote: Notice the title of the book, "The Book That Was Never Checked Out: Titanic."
before: You just point a camera at a class, and it always looks like this. So this is one of the books that they do.
after: And the first line of that book is, " Once there was a book named Cindy that was about the Titanic. " So, meanwhile, there's an adult in the back typing this up, taking it completely seriously, which blows their mind.
ru: Обратите внимание на заголовок книги, "Книга, которую никто никогда не брал в библиотеке: Титаник"

quote: And if the title "Searching for Armillaria Death Rings," sounds ominous, it is.
before: I think that really puts human lifespans into a different perspective. And what you're looking at here is an aerial photo take over eastern Oregon.
after: The Armillaria is actually a predatory fungus, killing certain species of trees in the forest. It's also more benignly known as the honey mushroom or the " humongous fungus " because it happens to be one of the world's largest organisms as well.
ru: И если заголовок «Поиски смертельных кругов Армиллярии» звучит угрожающе, это действительно так.

quote: The title is "The Power of Movement in Plants."
before: How is it possible to do this without a brain? We need to wait until 1880, when this big man, Charles Darwin, publishes a wonderful, astonishing book that starts a revolution.
after: No one was allowed to speak about movement in plants before Charles Darwin. In his book, assisted by his son, Francis — who was the first professor of plant physiology in the world, in Cambridge — they took into consideration every single movement for 500 pages.
ru: Её название -- "Способность к движению у растений".

quote: And which title: Female Grand Master or International Master gave you more joy?
before: Tell me about the time you got the title "International Master".

after: If you cut off my head, I forgive you. But perhaps you've transcended your violent history...
ru: Я научился принимать всех божьих созданий.

after: I don't know. But while Condé was away, he met with Protestant leaders who were furious with you for sending troops to Scotland.
ru: Его принимают при дворе, у него защита Марии, все, что он хочет.

quote: Okay, the defendant has admitted his guilt, and I accept his plea.
before: - With your bare hands? - Yes, your honor.
after: Let's move on to the impact statement. I understand that the victim's wife and parents are here.
ru: Хорошо, обвиняемый признал свою вину, и я принимаю его признание.

quote: And yet you accept the meeting invitation, and you go.
before: But there's no agenda. There's no information about why you were invited to the meeting.
after: And when this highly unproductive session is over, you go back to your desk, and you stand at your desk and you say, " Boy, I wish I had those two hours back, like I wish I had my chair back. " (Laughter) Every day, we allow our coworkers, who are otherwise very, very nice people, to steal from us.
ru: И всё же вы принимаете приглашение, и вы идёте.

quote: It was total nonsense, and I refused to accept that punishment.
before: That means I had to go 600 miles away from my hometown to the River Ganges to take a holy dip. And after that, I should organize a feast for priests, 101 priests, wash their feet and drink that water.
after: How did they punish me? I was barred from entering into my own kitchen and my own dining room, my utensils were separated.
ru: Это было абсолютной чушью, и я отказался принимать такое наказание.

after: Well because they don't know that it was different. And in fact, lots of people, scientists, will contest that it was really different.
ru: Вопрос вот в чём, почему люди это принимают?

How do you plan on accomplishing that?
before: Now that was an awfully big threat. Destroy everyone's happiness?
after: The dark curse. Are you sure, your majesty?

ru: За следующие тридцать дней необходимо выполнить объем работ, на который нужно втрое больше.

after: They have to move an arm in three dimensions. But each monkey is only getting the two dimensions on the video screen that the monkey controls.
ru: Они получают визуальную информацию в двухмерном пространстве, но выполнить задание они должны в трёхмерном пространстве.

quote: You have a group of people trying to accomplish a mission greater than themselves; it's not about you.
before: I saw my friends battling these circumstances, and I watched the anxiety it produced in them and me, not being able to express our feelings about it. The military and theater communities are actually very similar.
after: You have a role, you have to know your role within that team. Every team has a leader or director; sometimes they're smart, sometimes they're not.
ru: У вас есть группа людей, пытающихся выполнить миссию, которая важнее, чем они сами, это не ради себя.

quote: So hopefully, you can accomplish your dreams as well, with this outlook.
before: (Video) ♫ Spider-Man theme song ♫ (Applause) Thank you. All right, all right, so — That was pretty cool, and so I was able to accomplish my dream of playing snare drum with the marching band, as I believe I can do for all of my dreams.
after: The next aspect to my philosophy is that I surround myself with people I want to be with, people of high quality. I’ m extremely lucky to have an amazing family, who have always supported me throughout my entire life.
ru: Итак, надеюсь, что вы также сможете осуществить свою мечту, с такой установкой.

quote: Working with local partners would be an option to accomplish this, according to Coonen.
before: The change will not affect existing customers dramatically, says Coonen: "We are going to inform them of the new status, and they will have to accept our terms of service again." He also said that for now, there were no plans to use the new licence to offer traditional banking services, but the possibility was being evaluated by PayPal.

quote: Achieving goals, mastering skills, the opponent isn't the other team, it's really just yourself.
before: Alright, look... we're gonna throw a net over the entire tri-county area to find our number one suspect. We might be dealing with a madman here, a bonafide deranged killer.
after: And if you've worked hard, and done the absolute best that you can, then no matter what the scoreboard says, you are the winner in the game of life. You can hold your head high...
ru: Достигайте целей, улучшайте свои навыки, ваш настоящий противник - это не не другая команда, а вы сами.

before: You couldn't do it because of "viking quest." You coulda shot around me!
after: No, I-I know that. Do you think I'd have a super bowl ring. If I listened to everybody who told me I was too short?
ru: То, что ты невысокий не означает, что ты не можешь достигать своих целей, И.

before: Gets the job done. You should know some things about me.
after: So if I were you, I would exercise some... caution. - And if I were you, I'd do the same.
ru: Моё руководство интересуют результаты, но они не меньше озабочены тем, как я их достигаю.

quote: Let's discuss your best outcome here and how I can help you achieve it.
before: It's impossible. So let's talk about what you really want.
after: You talk this much in bed? You this... chatty on your hands and knees?
ru: Давай обсудим твою выгоду в этом деле, и то, чем я могу помочь, чтобы ее добиться.

quote: These problems still seem very daunting and very intractable, and any solutions we're achieving are small solutions.
before: The awkward reality is we're not making fast enough progress. We're not winning.
after: We're making incremental progress. What's the fundamental problem we have in dealing with these social problems?
ru: Эти проблемы всё ещё кажутся очень устрашающими и очень неподатливыми, и любые решения, которых мы достигаем — это малые решения.

quote: That can only be achieved through debate, critical conversation and insisting on dialogue that doesn't demonize people.
before: They have formed me as a democratic citizen and a bridge builder. If you want to prevent hate and violence, we have to talk to as many people as possible for as long as possible while being as open as possible.
after: I'm going to ask you a question. I invite you to think about it when you get home and in the coming days, but you have to be honest with yourself.
ru: Этого можно добиться только путём дискуссии, ответственного разговора, такого, при котором никто не очернял бы других людей.

quote: Weightfully this self which weighed upon me, the release from which is what I desire and what I achieve.
before: Weightfully upon me was the world. Weightfully this self which graced the world yet never wholly itself.
after: And the girl remembers, in this infinite instant already now so many times divided, the sadness she felt once, hardly knowing she felt it, to merely inhabit herself. Yes, the girl falls, absurd to fall, even the earth with its compulsion to take unto itself all that falls must know that falling is absurd, yet the girl falling isn't myself, or she is myself, but a self I took of my own volition unto myself.
ru: Весома эта оболочка, которая давит на меня, избавление от которой - это то, чего я желаю и чего я достигаю.

quote: It aims to achieve this by regulating federal activity in the habitat of threatened species.
before: The purpose of the Endangered Species Act is to protect species that may be in danger of extinction as a result of human action.
after: Commercial activity is not directly regulated, but companies must receive a permit for development in designated habitats.

quote: Okay, now please just sign here acknowledging that you understand the rules.
before: Don't stand too close to the glass. And if you need any help, just press the red button on the wall behind you.
after: I feel like I'm signing my life away. Well, let's hope not.
ru: Хорошо, теперь распишитесь здесь в том, что вы подтверждаете, что понимаете правила.

quote: The act of acknowledging your sins is terrifying.
before: But I've seen a lot of people suffer. And when they do, it causes them... to look at who they'll be when they die.
after: But I've learned that it's better to be honestly unhappy than dishonestly so. Oh. Well...
ru: Признаваться в своих грехах - страшно.

quote: Because you barely acknowledged me on my last day at work.
before: Okay, are you... are you mad at me? Or something?
after: Did I hurt your feelings by not telling you personally - that I was sick?
ru: Потому что ты едва признавал меня в мой последний рабочий день.

before: She's gone to the forest of Estate to find the Druids I told you not to get involved
after: For good reason! No, you don't understand.
ru: Ты даже не признавал, что она владеет магией.

quote: We refuse to even acknowledge that women who have sex with women or women who don't want children even exist.
before: (Applause) Pregnant women are not faceless, identity-less vessels of reproduction who can't stand on their own two feet. But the truth is, the real secret is, we tell all women that their sexual pleasure doesn't matter.
after: " Oh, it's just a phase... she just needs the right man to come along. "
ru: Мы не хотим даже признавать существование женщин, которые занимаются сексом с женщинами или не хотят иметь детей.

quote: And demand that the people who teach you acknowledge them and celebrate them too.
before: Be proud that you have them. Celebrate them.
after: That's one thing we can do. I don't know how many of you remember this: another moral hero, 15 years ago, Aaron Feuerstein, who was the head of Malden Mills in Massachusetts — they made Polartec — The factory burned down.
ru: И требуйте от своих учителей, чтобы они их признавали и славили.

quote: They acknowledged her limitations, but they also saw her strengths, and they celebrated her for who she was.
before: They didn't focus on all that was wrong with my kid. They didn't see her differences as problems to fix.
after: Their goal wasn't to make Fiona as normal as possible; their goal was simply to help her be as independent as possible so that she could fulfill her potential, however that looked for her. But the culture at large does not take this open attitude about disabilities.
ru: Они признавали её ограничения, но видели и сильные стороны, и принимали её такой, какая она есть.

after: He was a tough old guy. It takes a lot to accept that; it takes a very strong person.

quote: But you did acquire ownership of state utilities in rigged auctions, right?
before: ~ They accuse you of fraud... ~ Trumped-up charges.
after: Oil and gas companies worth billions of dollars. It was all perfectly legal.

before: The fool can't even separate his recycling. " But the perhaps surprising but overwhelming and compelling evidence from all these modern examples is that it does work.

ru: Дайте человеку ответственность, и он будет действовать ответственно.

after: Okay, we have to be careful. We can't let on that we know anything and blow our cover.

quote: I believed you, I trusted you, and you made me look a complete fool.
before: Please accept my apology. Accepted.
after: I know it didn't go to plan... "Didn't go to plan"?
ru: Я верил тебе, я доверял тебе, а ты сделал так, чтобы я выглядел как полный идиот.

quote: A lot of people with CP don't walk, but my parents didn't believe in "can't."
before: I have always loved the fact that my hood and my affliction share the same initials. I also love the fact that if I wanted to walk from my house to New York City, I could.
after: My father's mantra was, " You can do it, yes you can can. " (Laughter) So, if my three older sisters were mopping, I was mopping.
ru: Много людей с церебральным параличом не ходят, но мои родители не верили в «не могу».

quote: Now, you may not believe in ancient sayings.
before: And the cosmetic companies are already using it to make regenerating cream. Now, there is an ancient saying that for every disease known to mankind, there is a plant to cure it.
after: You may think they're obsolete now that our science and technology are so powerful. So you may look on Centella as being an insignificant, humble weed, which, if destroyed, won't be missed.
ru: Вы можете не верить в народную мудрость.

quote: Many of us, nowadays, seem to believe that a happy future is something impossible to achieve.
before: We don’ t think about it often, but everything is connected, and we need to restore our connections to a healthy state. Even the harsh judgment I hold in my heart against my brother or my sister, the open wound that was never cured, the offense that was never forgiven, the rancor that is only going to hurt me, are all instances of a fight that I carry within me, a flare deep in my heart that needs to be extinguished before it goes up in flames, leaving only ashes behind.
after: While such concerns must be taken very seriously, they are not invincible. They can be overcome when we don't lock our door to the outside world.
ru: Сегодня по разным причинам многие, похоже, перестали верить в возможность счастливого будущего.

quote: One of the children is believed to be two months old.
before: It is believed that the group consists of a union activist, his wife and four children.

quote: What would it take to make Al-Jahwar realize that Orisia and Sarifan belong to South Kharun?
before: - Bye. What would it take for you to leave Orisia?
after: I know you feel that Orisia belongs to you. But the hostilities in this area are threatening the peace process.
ru: Что потребуется, чтобы заставить Аль-Джавара понять - Что Орисия и Сарифан принадлежат Южному Каруну?

quote: Yeah, well, guy it belonged to was beat up and old, too.
before: I found it. It was so beat up and old, I almost tossed it.
after: But I was very close with him, and I'd, uh, I'd hate to lose it. I'll get it for you.
ru: Фляжка принадлежала старому, видавшему виды человеку.

quote: And we think it could belong to the killer.
before: So what am I looking at? Well, we found this on your property along with the skeletal remains.
after: Okay. Does it look familiar?
ru: И мы думаем, что это может принадлежать убийце.

quote: Or it could belong to a 5-day-old infant.
before: That's not good. Could be our victim's.
after: Okay, if we are looking at a double homicide involving a newborn, we need to find out about it as soon as possible. I want canine units to cover the entire pipeline.
ru: А может принадлежать младенцу пяти дней от роду.

quote: They say leadership is about creating a world to which people want to belong.
before: The leaders focus on building a sense of community and building those three capabilities. How do they define leadership?
after: What kind of world do people want to belong in at Pixar? A world where you're living at the frontier.
ru: Они говорят, что управление — это создание мира, к которому люди хотят принадлежать.

quote: One day, this ring that belonged to my grandfather will pass to my son, Charlie.
before: I come at this question not as a green campaigner, in fact, I confess to be rather hopeless at recycling. I come at it as a professional observer of financial policy making and someone that wonders how history will judge us.
after: And I wonder what his generation and perhaps the one that follows will make of the two lives this ring has worked. My grandfather was a coal miner.
ru: Однажды это кольцо, принадлежавшее моему отцу, перейдёт к моему сыну Чарли.

quote: So instead, someone went to where that gold was being stored and they just labeled it as belonging to France now.
before: In 1932, the Bank of France asked the United States to convert their holdings from dollars into gold. But it was too inconvenient to think about actually shipping all of that gold over to Europe.
after: And everyone agreed that France owned the gold. It's just like those Rai stones.
ru: Вместо этого кто-то отправился туда, где хранилось это золото, и просто отметил его как отныне принадлежащее Франции.

quote: Ms Combo felt the visit would boost a sense of belonging amongst Leicester-South's largely Asian population.
before: In the evening, Ms Shetty travelled to the city of Leicester to meet with members of Keith Vaz' constituency. Reena Combo, editor of British Asian entertainment magazine Ikonz, was one of the guests.

quote: He takes them to a location where he binds their hands and feet with wire, then cuts their throat before dumping the bodies.
before: Here's what we got so far. The San Joaquin killer abducts young girls, all between the ages of 16 and 20.
after: Small objects found near the crime scene are placed over their eyes... pebbles, pieces of glass, and bottle caps so far. Any pattern to where the bodies were found?
ru: Отвозит их в укромное место, связывает руки и ноги проволокой, перерезает горло, а потом выбрасывает тело.

quote: We have nothing that binds us, nothing.
before: I would like you to leave me alone. Never speak to me again.
after: Avoid me, please. Uhtred Ragnarson.
ru: Нас ничто не связывает, ничто.

quote: It's like the psychic glue that binds your whole notion of existence is gone, and you become unglued.
before: Not in the sense that you... you become humble or... or... or gain some kind of perspective, but that you literally lose your sense of self. And I'm not sure anyone, unless they have gone through it, can... can... can truly understand how... profound that loss is.
after: I think, therefore I am. I think too much, therefore I am not.
ru: Это как будто духовный клей, связывающий все понятие существования, исчезает, и ты становишься расклеенным.

quote: And there's this other man, this man who's bound up with us now.
before: It has its interest. Are you listening? Pull yourself together now. You've tried our nerves enough for one day.
after: What is he doing? What is he thinking?
ru: А также, простите меня, но есть другой, этот мужчина, который теперь нас связывает.

quote: And we bind ourselves in other ways as well.
before: A constitution is something which was set up in the past that applies now in the present, and what it says is, no matter how much we might to reelect a popular president for a third term, no matter how much white Americans might choose to feel that they want to reinstate the institution of slavery, we can't. We have bound ourselves.
after: We know that when it comes to choosing somebody for a job, for an award, we are strongly biased by their race, we are biased by their gender, we are biased by how attractive they are, and sometimes we might say, " Well fine, that's the way it should be. " But other times we say, " This is wrong. "
ru: И в других ситуациях мы также связываем себе руки.

quote: Second, this layer contains molecules which bind specifically to our tumor cell.
before: It creates a cloud of water molecules around the nanoparticle that gives us an invisibility cloaking effect. This invisibility cloak allows the nanoparticle to travel through the bloodstream long and far enough to reach the tumor, without getting eliminated by the body.
after: Once bound, the cancer cell takes up the nanoparticle, and now we have our nanoparticle inside the cancer cell and ready to deploy. Alright!
ru: Во-вторых, в этом слое есть молекулы, связывающиеся исключительно с клетками опухоли.

quote: It binds us into teams that circle around sacred values but thereby makes us go blind to objective reality.
before: To understand why this is happening to us, and what we can do about it, we need to learn more about moral psychology. So I'm a social psychologist, and I study morality, and one of the most important principles of morality is that morality binds and blinds.
after: Think of it like this. Large-scale cooperation is extremely rare on this planet.
ru: Она связывает нас в команды вокруг священных ценностей, но в то же время она затмевает объективный взгляд на реальность.

quote: The proposal will be binding if the council passes it by majority vote in May.
She thinks you're Charlie, who she blamed for her sister's death.
before: That's the trigger. The white coat is the trigger.
after: I... Killed Rose... Trying to abort your baby. I know you know, and now you want to kill me.
ru: Она считает вас Чарли, которого винит в смерти сестры.

quote: You cannot blame me for not trusting my sister to tell me what's really going on.
before: Well, I would feel better hearing that from her. Every time I call Carol, she says that Charlie's just run out.
after: And Carol's crazy, but she does love her daughter. And we both agree that pushing Charlie to talk to us would be a mistake.
ru: Ты не можешь обвинять меня в недоверии к своей сестре когда она говорит, что на самом деле происходит

quote: But you can't blame a guy for trying.
before: You texted her asking if she wanted to see Mr Pecker in person? I knew she'd knock me back.
after: Karly was married. Yeah.
ru: Но нельзя обвинять просто за попытку.

quote: If anyone's to blame for her delusion, it's the Bureau itself.
before: Why does Alex Parrish, an agent that you once described as a bright star, disagree with you? Alex Parrish was one of the finest agents I've ever trained.
after: After the Grand Central bombing, we fell for Harper's plan to frame her. Turned her into a fugitive.
ru: Если кого и винить в ее заблуждении, так это само Бюро.

quote: Even worse, what if blaming the obese means we're blaming the victims?
before: So if you can be obese and not have insulin resistance, and you can be lean and have it, this suggests that obesity may just be a proxy for what's going on. So what if we're fighting the wrong war, fighting obesity rather than insulin resistance?
after: What if some of our fundamental ideas about obesity are just wrong? Personally, I can't afford the luxury of arrogance anymore, let alone the luxury of certainty.
ru: Еще хуже, что если скидывать вину на ожирение - значит во всем винить жертв?

quote: Now she blamed this on my father's side, of course.
before: I said, " What the hell are you talking about? " She then told me about our own family tree.
after: This was one of these cases, because she has no violence in her background, but my father did. Well she said, " There is good news and bad news.
ru: И, естественно, она винит во всем линию отца.

quote: What she found was many of these stories tend to blame victims and devalue their lives.
before: The Global Media Monitoring Project has found that stories by female reporters are more likely to challenge stereotypes than those by male reporters. At KUNM here in Albuquerque, Elaine Baumgartel did some graduate research on the coverage of violence against women.
after: They tend to sensationalize, and they lack context. So for her graduate work, she did a three-part series on the murder of 11 women, found buried on Albuquerque's West Mesa.
ru: И она обнаружила, что во многих этих историях винили жертв и обесценивали их жизнь.

quote: Poor funding and large class sizes are being blamed for the high drop out rates.
after: Separate OECD figures put Ireland 21st out of 27 developed countries in terms of spending per secondary level student.

quote: She found those letters and figured out what they meant and then she blackmailed my father to keep from blowing up both families.
before: Where would Ali have gotten that kind of money? Think about it.
after: I know. It's hard to believe when you say it out loud.
ru: Она нашла эти письма и поняла что они означают и тогда она шантажировала моего отца, чтобы удержать от "взрыва" обе семьи.

quote: Yeah, if you like blowing stuff up.
before: I talked to this guy who used to be like a total gamer. And now he's launching missiles off of an aircraft career. It's cool, huh?
after: I'll be in the car. See you in class, man. I gotta go find Chelsea.
ru: Да, если тебе нравится взрывать.

quote: No, as a matter of fact, I'd rather have you flying jets and blowing things up.
before: You were this close to being done with me, and being a real spy again. Why? You don't you want me here to catch you when you fall?
after: Wait here. - What about the interviews?
ru: Нет, вообще-то, я бы предпочел, чтобы ты летал и взрывал всё подряд.

quote: It got blown to hell, a bloody mess--
before: - How? Well, Tracy would kill me if she knew I was talking to you, but... she was--she was in a humvee with three other soldiers.
after: Body parts everywhere, including her leg. - The D.N.A...
ru: После взрыва, она попала в ад, в кровавое месиво

quote: But the problem was that people kept blowing everything up.
before: In Ireland the obvious choice is the military, but to be honest it actually kind of sucks. (Laughter) My mother wanted me to be a dentist.
after: So I actually went to school in Belfast, which was where all the action happened. And this was a pretty common sight.
ru: Но проблема заключалась в том, что вокруг постоянно все взрывали.

quote: I mean, here we're blowing wings off but the wing motor keeps all the way down.
before: An interesting thing is, we kill them all the time; we've never actually gotten the wings to shut off in midair. The wing motor is very resilient.
after: So, that's what I have. Thanks very much.
ru: Мы взрываем крылья, а мышцы крыльев продолжают работать.

quote: Now, when these things blow up, they're not going to do global ecological damage.
before: The one over Tunguska was probably made of rock, and that's much more crumbly, so it blew up in the air. Either way, these are tremendous explosions — 20 megatons.
after: They're not going to do something like the dinosaur killer did. They're just not big enough.
ru: Когда подобные объекты взрываются, они не приводят к экологической катастрофе.

quote: An abandoned building was also blown up in a controlled explosion.
before: Drills and exercises including training their forces in handling and firing rocket launchers and automatic rifles. They also train in "taking cover" and wear camouflage outfits.

quote: The Ministry immediately apologized and explained that the document was only brainstorming that didn't represent the political positions of the Foreign Office.
before: A further incident happened at the end of April 2010 when a British Foreign Office internal memo (attached to an official document which listed brainstormed ideas for the Pope's tour) suggested many sarcastic ideas for Benedict XVI. This included launching a condom brand marked "Benedict", or, during his visit in UK, inaugurating an abortion clinic, blessing a homosexual couple, or ordaining women as priests.
after: The Vatican answered via Benedict XVI's spokesman the Rev. F.

quote: And you'll go on just like before, breaking hearts.
before: A dark cloud on the horizon. There will be rain, but... it'll pass.
after: I can't tell you what it means to hear those words. You are my savior.
ru: И ты пойдешь дальше, как до этого, разбивая сердца.

quote: You're breaking your mother's heart.
before: Talk to me. I don't have to talk to you.
after: Why do you care so fucking much about my mother's heart, huh? That's nice.
ru: Ты разбиваешь сердце матери.

quote: And the way they represent information is they break up that data into little pieces that are represented by pulses and different neurons.
before: That's the red path that's highlighted. The way brains work, I told you all, you have got all these neurons.
after: So you have all these pieces of data distributed throughout the network. And then the way that you process that data to get a result is that you translate this pattern of activity into a new pattern of activity, just by it flowing through the network.
ru: И способ представления информации таков: все данные разбиваются на небольшие элементы, которые представляются в виде импульсов на разных нейронах.

quote: So how do we do that? Well, we break it down into a few smaller steps.
before: Can you be that specific in the detail? " And yeah, you really can.
after: So let me stretch out that equation. I start with my idea.
ru: Что ж, как мы это делаем? Мы разбиваем процесс на 4 маленьких этапа.

quote: They demystify law, break it down into simple terms, and then they help people look for a solution.
before: Community legal workers, sometimes we call them community paralegals, or barefoot lawyers, can be a bridge. These paralegals are from the communities they serve.
after: They don't focus on the courts alone. They look everywhere: ministry departments, local government, an ombudsman's office.
ru: Они проясняют законы, разбивают их на простые части, а потом помогают людям искать решение.

quote: During the trip, a group of youths started breaking everything for no apparent reason.
before: The Prosecutor ordered a preliminary inquiry into the incidents that took place onboard the Ierapetra.
after: They caused extensive damage to the passenger lounges and the bars, while they responded to the crew’s pleas with cursing. A Greek police officer was injured in the leg by a flare, and a crewmember was also injured.

quote: I've got myself locked in, but he's... he's trying to break down the door!
before: Who's trying to kill you, Mrs. Navarro? Diego!
after: Please help me! Hey, Frank.
ru: Я закрылась у себя в комнате, но он... он пытается сломать дверь!

quote: Let's hope they still have enough strength to break down the wall for us.
before: -Exactly. I'll say one thing, Doctor, for some of them it will be the first day's honest work they've done in their lives.
after: -How long before the power returns? -I don't know.
ru: Давайте надеяться, что у них все еще хватит сил, чтобы помочь нам сломать стену.

quote: They were going to break it down like the other times. So I opened it.
before: They were headed for my Dad's workshop. After a while I heard a knock at the door.
after: Who were they? It was my Grandmother, dressed like them.
ru: Они могли сломать ее, такое уже происходило, так что я открыла.

quote: It's very important to vote so we can break down this wall of shame.
before: It's just a wall. The wall of shame is something.
after: I have passion in my heart. Voting gives me a voice and power.
ru: Важно голосовать, чтобы мы смогли сломать эту стену стыда.

quote: We can break down ethnic barriers by playing Kenyan music done in English, Kiswahili and other ethnic languages, on what is now single-language ethnic radio.
before: We can use radio to help Kenyans hear the diversity that is Kenya. We can reserve 60 percent of all programing on Kenyan radio for Kenyan music.
after: Radio can help stimulate interest and demand for Kenyan music by Kenyans, while also providing the much-needed incomes by way of royalties. But more importantly, radio can help us build a more inclusive narrative about Kenya.
ru: Можно сломать этнические преграды, играя кенийскую музыку на английском языке, на суахили и на других этнических языках, на нынешнем одноязычном этническом радио.

quote: I'm gonna use them to break the ice with the members of the drill team.
before: Dad, don't do this. Salmon-chanted evening.
after: Once I gain their confidence, I'll destroy the drill, save hell, and we can all finally go home! - Yay, riddles! - I've got a riddle, everybody.
ru: я собираюсь использовать эти загадки, чтобы растопить лёд в отношениях с другими членами бур-команды.

quote: I'm making conversation to break the ice. How am I doing?
before: Yeah. One of them.
after: Am I all right? Amanda Emily's been trying to call you.
ru: Я веду беседу чтобы растопить лед, у меня получается?

quote: Thought it might break the ice, a bit.
before: But did you get any information? You're being funny now?
after: Funny doesn't suit you. Let's stick to ice.
ru: Подумал, это поможет растопить лёд.

quote: You need an event, to help break the ice and help make new friends.
before: No. You see, this is why you need the back to school dance.
after: Padraic is lovely. But it is also nice to have friends who don't eat stones for money. Hello Martin's school.
ru: Нужно культурное событие, которое растопит лед и станет поводом для дружбы.

quote: The reasons I thought we should break up.
before: Long story. It's a long story --
after: You don't have to explain it. No, I think I do.
ru: Из-за чего я решила, что мы должны расстаться.

quote: I don't want to break up with you.
before: I'm sorry. I'm just scared.
after: I'm sorry that I said that. I love you so much.
ru: Я не хочу расставаться с тобой.

quote: I keep thinking I shouldn't have broken up with him.
before: No, not at all. What's up? I just...
after: Maybe I was being too judgmental or whatever. Um, more like the other way around, isn't it?
ru: Я просто... думаю, что не надо было с ним расставаться.

quote: Did you just write "break up with P"?
before: What about you? Oh, damn.
after: How about a second course? - Esther, would you get that?
ru: Ты только что написала "расстаться с П"?

quote: So, they decide to break up.
before: Both Iris and Onion are devastated. They know they can't continue their relationship if Iris is going to hurt and cry every time Onion takes off her jacket.
after: As Onion walks out the door, Iris stops crying. And immediately starts again.
ru: Поэтому они решили расстаться.

quote: And he recognized you as someone who brought a package to the post office that day.
before: A postal worker identified me as the person who brought him that envelope? No. I showed him photos of ASAs.
after: That is an air-tight case. He said you would have received a receipt just like this.
ru: И он узнал тебя, как человека, который приносил сверток на почту в тот день.

quote: Well, believe it or not, my parents used to bring us here when we were kids.
before: Something you two want to tell us? Where did you find this place?
after: Your parents? They brought you here?
ru: Веришь или нет, мои родители привозили меня сюда в детстве.

quote: So you were the one who brought all the prostitutes?
before: They called me "the Coho King." Pretty much single-handedly organized those things myself.
after: Uh... Whoa, whoa, whoa. Can we slow down? Why?
ru: Так значит это вы привозили туда всех этих проституток?

quote: I would make it and bring it to her in bed.
before: Okay. Um... for as long as I can remember, I've woken up at 6:30 every day to make Shelly coffee, splash of milk, two sugars.
after: She says that her day doesn't even start until she's got caffeine in her veins. And then one day, woke up, 6:30... like always, and I made myself one.
ru: Я делал это и приносил ей в постель.

quote: It's what brings that lightning.
before: And those are the two critical elements of a music city, a city whose leaders recognize the importance of music for our development as individuals, our connection as a community and our viability as a vibrant place to live. See, smart cities, music cities, know that thriving nightlife, a creative class, culture is what attracts young, talented people to cities.
after: And no, we can't predict the next egg that will hatch, but we can create a city that acts like an incubator. To do that, first, we've got to know what we've got.
ru: Это то, что приносит ту самую удачу.

quote: The bomb caused a 15-foot wide crater, and brought down the west wing of the hotel.
after: An injured guest, Jawad Chaudhry, said, "The floor under my feet shook. I thought the roof was falling on me.

quote: It was grandfather who brought about a reconciliation with the Shimerdas.
after: One morning he told us that the small grain was coming on so well, he thought he would begin to cut his wheat on the first of July. He would need more men, and if it were agreeable to everyone he would engage Ambrosch for the reaping and threshing, as the Shimerdas had no small grain of their own.
ru: Это дедушка добился примирения с Шимердами.

quote: He hated himself and he hated the fate that had brought about his humiliation.
before: George heard the man and woman making their way through the bushes. As he crept down the hillside his heart was sick within him.
after: When his mind went back to the hour alone in the alleyway he was puzzled and stopping in the darkness listened, hoping to hear again the voice outside himself that had so short a time before put new courage into his heart. When his way homeward led him again into the street of frame houses he could not bear the sight and began to run, wanting to get quickly out of the neighborhood that now seemed to him utterly squalid and commonplace.
ru: Он ненавидел себя и судьбу, которая довела его до унижения.

quote: It took a lot of work to bring about our reunion.
before: Oh, my. I wouldn't undersell it.
after: Reunion? Have we met before?
ru: На наше воссоединение ушло немало сил.

quote: And their descendents, the Minoans, brought about the end of their civilization trying to reclaim it.
before: I find this notion romantic but um... ..unlikely. No, I believe it was transcribed by the elders of an ancient civilization in Crete... 9,000 years before Christ, in a place that later became the legendary lost City of Atlantis.
after: And that sounds more likely? Whoever lays their hands on the Book of Leaves will rule all of Italy... if not the world.
ru: А их потомки, минойцы, привели свою цивилизацию к гибели, пытаясь вернуть книгу.

quote: Look, like I've told you, we're doing everything we possibly can to see what brought about that lion attack.
before: Really? I came to ask you a few questions-- the last thing I expected to find was you having a party one day after three people died on your watch.
after: Well, then would you care to comment on information we have in regards to the zoo's choice of food suppliers being adjusted due to budgetary restrictions? Information culled from where, Ms. Campbell? Our previous vendors?
ru: Я уже вам говорил, мы делаем всё возможное в расследовании причины этих нападений.

quote: Anger has a long history of bringing about positive change; but, in addition to being angry, I'm also hopeful.
before: Gender as it functions today is a grave injustice. We should all be angry.
