after: Hopefully, we've done enough to convince you that in fact we can all draw. And not just people here.
ru: Готово. Мы могли бы продолжать, правда?

quote: So what happens after we catch Waylon and Clint?
before: You... Mouthy townie bastard.
after: Put them in a cell. Then what?
ru: Ну и что будет после того, как мы поймаем Вейлана и Клинта?

quote: It appears we have caught the intruder's accomplice.
before: He knew that. What is it?
after: We found him with blood on his clothing. When questioned, he attempted to flee.
ru: Похоже, мы поймали сообщника лазутчика.

quote: Yes, did you catch lots of flies, Mr. Toad?
before: How are you, Mr. Toad? Have you been good, Na Rim?
after: Are you alright? Yes, I am alright, Mister.
ru: Нормально. Вы поймали много мух на ужин, дядя Жаба?

quote: If I'm ever caught by them, I may be sold off to some lonely islands.
before: I'm truly sorry. I'm really at my wits' end.
after: The police station should be very safe. The hooligans can't do anything anyway.
ru: Если меня поймают, то меня могут продать на какой-нибудь отдалённый остров.

quote: You fall outside the door, you're caught in the slipstream.
before: The first guy goes, and you're just in line, and you just kind of lumber to the door. Jump is a misnomer; you fall.
after: The first thing you do is lock into a tight body position — head down in your chest, your arms extended, put over your reserve parachute. You do that because, 27 years before, an airborne sergeant had taught me to do that.
ru: Вы падаете за дверь, ловите воздушный поток.

quote: And what we know is that it's as if the bees have caught a flu.
before: And one documentary writer, who was here and looked at this two months after I was here, described this not as beehives but as a graveyard, with these empty white boxes with no bees left in them. Now, I'm going to sum up a year's worth of work in two sentences to say that we have been trying to figure out what the cause of this is.
after: And this flu has wiped through the population of bees. In some cases, and in fact in most cases in one year, this flu was caused by a new virus to us, or newly identified by us, called Israeli Acute Paralysis virus.
ru: А что мы знаем, так это то, что это как если бы пчелы поймали грипп.

quote: It doesn't catch every little thing that's going on.
before: At the beginning of class, I just perch it in the back of the classroom. It's not a perfect shot.
after: But I can hear the sound. I can see a lot.
ru: Камера не ловит каждую мелочь, которая происходит.

quote: According to reports, both carriages of the derailed unit had also caught fire.
before: An investigation is currently under way in Argyll, Scotland, following a derailment on the Glasgow – Oban railway. The incident took place at 2100 BST (2000 UTC) on Sunday, close to the Falls of Cruachan station.
after: At the location of the incident, the railway line is on an embankment above a local roadway, and the lead car came to rest overhanging this road.

quote: And so Daphne downloaded a host of extrasensory images, and now she's completely caught up.
before: Thank you so much. It's fine.
after: Okay, that's fascinating. I attribute it to the stress of the past couple months coupled with the natural hormonal imbalance of a teenaged girl.
ru: И так Дафни загрузила множество экстрасенсорных изображений и теперь она полностью наверстала забытое.

quote: With this orbit, the U.S. has caught up.
before: Come on, babe. We're almost there.
after: The space race is neck and neck, and the prize can be ours. World War II ace pilot Deke Slayton will be next.
ru: После этого полета Соединенные Штаты догнали соперника.

quote: It was great catching up with you, Norrie.
before: You're too busy belonging? We decided that we would take a break until you graduate, Joe.
after: Joe. Damn it.
ru: Здорово было поболтать с тобой, Норри.

quote: I'm so far behind, you know, there's no way I could catch up.
before: - I don't agree with that. - It doesn't matter any more.
after: Well, actually, you haven't missed that much time at all. I'm sure the school would work with you.
ru: Я уже так отстала, знаете, уже невозможно наверстать.

quote: But behind, the average team is trying to catch up.
before: And the two other runners on the US team are not bad, either. (Laughter) So clearly, the US team has won the war for talent.
after: Let's watch the race. (Video: French sportscasters narrate race) (Video: Race narration ends) Yves Morieux: So what happened?
ru: Но позади средняя команда пытается догнать их.

quote: And then she went back to the office and worked past midnight to catch up.
before: So she came up with a plan. Every Tuesday and Thursday, Sally left work early, picked up her daughter from school, played with her, fed her, bathed her and put her to bed.
after: Only, Sally's rumination journal indicated she spent almost every minute of her quality time with her daughter ruminating about how much work she had to do. Ruminations often deny us our most precious moments.
ru: Потом она возвращалась в офис и работала там за полночь, чтобы наверстать время.

quote: And there is no doubt that fast catch up can take place.
before: You see, Japan did it like that. We add Japan to it.
after: Can you see here what Japan did? Japan did it like this, until full catch up, and then they follow with the other high-income economies.
ru: И нет сомнений, что можно наверстать быстро.

quote: Look, I know our plans changed. But, they changed because I did well.
before: I think the first phase would be a few years. And then potentially, if that went well... for longer. It sounds like we're staying.
after: And I know it doesn't feel like that to you, but maybe it's a good thing that they changed. For you?
ru: К сожалению, наши планы изменились, но это потому, что у меня все получилось.

quote: So, did the D.A.'s office know anything about Kate changing her testimony?
before: What? I'm Lieutenant Al Burns, and I'm interviewing Kate Jordan on August 14, 2010.
after: She never notified them. KATE: It's the right thing to do...
ru: Так в офисе окружного прокурора не знают о том, что Кейт собралась изменить показания?

quote: He's changing the troubles, and we don't know any of the rules.
before: Let's go home. William.
after: And we have nothing. What?
ru: Он меняет беды, а мы не знаем никаких правил.

quote: And yeah, that sucks, which is why things have to change.
before: It doesn't matter what I want! It's how the public already sees you.
after: Avery. Hi. What the hell are you playing that for?
ru: И да, это ужасно, поэтому нужно это менять.

quote: We've changed the chemistry of the soil with our artificial fertilizers.
before: We cut roads through the forest. We have added little plastic particles to the sand on ocean beaches.
after: And of course, we've changed the chemistry of the air. So when you take your next breath, you'll be breathing in 42 percent more carbon dioxide than if you were breathing in 1750.
ru: Мы изменили химический состав почвы с помощью искусственных удобрений.

quote: And right about now, the activity in your prefrontal cortex is changing.
before: The front part of your brain, the prefrontal cortex, which is responsible for your executive function, your attentional control, is now being downregulated. The part of your brain called the DMN, default mode network, which is the interaction between multiple areas in your brain, which is active during, sort of, ideation, creative thinking in terms of divergent thinking and daydreaming, is now being upregulated.
after: It's becoming asymmetrical in its activity, biased towards the right, which is highly correlated when people step forward into the world, as opposed to step back. In fact, the activity across the brains of all these people was so correlated that we're able to train an artificial neural network to predict whether or not people are experiencing awe to an accuracy of 75 percent on average, with a maximum of 83 percent.
ru: И прямо в этот момент активность в вашей префронтальной коре меняется.

quote: So, obviously, the technology is here today, and, over the next several years, that will change.
before: It is absolutely archaic that we call cancer by prostate, by breast, by muscle. It makes no sense, if you think about it.
after: You will no longer go to a breast cancer clinic. You will go to a HER2 amplified clinic, or an EGFR activated clinic, and they will go to some of the pathogenic lesions that were involved in causing this individual cancer.
ru: Однозначно, сегодня у нас есть технологии и в течение последующих несколько лет все изменится.

quote: A third-party candidate also emerged who could potentially change the outcome of the election.
before: In May 2008, the candidates of the United States presidential election campaigned and faced questions on as wide ranging issues as assassination, Hitler and the death of one's political career. The month more clearly showed who the Democratic Party candidate would be, and potentially narrowed the field for the Vice-Presidential race in the Republican Party.

quote: Bob, did you check their data packs for vital signs?
before: That's not how the Angels kill you, they displace you in time. Unless they needed the bodies for something.
after: We may be able to initiate a rescue plan. Don't be an idiot!
ru: Боб, ты проверял сигналы на предмет признаков жизни?

quote: When was the last time you had your eyes checked?
before: Good luck crossing Grandma Moses. Hi, Nana Joe.
after: Oh, I don't know. A few months ago.
ru: Когда вы в последний раз проверяли зрение?

quote: Checking in all those people, and then they were just gone.
before: Honestly, Mellie, I don't know. (Projector and camera shutter clicking) You were the gate agent that day, Mrs. Rowe.
after: The flight was sold out but took off with one empty seat. Judy, one of the flight attendants, called back to the gate to say there were being held on the tarmac by a federal marshal and someone was being taken off the plane.
ru: Проверяла всех этих людей, а потом они просто исчезли.

quote: Well, I'm having a lawyer look over the offer now, but if this checks out, this could be huge, Angie.
before: Oh. Honey, that's amazing. Do you think it's legit?
after: Yeah? What do you think, like, money huge?
ru: Ну, мой адвокат сейчас проверяет предложение, но, если все удастся, это будет грандиозно, Энджи.

quote: And make sure that people are constantly checking to say, "Are we good people doing good work?"
before: And so there was a lot that we had to do to sort of — We'd gone from a very small company — I mean if you go literally two and a half years ago, our company was 400 people, and today it's 6,500. And so when you go through that growth, you have to sort of cement your cultural values and talk about them all of the time.
after: And if you check those boxes, the next part of that is making sure you're telling your story. And I think we learned a lot of lessons but I think at the end of it we came out stronger.
ru: Убеждаться, что люди всё время проверяют: «Мы хорошие люди, которые делают хорошую работу?»

quote: They inspect it, they check it for cracks, for drill damage, for spalls, for chips.
before: At the peak of activity earlier this year, the researchers lowered the drill an extra hundred feet deeper into the ice every day and another 365 years deeper into the past. Periodically, they remove a cylinder of ice, like gamekeepers popping a spent shotgun shell from the barrel of a drill.
after: More importantly, they prepare it for inspection and analysis by 27 independent laboratories in the United States and Europe, who will examine it for 40 different trace chemicals related to climate, some in parts per quadrillion. Yes, I said that with a Q, quadrillion.
ru: Они осматривают его, проверяют на трещины, на повреждения от бура, на осколки и зазубрины.

quote: How many of you are checking it right now?
before: How many of you have checked your email today? Come on, raise your hands.
after: (Laughter) And how about finances? Anybody check that today?
ru: Кто из вас проверяет её прямо сейчас?

quote: How would you like to check what exactly happens?
before: How do you plan to investigate the chemistry of the phenomenon?

quote: I'm gonna check in and drink at the gate.
before: I'm going. But, so-- how long are you--
after: So how... long are you going for?
ru: Пойду зарегистрируюсь и выпью у ворот. Ладно.

quote: Front desk says she checked in yesterday afternoon alone.
before: She's a Philly girl. How long was she here for?
after: She wasn't alone. She brought 4,000 of her closest friends.
ru: На стойке регистрации сказали, что она заселилась вчера днем, одна.

quote: Can you maybe check in with them on Friday and tell them?
before: - Okay, look, I can't commit to Friday. Maybe... I won't know until I see how the session's going.
after: Give 'em like 80%? - All right.
ru: Можешь связаться с ними в пятницу и тогда сказать точно?

quote: He checked in three days ago as Frank Babcock.
before: Have you seen this guy? Gil Bellamy.
after: With a fake I.D. Expired credit card last time.
ru: Он заселился 3 дня назад как Фрэнк Бэбкок.

quote: Yes, hi, has a Marc Faison checked in yet?
before: You know what, maybe he thought we were meeting there. I'm calling the restaurant to see...
after: He has not. What about now?
ru: Да, здравствуйте, а Марк Фэйсон уже зарегистрировался?

quote: Why'd you check in under an alias?
before: According to the hotel's register, that is "John Mason." He bares a striking resemblance to you, Mr. Elspeth.
after: I suppose you have me dead to rights, so... I confess.
ru: Почему Вы зарегистрировались под псевдонимом?

quote: Anyway, she wants us to go to the house and check in on Stuart because he might be "lonely."
before: Mmm, she loves it. She finally found a place where everyone talks about how sweaty they are.
after: She's just being nice. Well, I'm her son, how come she doesn't send someone to check on me if I'm lonely?
ru: Как бы то ни было, она хочет, чтобы мы съездили туда и проведали Стюарта, потому что ему может быть «одиноко».
source_ru: В любом случае, она хочет, чтобы мы поехали в дом и проверили Стюарта, потому что ему может быть "одиноко"

quote: To check in with us and remind us that we are a link.
before: Isn't that what we all need? Somebody to reach out and make sure that we're OK.
after: Every now and then, we all just need a little help holding the stapler. Thank you.
ru: Кто поинтересуется, как у нас дела, и напомнит нам, что мы — звено цепочки.

quote: Sometimes to get your needs met, you need to choose an unsavory partner.
before: Gossip Girl didn't offer to help? Yeah, but only if I help her, whatever that means.
after: You know, that might work for you at 3:00 in the morning in the lower east side, but it's Gossip Girl. It's been pretty nice not having her record our every move.
ru: Иногда, чтобы добиться желаемого, приходится выбирать сомнительных партнеров.

quote: Sweetheart, why do you think I chose my side of the bed?
before: Uh, dad, it's totally the left. I mean, look at it.
after: Okay! Okay.
ru: Дорогая, как ты думаешь я выбирал, с какой стороны кровати спать?

quote: I give her a home, somewhere from which she may choose what to make of herself.
before: Rose, this woman would make a penniless drudge of you. I would not.
after: Rose? Is it your wish that you remain here a while longer yet?
ru: Я дала ей кров, место, где она может выбрать, чем заниматься.

quote: I think now we're just choosing what our future's gonna be.
before: Are we trying to fix things between us or not? I don't know the answers yet.
after: We've kept this secret a long time. You had an affair with her, right?
ru: Я думаю, сейчас мы выбираем каким будет наше будущее.

quote: We can choose to change our environment to have more bees.
before: We can make individual changes, but we can make social changes. We can choose to have more wolves.
after: We can choose to have different rating agencies. We can choose to control corporations instead of allowing corporations to control us.
ru: Можно выбрать изменить окружающую среду, чтобы стало больше пчёл.

quote: A single electron isn't choosing to go left or right but left and right simultaneously.
before: Block one of the slits and the stripes go away. This shows that the pattern is a result of each electron going through both slits at the same time.
after: This superposition of states also leads to modern technology. An electron near the nucleus of an atom exists in a spread out, wave-like orbit.
ru: Электрон не выбирает, куда идти, а идёт сразу и направо, и налево.

quote: I chose Sub-Saharan Africa because this is a huge delivery territory.
before: Let me show you how possible this is. This is a map of Sub-Saharan Africa, with a map of the United States for scale.
after: It's very challenging. But we analyzed every 50-mile by 50-mile block on the continent, and we found that half of farmers live in just these shaded regions.
ru: Я выбрал Южно-Африканский регион, так как это огромная территория доставки.

quote: Why did you choose to run in this constituency?
before: Why have you chosen to involve yourself in the political process?

quote: Slow down. You claim it was the last time you saw Puss?
before: Action, Motherfuckers! It takes about 30 minutes online to find Zooey Wigner.
after: Yeah. Really? So, it would surprise you to learn that.. when Schrodinger's warehouse was open the next morning, Puss was still there.
ru: Погоди, ты заявляешь, что тогда видел этого Киску в последний раз?

quote: It did claim to be Napoleon and Karl Marx.
before: And on top of all that my superego keeps popping up. You were right, by the way.
after: And the Pope. And something else.
ru: Оно требовало быть Наполеоном и Карлом Марксом.

quote: He claims your man kidnapped and assaulted him.
before: Sid Rothman assaulted one of my officers. That's got to count for something.
after: He's ready to press charges. Let me guess.
ru: Но он утверждает, что ваш человек похитил его.

quote: Yeah, uh, the limo company claims that the car she arrived in was ordered by you.
before: Well, I mean, we're trying to figure out how she got there, and your mom said that she wasn't scheduled to work yesterday. So...
after: I've never drunk dialed a limo before. But...
ru: Да, и в прокате лимузинов утверждают, что машину, на которой она приехала, заказали вы.

quote: Just yesterday, I was attacked by a guy who claimed that I was filming him.
before: You hear about, actually, a drone pilot, a hobbyist, was attacked two weeks ago because he was flying near a beach. Here's some personal input I didn't expect.
after: I was checking my email right here — easy way to get input for your talk. But I think there are better solutions.
ru: Буквально вчера на меня напал парень, утверждавший, что я его снимаю.

quote: But I never claimed things I didn't understand, I talked about my personal experiences.
before: That's what I asked constantly, because, again, I am not an expert, I am a normal kid, and now I'm talking to CNN and Fox News about a scientific discussion that really, should I be facilitating, should I be commenting on? And a lot of people questioned that, and for good reason.
after: And even at the Senate hearing, I just talked about how misinformation is dangerous. My mom got a lot of her beliefs from social media, from Facebook and from organizations that were allowing their platforms to push lies that were very dangerous.
ru: Но я никогда не заявлял того, чего не понимал, я говорил о личном опыте.

quote: Critics also claim that harm reduction gives the wrong message to our children about drug users.
before: We know that if recovery is ever going to happen we must keep people alive. Offering someone a clean needle or a safe place to inject is the first step to treatment and recovery.
after: The last time I looked, these drug users are our children. The message of harm reduction is that while drugs can hurt you, we still must reach out to people who are addicted.
ru: Критики также заявляют, что программа снижения вреда создаёт у наших детей неправильное представление о наркопотребителях.

quote: Whitton claims the creature was walking "parallel" to them as they hauled out the corpse.
before: The single photo shown at the conference portrays a blurred black figure in the distance.
after: Another photo on Whitton's website www.searchingforbigfoot.com shows what is allegedly the corpse, decapitated and stuffed into a freezer.

quote: Clarify your ideas by putting them in words; the talker gains as much from his conversation as the listener.
before: Proper friendships form one of the best means for the formation of ideas and ideals, for they enable one to practise in giving expression to thought. The speaker who would speak fluently before an audience should learn to speak fluently and entertainingly with a friend.
after: You sometimes begin to converse on a subject thinking you have very little to say, but one idea gives birth to another, and you are surprised to learn that the more you give the more you have to give. This give-and-take of friendly conversation develops mentality, and fluency in expression.
ru: Проясняйте свои мысли, облекая их в слова: говорящий получает от беседы не меньше, чем слушатель.

quote: There's just one thing you need to clarify for me.
before: Provided you still want it. That's a generous offer, sir.
after: Of course. Frost may have been carrying some vital Intel.
ru: Только сначала проясните для меня одну вещь.

quote: I called him this morning just to clarify a few things.
before: You did? Yeah.
after: You may have noticed I wasn't exactly paying attention when we were in his office. Well, you were surprised.
ru: Я звонил ему утром, что бы разъяснить несколько вещей.

quote: Oh, thank you for clarifying. I feel much better now.
before: And I sat in hundreds of police meetings just like yesterday's, but suddenly I'm disinvited. Uninvited. "Disinvited" implies you were invited in the first place.
after: Cut it out. It was a purely technical huddle.
ru: Спасибо за объяснение, мне стало намного легче.

quote: Just to clarify: copy editors don't choose what goes into the magazine.
before: I'm a copy editor. I work at The New Yorker, and copyediting for The New Yorker is like playing shortstop for a Major League Baseball team: every little movement gets picked over by the critics — God forbid you should commit an error.
after: We work at the level of the sentence, maybe the paragraph, the words, the punctuation. Our business is in the details.
ru: Следует пояснить, что редактор-корректор не выбирает, что печатать.

quote: But before I do, I just want to clarify which numbers I'm talking about here.
before: But you should also be able to tell which numbers are reliable and which ones aren't. So today I want to try to give you some tools to be able to do that.
after: I'm not talking about claims like, " 9 out of 10 women recommend this anti-aging cream. " I think a lot of us always roll our eyes at numbers like that.
ru: Но сначала хочу просто пояснить, о каких цифрах я веду речь.

quote: He went on to clarify that he believed Japan could provide data about missiles to the United States without violating Japan's constitution.
before: Koizumi pointed out that the angle and altitude of a missile in flight could be used to determine the target of the missile.
ru: Затем он уточнил, что, по его мнению, Япония может передавать США данные о ракетах, не нарушая японскую конституцию.

quote: The one who cleans his ears with his car keys?
before: - Where'd you get the booze, huh? - [sighs] Was it that Greyson kid?
after: Why do you have to get to the bottom of everything? - Because this is serious.
ru: Который чистит уши ключами от машины?

quote: Your main duty will be cleaning my crown.
before: Oh, and one last thing. I want you to be my new handmaiden.
after: That is not your crown. That is the official crown of the Queen of Valencia, and my mother is its rightful owner.
ru: Ты будешь все время чистить мою корону.

quote: I cleaned a metro station for two months.
before: I was a nurse. But my papers are no good here.
after: Two months, and that was it. I'd need three jobs anyway to bring my family here.
ru: Я два месяца убирал станции метро.

quote: So from now on, we're going to be cleaning the house my way.
before: Mr. Stilson usually just has us start in the kitchen. Mr. Stilson is no longer with us.
after: The Monk way. Who's Monk?
ru: И, начиная с этого момента, мы будем убирать дом по моему.

quote: They'd rotate who'd cleaned and who'd watch the kids.
before: They plastered neighborhoods with flyers and handed business cards out to their families and friends, and soon, they had clients calling. Two of them would clean the office or house and one of them would watch the kids.
after: (Laughs) It's awesome, right? (Laughter) And they split the money three ways.
ru: Они убирались и смотрели за детьми по очереди.

quote: And first-class morality is, don't bomb Mexico -- they clean my house.
before: Economy class morality is, we want to bomb you back to the Stone Age. Business class morality is, don't bomb Japan — they built my car.
after: (Laughter) Yes, it is politically incorrect. All right, now I want to do a little bit of a thing for you...
ru: И мораль первого класса: «Не бомбите Мексику — они убирают у меня в доме».

quote: And there are no international laws in space to enforce us to clean up after ourselves.
before: This is the paradigm of the satellite industry. Satellites that are no longer working are often left to deorbit over many, many years, or only moved out of the way as a temporary solution.
after: So the world's first satellite, Sputnik I, was launched in 1957, and in that year, there were only a total of three launch attempts. Decades later and dozens of countries from all around the world have launched thousands of more satellites into orbit, and the frequency of launches is only going to increase in the future, especially if you consider things like the possibility of 900-plus satellite constellations being launched.
ru: Нет никаких международных законов о космическом пространстве, принуждающих убирать за собой мусор.

quote: County officials closed the schools to clean them.
before: In Moneta, Virginia, a high school senior died from an infection that spread to his kidney, liver, lungs and heart. In Bedford County, where Moneta is located, school officials have reported five cases of the Methicillin-resistant strain of the Staph bacteria.

quote: But when he takes us to gym, we're supposed to climb the rope.
before: Playing catch in class? That, for most kids, is what's called fun.
after: He fails to pick up on my reluctance. He's not a good fit for me.
ru: А когда мы идем в спортзал мы должны подниматься по канату.

quote: It's still a great pleasure to climb with such a beautiful woman!
before: He doesn't like talking about the past, but here he has to. You were barely out of nappies the last time Lothar was here.

quote: We know what the wind resources are. You can cover 15 percent.

before: They're so creasy. We built this place secretly with your father to hold a very special prisoner.

ru: Ее зовут ПиЛи и она очень могущественный маг огня, который способен создавать взрывы силой мысли.

quote: I had studied chemistry, so I helped the Ra'id create a new methane-based compound.
before: Yes. My mother was killed in a drone attack.
after: And what did this compound do? When injected under the skin, it would make a head explode.
ru: Я изучал химию, и помогал Рейду создавать новую смесь на основе метана.

quote: And, indeed, musicians exhibit enhanced memory functions, creating, storing, and retrieving memories more quickly and efficiently.
before: Because making music also involves crafting and understanding its emotional content and message, musicians often have higher levels of executive function, a category of interlinked tasks that includes planning, strategizing, and attention to detail and requires simultaneous analysis of both cognitive and emotional aspects. This ability also has an impact on how our memory systems work.
after: Studies have found that musicians appear to use their highly connected brains to give each memory multiple tags, such as a conceptual tag, an emotional tag, an audio tag, and a contextual tag, like a good Internet search engine. How do we know that all these benefits are unique to music, as opposed to, say, sports or painting?
ru: Исследования подтверждают, что у музыкантов память лучше: им удаётся создавать, хранить и припоминать воспоминания быстрее и эффективнее.

quote: We need to create opportunities to give that enable us to appreciate our shared humanity.
before: Instead, it matters how we do it. And if we want people to give more, we need to subvert the way we think about charitable giving.

ru: Для этого нужно создавать возможности для дарения, помогающие ценить нашу общую человечность.

quote: Where other scientists would play in their laboratory, Tesla created his inventions in his mind.
before: Probably a form of synesthesia. But it was something he later turned to his advantage.

ru: В то время пока другие учёные игрались в своих лабораториях, Тесла создавал свои изобретения в уме.

quote: After the partition is created, the user must load a Microsoft Windows install disc.

before: No, I stopped going to 'em around 1967, I think. Yeah, I stopped in 1980.
after: Well, the last time we were cross was when George was suing me. Er, the last time he calls me was to say, "I'm going to sue you."
ru: А что сейчас? Что заставляет вас пересекаться сейчас?

quote: All they told me is we're crossing the Delaware.
before: Me? No. Thought you would.
after: Great. They told us just to follow you.
ru: Я только услышал, что мы пересекаем Делавэр.

quote: I don't know why I'm afraid of crossing a river.
before: Yeah, that would suit me all right, too. I crossed an ocean.
after: Gus! I found your horse.
ru: Не знаю, с чего бы мне бояться пересекать реку.

quote: But now we know how difficult it is to cross over.
before: Go on. For reasons that will become clear in time, I cannot go back yet, maybe not ever.
after: I can count on my hand the number of people who've done it safely. But on this side, they've become more insidious.
ru: Но теперь мы знаем, как сложно переходить.

quote: No person fleeing war or persecution should have to die crossing a sea to reach safety.
before: But is that more important than saving human lives? Because there is something fundamental here that I think overrides the rest, and it is about our common humanity.
after: (Applause) One thing is for sure, that no refugee would be on those dangerous boats if they could thrive where they are. And no migrant would take that dangerous journey if they had enough food for themselves and their children.
ru: Ни один беженец, спасающийся от войны или гонений, не должен погибнуть, пересекая море в поиске безопасности.

quote: It also matters how we treat people who are crossing borders.
before: These terms, these misused terms, that are meant to identify the other, the victim, the person who is not supposed to be here, these terms are barriers to economic recovery, to social integration and to the healing required from the climate crisis and climate trauma. Words matter.
after: We should care about how people who are crossing borders today to seek refuge and safety are being treated, if for no other reason than it might be you or someone you love who needs to exercise their human right to migrate in the nearby future. We must start preparing for global migration today.
ru: И также важно, как мы относимся к людям, пересекающим границы.

quote: He was coming every day, crossing the front line.
before: And slowly, slowly week after week his legs were improving. The stump or cast prosthesis was made, and he was starting the real physical rehabilitation.
after: A couple of times I crossed the front line in the very place where Mahmoud and his son were crossing. I tell you, it was something so sinister that I was astonished he could do it every day.
ru: Он не пропускал ни дня, переходил линию фронта, рискуя жизнью.

quote: The legislation would ban the use of any electronic device while crossing a street.

after: The impetus for the legislation is the recent deaths of three people in Brooklyn and Manhattan, all of which were attributed to the distraction caused by the use of electronic devices.

quote: She was drawing a picture and she started to cry.

after: My neck still hurts, more than before. Baby, it's gonna be all right.
ru: Она рисовала, а потом начала плакать.

quote: And I just keep having these waves where I start to cry and I can't stop.
before: And then Sheldon has found Miranda, and she's just lovely with him. And then Addison and Jake, and it... everybody's living.
after: And-and so I was at this bookstore with this attractive man. And I had this moment, Sam, where I just...
ru: А на меня все накатывают эти волны, когда я начинаю плакать и не могу остановиться.

quote: You cry when I tell you to cry.
before: - What happened I. - What happened actor? You crying?
after: So reabsorb that disgusting droplet of salt and bad choices back into your doughy body. And then call your mother to see if you can be reabsorbed back into her doughy body or so help me God, I will take that tear, I will freeze it, and I will stab you in the eye with it, you waste of a soul-shaped hole forgotten by God.
ru: Ты плачешь тогда, когда я тебе говорю плакать.

quote: When I was little, I used to cry every time we drove over a bridge.
before: I remember. No, wait, I forgot.
after: I don't know why. My mom used to try to distract me...
ru: Когда была маленькой, я всегда плакала, когда мы проезжали по тому мосту.

quote: The first thing I thought about was my mom, who was crying over beside me.
before: But very quickly I recovered. It was like that.
after: And I swear to God, I walked out of his office, " I will drive. I will drive.
ru: Это было так. Первое о чем я подумала, была моя мама, которая плакала склонившись рядом со мной.

quote: Millions will feel awe or fear, millions will laugh and millions will cry.
before: They'll watch movies about aliens or robots, or robot aliens or regular people. But they will all be movies about what it means to be human.
after: And then the lights will come back on, and they'll reemerge into the world they knew several hours prior. And millions of people will look at the world a little bit differently than they did when they went in.
ru: Миллионы почувствуют восторг или страх, миллионы будут смеяться и миллионы будут плакать.

quote: The sun was always streaming in, and our children would never be crying.
before: (Laughter) We subscribed to a lot of magazines, did our homework, but really everywhere you look around, we were surrounded by images like this. And we went into parenting expecting our lives to look like this.

ru: Что солнышко будет всегда светить, наши детки никогда не будут плакать.

after: The chisel only carves where the artist points it. And even our most advanced tools do nothing without our explicit direction.
ru: Наш самый первый инструмент резал только то, во что его втыкали.

ru: Ты и понятия не имеешь, с чем мне приходится иметь дело.

ru: Тебе пришлось целый день иметь дело с Майлзом.

after: You think the Internet was big. These are huge questions.
ru: И как мы сможем научиться справляться с прямотой нефильтрованной человеческой мысли?

quote: Over time, these dysfunctional adaptations impair your body's ability to deal with the forces on it.
before: Some muscles will become tight and inflexbile. Others will be inhibited.
after: Poor posture inflicts extra wear and tear on your joints and ligaments, increases the likelihood of accidents, and makes some organs, like your lungs, less efficient. Researchers have linked poor posture to scoliosis, tension headaches, and back pain, though it isn't the exclusive cause of any of them.
ru: А со временем эти дисфункциональные изменения снизят способность вашего тела справляться с оказываемым на него давлением.

quote: In fact, I've developed some interesting tools to help me deal with this fear.
before: Not that I'm not afraid now, but I've learned to pretend. I've learned to be flexible.
after: Let me explain. Back in the' 50s and' 60s, when I was growing up, little girls were supposed to be kind and thoughtful and pretty and gentle and soft, and we were supposed to fit into roles that were sort of shadowy — really not quite clear what we were supposed to be.
ru: Я разработала несколько методов, которые позволяют мне справляться со страхом.

quote: So you two have decided to do the right thing?
before: Compromises are for lesser souls. Die, werewolf zombie!
after: Ugh! Fine! I'll go home and change!
ru: Так вы двое решили поступить правильно? Ох!

quote: You don't get to decide what's good for me anymore.
before: Are you kidding me? And what good would that do?
after: What else aren't you telling me? That's it.
ru: Теперь не вам решать, что для меня лучше.

before: My. Cookie, sweetheart, you have not seen our firepower.
after: Come, my love. Come.
ru: Когда мы решим выстрелить, мы сожжём всю твою семью дотла.

quote: She can't bloody decide when I'm going to call.

after: Tell the stupid bitch to go to bed! Hello?
ru: Не ей, чёрт возьми, решать, когда мне звонить.

quote: So I decided to pick up my tape recorder and find out more.
before: He told me that one night in 1969, a group of young black and Latino drag queens fought back against the police at a gay bar in Manhattan called the Stonewall Inn, and how this sparked the modern gay rights movement. It was an amazing story, and it piqued my interest.
after: With the help of a young archivist named Michael Shirker, we tracked down all of the people we could find who had been at the Stonewall Inn that night. Recording these interviews, I saw how the microphone gave me the license to go places I otherwise never would have gone and talk to people I might not otherwise ever have spoken to.
ru: Поэтому я решил взять свой магнитофон и узнать немного больше.

quote: So I decided I'm going to take my son up on his challenge.
before: (Laughter) Now I'm a writer, and for my books I like to go on adventures. Go on quests.
after: It seemed simple enough. And to make it even simpler, I decided to focus on just one item.
ru: Так что я решил, что возьмусь за это с моим сыном.

quote: And he one day decides to drive up into the driveway with this bread truck.
before: I wanted to be Arthur Ashe, I didn't want to be one of those moon guys. And as I went on through this journey, my dad, who was a school teacher, he played in a band, he did all these things to make money for my sister and I to take piano lessons and do these different things with education.
after: And I'm thinking, " OK, bread truck, me delivering bread while my dad's driving the truck. " I'm like, " OK, I'm going to be a bread guy now. "
ru: Однажды он решает подъехать к нашему дому на хлебном фургоне.

quote: "At the end of the day, we decided we couldn't accommodate that request," Mulloy said.
before: According to Intel spokesman Chuck Mulloy, OLPC had repeatedly asked Intel to abandon its support for the Classmate PC, a similar laptop designed for children in developing countries, and focus entirely on the OLPC program.

quote: I'm afraid we must respectfully decline your request.
before: None. You can see why these numbers seem unlikely to add up to a happy ending from our perspective.
after: But we thank you for paying us the honor of your visit. My lord.
ru: Боюсь, что при всём нашем почтении мы вынуждены отклонить вашу просьбу.

quote: Pray, convey our delight in declining his invitation.
before: I've sent our regrets. No, no, no. No, surely not.
after: Now then, boy, would you like to do your lessons, or help me in the fields? - The fields!
ru: Сообщите ему, как мы счастливы отклонить приглашение.

quote: I regret I must decline your invitation for Christmas.
before: I'm only grateful for your hesitation, and your loyalty all these months. Loyalty's not all on one side, Ross, nor ever has been.
after: I believe Francis would want me to spend it in his house. And I regret that circumstances are such that I cannot take care of you as I might wish.
ru: Сожалею, что придется отклонить приглашение к Рождеству.

quote: Dr. Webber said that he chooses to decline your proposal.

ru: Д-р Вебер сказал, что он решил отклонить ваше предложение.

quote: Drawdown is that point in time when atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases begin to decline on a year-to-year basis.

And so I had to start studying, who is it that's making these decisions?

ru: А еще, они предложили Теду продлить наш тур еще на шесть месяцев.

before: You trained these guys, right? I taught 'em all they know, not all I know.
after: It is. I already have.
ru: Продлишь им кредит, пеняй на себя.

quote: It's essentially like he's extending his skin up there, far away.

after: And that's just the beginning. What we're envisioning is taking a modern cockpit full of gauges and instead of trying to read the whole thing, you feel it.
ru: По сути мы расширили его ощущения при помощи данных с летательного аппарата.

quote: We've built tools like our Mars Rover to extend our vision and lengthen our reach.
before: Humans are natural explorers. We can instantly understand an environment, just by being present in it.
after: But for decades, we've explored from a seat behind screens and keyboards. Now, we're leaping over all of that, over the giant antennas and the relay satellites and the vastness between worlds to take our first steps on this landscape as if we were truly there.
ru: Мы создаем инструменты, такие как марсоход, чтобы расширить наше видение и увеличить наш горизонт.

quote: Robotic repair and maintenance could extend the lives of hundreds of satellites orbiting around the Earth.
before: Imagine if a robotic arm on some sort of space tow truck could fix the broken components on a satellite, making them usable again. Or what if that very same robotic arm could refuel the propellant tank on a spacecraft that relies on chemical propulsion just like you or I would refuel the fuel tanks on our cars?
after: Whatever the disposal or cleanup options we come up with, it's clearly not just a technical problem. There's also complex space laws and politics that we have to sort out.
ru: Ремонт и техническое обслуживание сможет продлить жизнь сотням спутников, вращающихся вокруг Земли.

quote: The Cheetahs extended their lead in the 60th minute with another penalty kick.

quote: A few months ago, Constable Alice Craig failed her refresher course.
before: One. I really don't see the relevance.

quote: No, I do not want to fail a practice test with Dr. Bell.

before: With fear. He's never trusted us.

before: The best scientists and leaders from all over Asia. You have supplies, an aircraft, an army, but no cure.
after: We must harvest anti-bodies and platelets from The Murphy. There he goes.
ru: Все наши усилия создать вакцину провалились.

quote: And sure enough, the merger eventually failed.
before: They just seemed unnecessary and cute in the end. I didn't know back then that our decision marked the beginning of the end — that these two organizations would never become one.
after: Now, was it because there weren't any orange balloons? No, of course not.
ru: Конечно, слияние в итоге провалилось.

quote: Why do so many people reach success and then fail?
after: One of the big reasons is, we think success is a one-way street. So we do everything that leads up to success, but then we get there.
ru: Почему многие люди достигают успеха, а затем проваливаются?

quote: You failed the pop quiz, and you're hardly five minutes into the lecture.
before: I made these up! These are the data.
after: Because the fact is that a year after losing the use of their legs and a year after winning the lotto, lottery winners and paraplegics are equally happy with their lives. Don't feel too bad about failing the first pop quiz, because everybody fails all of the pop quizzes all of the time.
ru: А вот настоящие данные. Вы провалили внезапный экзамен, а ведь прошло всего 5 минут лекции.

quote: Women may face caning up to 74 strokes for failing to observe hijab.
before: Following the Islamic Revolution in 1979, hijab became mandatory in Iran for every woman including foreigners after over 98% of citizens voted for an Islamic government.
after: In this recent crackdown, the authorities have arrested many citizens throughout the country. Not only have women been taken into custody for their hair being uncovered on their foreheads and tight clothes that show body shapes, For men they need to cover from knee to their waist as according to Sharia.

quote: The only thing I can tell you-- Icarus doe here was falling at terminal velocity.
before: Do you have anything for me? Ms. Duquesne, Look at him. With this much damage, we'll be lucky if we ever know.
after: Terminal velocity is 120 miles per hour, So that means he fell from a distance of... Over 2,000 feet.
ru: Единственное, что я могу сказать - наш Икар падал на предельной скорости.

quote: They almost look like diamonds falling from the sky.
before: Drops from the spigot coming down. They catch the light just... just so.
after: They're so close. I struggle to move my head... just an inch.
ru: Они выглядят практически как бриллианты, падающие с небес.

quote: When it rains, around here it feels like the very sky is falling down.
before: He said that you should call him back when you're awake. I can't quite believe it! Now, you must tell me everything. Everything, you hear?
after: Almost as if God Almighty has decided to erase the earth the walls, all traces, even the echo of the few things that happen around here. The town square ceases, then, in its role as the people's living room to the great advantage of the cash registers at the Meletti Café . into which, on that Sunday morning, the important people and we were important, the most important were crammed, like a tin of sardines.
ru: Когда здесь идет дождь, такое чувство, как будто само небо падает вниз.

quote: Or it'll just fall off the stand for no reason. "Why have you done that?"
before: David Coulthard is the other pundit, and that worries me. I think that means that on lap two of every race your telly will suddenly go off.
after: Apparently, they've got Murray Walker involved. They have. Murray Walker's coming back to the BBC. He is. Yeah. AUDIENCE CHEERS
ru: "ли вообще будет падать на пол, без видимой причины. ""ачем ты это сделал?"

quote: If you have a waterfall in there, right out there at the horizon; you look at the waterfall and you go, "Oh, the water is falling really slowly."
before: And if you stop again, you wonder, " Is that a one-hour valley? Or is that a three-hour hike, or is that a whole day I'm looking at? "
after: And you go, " My god it's really far away and it's a giant waterfall. " If a waterfall is falling faster, it's a smaller waterfall which is closer by — because the speed of falling water is pretty constant everywhere.
ru: Если там есть водопад, где-нибудь на горизонте, посмотрев на водопад, сразу видишь: "Вода падает очень медленно."

quote: (Laughter) But, either way, you fall for the rest of your life.
before: If you fall to your left, you're going to fall 8,000 feet into Nepal; if you fall to your right, you're going to fall 12,000 feet into Tibet. So it's probably better to fall into Tibet because you'll live longer.
after: OK. Those climbers were up near the summit, along that summit ridge that you see up there, and I was down here in Camp Three.
ru: (Смех) Но, в любом случае, вы будете падать всю оставшуюся жизнь.

quote: You know, you're sitting there, thinking a deep thought, the apple falls from the tree, and you have the theory of gravity.
before: Another is Newton and the apple, when Newton was at Cambridge. This is a statue from Oxford.
after: In fact, the spaces that have historically led to innovation tend to look like this. This is Hogarth's famous painting of a kind of political dinner at a tavern, but this is what the coffee shops looked like back then.

quote: A downpour of rain fell during the day causing the ground to be waterlogged.

quote: Look, I'm really sorry I fell a little behind.

ru: Послушай, мне очень жаль что я немного отстал.

ru: Ни в коем случае не отставайте и не оглядывайтесь.

quote: So those who fall a little behind find it near impossible to ever catch up and appreciate that beauty.
before: Much like I did for that brief couple of weeks in high school. Unfortunately, our school systems — we move students through mathematics in a lockstep process.
after: But why is this a problem? Why should we care?
ru: И если ученик хоть немного отстал, то потом ему практически невозможно догнать других и оценить всю эту красоту.

quote: The advertisement page of a magazine fell out.
before: The dust lay thick upon it, and festoons of cobwebs lay between it and the wall. Sir James handed her a pocket-knife, and she ripped away the brown paper from the back....
after: Jane picked it up. Holding apart the frayed inner edges she extracted two thin sheets covered with writing!
ru: Из журнала выпала страница с рекламой.

quote: He had a falling out with his father, left to study at Oxford.
before: Carter's fine, but he identified one of the terrorists as Jadalla Bin-Khalid. Jadalla?
after: Yeah, well, guess his father's death gave him a change of heart. Hey, have you gotten anywhere with Nilaa Mizrani?

ru: Мелочно боролся за власть, и... выпал из окна.

after: Someone talked about a loved one who had passed away quickly and unexpectedly. Someone else talked about their friends from school who had moved away as well.

after: Usually, she's weak and very light-headed. Since using the machine, she's had energy and strength.
ru: Тина рассказывала, что от загрязнённой свинцом воды у неё выпадали волосы.

quote: Relations between Iceland and the United Kingdom are deteriorating after the two nations fell out over the current financial crisis.
after: When Iceland nationalised first Landsbanki and then Kaupthing Bank the Financial Services Authority only took on domestic assets, leaving British customers with subsidiary banks out of pocket. While Britain feels Iceland should also pay out to their citizens, Iceland blame the UK for triggering the crisis by using the Anti-terrorism, Crime and Security Act 2001 to freeze the UK assets of Icelandic banks.

after: Some even turn violent. One could make the argument that these so-called victims are better off.
ru: Как много людей оказываются за бортом и ведут ничтожную, жалкую жизнь.

after: So... I don't know where the fuck you are or why you think you can fucking run away from the FBI, but you better get back here... [Beep] Fuck!

before: Figure what out? He never said.

after: You know that. Thanks. I appreciate it, chef. We'll be okay. Thanks.
ru: Нужно время от времени, кормить его.

quote: OK. A farm that doesn't feed its fish, a farm that measures its success by the success of its predators.
before: It evolved to soak up impurities. " And then he added, " But our water has no impurities. "
after: And then I realized when he says, " A farm that has no impurities, " he made a big understatement, because the water that flows through that farm comes in from the Guadalquivir River. It's a river that carries with it all the things that rivers tend to carry these days: chemical contaminants, pesticide runoff.
ru: Хорошо, ферма, которая не кормит свою рыбу. Ферма, которая измеряет свой успех успехом своих «хищников».

quote: Instead, we want to feed them more vegetable proteins.
before: In fact, what you're seeing here are soybean fields. These soybeans are being shipped to Europe and to China as animal feed, especially after the mad cow disease scare about a decade ago, where we don't want to feed animals animal protein anymore, because that can transmit disease.
after: So soybeans have really exploded, showing how trade and globalization are really responsible for the connections to rainforests and the Amazon — an incredibly strange and interconnected world that we have today. Well, again and again, what we find as we look around the world in our little tour of the world is that landscape after landscape after landscape have been cleared and altered for growing food and other crops.
ru: Вместо этого, мы предпочитаем кормить их растительными белками.

quote: She fed love to a generation of people with purple hull peas and greens.
before: My mother cooked with the colors and textures of her garden. She baked yams and squash and heirloom tomatoes and carrots.
after: It seems that during my childhood, the blooms from my mother's gardens have healed all the way from her halo to the roots on the soles of our feet. In our last conversation before her death, she encouraged me to go anywhere in the world that would make me happy.
ru: Она кормила любовью целое поколение с помощью фиолетовой фасоли и зелени.

quote: The captors locked the crew inside the vessel and they were not fed well.

after: The vessel is now headed to Italy and will sail from there to Greece, to meet the ship owners.

ru: Думаю, то безусловную любовь, которую я когда-либо чувствовал, была от Ли Якокка.

before: I mean, he's going through enough right now. As a sick person, I wouldn't want someone to give up on me because of that.
after: - I don't even know what to say. - Just be honest.
ru: Большинство времени я просто хочу чувствовать себя нормальной.

before: - No, I'm fine. - Oh... Crack the sky was a big deal for me.
after: Gave me a huge writing boner. Come on.
ru: С тобой я чувствовал себя, как будто забираюсь на Килиманджаро

after: We can have what I call this duality of presence, and I think that's what allows me to tap into these feelings of empathy. Right?
ru: Но мы можем чувствовать себя, как будто находимся сразу в двух местах.

quote: You can feel just fine while high blood pressure ravages your most vital organs.
before: So it's no wonder that some men don't want to be bothered and skip going to the doctor altogether, especially if they feel fine. But herein lies the problem.
after: This is Denny Moe, owner of Denny Moe's Superstar Barbershop in Harlem. I've been lucky enough to have Denny as my barber for the last eight years.
ru: Можно чувствовать себя нормально, пока высокое давление разрушает жизненно важные органы.

quote: Without decisions you cannot see, you cannot think, you cannot feel.
before: And what that illustrates is that decisions are the key things that support our perceptual bubble. It keeps it alive.
after: And you may think that anesthetics work by sending you into some deep sleep, or by blocking your receptors so that you don't feel pain, but in fact most anesthetics don't work that way. What they do is they introduce a noise into the brain so that the neurons cannot understand each other.
ru: Без принятия решений человек не может видеть, не может думать, не может чувствовать.

quote: Q: Which council decision do you feel the city/your ward should be most proud of?

quote: Why would they be fighting about Hannah?
before: He had a right ding-dong with him about it last week. I thought it was about our Hannah, but... maybe it was about this.
after: My dad never liked them going together. Nearly ten years between them.
ru: Зачем им драться из-за Ханны?

quote: The woman who exists to fight the Troubles.
before: I'm already ruined. I kidnapped Audrey Parker.
after: They won't forgive that. They'll execute me.

after: Stolen by the invaders along with a Saxon girl, Brida, I became first a slave and then a son to Earl Ragnar.
ru: Советую никогда не переходить дорогу Уббе. И никогда с ним не драться.

ru: Потому что правительства и компании будут бороться за власть, а где будем мы?

after: You actually need to organize it. You need to harness it.

ru: Мы все просто пытаемся понять кто мы есть.

ru: Ты должна понять, что ты можешь ему дать, чего никто другой не может.

ru: Рвота на моих волосах стекает вниз по телу и наполняет мои ботинки.

ru: Я нахожу Рейну Круз, а они заполняют пропуски.

quote: We don't have to fill it with ums and ahs.

ru: Не стоит заполнять её паразитами вроде «э-э-э» и «хм-м-м».

quote: We have filled the void with something wonderful, but it is not enough.

after: I still don't know if I will ever be able to run again, or walk at any distance, or do any of those kinetic things that I now only get to do in my dreams. But I am so grateful for how far I have come.
ru: Мы заполняем существующие пробелы своими исследованиями, но этого не достаточно.

after: I have. Cos I don't want to work for 'em. But you've got your new baby to think of now.
ru: - Почему ты не заполнил анкету для Ньюбери? Я заполнила.

quote: Man, this story is filling in a lot of gaps.
before: Well, then I'll be a spokesman for my people, like Ralph Abernathy. Ralph, I like that name.
after: But I want to know about Dad and his broken heart. Your father lost a lot in his life-- his hair, his mother, more games of Monopoly than any man ought.
ru: Человек, эта история заполняется в много пробелов.

quote: We need to fill in the gaps and find these kids.
before: Listen up, everyone, it's confirmed. Driver has a record, Major Crimes has their suspect.
after: What about the boy with the police? Says he can't remember anything.
ru: Мы должны заполнить пробелы и найти этих подростков.

quote: For me, having you here fills in the biggest blank.
before: But to actually do it, after 30 years? I just have a lot of blanks to fill in.
after: "Played out." You're kidding. That place was great.
ru: Для меня одно твоё присутствие заполняет самую большую пустоту.

quote: There's porn to fill in the gaps -- and it will fill in the gaps.
before: So as parents, one of the things that we do is we teach our children about sex. We have books to help us, we have sex ed at school for the basics.
after: (Laughter) We teach our children " the talk " about biology and mechanics, about pregnancy and safe sex, and that's what our kids grow up thinking that sex is pretty much all about. But we can do better than that.
ru: А чтобы заполнить пробелы, есть порнография — и какие только пробелы она не заполняет!

quote: And boy are we willing to fill in those gaps in our lives with lies.
before: We wish we were better husbands, better wives, smarter, more powerful, taller, richer — the list goes on. Lying is an attempt to bridge that gap, to connect our wishes and our fantasies about who we wish we were, how we wish we could be, with what we're really like.
after: On a given day, studies show that you may be lied to anywhere from 10 to 200 times. Now granted, many of those are white lies.
ru: И к сожалению, мы готовы заполнить такие пробелы в нашей жизни ложью.

quote: But maybe Mission Blue can fill in that ocean that we can't see.
before: And now with Google's Oceans, we can actually put a white shark in that ocean. And when we do and it swims, we see this magnificent bathymetry that the shark knows is there on its path as it goes from California to Hawaii.
after: We've got the capacity, NASA has the ocean. We just need to put it together.
ru: Но, возможно, миссия "Голубая планета" поможет заполнить пробелы в знаниях об океане.

quote: I--I'm trying to find the Jennifer Williams I knew 23 years ago.
before: Cyrus Harry? You used to call my Cy if it's-- if it's really you.
after: We spent a long weekend at the Jersey Shore? She was visiting a friend...
ru: Я--я пытаюсь найти ту Дженнифер Уильямс, с которой был знаком 23 года назад.

quote: My mother could find the cloud in every silver lining.
before: It's gettin' ugly out there. You okay?
after: That's cute. Mine smiles all the time, like some ghoul.
ru: Моя мать могла найти каплю дёгтя в любой бочке мёда.

quote: Good help is so hard to find these days.
before: John Amos? Tea and cookies at once!
after: Is there something wrong with your face? Bart, that's rude.
ru: В эти дни трудно найти хороших работников.

quote: We need to find Euron Greyjoy's fleet and sink it.
before: And careful of the paper mites. They like flesh as well.
after: Your Grace, he's already destroyed a good portion of our fleet. To send our remaining ships after him...
ru: Мы должны найти флот Эурона Грейджоя и потопить его.

quote: Perhaps part of this journey is about me trying to find out where I belonged.
before: I had no idea. So I hope there aren't too many psychologists in this audience.
after: So whilst going, and don't worry, I didn't when I arrived with these tribes, I didn't paint myself yellow and run around with these spears and loincloths. But what I did find were people that belonged themselves, and they inspired me, some extraordinary people, and I'd like to introduce you to some heroes of mine.
ru: Возможно, целью путешествия было найти своё место в этом мире.

quote: I bought a book on simplicity to try to find answers.
before: It was a disaster. I felt completely trapped.
after: And I did find a quote that made a big difference in my life, which was, " We suffer more often in imagination than in reality, " by Seneca the Younger, who was a famous Stoic writer. That took me to his letters, which took me to the exercise, " premeditatio malorum, " which means the pre-meditation of evils.
ru: В попытке найти решение я купил книгу о простоте.

quote: We have to really find a way of supporting those countries in a better way.
before: These red are the countries that doesn't do it, and the policy has to be improved. Not simplistic extrapolation.
after: We have to respect the middle income countries on what they are doing. And we have to fact-base the whole way we look at the world.
ru: Мы должны по-настоящему найти путь для поддержания тех стран лучшим способом.

quote: Police noted a blood trail was found outside the business.
before: It is unclear if the suspects left with any property, but early reports indicate one suspect was injured during the robbery.
after: Police said the men may have arrived at the business driving a light blue or silver Ford Mustang.

after: Olivia, if I had any inclination of what Peter was doing... I know.
ru: Если доктор Бишоп выяснит, мы будем рады узнать больше об этом устройстве.

after: I wanted revenge. But shooting him?
ru: Я узнал, что этот свихнувшийся на Библии идиот пытается прижать меня.

after: Check it out. Maybe, it's the Android's sister.
ru: Нужно узнать, что ей известно.

ru: Но когда она узнала, что он и его семья — преступники, она захотела развода.

before: And I have a beautiful page of doodles from Jonathan Woodham's talk. So, good things come out of, you know, incomprehension — (Laughter) — which I will do a painting of, and then it will end up in my work.

ru: Поэтому я открыта возможностям, которые даёт незнание и узнавание чего-то нового.

after: And so what do we do? We put on our white coats and we hide behind them.
