before: Trial? Hold on, Elizabeth.
after: I'm sure if we wait it out a bit longer... I've been waiting.
ru: Даже с новыми показаниями будет почти невозможно, что они смогут довести до конца криминальное расследование.

quote: Someone bold enough to want to cross us and dangerous enough to follow through.
before: He's been with us from the start and he wouldn't have had the nerve to cross me like that. So, I knew it had to be someone else, someone in proximity to him.
after: So, from there, the list got very short very quickly. Max fucked us.
ru: Кто-то, кому хватило бы смелости бросить нам вызов и довести дело до конца.

quote: You have to shift your weight from the back to the front And follow through on the release.
before: Let's play some ball. Now the most important thing when throwing a football Is the follow through.
after: So shift your weight, Release, and follow through. You need to release and follow through like this.
ru: Тебе надо перенести весь твой вес вперед, и довести до конца твой выход.

quote: We need to remain vigilant and follow through.
before: We are on the verge of an AIDS-free generation. We need to pay attention.
after: Otherwise, millions more will die. Thank you.
ru: Мы должны сохранять бдительность и довести дело до конца.

quote: It happened, but I didn't follow up on it.
before: - Like that makes a difference. - It does, all right?
after: And what you're leaving out is that even after all that happened, you asked me to choose, and I chose you. I asked you if anything ever happened between the two of you, and you lied.
ru: Это случилось, но я не стал разбираться дальше.
source_ru: Это произошло, но я не зациклился на этом.

quote: I just wanted to follow up, Mr. Rivetti.
before: I'll see you at the office, Vern! I will see you at the office!
after: Are you kidding me? How did you get my number? If I could just ask one more question.
ru: Я хотела закончить наш разговор, мистер Риветти.

quote: And while we're pointing out how lame you are, you didn't even follow up on that thing I told you.
before: Stuck in the very Hell you once ruled. Trapped by your own guilt.
after: What I whispered in your ear before I died. What?
ru: И раз уж мы обсуждаем, какой ты слабак: ты даже не занялся тем, о чём я тебе говорил.
source_ru: И пока мы обсуждаем, какой ты слабак, ты даже не прислушался к тому, что я тебе сказал.

quote: We followed up with that mother a few months later.
before: I saw a team transformed because of coaching. And I saw at least one life saved because of it.
after: Mom and baby were doing great. The baby's name is Anshika.
ru: Мы связались с роженицей через несколько месяцев.

quote: It's like, why didn't I follow up on that?
before: And I wrote, insult to history. I'm on the plane and I'm just tearing my hair out.
after: What the hell does that mean? Insult to history.
ru: Ну как же так, я не вернулся к этому?

quote: Are there any future plans to follow up on this study?
after: Perhaps in different physical environments and with different microorganisms?
ru: Есть ли планы продолжить это исследование?

quote: "Number one, I was so worried, I forgot to write the rest of this letter."
before: Jenna, everyone has written you letters that they'd like to share. "Miss Maroney, your addiction has negatively affected me "in the following ways.
after: Thank you. I mean... [Cries]
ru: Пункт первый: я был так озабочен, что забыл написать остальную часть письма".

quote: I, totally spaced and forgot to get the reading list.
before: Yeah. I guess so.
after: Sure. Let me check. This isn't going to hurt.
ru: Я абсолютно отвлеклась и забыла записать конспект. У тебя есть? Конечно.

quote: That's what he said yesterday, before he told me to forget.
before: Uh... Klaus compelled me to go out with Marcel, to spy on him.
after: I'm remembering. Let's take you back more.
ru: Он рассказал об этом вчера, перед тем, как приказал мне забыть.

quote: I think I forgot something in my locker.
before: Don't worry. Safety's on.
after: Yeah. - I'll be right back, Roderick.
ru: Кажется, я забыл кое-что в своем шкафчике.

quote: And John suddenly remembers, "I need to ask Nancy for that document before I forget."
before: So let's say there's two people. Nancy's on the left and she's working on a document, and John's on the right.
after: So when he sends her that message, it blows away her attention. That's what we're doing all the time, bulldozing each other's attention, left and right.
ru: Внезапно Джон вспоминает: «Пока не забыл, нужно попросить у Нэнси этот документ!»

quote: But the kindness of all those people made us forget everything.
before: It wasn't simple to work in such environments, sometimes having pigs under you while you paint or climbing a stack of garbage to reach a lift. But we all got over the fear of the heights, the swinging lifts, the strength of the smell and also the stress of not finishing on time.
after: The building number 3 was the house of Uncle Bakheet and Aunty Fareeda. In Egyptian, they have this expression that says, " Ahsen Nas, " which means " the best people. "
ru: Но доброта этих людей помогла забыть обо всём.

quote: So we started to forget about phages, especially in Western medicine.
before: And by the way, they have contributed tremendously to our life expectancy. We are only able to do complex medical interventions and medical surgeries today because we have antibiotics, and we don't risk the patient dying the very next day from the bacterial infection that he might contract during the operation.
after: And to a certain extent, even when I was growing up, the notion was: we have solved bacterial infections; we have antibiotics. Of course, today, we know that this is wrong.
ru: Так мы начали забывать о фагах, особенно в западных медицинских кругах.

quote: And the claim was that it had to do with Iranian missiles, but forget about that.
before: When Bush proposed the missile defense systems in Eastern Europe, Poland and Czechoslovakia, it was a real provocation to the Soviet Union. I mean that was discussed in U.S arms control journals, that they would have to regard as a potential threat to their strategic deterrent, meaning as a first strike weapon.

quote: Eventually, it freezes -- not because it's a bad computer, but because it has too much to do at once.
before: You could compare it to a new computer that's running 10 heavy programs at once. It gets slower and slower, making errors.
after: The poor have the same problem. They're not making dumb decisions because they are dumb, but because they're living in a context in which anyone would make dumb decisions.
ru: Наконец, он зависает. Не потому, что компьютер плохой, а из-за того, что он должен делать сразу слишком многое.

quote: Assets worth 76 billion baht (US$ 2.2 billion) are currently frozen over this issue.
before: Prosecution of Thaksin on other charges, which he maintains are politically motivated, continues; the supreme court is expected to hold a hearing next month on accusations that he is 'unusually rich'. This relates to the sale of the family's stake in Shin Corporation to Temasek Holdings, the investment arm of the Singapore government.
after: The ex-PM escaped impeachment over the tax-free sale of Shin in February 2006. Thai media reports that an amicable divorce of Thaksin and his wife Pojaman in Hong Kong will have no bearing on the case or asset seizure.

quote: It says here that some men gain "sympathy weight" when their partners get pregnant.
before: We may destroy this government one day after all. These pamphlets are fascinating.
after: If that happens to me, I'd be miserable. But happy.
ru: Здесь сказано, что некоторые мужчины набирают "вес сочувствия", когда их партнер в положении.

quote: She gained more than 20 times before he answered.
before: Solen, I said later! Less than 5 minutes ago Ms. Garnier call this number.
after: Listen. Why do not you answer me?
ru: Она набирала больше 20 раз, прежде, чем он ответил.

quote: By saying "Your Honor", you gain the court's attention and open up a channel of communication, a conduit.
before: - Fuck! You say "Your Honor".
after: So, we'll try again. For the benefit of the jury, on whose behalf were you working on this side of the river?
ru: Говоря "Ваша честь", ты получаешь внимание суда и открываешь канал общения, коридор.

quote: Pat, you don't have to gain weight for him to lose it.
before: I have to cut weight. I'll eat his dinner.
after: In the meantime... I want you to read this letter.
ru: Пэт тебе не обязательно набирать вес, который сбрасывает твой брат.

quote: They even use cheesy PowerPoint clip art like, you know, "Success," when they gain access to services like this.
before: Here's the primary target, here's the secondary target, here's the teaming. They probably have a team building on Thursday evening in a pub.
after: What the hell? And then there's the argument that okay, yes, this might be going on, but then again, other countries are doing it as well.
ru: Они даже используют броскую презентацию PowerPoint с названием «Успех», когда получают доступ к сервисам подобного уровня.

quote: Forty percent of them have gained even more.
before: Diets don't have very much reliability. Five years after a diet, most people have regained the weight.
after: If you think about this, the typical outcome of dieting is that you're more likely to gain weight in the long run than to lose it. If I've convinced you that dieting might be a problem, the next question is, what do you do about it?
ru: Сорок процентов набирали даже ещё больший вес.

quote: Abusers are cheered on in chat rooms dedicated to the abuse of children, where they gain rank and notoriety with more abuse and more victims.
before: This is a truly global problem, but if we just look at the US: in the US alone last year, more than 45 million images and videos of child sexual abuse material were reported to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, and that is nearly double the amount the year prior. And the details behind these numbers are hard to contemplate, with more than 60 percent of the images featuring children younger than 12, and most of them including extreme acts of sexual violence.
after: In this market, the currency has become the content itself. It's clear that abusers have been quick to leverage new technologies, but our response as a society has not.
ru: В таких чатах подбадривают насильников, которые с каждой новой жертвой получают больше званий и славы.

quote: Sri Lanka gained the support of China, Egypt, India and Cuba.
before: The Sri Lankan government denied any wrongdoing. On Wednesday, the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva, Switzerland cleared Sri Lanka of any alleged war crimes.

quote: A drain, a weight to be endured. Getting in the way, gathering dust.
before: What are you? 30? The embarrassing unmarried daughter.
after: But thank Christ for the war. At last, function.
ru: Нахлебница, путающаяся под ногами, только и умеющая, что собирать со всех углов пыль.

quote: I'm just gathering up my evidence before I report it.
before: Who else knows about this anyway? Nobody.
after: I wanted to tell you first. Well, I appreciate that.
ru: Я просто собираю информацию для отчёта.

quote: Wait, wait, what are we gathering around for?
before: Gather round. Yes.
after: You will see. Friends, workers, as you all know, like Kanye West, I have recently acquired a daughter.
ru: Подожди, подожди, для чего нам собираться в круг?

quote: It gathers all its data, and soon enough, we have his phone cloned.
before: - How's it work? I get close enough to Owen, and his phone thinks that mine's a local cell tower.
after: And everything he's got on the stress monitor. Exactly.
ru: Он собирает все данные, и совсем скоро мы клонируем его телефон.

quote: The sails may gather energy from the solar wind.
before: Mars, on the other hand, has been unprotected because of its lack of magnetic field, and over billions of years, maybe enough atmosphere has been stripped away to account for a transition from a habitable planet to the planet that we see today. Other scientists think that magnetic fields may act more like the sails on a ship, enabling the planet to interact with more energy from the solar wind than the planet would have been able to interact with by itself.
after: The magnetic field may gather energy from the solar wind that allows even more atmospheric escape to happen. It's an idea that has to be tested, but the effect and how it works seems apparent.
ru: Паруса могут собирать энергию солнечного ветра.

quote: The way we gather matters because how we gather is how we live.
before: And it wasn't until I grew up and through conflict work that I began to stop hiding. And I realized that gatherings for me, at their best, allow us to be among others, to be seen for who we are, and to see.
after: Thank you. (Applause)
ru: То, как мы собираемся вместе, имеет значение, потому что наши встречи отражают нашу жизнь.

quote: But it was a social arena in which other people were gathering with a common motive.
before: It enabled me to send out short, 140-character messages. Also, an amazing search facility.
after: And in this case, independently of journalists, people themselves were interrogating exactly what had happened to Ian Tomlinson in his last 30 minutes of life. Individuals like these two guys.
ru: Но это была социальная арена, на которой собирались люди с общим мотивом.

quote: A jumbo screen was placed in the streets of Limerick, where thousands of Munster fans gathered.
before: The match is Biarritz's first Heineken Cup final appearance. It is Munster's third, after two final losses in the past.

quote: Our scans indicate That bertha is generating magnetic energy as we speak.
before: All I'm asking for is a little more time To allow what's happening to run its course.
after: The risks are too high. Terence--
ru: Мы установили, что Берта производит магнитную энергию, такую же как наша речь.

quote: Warm blood enables an animal to generate the abundant energy that's needed for aerobatics.
before: Some specimens of Tapejara show that it had fur. And that suggests that it was warm-blooded.
after: But, Dr Chatterjee has another imaginative and controversial interpretation of Tapejara's bizarre anatomy. What we have found special in this model, we did some simulations.
ru: Теплокровность позволяет животным производить избыточную энергию, необходимую для сложных манёвров.

quote: We can't overestimate the amount of despair that we are generating with places like this.
before: The immersive ugliness of our everyday environments in America is entropy made visible.
after: And mostly, I want to persuade you that we have to do better if we're going to continue the project of civilization in America. By the way, this doesn't help.
ru: Невозможно переоценить уровень отчаяния, порождаемого такими пространствами.

quote: It can generate action and reaction.
before: (Speaks Spanish) A fallen king chess piece in red. (Speaks Spanish) A good cartoon has a lot of power.
after: That's why a cartoonist must exercise their power responsibly, showcasing the truth and drawing without the fear of consequences. (Speaks Spanish) Having an opinion has a cost, and in some countries, that cost is high.
ru: Она порождает действие и противодействие.

quote: White phosphorus is a spontaneously flammable chemical used in battlefield illumination or to generate smoke screens.
after: Contact with the substance results in burning and melting of skin and flesh. According to an account of a former US soldier, the phosphorus explodes and forms a plume, killing everyone within a 150 metre radius.

quote: In my country, when you turn 16, you get your turkey.
before: Congratulations, Luke! You're finally a man!
after: Wait, you made the video before you decided to come back early. Were you gonna keep the turkey in there for four days?
ru: В моей стране, когда тебе исполняется 16, ты получаешь индейку.

quote: We get a lot of bodies in and out of here.
before: How is that not a big deal? This is Los Angeles.
after: It happens. You never lose your car keys?
ru: Мы получаем много тел, отсюда и нет.

quote: And I might actually be getting there slowly.
before: I'm sorry for your parents. I'm sorry that I'm not the man you thought I was, but John reminded me, as he does, that I'm trying to be that man...
after: In the meantime, I would really appreciate your patience. Sounds reasonable to me.
ru: И, возможно, хоть и медленно, но у меня получается.

quote: Applied Minds has enough play money that we can go and just work on something without getting anybody's funding or permission or anything.
before: And he took me through specific examples of when he really needed it. And I realized, wow, this would really make a big difference, if we could do it, and so I said, " Well, let's look at it. "
after: So we started playing around with this. And as we did it, we realized this was the basic problem — that taking the sip of coffee — that there were humans doing this complicated process and that what really needed to be done was to automate this process like an assembly line and build robots that would measure proteomics.
ru: У "Applied Minds" есть неплохой бюджет, который позволяет нам работать над чем-то, не получая ничьего разрешения или финансирования.

quote: I want them to be able to ask for what they want in bed, and to get it.
before: I want them to see sexuality as a source of self-knowledge, creativity and communication, despite its potential risks. I want them to be able to revel in their bodies' sensuality without being reduced to it.
after: I want them to be safe from unwanted pregnancy, disease, cruelty, dehumanization, violence. If they are assaulted, I want them to have recourse from their schools, their employers, the courts.
ru: Я хочу, чтобы они могли просить о том, чего они хотят в постели, и получать это.

quote: They had a leader board where, if you recommended the best stories, you would get points.
before: Digg is a communal dynamic to try to find and source the best news, the most interesting stories. And they made this into a game, initially.
after: And that really motivated people to find the best stories. But it became so powerful, there was actually a cabal, a group of people, the top seven on the leader board, who would work together to make sure they maintained that position, recommending people's stories.
ru: У них есть таблица лидеров, где вы, если находите лучшие истории, получаете очки.

quote: Oh, but you got along with him okay?
before: Oh, well, it wasn't my own trailer. That director kid had the big trailer.
after: Well, yeah, I mean, you know, we had to-- I tell you, Millie, the kid is like-- he looked like an alien.
ru: Но ты с ним нормально ладил?

quote: Why do you have to get along with everyone you work with?
before: - You do? - Yeah.
after: We didn't get along when we first started working together. Yeah, and I hated that.
ru: Почему тебе хочется ладить со всеми коллегами?

quote: I didn't always get along with my teammates.
before: Well, this is sort of funny. It reminds me of the old days, when I played football.
after: But on Sunday we put all that bullshit aside and played together. I don't get it.
ru: Я не всегда ладил с членами команды.

quote: It's the only people he gets along with anyway.
before: Who wants to tell the patient? Fine, I'll get some kid to go talk to him.
after: Are we still fired? He works with abandoned kids.
ru: Он всё равно только с ними и ладит.

quote: We can't get along with other people, even in our own families.
before: Why do we have these wars in every generation, and in every part of the world? And revolutions?
after: We find ourselves in the paralyzing grip of self-destructive habits we can't break. Racism and injustice and violence sweep our world, bringing a tragic harvest of heartache and death.
ru: Мы не умеем ладить с другими людми, даже в наших собственных семьях.

quote: Because I don't think they should get away with it.
before: No, I'm not. Someone threw a man off a bridge and I want to know who did it and why.
after: Because that is my job and I'm sick of people trying to stop me from doing it. GROANS IN PAIN Oh, my God.
ru: Потому что я не считаю, что это должно сойти им с рук.

quote: It's just me telling him he can get away with anything.
before: Which means it's too late for me to back down. It's no longer my choice.
after: I have to send him to prison. Your job is to keep this machine running.
ru: Как будто я говорю ему, что ему может сойти с рук что угодно.

quote: Then you know why he can't get away with it.
before: But victim or perpetrator, if your number's up, we'll find you. We know about Quinn and what he did to Cal.
after: Where are we taking him? Fed building downtown.
ru: Тогда вы знаете, почему это не может сойти ему с рук.

quote: She doesn't just get to get away with this!
before: And does that make you feel important? Are you enjoying this? !
after: I'm sick of that bitch! I'm sick of you!
ru: Ей не должно это просто так сойти с рук!

quote: I just wanted to get back to you on that message about Chesapeake Bay.
before: The larvae he swallowed in the bay had grown into a full-sized parasite in eight hours from the toxic soup. Hi, this is Steve Slattery over at Homeland Security.
after: Yeah? And? Yeah, uh... turns out we did hear something a few weeks back about a couple divers' bodies being found in the water.
ru: Я хотел ответить вам на то сообщение о Чесапикском заливе.

quote: I'll get back to you as soon as I know anything.
before: Consider it done. I'll just, I'll drop Nadia off and then I'm all yours.
after: Thanks. Well, if it is drugs these kids are not gonna narc to a teacher.
ru: Я вернусь к вам как только узнаю что нибудь.

quote: We'll get back to you as soon as we have something.
before: Damn strange business. First his car blows up, and then somebody tries to kill him.
after: Dougie, you can take the rest of the day off. Well, that's great, because I can take him to the doctor.
ru: Мы свяжемся с вами, как только что-то узнаем.

quote: I told them that I was doing a project, had some questions and at some point may possibly get back to them.
before: AS: I did video recorded interviews with several Scientologists – they didn't know what the interviews were for.
after: I asked them questions about themselves, their skills, where they stood on Scientology training and counseling, etc. I then weeded out the ones that I didn't think would be appropriate for the personal staff of Tom Cruise and for those who seemed promising, I compiled their video with contact information and sent it to Shelly Miscavige. She would forward to Andrea (TC's Assistant at the time) any she thought were good.
ru: Я сказал им, что делаю проект, что у меня есть вопросы и что когда-нибудь, возможно, я с ними свяжусь.

quote: Meaning that your firm, it pays its employees the minimum, just enough to get by and remain a permanent underclass.
before: I think what Allen is implying is that there are wage slaves. Meaning what?
after: Are you accusing me of exploitation? Are you ever coming in here?
ru: То есть твоя фирма платит сотрудникам минимум — ровно столько, чтобы сводить концы с концами, — и они навсегда остаются низшим классом.
source_ru: Это то, что твоя фирма платит сотрудникам минимум, ровно столько, сколько нужно, чтобы оставаться низшим классом.

quote: I never thought I'd be the guy who just got by.
before: You'll cram and you'll survive. All my life, I was who I was because I was the smartest.
after: You know what I don't get, is if you're having so much trouble, how is everybody else getting through this? But polarity reverses in a sub-quantum flux.
ru: Никогда не думал, что стану тем, кто просто кое-как перебивается.
source_ru: Я не думал, что буду тем парнем, который прорвется.

quote: You're gonna be okay, John. A lot of people get by with nine toes.
before: You owe me a toe, Bartowski. There.
after: - I'm getting by fine with eight. - How much is a toe worth to Casey?
ru: Всё будет хорошо, Джон. Многие прекрасно обходятся девятью пальцами на ногах.
source_ru: Множество людей ходит с девятью пальцами на ноге.

quote: And the rest of us, the vast majority of us, struggle to get by.
before: And I asked myself the question: How is it possible that we could be so poor here in the United States, because coal is such a wealthy resource; it's so much money? And I realize: because the Chinese ingratiated themselves with a small ruling class here in the United States, who stole all of that money and all of that wealth for themselves.
after: And the Chinese gave this small ruling elite loads of military weapons and sophisticated technology in order to ensure that people like me would not speak out against this relationship. Does this sound familiar?
ru: А остальные, подавляющее большинство из нас, еле сводят концы с концами.
source_ru: А что до остальных, мы - подавляющее большинство вынуждены прозябать в нищете.

quote: Other people do all sorts of jobs to get by.
before: Under our apartment, there is a carpenter, sweetshops, a butcher, a printing house, workshops, among many more. I have started teaching part-time, and with my husband, who juggles several jobs, we've opened a small bookshop.
after: When I look at my destroyed city, of course, I ask myself: What has led to this senseless war? Syria was largely a place of tolerance, historically accustomed to variety, accommodating a wide range of beliefs, origins, customs, goods, food.
ru: Другие люди берутся за любую работу, чтобы выжить.

quote: Give us enough to get by but not enough to provide for ourselves.
before: Oho! Oh, it all makes sense.
after: Keep us psychologically feeble so we lose our purpose in the process. Stop thieving our aspirations out of our sleep.
ru: Дайте нам достаточно, чтобы кое-как обходиться, но недостаточно, чтобы обеспечивать себя.
source_ru: О, всё это очень продуманно. Дайте нам вдоволь, чтобы едва держаться на плаву, но не больше.

quote: Oh don't worry about me; get on with the tunnel.
before: Ah... you're lucky. I think it's only temporary paralysis.
after: Thanks to you and Jamie it's nearly finished. Doctor, I think the Dominators have finished drilling too.
ru: О, не беспокойтесь обо мне; продолжайте туннель.

quote: Just get on with it, Inspector.
before: Oh, no, we're not. Eddie, do shut up.
after: Thank you. Ms Viviani, Mr Grace - good afternoon.
ru: - Продолжайте, инспектор.

quote: Would everybody please get on with their tasks?
before: So, how old are you? None of your business how old I am.
after: Morning. Thank you.
ru: Пожалуйста, все продолжайте свою работу.

quote: Just get on with it.
before: A hamster with a blunt penknife would do it quicker! You ordered me to make no noise, master.
after: Cheer up. It'll all be over soon.
ru: Просто продолжай.

quote: Quinn's preggo and feels that she's totally alone... and Sue won't leave Will alone... as the poor guy's trying to get over... divorcing his terrible wife Terri.
before: - I think I kinda like her. I don't want her to get hurt.
after: I mean, she's not terrible. - She's just kinda, you know, terrible. - Sorry.
ru: Квинн беременна и чувствует себя совершенно одинокой. И Сью все никак не оставит Уилла в покое, в то время как бедняга пытается пережить развод со своей ужасной женой Терри.

quote: The poor kid can't get over it.
before: - What about Isabelle? He dropped her.
after: Emilie surprised me. She seemed like a nice girl.
ru: Бедный ребенок не может прийти в себя.

quote: Or maybe I just need to get over it.
before: I actually convinced myself that he was in some remote mountain region and couldn't accept my calls. Or maybe he just doesn't want to bother you with every half-lead that goes nowhere.
after: Thanks for the books. Elena on phone:
ru: Или может быть, мне просто нужно пережить это.

quote: We all have to get over it. Okay.
before: Yes. I won't see Vivienne again, you won't see Vivienne again and he won't see Vivienne again.
after: Now, bounce me up. I'm not moving until you play with me.
ru: Нам всем нужно это пережить Ясно?

quote: And maybe if you come back to a close, cohesive, tribal society, you can get over trauma pretty quickly.
before: When their warriors came back from fighting the US military or fighting each other, I bet they pretty much just slipped right back into tribal life. And maybe what determines the rate of long-term PTSD isn't what happened out there, but the kind of society you come back to.
after: And if you come back to an alienating, modern society, you might remain traumatized your entire life. In other words, maybe the problem isn't them, the vets; maybe the problem is us.
ru: Может, вернувшись в сплочённое, закрытое общество, можно быстро оправиться от травмы.

quote: That is something that I did not get over.
before: A camp counselor fortunately came over and separated us. From that point onward I was terrified of swimming.
after: My inability to swim has been one of my greatest humiliations and embarrassments. That is when I realized that I was not the Incredible Hulk.
ru: Это был страх, от которого я не смог оправиться.

quote: One of the most off-putting things you can say is, "Just get over it."
before: It's not hard science, but I worked with a lot people I know who've lived with depression to refine these suggestions. First up, some things you might want to avoid — some " don'ts. "
after: Great idea — love it, it's just we already thought of that. (Laughter) The absence of the ability to just get over it is depression.
ru: Одна из самых отталкивающих фраз, которую вы можете сказать: «Просто переживи это».

quote: That eager to get rid of me, huh?
before: Also for two. You can't believe these forms.
after: Hey, you know those, uh, little berets you guys wear? You got any extra?
ru: Так хочешь от меня избавиться?

quote: To elaborate, I want your wife, the teacher, to help get rid of Lisa's substitute.
before: Don't want to hit you. I want your wife.
after: Edna? You know how you said you could help me with any desire, and nothing was forbidden?
ru: В смысле, мне нужна твоя жена-училка, чтобы помочь Лизе избавиться от учительницы на замену.

quote: But I became disenchanted, so I had to get rid of her.
before: I-I thought you already were married. Yes, I was.
after: Through divorce. Where's your sense of humor?
ru: Но я разочаровался, так что пришлось от нее избавиться.

quote: Why do I feel like you're trying to get rid of me?
before: You might want to beat traffic, so... I thought you'd be happy that I was here.
after: I have no idea. It's not because you're a jinx.
ru: Почему у меня такое чувство, что ты пытаешься избавиться от меня?

quote: Even if you don't want them, you can't get rid of them.
before: Those are the ones that you can't delete if you're an iPhone person. You press on them and they don't jiggle and they don't have x's.
after: (Laughter) Those are like the core genes of Prochlorococcus. They're the essence of the phone.
ru: Даже если они вам не нужны, вам от них не избавиться.

quote: First is, everybody says we're going to get rid of a lot of cars.
before: What are your concerns or issues about them? Peter Calthorpe: Well, I think there's almost too much hype here.
after: What they don't say is you're going to get a lot more vehicle miles. You're going to get a lot more cars moving on streets.
ru: Во-первых, говорят, что мы сможем избавиться от большого количества машин,

quote: People burn trash to get rid of the garbage, and they dig their own sewer channels.
before: People steal electrical power — this is Rio. People tap in and they have thieves who are called " grillos " or " crickets, " and they steal the electrical power and wire the neighborhood.
after: Talk about more plastic bags than plankton. And sometimes they have natural trash-disposal.
ru: Чтобы избавиться от мусора, его сжигают. И они сами себе роют каналы канализации.

quote: So the killer got stuck in, threw a few punches.
before: Hang on. Heavy bruising, upper torso.
after: Here. Partially fractured spine.
ru: Ну убийца застрял, ударил несколько раз.

quote: The wheel got stuck in a open manhole.
before: Oh, brother. Uh-huh. I made it seven blocks before I smashed into the construction barricade.
after: And when Frank found out...? It was not pretty.
ru: Колесо застряло в открытом люке.

quote: I mean, what if we got stuck out there?
before: Yes, there is. We-- we have to go back and... get all our supplies.
after: We will go to your camp. It is on the way to where we will take you.
ru: Вдруг мы здесь застрянем надолго?

quote: Who knows what they wanted me for before you got stuck with me?
before: Look, it's pretty simple, ok? If we make it to the base and it's still up and running I might not make it out alive.
after: Hell if I know. It's gotta be a cure though, right?
ru: Кто знает, чего от меня хотели, пока ты со мной не застрял?

quote: I got stuck and I made it through.
before: This is an amazing feeling of calmness, being the only person in the world who knows a new law of nature. And I started the second project in my Ph.D, and it happened again.
after: And I started thinking, maybe there's a pattern here. I asked the other graduate students, and they said, " Yeah, that's exactly what happened to us, except nobody told us about it. "
ru: Я застрял, и прошёл через это испытание.

quote: And the third: a mysterious stranger has gotten stuck squeezing through the bars on her window.
before: The first: a prison cell. The second: complete amnesia.
after: His name is Hedge, and he has come to help Ethic save the world. But first they have to break out of jail.
ru: Третий — странный незнакомец застрял, пытаясь протиснуться сквозь решётку на окне.

quote: (Robot buzzes) (Singing) Oh no, it got stuck.
before: So, we're all good. OK.
after: Isn't it comforting that even robots sometimes get stage fright? It just gets stuck a little bit.
ru: (Жужжание робота) (Пение) О, нет, он застрял.

quote: I'm sure you could get the hang of it pretty quick.
before: I'm available whenever. We're not splitting the atom, okay?
after: But if you can't deal with customers Or you get bored and quit on me, Then we're gonna be short-staffed And I'm gonna have to go through all this again.
ru: Я уверена, вы освоитесь довольно быстро.

quote: It's not too bad when you get the hang of it.
before: Delicious. How do you like your school, Elliott?
after: That's wonderful. How do you think Greta will go?
ru: Не так плохо, если приноровиться.

quote: I doubt he'll ever get the hang of it.
before: I say just be yourself and stop trying so hard. "Be interested..." Ha.
after: Robert didn't rebel. He didn't ask questions.
ru: Сомневаюсь, что он когда-нибудь с этим освоится.

quote: It takes a little time to get the hang of it at first.
before: DAPHNE [ON RECORDER]: I was lying in bed wearing a whipped-cream teddy. But did he care?
after: My God, you should've heard my audition tape. - I was so inept it was incredible.
ru: Потребуется какое-то время, чтобы приноровиться.

quote: I got to get up to this floor more often, huh?
before: Wow. That's some good skinny.
after: They're joking. They're here on official police business.
ru: Мне стоит подниматься на этот этаж почаще, а?

quote: Now, if you passed the test, go ahead and get up and exit the classroom.
before: Everyone could see that they had chemistry together, but it wasn't until Donny Richter's algebra class that the real bonding began. Okay, I don't want to embarrass anyone, so, everyone, close your eyes, close 'em.
after: Does that include the crew? No, the "Babies Having Babies" crew... - 38.
ru: Теперь, если вы закончили с тестом, вставайте и выходите из класса.

quote: You didn't get up to see why the baby wasn't crying.
before: The old Dan Logan charm. The baby didn't cry.
after: The phone didn't ring. Your neighbor didn't stop by and borrow some sugar--
ru: - Ты не вставала проверить, почему малышка не плачет.

quote: I just have to get up early tomorrow to grind out a piece before Friday.
before: Oh, come on, Chris, I was just kidding around. No, it's fine.
after: Goodnight, Mom. Oh!
ru: Мне завтра рано вставать, чтобы со всем управиться до пятницы.

quote: (Video) Roy Neary: Get up, get up! I'm not kidding. Ronnie Neary: Is there an accident?
before: Stu Pickles: Because I've lost control of my life. (Laughter) Rives: And then there was the lone TEDster who was disgruntled I had overlooked what he considers to be a classic.
after: Roy: No, it's not an accident. You wanted to get out of the house anyway, right?
ru: (Видео) Рой Нери: Вставай! Я не шучу. Ронни Нери: Что-то случилось?

quote: If you sit a lot, get up and move around on occassion, and be sure to exercise.
before: Keep anything you're carrying close to your body. Backpacks should be in contact with your back carried symetrically.
after: Using your muscles will keep them strong enough to support you effectively, on top of all the other benefits to your joints, bones, brain and heart. And if you're really worried, check with a physical therapist, because yes, you really should stand up straight.
ru: Если вы много сидите, вставайте и двигайтесь при любом удобном случае. И обязательно делайте упражнения.

quote: You're both getting up. Here we go. Good, now? Them.
before: And... bam, bake... (clicks metronome) Great. Okay, from there, you're both getting up.
after: (Applause) So from there, from there, we're both getting up, we're both getting up, going in this direction, going underneath. Whoa, whoa, underneath.
ru: Вы вдвоём, вставайте. Вот и мы. Хорошо.

quote: She owns a small business, and she loves to give, not as much as she loves to receive.
before: I'll find someone else with a business. What about Sophie?
after: I'm not so sure Sophie's cleaning business is totally, well, legal. I mean, when we worked for her, on the memo line of our paycheck, she wrote "colonoscopy."
ru: У нее есть маленький бизнес, и она любит давать, конечно не так сильно, как она любит получать.

quote: And I've really missed giving it.
before: Yeah. I have really missed your advice, Ms. Grant.
after: Now, shoo. Up, up and away. No time to lose.
ru: А я скучала по даванию советов.

quote: You gave me the world's finest jewels, but no wedding ring.
before: I've never wanted to be free. When I met you at the jewelry shop, I thought I'd get 29 years straight.
after: Who said: "Never wed your mistress, "for marriage is love's perfect murder."? You have more like that?
ru: Ты дарил мне самые прекрасные в мире украшения. Но ни разу - обручального кольца.

quote: Let me give you some examples of my work.
before: We all can contribute towards change. Like I said, I'm a designer and I would like to change things through design.
after: I'm collaborating with Swarovski, the crystal company. And if you cut crystals in a certain way, you are able to bend and direct the light onto a certain place.
ru: Давайте я приведу несколько примеров своих работ.

quote: And the final one is that most anti-economic of activities, but give.
before: It can be learning to cook a new dish, picking up an instrument you forgot as a child. Keep learning.
after: Our generosity, our altruism, our compassion, are all hardwired to the reward mechanism in our brain. We feel good if we give.
ru: И последний поступок самый анти-экономический из всех. Дарите.

quote: America gave them weapons, gave them money, gave them support, encouragement.
before: And we forget this now, but back then the Mujahideen were celebrated in this country, in America. We thought of them as holy warriors who were taking the good fight to the ungodly communists.
after: But within that group, a tiny, smaller group, a minority within a minority within a minority, were coming up with a new and dangerous conception of jihad, and in time this group would come to be led by Osama bin Laden, and he refined the idea. His idea of jihad was a global war of terror, primarily targeted at the far enemy, at the crusaders from the West, against America.
ru: Америка давала им оружие, деньги, оказывала поддержку, поощряла.

quote: Mohammadi was given a sentence of 14 years, with a minimum non-parole period of seven years.
before: Maio, changed his plea to guilty during the trial, and was sentenced to 12-and-a-half years in jail, with a non-parole period of six years. Judge Kerry Cullinane sentenced Labanon to six years jail, He was ordered to serve at least three years before being eligible for parole.

quote: We should never give in to these vile pagans, to these brutes.
before: - There is, alas, no other way. - Father, I beg you, ignore this counsel of despair.
after: Otherwise we will have failed, and that is how we would be judged. - Your Highness, I think you must...
ru: Мы не должны поддаваться этим мерзким язычникам, этим скотам.

quote: But despite the bitterness of loss, you can not give in to anger.
before: I understand how you hard. We have all lost loved ones and friends.
after: You can not. People have been waiting for thousands of years... contact.
ru: Но несмотря на горечь утраты, нельзя поддаваться гневу.

quote: But you had to give up a successful career of your own.
before: When Rick had a passion, there was no stopping him. I loved that about him.
after: High-end sales type of business. Following someone else's dream must be, uh...
ru: Но вам пришлось бросить успешную карьеру.

quote: I paid for you to go to rehab. I gave up Abby for you.
before: That it is ours. What's wrong?
after: Now you want me to buy you a business? It never ends.
ru: Я заплатил за твою реабилитацию, я бросил ради тебя Эбби.

quote: Who gave up the woman he loved for zombies.
before: A human who you told about us. A human who risked his life for zombies.
after: Yeah. That guy.
ru: Тот, кто бросил любимую женщину ради зомби.

quote: I'm not ready to give up on this just yet.
before: If I stay with the Tok'ra, I can at least try to mend some fences. Are you sure?
after: Don't worry, I'll be back eventually. I'll miss you.
ru: Я пока не готов сдаваться относительно этого.

quote: The three things I did sort of blurt out when we got there, was first: Never, ever give up.
before: And we'll never forget it. It'll always be part of us.
after: I live it. What's the phrase from today from Socrates?
ru: Я брякнула какие-то три вещи, когда мы добрались до берега. Во-первых, «Никогда, никогда не сдаваться».

quote: It takes time, it takes a tolerance for failure, it takes individual people choosing every day not to give up.
before: But those discoveries come with a cost. It took thousands of people and 44 years to get the Hubble Space Telescope from an idea into orbit.
after: I know how hard that choice is because I live it. The reality of my job is that I fail almost all the time and still keep going, because that's how telescopes get built.
ru: и запустить его на орбиту. Для этого нужно время, нужно уметь мириться с неудачами, нужны люди, которые каждый день принимают решение не сдаваться.

quote: On some days, it means not giving up, continuing to swim in freezing water and setting a world record.
before: Even today, when I can't find motivation or joy in what I'm doing, all I ask myself is, " Is this the best I can do right now? " And the meaning of my " best " changes.
after: But on many other days, it means getting over my depressing thoughts, stepping out of the house and being able to do the daily chores. What does not change is that voice within.
ru: Иногда оно означает — не сдаваться, продолжать плыть в ледяной воде с целью установить мировой рекорд.

quote: Didn't you know she convinced Remi to go to the Congo without me?
before: Thank you. Why didn't you tell your mother you were home?
after: You should be in school, making something of your life. You're trying to control me.
ru: Вы что, забыли, что это она убедила Реми ехать в Конго без меня?

quote: Well we don't even have to go to Houston, we can come very close to home.
before: So belief systems and biases, literacy and misinformation. How do we step out of the boxes that are cornering our perceptions?
after: (Laughter) Remember " Snowpocalypse? " (Laughter) Snowmageddon?
ru: Для этого не нужно ехать в Хьюстон, это можно сделать и в родном городе.

quote: The demonstration in London set off from Parliament square and went to Hyde park.
after: Organisers' figures for attendance (100,000) differ greatly from the police's estimate of only 10,000. Stop the War Coalition, the Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament (CND) and the Muslim Association of Britain (MAB) jointly organised the demonstration.

quote: Turns out she's going through a difficult time as well.
before: Mmm, vanilla. So, we got to talking.
after: Next thing I know, we're cleaning out her locker at the strip club and driving to Vegas. Where you got married.
ru: Оказалось, что она тоже переживает трудные времена.

quote: I don't mean to belittle what you are going through.
before: Good. Very good.
after: The queen crossed a line. But the Dhampir must always bow down.
ru: Я не хочу преуменьшить то, через что вы проходите.

quote: I can't imagine what you guys are going through.
before: I heard your podcast this morning. Thanks for what you said about Riley.
after: Yeah. You don't want to.
ru: Не могу представить, через что вы проходите.

quote: For the record, I don't want to go through that again.
before: I was going to say your prelim neuro looks good. The symptoms are different from last time.
after: You shaved my head. I was, like, an ug-mo troll for weeks until I could get extensions going.
ru: Учтите, я не хочу снова проходить через это.

quote: Today, my aunt, she's fighting bravely and going through this process with a very positive attitude.
before: We cannot lose the war against cancer. It not only costs us billions of dollars, but it also costs us the people we love.
after: However, I want fights like this to become very rare. I want to see the day when cancer is treated easily because it can be routinely diagnosed at the very early stages, and I'm certain that in the very near future, because of this and other breakthroughs that we are seeing every day in the life sciences, the way we see cancer will radically change.
ru: Сегодня моя тётя мужественно сражается и проходит через это испытание с позитивным настроем.

quote: This -- I on purpose -- they go through life stages.
before: (Applause) So, thank you, John, thank you, and get back to work, all right, man? All right — (Laughter) — no, it's very painful, so — (Laughter) — these are little Pleos and you can probably see them.
after: So when you first get them, they're babies. And you — more you have them, kind of the older they get, and they kind of learn through their behavior.
ru: Моя цель — они должны проходить через стадии жизни.

quote: Meaning: The artistic director doesn't necessarily need to go through our lobby.
before: Now, that theater machine has ability to move between a whole series of configurations at the push of a button and a few stagehands in a short amount of time. But it also has the potential to not only provide multiform but multi-processional sequences.
after: One of the things that we learned when we visited various theaters is they hate us architects, because they say the first thing they have to do, the first five minutes of any show, is they have to get our architecture out of the mind of their patron. Well now there are potentials of this building to allow the artistic director to actually move into the building without using our architecture.
ru: Это значит, что художественному директору нет необходимости непременно проходить через вестибюль.

quote: Even if he knows he can't refuse, he always attempts to make it appear he's granting you permission.
before: -What? The Castellan agreed too quickly to our visiting the Doctor.
after: I mean, that's the Castellan's way. So soon?
ru: Даже если он знает, что не может отказать, обычно он всегда пытается представить это в таком свете, будто он предоставляет разрешение.

quote: Then she called the provisional government and informed them she was granting Kubus sanctuary.
before: Winn then asked for the use of my computer. She accessed information from the library.
after: - Do you know what she looked up? - I'm trying to find out.
ru: Затем она вызвала временное правительство и сообщила им, что предоставляет Кубусу убежище.

quote: This ronin from Hiroshima, Master Hanshiro Tsugumo, is to be granted use of the courtyard to perform harakiri.
before: Master Tsugumo, since you are unswerving in your resolve, I shall grant your wish. Attendant!
after: His present dress will not do. Give him fresh robes befitting one who journeys to the next world.
ru: Господину Ханширо Цугумо - ронину из Хиросимы - предоставляется наш двор для совершения ритуала харакири.

quote: Harry Farr, whose family had appealed to the Defence Secretary to grant a full, posthumous pardon.
before: The proposed pardon will include the case of Pte.
after: The Ministry of Defence informed the family lawyers of the decision hours before making a public announcement.

quote: You know, that grow out of the ground?
before: Trees? Yeah, real ones.
after: Hello? Sorry, it's just...
ru: Понимаешь, которые из земли растут.

quote: With the Earth Republic at our side, this town will only prosper and grow.
before: I like my chances. Ms. Rosewater, Defiance could use a friend like the Earth Republic.
after: I'm not letting you resign. If Datak wins this election, he is gonna kick open the doors to Colonel Marsh and his E-Rep goons, and a year from now, you won't even recognize this place.
ru: С таким союзником, как Земная республика этот город будет расти и процветать.

quote: You grow with him. I feel I've grown.
before: Malte is such a breath of fresh air. It doesn't matter if you're from Nibe or Hollywood.
after: Malte has helped us grow, hasn't he? If Malte wasn't gay, I bet he'd be a fantastic lover. Hey!
ru: Общение с ним помогает мне расти.

quote: Despite a low BPS, the growing trading volume caught my eye.
before: If you look at this day, there is a huge purchase. I predicted the rigging period to be three months.
after: A pullback here meant that the manipulators... Mr. Lee.
ru: Несмотря на низкую БСА, в глаза бросается растущий объем торгов

quote: Every single one of these plants grew from a seed that planted itself there.
before: Now, this may sound like the beginning of the High Line story in Manhattan, and it's very similar, except they haven't developed this into a park yet, although they're working on it. So for now, it's still this little sort of secret wilderness in the heart of Philadelphia, and if you know where the hole is in the chain-link fence, you can scramble up to the top and you can find this completely wild meadow just floating above the city of Philadelphia.
after: This is completely autonomous, self-willed nature. And it's right in the middle of the city.
ru: Здесь каждое растение выросло из семечка, попавшего сюда случайно.

quote: We'll also need to grow more food with less water.
before: Now, you might not think in terms of oil and food as being linked, but there's a very strong link, in fact. It takes 10 calories of fossil fuel energy in our highly industrialized food system in order to produce one calorie of food energy.
after: These three images come from three very different parts of the planet, but they all tell the same story of catastrophic drought. We'll also need to grow more food with less farmland.
ru: Нам также придётся растить больше еды с меньшим количеством воды.

quote: India has the youngest growing population in the world.
before: Right? And the last thing we point out in this slide, which is, you know, that to this story, there's one caveat.
after: This demographic dividend is incredible, but paradoxically, there's also the mirage of mighty labor pools. Indian institutes and educational system, with a few exceptions, are incapable of producing students in the quantity and quality needed to keep this innovation engine going, so companies are finding innovative ways to overcome this, but in the end it does not absolve the government of the responsibility for creating this educational structure.
ru: Индия имеет наиболее молодое растущее население в мире.

quote: So we grew up during the same period of time.
before: 71. All right, so we're the same age.
after: And your father was a trumpet player?

quote: I want to be you when I grow up.
before: She's certainly got my attention. You're an impressive man.
after: I get so tired of this guy. Aren't you tired?
ru: Я хочу быть тобой, когда вырасту.

quote: Abel, maybe you're gonna grow up and be a doctor like your mom someday.
before: She's sick. TARA: That's nice of you.
after: (phone ringing) GEMMA: Hello.
ru: Абель, возможно, когда ты вырастешь, то станешь доктором, как твоя мама.

quote: That I'd never see Alice again, see my baby born, grow up.
before: When I got lost through my own stupidity... I was terrified that no one would ever find me.

after: SS: So we have a bi-species environment, we call it a " panhomoculture. " We're learning how to become like them.
ru: Большое спасибо. Ведущий: Никто из нас, ни бонобо, ни человек, не может даже представить себе?

quote: Can you imagine how it hits him in the gut?
before: And to sit here and see this going on in his own country? Can you imagine what kind of a reaction he has?
after: How he would decide to put his life on the line?

quote: I know that there are changes that you want to implement.
before: - I am so flattered. - I know education is your passion. It is.
after: - There are, but... - There is no better place to affect change on a municipal level than from the mayor's office.
ru: Я знаю, что у тебя есть идеи, которые ты хочешь реализовать.

quote: I urge you all to vote to implement this.
before: It is restrictive, it is non-negotiable... But it is fair, and, better still, it is unambiguous.
after: Looking back, it's easy to see when a mistake has been made... ♪ ooh-ooh-ooh, ooh-ooh, ooh-ooh-ooh ♪ ♪ ooh-ooh-ooh, ooh-ooh, ooh-ooh-ooh ♪
ru: Я призываю вас всех проголосовать, чтобы реализовать это.

quote: For one thing, it hasn't been implemented yet.
before: Are you sure that's a good idea? What's the problem?
after: I know that. It's just that polling is a science and this wouldn't be a proper...
ru: - Во-первых, реформу ещё не внедрили.

quote: And you want to see it implemented around the country?
before: You like Governor Vargas' free-education plan, don't you? That's correct.
after: I really do. Then why did you torpedo it on national television?
ru: И вы хотите, чтоб он был реализован по всей стране?

quote: There's a possibility of this being implemented and saving a good portion of those.
before: So now we're in a situation where we have a product, which is actually better than what you can buy in Haiti in the marketplace, which is a very wonderful place to be. In Haiti alone, about 30 million trees are cut down every year.
after: In addition, the revenue generated from that charcoal is 260 million dollars. That's an awful lot for a country like Haiti — with a population of eight million and an average income of less than 400 dollars.
ru: Но есть возможность внедрить нашу технологию и спасти приличное количество деревьев.

quote: They wanted to implement standard care practices in hospitals and health systems throughout the country.
before: There are some places that have actually adopted these standards, and it's really making a difference. A few years ago, the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists joined forces with other healthcare organizations, researchers like myself and community organizations.
after: And the vehicle they're using is a program called the Alliance for Innovation in Maternal Health, the AIM program. Their goal is to lower maternal mortality and severe maternal morbidity rates through quality and safety initiatives across the country.
ru: Они захотели внедрить стандартные процедуры помощи в больницах и медицинских учреждениях по всей стране.

quote: He designed a state in "The Republic," a design never implemented.
before: Other designs I really couldn't afford, like the 1974 911 Targa. In school, I studied nothing close to design or engineering; I studied useless things like the Classics, but there were some lessons even there — this guy, Plato, it turns out he's a designer.
after: Listen to one of the design features of Plato's Government 4.0: " The State in which the rulers are most reluctant to govern is always the best and most quietly governed, and the State in which they are most eager, the worst. " Well, got that wrong, didn't we?
ru: Он придумал целое государство в «Республике», дизайн, который так и не был реализован.

quote: You can write DVDs that don't implement the DRM.
before: I've been told you can't make and sell Blu-ray discs that anyone can copy. That was one example of a change for the worst compared with DVDs.

quote: She knew that she had improved in appearance.
before: Besides, she was not sure that she was really face to face again with the bitter problem of self-sustenance. Anyhow, there was one change for the better.
after: Her manner had vastly changed. Her clothes were becoming, and men—well-dressed men, some of the kind who before had gazed at her indifferently from behind their polished railings and imposing office partitions—now gazed into her face with a soft light in their eyes.
ru: Она знала, что похорошела.

quote: If I'm not honest with you, you can't improve.
before: I figured you'd be the one to pick up. Why are you sending second-rate thugs to try and kill me?
after: You let me down. You didn't deliver the sapphire monkey.
ru: Если я не буду честен с тобой, ты не сможешь стать лучше.

quote: She was recovering from bypass surgery. Her-her blood pressure was improving, her oxygen saturation...
before: People do not get better from metastasized cardiac cancer. She didn't have cancer.
after: No. You're wrong. - They'd found a mass in her heart.
ru: Она оправлялась от шунтирования у неё выравнивалось кровяное давление и оксигенация крови...

quote: Can't wait to hear your notes on how to improve that.
before: I promise. We good?
after: I don't have to give notes. I only have to pretend to give notes.
ru: Не могу дождаться твоих комментариев на тему, как это можно еще улучшить.

quote: But if you have a growth mindset and think your abilities can improve, a challenge is an opportunity to learn and grow.
before: These beliefs matter because they can influence how you act when you're faced with setbacks. If you have a fixed mindset, meaning that you think your talents are locked in place, you might give up, assuming you've discovered something you're not very good at.
after: Neuroscience supports the growth mindset. The connections in your brain do get stronger and grow with study and practice.
ru: Но если у тебя установка на рост и вера в то, что таланты можно развить, то для тебя испытание — это возможность учиться и расти.

quote: Diagnosing areas where a teacher needs to improve is only half the battle.
before: [Every classroom could look like that] (Applause) Bill Gates: One day, we'd like every classroom in America to look something like that. But we still have more work to do.
after: We also have to give them the tools they need to act on the diagnosis. If you learn that you need to improve the way you teach fractions, you should be able to watch a video of the best person in the world teaching fractions.
ru: Выявление областей, над которыми учителю стоит поработать, только половина победы.

quote: On Friday, international charity organization Oxfam unveiled an action plan to improve its safeguarding systems and whole internal culture.
after: This follows a news article on February 9 in The Times, describing sexual misbehaviour by some Oxfam members on a Haiti mission following the big earthquake in 2010.
ru: В пятницу международная благотворительная организация Oxfam представила план действий, чтобы улучшить свою систему защиты от злоупотреблений и всю внутреннюю культуру.

quote: He was a drug dealer whose hobbies include murder and extortion.
before: I prefer scumbag lawyer, but, yeah, that's him. Body belongs to Melvin La Grange.
after: Let me guess, scumbag's client? Yeah, only this time he's collateral damage.
ru: Он был наркоторговцем, чье хобби включало в себя убийство и вымогательство.

quote: All of his murders, including Cindy Allen, took place in the Pacific Northwest.
before: Okay, this is one weird dude. Buried all his bodies in his own backyard.
after: There's nothing indicating that he ever visited New York City, or had any connection to the Seville family. Okay, tell me there's a "but" here.
ru: Все убийства, включая Синди Аллен, произошли на Тихоокеанском северном побережье.

quote: And that includes karaoke and mime, so take no chances.
before: And feeble though it is, I can use it to blow this whole room If I see one thing that I don't like.
after: See, clara? That's how you disguise yourself as a droid.
ru: И, что включает в себя караоке и пантомима, так не берут никаких шансов.

quote: Symptoms include anaemia, trembling, sensitivity to sunlight and erosion of teeth.
before: Tertiary syphilis. The final stage of the disease.
after: Apparently I'm the only one he wouldn't touch. How he contracted the disease is irrelevant.
ru: Симптомы включают анемию, судороги, светочувствительность и разрушение зубов.

quote: And actually, our political beliefs also can affect the way we see other people, including politicians.
before: So dieters, for instance, see apples as larger than people who are not counting calories. Softball players see the ball as smaller if they've just come out of a slump, compared to people who had a hot night at the plate.
after: So my research team and I decided to test this question. In 2008, Barack Obama was running for president for the very first time, and we surveyed hundreds of Americans one month before the election.
ru: И наши политические убеждения также сказываются на том, как мы видим людей, включая политиков.

quote: Then, each pirate, including Amaro himself, gets to vote either yarr or nay.
before: But now, they must divvy up the booty according to the pirate code. As captain, Amaro gets to propose how to distribute the coins.
after: If the vote passes, or if there's a tie, the coins are divided according to plan. But if the majority votes nay, Amaro must walk the plank and Bart becomes captain.
ru: Затем все пираты, включая самого Амаро, голосуют за этот план или против него.

quote: And then we're going to ask them to rate a bunch of things including ticklishness.
before: And in effect, what we have is some sort of stick in one hand attached to a robot, and they're going to move that back and forward. And then we're going to track that with a computer and use it to control another robot, which is going to tickle their palm with another stick.
after: I'll show you just one part of our study. And here I've taken away the robots, but basically people move with their right arm sinusoidally back and forward.
ru: Затем мы будем просить их оценить кучу вещей, включая щекотливость.

quote: Other terms being tracked included "client/server," "solution," "paradigm," "backward compatible," and the "STUN protocol."
Bring pressure to two atmospheres and then increase one atmosphere per second.
before: A weightless state has become their natural condition. Pressurise the unit.
after: Continue increasing pressure. Pressure, Spock.
ru: Поднять давление до 2-х атмосфер, а затем увеличивайте на одну атмосферу в секунду.

quote: At the same time, we are releasing vast quantities of carbon dioxide increasing the greenhouse effect.
before: Human activities brighten our landscape and our atmosphere. Might this ultimately make an ice age here?
after: The Earth need not resemble Venus very closely for it to become barren and lifeless. It may not take much to destabilize the Earth's climate to convert this heaven, our only home in the cosmos into a kind of hell.
ru: В то же время, мы создаем большое количество углекислого газа и увеличиваем парниковый эффект.

quote: But after that, increasing your income doesn't make you any happier.
before: Especially when stuff is food or a roof over your head. You know, there was this study that said money does buy happiness, up to $75,000 a year.
after: Seventy-five grand is a lot. Yeah, no.
ru: Но все-таки, увеличивая свой доход, люди не становятся счастливее.

quote: To put it into a word, it is the mechanism of scarcity that increases profits.
before: If a diamond company finds ten times the usual amount of diamonds during their mining, it means the supply of diamonds has increased, which means the cost and profit per diamond drops. The fact is: efficiency, sustainability and abundance are enemies of profit.
after: What is scarcity? Based on keeping products valuable.
ru: Одним словом, механизм таков, что именно дефицит увеличивает прибыль.

quote: There are rich and poor and the gap is increasing.
before: That will help you score better on our tests. (Applause) That was the first one.
after: It's a terrible inequality. Yeah, it's an unequal world, but when you look at the data, it's one hump.
ru: Теперь богатые и бедные. Все думают, что пропасть между ними растёт.

quote: It collects more data. It increases the accuracy of its prediction.
before: It plays itself. It collects more data.
after: And then Arthur Samuel goes back to the computer and he plays it, and he loses, and he plays it, and he loses, and he plays it, and he loses, and Arthur Samuel has created a machine that surpasses his ability in a task that he taught it. And this idea of machine learning is going everywhere.
ru: Собирает больше данных. Увеличивает точность прогнозов.

quote: And the point is, we need to carry on increasing well-being.
before: That is changing our business. That is changing the way we create our organizations, we do our government policy and we live our lives.
after: No one can go to the polls and say that quality of life is going to reduce. None of us, I think, want human progress to stop.
ru: И суть в том, что нам нужно продолжать увеличивать благополучие.

quote: By sharing this information, we encourage governments to increase awareness and acceptance of the documents.
before: We remind governments of their obligations under international treaty law, customary international law, and national constitutions to affirm the right to identification and freedom of movement. For example, we cite the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, the UN Charter, and constitutional human rights provisions as the legal basis.

quote: We won't know until we get the autopsy, but contracted pupils, sudden coma, could indicate poison.
before: Any enemies? Surely you don't suspect murder.
after: If the press get hold of this, I'm ruined. Are you alright?
ru: Мы не узнаем, пока не сделаем вскрытие, но суженные зрачки и внезапная кома могут указывать на яд.

quote: Spatter pattern indicates it's a high forced event.
before: Blood evidence. Myself and Miss Watson found it and examined it closely.
after: He's saying the blood came from someone who was hit in the nose. Okay.
ru: Брызги крови указывают на то, что завязалась кровавая драка.

quote: The oval and striation residue marks indicate the use of naphthenate and boric acid as accelerants.
before: He didn't do it. Uh, all of the souvenirs indicate that they came from a green-flame fire.
after: The toaster and the Buddha trace back to fires in Seattle two years ago. Indicating that the green flame started fires in Seattle before he moved to Portland.
ru: Борозды и овальные следы возгорания указывают, что катализатор — нафтенат и борная кислота.

quote: We have evidence that indicates William Bell may be involved with several biological attacks.
before: Because whatever is in those cases is going to destroy us all. Previously, on Fringe...
after: I will turn this world over looking for him. William Bell is not in this world.
ru: У нас есть доказательства, каторые указывают на причастность Уильяма Белла к серии биологических атак.

quote: And so this is just indicating the tremendous thirst for this kind of open, free content.
before: Tremendous use. In fact, a lot of this use coming from United States K-12 schools, because anyone who's involved in a school scale back, the first thing that's cut is the music curriculum.
after: A lot of teachers are using this stuff. What about ripping?
ru: и наши данные указывают на впечатляющую жажду к такому типу открытого, бесплатного контента.

quote: You see craters indicating that it didn't have an atmosphere that could stop those impacts.
before: And so even though Mars has an atmosphere, we can see it's much thinner than the Earth's. Just look at the surface.
after: Also, we see that it's the " red planet, " and atmospheric escape plays a role in Mars being red. That's because we think Mars used to have a wetter past, and when water had enough energy, it broke up into hydrogen and oxygen, and hydrogen being so light, it escaped into space, and the oxygen that was left oxidized or rusted the ground, making that familiar rusty red color that we see.
ru: Эти кратеры указывают, что у него не было атмосферы, способной остановить столкновения.

quote: This is again, indicating how numbers relate to space relate to form, maps of the universe.
before: (Laughter) This is, of course, the Cartesian coordinates. Once again, that's Sierra Leone.
after: Because that's why we're here, really, I think to figure stuff out and to love each other. Descartes.
ru: Это еще раз показывает, как числа связаны с космосом, как связаны с геометрической формой, с картами вселенной.

quote: Initial reports indicate that the fire started in an upstairs apartment and spread rapidly.
before: 8 apartment units were reportedly totally destroyed in the incident.
after: Local medical personnel were alerted to expect a large number of casualties. A woman, who lives in the neighboring apartment complex and was present during much of the event, spoke to Wikinews on the condition of anonymity.

quote: Well, I-I-I need to be informed in advance.
before: You are Mr. Christie? You complained to the landlord about this outhouse.
after: Look, mate, I just take my orders from the owners. It is just the, uh, wash house, is it?
ru: Я думал... что мне сообщат заранее.

quote: I regret to inform you that four of your classmates have just been killed.
before: A kid would wrap his car around a tree and with Bernie it was... and yet, death slipped up on young Mr. Shotwell, as gentle as a fallen mist. What happened?
after: Now this is gonna happen to you if you drink and drive. Is this what you want to happen to you?
ru: С прискорбием сообщаю, только что четверо ваших одноклассников погибли.

quote: What if someone here informed the navajeros of those transports?
before: But here there's something that doesn't feel right. Every gold transport destined to arrive here at Trinitá is attacked, on a regular basis.
after: Mayor, if things are that way - and I am firmly convinced of that - ... it's clear that I'm no longer capable of doing my job properly. My hand are bound!
ru: Что, если кто-то здесь сообщает "навахерос" об этих перевозках?

quote: He was informed by telephone that his friend something happened.
before: I can also play detectives. Laborde was a friend of Evan.
after: They come to find out that it was. Why would he beat me on the head?
ru: Ему сообщают по телефону, что с его другом что-то случилось.

quote: No doubt, I was informed, the consent had been obtained.
before: And at each time, I would feel the chilling stares of condemned prisoners' eyes follow me. And for two years, I struggled with the dilemma of waking up at 4: 30 am on a Friday morning, driving to the prison, getting down, gloved and scrubbed, ready to receive the body of an executed prisoner, remove the organs and then transport these organs to the recipient hospital and then graft the gift of life to a recipient the same afternoon.
after: But, in my life, the one fulfilling skill that I had was now invoking feelings of conflict — conflict ranging from extreme sorrow and doubt at dawn to celebratory joy at engrafting the gift of life at dusk. In my team, the lives of one or two of my colleagues were tainted by this experience.
ru: Без сомнения, мне сообщали, что согласие получено.

quote: At its best, prescriptivism is useful for informing people about the most common established patterns at a given point in time.
before: Rather than deciding how language should be used, it describes how people actually use it, and tracks the innovations they come up with in the process. But while the debate between prescriptivism and descriptivism continues, the two are not mutually exclusive.
after: This is important, not only for formal contexts, but it also makes communication easier between non-native speakers from different backgrounds. Descriptivism, on the other hand, gives us insight into how our minds work and the instinctive ways in which we structure our view of the world.
ru: Польза прескриптивизма в том, что он сообщает людям, какие наиболее общие нормы существуют в определённый момент времени.

quote: Decker's family has informed the RCMP that he is not yet able to communicate.
before: Of the 19 people aboard, Robert Decker is the sole survivor.
after: Decker, who was put on life support when first admitted to hospital with injured lungs and broken bones, has said a few words; RCMP investigators hope that he will be able explain what happened in the accident and assist with the investigation, possibly toward the end of the week.

before: Speaking earlier this month, Mr Rynja said that "The Jewel of Medina has become an important barometer of our time. As an independent publishing company, we feel strongly that we should not be afraid of the consequences of debate."
after: She noted that she "[has] deliberately and consciously written respectfully about Islam and Muhammad." She "envisaged that [her] book would be a bridge builder" between Islam and the western world.

before: Don't tell me you're naive enough to believe you won by yourself? Please, Roban...
after: Behind the scenes, who stood up for your honesty your independent spirit? Who convinced the Supreme Court to clear your name?
ru: Думаете, зачем я представил вас масонской ложе?

ru: Катерина, позволь представить тебе лорда Николауса.

before: Yeah. That sample was taken from the same one that was loaded with blasts.
after: Maggie, the cancer appears to be gone. - How?
ru: Я представил лейкоциты Джэйкоба около часа назад.

quote: Let me introduce you to my best friend, Girolamo.
before: You are very beautiful at night, Sister Mary. Please...
after: - Is he a good friend? - Yes. The only one who never criticizes me.
ru: Позвольте представить Вам моего лучшего друга - Джироламо.

quote: Well, let me introduce you to my friend Cayla.
before: Do you remember when you were a child, you probably had a favorite toy that was a constant companion, like Christopher Robin had Winnie the Pooh, and your imagination fueled endless adventures? What could be more innocent than that?
after: Cayla was voted toy of the year in countries around the world. She connects to the internet and uses speech recognition technology to answer your child's questions, respond just like a friend.
ru: Позвольте мне представить вам мою подругу Кайлу.

quote: They did chicken pot pie, fried chicken, and finally introduced Chicken McNuggets.
before: A good contrast is Chicken McNuggets. McDonald's actually spent 10 years coming out with a chicken-like product.
after: And the great innovation of Chicken McNuggets was not nuggifying them, that's kind of an easy concept. The trick was, they were able to remove the chicken from the bone in a cost-efficient manner, which is why it took so long for people to copy them — 10 years, then within a couple months, it was such a hit, they introduced it across the entire McDonald's system in the country.
ru: Они делали куриные пироги в горшочках, жареную курицу, а затем, они, наконец, представили Чикен МакНаггетс.

before: And if you're a performer that wants to collaborate with an adorable robot, or if you have a robot that needs entertainment representation, please contact me, the Bot-Agent. The bot, our rising celebrity, also has his own Twitter account: @ robotinthewild.
after: He's named after the Star Trek character. I think he's going to be super popular.
ru: Итак, разрешите представить вам одного из наших первый роботов, по имени Дейта.

after: "It's not just Hong Kong, he said. "This virus will exist in neighboring areas, southern China as well as Hong Kong," Dr Chow said.

after: ♪ To thee who's blood can cleanse ♪ ♪ Each spot o' land ♪
ru: Он был слишком прижимист, чтобы просто тратить деньги, но он обожал вкладывать деньги во все, что только можно.

before: This is huge. Um, seriously, I told my partner...
after: I'm investing in you. You know, before your father's surgery, he and I spent a lot of time together.
ru: Я не собираюсь вкладывать в бар, Джоуи.

before: Kill him. Kill him.

quote: It's withering and it's dying because we've invested so much in our protective arm.
before: (Laughter) You know, it's kinda weak. It looks sickly.
after: But we forgot to treat our communities like they're our customers; like they're our sons and daughters, our brothers and sisters, our mothers and fathers. And so somehow, along the way, we've gotten out of balance.
ru: Она чахнет и умирает, потому что мы слишком много вкладываем в руку-защитницу.

quote: One: if you want to solve the world's biggest problems, invest in women and girls.
before: And what it really ingrains in people is that ability to trust and to move the agenda ahead. So, three things that I have learned that I want to share with you through my work.
after: (Applause) Not only do they expand the investment, but they care for everyone in the community. Not only their needs but the needs of their children, the needs of the rest of the community, the needs of the elderly, and most important, they protect themselves — which is really important — and they protect their communities.
ru: Первое — если вы хотите решить самые сложные мировые проблемы, вкладывайте в девушек и женщин.

quote: They invest in professional development and collaboration and many other things.
before: And Korea also invests into long school days, which drives up costs further. Last but not least, Koreans want their teachers not only to teach but also to develop.
after: All that costs money. How can Korea afford all of this?
ru: Они вкладывают в профессиональное развитие, обмен знаниями и так далее.

after: You'd still be under his power without me! What do you mean?
