quote: And what type of people did you kill today, James?
before: About, what, one... One an hour on average, I'd say.
after: You know, the usual. Bad guys? Baddest-ass, suicide-vested, cold-hearted Pakistani motherfuckers this side of Karachi.
ru: Каких людей ты сегодня убивал, Джеймс?

quote: Some got killed, and some did it without drug assistance.
before: And I had friends who were really good kids, who lived out the Dr. Jekyll Mr. Hyde scenario — Robert Louis Stevenson. That is, they took drugs, got in trouble, went to jail.
after: So when I read Robert Louis Stevenson, that wasn't fiction. The only question is, what was in the juice?
ru: Некоторых убивали, некоторые умирали без помощи наркотиков.

quote: They were killing people. They were doing whatever they want because they have power.
before: And it was for us, the young, the first time really we hear the language of war, of guns. And even people who faced the rebellion of 1963, after our independence, they didn't believe what was happening.
after: Who have been doing that? Young children.
ru: Они убивали людей и делали все, что хотели, потому что у них была власть.

quote: We're still killing bluefin tuna; truly endangered and much more valuable alive than dead.
before: We're clogging the ocean, poisoning the planet's circulatory system, and we're taking out hundreds of millions of tons of wildlife, all carbon-based units. Barbarically, we're killing sharks for shark fin soup, undermining food chains that shape planetary chemistry and drive the carbon cycle, the nitrogen cycle, the oxygen cycle, the water cycle — our life support system.
after: All of these parts are part of our life support system. We kill using long lines, with baited hooks every few feet that may stretch for 50 miles or more.
ru: Мы продолжаем убивать голубых тунцов, которые уже находятся под угрозой исчезновения, и которые намного ценнее живыми, чем мертвыми.

quote: NSG has announced that the Taj hotel is now clear and all terrorists are killed.
after: One cell phone with a foreign SIM card was found outside Taj hotel, which belonged to one of the terrorists.

quote: And if you'd like to know how I feel,
before: It also needs a few psychopaths to keep the rest of us on our toes. There is no evidence I did this.
after: I feel like I don't want to be here anymore. So, if you're not detaining me,
ru: И если хотите знать как я себя чувствую...

quote: So there are real neurologic reasons why folks exposed to high doses of adversity are more likely to engage in high-risk behavior, and that's important to know.
before: It inhibits the prefrontal cortex, which is necessary for impulse control and executive function, a critical area for learning. And on MRI scans, we see measurable differences in the amygdala, the brain's fear response center.
after: But it turns out that even if you don't engage in any high-risk behavior, you're still more likely to develop heart disease or cancer. The reason for this has to do with the hypothalamic – pituitary – adrenal axis, the brain's and body's stress response system that governs our fight-or-flight response.
ru: То есть существуют реальные неврологические причины того, почему людям, подвергавшимся большому количеству бедствий, чаще свойственно поведение с высокой степенью риска, и об этом важно знать.

quote: Anyone who is suffering from shame and public humiliation needs to know one thing: You can survive it.
before: Time to stop tiptoeing around my past, time to stop living a life of opprobrium and time to take back my narrative. It's also not just about saving myself.
after: I know it's hard. It may not be painless, quick or easy, but you can insist on a different ending to your story.
ru: Любой, кто страдает от публичного позора и унижения, должен знать следующее: это можно пережить.

quote: InSight carries eight scientific instruments, including a seismometer known as Seismic Experiment for Interior Structure (SEIS).
before: Both InSight and the MarCO cubesats are en route to Mars.
after: The SEIS instrument will be recording the very first seismic measurements of Mars, which scientists hope will shed light on the structure of Mars beneath its surface. The lander was equipped with two cameras, based on the architecture of the Mars Exploration Rover's navigation camera and hazard avoidance camera, to allow mission scientists to monitor the activity of the instruments.

quote: And after that wedding, I swore no guy would ever laugh at me again.
before: I'm a bigger idiot for always believing the same lie. Even when different guys tell me it.
after: Where are you going? Will no one tell me about that wedding?
ru: И после той свадьбы я поклялась, что больше ни один парень не посмеет смеяться надо мной.

quote: I want you to show me how to laugh.
before: In order to laugh, you don't need a technique. You just laugh.
after: I showed you. I don't want you to copy my laugh.
ru: Я хочу, чтобы ты показал мне, как надо смеяться.

quote: I get angry with people a lot, and I don't laugh easily.
before: So how could you sleep this long? I've changed a lot lately.
after: If you saw me, you'd be surprised. I can't remember your voice.
ru: Я много злюсь на окружающих, а еще я перестала смеяться.

quote: But back they will be laughing then.
before: I believed it, it would be necessary to spit one onto the audience, it elsõ one after the other. In this manner, ni!
after: Nothing, it are understood it is believed - this an a prank is like this. Did you find a clown for yourself?
ru: Так смеяться же будут всё равно.

quote: I did not know what they were laughing at, but I wanted in.
before: They were lying on the floor laughing. They were screaming with laughter.
after: I wanted to be part of that, and I kind of sat around at the edge going, " Hoo hoo! " (Laughter) Now, incidentally, what they were laughing at was a song which people used to sing, which was based around signs in toilets on trains telling you what you could and could not do in toilets on trains.
ru: Я не знала, над чем они смеялись, но хотела смеяться вместе с ними.

quote: Millions will feel awe or fear, millions will laugh and millions will cry.
before: They'll watch movies about aliens or robots, or robot aliens or regular people. But they will all be movies about what it means to be human.
after: And then the lights will come back on, and they'll reemerge into the world they knew several hours prior. And millions of people will look at the world a little bit differently than they did when they went in.
ru: Миллионы почувствуют восторг или страх, миллионы будут смеяться и миллионы будут плакать.

quote: If we can laugh together, we can live together.
before: It was hysterical. And in that five minutes, you couldn't help but feel that the possibility of peace had been advanced in some way, that somehow, compromise was just a little closer at hand, and that's what laughter can do.
after: You know what I think the secret of life is? Some people would say, it's knowledge, but for me we don't seem to learn very much in our human evolution.
ru: Если мы можем смеяться над одним и тем же, мы можем сосуществовать.

quote: "People laugh at metal detectorists," Herbert said in late September.
after: "I've had people go past and go 'beep beep, he's after pennies'. Well no, we are out there to find this kind of stuff and it is out there."

quote: We're launching a multiagency search in the area we think they're in.
before: What happened? We lost them.
after: That you think they're in? Will you be able to find them, or not?
ru: Запускаем поиск с участием всех агентств. на территории, где по нашему мнению, они могут находиться.

quote: Leo had all the equipment to launch a weather balloon.
before: Amazing.' Pause that a second.
after: Helium, balloons, radiosondes. What's a radiosonde?
ru: У Лео было всё оборудование для запуска метеозонда.

quote: I'm launching my Forever Puppies, and there's nothing you can do about it!
before: Go, Tim! Go, go! Launch initiated.
after: No! Baby Corp stole all the love from me... and now I'm going to take it back from them.
ru: Я запускаю моих щенков, и вам ничего с этим не поделать.

quote: Now all you need to do is connect the couplings, then we can launch.
before: I'm here! We're ready.
after: Save us, this equipment! - Needs rebooting all the time.
ru: Осталось лишь присоединить сцепления, и можно запускать.

quote: Or just to really prove a point, we can launch programs like my personal favorite, the Windows Calculator.
before: You can turn on the webcam. That can be very embarrassing.
after: So isn't it amazing how much control the attackers can get with such a simple operation? Let me show you how most malware is now distributed today.
ru: Или же, чтобы показать более наглядно, мы можем запускать программы — как, к примеру, моя любимая, калькулятор.

quote: So we are launching an independent study.
before: And this was the entire food web for the sea ducks. And as you know, we lost about 300,000 sea ducks from the Exxon Valdez spill, and they haven't come back.
after: And by independent, I do not mean alone; I mean independent in the sense of not tied to the kind of crime-scene secrecy that's going on in the Gulf now. But we are actually going to be assessing toxic impacts, but we need lots and lots of partners to do this intelligently.
ru: Мы запускаем независимое исследование.

quote: I met these founders just weeks after they had launched, and now, in two years, what would you do for five dollars?
before: And it's not just with transportation, my love, but of course in other realms. Here's Fiverr.com.
after: Seven hundred and fifty thousand gigs are now posted after two years, what people would do for five dollars. And not just easy things that anyone can do.
ru: Например, Fiverr.com. Я познакомилась с создателями сайта через несколько недель после запуска сайта, и сейчас, спустя 2 года после запуска, что бы вы сделали за пять долларов?

quote: The former will be launched later this year, and the latter being launched next year.
before: State broadcaster, Television New Zealand (TVNZ), who owns TV One and TV2, announced earlier that they will be launching two new channels. One will carry family, arts and entertainment type programmes and the other will be a news and current affairs channel.
after: As well as the $25 million the Government has already contributed to Freeview, TVNZ's new channels will be given $79 million over five years.

quote: I repeat, lay down your weapons.
before: On me. Lay down your weapons, or we will open fire!
after: Tell me you saw that. Ok.
ru: Я повторяю, положите ваше оружие.

quote: You laid your hands on my sister!
before: Get down! Shut up!
after: I'll lay my hands on you! I didn't do anything!
ru: Ты положил ручищи на мою сестру!

quote: They lay me on my back, I shut my eyes and squeak.
before: More honest. Look, I'm a doll.
after: Happy or sad, it's the same squeak. Come, boys and girls, pull my pants off.
ru: Они положили меня на спину, я закрываю глаза и пищу.

quote: My fourth grade teacher showed us the whole numbers laid out in a row, and below each we have its double.
before: As another example of matching being more fundamental than counting, if I'm speaking to a packed auditorium, where every seat is taken and no one is standing, I know that there are the same number of chairs as people in the audience, even though I don't know how many there are of either. So, what we really mean when we say that two sets are the same size is that the elements in those sets can be matched up one by one in some way.
after: As you can see, the bottom row contains all the even numbers, and we have a one-to-one match. That is, there are as many even numbers as there are numbers.
ru: В 4-ом классе учитель продемонстрировал это, выписав все целые числа в ряд, а под ними — их удвоенные значения.

quote: The families themselves laid roses and then met the prince and the duchess.
Michael, you must lead another life.
before: Do you hear me? When they come, they'll come at what you love.
after: You have everything a man could desire. It's time for you to retire.
ru: Мишель, ты должен вести иную жизнь.

quote: I have led our people since before you were born.
before: No, I only... -Let me tell you something, Senator.
after: I've seen a hundred planets rise and fall through force of arms. If it's not the Separatists out there, then it's a malevolent and aggressive enemy nonetheless, and I will not let whoever it is jeopardize the security of the people of Pantora.
ru: Я людьми руководил ещё до вашего рождения.

quote: His largest-scale organizing project came in 1963, when he led the planning for the national march on Washington.
before: As King’ s prominence increased, Rustin became his main advisor, as well as a key strategist in the broader civil rights movement. He brought his organizing expertise to the 1956 bus boycotts in Montgomery, Alabama — in fact, he had organized and participated in a transportation protest that helped inspire the boycotts almost a decade before.
after: The possibility of riots that could injure marchers and undermine their message of peaceful protest was a huge concern. Rustin not only worked with the DC police and hospitals to prepare, but organized and trained a volunteer force of 2,000 security marshals.
ru: Его крупнейший организационный проект состоялся в 1963 году, когда он руководил планированием национального марша на Вашингтон.

quote: Or sometimes you say you're leading with your heart or soul.
before: The best we can muster up is, " I don't know. It just doesn't feel right. "
after: I hate to break it to you, those aren't other body parts controlling your behavior. It's all happening here in your limbic brain, the part of the brain that controls decision-making and not language.
ru: Иногда мы говорим, что мы руководим с помощью сердца, или руководим с помощью души.

quote: Health officials have suggested this could lead up to a second outbreak of the virus.
before: About five thousand new cases of swine flu were reported in the United Kingdom in recent weeks, reversing a declining trend in the number of new infections.

quote: Pro: she's learning to take care of herself.

after: Con: She'll start sucking her thumb, mess up her teeth, end up going to Winter Formal with her gay best friend because nobody asked the girl with massive braces and headgear. I'll get her the pacifier.
ru: Плюс: она учится заботиться о себе сама.

quote: Manny has forgotten most of his Spanish, and Joe--I'm sure he's not even going to learn it.
before: Just... thank you. Hey. Hey, what's going on with you?
after: I know this is silly, but I just don't like feeling like I'm so different from the rest of my family. Oh, honey.
ru: Мэнни практически полностью забыл испанский, а Джо... Я даже не уверена, что он будет его изучать.

quote: I knew I should have learned Spanish.
before: - Zihuatanejo? That's Mexican for Philadelphia.
after: I can't believe my manager's going to jail. Think about it.
ru: Так и знал что надо было учить испанский

quote: By learning and knowing about him, I do hope to get closer to Gii!
before: Moreover, compared to myself... That just makes me want to know more about him!
after: "Fractals". The ones that are non-linear designs.
ru: Узнавать его привычки. Я хочу стать ближе к Гии.

quote: They need to learn to respect their teachers.
before: They need to learn to respect themselves. They need to learn to respect their schoolmates.
after: And, most important, they need to learn to respect learning. That's the principle objective.
ru: Им нужно научиться уважать своих учителей.

quote: He's learning about how to keep a fire going.
before: SS: So Kanzi is very interested in fire. He doesn't do it yet without a lighter, but I think if he saw someone do it, he might be able to do — make a fire without a lighter.
after: He's learning the uses for a fire, just by watching what we do with fire. (Laughter) This is a smile on the face of a Bonobo.
ru: Он учится не давать костру погаснуть.

quote: When you learn to code, it opens up for you to learn many other things.
before: You learn more about how computers work. But that's just where it starts.
after: Let me show you an example. Here's another project, and I saw this when I was visiting one of the computer clubhouses.
ru: Когда вы учитесь программировать, появляются возможности для изучения многих других вещей.

quote: I learned that not everyone is in politics for the same reasons as I am.
before: I learned last election to operate with integrity and stick to my values. I learned that being a politician was about representing your community and being a voice for the members of your community so they could live a better life.

quote: The sofa's quite comfortable, and she mustn't be left alone.
before: I'll show you the way. I'll ask one of the maids to sleep in Mrs Wickham's room tonight, madam.
after: I take it that once they're found, Mr Wickham and Captain Denny will not be stopping over? A hot meal and we'll send them on their way.
ru: Диван довольно удобный, ее нельзя оставлять одну.

quote: Leaving with Cary and the other fourth years.
before: He thinks I'm doing what you're doing. What am I doing?
after: Oh, well, yeah. All right, I need help.
ru: Уходишь с Кэри и остальными 4-годками.

quote: Ali left town, but "A" said she couldn't.

after: What changed? Well, Ali made a deal with Noel.
ru: Эли уехала, но ведь "Э" запретил ей уезжать.

quote: Or leave a note for the smallest thing.
before: (Buddy) It was too bad. Not only was this the best scam I'd ever run, but I really liked the people here... how they help each other out after a storm...
after: What is taking him so long? You know what?
ru: Или то, как оставляют записки даже по пустякам.

quote: We must actively dismantle the hurdles we have created, which are leaving indigenous populations out of conservation efforts.
before: But I will not give up my efforts to bring indigenous communities to this fight for the survival of our planet. I'm asking you to come and stand together with me.
after: I've dedicated my life to protecting lions. And I know my neighbor would, too, if only they knew the animals that lived next door to them.
ru: Мы должны активно устранять созданные нами препятствия, которые оставляют коренное население в стороне от охраны природы.

quote: You come in, you face the wall, you take your test and you leave.
before: The first was a series of renovations of computer labs. So traditionally, the computer labs, particularly in an under-performing school like Bertie County, where they have to benchmark test every other week, the computer lab is a kill-and-drill testing facility.
after: So we wanted to change the way that students approach technology, to create a more convivial and social space that was more engaging, more accessible, and also to increase the ability for teachers to use these spaces for technology-based instruction. So this is the lab at the high school, and the principal there is in love with this room.
ru: Ты приходишь, садишься лицом к стене, делаешь тест и уходишь.

quote: Every time we'd be left in a car, at a house, at a store, I'd cry.
before: It made our lives chaotic and unstable: promises being made and constantly broken, their fighting, the weight of their secret — the weight of our secret kept so much so-called " normal " out of our lives. Every time we'd be dropped off at our grandparent's house, I'd be stuck on the thought that I was never going to see them again.
after: And every time I saw those El tracks — the same ones I take to work now to McPherson — from the backseat of a car, I'd be angry, because even kids know when their parents are trying to score drugs. There was so little I could do to control what was going on around me, that that feeling of helplessness was overwhelming.
ru: Каждый раз, когда нас оставляли в машине, дома или в магазине, я плакала.

quote: This safety aspect is left to the responsibility of the operator.
before: According to the Swiss law, every chair lift must be designed to withstand a lateral wind load of 250 newtons (approx. 25kg) per square meter. However there is no law limit at which wind speed or lateral loads the chair lifts have to be stopped.
after: The safety of the lift was checked by the Swiss Federal Office of Transport in January 2006. This chairlift accident is said to be the worst in Switzerland for the last 8 years.

quote: And a brain that's never let me down.
before: Flawless skin and great teeth. Ooh. She does have great teeth.
after: I promise to honor your memory By living the best life I can. And if you're watching me now...
ru: И ум, который никогда меня не подводит.

quote: Has daddy ever let you down before?
before: Fuck. Why do you always assume it's a bad thing?
after: Well... Don't answer that.
ru: -Папочка когда-нибудь тебя раньше подводил?

quote: You never fail to let me down.
before: I'm your bloody sister. You'd even use a boy's death to your own ends.
after: Right, what did you see the night Danny was killed? What night was it, even?
ru: А ты типа никогда меня не подводила?

quote: I had to let him down easy.
before: You seem to be in a good mood. Johnson was actually a no-show last night, but I got an email from him apologizing.
after: He said I'd have been an Insta-hire if they'd not just relocated to Poughkeepsie last night. Well, maybe it's for the best.
ru: Я хотела не разочаровывать его.

quote: It just seems scary, remote, distant, and it has let them down, and so globalists, global governance -- no, go away!
before: Another thing that I would emphasize is that anybody who is really interested in global governance should always make it very, very clear that it doesn't replace or abolish local identities and communities, that it should come both as — It should be part of a single package. CA: I want to hear more on this, because the very words " global governance " are almost the epitome of evil in the mindset of a lot of people on the alt-right right now.
after: And many view the election as the ultimate poke in the eye to anyone who believes in that. So how do we change the narrative so that it doesn't seem so scary and remote?
ru: Оно кажется пугающим, далёким, и оно не раз уже всех подводило, так что пусть все сторонники глобализации и мирового управления идут куда подальше!

quote: Once again, Nicaragua let me down.
before: That guy is rockin'. (Laughter) What a handsome cat.
after: (Laughter) And Copernicus looks like Johnny Carson, which is really weird. (Laughter) I don't get that at all.
ru: Опять таки, Никарагуа подводит меня.

quote: Just that nobody has to lie about it any more.
before: I might give it a go. There's nothing that hasn't been done before.
after: Sniffer dog, sniffer dog. Snoop's about, got to split.
ru: Просто теперь об этом никому больше не придётся лгать.

quote: What if the woman that you loved was lying in a ditch somewhere, you know, because of something you did?
before: [ sighs ] I really need you to help me find her. Oh, my god.
after: Hey. Charlie, w-what are you doing out here?
ru: Что если женщина, которую вы любили, лежала где-то в канаве, знаете, по вашей вине?

quote: You're not supposed to lay in the beds, but I do sometimes.
before: You looked like you were having a crazy dream. What?
after: I'm back in the store? I'm young again.
ru: Здесь нельзя лежать на кроватях, но я иногда разрешаю.

quote: Beyond the mystery of mass lies a much thornier challenge for the Standard Model, a puzzle that defeated even Einstein.
before: to new physics. Even if the Higgs boson does turn up at the launch party, work at the Big Bang machine won't stop.
after: Why does the world appear to obey different rules? There's the world of the small, the quantum world, that the Standard Model explains so well, and then there's the world of the large, the world of stars and planets and galaxies.
ru: Позади загадки массы лежат ещё более волнующие проблемы для Стандартной модели и также вопрос, который не разрешил даже Эйнштейн.

quote: And Gene, who's lying on the floor, says, "We've got to soak towels." I said, "What?"
before: Here I've been playing God with my friends' lives, my friends' son, with Natasha's life, and this what you get when you try playing God, is you hurt people. I remember just being so frightened and terrified.
after: " We've got to soak towels. We're going to die from the smoke. "
ru: А Джин, который лежал на полу, говорит: “Надо намочить полотенца.” Я спросил: “Что?” Он говорит: “Надо намочить полотенца, иначе мы отравимся дымом.”

quote: I use a lot of tricks, which means that sometimes I have to lie to you.
before: A magician promises to deceive you — and he does. MT: I like to think of myself as an honest magician.
after: Now I feel bad about that. But people lie every day.
ru: Я пользуюсь большим количеством трюков, что означает, что время от времени мне приходится лгать вам.

quote: If you're an average married couple, you're going to lie to your spouse in one out of every 10 interactions.
before: Men lie eight times more about themselves than they do other people. Women lie more to protect other people.
after: Now, you may think that's bad. If you're unmarried, that number drops to three.
ru: Если вы — среднестатистическая супружеская пара, вы будете лгать друг другу один раз из десяти.

quote: Elias and the other two men were stabbed in the back while lying on the ground.
And so we hide, and we hide behind what we like to call the floodgate of intimacy.
before: (Laughter) The floodgates in our mind open much like the streets of Shanghai. (Applause) So many pieces of information to process, so many ideas, concepts, feelings and, of course, vulnerabilities that we don't often wish to share.
after: (Laughter) And what might that floodgate be holding? What is the dike upon which it is built?
ru: И поэтому мы скрываем, и скрываем за тем, что мы любим называть «воротами близости».

quote: Is there anything else you would like to say to people reading this article?
I listened to the Qur'an on the radio yesterday.
before: What are you thinking, Wadjda? This competition is very difficult for me.
after: "If the learning of the Qur'an is difficult for you, God will reward you twice." Good.
ru: Я вчера целый день слушала Коран по радио.

quote: This is going to be quick and it's not going to be repeated, so listen up.
before: Oh, mate! Ready to order.
after: I'll have a bowl of won ton soup, the Singapore vermicelli noodles, half a Peking duck with pancakes har gow, char siu and the wasabi chicken dim sum. OK. And for you?
ru: Говорю я быстро, повторять не буду, так что слушай внимательно.

before: Master Phineus, master of the paintbrush, patiently awaits. Make him look marriageable, Master Phineus.
after: I shall endeavor to please, Your Majesty. But I can't work miracles.
ru: Мы должны подыскать подходящую невесту, даже если он меня совсем не слушает.

quote: Don't you want a lot of people to listen to your songs?
before: Yes, but only a small number. Let me ask you this.
after: The melody, it is really very good and you are very good at it, and I have the same idea that you have. To bring in new kinds of sounds to the music industry.
ru: Ты хочешь, чтобы много-много людей слушали твои песни?

quote: So listening to this brought something to the ear besides the obvious burst.
before: (Digital beeping sounds) This is scientific data converted into sound, and it's mapped in pitch. The process is called sonification.
after: When I examine the very strong low-frequency regions, or bass line — I'm zooming into the bass line now. We noted resonances characteristic of electrically charged gasses like the solar wind.
ru: Слушая гамма-всплеск, я поняла, что кроме него здесь есть что-то другое.

quote: No one's quite listening hard enough, but I very much believe it's true.
before: They're sucked in from other people; chiefly, if you're a man, your father, and if you're a woman, your mother. Psychoanalysis has been drumming home this message for about 80 years.
after: And we also suck in messages from everything from the television, to advertising, to marketing, etc. These are hugely powerful forces that define what we want and how we view ourselves.
ru: Никто их не слушает. Я же уверен, что именно так и есть.

quote: We may be the first people in the United States listening to this.
before: Can I hear? " And before long, they think, " Jeez, this is kind of historic.
after: We should record it. " So they bring in this big, clunky analog tape recorder and start recording these little bleep, bleeps.
ru: Может быть, мы первые люди в США, начавшие слушать его.

quote: I don’t listen to many a capella bands, though.
before: We are playing melodic metal, so my inspiration as a composer can be found in Blind Guardian and Nightwish. Metallica has always been a great influence for me, too.
after: There’s a German a capella band called the Wise Guys which I like, but it’s pop and doesn’t have to do much with our style of singing or performing. Combining the metal style with the performing style a capella is the original part of the idea.

quote: No, you should let one of them live.
before: I know it is, whoa, whoa. But you need to take care of this for them. We should let niki die?
after: You should give the cord blood to niki because she's weak And she needs it.
ru: - Нет, вы должны дать одной из них жить.

quote: I think I don't want to live in an Easter basket.
before: If you look closely, that's blue, that's green, that's yellow... to take the edge off all the chrome and concrete. What do you think?
after: I know. You really want to live in the batcave.
ru: Я думаю, что я не хочу жить в Пасхальной корзинке.

quote: I'll be living my dream in Iowa for eight weeks.
before: Wait a minute. Are you actually good at this writing thing?
after: How are you gonna ruin that, Peggy? Eight weeks?
ru: Я буду жить своей мечтой в Айове целых восемь недель.

quote: My family will live in a house down the hill.
before: The soccer field will be over here. Here, I want to have a little doll house for Manuela, and downstairs, a bar with a Jacuzzi for the guys.
after: I'm going to install a telescope so I can look at them whenever I want. Yeah, right.
ru: Моя семья будет жить в доме на склоне.

quote: I hope that you will find it as fascinating to read about traditional societies as I found it to live in those societies.
before: Features of the modern lifestyle predispose us to those diseases, and features of the traditional lifestyle protect us against them. Those are just some examples of what we can learn from traditional societies.
after: Thank you. (Applause)
ru: Я надеюсь, что вам будет так же интересно прочесть книгу о традиционных обществах, как и мне было интересно жить в таких обществах.

quote: These organisms can be totally desiccated; they can live in a vacuum.
before: Twelve to 24 hours later, it put it back together exactly as it was before. We have thousands of organisms that can do this.
after: I am absolutely certain that life can exist in outer space, move around, find a new aqueous environment. In fact, NASA has shown a lot of this is out there.
ru: Эти организмы можно полностью обезводить, они могут жить в вакууме.

quote: But it's also wrong about plants, because plants are not just able to live; they are able to sense.
before: But it's something completely wrong. You know very well about professors.
after: They are much more sophisticated in sensing than animals. Just to give you an example, every single root apex is able to detect and to monitor concurrently and continuously at least 15 different chemical and physical parameters.
ru: Также это -- ошибочно в отношениии растений, потому что они не просто способны жить; они способны чувствовать.

quote: Dannie Abse is an esteemed Jewish writer who lives in Glamorgan, South Wales.
after: Joan Abse, his wife, was an art historian and writer. Dannie Abse is well-known for being a poet and a medical doctor.

quote: No, I locate and retrieve children Who are abducted by non-custodial parents.
before: Recover? Don't you mean kidnap?
after: Which nicholas is not. He lives with his biological father, Who's the sole legal guardian.
ru: Нет, я находил и возвращал детей, которых похищали, несвязанно с лишением родительских прав.

quote: This club and the steel factory in which its located are all assets of Queen Consolidated.
before: My condolences, and to give you this. It's a notice to vacate the premises.
after: No, you--you can't do this. It's already done.
ru: Этот клуб и сталелитейный завод, в котором он располагается, являются имуществом Куин Консолидейтед.

quote: This cell is located in the Ryloth system.
before: A rebel cell has reported an Imperial carrier over their world. If we can steal that ship, we can use it to house all our fighters.
after: Ryloth? I know the cell you're talking about.
ru: Эти повстанцы находится в системе Рилот.

quote: Can you tell me where you're located?
before: How may I help you? Yes, I'd like to open up a new account.
after: I'm sorry, sir. We're not accepting new accounts at this time.
ru: Не подскажете, где вы располагаетесь?

quote: The ground stations are located on safe locations on the ground.
before: So they use GPS and other sensors on board to navigate between ground stations. Every vehicle is equipped with an automatic payload and battery exchange mechanism, so these vehicles navigate to those ground stations, they dock, swap a battery automatically, and go out again.
after: They secure the most vulnerable part of the mission, which is the landing. They are at known locations on the ground, so the paths between them are also known, which is very important from a reliability perspective from the whole network.
ru: Наземные станции располагаются в безопасных местах на земле.

quote: This was taken under the Montparnasse Cemetery where most of the ossuaries are located.
before: So the bones were moved from the cemeteries into the quarries, making them into the catacombs. The remains of over six million people are housed in there, some over 1,300 years old.
after: There are also phone cables that were used in the' 50s and many bunkers from the World War II era. This is a German bunker.
ru: Этот снимок был сделан под кладбищем Монпарнас, где находится большинство склепов.

quote: B is located on the edge of the network.
before: (Audience: B.) Nicholas Christakis: B, it's obvious.
after: Now, who would you rather be if a juicy piece of gossip were spreading through the network? A. And you have an immediate appreciation that A is going to be more likely to get the thing that's spreading and to get it sooner by virtue of their structural location within the network.
ru: Узел Б находится на краю сети.

quote: Q: Why should businesses be attracted to locating in Mississauga?
And I was looking at your things.
before: I was looking for a broom. And then I saw the box.
after: Well, don't. I just...
ru: И я смотрела на ваши вещи.

quote: I wasn't even gonna look at him.
before: I didn't think I would care. You know, I had a plan.
after: And when I realized he wasn't coming at all, I just got this awful feeling in the pit of my stomach. He doesn't even want to see me.
ru: Я не собиралась даже смотреть на него.

quote: Your father sent a carrier pigeon through the skylight when the guards weren't looking.
before: Cousin Harry's coming? But... how?
after: Your cousin will save us, and then you will marry him, as planned. I don't want to marry my cousin.
ru: Твой отец послал почтового голубя через окошко, пока стражники смотрели в другую сторону.

quote: Is that how she looked when you saw her on the bed in your uncle Steven's bedroom?
before: I don't understand. Is that your-- Is that your description?
after: I didn't see it. You just made that up?
ru: Так она выглядела, когда вы увидели её на кровати в спальне вашего дяди Стивена?

quote: That star I looked to night after night was called Vega.
before: And almost a sense of vertigo, like I was going to fall into space. And when this happened — I know this sounds kind of ridiculous, but I would simultaneously feel unfathomably insignificant and also kind of weirdly important.
after: Vega is the brightest star in the constellation Lyra, which is not coincidentally the name of one of my dogs. (Laughter) But this experience is being lost.
ru: Звезда, на которую я смотрела ночами, называется Вега.

quote: Early journalists looked at these spills, and they said, "This is a filthy industry."
before: The oil industry is like a huge, gigantic octopus of engineering and finance and everything else, but we actually see it in very moral terms. This is an early-on photograph — you can see, we had these gushers.
after: But they also saw in it that people were getting rich for doing nothing. They weren't farmers, they were just getting rich for stuff coming out of the ground.
ru: Первые журналисты смотрели на эти лужи нефти и говорили: "Это грязная индустрия".

quote: I look out at what's happening on college campuses, and I see the anger.
before: The tide of resistance, in fact, was so intense, that my college president rescinded the invitation. I was deeply disappointed by this because, as I saw it, there would be nothing that any of my peers or I could do to silence someone who agreed with him in the office environment of our future employers.
after: And I get it. But what I wish I could tell people is that it's worth the discomfort, it's worth listening, and that we're stronger, not weaker, because of it.
ru: Я смотрел на происходящее в кампусе колледжа и видел ярость.

quote: It also suggested that the Council should look at setting up a monitoring force in Lebanon.
before: The summit declaration called on the UN Security Council to draw up plans for implementing its resolutions UNSCR 1559 and 1680, which call for extending the Lebanese government's authority over all of Lebanon and the disarming of militias such as Hezbollah.

quote: Well, somebody's got to look after you, and that somebody turned out to be me.
before: - All right, everybody in. - We're not tired.
after: It's my sacred duty. That's what your mama said.
ru: Кто-то должен присматривать за вами, и этим кем-то оказался я.

quote: We have to be big enough to look after this baby.
before: What do you mean? Well, we have to blend in, don't we?
after: So, gather around, ladies. Get ready.
ru: Нужно быть весьма большими, чтобы заботиться о ней.

quote: I've looked after the new boy, sir, and shown him round the dormitory.
before: Obviously, you're a new boy. You've not been here before. - Never. - You, of course, have.
after: Have you? Cos last time you came, you were super-quick. Yeah, but the worst thing about the last time I came was my reaction when you told me how well I did.
ru: Ты у нас, конечно, был. Я присматривал за новичком и показал ему студию.

quote: I'm not staying, and I'm not gonna be stuck here looking after kids.
before: It's good that you're back, kid, you know, for... Stella and that.
after: - But I should? - They're your kids!
ru: Я не останусь и я не собираюсь застрять тут, чтобы присматривать за детьми.

quote: Okoloma lived on my street and looked after me like a big brother.
before: So I would like to start by telling you about one of my greatest friends, Okoloma Maduewesi.
after: If I liked a boy, I would ask Okoloma's opinion. Okoloma died in the notorious Sosoliso plane crash in Nigeria in December of 2005.
ru: Мы с Околомой жили на одной улице, он присматривал за мной как старший брат.

quote: If the city looks after the country, the country will look after the city.
before: It's about the relationship between the city and the countryside. And I think the message of this is very clear.
after: And I want us to ask now, what would Ambrogio Lorenzetti paint if he painted this image today? What would an allegory of good government look like today?
ru: Если город заботится о деревне, деревня будет заботиться о городе.

quote: I grew up herding, looking after our livestock -- goats, sheep and cattle.
before: A Himba is one of the 29 ethnic groups in Namibia. We live a very traditional lifestyle.
after: And one day, my father actually took me into the bush. He said, " John, I want you to become a good herder.
ru: В детстве я был пастухом, присматривал за животными — овцами, козами и крупным рогатым скотом.

quote: I will not let anyone look down on us and Prof. In.
before: I borrowed from the janitor. It's a bit light, but it'll do.
after: Everyone, I'm asking for 100% from you today. There...
ru: Никому не позволю смотреть на нас с учительницей Ин свысока.

quote: After experiencing the United States, she looks down on our country's traditional marriage arrangements.
before: Looking at the atmosphere, it would be impolite to hide this. She is still young and likes to make up stories.
after: You said that because you were afraid I'd arrange your marriage, right? No, Dad.
ru: Пожив за границей, моя дочь стала смотреть свысока на наши традиции касательно заключения браков.

quote: They look down on us, and we risk our lives for them.
before: SURVIVAL KIT "These whites, these dirty whites.
after: They're a bunch of nouveaux riches, pretentious, arrogant, ignorant. They don't deserve this beautiful land.
ru: Они нас презирают. а мы рискуем ради них своей шкурой.

quote: How dare you look down on me? I never looked down on you!
before: Now look at me. I passed with the highest marks. You're just another student. You jerk, Takuma!
after: You jerk! You have no idea how I felt!
ru: Как только смел смотреть на меня свысока!

quote: I looked down on my reality.
before: I struggled to reconcile my reality with the formal education I received in school, in the schools I attended. I had identity crises.
after: I looked at my ancestry, I looked at my lineage with disrespect. I had very little patience for what my life had to offer around me.
ru: Я презирала окружавшую меня жизнь.

quote: I was looking for dad's "Playboys" in the guest house.
before: Toby, unless you want dad to find out about whatever's going on in there, you better tell me everything you know. Okay, a long time ago,
after: Nice. And I ran across... a bunch of legal stuff about your birth mom.
ru: Я искал папины "Playboy" в домике для гостей.

quote: Let's start looking for anagrams of Sidney Falco and Sweet Smell of Success.
before: - There aren't. And you don't want to start looking for anagrams--
after: Okay. I got your text.
ru: Начинаем искать анаграммы Сиднея Фалько и "Сладкого запаха успеха"

quote: The petition you've been looking for backing Selah Strong to the New York Congress.
before: Major, Captain. What have you for us, Mr. Paine?
after: I confess my name is on it, a foolish mistake in a moment of drunken weakness. But I suspect there are others who will prove of more interest to you.
ru: Петиция, которую вы искали, в поддержку Силаха Стронга как кандидата в Конгресс.

quote: You were looking for Tatiana, were you not?
before: - Thank you. Why are you here?
after: I considered it an invitation to bring her to dinner. It was very smart, but I warned you.
ru: - Ты же искал Татьяну, разве нет?

quote: And I was always looking for a better canvas to tie these all together.
before: In one, I used NASA supercomputers to design next-generation spacecraft, and in the other I was a data scientist looking for potential smugglers of sensitive nuclear technologies. As a data scientist, I did a lot of analyses, mostly of facilities, industrial facilities around the world.
after: And one day, I was thinking about how all data has a location, and I realized that the answer had been staring me in the face. Although I was a satellite engineer, I hadn't thought about using satellite imagery in my work.
ru: И я всегда искал канву, которая лучше подходит для того, чтобы связать их все вместе.

quote: So we switched our models, and now we began to look for skeletal stem cells.
before: And two, that maybe that, the degeneration or dysfunction of this stem cell is what's causing osteochondral arthritis, a very common ailment. So really the question was, were we looking for a pill when we should have really been looking for a cell.
after: And to cut again a long story short, about five years ago, we found these cells. They live inside the skeleton.
ru: Поэтому мы поменяли наши модели и начали искать скелетные стволовые клетки.

quote: And I was looking for caves: caves because caves are the original prime real estate.
before: There was actually a few other academics out there. But sadly, due to political instability, they moved out, and so I moved in.
after: But also because if you're looking for fossils in that kind of heat, your best bet for fossil preservation is always going to be caves. But then, Yemen took a really sad turn for the worse, and just a few days before I was due to fly out to Yemen, the civil war escalated into a regional conflict, the capital's airport was bombed and Yemen became a no-fly zone.
ru: И я начала искать пещеры: искать пещеры, потому что пещеры это первичный вид недвижимости.

quote: I look forward to it.
before: That's... Fantastic.
after: We liked you when you came in here. We like you more now. Well, thank you so much for taking the time.
ru: Буду с нетерпением ждать.

quote: I look forward to your trial.
before: - It's time. - Good. I'm glad Na'Toth didn't succeed.
after: Are you really that naive? Do you imagine Earth Alliance will permit this charade?
ru: С нетерпением буду ждать суда.

quote: Right, I'll look forward to that.
before: I could borrow it if you like. Yeah.
after: You're going to be late. It's 11:30.
ru: Конечно, буду ждать с нетерпением.

quote: Although, I gotta say, I'm looking forward to getting rid of this thing one day.
before: Are you feeling more like yourself? Well, according to my DNA, I'm 100% John Sheppard.
after: Doc says it'll clear up eventually. So listen.
ru: Хотя, должен сказать, я с нетерпением буду ждать, когда однажды смогу избавиться от этого.

quote: I hope you're looking forward to that. Thank you very much.
before: But I think in this context and with the idea of taking something fake and making it into something real, I'm just going to leave it there, and walk off the stage. (Laughter) I will be seeing you several times over the next few days.
after: (Laughter) (Applause)
ru: Надеюсь, вы будете с нетерпением ждать следующей встречи.

quote: Because if we do, I can look forward to the conversation I'm going to have with my daughter in 20 years.
before: I can't wait to see what we TEDsters do about this crisis. And I really, really hope that we multiply all of our energy, all of our talent and all of our influence to solve this problem.
after: (Applause)
ru: Потому что, если мы сделаем это, я буду с нетерпением ждать разговора, который у меня состоится с моей дочерю через 20 лет.

quote: They were trying to get me to look up your S.A.T. score.
before: What are you guys doing? I'm officially not a part of this.
after: - What? - What are you, a narc?
ru: Они пытались заставить меня посмотреть твои оценки.

quote: I-I-I looked her up and saw that she was playing in Vegas.
before: Is that why you showed up 18 years later and killed her? I-I, I didn't kill her.
after: I didn't come here to kill her. I came here to, to talk to her, explain my side of the story.
ru: Я искал её и увидел, что она играет в Вегасе.

quote: Who's on the other end looking it up?
before: It's like sending a letter. There's a box, you type in a question, and the answer comes up.
after: Nobody. It's in the wires.
ru: А кто на другом конце будет его искать?

quote: She was looking up places to buy the morning-after pill.
before: Mr. Kennish, I swear... Please don't play dumb with me. I saw her computer.
after: I don't know if that's the reason that you broke up, but I do know I do not want her with someone who would put her in that position. You know, honestly, I expected more from you.
ru: Она искала места ,чтобы купить Таблетку после не защищенного секса

quote: As we walked to the center of the room, I looked up at the heavens through the oculus.
before: Dad explained that this wasn't a big open hole, but it was called the oculus, an eye to the heavens. And there was something about this place, I didn't know why, that just felt special.
after: This was the first church that I'd been to that provided an unrestricted view between God and man. But I wondered, what about when it rained?
ru: Когда мы двинулись к центру помещения, я посмотрел на небо через окулус.

quote: So I put on my best "Yeah, I totally understand" face, and went home to look up what Décimas were.
before: I was getting up to leave and go home to write, when Joaquín stopped me and said, " Hang on, hang on, " and presented me with this challenge: " Write the stanzas for this song in Décimas. " Now, at this point in my life, I still wasn't completely sure what Décimas were, but I was too embarrassed to tell my teacher I didn't know.
after: I learned that a Décima is a type of verse that only exists in Spanish, and that it has 10 lines. It's very, very complex — perhaps the most complex style of stanza that we have in Spanish.
ru: Поэтому я сделал вид, что всё понял, пошёл домой и посмотрел, что такое децимы.

quote: We look up and to the left and see vultures circling round and round.
before: Instead, we hear them say, " Oh, look. Something must be dead. "
after: It occurred to me at this very moment that if these ladies at the derby are aware of vulture's connection to death, then why aren't we talking more about these birds at crime scenes? People know that vultures are connected to death.
ru: Посмотрев вверх, мы увидели кружащих в небе грифов.

quote: A boy needs to look up to his father.
before: She told him... I slept around, that I brought diseases home, that I fathered other children, that I never cared about them. What part of that is not true?
after: You poisoned him about me. yourself feel better, to control him.
ru: Мальчик должен уважать отца.

quote: But we all looked up to her, in many ways.
before: She was head and shoulders above the others. She didn't see eye to eye with everyone.
after: Now, one moment, please. There we are.
ru: Но мы все её уважали во многих отношениях.

quote: He is not the big football star we all used to look up to, Dale.
before: It looked like he needed a gig. That's all this is -- a-a jump-start.
after: You seriously want me to kick him out of the band? If you want that poster in the window.
ru: Он уже не та великая звезда футбола, которого мы так уважали, Дейл.

quote: The people need a hero. They need someone to look up to.
before: I have seen too much reality to trust in legends, and I am not alone. Nobody has any faith anymore.
after: My son believes in you. Bring us peace, and I will believe in you, too.
ru: Людям нужен такой герой, которым можно восхищаться.

quote: This is a friend of mine, who I look up to, Francis Collins, the director of the NIH, and this is us at TEDMED last year, chatting away.
before: And this was also derived from my family and my mentors, who always make me feel whole, and good about myself. Now today my ambitions have changed a little bit, I’ d like to go into the field of Biology, maybe cell biology, or genetics, or biochemistry, or really anything.
after: I feel that no matter what I choose to become, I believe that I can change the world. And as I’ m striving to change the world, I will be happy.
ru: Это — мой друг, которого я очень уважаю, Фрэнсис Коллинз, директор Национального Института Здоровья, и это мы за непринуждённой беседой на TEDMED в прошлом году.

quote: Those with "Need to know" will be looped in further.
before: C.I.A., 103. The number lost on U.S. soil, 4.
after: Until then, all I can say is we've lost a good operative. I've never seen it so quiet in here.
ru: Те, у кого есть допуск, будут посвящены в детали.

quote: Bad, bad timing, this. Okay, so I'll loop in East Africa desk.
before: You okayed his request. I didn't know he was going on a cruise.
after: I wanna call Jeff Miller at State. He's a guy you can at least talk to. And D.S. needs to free up some emergency funds for potential ransom.
ru: Ладно, значит я свяжусь с отделом по Восточной Африке.

quote: Send me the coordinates and I'll loop in Carlos.
before: I don't think it's on the cop's radar yet. Good work, Alec.
after: He is something, isn't he? You screw with that kid's life, and you will answer to me.
ru: Отправь мне координаты, а я сообщу Карлосу.

quote: You've got half of Illinois mobilized for a bio-attack, and you don't loop in the agency?
before: Great. All right, let's shut down these trains. What the hell, Jack?
after: - You didn't get a call? - We didn't. We didn't see any chatter on this, either,
ru: У вас половина Иллинойса мобилизована для предотвращения био-атаки, и вы не связались с управлением?

quote: The feds are also looped in, along with faa and transit.

ru: И это антидепрессантное медицинское средство производится обвиняемым?

quote: We need to find out who is manufacturing this drug and seize it.
before: You are criminal by association. By the mere fact that you attended school at St. Angelus.
after: We need to find out who else has it. If we open the lockers, how many parents will pull their kids from St. Angelus?
ru: Нам нужно отыскать производителя наркотиков и задержать его.

quote: This is too elaborate just to manufacture meth.
before: Check this out. Well, somebody trashed the place.
after: An industrial fridge. Don't usually see that in a meth lab.
ru: Это слишком сложное оборудование, чтобы просто производить мет.

quote: Mr. Openshaw ran the company which manufactured them.
before: The Pipz, aka "the beads." They're from a toy which was implicated in the deaths of a number of children last year.
after: Mr. Fordham was his criminal defense attorney. Some of the Pipz, you see, were poison.
ru: Мистер Опеншоу владел компанией-производителем.

quote: We even put satellites in space just to test the satellites, and we've learned to manufacture our satellites at scale.
before: And we take a different risk approach. We take them outside and test them.
after: We've used modern production techniques so we can build large numbers of them, I think for the first time. We call it agile aerospace, and that's what's enabled us to put so much capability into this little box.
ru: Мы даже запустили спутники в космос, просто чтобы их опробовать. И мы всерьёз научились производить их.

quote: Indeed, today we can manufacture gold on Earth thanks to modern inventions that those medieval alchemists missed by a few centuries.
before: They wanted to transform lowly lead into gleaming gold. History portrays these people as aged eccentrics, but if only they'd known that their dreams were actually achievable.
after: But to understand how this precious metal became embedded in our planet to start with, we have to gaze upwards at the stars. Gold is extraterrestrial.
ru: И правда: ведь сегодня мы можем производить золото. И всё благодаря достижениям науки, до которых средневековые алхимики не дожили каких-то несколько веков.

quote: He cofounded a company called Deaftronics, which now manufactures the Solar Ear, which is a hearing aid powered by his invention.
before: Now, he noticed that these hearing aids needed batteries that needed replacement, very often at a cost that was not affordable for most of the users that he knew. In response, and being an engineer, Tendekayi invented a solar-powered battery charger with rechargeable batteries, that could be used in these hearing aids.
after: My colleague, Sudesh Sivarasu, invented a smart glove for people who have suffered from leprosy. Even though their disease may have been cured, the resulting nerve damage will have left many of them without a sense of touch in their hands.
ru: Он стал соучредителем компании Deaftronics, которая на основе его изобретения производит слуховой аппарат под названием «Solar Ear» (Солнечное ухо).

quote: How frequently did the Neanderthals used bones to manufacture tools?
I promised to marry her as soon as she left her husband.
before: But the sight of you drove me crazy. Made me reckless.
after: - And she has left her husband now. - I left my husband, too.
ru: Я обещал жениться на ней, как только она бросит своего мужа.

quote: You don't have to be married to understand that.
before: You just have clients. I know what it feels like to care deeply about someone, okay?
after: Let me ask you a question. What does it feel like for you now to be the other guy?
ru: И не обязательно жениться, чтобы это понять.

quote: With such connections they can have very little chance of marrying well, Bingley.
before: Perhaps we should call, when we are next in town. They would be just as agreeable to me, had they uncles enough to fill all Cheapside!
after: That is the material point. Miss Bennet, how does your sister do?
ru: Да, с такими связями им будет очень сложно удачно выйти замуж, Бингли.

quote: You think I'd let my son marry a WASP?
before: This girl is shit to him. Look at her, she's a WASP.
after: It's not gonna happen. Is it true?
ru: Ты думаешь, что я бы позволил своему сыну жениться не на католичке?

quote: My uncle, my aunt, my brother or sister, cannot force me to marry.
before: My mother can't force me to marry. My father cannot force me to marry.
after: No one in the world can force me to marry. I'll marry when I want.
ru: Мой дядя, моя тётя, мои брат или сестра не смогут заставить меня выйти замуж.

quote: My son, he says he is not ready to get married.
before: But when they got older, when the time comes for them to start think about getting married, that's when we expect them to realize, a little bit more, their own culture. But that's where we had some problems.
after: And he has a sweetheart, but she is American woman, not Chinese. It's not that it's bad, but I told him, " What's wrong with a Chinese woman? "
ru: Мой сын говорит, он не готов к женитьбе.

quote: Any boys and girls caught flirting would get married off immediately, okay.
before: And the first one was about a group called The Party of God, who wanted to ban Valentine's Day. Red was made illegal.
after: The second one was about a woman complaining because three minivans with six bearded men pulled up and started interrogating her on the spot for talking to a man who wasn't related to her. And I asked the students in Kuwait where they thought these incidents took place.
ru: Запретить красный цвет. А если будет замечено, что юноша и девушка флиртуют друг с другом, их следует немедленно женить.

quote: McGuiness also said that "gays are not prohibited to marry in California."
It matches the outline on the wall in Zalman's workshop.
before: Looks like he's doing his preflight. Look at that.
after: He was painting a decal. Zoom in on that guy.
ru: Это совпадает с контуром стены в мастерской Залмана.

quote: The pattern on the carpet matches the blood on his shirt.
before: That's the way the maid said she found him. Well, this body's been rolled.
after: That could have been the killer. There's no wallet, nothing in his pockets.
ru: Отпечаток на ковре совпадает с кровью на рубашке.

quote: The bullet found in Agent Booth's body matches one fired from your gun.
before: They've arrested me, and they won't even tell me why. Well, how about for what we believe to be the most devastating terrorist attack on American soil since 9/11?
after: So add that to the list of all the other lives you took today. Liam, you know me.
ru: Пуля, найденная в теле агента Бута, совпадает с пулями, выпущенными из твоего пистолета.

quote: If someone else was here, that matches the M.O. of the Son of Sam murders.
before: But it rained last night. It compromised the scene.
after: Berkowitz's first victims were two girls he shot in a car. Yes, but one of them was only hit in the leg and survived.
ru: Если был кто-то ещё, это совпадает с почерком убийств Сына Сэма.

quote: Random genetic mutations in orchids may result in a trait– like a scent or a shape– that, by chance, matches the needs of a single insect species.
before: Other orchids look and smell just like the fungi on which certain insects lay their eggs. Where do all these bizarre adaptations come from?
after: The huge diversity within the insect world also increases the likelihood that an orchid will find a unique audience. Able to make more seeds and offspring with the help of its dedicated pollinators, the orchid successfully reproduces in isolation, and becomes a new species.
ru: Случайные генетические мутации могут привести к появлению у орхидей свойств, например запаха или формы, удачно совпадающих с потребностями отдельных видов насекомых.

quote: Remember that "cisgendered" means that your gender identity does match the gender you were assigned at birth.
before: In our original diagram, rich white men were at the top, but if we restricted our attention to non-men, we would see that they are here, and now the rich, white non-men are at the top. So we could move to a whole context of women, and our three types of privilege could now be rich, white and cisgendered.
after: So now we see that rich, white cis women occupy the analogous situation that rich white men did in broader society. And this has helped me understand why there is so much anger towards rich white women, especially in some parts of the feminist movement at the moment, because perhaps they're prone to seeing themselves as underprivileged relative to white men, and they forget how overprivileged they are relative to nonwhite women.
ru: Помните, цисгендер означает, что тот, кем вы себя ощущаете, совпадает с тем, какой пол у вас определили при рождении.

quote: Then after we harvest a coral, we measure this ratio, and now you can see, those curves match perfectly.
before: Their ratio tells us the water temperature. In this example here, we had monitored this reef in Galapagos with temperature recorders, so we know the temperature of the water the coral's growing in.
after: In this case, at these islands, you know, corals are instrumental-quality recorders of change in the water. And of course, our thermometers only take us back 50 years or so here.
ru: Вырастив коралл, мы определили содержание изотопов кислорода. Как видите, две кривые идеально совпадают.

quote: This means we're next, and I care about us.
before: TROY: Please, Pierce. Please, don't die slightly before your time.
after: Where--? Gotcha!
ru: - Это значит, мы следующие, а я беспокоюсь о нас.

quote: It doesn't mean we won't continue with our sex life, which is very important to me.
before: At the moment, I don't seem to satisfy you in the way that I'd like to. Don't get upset, Joe.
after: Very important to me. When you buy a tiger, right, you also have to feed it.
ru: Это не значит, что мы поставим крест на нашей сексуальной жизни, которая очень важна для меня.

quote: What do you mean The Library is cut off from the outside world?
before: Flynn, what happens when the bell stops? Charlene, no!
after: Get out! Grab what you can and get out!
ru: Что значит, Библиотека отрезана от внешнего мира?

quote: Which could mean he doesn't feel very important in his everyday life.
before: Well, it makes him easier to control. He prolongs the torture because the more he does, the more powerful he feels.
after: Kate: Maybe he has low self-worth. Like attracts like.
ru: Это может говорить о том, что он не чувствует себя значимым в повседневной жизни.

quote: But that doesn't mean we voters can't demand courage from our political leaders.
before: Making big changes involves taking big risks, and taking big risks is scary. Overcoming that fear requires guts, and as you all know, gutsy politicians are painfully rare.
after: I mean, that's why we put them in office in the first place. And given the state of the world today, there's really no other option.
ru: Но это не значит, что мы, избиратели, не можем требовать от политических лидеров храбрости.

quote: Meaning that fat could be this new sixth basic taste.
before: Which we know surprisingly little about. For example, we know that there are those five basic tastes, but we strongly suspect that there are more, and in fact, using our EEG setup, we found evidence that fat, besides being sensed by its texture and smell, is also tasted.
after: And if we figure out how our brain recognizes fat and sugar, and I'm just dreaming here, but could we then one day create a milkshake with zero calories that tastes just like the real deal? Or maybe we figure out that we can't, because we subconsciously detect calories via our receptors in our gastrointestinal tract.
ru: Это значит, что жир может стать шестым основным вкусом.

quote: It means, for example, that the smallest male in a group can be the alpha male.
before: He has only trouble with the combination of the two. And so the coalition formation that goes on in chimpanzee society makes it much more complex than you think.
after: You don't need to be the biggest and strongest male. The smallest male, if he has the right friends and keeps them happy, or he has female support, he can be the alpha male.
ru: Это значит, например, что самый маленький самец в стае может быть альфа-самцом.

quote: Blow crap up they will, but this time, Instead of trying to visualize the shock wave, They'll measure it.
before: A good day to blow some crap up, huh? You bet.
after: Adam: This plumbing equipment here is a matrix For holding together our key piece Of detection equipment in this myth, And that is this -- an oseco rupture disk, Basically a calibrated piece of aluminum foil.
ru: Они будут взрывать, но на этот раз вместо попыток визуализировать ударную волну они будут измерять ее.

quote: Park's tiger mom and dad were so insufferable, she has to measure their affection in hours.
before: - Thank you. Makes sense.
after: Chase's careerist dad and alcoholic mom were so indifferent, he has to believe it's a wash. Your turn.
ru: Суровые родители Парк были настолько невыносимы, что она должна измерять их любовь в часах.

quote: You once told me how much you hated that your father measured his happiness by the night's receipts.
before: To be honest, I don't think I realized how much this place being closed put me in a funk, but I swear, it's like I'm starting to feel alive again. Careful.
after: Yeah, but that's because it's all he had. Declan and I were always butting heads with him, his marriage was crap.
ru: Однажды ты сказал мне, как ненавидел, что твой отец измерял свое счастье выручкой за вечер.

quote: They run water temperature tests to measure the greenhouse effects.
before: You own a boat, Mr. Grant? The fund owns one.
after: But you didn't bring me in here to talk about a boat, now, did you? Sarah Rhodes and Adam Lewis.
ru: Они измеряют температуру воды, чтобы определить парниковый эффект.

quote: It's coming into some tricky things then when we are measuring MDGs.
before: So what I'm telling you is that we know the child mortality. We have a decent trend.
after: And the reason here for Africa is especially important, because' 90s was a bad decade, not only in Kenya, but across Africa. The HIV epidemic peaked.
ru: Но затем начинаются всякие неоднозначные моменты, когда мы измеряем результаты достижения ЦРТ.

quote: You know, it looks at economic power measured by GDP.
before: And that the Chinese won't catch up or pass the Americans until somewhere in the latter part, after 2050, of this century. The other point that's worth noticing is how one-dimensional this projection is.
after: Doesn't tell you much about military power, doesn't tell you very much about soft power. It's all very one-dimensional.
ru: Видите ли, он учитывает экономическую мощь, измеряемую в ВВП.

quote: Rezero keeps his balance by constantly measuring his pitch angle with a sensor.
before: Now we'll explain that in a second. Let me first explain how Rezero actually keeps his balance.
after: He then counteracts and avoids toppling over by turning the motors appropriately. This happens 160 times per second, and if anything fails in this process, Rezero would immediately fall to the ground.
ru: Резеро балансирует, постоянно измеряя угол наклона с помощью сенсора.

quote: Strong aftershocks followed the initial earthquake, with at least one measuring a magnitude 5.6.
after: Tsunami alerts were issued for the entire South Pacific region but were later canceled. Survivors fled to high ground and stayed there for hours. __NOTOC__

quote: Before you were taken, you met with a man.
before: You're-you're doing really good. I have just one more question.
after: At a coffee house. Yeah, I remember.
ru: До того, как тебя похитили, ты встречалась с мужчиной.

quote: Do you kiss the wife of every president you meet?
before: Well, dignity's a bit overrated for a mistress, don't you think? Ah... you know, a woman like your wife, for example, would certainly make it worthwhile.
after: Oh. Not every president's wife looks like yours.
ru: Ты поцелуй жены каждый президент, вы встречаетесь?

quote: How could I have imagined someone I've never met before?
before: Job done, right? She's alive!
after: That's her, exactly. Same dress, same everything... except for the tattoo.
ru: Как мне мог привидеться человек, с которым я ранее не встречался?

quote: Maybe he met with a person there, huh?
before: No, I guess he can't. Unless we find out where he was staying.
after: - I'll look into it. - No, I'll do it. You go home.
ru: Может, они там встречались?

quote: So I want to introduce you to this framework: Old power, meet new power.
before: How can we describe it and give it a framework that makes it more useful? Because we realized that many of the lessons that we were discovering in movements actually applied all over the world in many sectors of our society.
after: And I want to talk to you about what new power is today. New power is the deployment of mass participation and peer coordination — these are the two key elements — to create change and shift outcomes.
ru: Я хочу ознакомить вас с этой основой: старая власть встречает новую власть.

quote: And you meet someone you really like, you get to know her.
before: And when I tell people about this, they tend to think of maybe an 80 or 90 year-old person who looks really good for being 90 or 80. But it's really more like this: let's say you're a 30 year-old guy — or in your 30s — and you're a bachelor and you're dating people.
after: And you're in a restaurant, and you say, " Well how old are you? " She says, " I'm 60. "
ru: Вы встречаете кого-то, кто вам очень нравится, вы с ней знакомитесь.

quote: Number two -- my favorite -- we meet a rogue black hole.
before: Now, there is money in the federal budget, next year, to build up the public health service. But I don't think to any extent that it really needs to be done.
after: You know, 10 years ago, or 15 years ago, really, you walk into an astronomy convention, and you say, " You know, there's probably a black hole at the center of every galaxy, " and they're going to hoot you off the stage. And now, if you went into one of those conventions and you said, " Well, I don't think black holes are out there, " they'd hoot you off the stage.
ru: Номер два — моё любимое: мы встречаем злобную чёрную дыру.

quote: High schools had to meet a passing grade of 55 percent or face large scale reform.
before: In March, Wake County Superior Court Judge Howard Manning threatened to close state high schools that did not meet his expectations.

quote: Let me guess, someone's making it difficult for you to meet your deadline.
before: Still got the ink stains on my fingers. The contract stipulates that if I don't finish phase one of the build within six months, Playa Verde takes full control of the property.
after: Workplace accidents, stolen materials, nothing went right since they came onboard. Playa Verde sent a security consultant to keep an eye out.
ru: Дайте-ка я угадаю, кто-то начал усложнять вам задачу уложиться в срок.

quote: And if we do not meet this deadline-- we'll meet the deadline.
before: Look, if you just want me to kill him, I can do it in his sleep. But if the point is to make it look like somebody else did it-- the point is we are running out of time.
after: Want to take it down to the truck? Yeah, hold on.
ru: И если мы не управимся в срок... Мы управимся.

quote: Gina, if they meet my deadline, I win.
before: They're pissed off they didn't get him, that's all. Please.
after: If they don't, they give me licence to go after them twice as hard. Thank you.
ru: Джина, если они уложатся в мой дедлайн, я выиграю.

quote: We just need to meet our deadline.
before: If I rake in all our receivables and hold back some pay checks we can pay one single fine. I got the money.
after: - Just how did you do that? - I took out a second mortgage.
ru: Мы просто должны укладываться в сроки.

quote: Yeah, it was easy enough to finish the transfer in time to meet the deadline.
before: Well, once I figured out where the mistake was, you know, they took the money from your account, put it into their account, but never sent it on to "Heat" magazine's account before they left for the weekend... Assholes.
after: It was genius. Sheer genius.
ru: Да; было уже довольно легко закончить перевод вовремя, чтобы успеть к сроку.

quote: I didn't think you'd meet the deadline.
before: I wanted to be sure that it would get done. It wasn't due for two more days.
after: - Based on what? - Based on past performance.
ru: Я думала, что ты не уложишься в срок.

quote: My contact in Boston may have mentioned that Meredith said their program's her first choice.
before: Not without Yang anyway. Cristina has options.
after: You're building a house. Harvard has an excellent neurosurgery department.
ru: Мой человек в Бостоне упоминал, что Мередит сказала что их программа для нее на первом месте.

quote: Now we mustn't mention him to Daddy, else it'll spoil the surprise.
before: An old friend. Of the family.
after: And there'll be special sweets for boys who can keep secrets. I wanted to thank you... for what you did the other day with my father.
ru: Мы не должны упоминать о нем папе, иначе мы испортим сюрприз.

quote: And when you mentioned it on our date, I remembered it instantly.
before: God, I really hate that band. I was at the first show.
after: It was you. Did I mention I'm a terrible person?
ru: Когда ты упомянул его на нашем свидании, я сразу же вспомнила.

quote: Dr. Naylor ever mention the name Morland Holmes?
before: Maybe a family member who thought he belonged in a mental health facility, took it out on Dr. Naylor. What are the chances that the same family member wanted Emil Kurtz dead?
after: Sorry, no. Calendars and contacts.
ru: Доктор Нейлор упоминала имя Морланда Холмса?

quote: Well, you remember that World Values Survey that I mentioned earlier?
before: (Laughter) Or maybe the heartless, greedy Wall Street type, right? Or maybe people like me, with multiple origins, living in a big, cosmopolitan metropolis.
after: It showed another fascinating finding: 71 percent of the world population agreed with the statement, " I am a citizen of the world. " Do you know what it means?
ru: Помните Всемирный обзор ценностей, который я упоминал ранее?

quote: Joseph Jeune also never mentioned that he was not cost-effective.
before: And we were seeing patients like this. Joseph Jeune.
after: A few months of medicines, and this is what he looked like. (Applause) We call that the Lazarus Effect of HIV treatment.
ru: Джозеф Джён тоже никогда не упоминал о нерентабельности своего лечения.

quote: Carolyn Porco mentioned another one called Enceladus the other day.
before: It was that gadget that serendipitously opened a door to another unexplored world. This is Europa.
after: This is one of the places where planetary scientists believe there is a highest probability of the detection of the first life off earth in the ocean that exists below there. For those who have never seen this story, Jim Cameron produced a really wonderful IMAX movie couple of years ago, called " Aliens of the Deep. "
ru: Кэролин Порко уже упомянула Энцелад здесь недавно.

quote: The budget report mentioned a increase in fuel duty.
after: The budget report said that "the planned fuel duty increase of 2 pence per litre in April 2008 will now be postponed until October 1, 2008. Main road fuel duty rates will rise by 1.84 pence per litre on 1 April 2009, and will increase by 0.5 pence per litre above inflation on 1 April 2010".

quote: But I really did miss you, and you know how much I care about you.
before: I just want to wait and see how things go. All right, we can wait.
after: And you know how much I care about you, but I'm still not doing it. What if I decide to go to the same school that Jack is going to?
ru: Но я действительно скучал по тебе, и ты знаешь, что ты мне небезразлична.

quote: My boss had a tee time that he didn't want to miss.
before: You want them to have your back. Because at the end of the day, it wasn't about proving my mettle.
after: I wasn't there long. Could I ask why we are here?
ru: Мой босс не хотел пропустить игру в гольф.

quote: Now, there's a heart-warming tableau that Norman Rockwell somehow missed.
before: All right, come on. And I'm gonna take you now to show you your first lady butt.
after: Hello, ladies. Earl!
ru: Вот это греющая сердце картина, которую Норман Роквелл каким-то образом пропустил.

quote: I hate the feeling that I missed out on everything.
before: I-I don't know when this thing became about proving something. It just did.
after: You--you have your stories. I've heard all of them--
ru: Я ненавижу чувство, что я все пропустила.

quote: What he missed was connection to the other men he was with.
before: I think what he missed is brotherhood. He missed, in some ways, the opposite of killing.
after: Now, brotherhood is different from friendship. Friendship happens in society, obviously.
ru: Он скучал по связи с другими мужчинами, которая у него была.

quote: I also missed the sense of clarity I'd felt at my sickest.
before: Like me, everyone in there was broken. But out here, among the living, I felt like an impostor, overwhelmed and unable to function.
after: Staring your mortality straight in the eye has a way of simplifying things, of rerouting your focus to what really matters. And when I was sick, I vowed that if I survived, it had to be for something.
ru: Ещё я скучала по ясности, которую чувствовала, когда болела.

quote: They want to be missed when they're gone.
before: They want to be missed. They want to be missed the day they don't show up.
after: And tribe leaders can do that. It's fascinating, because all tribe leaders have charisma, but you don't need charisma to become a leader.
ru: Они хотят, чтобы по ним скучали, когда они уходят.

quote: Heat-seeking devices and helicopters are being used by rescue workers to search for missing persons.
before: Four people are reportedly still missing.

quote: You both donate, they mix it up, fertilize the egg.
before: But that's the beauty of the swirl. The swirl?
after: You never know who the father is. Ooh. That's Stefan.
ru: Вы оба сдаете сперму, ее смешивают, и оплодотворяют яйцеклетку.

quote: Mixing these elements, we irrevocably bind ourselves to one another, creating a new Crescent pack.
before: I'll explain later. Oh. Your timing is perfect.
after: I ask each one of you, do you renounce your alpha status? Well, where is he?
ru: Смешивая эти элементы, мы навсегда связываем друг друга, создавая новую стаю Полумесяца.

quote: I know you usually mix it, I couldn't quite bring myself to do it, but...
before: Gene? Um, I brought you a beer and some ice cream.
