after: A... are you there? Anyway, I just wanted to apologize for earlier at dinner, and, uh... That's it, really.
ru: Знаю ты обычно их смешиваешь, не думаю, что я бы решилась...

quote: If they have to tell you how to mix it, it's all the better.
before: Oh, that's perfect. The only reason people order exotic drinks is to show how sophisticated they are.
after: It makes them feel like experts. Plus Larry and I are gonna have our hands full.
ru: Им придётся объяснить, что надо смешивать. Даже лучше.

quote: I think it's great we're all hugging here, as we mix our vowels, and we make the saddle.
before: I speak a little bit — you don't understand, but I speak a little bit and I'm sure you are my friend. You are my friend, You are my friend, You are my friend, You are my — I love people.
after: I appreciate less the consonants of those we haven't sounded. I'm pressing the buzzer; I am interpassionate.
ru: Я думаю, это хорошо, когда мы обнимаемся, когда мы смешиваем наши гласные, мы помогаем друг другу.

quote: And the blue former developing countries are mixing up with the former industrialized western world.
before: And it is the DHS that makes it possible to know this. And we had an increase in income.
after: We have a continuum. But we still have, of course, Congo, up there.
ru: И синие, ранее «развивающиеся» страны, смешиваются с бывшим индустриальным «западным» миром.

quote: We freely mix R's and L's, English and vernacular versions of their names.
before: And if they lose their booklets, their records can still be pulled by searching with their names. Now, the way we pronounce and spell names varies tremendously.
after: Even soundex, a standard method for grouping words by how similar they sound, was not good enough. So we had to modify it to help us link and match existing records.
ru: Мы свободно смешиваем «Р» и «Л», английские и народные версии имён.

quote: The company's performance this year compared to last year has been mixed.
before: The total complaints against Sallie Mae for September of this year is 2 fewer than the same time last year.
after: March and June numbers were down over 150 complaints from the same month a year before. April, May, July and August all saw increases of 17–43.

quote: Helen was beaten last night, and then she was pushed from a moving vehicle.
before: And we weren't supposed to trust calls or e-mails from each other because they could've been a trap. And we could have ended up hurt or... or dead.
after: Do you think that The Wolf killed her? How do I get a hold of him?
ru: Хелен избили прошлой ночью, а затем ее вышвырнули из двигающегося автомобиля.

quote: I am effectively quitting Shulman Associates and moving to Texas.
before: It's actually... Guys, I've got some incredibly major news.
after: And I want to thank the one person that convinced me to keep Austin weird and follow my heart, Mindy Lahiri.
ru: Я покидаю "Шульман и парнеры" и переезжаю в Техас.

quote: Jason would want us to move on with our lives.
before: So I speak with the confidence only a twin could have... Jason wouldn't want us to spend the year mourning.
after: Which is why I've asked the School Board not to cancel the Back-to-School semiformal. But rather, to let us use it as a way to heal, collectively, and celebrate my brother's too, too short life on this mortal coil.
ru: Джейсон хотел бы, чтобы мы двигались дальше.

quote: His fiancée was just murdered,and he's already moving on.
before: He's blind. That's too literal,Bones.
after: Well,she's gone. He has accepted it.
ru: Его невеста была убита и он двигается дальше

quote: But I think with the vision to do that, we can move forward.
before: We have 30 students a year go out into the field and try to implement this and move it forward. The other thing is you have to do things with a long time frame, as, you know, you can't expect to get something done in a year or two years; you have to be looking five or 10 years ahead.
ru: Но я думаю, что, имея представление об этом, мы можем двигаться дальше.

quote: The bubbles will move to the target areas.
before: It can also play a role in medicines, for instance, as a method for noninvasive delivery systems for drugs and genes to a specific part of the body. Imagine a microbubble filled with a mixture of drugs and magnetic agents being injected into our bloodstream.
after: But how do they know where to go? Because we placed a magnet there.
ru: Пузырьки будут двигаться к цели.

quote: It's a pool of water, and the protocell starts moving itself around in the system.
before: In this protocell model, it's just an oil droplet, but a chemical metabolism inside that allows this protocell to use energy to do something, to actually become dynamic, as we'll see here. You add the droplet to the system.
after: Okay? Oil droplet forms through self-assembly, has a chemical metabolism inside so it can use energy, and it uses that energy to move itself around in its environment.
ru: Это вода, и протоклетка начинает двигаться по этой системе.

quote: "We aimed our weapons at him and told him to move away from us" (Ynet).
before: "The boy pulled out a matchbox, held up a pipe bomb, and attempted to detonate it," said Muli.

quote: Jack, we need to get you off this boat.
before: Hey, bud. They say the best way to a fisherman's heart is through his fly.
after: Yeah, Jill didn't care for that one, either. I'm fine.
ru: Джек, нужно забрать тебя отсюда.

quote: If you need these, you must be planning to hit one of these targets.
before: David Estes is briefing you tomorrow morning on homeland security. There's a safe in his office containing the encryption key to a database of potential targets.
after: I am not a terrorist. There's a difference between terrorism and a justifiable act of retaliation.
ru: Если вам нужно это, вы должно быть готовите удар по одной из этих целей.

quote: She needs a cane to walk, you know?
before: She... she's a widow. She works hard all day, every day, just like her mother before her, from dawn till dusk, scrubbing the floors of rich people.
after: She's got arthritis. And still, she works every day.
ru: Ей нужна палочка для ходьбы, понимаете?

quote: Go ahead. I said I needed 10 rental cars.
before: Lee Jung-soo speaking. No problem, I'm driving.
after: But we're a bit short on cash. So instead I'll take 8, and can you throw in 3 of those kids' car seats?
ru: Помните, я говорил, что мне нужно 10 машин?

quote: We need to have a meal that we can trust, live long lives.
before: We want to eat good and healthy. And if we eat an animal, it needs to be one that had a happy and healthy life.
after: And this is not just for people in San Francisco or Northern Europe — this is for all of us. Even in the poorest countries, it's not just about money.
ru: Нам нужна пища, которой мы можем доверять, благодаря которой можно жить долгие годы,

quote: It needs to be a decade-long approach, rather than just a couple of years.
before: It does increase security. But it needs to be done long-term.
after: That's one actor, the Security Council. The second actor, different cast of guys, is the donors.
ru: Миротворческие силы нужно вводить на всё десятилетие, а не просто на пару лет.

quote: I need a woman volunteer. Where can I get one in India?
before: That's how all this started, but after making a sanitary pad, where can I check it? It's not like I can just check it in the lab.
after: Even in Bangalore you won't get [one], in India. So only problem: the only available victim is my wife.
ru: Мне нужна женщина-доброволец. Как я смогу найти её в Индии?

quote: We need to keep our precious resources intact and available for future generations.
before: As an independent it can be tricky to pass private member bills, but some big reforms I would like to see passed in my lifetime include, reinstating the euthanasia law, legalizing cannabis, decriminalising other drugs, strengthening the environmental protection legislation and removing floor pricing from alcohol sales (as it only benefits the suppliers and bottle shops). But I think one of the key reforms I would love to action immediately is strengthening of the Water Act to protect our waterways and water sources; we would need to see appropriate penalties for illegal extraction and a tightened control on licensing to reduce overuse.

quote: If they say it's too dangerous to negotiate, we have to listen.
before: You're not thinking straight. If I don't talk to Mantus, this is nothing more than an execution.
after: You may be the ranking officer here but they have years of experience. This is what they do!
ru: Если они говорят, что переговоры вести опасно - стоит их послушать.

quote: I mean, we could be negotiating with, like, Susan Sarandon or something.
before: Empty calories. This body needs protein.
after: The governor is not going to send an actress to negotiate a prison deal. She's an actrivist.
ru: В смысле, мы могли бы вести переговоры, например, с Сьюзен Сарандон.

quote: Fortunately we will never have to negotiate over Norway.
before: - I don't believe in negotiating. And I don't think this "total war", in which we find ourselves, will allow for it.
after: Here's to good old Fortress Norway. - To Norway.
ru: Если нам повезет нам не придется договариваться с Норвегией.

quote: I'm not going to negotiate over the phone.
before: A couple million dollars? No, no, no, no.
after: I'm just saying, if you still have a desire to do this thing, then, um, I have half a mind to help you. Joe?
ru: Я не собираюсь вести переговоры по телефону.

quote: You can't negotiate with the laws of physics.
before: And we couldn't just turn it off. You can't make a peace treaty with the planet.
after: You're in there. You're stuck.
ru: Нельзя вести переговоры с законами физики.

quote: I was negotiating, compromising, building alliances with other political actors.
before: So you could say I was raised as a politician. By the age of six or seven, I mastered politics.
after: (Laughter) And I even once tried to jeopardize the political process. (Laughter) These meetings sound very peaceful, civil and democratic, right?
ru: Я умела вести переговоры, идти на компромиссы, создавала союзы с другими политическими силами.

quote: Chinese people start to learn how to negotiate and talk to people.
before: It's like a big TED, right? But also, it is like the first time a public sphere happened in China.
after: But also, the cat, the censorship, is not sleeping. It's so hard to post some sensitive words on the Chinese Weibo.
ru: Китайцы начинают учиться, как вести переговоры и говорить с людьми.

quote: We do not negotiate with terrorists, we put them out of business.
before: We will not let up or stop until the job is done. We will win this war on terrorism.
after: We're working to advance freedom and democracy. We will pursue those who seek to do harm."

quote: Hey, Frankie, did you ever notice how Frost can talk and work at the same time?
before: If you find it boring going through old files, maybe Martinez has something exciting to do. Yeah, somebody's got to count all those seized xanax pills.
after: [sighs] "Bats in the attic." "Lost car keys."
ru: Эй, Фрэнки, ты когда-нибудь замечал, как Фрост ухитряется одновременно говорить и работать?

quote: I was looking at you but you didn't notice me.
before: - I know everything about you. We were studying together.
after: You were occupied with studying, practice, always in a hurry... I failed on third year because Kenigsmark, works with you at the hospital, didn't' gave permission for exam in ethics.
ru: Я все время смотрел на вас, но вы не замечали меня.

quote: So there's something wrong, there's some detail I'm not noticing that's spoiling the big picture.
before: Maybe just a fly. In the ointment.
after: Is this significant? Or is this dream just going in a different direction now?
ru: Значит, что-то не так. Есть какая-то деталь, которую я не замечаю. Которая портит всю картину.

quote: Spend enough time with someone, and they begin to notice your patterns.
before: As you're so adept at reading my mind, what do I want now? Privacy.
after: Yeah, well, Palmer's got your number, Duck. And I have yours.
ru: Проведи достаточно времени с кем-то рядом, и они начнут замечать твои привычки.

quote: Some begin to notice an improvement in their symptoms after just one session, while others take longer to respond.
before: Half or more of those who undergo treatment experience an improvement in their symptoms. Most patients treated with ECT have two or three sessions per week for several weeks.
after: Patients often continue less frequent treatments for several months to a year, and some need occasional maintenance sessions for the rest of their lives. Modern ECT is much safer than it used to be, but patients can still experience side effects.
ru: Некоторые замечают улучшение состояния уже после первого сеанса, а у других прогресс наступает позднее.

quote: That we wouldn't be able to notice this difference after all.
before: (Laughter) And worse... I also feared that this investment would be in vain.
after: Unfortunately, especially for my husband, he had momentarily forgotten that he's married to a neuroscientist with a specialty in food science. (Laughter) Alright?
ru: что мы со временем перестанем замечать разницу.

quote: And then you notice that those seeds become farms across the Bronx that look like this.
before: But with those seeds, from day one, we are growing in my classroom, and this is what it looks like in my classroom. And you see how attentive these kids are to these seeds.
after: But again, I am not a farmer. I'm a teacher.
ru: И затем вы замечаете, что семена становятся фермами по всему Бронксу, и это выглядит так.

quote: Kop noticed the warm black rock on her father's bedroom floor about 12:30 PM (UTC−04:00).
after: She found two holes in the ceiling, which scientists determined the meteorite created when it impacted the house at high speed and bounced off the floor. Kop contacted the police, who sent a hazmat team, which determined the rock was not dangerously radioactive.

quote: From here on in, my role is to observe and report.
before: That must involve a lot of travel. Focus, Chuck.
after: More of like a proctor than a partner. What's this thing?
ru: С этого момента, моя роль в задании: наблюдать и докладывать.

quote: Kepler proves that the reality we observe solely depends on the observer.
before: Because no matter how precise and complex the mechanism may be, it also comes with its own share of madness. Thanks to his cosmological model,
after: Reality and dreams can constantly be mistaken for one another. Based on Kepler's theory and on my own observations, my hypothesis is the following:
ru: Кеплер доказывает, что реальность, которую мы наблюдаем зависит исключительно от наблюдающего.

quote: Observing us like we're animals at the zoo.
before: How superior you are. A woman of your means slumming the lower depths.
after: You see there are no bars here. And we are not caged.
ru: Наблюдающая за нами, как будто мы животные в зоопарке.

quote: I'll be observing Dr. Lightman's progress with the prisoner.
before: Defense. Special deputy operations and plans.
after: Top secret news sure does spread fast in this town. Ha ha! Welcome. Cute. This way.
ru: Отдел специальных операций. Я буду наблюдать за работой доктора Лайтмана с пленником.

quote: The second pattern I observe is the need for remembrance.
before: As I placed the defibrillator pads on his chest, prepping for what was going to happen, he looked me in the eye and said, " I wish I had spent more time with my children and grandchildren instead of being selfish with my time. " Faced with imminent death, all he wanted was forgiveness.
after: Whether it was to be remembered in my thoughts or their loved ones', they needed to feel that they would be living on. There's a need for immortality within the hearts and thoughts of their loved ones, myself, my crew, or anyone around.
ru: Вторая вещь, которую я наблюдаю — потребность в том, чтобы тебя помнили.

quote: But we observed that there are no cells entering the brains of these animals.
before: There are more genes expressed that are known to be involved in the formation of new memories. And there's less of this bad inflammation.
after: So when we connect them, there are actually no cells going into the old brain, in this model. Instead, we've reasoned, then, that it must be the soluble factors, so we could collect simply the soluble fraction of blood which is called plasma, and inject either young plasma or old plasma into these mice, and we could reproduce these rejuvenating effects, but what we could also do now is we could do memory tests with mice.
ru: Но мы наблюдали, что никакие клетки не проникают в мозг этих животных.

quote: In fact, I grew up observing two different kinds of womanhood.
before: Now in the early 1970s, in Ankara, that was a bit unusual. Our neighborhood was full of large families, where fathers were the heads of households, so I grew up seeing my mother as a divorcee in a patriarchal environment.
after: On the one hand was my mother, a well-educated, secular, modern, westernized, Turkish woman. On the other hand was my grandmother, who also took care of me and was more spiritual, less educated and definitely less rational.
ru: В действительности, я росла, наблюдая два разных типа женщин.

quote: So we never observed in the same system a planet and the spiral, ok.
before: And we know that planet should generate structures like spirals in a disk. So we knew from the theory that planet and spirals are connected, but we never ever made the connection between the two.
after: So here, we don't have exactly observed that because we did not detect the planet, but we detected the presence of the planet in the structure of the spiral. So we are getting one step closer to making the connection between the planet and the spirals, and the structures in the disk.

quote: Did it even occur to you that I might get fired?
before: - I'm right. Definitely right.
after: - You just don't care. - What happened?
ru: Тебе приходило в голову, что меня могут уволить?

quote: Did it ever occur to you that she might not want to talk to you?
before: She's been gone a week now. I can't find her, and she won't call me back.
after: - Okay, okay, come on, let's calm down, step outside in the hall, have a chat, all right? You okay?
ru: Тебе не приходило в голову, что, возможно, она не хочет говорить с тобой?

quote: Did it ever occur to you that I don't need taking care of?
before: I appreciate the help but stop cop-blocking me! I guess a thousand years of chivalry is hard to shake.
after: I know. - I just wanted to be here.
ru: Тебе когда-нибудь вообще приходило в голову, что обо мне не нужно заботиться?

quote: Well, did it ever occur to you you sucked at your job?
before: What did they get for it? Cooked in their own skin.
after: You know, maybe Miles has a right to talk to me like that, maybe. You?
ru: А тебе когда-нибудь приходило в голову, что ты дерьмово выполнял свою работу?

quote: Secondly, survival is not how evolution occurs, reproduction is.
before: For one thing, evolutionary fitness is just a matter of how well-suited they are to their current environment. If all the tall trees suddenly died out and only short grass was left, all those long-necked giraffes would be at a disadvantage.
after: And the world if full of creatures like the male anglerfish, which is so small and ill-suited for survival at birth that it has to quickly find a mate before it dies. But at least we can say that if an organism dies without reproducing, it's evolutionarily useless, right?
ru: Во-вторых, эволюция происходит не при выживании того или иного существа, а при его репродукции.

quote: It didn't occur to me that glasses were really a medical device.
before: I think that at the time, Catwoman had a really cool pair of glasses in the Batman series that was on television. And I wanted to be cool like her.
after: (Small Thing.) (Big Idea.)
ru: Мне даже не приходило в голову, что очки носят по рецепту окулиста.

quote: We know that damage to the brain occurs after death and during freezing.
before: I don't know — I prefer to test their beliefs, scientifically. I propose that we attempt to find a connectome of a frozen brain.
after: The question is: has that damage erased the connectome? If it has, there is no way that any future civilization will be able to recover the memories of these frozen brains.
ru: Мы знаем, что происходит повреждение мозга после смерти и во время заморозки.

quote: Debate on the bill will occur at a later date.
after: A bill proposed later in the sitting day by the Australian Greens to stop the Governor-General disallowing ACT state law establishing civil unions failed, by a majority of two votes.

quote: We're offering you the opportunity to take responsibility now.
before: I'm sorry, Mr. Kent, but what is this about? I called you in as a courtesy.
after: Or we'll be filing a lawsuit this afternoon. Okay, what the hell is going on here?
ru: Мы предлагаем вам возможность сейчас взять на себя ответственность.

quote: Angela, you should really be offering some healthy snacks.
before: No, but you can try one of these instead... my new espresso brownies. Business is booming!
after: I do. They just don't sell.
ru: Анжела, вы должны предлагать и здоровые легкие закуски.

quote: But please don't offer me a cup of Horlicks.
before: I really didn't fancy a complexion-ruining evening of orange squash and pork scratchings. I can't say I blame you.
after: If you do, I might burst into tears. God love you, but you look lonely.
ru: Но не стоит предлагать мне чашечку "Хорликса".

quote: We've been offered 14 million and a 2-year exclusive for all their products.
before: Right, everything we need. These are The Moon sweets, the future of our agency.
after: The Japanese have set up a competition between agencies. So, what did I do?
ru: Будущее нашего агентства. Нам предлагают четырнадцать миллионов и двухлетний контракт на рекламу всех продуктов этой марки.

quote: And in exchange, women have offered fidelity, or at least a promise of fidelity.
before: The idea is that, as part of human nature, from the beginning of our species' time, men have sort of leased women's reproductive potential by providing them with certain goods and services. Generally we're talking about meat, shelter, status, protection, things like that.
after: Now this sets men and women up in an oppositional relationship. The war between the sexes is built right into our DNA, according to this vision.
ru: Взамен, женщины предлагали верность, или, по крайней мере, пообещали.

quote: History has repeatedly offered an answer to that paradox.
before: Why doesn't that make our labor superfluous, our skills redundant? Isn't it obvious that the road to our economic and social hell is paved with our own great inventions?
after: The first part of the answer is that technology magnifies our leverage, increases the importance, the added value of our expertise, our judgment and our creativity. That's the O-ring.
ru: История постоянно предлагает нам ответ на этот парадокс.

quote: I'm offering the metaphor of a staircase in the mind.
before: So let me summarize where we are. I'm saying that the capacity for self-transcendence is just a basic part of being human.
after: I'm saying we are Homo duplex and this staircase takes us up from the profane level to the level of the sacred. When we climb that staircase, self-interest fades away, we become just much less self-interested, and we feel as though we are better, nobler and somehow uplifted.
ru: Я предлагаю описать это метафорой о лестнице в нашем сознании.

quote: The APA offered 10 suggestions for teenagers' safe and responsible use of social media.
Cyril, what have I told you about opening your presents early?
before: What are you doing? How dare you leave the house? !
after: Sorry, Mummy. Something like this was bound to happen.
ru: ! Сирил, что я говорила тебе по поводу открывания подарков заранее?

quote: Staff arrive half five, we open the doors at six.
before: 6pm. 6pm. No exceptions. That's the rule.
after: Just open the fucking door! All I want is my bed, that's all.
ru: Это правило. Сотрудники приходят к полшестого, двери открываем в шесть.

quote: I'm opening a door for you, Mr. Reyes, both literally and figuratively.
before: I don't think you'll do that. Flying isn't one of your special talents.
after: And in return you want...? Same thing you do...
ru: Я открываю двери для Вас, Мистер Рэйс, в прямом и переносном смысле.

quote: Uh, I've been opening bear traps since I was a kid.
before: I mean, I'm getting 5 million bucks for her to do Hush, Hush 2. Vance, uh, I don't know, for... I'm really glad, but, uh... For some reason, has some sort of a, uh, bottle opener/bear trap opener on his key chain.
after: So it really wasn't that big of a deal. Did I... did I get the message from Jake about finding the hand in the refriger... yeah.
ru: Мне с детства доводилось открывать капканы.

quote: We open the gates for higher education for every qualified student.
before: By the end of each week, the students take a quiz, hand in their homework, which are assessed by their peers under the supervision of the instructors, get a grade, move to the next week. By the end of the course, they take the final exam, get a grade, and follow to the next course.
after: Every student with a high school diploma, sufficient English and Internet connection can study with us. We don't use audio, we don't use video.
ru: Мы открываем путь к высшему образованию для всех студентов c подходящими данными.

quote: It opens doors. Poetry works as a mirror.
before: I remember a verse by a tremendous poet, a great poet, from our Unit 48 workshop, Nicolás Dorado: " I will need an infinite thread to sew up this huge wound. " Poetry does that; it sews up the wounds of exclusion.
after: It creates a mirror, which is the poem. They recognize themselves, they look at themselves in the poem and write from who they are, and are from what they write.
ru: Она открывает двери. Поэзия становится зеркалом.

quote: The poor puppy jumps up, you open the dog book, what does it say?
before: I'm really sorry, yes, it's my fault. " They are just so beatable, and that's why they get beaten.
after: " Hold his front paws, squeeze his front paws, stamp on his hind feet, squirt him in the face with lemon juice, hit him on the head with a rolled-up newspaper, knee him in the chest, flip him over backwards. " Because he grew?
ru: Несчастный щенок подпрыгнул, вы открываете книгу про собак, и что там написано?

quote: The Westlink M7 motorway is set to open today some eight months ahead of schedule.
I didn't know that little puppies could operate an iPod with their little puppy paws.
before: Oh, man. Well, all right. Aw, did you want to DJ, little puppy?
after: Eew and boo. This kind of thing is getting out of hand with you two.
ru: Я не знала, что щеночки умеют управлять с айподом своими маленькими щенячьими лапками.

quote: Yes. I will operate the onboard systems of Discovery.
before: I am completely operational and all my circuits are functioning perfectly. That's good. Do you know what those duties are?
after: There is a launch window in 31 days when Earth is in the proper position. There is enough fuel on board for a Iow consumption route that will enable Discovery to return in 28 months.
ru: Да,я буду управлять бортовыми системами "Дискавери".

quote: I can't have you giving your life energy... and operating this machine at the same time.
before: - No. I thought we agreed-
after: What happens if you pass out during the process, huh? It'll just keep taking your life energy until you're dead, correct?
ru: Не могу позволить вам делиться своей энергией и в тоже время управлять этой машиной.

quote: You've proven your Ancient gene allows you to operate Ancient technology.
before: Concentrate? Got nothing.
after: It's no different than the device in Antarctica. Just... focus your mind.
ru: Давай, Джек. Ты доказал, что твой ген Древних позволяет тебе управлять технологией Древних.

quote: So that would give us extra cortex to do more interesting things than just operating the body.
before: It must be really extraordinary, an exception to the rule. Theirs may be bigger, but ours is better, and it could be better, for example, in that it seems larger than it should be, with a much larger cerebral cortex than we should have for the size of our bodies.
after: That's because the size of the brain usually follows the size of the body. So the main reason for saying that our brain is larger than it should be actually comes from comparing ourselves to great apes.
ru: Таким образом, это даёт нам дополнительную кору чтобы заниматься более интересными вещами, чем просто управлять нашим телом.

quote: It says, "Is this toy operated with your genitals?"
before: Because it's important that boys play with and as female superheroes just as my daughter plays with and as male superheroes. As a matter of fact, what I would love is a world in which every person who goes to the store goes with a little flowchart in their head of whether or not they should buy this toy for a boy or a girl, and it's a real simple flowchart because it only has one question on it.
after: (Laughter) If the answer is yes, then that is not a toy for children. (Laughter) And if the answer is no, then it's for boys and girls.
ru: Он звучит так : «Эта игрушка управляется вашими гениталиями?»

quote: So we can also generate instructions on how to operate the controls of the vehicle.
before: One is, first of all, process this information to have an understanding of the environment — these are the lanes of the road, there's the obstacles — and convey this information to the driver. The system is also smart enough to figure out the safest way to operate the car.
after: But the problem is this: How do we convey this information and instructions to a person who cannot see fast enough and accurate enough so he can drive? So for this, we developed many different types of non-visual user interface technology.
ru: Так, мы также можем давать рекомендации о том, как управлять машиной.

quote: Ulysses operated for over three times its design life.
after: It was originally planned to survive for five years, and make a single orbit of the Sun. Its seventeen year mission duration made it one of the oldest spacecraft in service at the time of its retirment, along with the Hubble Space Telescope, which was launched just six months earlier, the Voyager probes, and the much older Pioneer Solar probes.

quote: Look, I will oppose both the Government and Tikki Wendon on this, and I won't back down.
before: Tikki Wendon's superbly imaginative plan to build an edifice rivalling the Opera House on the other side of the Harbour - billions of dollars of investment, thousands of jobs... By 'edifice', you mean 'casino', right?
after: My dad shot through because of his problem with gambling. Yeah, thanks.
ru: Я буду выступать здесь как против правительства, так и против Тикки Вендон, и я не отступлюсь.

quote: Do you plan on hanging this over my head every time I try to oppose you?
before: You came here to threaten me. We don't need to be at odds, Jackie.
after: You can't fault me for your sloppiness. That's a "yes."
ru: Ты каждый раз будешь разыгрывать эту карту, когда я буду выступать против тебя?

quote: In 1787, there were delegates who were opposed to the Bill of Rights.
before: Thanks for the fish. Keep your head in the game.
after: This is what a member of the Georgia delegation had to say: "If we list a set of rights, some fools will claim that the people are entitled only to those rights. "
ru: В 1787, было значительное число депутатов, выступавших против Билля о правах.

quote: You shouldn't be appearing in front of groups that oppose gay marriage.
before: Women United Through Faith, what about them? You have six concert appearances scheduled with them around the country on six consecutive Mondays.
after: Are you censoring me? Don't put it like that. Give me another way to put it.
ru: Да. Не надо выступать перед группами, которые протестуют против однополых браков.

quote: Not voting is voting, for everything that you may detest and oppose.
before: Why bother voting? Because there is no such thing as not voting.
after: Not voting can be dressed up as an act of principled, passive resistance, but in fact not voting is actively handing power over to those whose interests are counter to your own, and those who would be very glad to take advantage of your absence. Not voting is for suckers.
ru: Не голосуя, вы отдаёте свой голос за всё то, что вы не любите и против чего выступаете.

quote: And that's the ability to exploit opposing ideas and opposing constraints to create new solutions.
before: Now, Brunel was working 100 years before the emergence of the design profession, but I think he was using design thinking to solve problems and to create world-changing innovations. Now, design thinking begins with what Roger Martin, the business school professor at the University of Toronto, calls integrative thinking.
after: In the case of design, that means balancing desirability, what humans need, with technical feasibility, and economic viability. With innovations like the Great Western, we can stretch that balance to the absolute limit.
ru: Это способность использовать полярные идеи, и противостоящие друг другу ограничения для выработки новых решений.

quote: The opposing council always fight it and oppose it.
before: First of all, there's a long history of antipathy between science and the law in American jurisprudence. I could regale you with horror stories of ignorance over decades of experience as a forensic expert of just trying to get science into the courtroom.
after: One suggestion is that all of us become much more attuned to the necessity, through policy, through procedures, to get more science in the courtroom, and I think one large step toward that is more requirements, with all due respect to the law schools, of science, technology, engineering, mathematics for anyone going into the law, because they become the judges. Think about how we select our judges in this country.
ru: Мои оппоненты всегда выступали против неё.

quote: The Western Isles Council is also opposed to the new service.
before: According to Harris West councillor Morag Monro, more than 700 people on both Harris and Lewis signed a petition opposing the Sunday service.

quote: He outlined some very unpleasant options in the event that Iran has found a way around the IAEA inspections.
before: This question with Iran, it could get me stuck in the starting blocks. I had a visit from Dar Adal.
after: And have they? Apparently, that parallel program's underway in North Korea.
ru: Он обрисовал некоторые неприятные варианты на тот случай, если Иран нашел способ обойти проверки МАГАТЭ.

quote: After the magistrate outlined the conditions Assange said, emotionlessly, on Tuesday, "I understand."
before: Assange would also have to spend at least four hours at Smith's mansion in the day and four at night. He will also have to check in with police every day between 6–8 pm local time.
after: Bail conditions remained the same, with small changes that included where he is allowed to travel, changes to his curfew and times in which he must report to authorities. Assange has yet to be formally charged with any crime.

quote: I have to write an essay about my hardships and how I've overcome them.
before: Hey, for 50 bucks, I will study anything they want me to. I am also applying for the local Al-Anon scholarship.
after: Speaking of, would you guys describe yourselves as more escapist drinkers or panic drinkers? Escapist, definitely.
ru: Я должна написать эссе о моих трудностях и как я их преодолела.

quote: That's pretty amazing, knowing that you can overcome it.
before: You know what, almost everyone there comes from some kind of troubled background. You realize that bad stuff happens to everyone, but they train you to get your crap together and stop whining and grow up.
after: (David) Well, here's to you, Crash. You've come a long way, and I think I speak for everyone when I say - we are proud of you.
ru: Удивительно осозновать, что ты можешь преодолеть это

quote: And you believe she should overcome her dislike.
before: Victoria does not like him. Sir Robert Peel will be Prime Minister one day.
after: I see. You think you can run faster than the constable?
ru: И вы считаете, она должна преодолеть свою неприязнь?

quote: My job is to enable students to overcome their prejudices.
before: I did not speak of homosexuality. I spoke about homophobia.
after: No, your job is to teach English. Point.
ru: Моя работа состоит в том, чтобы помочь учащимся преодолеть собственные предрассудки.

quote: We don't want to have to overcome unnecessary hurdles.
before: Of course, I think any of us, in any remotely similar situation, would feel the same way, we'd have the same instinct. We don't want to be asked to do good work with bad tools.
after: But Jarrett's instinct was wrong, and thank goodness he changed his mind. And I think our instinct is also wrong.
ru: Мы не хотим преодолевать ненужные препятствия.

quote: But you can't overcome something you don't talk about.
before: (Laughter) And finances are something that holds us back so often, our dreams are bounded by how much we have in resources. But we hear again and again the stories of those who overcome those resource challenges.
after: And that's why I didn't allow them to debt-shame me in my campaign. I didn't allow anyone to tell me that my lack of opportunity was a reason to disqualify me from running.
ru: Но нельзя преодолеть что-то, о чём не говоришь.

quote: How could it ever be adaptive for any organism to overcome self-interest?
before: The New Atheists, for example, argue that religion is a set of memes, sort of parasitic memes, that get inside our minds and make us do all kinds of crazy religious stuff, self-destructive stuff, like suicide bombing. And after all, how could it ever be good for us to lose ourselves?
after: Well let me show you. In " The Descent of Man, " Charles Darwin wrote a great deal about the evolution of morality — where did it come from, why do we have it.
ru: Неужели любой организм способен приучиться преодолевать собственные интересы?

quote: So if he's close enough you can overcome that issue?
We're bound to overlap sometimes.
before: Do not mock. We are in a much smaller community now.
after: Live with it. And please don't involve the dog.
ru: И теперь нам придется пересекаться.

quote: She would overlap with Schmidt and Cece.
before: - That's always a long weekend. - I know.
after: And six people is a violation of the loft agreement. But loft agreements are reached to be amended.
ru: Ей придется пересекаться со Шмидтом и Сиси.

quote: Those two groups might not overlap at all.
before: Only 16 percent defined it as, " violent holy war against unbelievers. " This is the really important point: based on those numbers, it's totally possible that no one in the survey who defined it as violent holy war also said they support it.
after: It's also worth asking how the survey was carried out. This was something called an opt-in poll, which means anyone could have found it on the internet and completed it.
ru: Эти две группы могли вообще не пересекаться.

quote: NTL’s and Telewest’s service territories do currently overlap.
before: United Kingdom cable TV operator NTL has agreed to buy Telewest Broadband for $6 billion USD (3.4 billion pounds).
after: The acquisition is expected to save the companies 1.5 billion pounds.

quote: Sorry, I just need to make sure nothing's overlooked.
before: Okay, good, let's move on to the Haddad network. I'm up to speed on the Haddads.
after: Oh, understandable. But I'm on it.
ru: Извини, просто не хочу ничего не упустить из виду.

quote: I overlooked one of the security monitors.
before: Just as I thought. Don't tell me.
after: You were trying to override the launch controls for the quantum torpedoes. I was hoping to gain control of the phasers as well.
ru: Я не заметил один из мониторов системы безопасности.

quote: And, of course, I couldn't overlook your faithful service.
before: I want you to pay a visit to my supporters in the Yaro province. Give them all new titles, whatever I promised.
after: I think the title First Castellan suits you very well. I feel like I've finally come home again, but it's hardly as I left it.
ru: И конечно, я не мог не заметить твоей верной службы.

quote: If you like, you can review my daily log of social interactions and see if there's a blunder I overlooked.
before: Well, you clearly did something to aggravate her. I'm at a loss.
after: Here you go. Oh, you owe me another two dollars.
ru: Если хочешь, я покажу тебе мой журнал социальных взаимодействий, может, ты заметишь ошибку, которую я упустил.

quote: I'm here to tell you that we have overlooked the most powerful and practical resource.
before: But it's not enough. Our poverty rates haven't changed that much in the last 50 years, since the War on Poverty was launched.
after: Here it is: people who are poor. Up in the left-hand corner is Jobana, Sintia and Bertha.
ru: Я здесь, чтобы сказать вам, что мы упустили из виду самый мощный и конструктивный способ.

quote: How could you overlook the things that were said?
before: (Laughter) Caitlin is a successful professional woman who is deeply caring and compassionate, and the Caitlin I know would never excuse any man from talking about women the way that Trump did during the campaign. It was hard for me to reconcile these two things in my mind.
after: CQ: So I'm guessing I may not be the only one here that thought we didn't have the best choices for the presidential election last year. (Laughter) The Republican candidate who I did support didn't make it out of the primary, so when it came time to vote, I had a decision to make.
ru: Как ты могла не заметить тех вещей, что он сказал?

quote: Imagine the thousands of artists who were destined to be legends but for various reasons, were just overlooked.
before: When you're digging for records, you're surrounded by music you don't know. You're surrounded by mystery and by all these dreams — records that people once believed in.
after: Many of these records only exist in a handful of copies, and some have never even been found, never been heard. They're literally endangered species.
ru: Представьте тысячи музыкантов, которым суждено было стать легендами, но по разным причинам их не заметили.

quote: Charlton striker Darren Bent says on his agents' website that he is disappointed to be overlooked.
before: Tottenham Hotspur FC coach Martin Jol is amazed that Jermain Defoe is not in the squad but he still believes that he will be there, referring to the situation with Wayne Rooney and Michael Owen.

quote: No, tell N.O.R. to override it.
before: You just get us there and I'll worry about the rest. Reposition our Titan satellite over the sector.
after: This is our top priority. I want every square inch of that neighborhood covered.
ru: Нет, пусть они переопределят его.

quote: The European Union (EU) is sending aid, overriding sanctions, after Syria's government requested it.
before: The ongoing Syrian Civil War has worsened the situation there and made the country less accessible to aid workers.

quote: I never thought I'd say this to you, son, but you may be overthinking this.
before: Haverford playbook move number two-- "ladies love a guy waiting for them in the rain."
after: This song has to be perfect, Ron, okay? Leslie trusted me with it.
ru: Никогда не думал, что скажу это тебе, сынок, но ты слишком много об этом думаешь.

quote: Nick, is it possible that you are maybe overthinking this just a little bit, okay?
before: We be all night. We be all night.
after: 'Cause, look, Reagan is a really good roommate. She's quiet, she pays, she takes care of her room.
ru: Ник, возможно ли, что ты, может быть, немного накручиваешь себя?

quote: Bernadette, come on, look, you're overthinking this, okay?
before: I keep waiting to feel excited, but it's not happening. What if it never happens?
after: You're gonna be an amazing mom. Even if you don't believe it,
ru: Бернадетт, ладно тебе, ты себя накручиваешь.

quote: Sometimes, when you overthink things, you get confusing.
before: Bishop was being very confusing. I was?
after: I do? Mm-hmm. All right, then I'll be clear.
ru: Иногда, когда слишком много думаешь, то запутываешься. - Я?

quote: The video game is overwriting reality.
before: So, if the core database downloaded the corrupted code from that game, then an overload in the quantum field could have created a superposition state that amplified virtual reality into actual reality. So, we're not inside the video game.
after: We went through the door at the moment of the overload, so we weren't affected. Yeah, we all went through the door.
ru: Видеоигра перезаписывает реальность.

quote: Did you pack your bags yourself?
before: Hare Rama. I have to ask you a few questions this evening.
after: Have your belongings been in your possession the entire time? Mr. Browning?
ru: Вы собирали вещи самостоятельно?

quote: That's why he's packing up.
before: Okay, they're very- they're very powerful. They're very- they're scary people.
after: Okay? That's why he's scared, because- see, he's running away, you see?
ru: Вот почему он собирает вещи

quote: I've been at our old apartment all afternoon, packing things up to put in storage.
before: I was in the neighborhood. Why don't you join us?
after: And suddenly I just... felt the need to talk to somebody. And then I remembered it was Wednesday at 4:00, so I figured I'd already paid for the hour, so...
ru: Я был в нашей старой квартире весь день, упаковывая вещи на хранение.

quote: And this pace exists because of our ability to pack more and more devices onto a computer chip.
before: We just have come to expect the pace of computing advancements to go on indefinitely. We've built entire economies on this idea.
after: And as those devices get smaller, they get faster, they consume less power and they get cheaper. And it's this convergence that gives us this incredible pace.
ru: И этот прогресс существует благодаря нашей способности «упаковывать» всё больше устройств в компьютерный чип.

quote: We're just packing in columns, so that we'd have more neocortical columns to perform more complex functions.
before: They were so successful in evolution that what we did was to duplicate them over and over and add more and more of them to the brain until we ran out of space in the skull. And the brain started to fold in on itself, and that's why the neocortex is so highly convoluted.
after: So you can think of the neocortex actually as a massive grand piano, a million-key grand piano. Each of these neocortical columns would produce a note.
ru: Мозг упаковывает колонки неокортекса с тем, чтобы иметь их побольше для выполнения более сложных функций.

quote: Cheap packing foam had been used as soundproofing material to surround the stage, and this ignited.
before: The fire started when band manager Daniel Bichele ignited pyrotechnics towards the beginning of a concert by Great White at the club.
after: Great White were never charged, but Bichele was given a 15-year sentence with 11 of those suspended in 2006 for 100 counts of involuntary manslaughter, to which he pleaded guilty. He was paroled in March this year.

quote: Mr Coley, you're painting with your tea.
before: Do you know name of the brand? It'll come to me.
after: How am I supposed to get anything done with you distracting me? Miss, there's an emergency.
ru: Мистер Коули, вы красите чаем.

quote: Can I show you exhibit A, one of the walls that you started painting ten years ago and never finished?
before: I'll do it to the highest professional standards. Yes?
after: Please, Mark. I'll... think about it.
ru: Можно показать тебе экспонат А, одну из стен, что ты начал красить 10 лет назад, но так и не закончил?

quote: He had people go ahead of him and paint the leaves green, wherever he went.
before: Complete mental. And an unpleasant mental.
after: As we waited, James had become really lost. MUSIC: "Non, Je Ne Regrette Rien" by Edith Piaf
ru: Он заставлял людей идти впереди себя и красить листья в зеленый, везде, куда бы он не пошел.

quote: (Applause) In painting those walls, we got to know each other.
before: Of course not. But that's exactly what happened.
after: We believed in each other. And we figured it out together.
ru: (Аплодисменты) Пока мы красили стены, то лучше узнали друг друга,

quote: They provided a Halo 3 painted car as a grand prize.
before: In the United States, more than 10,000 retailers opened their stores at midnight on September 25.
after: Gamers lined up for hours in excitement for the long awaited game to come out.

quote: I don't recommend you participate in any rehabilitation effort.
before: When. Let's be honest.
after: I was so confident in my ability to help him... To solve him.
ru: Я не советую вам участвовать в любых попытках его реабилитации.

quote: Because you never let me participate in the planning.
before: - I really don't think two men who live together for ten years need a party. Why must you always be like this?
after: I would love for you to participate. Gah!
ru: Потому что вы никогда не даете мне участвовать в планировании.

quote: Turns out 40 gals participated in the sex study at least three times with different partners.
before: I need to cancel an appointment... Several of them, actually.
after: I call them the overachievers. And you've contacted them all?
ru: - В исследовании участвовали 40 девушек. Каждая по три раза, с разными партнерами.

quote: Oh, I'm not here to participate in whatever this is.
before: Look alive, maestro. Take the coat and don't ask questions.
after: I was just hired to play the piano till 9:00. I don't mean to burst your bubble, but I'm not trying to get into your pants.
ru: Нет, я не собираюсь в этом участвовать.

quote: I actually participated in a play -- I hope there’s no video of that around still.
before: So I made my second horrible career choice: I decided to study acting for a semester. I took off from the PhD, I went to acting classes.
after: (Laughter) And I got every book I could find about acting, including one from the 19th century that I got from the library. And I was really amazed, because my name was the second name on the list — the previous name was in 1889.
ru: Я участвовал в постановке. Надеюсь, что больше нет видео тех событий.

quote: Mary didn't do anything wrong. She didn't participate in the fraud.
before: She was exposed. And when she was exposed, she received a demotion, death threats, over collegiate sports.
after: She really thought that she was giving voice to students that were voiceless. But her loyalty was questioned.
ru: Мэри всё сделала правильно. Она не участвовала в афере.

quote: You offer 50 funds -- 10 percent fewer employees participate than if you only offer five.
before: A colleague of mine got access to investment records from Vanguard, the gigantic mutual fund company, of about a million employees and about 2,000 different workplaces. What she found is that for every 10 mutual funds the employer offered, rate of participation went down two percent.
after: Why? Because with 50 funds to choose from, it's so damn hard to decide which fund to choose, that you'll just put it off till tomorrow, and then tomorrow and then tomorrow and tomorrow, and, of course, tomorrow never comes.
ru: Если вы предложите 50 фондов, то будут участвовать на 10% меньше работников, чем в случае, если вы предложите только пять.

quote: All ambassadors accredited in Bucharest, as well as political personalities, have been invited to participate.
before: Media celebrities such as the soprano Felicia Filip and singers Angela Similea and Dida Dragan will also be participating, as well as Maia Morgenstern, known internationally for her role in the film The Passion of the Christ.

quote: You've had these thoughts before. They've always passed.
before: I don't know. They'd assume it's an OD. Happens all the time.
after: It's hell while it lasts, but... It'll get better. Everything will be fine.
ru: У тебя такие мысли были и до этого, но они всегда проходили.

quote: You're just passing through, looking for the next game.
before: But given that he's dead, I like my chances better now. Brody, you are the same guy now you were back then.
after: And I have to tell you that I'm... Not the same little girl.
ru: Ты просто проходишь мимо в поисках следующей игры.

quote: I can do more than just pass off thumb drives and autopsy reports.
before: I don't care what deal he offered you. He doesn't make that call.
after: I-I don't understand. W-Why is this so important to you?
ru: Я могу больше, чем просто передавать флешки с результатами вскрытия.

quote: Passing outer marker, ILS Approach 1-6, good to land.
before: Plus, one look at Oscar, and... there's no way he's a pilot. All right, let's go hear this flight recording.
after: Radar contact, cleared to land runway 1-6. Ceiling 2-0-0. Visibility one-quarter mile, wind one-niner-zero, - variable 25 gust...
ru: Проходим внешнюю отметку, система посадки по приборам заход 1-6, приземление санкционировано.

quote: Even the difficult and strenuous sections passed by with ease.
before: I had no doubts. I just climbed right through.
after: I was perfectly executing my routine. I rested for a moment below the Boulder Problem and then climbed it just as I had practiced so many times with the rope on.
ru: Даже тяжёлые и напряжённые участки проходились с лёгкостью.

quote: Through mycorrhizal networks, fungi can pass resources and signaling molecules between trees.
before: The mycelium spreads across a much larger area than the tree root system and connect the roots of different trees together. These connections form mycorrhizal networks.
after: We know the oldest trees have the largest mycorrhizal networks with the most connections to other trees, but these connections are incredibly complicated to trace. That’ s because there are about a hundred species of mycorrhizal fungi – and an individual tree might be colonized by dozens of different fungal organisms, each of which connects to a unique set of other trees, which in turn each have their own unique set of fungal associations.
ru: По микоризным сетям грибы способны передавать между деревьями питательные вещества и сигнальные молекулы.

quote: But I think we also do it because it serves the human need to pass along cultural knowledge.
before: So for myself and most of the record collectors I've encountered in 20 years, I think that we all have some sort of an outlet for these discoveries. I think it's our way to keep our sanity and sort of sense of purpose in this very maddening obsession, because it can be sort of a lonely one.
after: Speaking of the need for curation, in an era of overwhelming choice, it's been demonstrated that too much choice actually hinders discovery. For example, if you're trying to watch something on Netflix, you're actually only browsing through a catalog of 6,000 titles.
