after: I should never have planned it. I found the ring in your sock.
ru: Мне не стоило откладывать наш отпуск.

quote: I no longer want to postpone anything in life.
before: As I thought about that later on, I came up with a saying, which is, " I collect bad wines. " Because if the wine is ready and the person is there, I'm opening it.
after: And that urgency, that purpose, has really changed my life. The second thing I learned that day — and this is as we clear the George Washington Bridge, which was by not a lot — (Laughter) I thought about, wow, I really feel one real regret.
ru: Я не хочу больше откладывать ничего в жизни.

quote: And besides, growing old only postponed the inevitable, time seeing through what circumstance did not.
before: I was prone to meditating on time and age. An illness in the family and later an injury to me had long made clear that growing old could not be assumed.
after: It was all a bit disheartening. A list, though, would last.
ru: К тому же, долгая жизнь только откладывает неизбежное, если этого не сделают обстоятельства, то время возьмёт своё.

quote: On the other hand, if your problem is you tend to postpone, then it might give you a reason to act today rather than later.
before: Now, a kilo of lentils is tiny. It's never going to convince anybody to do something that they don't want to do.
after: So what do we find? Well, beforehand, everything is the same.
ru: С другой стороны, если проблема в том, что вы склонны всё откладывать на потом, это, возможно, заставит вас действовать сейчас. А не откладывать.

quote: Rick Perry, the Governor of Texas, had postponed Newton's sentence to allow further investigation of evidence.
before: In 1998 hundreds protested the execution of Karla Faye Tucker, the first woman put to death in Texas since the Civil War era.
after: Once the governor was convinced the state's case was solid, he allowed the execution to proceed.

quote: Although being from L.A., I really prefer, uh, cocaine.
before: Boys, we got trouble with a capital... Well, since no one else is gonna be drinking this... beer me, brah.
after: There you are. What took you so long?
ru: Хотя я из Л.А. И действительно предпочитаю, оа, кокаин

quote: Now, would you prefer a man or a woman?
before: Why do I have to have one? Because you have to set the tone.
after: There's a great 72-year-old woman, really cute. Ugh. That's like the same age as my mom.
ru: Ты предпочитаешь мужчину или женщину?

quote: Well, I do keep track of which ladies prefer which shades.
before: I see. You don't keep details on your clientele?
after: That would be most helpful. Do you like it?
ru: Что ж, я делаю записи о том, кто какой оттенок предпочитает.

quote: Some of us prefer keep in our safe corners.
before: What does that mean? I do not know.
after: Some of us can not afford to wander around without a destination trying to find himself. At least I try I find myself.
ru: Некоторые из нас предпочитают оставаться в безопасной раковине.

quote: Take Sean, who prefers blue tasting food, such as milk, oranges, and spinach.
before: The amazing thing is that a single nucleotide change in the sequence of one's DNA alters perception. In this way, synesthesia provides a path to understanding subjective differences, how two people can see the same thing differently.
after: The gene heightens normally occurring connections between the taste area in his frontal lobe and the color area further back. But suppose in someone else that the gene acted in non-sensory areas.
ru: Шон предпочитает пищу синего вкуса, например, молоко, апельсины и шпинат.

quote: We prefer to know them as the mafia.
before: So what was a business man in the brave new world of East European capitalism going to do to make sure that his contracts would be honored? Well, he would turn to people who were called, rather prosaically by sociologists, privatized law enforcement agencies.
after: And in Bulgaria, the mafia was soon joined with 14,000 people who were sacked from their jobs in the security services between 1989 and 1991. Now, when your state is collapsing, your economy is heading south at a rate of knots, the last people you want coming on to the labor market are 14,000 men and women whose chief skills are surveillance, are smuggling, building underground networks and killing people.
ru: Мы предпочитаем называть их мафия.

quote: I don't know -- I prefer to test their beliefs, scientifically.
before: Should we ridicule the modern seekers of immortality, calling them fools? Or will they someday chuckle over our graves?
after: I propose that we attempt to find a connectome of a frozen brain. We know that damage to the brain occurs after death and during freezing.
ru: Я не знаю. Я предпочитаю проверить их убеждения по-научному.

quote: And, the fact that the rats would prefer the easy lever was also not so straightforward.
before: The articles were not giving as much information as we now have to write down. And so we had to guess some parameters over there.
after: So we thought "oh, they are gonna prefer the easy lever, and that's it." But at the end, you know, some rats, some animals develop a preference on the side; like they prefer their right lever, or the left lever, or others, they prefer the heavy lever.

quote: You know, were were preparing a, uh, wrongful death lawsuit against Dellinger.
before: Not sure. Our lawyers, I think.
after: It's not gonna happen now. And have you been in contact with Mr. Dellinger since your wife's death?
ru: Мы готовились к судебному процессу о причинении смерти в результате противоправных действий, против Делинджера.

quote: Well, I told them I was preparing an appeal to be lodged with the ecclesiastical court.
before: Meanwhile, there's no one to see you in your altogether except me. How are you allowed to wander around the castle?
after: Of course, we all know how pointless that would be. Don't call out.
ru: Ну, я сказал им, что я должен готовить обращение в церковный суд.

quote: Sir, FEMA's mission is to prepare for the worst.
before: Yes, but some of these projections have it turning back to sea. That's highly unlikely, sir.
after: First responders, medical, mass evacuation. I'm worried about the funding.
ru: Сэр, задача ФАЧС - готовиться к худшему.

quote: I had to tell you the truth to prepare you.
before: Partly because you were meant to do it, But mostly because if you don't, I will always remind you That you are a sac-less little fraidy-cat. Why in the hell did you try to talk me out of it?
after: If I'd fluffed it up, you would have tortured me forever. So you really think I'm the man for the job?
ru: Я должен был рассказать всю правду, чтобы подготовить тебя.

quote: Personally, I feel like I've been preparing for this moment my whole life.
before: In the end, if I have to choose between being the president's friend or enemy, I always prefer to be their enemy. In closing: I know this is a difficult time to be an immigrant and a journalist, but now more than ever, we need journalists who are prepared, at any given moment, to set neutrality aside.
after: When they censored me when I was 24, I learned that neutrality, fear and silence often make you an accomplice in crime, abuse and injustice. And being an accomplice to power is never good journalism.
ru: Лично я чувствую, что готовился к этому моменту всю жизнь.

quote: The threat is serious, and the time to prepare for it is now.
before: They're crowd-mapping the activities of the drug dealers. Whether or not you realize it, we are at the dawn of a technological arms race, an arms race between people who are using technology for good and those who are using it for ill.
after: I can assure you that the terrorists and criminals are. My personal belief is that, rather than having a small, elite force of highly trained government agents here to protect us all, we're much better off having average and ordinary citizens approaching this problem as a group and seeing what we can do.
ru: Это серьёзная угроза, и именно сейчас самое время к ней подготовиться.

quote: So what can we do? How can we prepare and adapt?
before: The military gets it. They call climate change a threat multiplier that could harm stability and security, while governments around the world are evaluating how to respond.
after: I'd like to share three sets of examples, starting with adapting to violent storms and floods. In New Orleans, the I-10 Twin Spans, with sections knocked out in Katrina, have been rebuilt 21 feet higher to allow for greater storm surge.
ru: Так что же может быть сделано? Как подготовиться и приспособиться к новым условиям?

quote: Towns and communities in north Western Australia are preparing for the sixth cyclone of the season.
after: The Bureau of Meteorology says a cyclone warning is current for a category 3 cyclone for coastal and island areas between Cape Leveque and Bidyadanga. A cyclone watch extends south to Dampier.

quote: For each incorrect answer, the subjects pressed a button on a device they were told delivered a shock to the test taker.
before: Blind obedience? Participants were told they'd be administering a quiz to a test taker in the next room.
after: What is the capital of Peru? San Jose?
ru: При каждом неверном ответе участник нажимает кнопку устройства, которое, как им сказали, бьёт током опрашиваемого.

quote: They pressed the button every time they saw the face.
before: So we devised what might be considered one of the world's most boring experiments. All the participants saw were a series of faces on the screen, one after another.
after: That was pretty much it. Well, one trick was that sometimes, the face would be upside down, and it would happen very infrequently.
ru: Они нажимали кнопку каждый раз, когда видели лицо.

quote: Truth of the matter is you can play the piano without a cochlear implant, because all you have to do is press the keys at the right time.
before: And this is really unheard of stuff, and this is all because of this technology. And the fact that he can play the piano like that is a testament to his brain.
after: You don't actually have to hear it. I know he doesn't hear well, because I've heard him do Karaoke.
ru: Суть в том, что вы можете играть на фортепиано без кохлеарного имплантата, ведь всё, что вы должны делать, это нажимать клавиши в нужное время.

quote: They're going to press left or right.
before: So we're going to check that out by having the chimps actually play a game by touching two touch screens. The chimps are actually interacting with each other through the computers.
after: One chimp is called a matcher. They win if they press left, left, like a seeker finding someone in hide-and-seek, or right, right.
ru: нажимая на левый или правый экран.

quote: The Mariners pressed early keeping Queensland to their own half in the first three minutes.
before: Queensland lead one goal to zero after a back and forth first half.
after: Queensland created a number of opportunities down the other end to no avail. The Queenslanders missed from a corner and were unlucky to have an offside decision go against them.

quote: However, today, I can't sit back and pretend I don't have an opinion, because I do.
before: London, moscow, rio-- people everywhere reacting to the fact that when they leave, the visitors will take with them their many gifts to humanity. It is my job to report the news objectively.
after: The v's saved my life. We, the people, must fix this.
ru: Однако сегодня я не могу просто сидеть здесь и притворяться, что у меня нет мнения, потому что оно есть.

quote: Don't pretend like this wasn't your plan all along.
before: I've had my representatives tend you an offer for SadTech Inc. and all intellectual property including your exclusive services. Well that's one way to get out of a lawsuit I suppose.
after: Is that what I'm doing? Now you're just being rude.
ru: не делай вид, что ты этого не планировал.

quote: I know we can't pretend it all away.
before: Melinda... The world has gotten more complicated, hasn't it?
after: But I'm still the same man you fell in love with. I never gave up on you.
ru: Я знаю, мы не можем притворяться, что ничего не произошло.

quote: We won't be able to pretend that we can protect ourselves anymore.
before: We'll expose our most tender selves, only to be mocked and destroyed. We'll be so vulnerable, and we'll pay the price.
after: It's a huge danger, a gigantic risk, but it's worth it. If only we can learn to take care of each other.
ru: Мы не сможем делать вид, что способны оградить себя.

quote: I wrote it because I was tired of pretending I was all right when I wasn't.
before: I wrote this piece a year ago. It's a composite of my story and other women I know.
after: I was tired of faking normal. I wasn't seeing myself in the popular press.
ru: Я написала её, потому что устала делать вид, будто всё в порядке, когда на самом деле это было не так.

quote: To pretend they're not a mess when they are a mess.
before: I actually realized once in Kosovo, when I watched a man break down, that bullets are actually hardened tears, that when we don't allow men to have their girl self and have their vulnerability, and have their compassion, and have their hearts, that they become hardened and hurtful and violent. And I think we have taught men to be secure when they are insecure, to pretend they know things when they don't know things, or why would we be where we are?
after: And I will tell you a very funny story. On my way here on the airplane, I was walking up and down the aisle of the plane.
ru: Притворяться, что они в порядке, когда они в полном беспорядке.

quote: It's good to see you again. (Cheers) (Music) Rob Legato: I pretend they're clapping for me.
before: (Music) And then I'm going to show you exactly what it is that you were reacting to when you were reacting to it. (Music) Tom Hanks: Hello, Houston, this is Odyssey.
after: (Laughter) So now I'm in a parking lot. Basically it's a tin can, and I'm basically recreating the launch with fire extinguishers, fire, I have wax that I threw in front of the lens to look like ice, and so basically if you believed any of the stuff that I just showed you, what you were reacting to, what you're emoting to, is something that's a total falsehood, and I found that really kind of fascinating.
ru: Приятно снова вас видеть. (Аплодисменты) (Музыка) Роб Легато: Я делаю вид, что аплодируют мне.

quote: It pretends that there is no difference between a man and a woman.
before: It would be churlish and ridiculous to pretend otherwise and I, for one, would never do so." Lord Framlingham criticised "the Government's complete rejection of any meaningful amendments" and said the Bill "is built entirely on pretence.
after: From this deceit have sprung all the problems we have been wrestling with — problems we have failed to resolve and which will bedevil generations to come."

quote: Do you now finally understand why you should never have prevented me from deactivating her?
before: The bad news is it was Aya who did it, right after switching off her emotions and going bat guano nuts. And right before using the Anti-Monitor's body to start vaporizing star systems herself.
after: I... - We didn't know what she was capable of.
ru: Теперь вы наконец поняли, почему не стоило мешать мне отключить ее?

quote: Well, we train law enforcement now to identify and prevent false confessions.
before: You remember how law enforcement got those kids to confess to something they didn't do? What about it?
after: We found a body near your shed, belonging to a man who was killed 35 years ago. Now, your son Lyle was just a toddler then, and your wife doesn't pick up anything heavier than a gardening hoe, and the personal nature of these crimes tells us there was just one offender.
ru: Сейчас мы учим сотрудников органов выявлять и предотвращать ложные признания.

quote: This trade war is preventing the refinery from being approved in Beijing.
before: I'd call that liberating him. You know that's not how he'll see it.
after: His co-venture with Feng is not our highest priority right now. A rare earth refinery solves this crisis permanently.
ru: Эта торговая война мешает получить одобрение Пекина на строительство перерабатывающего завода.

quote: His soldier brain is the only thing preventing me from falling apart grieving for Drake.
before: I'd rather stay on Janko brain. The man is ice cold.
after: It's going to wear off soon. I know.
ru: Солдатский мозг — единственное, что мешает мне развалиться от горя по ДрЭйку.

quote: This prevented the system from dying in the middle of the night.
before: Next, I had to design a wearable wireless circuit, but wireless signal transmission consumes lots of power and requires heavy, bulky batteries. Thankfully, I was able to find out about the Bluetooth low energy technology, which consumes very little power and can be driven by a coin-sized battery.
after: Lastly, I had to code a smartphone app that would essentially transform the care-giver's smartphone into a remote monitor. For this, I had to expand upon my knowledge of coding with Java and XCode and I also had to learn about how to code for Bluetooth low energy devices by watching YouTube tutorials and reading various textbooks.
ru: Это предотвращало выход системы из строя посреди ночи.

quote: The prohibition of street prostitution also causes more harm than it prevents.
before: He eventually left without getting physically violent, but the knowledge that we were breaking the law empowered that man to threaten us. He felt confident he'd get away with it.
after: Firstly, to avoid getting arrested, street workers take risks to avoid detection, and that means working alone or in isolated locations like dark forests where they're vulnerable to attack. If you're caught selling sex outdoors, you pay a fine.
ru: Также запрет уличной проституции причиняет больше вреда, чем предотвращает.

quote: When you use materials that have a local significance, you prevent cities from all looking the same.
before: But the truth is that these are mostly one-offs, boutique projects, not easily reproduced at a global scale. And that is the point.
after: Copper has a long history in New York — the Statue of Liberty, the crown of the Woolworth Building — but it fell out of fashion for a long time until SHoP Architects used it to cover the American Copper Building, a pair of twisting towers on the East River. It's not even finished and you can see the way sunset lights up that metallic facade, which will weather to green as it ages.
ru: Использование материалов, распространённых локально, предотвращает обезличивание городов.

quote: Allegedly, hour-long traffic delays at the venue prevented some party members from voting.
before: A portion of media attention was devoted to the Conservative Party of Canada hosting its leadership convention in the north building of the Toronto Congress Centre, simultaneous to Anime North.
after: Polls were Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., local time. The north building is accessed from a different road than the south.

quote: That's the same skull that Shane Casey printed on those T-shirts, remember?
before: That's the guy. Stella.
after: "QJ2432." That's Shane's inmate number.
ru: Тот же череп, который Шейн Кейси печатал тех футболках, помнишь?

quote: By literally printing out our money.
before: Wanna know how we make money? Do you wanna know how we make money?
after: We bought a printing press. This prints bills with our faces and the e720 logo on them.
ru: Получаем, в буквальном смысле печатая их сами!

quote: We've been printing all night...
before: Well, nothing awful has happened. If it happened, it happened.
after: I waited for you since yesterday's morning. That you won't come they probably guessed.
ru: Ведь всю ночь печатали...

quote: Why don't you print some money, fix a wage rate for different jobs, then people could buy with what they earn from Arthur Russell's store.
before: -Alan thinks it's just like the army. Well, Alan's wrong.
after: He could make a nice supermarket, that one. -You could even have a till.
ru: Может вам еще печатать деньги, назначить людям зарплаты, чтобы они покупали нужные товары в лавке Артура Рассела.

quote: Millions of in-the-ear hearing aids are already 3D printed today.
before: 3D printing is changing personalized medical devices as we know them, from new, beautiful, conformal, ventilated scoliosis braces to millions of dental restorations and to beautiful bracings for amputees, another opportunity to emotionally reconnect with your symmetry. And as we sit here today, you can go wireless on your braces with clear aligners, or your dental restorations.
after: Millions of people are served today from these devices. What about full knee replacements, from your data, made to measure, where all of the tools and guides are 3D printed?
ru: Множество внутриушных слуховых аппаратов уже сегодня печатаются на 3D-принтерах.

quote: So, let's go back to that original question: Can we print money for climate finance?
before: In both cases, " whatever it takes " meant trillions of dollars more in money-printing policies that continue today. What this shows is that when faced with some global challenges, policy makers are able to act collectively, with urgency, and run the risks of unconventional policies like money printing.
after: Three years ago, the idea of using money in this way was something of a taboo. Once you break down and dismantle the idea that money is a finite resource, governments can quickly get overwhelmed by demands from their people to print more and more money for other causes: education, health care, welfare — even defense.
ru: Давайте вернёмся к первому вопросу: можем ли мы печатать деньги для финансирования климата?

quote: We know with them that you can print in many materials ranging from plastic to chocolate to metal and even concrete.
before: Every time a new technology is being introduced, criminals are there to exploit it. We've all seen 3D printers.
after: With great precision I actually was able to make this just the other day, a very cute little ducky. But I wonder to myself, for those people that strap bombs to their chests and blow themselves up, how might they use 3D printers?
ru: Всем известно, что с их помощью можно печатать на различных материалах: от пластика и шоколада, до металла и даже бетона.

quote: The accusation was printed by the Brazilian magazine Veja in its issue circulating this week.
before: Former advisors to Brazilian Minister of Finance Antonio Palocci have claimed that three million US dollars from Cuba were used in the 2002 political campaign of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

quote: You have the potential to be a good lieutenant, but you need to prioritize.
before: Why, it's not best for Miami Metro? Because you'll find him.
after: You're letting your emotions take charge of you. You know what worked for me?
ru: В тебе есть потенциал, чтобы стать хорошим лейтенантом, но тебе нужно верно расставлять приоритеты.

quote: Just like Alaska, you make rash decisions, you don't prioritize.
before: I did the best I could under difficult circumstances. You never got your act together.
after: Oh, don't bring up the jade earrings. You bought gifts for our patients when we couldn't even pay the gas bill.
ru: Совсем как в Аляске. Ты принимаешь поспешные решения, не расставляешь приоритеты.

quote: But learning how to prioritize our duties in law enforcement, especially as they conflict with the Dodgers.
before: In fact, some days, I even admire you. As well you should.
after: Well, that takes time. Tell you what, I'll teach you when to speak up as a reserve officer, if you'll show me how to operate that great new vehicle we were in the other night.
ru: Но научись, как расставлять приоритеты в службе правопорядка, особенно когда они конфликтуют с Доджерс.

quote: When your resources are limited, you have to prioritize.
before: Important to whom? Society.
after: So you base treatment on whether patients have particular abilities? It's much more complicated than that.
ru: Когда ресурсы ограничены, приходится расставлять приоритеты.

quote: And I also strongly encourage you, and I'm sure we'll also have these discussions afterwards, to think about, how do we actually prioritize?
before: The amazing part of this process — and of course, I mean, I would love to — I only have 18 minutes, I've already given you quite a substantial amount of my time, right? I'd love to go into, and get you to think about this process, and that's actually what we did.
after: Of course, you have to ask yourself, why on Earth was such a list never done before? And one reason is that prioritization is incredibly uncomfortable.
ru: И я бы очень хотел, и я уверен, что мы потом ещё это обсудим, хотел бы, чтобы Вы подумали — а как мы расставляем эти приоритеты?

quote: McKibben is not the only member who prioritizes environmental issues.
after: Browner, who headed the EPA during the entire presidency of Bill Clinton, has worked under President Obama as the director of the White House Office of Energy and Climate Change Policy. While the environment is given a strong emphasis, Sanders has raised the point that labor representation on the committee is lacking.

quote: He has to be pure or we can't proceed.
before: But there's much more at stake here than one man's suffering. Don't we have to be strong?
after: Yes. Hey, he's coming around.
ru: Он должен очиститься, иначе мы не сможем продолжить.

quote: We will proceed according to your diagnosis and nothing else.
before: Does anyone here think my diagnosis is right? Well, then I have decided, for today only, to respect your opinions.
after: That's an order. Good luck.
ru: Мы продолжим согласно твоему диагнозу и больше ничего.

quote: Trial will proceed with Ms. Crane staying on as co-counsel.
before: No, I'm ready to go now. I may lack experience, but I am committed to clearing my name. Very well.
after: As those autopsy and crime scene photos show, Nadia Decotis had been struck repeatedly by a heavy object in the head and chest, suffering traumatic wounds pre-mortem.
ru: Суд продолжится и мисс Крэйн будет пребывать в качестве со-адвоката.

quote: If we determine there's a case, you can proceed.
before: Do not poke this bear. If you have something, bring it to us.
after: And most importantly, do not put agents undercover inside the Church of the Unlocked Mind. Well, it's a little late for that.
ru: Если мы решим, что есть судебное дело, вы можете продолжить.

quote: But before I proceed, I should set you the context.
before: (Laughter) Our national dress is unique, but this is not the only thing that's unique about my country. Our promise to remain carbon neutral is also unique, and this is what I'd like to speak about today, our promise to remain carbon neutral.
after: I should tell you our story. Bhutan is a small country in the Himalayas.
ru: Но прежде чем продолжить, необходимо объяснить вам контекст.

quote: But the gratitude that I felt towards him soon turned to horror as he proceeded to take off my clothes and get on top of me.
before: The security guards wanted to call me an ambulance, but Tom acted as my knight in shining armor, and told them he'd take me home. It was like a fairy tale, his strong arms around me, laying me in the safety of my bed.
after: My head had cleared up, but my body was still too weak to fight back, and the pain was blinding. I thought I'd be severed in two.
ru: Но благодарность, которую я испытывала к нему, скоро сменилась ужасом, когда он продолжил снимать с меня одежду и забрался на меня.

quote: (Laughter) And so they proceeded to engage this gentleman in a very robust discussion of his decision-making skills.
before: You don't belong here. " Now, my parents were studying to become United Methodist ministers, but they were not pastors yet.
after: (Laughter) My father may have mentioned that he was going to spend eternity in a very fiery place if he didn't find my name on that checklist. And indeed, the man checks the checklist eventually, and he found my name, and he let us inside.

after: (Laughter) But they aren't supposed to come back. But for the first time, at the beginning of this year, the Cyclone Pam, which destroyed Vanuatu, and in the process, the very edges of it actually touched our two southernmost islands, and all of Tuvalu was underwater when Hurricane Pam struck.
ru: Мы создаём их, а потом посылаем либо на север, либо на юг.

quote: What do you think Scientology was attempting to accomplish by sending these photos to the BBC?

ru: Для меня было честью служить вам.

quote: So if a bridge can become a museum, a museum can also serve as a bridge.

after: In Norway, we are building a museum that spans across a river and allows people to sort of journey through the exhibitions as they cross from one side of a sculpture park to the other. An architecture sort of adapted to its landscape.
ru: И если мост может стать музеем, то и музей тоже может служить мостом.

quote: So they took their money and their projects to others who would serve them better.

after: Well, it didn't take long for business to drop like a rock. My partner and I, Thom, we had to let all our employees go.
ru: Они унесли свои деньги и проекты другим, которые лучше их обслуживали.

quote: And I thought it might serve as a kind of permanent mnemonic device.

And what I loved about this image of the compass was that I felt like it encapsulated both of these ideas in one simple image.
after: Well it did. But it turns out, it doesn't remind me of the thing I thought it would; it reminds me constantly of something else instead.
ru: Я подумала, что он будет мне служить своего рода напоминающим устройством.

before: Masutha also announced yesterday the rejection of a parole application by apartheid killer Clive Derby-Lewis, an ex-MP.
after: Hani also led the ANC's militant division. His killing in 1993 sparked rioting.

quote: Setting snares at woods' edge.
before: - We caught him red-handed. - Doing what?

ru: Устанавливал силки на опушке.

quote: Okay, I'm setting the coordinates for the P.P.N.

after: First, you must answer the question, " Why? " Why?

quote: So, I have criticisms of the way the state government seems to have things set up.

ru: Мы настраиваем удаленный канал из вашего офиса.

before: We can have as many friends as we want, but have nobody to shake hands with. I want to take you to a different kind of world, the world of the imagination, where, using this most powerful tool that we have, we can transform both our physical surroundings, but in doing so, we can change forever how we feel and how we feel about the people that we share the planet with.
after: We all have moments in our lives, and when we're on our deathbeds, we're not going to remember the daily commute to work on the number 38 bus or our struggle to find a parking space every day when we go to the shop. We're going to remember those moments when our kid took their first step or when we got picked for the football team or when we fell in love.
ru: Моя компания «Артишок», которую я создала в 2006 году, была призвана создавать моменты.

quote: They weren't set up to do this. They're set up to make money.

Now of course, this doesn't come naturally to multinational companies.
after: But they are extremely efficient organizations. They have resources, and if we can add the will, the commitment, they know how to deliver that product.
ru: Они не создавались для этого, они созданы делать деньги.

after: Chinese soldiers will catch and send back North Koreans, where they face severe punishment. ru: Пограничники на границе Северной Кореи часто стреляли и убивали людей, пытавшихся пересечь границу без разрешения.

ru: Я пыталась показывать им снимки, но они даже не стали смотреть!

after: Now, gene editing and synthesis and sequencing, they're different disciplines, but they're tightly related. And they're all moving in these headlong rates.

ru: и не просто появляться в классе время от времени,

quote: If this email shows up -- how many of you have gotten an email like this, right?
before: Specifically, it feels like little bits of my time get slipped away to various things like this, like technology — I check things. I'll give you an example.
after: I've been tagged in a photo. When this appears, I can't help but click on it right now.
ru: Вам приходит такое письмо. Кто из вас не получал такие письма?

quote: And I asked them, I said, "How many of you now show up to work later than you used to?"
before: And I stood there in front of 200 of the most depressed people I've ever talked to. And I described to them some of these Lego experiments, and they said they felt like they had just been through that experiment.
after: And everybody raised their hand. I said, " How many of you now go home earlier than you used to? "
ru: Я спросил их: «Сколько из вас теперь будет приходить на работу позже?»

quote: Mr. Canning's predecessor counsel, Mr. Stern, already signed off on our evidence list.
before: Because you showed it to her. Uh-uh-uh. Mr. Canning, you'll have your chance.
after: He had no objection to this video. That's true, Mr. Canning.
ru: Мистер Каннинг, предыдущий адвокат, мистер Стерн, уже утвердил наш список доказательств.

quote: OK, so we need you to sign off on our sweeps promos.
before: Yeah, laugh. FYI, you all get buried in the pyramid with me.
after: Also, we should review the status of the development slate. Yeah, yeah, before that, I'd like to know, where's our vampire show?
ru: Мне надо, что бы вы утвердили показ некоторых пилотных эпизодов.

quote: And we just need you to sign off on it.
before: Hi, honey, so, here's the thing -- These guys -- They want to completely remove my penis and use it as an alien's heart.
after: - What? !
ru: И нам нужна ты, чтобы одобрить это.

quote: But Webber would have to sign off on it.
before: There's real research value in it. And with just two patients, it wouldn't take much enzyme.
after: Well, let's not tell him till we've got our ducks in a row. I could draw up a protocol and see if I can find a hospital willing to administer it.
ru: Но это должен одобрить Уэббер.

quote: Don't you think you should have... asked me before signing me up for this?
before: Castle. Can we talk for a second over there? I knew she was gonna say that.
after: I thought you were on board. Uh, you were trash-talking Ryan about it before.
ru: Тебе не кажется, что следовало спросить меня, прежде чем подписывать меня на это?

quote: You didn't have to sign up for football and soccer and...
before: I mean, I invited you. Because you never come down to San Diego. I have games on the weekends.
after: What... what are you... what's going on? It's just so hard.
ru: Тебе не нужно было записываться на футбол и...

quote: I told him not to sign up.
before: I think the least we can do is choose how to spend our days. Yeah...
after: I mean, what have the germans ever done to us? We're sending decent Canadian citizens over there to die on their beaches.
ru: Я говорила ему не записываться.

quote: So, when you sign up for TED2003, every six weeks you'll get a care package with a book or two and a reason why they're linked to TED.
before: And one key way that we're going to do this is to introduce this book club. Books kind of saved me in the last couple years, and that's a gift that I would like to pass on.
after: They may well be by a TED speaker, and so we can get the conversation going during the year and come back next year having had the same intellectual, emotional journey. I think it will be great.
ru: так что когда вы будете записываться на TED2003, каждые шесть недель вы будете получать специальный набор, с одной или двумя книгами, и причину из-за которой они связаны с TED.

quote: You'll sing and I'll be your manager.
before: Really? Let's run away to Dubai.
after: You're delirious. In Dubai, anything is possible.
ru: Ты будешь петь, а я буду твоим менеджером.

quote: I can't sing, but I can dance.
before: I'm really not a big fan of my nose, ever since I was really young. For me it was either this or "Little One," because I'm really short.
after: I was kind of, you know, the weirdo with red hair. For me it was either this or "Perfectionist,"
ru: Я не могу петь, но я могу танцевать.

quote: Yeah, but it's, it's about more than just being able to sing.
before: Rachel, Santana, Mercedes, - even Kurt. - Blaine can do that.
after: It's about the attitude, you know? - Yeah. - Those kids didn't just want to win, they wanted to crush the competition.
ru: Да, но дело не только в простом умении петь.

quote: Does anyone sing "wherever their fate leads them"?
before: Nekomanma. That doesn't sound like much of an answer, Master.
after: I hate that stuff. What stuff?
ru: Как можно петь что-то типа: "Куда же приведёт меня судьба?

quote: For example, I could never pitch my voice that high to sing.
before: They're higher in pitch. When you start laughing hard, you start squeezing air out from your lungs under much higher pressures than you could ever produce voluntarily.
after: Also, you start to get these sort of contractions and weird whistling sounds, all of which mean that real laughter is extremely easy, or feels extremely easy to spot. In contrast, posed laughter, we might think it sounds a bit fake.
ru: Например, я бы никогда не смогла петь таким высоким голосом.

quote: "I don't like to sing my own praises."
before: They say things like, " I don't like to toot my own horn. " " I'd rather let the work speak for itself. "
after: I hear very different narratives in working with male business owners, and I think this difference is costing women 20 cents on the dollar. I'd like to tell you the story of a consulting firm that helps their clients dramatically improve their profitability.
ru: «Не люблю петь себе дифирамбы».

quote: There is a song. I will not sing it, as I am a terrible singer.
before: 100 percent. (Applause) Dr. Bhan you came here and said such wonderful things.
after: GB: I too am a terrible singer. SRK: But we can't keep shut also, because we are saying wonderful things.
ru: Есть такая песня — петь не буду, так как певец из меня никакой...

quote: It's also very emotional because the singer who won that year sang about "unite unite, Europe."
after: It was perfect at that time. After he won, in the green room, he pulled a red rose from the bouquet and gave it to me, and he paid me some compliments.

quote: Hey, I was sitting there before you were, and I didn't feel any gun.
before: I'm just thinking how convenient it is... a gun that may have been used to shoot Paul was under my pillow? A-and now has my fingerprints on it?
after: Yeah, speaking of convenient... You're alone in the room, we came back, and suddenly there's a gun under the cushion?
ru: Слушай, я там сидела до тебя! и не почувствовала никакого пистолета.

quote: I told you, I was sitting at my desk when the attack happened.
before: The prodigal son has returned. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to go slaughter a fatted calf for lunch.
after: These rug burns are from last night. We think you were having sex, but memory loss could also be a symptom.
ru: Я сказал вам, что сидел за своим столом, когда случился приступ.

quote: You try sitting across from Vanessa redgrave as she recounts her trip to palestine.
before: It feels like it's gotten out of hand. I've had dinner meetings almost every night this week.
after: How am I supposed to get though these monotonous work events without a cocktail? I don't know.
ru: Попробуй сидеть напротив Ванессы Редгрейв пока она рассказывает о своей поездке в Палестину.

quote: How long do we have to sit here before you are stimulated?
before: You think that staring at pictures on our shirts is going to be more effective than hypnosis? If you'd stop talking, the re-enactment could stimulate activity in my hippocampus and parahippocampal cortex.
after: Stop staring at my breasts. And don't say, "Or lack thereof. "
ru: И сколько нам тут сидеть, пока ты не вызовешь активность?

quote: I don't recommend sitting on a gargoyle in the middle of January, naked.
before: This is the Tower of Saint Jacques. It was built in the early 1500s.
after: It was not very comfortable. (Laughter) And all this time, I never saw a single rat in any of these places, until recently, when I was in the London sewers.
ru: Не советую сидеть голышом на гаргулье в середине января.

quote: I wouldn't be sitting here right now if this hadn't happened.
before: So I did a self-portrait, because I wanted to show everybody what a bomb does to somebody, but also to show that losing your limbs doesn't end your life; that you can have what people say is disability, but not be disabled; that you can be able to do anything if you put your mind to it and have belief in it. It's strange, but in many ways I look at where I was a year ago, and I look at where I am now, and I realize that I have a lot of things I didn't have then.
after: I wouldn't have been able to show you those photographs and tell you those stories. I was lucky 10 years ago, when I sat down and I tried to work out what I could do to make a difference in this world.
ru: Я не сидел бы здесь, если бы этого не случилось.

quote: We were sitting in the kitchen. Sue Klebold was fixing dinner.
before: It took a long time to persuade them to talk to me, and once they agreed, they were so full of their story that they couldn't stop telling it, and the first weekend I spent with them, the first of many, I recorded more than 20 hours of conversation. And on Sunday night, we were all exhausted.
after: And I said, " If Dylan were here now, do you have a sense of what you'd want to ask him? " And his father said, " I sure do.
ru: Мы сидели на кухне. Сью Клиболд готовила ужин.

quote: Rafah sits on the border with the Gaza Strip in Palestine.
I suggest you sleep with the door locked tonight.
before: No. Little bit, yeah.
after: - No, seriously. - No, I'm going to, absolutely.
ru: Полагаю, тебе стоит сегодня спать с запертой дверью.

quote: Sleeping with you in Rome was a mistake.
before: So there's nothing to worry about. No, please, don't.
after: Uh... I'm afraid this is something I can't follow through on. What isn't?
ru: Спать с тобой в Риме было ошибкой.

quote: From now on, I'm not sleeping together with you.
before: We can't sleep together. I told you.
after: I'll just... sleep on the floor. In a few days, even if you want me here, I have to leave. Let's sleep together.
ru: С этого дня я не буду спать с тобой.

quote: After a quick meal everybody should sleep in uniform.
before: Lieutenant, I have an important message from the Lieutenant Colonel. Abort the exercise and return to barracks.
after: - What's happened? - We've received new intel.
ru: После приема пищи они должны лечь спать в полной готовности.

quote: Try sleeping on your side with your neck supported and with a pillow between your legs.
before: Adjust your screen so it's at or slightly below eyelevel. Make sure all parts of your body, like your elbows and wrists, are supported, using ergonomic aids if you need to.
after: Wear shoes with low heels and good arch support, and use a headset for phone calls. It's also not enough to just have good posture.
ru: Постарайтесь спать на боку с поддержкой шеи и с подушкой между ног.

quote: You want to sleep lightly, wake up easily.
before: Later, I found out that what I had was short-term PTSD: post-traumatic stress disorder. We evolved as animals, as primates, to survive periods of danger, and if your life has been in danger, you want to react to unfamiliar noises.
after: You want to have nightmares and flashbacks of the thing that could kill you. You want to be angry because it makes you predisposed to fight, or depressed, because it keeps you out of circulation a little bit.
ru: чутко спать и часто просыпаться.

quote: It wouldn't eat. It wouldn't sleep. It wouldn't have sex.
before: In the 1950s, Olds and Milner put electrodes into the brain of a rat. And the rat would just keep pressing that bar thousands and thousands and thousands of times.
after: It wouldn't do anything but press this bar. So they assumed this must be, you know, the brain's orgasmatron.
ru: Она не хотела ни есть, ни спать, ни размножаться.

quote: Nine other crew were sleeping on the fishing boat.
before: The Indian trawler was 100m from the ship. The trawler wanted the ship to pass."
after: The state has approved 500,000 rupees (US$10,125; £6,450) for each dead man's family.

quote: It's so good to be able to smile like this.
before: Can I call you just Yu-jeong? I'm just happy when I think of Thursdays when you come see me.
after: Good things never disappear. I'll... die anyway, but... my life was not a total failure, right?
ru: Это здорово, быть способным так улыбаться.

quote: I say we keep smiling and look for the hidden cameras.
before: I think it's crap. Of all the gay men in the world, We have to get the two without taste. What are we gonna do about this?
after: I think we're about to get punk'd. I don't think there's anything we can do. It's not our lawn.
ru: Я скажу что - продолжаем улыбаться и ищем взглядом скрытую камеру.

quote: I really hope I don't smile during my Cleopatra suicide monologue or kill myself during my toothpaste commercial.
before: - Sounds like you're really busy. - Yeah, it's total chaos.
after: I need another coffee. More coffee? Are you sure it's a good idea, Ade?
ru: Я очень надеюсь, что не буду улыбаться во время монолога самоубийства Клеопатры или убью себя во время рекламы зубной пасты.

quote: Devote five minutes a day to smiling, just smiling, and after a while it'll come naturally.
before: Think about it. Happiness is a state of mind and, like all things, it takes practice.
after: I didn't mean to... Hey, you forgot your pen!
ru: Посвятите хотя бы пять минут день тому, чтобы улыбаться. Просто улыбаться. И через какое-то время улыбка станет настоящей.

quote: When they're born, babies continue to smile -- initially, mostly in their sleep.
before: (Laughter) The good news is that we're actually born smiling. Using 3D ultrasound technology, we can now see that developing babies appear to smile, even in the womb.
after: And even blind babies smile to the sound of the human voice. Smiling is one of the most basic, biologically uniform expressions of all humans.
ru: младенцы продолжают улыбаться поначалу, в основном, во сне.

quote: This was the director of the bank when he was still smiling.
before: You always have to sort of adapt and improvise to the opportunities and accidents that happen, and the sort of turmoil of the world. One last example is that recently we, like last summer, we won the competition to design a Nordic national bank.
after: (Laughter) It was in the middle of the capital so we were really excited by this opportunity. Unfortunately, it was the national bank of Iceland.
ru: Это – председатель банка в то период, когда он еще мог улыбаться.

quote: It even appeared that Bush was smiling, as the shoes flew past his head.
before: Despite the incident, the press conference continued with some reporters apologizing for the man's actions.

quote: Basically it says you should avoid complexity When solving problems.
before: I have to look it up. It's some logic thing.
after: What does that have to do with flipping heads 20 times? I have no idea.
ru: Подразумевается, что надо избегать сложностей решая проблемы.

quote: Even true love's kiss can't solve every problem.
before: Roland's with little John now. I wish I could have told him I did everything I could.
after: Well, there's a reason that kiss didn't work. And it's not what everyone thinks.
ru: Даже поцелуй любви не решает все проблемы.

quote: And now you're a problem I have to solve.
before: You got to play king of the mountain, it didn't cost me anything, so I was happy to let you do it. But somewhere along the way, you convinced yourself that you had real power.
after: This is important, so if there's nothing else? Hi.
ru: Ты стал проблемой, которую мне надо решать.

quote: What, are we gonna just solve society's drug problem?
before: And then one of them's gonna... Okay. Call the police.
after: You know what I mean? Is that on us?
ru: А мы собираемся решать общественную проблему с наркотиками?

quote: So as you can see, we are always solving.
before: And how about this puzzle invented in 18th-century England: the jigsaw puzzle. Is this not making order out of chaos?
after: We are always trying to decode our world. It's an eternal quest.
ru: Так что, как видите, мы всегда решаем задачи.

quote: So how, then, does the brain solve its waste clearance problem?
before: I mean, the brain is this intensely active organ that produces a correspondingly large amount of waste that must be efficiently cleared. And yet, it lacks lymphatic vessels, which means that the approach that the rest of the body takes to clearing away its waste won't work in the brain.
after: Well, that seemingly mundane question is where our group first jumped into this story, and what we found as we dove down into the brain, down among the neurons and the blood vessels, was that the brain's solution to the problem of waste clearance, it was really unexpected. It was ingenious, but it was also beautiful.
ru: Как же мозг решает проблему устранения ненужных веществ?

quote: Now the proteins that exist on earth evolved to solve the problems faced by natural evolution.
before: I told you that nature uses an alphabet of 20 amino acids, and a typical protein is a chain of about 100 amino acids, so the total number of possibilities is 20 times 20 times 20, 100 times, which is a number on the order of 10 to the 130th power, which is enormously more than the total number of proteins which have existed since life on earth began. And it's this unimaginably large space we can now explore using computational protein design.
after: For example, replicating the genome. But we face new challenges today.
ru: Белки, существующие в природе, адаптировались так, чтобы решать проблемы естественной эволюции,

quote: He says no one will solve Africa's ills for it.
after: Africa must play the game of globalization but not unilateral globalization based solely on market forces. Konare said the new partnership must develop ways to address this issue.

quote: I got to see the lads, I've got to talk to them, sort them out.
before: I've not got much time, I've got to crack on. I've got a lot to fit in.
after: How much I should give them? I don't know, it's your money.
ru: Мне нужно повидаться с мальчиками, поговорить с ними, разобраться.

quote: You want to sort this out, you sort it out after he's arraigned.
before: All we're asking for is a delay until we can sort all this out. No, what you're asking for is preferential treatment for a murder suspect.
after: No, I don't think you understand. There's not gonna be an after.
ru: Вы хотите разобраться в этом, и вы разберетесь, после привлечения его к суду.

quote: Someone who can help us to sort out all of these tempestuous feelings.
before: A counselor? No no no.
after: No counselor. You know, this is happening way too fast.
ru: С кем-то, кто мог бы помочь нам разобраться с нашими бурными чувствами.

quote: He was a witness and we just need time to sort it out.
before: Just what did Dean see? An accident.
after: Nothing's going to happen to us, is it? He's all I've got in the world.
ru: Он был свидетелем, и нам нужно время, чтобы разобраться с этим.

quote: Even having a female leader, they always find something better to do than to sort out the pesky issue of inequality.
before: Nothing. Because she's much too busy cleaning up the mess the boys made.
after: So I keep talking about equality like it matters. Does it?
ru: Даже имея женщину-лидера, они всегда находят занятие получше, чем разобраться с назойливой проблемой неравенства.

quote: There's also complex space laws and politics that we have to sort out.
before: Robotic repair and maintenance could extend the lives of hundreds of satellites orbiting around the Earth. Whatever the disposal or cleanup options we come up with, it's clearly not just a technical problem.
after: Simply put, we haven't found a way to use space sustainably yet. Exploring, innovating to change the way we live and work are what we as humans do, and in space exploration, we're literally moving beyond the boundaries of Earth.
ru: Существуют сложные космические законы и политика, в которых нужно разобраться.

quote: So I've decided to get a grip and sort it out.
before: All of my relationships have failed. There's nothing in my life apart from my work.
after: So I joined a gym. " (Laughter) Now I don't mean to mock, but being a fit 10-hour-a-day office rat isn't more balanced; it's more fit.
ru: Так что я решила взяться за это всерьез и во всем разобраться.

quote: Ladies and gentlemen, Mr. Thompson will not speak to you tonight.
before: Good evening, my fellow Americans. Tonight, I can t...
after: His time is up. For years, you've asked, "Who is John Galt?"
ru: Дамы и господа, мистер Томпсон больше не будет говорить с вами сегодня.

quote: Do you not speak to Jesus in your prayers?
before: Well, I-I do have one. How long before Jesus speaks to me?
after: Yes, I speak to him. It's been a one-sided conversation so far.
ru: А разве ты не разговариваешь с ним в молитвах?

quote: I spoke to Mrs Oprescu, it'll be ready for Friday.
before: We'll stop at the post office on the way. It's OK, baby.
after: What? Why Wednesday?
ru: Говорила с мадам Опреску, к пятнице платье будет готово.

quote: What? Are you speaking to me again now?
before: Thank you. Morris,wake up.
after: I have to go. I need you to take Prescott and get out of the city.
ru: Ты снова со мной разговариваешь?

quote: Speaking for myself, it's a little bit uncomfortable to do that.
before: Do you think that your discussion may serve as a blueprint for other fields? JD: Well, I think it's hard for scientists to get out of the laboratory.
after: But I do think that being involved in the genesis of this really puts me and my colleagues in a position of responsibility. And I would say that I certainly hope that other technologies will be considered in the same way, just as we would want to consider something that could have implications in other fields besides biology.
ru: Если говорить обо мне, мне не очень комфортно это делать.

quote: It is a genetic birthright that we have, like walking or speaking or seeing.
before: It's not fiction, it's not story tales, it's not make-believe; it's cold, hard science. These are the benefits to play.
after: And if we handicap ourselves with play, we handicap ourselves as if we would with any other birthright that we have. We hold ourselves back.
ru: И это заложено в нас генетически с рождения, как способность ходить, говорить или видеть.

quote: But there people asked me, "Why do you speak Korean with a Spanish accent?"
before: It felt like a zero-sum game, where I had to give up my old identity to be able to gain or earn a new one. So when I was 18, I decided to go to Korea, hoping that finally I could find a place to call home.
after: (Laughter) And, " You must be Japanese because of your big eyes and your foreign body language. " And so it turns out that I was too Korean to be Argentinian, but too Argentinian to be Korean.
ru: Но там люди меня спрашивали: «Почему ты говоришь по-корейски с испанским акцентом?»

quote: Reactions to the legislation have been mixed, with opponents and advocates speaking out.
after: The President of the Union of Concerned Scientists, Kevin Knobloch, said that the Union was "thrilled that Congress has finally caught up with science and the American people in recognizing the need to switch on clean energy." A report by the The Heritage Foundation, a conservative think tank, stated that the legislation would "damage the economy and hobble growth."

quote: Maybe if you spent more time with her, she wouldn't act like such a complete spaz.
before: You have to help me. I don't know what to do with her.
after: Get her out of town. Go camp on Kauai.
ru: Возможно, если бы ты проводил с ней больше времени, она бы не вела себя как припадочная.

quote: And I've spent a night in jail before.
before: Or check them out from afar. I've had a beer before.
after: But there's a limit to everything. Who's your friend?
ru: А я проводил ночь в тюрьме.

quote: We spend money on things we used to get for free.
before: We all gotta work. Why?
after: We spend money on things we used to get for free like... water. You could still get free water, but nobody does it.
ru: Мы тратим деньги на вещи, которые были бесплатны.

quote: What do you spend all this time on me?
before: Tell him I'll be able to run the Buddy Garrity's 5 day charity race this year. You go see that doctor tomorrow, I wanna start doing some side-to-side on that knee. Find out what he has to say.
after: I mean, I graduated, I'm not your problem anymore. The reason I'm spending all this time on you...
ru: Тренер, почему вы тратите все это время на меня?

quote: Now, why would we spend so much time on something so small?
before: The truth is, designing this tiny little button was a huge pain in the butt. Now, this is the new version of the button, and the designer who led this project estimates that he spent over 280 hours redesigning this button over the course of months.
after: It's because when you're designing at scale, there's no such thing as a small detail. This innocent little button is seen on average 22 billion times a day and on over 7.5 million websites.
ru: Зачем тратить столько времени на такие мелочи?

quote: I spent a lot of time in the bathroom.
before: Every time the phone rang, I would run to the bathroom so I would not have to answer it. If it was for me, my parents would say I'm not around.
after: And I hated introducing myself, especially in groups. I'd always stutter on my name, and there was usually someone who'd go, " Have you forgotten your name? "
ru: Я много времени проводил в ванной.

quote: And one way to do that is to spend less time in the shower.
before: Taking me to lesson two: empower people to save water. Melbourne wanted people to spend less water in their homes.
after: However, interviews revealed that some people, women in particular, weren't keen on saving water that way. Some of them honestly said, " The shower is not just to clean up.
ru: И один из путей сделать это — тратить меньше времени на принятие душа.

quote: The first part of his visit was spent in Washington, D.C..
before: Benedict XVI arrived in New York Friday, as part of his visit to the United States.
after: He arrived on "Shepherd One", a specially dedicated plane belonging to Alitalia, the flag carrier of Italy.

quote: 'With printing, the written word truly began to spread.
