before: (Laughter) (Applause) They decided that they were not being asked to take responsibility, or maybe the bus planning manager was being asked to take responsibility for planning the bus diversions, and the council officer was being asked to close the roads, and the transport for London people were being asked to sort out the Underground. All these people were only being asked to do the thing that they could do that would help us.
after: And I, in my innocence, thought, " Well, I'll take responsibility, " for what turned out to be a million people on the street. It was our first show.
ru: Никого не просили брать на себя ответственность.

quote: But some countries take a harder line on this than others.
before: In fact, one in every 10 new infections of HIV is among people who inject drugs. Now drug use or possession is illegal in almost every country.
after: In Thailand people who use drugs, or are merely suspected of using drugs, are placed in detention centers, like the one you see here, where they are supposed to clean up. There is absolutely no evidence to show that throwing people into detention cures their drug dependence.
ru: Но некоторые страны занимают более жёсткую позицию, чем остальные.

quote: "By the way... "she's very pretty and takes after you.
before: "l don't know if you had been informed that Hermoni "has brought Maya to the Home at the end of the summer and left her here. "l implore you to return ASAP and take her from here.
after: "Best regards, Dov." Are you cold?
ru: Кстати, она... очень красива и похожа на тебя.

quote: So I know how much Stephen takes after him.
before: Your husband was, umm... Very important to me. You knew Roger?
after: Carrying the world on his shoulders. Doing the right thing.
ru: Так что я знаю, как сильно Стивен похож на него.

quote: Do you think he'll take after you or Mr. Grove?
before: I'm sorry. He's grown.
after: Promise you won't breathe a word? I promise.
ru: На кого же он похож, на тебя или мистера Гроува?

quote: I wonder who they're gonna take after.
before: Come on, guys! Time for dinner!
after: I got a feeling they're probably gonna take after their dad. Yeah?
ru: Интересно, на кого они будут похожи.

quote: He had somehow taken it for granted that he should go out with his union.
before: “But—but—” stammered Jurgis.
after: “The packers need good men, and need them bad,” continued the other, “and they’ll treat a man right that stands by them. Why don’t you take your chance and fix yourself?”
ru: Он почему-то считал само собой разумеющимся, что пойдёт вместе со своим профсоюзом.

quote: Luckily, he took it for granted that I had only just come upon the scene.
before: Rather ostentatiously, I stepped forward, crackling some dead branches with my feet as I did so. John turned.
ru: К счастью, он счёл само собой разумеющимся, что я только что появился на месте событий.

quote: I mean, I don't really know the guy, but he's an idiot if he's taking you for granted.
before: Yeah, it's always some excuse. And if I'm second to him now, what's it gonna be like when we're married?
after: Where's Rajiv? He has disappeared.
ru: Я хочу сказать, хотя я совсем не знаю этого парня, но он просто дурак, что принимает тебя как должное.

quote: Oh, I see, I'm home for a week, you're already taking me for granted.
before: - Thanks. - We got jammed up.
after: What? Never.
ru: Понятно: я дома всего неделю, а ты уже принимаешь меня как должное.
source_ru: Понятно, всего неделю дома, а ты уже ведешь себя, как будто мы и не разлучались.

quote: You should never take anything for granted, Mr Carson.
before: Would you like a piece? I thought Mr Branson might try to burn the house down but I didn't think you would. No?
after: No, no, no. Not now.
ru: - Нет? Вы никогда не должны ничего принимать на веру, мистер Карсон.

quote: I would like to teach Ryan a lesson about taking me for granted.
before: What now? Should we go pull a prank on some lesser pair of buddies?
after: - Hey. - Hey.
ru: Я проучил бы Райана за то, что он меня не ценит.

quote: Now, that's a sound I'll never take for granted again.
before: Because that is exactly the type of partner you want by your side in a crisis. Note his caring, loving and gentle touch.
after: I hate to interrupt your moment of Zen, but it's time you fill me in on the details of the buy. Keehi Small Boat Harbor, tomorrow morning.
ru: Этот звук никогда больше не буду принимать как само собой разумеющееся.

quote: Because I discovered that my coffee would not be possible without hundreds of people I take for granted.
before: (Laughter) This quest took me months. It took me around the world.
after: So I would thank the trucker who drove the coffee beans to the coffee shop. But he couldn't have done his job without the road.
ru: Потому что я понял, что мой кофе не получится без сотен людей, которых я воспринимаю как должное.

quote: I soaked it up and I thought, "How could I ever have taken this for granted?"
before: After six months, it was time to go home. I remember Dad pushing me outside in my wheelchair, wrapped in a plaster body cast, and feeling the sun on my face for the first time.
after: I felt so incredibly grateful for my life. But before I left hospital, the head nurse had said to me, " Janine, I want you to be ready, because when you get home, something's going to happen. "
ru: Я жадно впитывала его и думала: как я могла раньше принимать это как должное?

quote: Right, well, take your coat off, then.
before: - I'm sorry about the other night, Arthur. - Oh... Would you like to sing?
after: What do you know? Dean Martin, Frank.
ru: Что ж, тогда снимайте плащ.

quote: Wha-- are we taking our shirts off now?
before: That's insane. Wha-- what is going on over here?
after: Okay, follow the leader. Come on, Peter, hurry!
ru: Мы что снимаем наши футболки?

quote: Max, you're taking your pants off in public!
before: Let's just change and get to the diner. Look, all we have to do is make it through eight more hours, and then we can get a good night's sleep.
after: Oh, my God! I'm so tired, I forgot where I was!
ru: Макс, ты снимаешь штаны на глазах у всех!

quote: Take his coat off; it says that, you know what, he ain't going anywhere.
before: - See, that's good. He's staying in control, not letting him say that he's innocent.
after: Dr. Sweets, I loved Albert.
ru: Снимает свое пиджак, это говорит о том, знаешь что, что он никуда не уйдет.

quote: But when she comes in and takes off her jacket, something terrible happens.
before: Onion looks gorgeous in her bright purple jacket, and she smells terrific. So, Iris invites Onion to her house for dinner.
after: You see, when Onion's jacket is removed, a chemical reaction happens, converting the sulfoxides that make her smell so great into sulfenic acid, which then becomes a nasty substance with a long name: syn-Propanethial S-oxide. The gas stings Iris, and suddenly, she can't help it, she starts weeping uncontrollably.
ru: но, когда Луковка снимает свою куртку, случается ужасное.

quote: But when you take it off -- that's when the real action happens.
before: The Wearable Meeting. Because when you put it on, you immediately get everything you need to have a fun and productive and useful meeting.
after: (Music) (Laughter) (Applause) Stuart Brown: So I would encourage you all to engage not in the work-play differential — where you set aside time to play — but where your life becomes infused minute by minute, hour by hour, with body, object, social, fantasy, transformational kinds of play. And I think you'll have a better and more empowered life.
ru: Но когда снимаете... тогда-то все настоящее и происходит.

quote: So if it stopped working, I just had to take it off.
before: AK: It took just about probably three to four hours to get it to train. I had to hook it up to a computer, so I couldn't just train it anywhere.
after: So now it's able to train with just this little piece on the back. I can wear it around.
ru: Если рука отключалась, то приходилось её снимать.

quote: It was at that point where I felt like, oh my God, this is just taking over my life.
before: Only my husband should be seeing my panties. (Laughter) He's pretty aware of cancer already.
after: And that's when I told myself, claim your experience. Don't let it claim you.
ru: «Боже мой, это захватывает мою жизнь». И именно тогда я сказала себе: «Управляй своим жизненным опытом.

quote: It's that will to live, that need to survive, to express itself, that comes in a car, and takes over people like me.
before: And it's done by men and women working just like this, making cars. Now this little quote about sculpture from Henry Moore, I believe that that " pressure within " that Moore's talking about — at least when it comes to cars — comes right back to this idea of the mean.
after: And we tell other people, " Do this, do this, do this, " until this thing comes alive. We are completely infected.
ru: Это и есть то желание жить, та необходимость выжить, выразить себя, которая воплощается в автомобиле и захватывает таких людей, как я.

quote: There are two ways: On the left is what we call the lytic way, where the viruses go right in and take over the cells.
before: It takes control of these cells, turns them into virus-making factories, and they all burst, a huge, extended bacteria family, all dying with viruses spilling out of their guts, the viruses taking over the bacterium. So now you understand how viruses can attack cells.
after: On the [right] is the lysogenic way that uses secret agent viruses. So this stuff is not that hard, right?
ru: Есть два способа: один из них (слева) называется литическим, когда вирусы проникают напрямую и захватывают власть над клеткой.

quote: I'm also sorry that someone's trying to kill you, but I can really only take ownership for the first part.
before: Probably shouldn't be so pumped. Look, I'm sorry I doubted you.
after: It's okay, Sarge. I would've doubted me too.
ru: И также жаль, что кто-то пытается тебя убить, но я могу взять ответственность только за первое.

quote: Isn't it time we started taking ownership of our finale on this earth?
before: So my lesson from this last year is, life would be a lot easier to live if we talked about death now, while we're healthy. For most of us, we wait until we are too emotional, too ill or too physically exhausted — and then it's too late.
after: So let's get going. Do you know what you want when you die?
ru: А не пора ли нам взять ответственность за наш финал на этой земле?

quote: Long before the time of the Great Purge I took part in such ceremonies.
before: The old woman said it could be used to open the door to the spirit world? I have seen it with my own eyes.
after: Each year at Beltain, the High Priestesses would gather at the Great Stones of Nemeton and summon the spirits of their ancestors.
ru: Задолго до Великой чистки, я принимал участие в подобных церемониях.

quote: Mole people don't usually take part in life above ground.
before: What is that supposed to mean? Well, you're a mole person.
after: You guys just gonna perform a skit on the dangers of drinking? - Could be kind of fun.
ru: Люди-кроты обычно не принимают участие в жизни над землей.

quote: But the problem was, fewer of the self expressive individuals would take part in focus groups.
before: We must conform, he told them, to the new non-conformists. We must listen to the music of Bobby Dylan and go to the theater more.
after: The advertisers were left to their own devices. -There's a new cereal that tastes so right!
ru: Но проблема была в том, что очень мало ярких личностей принимало участие в фокус группах.

quote: There's only three people in the DC area taking part in the trial.
before: It's basically created to encourage the development... Point is it's new.
after: Manufacturer. Manufacturer ships it directly to the users each week.
ru: И лишь трое в округе принимают участие в эксперименте.

quote: I took part in a 43-day expedition race in the coldest, most remote, most challenging place on earth.
before: Mark Pollock: Eventually, I did rebuild my identity, and the Why for me was about competing again, because pursuing success and risking failure was simply how I felt normal. And I finished the rebuild on the 10th anniversary of losing my sight.
after: It was the first race to the South Pole since Shackleton, Scott and Amundsen set foot in Antarctica, 100 years before. And putting the demons of blindness behind me with every step towards the pole, it offered me a long-lasting sense of contentment.
ru: Я участвовал в 43-дневной экспедиции в самое холодное, отдалённое и самое недружелюбное место на земле.

quote: Then you have the clapping audience, yeah, actually taking part in doing the music.
before: I mean, obviously the orchestra musicians playing beautifully, the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra. They don't often even look at the conductor.
after: You know Viennese audiences usually don't interfere with the music. This is the closest to an Oriental bellydancing feast that you will ever get in Vienna.
ru: Потом, хлопающая публика, которая собственно принимает участие в создании музыки...

quote: We can see the stories that Bill Clinton is taking part in right now.
before: We can have his constellations emerge here. We can pull out his secrets, and we see that it has a lot to do with candidates, Hillary, presidential, Barack Obama.
after: Any of those can be opened up. So we see Obama and the Clintons meet in Alabama.
ru: Мы видим истории, в которых Билл Клинтон принимает участие прямо сейчас.

quote: This means that the engagement can take place on Sunday.
before: On Friday. Great.
after: Okay, dear? Excellent.
ru: Значит помолвка может состояться в воскресенье.

quote: Because I had many scenes in my early 20s that took place at a Denny's.
before: If I wanna use... I think all my first scripts always had some scene that took place at a Denny's,
after: And Reservoir Dogs, in the original script the opening scene where they're all talking, at a Denny's. All right, the opening scene in Pulp Fiction, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny at a Denny's.
ru: В 20 с чем-то я постоянно писал в сценариях, что сцена происходит в Danny's.

quote: Exterior. It means the scene is taking place outside.
before: Exterior Cherry Tree Lane. - Ext? What's Ext?
after: Ah, I see, an abbreviation. Oh, I'm sorry Mr DaGradi, did you feel you should--?
ru: "Экстерьер", значит действие происходит на улице.

quote: Does that take place before or after Dr. Sloan's ossicular reconstruction?
before: Mr. Gates-- the patient has a name-- also has an injured facial nerve, which means what? That Mr. Gates will also need a nerve repair.
after: -Before. -Incorrect.
ru: Она должна состояться до или после слуховой реконструкции доктора Слоана?

quote: A major portion of the movie takes place underwater.
before: We use science and the world we know as a backbone, to ground ourselves in something relatable and recognizable. " Finding Nemo " is an excellent example of this.
after: But how do you make it look underwater? In early research and development, we took a clip of underwater footage and recreated it in the computer.
ru: Бóльшая часть сюжета происходит под водой.

quote: And that conversation may take place as long as three months after the baby has died.
before: A health worker asks a mom who has just lost her child, " Was the baby vomiting? Did they have a fever? "
after: Now, put yourself in the shoes of that mom. It's a heartbreaking, excruciating conversation.
ru: Этот разговор может состояться и три месяца спустя после смерти ребёнка.

quote: The final fermentation takes place in stage nine.
before: The fermentation which started at stage three is continuing through all these other stages. Again, developing more flavor.
after: We call it " proofing. " Proofing means to prove that the dough is alive.
ru: Окончательное брожение происходит на девятом этапе.

quote: You need to just think you make a difference, instead of just taking up space...
before: Do you hear something? You're afraid of what I do because I help people with their problems, but I can't do it unless they admit that they have problems in the first place, and that's just somewhere you won't go!
after: Shut up for a minute. You're afraid that if you look inside yourself for even one second, you might find out that you're not invincible, that you're just as scared and vulnerable as the rest of us...
ru: А ты предпочитаешь думать, что что-то меняешь, а не просто занимаешь место...

quote: It takes up half the room.
before: Whoa. Is that a Devil's Trap?
after: These chains -- they have spellwork etched into them. So we have a dungeon.
ru: Она занимает половин комнаты.

quote: It takes up a lot of space in the house.
before: You gotta get your own ball. I don't bowl enough to get my own ball.
after: You keep looking at it in the closet going, "What I am doing with a bowling ball? I don't even bowl."
ru: Он занимает много места в доме.

quote: You realize you're taking up two parking spaces?
before: Oh, this your truck, chief? Yes, it is, ma'am.
after: It's a big truck, ma'am. It's not that big, sir.
ru: Вы понимаете, что занимаете два места?

quote: Until then, I take up no space but the space you give me.
before: An answer worthy of my wife. I have to find my way back to the flesh.
ru: А до тех пор я занимаю только то пространство, что вы мне даёте.

quote: Your visual cortex takes up about 30 percent of your brain.
before: What we see is a unique, personal, virtual reality that is masterfully constructed by our brain. Let me explain with a bit of amateur neuroscience.
after: That's compared to approximately eight percent for touch and two to three percent for hearing. Every second, your eyes can send your visual cortex as many as two billion pieces of information.
ru: Зрительная кора занимает около 30% головного мозга.

quote: What used to take up a building now fits in our pockets.
before: It's already very close to us. When I was a student it was across campus, now it's in our pockets.
after: What now fits in our pockets would fit in a blood cell in 25 years. And we will begin to actually deeply influence our health and our intelligence, as we get closer and closer to this technology.
ru: То, что занимало здание, теперь помещается в кармане.

quote: I talked her into driving up to her favorite composing place.
before: She wanted it... she wanted it perfect. I did, too.
after: We were so excited, I got distracted and... drove off the road into the Penobscot River. I barely made it out alive.
ru: Я уговорил ее поехать туда, где она любила сочинять музыку.

quote: Mm-hmm, not against Jeff, but I talked her into going after Chang for child endangerment.
before: Why are they arresting Chang? I thought you said Loquanda wasn't pressing charges.
after: Shirley, he could get three to five years for that. Are you sure that's what you want?
ru: Мм-мм, не против Джеффа, но я уговорила ее подать в суд на Ченга за угрозы детям.

quote: And talked the owners into letting us spend our honeymoon night there.
before: And completely late for dinner. You close on that new house already?
after: Well, I've got some more good news for you. New neighborhood checks out.
ru: И уговорил владельцев пустить нас провести брачную ночь там.

quote: Hey, thanks again for talking me into this, Mike.
before: Ah, it's not exactly priceless. I had to pay him 30 bucks to do that.
after: You really got everyone to come out? I just told the guys it was a big moment for you, although some of the specifics may have changed a little bit.
ru: Еще раз спасибо, что уговорил меня на это, Майк.

quote: So on one of these rides, I talked my way into the compound and went to see the warden.
before: This story began four years ago. The correction facility where they are locked up happens to be right in the middle of one of my usual trips, and it's surrounded by barbed wires and electric gates and armed guards.
after: I told the warden that I wanted to start a mountain biking club in this place and that basically I wanted to take the kids from here to there. And I told him, " Let's find a way in which I'll be able to take out 10 kids once a week to ride with in the summer in the country. "
ru: И вот однажды, во время одной из своих поездок, я уговорил охранников пропустить меня на территорию и позволить мне поговорить с начальником тюрьмы.

quote: Everybody, including Gabby, talked you into going back, and you did end up taking.
before: PM: Installing solar panels on the top of her house, I have to say. So after the tragic incident, Mark, you decided to resign your position as an astronaut, even though you were supposed to take the next space mission.
after: MK: Kind of. The day after Gabby was injured, I called my boss, the chief astronaut, Dr. Peggy Whitson, and I said, " Peggy, I know I'm launching in space in three months from now.
ru: Все, включая Габби, уговаривали вас вернуться, и, в конце концов, вы согласились.

quote: I talked my family into doing this, and they didn't know what I was doing.
before: And a dig jig — a dig jig is where, for a milestone anniversary or a birthday, you gather all your friends and family together and you dance on where you're going to be buried. (Laughter) And we got a lot of attention when we did it.
after: And I was like, " Get dressed for a funeral. We're going to go do some work. "
ru: Я уговорил мою семью заняться этим, не рассказав им суть.

quote: If you speak Chinese well, please teach Ae Jung.
before: You could get ready together and go together. I heard that Gu Ae Jung would be doing a program abroad.
after: English is good too. Jenny unni, I'm here.
ru: Знаешь, если ты хорошо говоришь по-китайски, то смог бы учить Э Чжон.

quote: And then you left because you decided to teach religion?
before: Okay. So, you flew some planes.
after: Well, the transition was a little more complicated than that. Mom's on TV.
ru: А потом ты бросил, потому что решил преподавать религию?

quote: Why come to a little place like Jodie when there's plenty of teaching jobs in Dallas?
before: General Walker. I have something to say!
after: I didn't really take to the city. Call me Deke.
ru: - Зачем приезжать в такео маленькое местечко как Джоди, когда в Далласе столько работы для учителя?

quote: You may as well have taught me to play the banjo!
before: You're not very good. Because you taught me the wrong kind of skiing!
after: DOGS BARK 'And as zero hour approached, 'I was also struggling to bond with the dogs.' Ah, there's a pile of poo there!
ru: Это беговые лыжи! Ты мог с тем же успехом учить меня играть на банджо!

quote: Any student I've had the honor of teaching in my classroom is my kid.
before: But mine really are. (Laughter) I have 696 kids, and they are the most intelligent, inventive, innovative, brilliant and powerful kids that you'll ever meet.
after: However, because their " real " parents aren't rich and, I argue, because they are mostly of color, they will seldom get to see in themselves the awesomeness that I see in them. Because what I see in them is myself — or what would have been myself.
ru: Любой ребёнок, которого я имела честь учить в моём классе, становится моим.

quote: And it was because of these women that we just kept teaching.
before: And sometimes there were shocking realizations, and other times there were tears, but mostly it was laughs. And I ended that summer with this incredible sisterhood, and I began to feel much safer in my own skin.
after: I never thought that I would continue, but we just kept teaching. And today, nine years, 17 cities, 12 countries, 760 courses and thousands of women and girls later, I'm still teaching.
ru: Всё благодаря этим женщинам, которых мы продолжили учить.

quote: A few years into my teaching career, I learned firsthand the educational potential of comics.
before: Comic books didn't belong in the classroom. But again, I was wrong.
after: One semester, I was asked to sub for this Algebra 2 class. I was asked to long-term sub it, and I said yes, but there was a problem.
ru: Проработав учителем пару лет, я на своём опыте узнал, как комиксы могут помочь в учёбе.

quote: Judt had previously taught at Cambridge, the University of California, and Oxford University.
before: An alumnus of King's College, he began teaching at NYU as Professor of European studies in 1987.

quote: His sister's seven years older, And he told her there was no tooth fairy.
before: he's exceptionally bright. It's never been easy to lie to him.
after: Did you consider telling him the truth? I was just in shock.
ru: Его сестра на семь лет старше него, и это он рассказал ей, что зубной феи не существует.

quote: Might have been an idea to tell me about the skeleton in your closet.
before: 350 years of continuous trading and shifting your fucking assests is bringing my bank to its knees. Tom served in the British Army in Bosnia.
after: We can't sit on secrets like that. This is misinformation.
ru: Это была бы хорошая идея - рассказать мне о скелетах в твоем шкафу.

quote: Stiles told her about Lydia cracking the second part of the Dead Pool.
before: - Where's Kira? - She took off.
after: Her mom's on it. Everyone's on it.
ru: Стайлз рассказал ей, что Лидия взломала вторую часть списка.

quote: That was when she told me about that man for the first time.
before: Did you really have to kill him? When I was in middle school, my mother was really sick.
after: I wrote to him in Macau, asking him to pay her hospital bills. My mother... was dying.
ru: Тогда она впервые рассказала мне об этом человеке.

quote: I am here to tell you that change is in the air.
before: And this is not just specific to Ethiopia, but happens over and over, all over Africa. Well, I'm not here today to lament about the situation, or wring my hands.
after: Africa today is not the Africa waiting for aid solutions, or cookie-cutter foreign expert policy prescriptions. Africa has learned, or is learning somewhat slowly, that markets don't happen by themselves.
ru: Я здесь, чтобы рассказать вам о том, что перемены витают в воздухе.

quote: I took this to my colleagues at Stanford in anthropology and told them the same story.
before: And I always felt that if my patient gave up the quest for the magic doctor, the magic treatment and began with me on a course towards wellness, it was because I had earned the right to tell them these things by virtue of the examination. Something of importance had transpired in the exchange.
after: And they immediately said to me, " Well you are describing a classic ritual. " And they helped me understand that rituals are all about transformation.
ru: Я пошёл с этим к своим коллегам, антропологам из Стэнфорда и всё им рассказал.

quote: The stories -- these goddam stories -- the stories we tell ourselves become lies over time.
before: You wrote,' We are as gods and might as well get used to it.' " I'd forgotten that entirely.
after: So, documentation helps cut through that. It did move on to " We are as gods and might as well get good at it, " and that was the Whole Earth Catalog.
ru: Истории, проклятые истории, рассказы, которые мы рассказываем себе, со временем превращаются в ложь.

quote: Tell us about your history with criticism of Scientology?
Guys who buy cheap suits tend to trust guys who wear cheap hair.
before: I'm going to have to measure you. So, what-what's with the hair?
after: Tell me, uh, where do you wear your pants? I don't know, to work.
ru: Мужики, покупающие дешёвые костюмы, склонны доверять мужикам с дешёвыми волосами.

quote: Raiders tend to move at a pretty fast clip after a hit.
before: All I know is six of my men are dead, and valuable E-Rep equipment has been stolen, and it needs to be found now! Well, I wouldn't get my hopes up there.
after: They're probably 500 klicks away by now. Well, then I reckon you better get moving.
ru: Рейдеры склонны ехать достаточно быстро, после налёта.

quote: You tend to vanish, then materialize within the walls of a rival agency.
before: Space exploration and the defense department no longer eat at separate tables. But they also don't like to share recipes.
after: I feel like I'm talking to a ghost. Whereas I'm talking to a corpse.
ru: Вы склонны исчезать, а потом вдруг появляетесь в агентстве конкурента.

quote: People tend to get uncomfortable when they cannot put you in a box.
before: I choose to wear the hijab. It does not oppress me... but liberates me from society's expectations of what a woman should look like.
after: But I've always liked to make people uncomfortable. Well, you're very good at it.
ru: Люди склонны испытывать дискомфорт, когда не могут запихнуть тебя в рамки.

quote: They tend to bite each other, often quite ferociously and usually on the face.
before: But how can a cancer spread in a population? Well the final piece of the puzzle came when we remember how devils behave when they meet each other in the wild.
after: We think that cancer cells actually come off the tumor, get into the saliva. When the devil bites another devil, it actually physically implants living cancer cells into the next devil, so the tumor continues to grow.
ru: Они имеют склонность кусать друг друга, часто очень сильно и как правило за морду.

quote: We also tend to overestimate the value of small probabilities.
before: Almost half of the patients who are prescribed high blood pressure pills stop taking them within a year. Think of how many lives we could save if we could solve just that one problem.
after: This actually explains why state lotteries are so popular, even though they return pennies on the dollar. Now, some of you may buy lottery tickets — it's fun, there's the chance you might strike it rich...
ru: Мы также склонны преувеличивать ценность малых вероятностей.

quote: We tend to see commonalities more than differences.
before: This potential is not for the lucky few. It turns out, most people over 50 feel better, are less stressed, less hostile, less anxious.
after: Some of the studies even say we're happier. (Laughter) This is not what I expected, trust me.
ru: Мы более склонны видеть общее, чем различия.

quote: I find games like that to take far too long, and tend to become tedious.
before: The few times I have played it, I thought it was boring to be honest. I don't like the type of game where one marches armies around a 'large map' and then must 'zoom in' to a different 'battle field' every time a battle takes place.

quote: The photos we keep tend to be flattering.
before: I mean... You look like him on a good day.
after: I guess I wasn't any different. You're so soft.
ru: Фотографии, которые мы храним, обычно весьма лестные.

quote: Do these things tend to start on time?
before: At 5:00. Uh, I got a family thing at 5:00.
after: Of course. It's not a cat show.
ru: Обычно эти мероприятия начинаются вовремя?

quote: For example, men tend to be punishment-oriented And favor the prosecution.
before: Miss pratt. By making sure the bias swings in your favor.
after: What have you heard in the media about my client? That he's a sociopathic cop-killer.
ru: Например, мужчины обычно положительно относятся к наказанию и поэтому чаще помогают обвинению.

quote: In my experience, innocent people tend to speak in specifics.
before: The announcement this morning. You said that you caused the blackout, and then that you didn't mean to. It was all kind of a jumble.
after: No. No, no. I spoke in specifics.
ru: Обычно, невиновные люди не упускают подробности

quote: I tend to win those arguments, because I know the tricks.
before: I'm not interested really in arguments about whose turn it is to do the dishes or who has to take out the garbage. Yeah, we have those arguments, too.
after: But those aren't the important arguments. I'm interested in academic arguments, and here are the things that puzzle me.
ru: Обычно я выигрываю такие споры, потому что знаю некоторые уловки.

quote: And the thing is, these judgments tend to be accurate.
before: You look at me, you know my name, you know certain facts about me, and you could make certain judgments. You could make guesses about my ethnicity, my political affiliation, my religious beliefs.
after: We're very good at this sort of thing. And we're very good at this sort of thing because our ability to stereotype people is not some sort of arbitrary quirk of the mind, but rather it's a specific instance of a more general process, which is that we have experience with things and people in the world that fall into categories, and we can use our experience to make generalizations about novel instances of these categories.
ru: Правда в том, что такие суждения обычно верны.

quote: There tends to be water at the base of the ice sheet here.
before: The ice flows in complex ways. In some places, the ice flows very fast.
after: In other places, not so fast. Usually, there's not water present at the base there.
ru: В этом случае у основания обычно можно обнаружить воду.

quote: I don't think you could slip that in, somehow.
before: Great news. Mastermind, can I have it on Mastermind?
after: Someone's going to have to answer a lot of questions to beat that. And of course, unfortunately, Graham, you get nothing.
ru: Я не думаю, что у тебя получится их всунуть.

quote: I thought you might want to make a confession.
before: Let me out! Let me out! Let me out!
after: It was you who made the chandelier fall, wasn't it? You created the ghost at the house?
ru: Думаю, тебе нужно кое в чём признаться.

quote: I was not anticipating this, but I think it will be workable from our end.
before: I think this is more reasonable, and it's my final offer. Take it or leave it.
after: And one more thing... Monica votes for Raviga's board seat.
ru: Такого я не ожидала, но думаю, мы всё сможем устроить.

quote: Not as bad as you thought, I'm sure.
before: - Mm. Thank you. - Wow. - How'd it go? - [clears throat]
after: Worse, I think. I believe that he used "I told you so"
ru: Уверен, лучше, чем ты думал.

quote: And I think it's a pretty valid question.
before: (Laughter) Which I was pretty surprised by. I expected people to be wondering, " Why did I draw a sheep? "
after: And there's a lot of reasons why I chose sheep. Sheep were the first animal to be raised from mechanically processed byproducts, the first to be selectively bred for production traits, the first animal to be cloned.
ru: Думаю, это вполне справедливый вопрос.

quote: This is rapid eye movement kind of dreaming that we only thought mammals and birds did.
before: Now, in terms of cognitive skills, look at this sleeping behavior in the cuttlefish. Especially on the right, you see the eye twitching.
after: And you see the false color we put in there to see the skin patterning flashing, and this is what's happening a lot. But it's not normal awake behaviors; it's all different.
ru: Это что-то вроде фазы быстрого сна. Мы думали, что она есть только у млекопитающих и птиц.

quote: I even think it can go into the real world.
before: The person said, " No, that's fine. " I believe we can build architectures online to make such human requests that much easier to do, to make it possible for all of us to see that the data we encounter online is just stuff on which to click and paste and copy and forward that actually represents human emotion and endeavor and impact, and to be able to have an ethical moment where we decide how we want to treat it.
after: We can end up, as we get in a world with more censors — everywhere there is something filming you, maybe putting it online — to be able to have a little clip you could wear that says, " You know, I'd rather not. " And then have technology that the person taking the photo will know later, this person requested to be contacted before this goes anywhere big, if you don't mind.
ru: Я даже думаю, что это можно применить в реальном мире.

quote: You've got to think that eventually Google figures out a way to deal with this.
before: Tim Ghriskey, the chief investment officer for Solaris Asset Management said, "Clearly not good news for Google and clearly not good news for consumers.
after: If they do have to shut down their Chinese operations, that they would be able to reinstate them. Hopefully soon.

quote: I'd say they were thinking it over.
before: Is that a yes or a no? They're not moving away.
after: I've wanted Santiago dead for so long. I wasn't sure we could really pull it off.
ru: Я бы сказал, они обдумывают предложение.

quote: We'll, uh, think it over, Monsieur La Valle.
before: Speaking for Madame Colet, as well as for myself, resign. Very well.
after: Now, Monsieur La Valle, as for Madame Colet's life insurance, it totals one million francs. There's 500,000 fire insurance... and 400,000 against burglary.
ru: Мы обдумаем это, месье Ла Валль.

quote: Just give me your word you'll think my offer over and I'll be gone.
before: - I'm very flattered, Mr Shinar. I see that my overture is a shock to you, Miss Day, and I'll not force you for an answer straightaway.
after: I give you my word. I'll make you happier than a woman has ever been.
ru: Но дайте мне слово, что вы обдумает е моё предложение, и я уйду.

quote: I, I would like some... some time to think it over, though, but... it's okay.
before: Okay. I guess, um...
after: Hey -- think positive. If I remember correctly, your wife... doesn't allow you to drink coffee at home.
ru: Я... Я бы хотел еще... Все-таки еще немного обдумать это, но, ладно.

quote: Let us throw and sweep a'twain Until the heavens themselves Drop their jaws in wonder and envy!
before: Mm... Hmm. Let us curl, milady.
after: And afterwards there'll be beer and cocoa, With marshmallows floating in the foam. And if, from now till the end of time, Someone should ask what we were doing On the eve of the 17th of November,
ru: Давайте бросать и отчищать вместе до тех пор, пока на небесах не отвиснут челюсти от восхищения и зависти.

quote: You throw away your life because you've come to assume that it'll bounce right back into your lap.
before: Wrecking the natural order's not quite such fun when you have to mop up the mess, is it? This is hard for you, Dean.
after: But the human soul is not a rubber ball. It's vulnerable, impermanent, but stronger than you know.
ru: Ты бросаешься своей жизнью, полагая, что она прискачет обратно к тебе на колени.

quote: Uh, he's embarrassing himself and throwing away his career.
before: He is a nice person, and we should all stand up and say, "I... like..." Ben! No! What are you doing?
after: - Sweetheart, stop. - O, captain, my captain. - What is happening?
ru: Он ставит себя в неловкое положение и бросает карьеру на ветер. Милый, остановись.

quote: You have tested me and thrown me every which way.
before: It's a prophecy. I can't interfere.
after: And I have never asked for anything. Not a damn thing.
ru: Ты проверял меня и бросал во все стороны

quote: Now I'm not trying to throw stones here.
before: Systems thinkers who were reinventing the world, to a priesthood of folks in black turtlenecks and designer glasses working on small things. As our industrial society matured, so design became a profession and it focused on an ever smaller canvas until it came to stand for aesthetics, image and fashion.
after: I'm a fully paid-up member of that priesthood, and somewhere in here I have my designer glasses. There we go.
ru: Я не пытаюсь бросать в кого-то камни.

quote: The gunner was throwing candy.
before: And he said, " My gunner was throwing candy. " And I knew what he was going to say.
after: They used to throw candy to the kids. Kids got too close, very often.
ru: Его пулеметчик бросал конфеты.

quote: A man seen throwing down the belt was among those arrested.
before: In the hours following the bombings, police arrested three people, and recovered another explosives belt near Kandara Hotel.
after: Moroccan authorities have been downplaying a possible connection with Wednesday's bombings in neighboring Algeria.

quote: I mean, it gets tired, jetting off to Prague every weekend with Frank ocean.
before: I mean, you were telling me how you're very serious about settling down? Yeah, I am done with that whole lifestyle.
after: Love him. Love "Caribbean queen."
ru: Это утомляет, отправляться в Прагу каждые выходные с Фрэнком Оушеном.

before: However, I was unable to think of anything new at that moment. (Laughter) My ideas were unoriginal.
after: It was so hard that I became this skinny. (Laughter) It's true.
ru: Новые идеи не появлялись, и я стал уставать от мыслительного процесса.

quote: It'd be better if you didn't touch anything.
before: Why don't you let me get that for you? It's Zach, right?
after: Ah, yes. Evidence.
ru: Будет лучше, если вы ничего трогать не будете.

before: Looks like this gang had a busy night. The owner already started cleaning up inside.
after: Well, according to Akers, this is the second time these guys have hit this place. They did the same thing to a beauty supply store a block down, a couple nights ago.
ru: Но я попросила его ничего не трогать, пока мы не закончим.

quote: They're playing with their hair and touching your arm.
before: Are you sure? Yes, of course.
after: Classic green light. Are you positive?
ru: Они играют со своими волосами и трогают тебя за руку.

quote: Okay, then we won't touch the hard drive.
before: He offers to stand by his equipment, and we in return agree not to violate the integrity of the internal hardware. This little orange sticker is all that stands between us and anarchy.
after: We'll just erase the first season of Battlestar. There.
ru: Хорошо, тогда мы не будем трогать жесткий диск.

quote: We touch, feel and even taste it to identify what properties it lacks.
before: All we have to do is to bring these elements together and let nature take over. To make a forest we start with soil.
after: If the soil is made up of small particles it becomes compact — so compact, that water cannot seep in. We mix some local biomass available around, which can help soil become more porous.
ru: Мы трогаем, щупаем и даже попробуем её, чтобы определить недостающие свойства.

quote: Once on, the transporter worked best when I didn't touch it.
before: " Go, " I softly whispered to the transporter, stamping my foot. The thin metal rings I wore around each ankle jingled noisily, but I stamped my foot again.
after: " Go, " I said again, sweat forming on my brow. When nothing moved, I chanced giving the two large suitcases sitting atop the force field a shove.
ru: Транспортёр работал лучше всего, если его не трогать.

quote: I want to touch its precious screen.
before: You had me from, " Hello. " I want an iPhone.
after: I want to wipe the smudges clean. I want my friends to look and drool.
ru: Хочу касаться этого чудесного экрана.

quote: A tornado touched down yesterday in Joplin, Missouri, causing widespread damage.
after: At least 89 were killed.

before: Hey. Laurel, it's Ryan.
after: I'm a little concerned about Ivy's work and... and attitude at school lately, and, I don't know, I'd like to talk to you about it. So call me when you get a second.
ru: Эм, я просто хотел связаться с тобой.

quote: Could you touch base with her, please, and tell her you're actually alive?
before: You know, and the thing is, I feel kind of uncomfortable starting off this relationship with her with this secret about my friend-slash- not-dead-ex-fiancée.
after: Not a good idea. Mm-mm. You know, uh, Alex's having a tough time with this, you know?
ru: Не мог бы ты связаться с ней, и сказать, что ты жив?

quote: I'm trapped at N.Y.U., and- and it's too late to transfer.
before: So I'm pretending to be a student here. But it's only because I'm living a nightmare.
after: So what's wrong with cheering myself up with a little denial And a "Gossip Girl" blast or two? Nothing, I guess, but you can always make it right With whoever you take down online.
ru: Я заперта в Нью-Йорксокм университете, и уже слишком поздно переводиться.

quote: The Supreme Court instructed Pathankot's district judge not to transfer the case to any other court.
before: There are about 221 witnesses for this case. Statements in Urdu are to be translated in English.

quote: I don't see him traveling without a crew.
before: Manager says Torres checked in alone. Guy with his share of enemies...
after: What the hell? I got something ugly in this bottle.
ru: Странно, что он путешествовал без своей охраны.

quote: A young woman in Minnesota, recently traveled to China.
before: In 72 hours, we'll know what it is, if we're lucky. Clearly, we're not lucky.
after: Son also died. As of this morning, 87 cases, 15 deaths.
ru: Молодая женщина из Миннесоты. Ездила в Китай.

quote: I assume they can travel back and forth?
before: Well, they depend on that. You call them out on it, they'll just say you're crazy.
after: You want to catch a ride home. I didn't say that.
ru: Я так понимаю, они могут путешествовать туда и обратно?

quote: It's the places she's traveled to that's the problem.
before: She hates traveling. She loves traveling.
after: - Can I get you anything? - No, I'm fine.
ru: Проблема в том, куда ей приходится ездить.

quote: I graduated but wasn't sure what to do next, so I traveled.
before: Why did Native Americans want their heritage back from the very places preserving it? And how could scientists spend their entire lives studying dead Indians but seem to care so little about living ones?
after: One day, in South Africa, I visited Nelson Mandela's former prison cell on Robben Island. I had an epiphany.
ru: После окончания учёбы я не знал, что делать дальше, поэтому начал путешествовать.

quote: Truth continued to travel and speak well into her 80s.
before: Her work was so well regarded that she was invited to meet President Lincoln. She took the occasion to argue that all formerly enslaved people should be granted land by the government.
after: Until her death in 1883, she remained an outspoken critic who fought for her right to be heard in a hostile world. As Truth once said, “I feel safe even in the midst of my enemies; for the truth is powerful and will prevail. "
ru: Трут продолжала путешествовать и выступать, даже когда ей было за 80.

quote: You can go and travel and meet people.
before: And you become friends. And at some point, you become friends on Facebook, and you become friends in life.
after: And I was in Munich a few weeks ago. I went there to open an exposition about Iran and I met there with people from the page that told me, " Okay, you're going to be in Europe, I'm coming.
ru: Мы можем путешествовать и встречаться с людьми.

quote: The man was traveling alone, and was taken into custody after the plane landed safely.
after: Reports also say that the unnamed individual was riding an employee bus, then boarded the plane, but does not have proper identification which says he works for the airline.

quote: You got an illness here, and you didn't treat it.
before: I know I'm due. More like overdue.
after: Now we're in a situation where you don't have much time. - Uh, how long?
ru: У тебя тут болезнь, которую ты не лечишь.

before: - Wait here. - Make it quick.
after: Bring me the bank files from Venezuela, please. Let's go.
ru: Сол должен был проинструктировать вас обращаться со мной чуть более уважительно.

quote: So no offense, but you shouldn't be treating patients.
before: Wait. What?
after: You should be in rehab. Maggie, what are you talking about?
ru: Без обид, но тебе не стоит лечить людей.

quote: We can either treat Benjamin or Josh, but not both.
before: You're both gonna have to talk to Ms. Goodwin about this. Because of emergency surgeries, and a pregnant mother's serious bleeding disorder, we have used almost all of our O-Negative.
after: Benjamin needs an angio embolization more urgently than Josh needs surgery. How can you say that?
ru: Мы можем лечить Бенджамина или Джоша, но не обоих.

quote: She was one of the doctors who treated victims of the Chernobyl power plant meltdown.
before: (Laughter) Why would someone do this, you might wonder. Dr. Bodnar came to the ceremony and she explained that she grew up in Ukraine.
after: And they later discovered that a lot of the worst medical problems came from the particles people breathed in. So she was always thinking after that about could there be some simple mask that was available everywhere when the unexpected happens.
ru: Она лечила жертв взрыва на Чернобыльской атомной электростанции.

quote: The first patient to ever be treated with an antibiotic was a policeman in Oxford.
after: On his day off from work, he was scratched by a rose thorn while working in the garden. That small scratch became infected.
ru: Самым первым пациентом, которого лечили антибиотиками, был полицейский из Оксфорда.

quote: I talked before about the use of devices to dramatically change the way we treat disease.
before: All done in the lab. And I think fairly soon, you will see patients being treated with their own fat-derived, or adipose-derived, stem cells.
after: Here's just one example before I close up. This is equally tragic.
ru: Я уже говорил о том, что использование устройств может существенно изменить то, как мы лечим болезни.

quote: It's not a scholarly reference book, and I don't know anyone who treats it like one.
before: It doesn't make walking on streets a broken behavior. People use Wikipedia, by and large, properly -- as a glance at the collected pool of information on a subject, to figure out what something is or how it works.

What's the matter, you don't trust me anymore?
before: Good times all round. What are we doing here?
after: Who's your friend? Weapons man.
ru: В чём дело, вы мне больше не доверяете?

quote: I just don't know who I can trust.
before: Or your parents. I wish I could.
after: You can trust me. Spencer, Aria...
ru: Я просто не знаю, кому могу доверять.

before: Lachlan, thank you. After what I did, leaving you for Rafael, it's not lost on me, the irony.
after: Latin lover narrator: It should be noted that Petra should absolutely not trust Lachlan. - Go. Go. (Laughs)
ru: Поэтому ты единственный человек, которому я могу доверять.

quote: And besides, if Baird trusts him, so should we.

ru: Кроме того, если Бэйрд доверяет ему, мы - тоже.

before: And we took him under our wing. It was an honest trust issue.

Having met Alexander, I had a chance, and he gave me the opportunity and the support, to enroll for a university degree at the University of London.
ru: Он доверял нам, хотя мы были приговорены к смертной казни.

quote: If they can't internalize it, they won't trust it.
before: Worked pretty well for 200 years. Law has to be simple enough so that people can internalize it in their daily choices.
after: And how do you make it simple? Because life is complex, and here is the hardest and biggest change: We have to restore the authority to judges and officials to interpret and apply the law.
ru: Если они не смогут применять его, он не будут ему доверять.

quote: I had come to completely trust this little blue dot and its reassuring blue halo.
before: Now, the Dr. Frankenstein moment, when the spoofer finally came alive and I glimpsed its awful potential, came late one night when I tested the spoofer against my iPhone. Let me show you some actual footage from that very first experiment.
after: They seemed to speak to me. They'd say, " Here you are.
ru: Я привык полностью доверять этой маленькой синей точке и её обнадёживающему синему ореолу.

quote: The Prime Minister has defended his nephew saying that he trusts him.
before: Youri Latortue is also the nephew of interim Prime Minister Gérard Latortue and is currently working as security chief. He is nicknamed Mr. 30 Percent due to the fact that he charges 30 percent in exchange for government contracts.
after: Youri allegedly has ties to smugglers in Gonaives who control the trafficking at the seaport.

quote: That doesn't mean you stop trying.
before: Maybe I just shouldn't go. Babe, you got hurt.
after: Okay? Okay.
ru: Но это не значит, что нужно перестать пытаться.

quote: So you keep trying until you finally realize it's not your fault.
before: She doesn't give you what you need. You think it's your fault, maybe you're not good enough.
after: It's hers. But by that time, you're so screwed up, you can't really change.
ru: Так ты будешь пытаться, пока, наконец не поймешь, что это не твоя вина.

quote: Have you tried the standard language decryptions?
before: But it could be a transmission. Possibly.
after: All of them with no success. Success seems to be in short supply lately.
ru: Пробовали стандартные языковые дешифраторы?

quote: I’m reminded of that wonderful teachers’ union bumper sticker: ‘if you think education’s expensive, try ignorance’.
before: Whatever the true figure, it is undeniably expensive; but it gives our musicians a chance to be on national radio. We figure it’s worth it.
after: If you think creating the world’s first radio station playing 100% new music is expensive …. try being inaudible.

quote: Since then, werewolves can only turn on a full moon, and vampires are weakened by the sun.
before: Isobel. Vampires and werewolves used to roam freely until a shaman put a curse on them to limit their power.
after: The werewolf part of the curse, it's sealed with the moonstone. You must be Elena.
ru: С тех пор, оборотни могут превращаться только в полнолуние а вампиры очень слабы на солнце.

quote: first you say your vows to each other, then I turn to you Tim, your full name...
before: Weddings are actually over really quickly, so I want you to really cherish the time you have here in front with me. It goes like this:
after: Tim Aron Bratthall. Tim Aron, that's a nice name, Bratthall.
ru: сначала клятвы друг другу, потом я поворачиваюсь к Тиму, ваше полное имя...

quote: You shouldn't turn your back on that, especially when your amazing girlfriend asks you to do it.
before: I thought that was kind of sad because people used to really look up to you because of it. I mean, having people look up to you for anything is kind of awesome.
after: 'Cause there are girls and then there's April. She's in, like, a whole different category.
ru: Ты не должен поворачиваться к ним спиной, особенно, когда тебя простит об этом твоя удивительная девушка.

quote: And second, even though the rapper is really focused on his iPhone, as soon as the robot turns to him, he turns back.
before: Notice two things: one, how irresistible it is to join the robot while it's moving its head. You kind of want to move your own head when it does it.
after: So even though it's just in the periphery of his vision, in the corner of his eye, it's very powerful. And the reason is that we can't ignore physical things moving in our environment.
ru: И во-вторых, хотя рэпер и сосредоточен на своём iPhone, как только робот поворачивается к нему, рэпер смотрит на робота в ответ.

quote: Place your foot just so, mind how you turn: too swift a swivel can bring you down.
before: But I digress. More and more these days, digression seems the most direct route through from where I've lost or found myself out of place, mind, turn, time.
after: Take your time ushering the audience out, saying goodbye to the actors. The ghost light is what they call the single bulb hanging above the bare stage in an empty theater.
ru: Поставь ногу вот так, поворачивайся осторожно: слишком быстрое вращение — и можешь упасть.

quote: I had this black-and-white character printed on it, so that way, when the disc is turned, it completes the couple in all of these different guises.
before: (Laughter) And they thought I was crazy. Meanwhile, Mike and Karen were recording a song, which they had mastered to a clear flexi disc.
after: (Laughter) So we did it, we really did it! We made a paper record player — 200 recipient-operated paper record players.
ru: Я напечатала этого чёрно-белого персонажа на принтере, и когда диск поворачивается, это сводит пару в таких различных обличиях.

quote: Psiphon is supposed to be able to effectively turn anyone's personal computer into a proxy server.
after: The censored user may then connect to the computer running Psiphon and accesses banned content from there, all out of the view of censors. Psiphon data is also encrypted and moves globally on a network reserved for secure financial transactions, so the Censor wouldn't be able to tell a Psiphon request from a MasterCard purchase.

quote: They have turned down your request to test genetronics on humanoids three times already.
before: You're using the desperation of an injured man as an excuse to try a procedure that you couldn't do under normal circumstances. I checked with Starfleet Medical.
after: Are you really going to hide behind the rules of some bureaucracy? Beverly, your patient's life is at stake here.
ru: Они уже трижды отклоняли вашу просьбу о проведении генотронного лечения.

quote: I turned down TV interviews, and I said no to every request for photos of the two us.
before: So my first impulse in the face of all of this attention was to become very protective of my own relationship. I said no to every request for the two of us to do a media appearance together.
after: I think I was afraid that we would become inadvertent icons for the process of falling in love, a position I did not at all feel qualified for. And I get it: people didn't just want to know if the study worked, they wanted to know if it really worked: that is, if it was capable of producing love that would last, not just a fling, but real love, sustainable love.
ru: я отклоняла интервью на телевидении, говорила «нет» всем, кто хотел получить нашу совместную фотографию.

quote: I turned off the grill about a half an hour ago.
before: Toys? ! Hey, I'm just closing up.
after: Oh, we, uh... No, we're not here to eat, Blaine.
ru: Я выключил гриль где-то полчаса назад.

quote: But what I don't understand is why you turned off the scoreboard.
before: - You understand, right? - I do.
after: No, no, no, I turned off the microphone. No.
ru: Чего я не понял, так это зачем вы выключили табло со счетом.

quote: Turn off your bomb, we'll talk about it.
before: You want to tell your boy here to ease up on his trigger finger? Soon as you and your people leave this ship.
after: I already told you, it's not our bomb. Then whose is it?
ru: Выключи свою бомбу, и мы поговорим об этом.

quote: Will you set the timer, turn off the oven in 35 minutes?
before: Hey, sorry. I'm going out.
after: I'm using the timer for a meeting, hon... Angela.
ru: Установи себе таймер, выключить духовку через 35 минут.

quote: Turn off those mobile phones. Turn off those computers.
before: We stand in a massively lit bathroom, looking into the mirror cleaning our teeth. It's the worst thing we can possibly do before we go to sleep.
after: Turn off all of those things that are also going to excite the brain. Try not to drink caffeine too late in the day, ideally not after lunch.
ru: Отключите мобильные. Выключите компьютеры.

quote: It's not something we can turn off.
before: Now, working memory is that part of our consciousness that we are aware of at any given time of day. You're going it right now.
after: If you turn it off, that's called a coma, okay? So right now, you're doing just fine.
ru: Вы не можете просто выключить её.

quote: Right this minute, we can turn off TV, log off the Internet, get up and start to do something.
before: Yes, that's right. Right now, we need to start our own art.
after: Where I teach students in drama school, there's a course called Dramatics. In this course, all students must put on a play.
ru: Прямо сейчас — начать самим творить. Вот в эту самую минуту — выключить телевизор, выйти из интернета

quote: Mr. Beale, would you turn on the news channel?
before: The next step is to trace the delivery chain from the cyanide factory to the plating plant. Something had to have happened along the way.
after: ...San Fernando Valley, where a freak series of heart attacks has kept paramedics on their toes in this Chatsworth neighborhood. The 911 calls came within five minutes of each other from three different homes.
ru: Мистер Бил, включите канал новостей.

quote: Ed was dead before the oven was turned on.
before: He was found in his apartment with the gas turned on, right? I mean, how is that not a suicide?
after: Oh, no, no. No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no.
ru: Эд был мёртв до того, как включили духовку.

quote: Turns on the TV, leaving it on while he assaults her.
before: He goes into the victim's bedroom. Chloroforms her.
after: Actually, Amy already had her television on, so he just left it playing. What if it wasn't a coincidence?
ru: Включает телевизор, оставляет его включенным когда насилует ее.

quote: And now, in the immortal words of Saint Nick, turn on the compressor.
before: Obviously not. Behold, the greatest inflatable tree that 'murica has to offer.
after: You hear that? It's the sound of Christmas.
ru: И теперь, говоря бессмертными словами Святого Николая: "включить компрессор".

quote: Every time I turned on the faucet, I was overwhelmed.
before: When I was in Africa some years ago and then came back, I noticed water. In Africa where I was, I didn't have drinkable water.
after: Every time I clicked on the light, I was so grateful. It made me so happy.
ru: Каждый раз, когда я включал кран, я был поражён.

quote: I knew when you turned on your TV and how long you watched it for.
before: KH: Uh, I think you just outed them to, like, a lot of people here. SM: Don't be embarrassed, it's just metadata.
after: Fun fact about the Hill household: they don't watch a lot of television, but when they do, it's usually in binge mode. Favorite shows include " Difficult People " and " Party Down. "
ru: Я узнал, когда ты включаешь телевизор и как долго ты его смотришь.

quote: I turn on the flashing lights to indicate compliance.
before: (Laughter) She's had some drinks, so I drive us in her parents' car, and we get pulled over by the police. I'm scared.
after: I pull over slowly under the brightest streetlight I can find in case I need witnesses or dashcam footage. We get out my identification, the car registration, lay it out in the open, roll down the windows, my hands are placed on the steering wheel, all before the officer exits the vehicle.
ru: Я включил аварийные огни, чтобы показать, что я подчиняюсь.

quote: I mean, any kind of profound, new change in the world could turn out to be a black ball.
before: NB: That looks plausible under current conditions. It's not just synthetic biology, either.
after: CA: Let's look at another possible response. NB: This also, I think, has only limited potential.
ru: Чёрным шаром могут оказаться абсолютно любые новые серьезные изменения в мире.

quote: We've got to tweak it a little.
before: - I wrote it. - Oh. Well, it's got some good bits.
after: Yes, yes, she's got to get off the stage fast too. Well, stick her in a cannon.
ru: Нужно только немного подправить.

quote: I had to tweak the image a little bit, but it's under control now.
before: See you. Everything on schedule?
after: Foley's up there. Get him!
ru: Пришлось немного подправить картинку, но теперь все под контролем.

quote: Many weapons programs were tweaked but no major weapon system was cut.
after: Funding for unmanned aircraft will be increased.

quote: Well, I don't understand why they'd say that.
before: You know what they said happened. They said that I advised that girl to have an abortion.
after: I mean, that doesn't make sense. Well, I know it doesn't make sense.
ru: Ну, я не понимаю, почему они так сказали.

quote: You have to understand what this baby is.
before: But, when you're looking for the baby I see only the motions. It has to be more real for you.
after: To understand what a missing baby is, you must understand what it is to have a baby. It comes from the body, not from the mind.
ru: Ты должна начинать понимать, что значит этот младенец для тебя.

quote: If you don't want to go through with this, I totally understand.
before: Noma! What?
after: I've come this far. You think I'm giving up now?
ru: Если ты этого не хочешь, я полностью понимаю.

quote: He just terminated my employment, and I don't understand why.
before: You seem upset. I've been the head of his security detail for 20 years.
after: If it's about the other night, I-I was following orders. He told you to shoot that man?
ru: А он только что отказался от моих услуг, и я не понимаю, почему.

quote: Something inside of me was changing that I just didn't understand.
before: He was very intimidating, and there was absolutely no doubt in his guilt. But regardless of his guilt, as the days passed, I began to see this monster as a human being.
after: I was beginning to question myself as to whether or not I wanted to give this man the death penalty. Jury deliberations began, and the judge gave us jury instructions and it was to be used as a tool in how to reach a verdict.
ru: Внутри меня что-то менялось, а я не понимала, что.

quote: And of course, I'd smile as if I understood everything.
before: Now, dealing with an unfamiliar language was at times very frustrating and uncomfortable. I found myself several times at parties clutching my glass of wine, without understanding a single word of what was being said around me.
after: I felt limited in my ability to say what I thought, what I felt, what I believed. Not only did I not understand the conversations, but the streets were full of signs and text that I couldn't read.
ru: Разумеется, с улыбкой на лице, как будто всё понимала.

quote: And we don't understand why they won't let us in. Right?
before: This is the modus operandi that we have today. We roll 120-foot Spartan, i.e. our vision, up to our clients' gates of Troy.
after: Well, how about instead of doing that, we roll up to the gates something they want. Now this is a little bit of a dangerous metaphor, because of course we all know that inside of the Trojan Horse were a bunch of people with spears.
ru: И мы не понимаем, почему они не хотят нас пускать внутрь?

quote: And if you want to do essential business, okay, I understand!
after: Some people [don't] have a car, some people—like for example, do you know many nurses live in Long Island, they have to drive their car? A lot, a lot!

quote: And he didn't use bleach Because that would cause discoloration And leave an odor.
before: I'm thinking peroxide. Hansen must have used it To clean all the blood evidence.
after: And makes it obvious That a cleanup had taken place. He also left the alarm clock on the windowsill, exposing it To direct sunlight.
ru: Он не использовал отбеливатель, это бы оставило пятна и запах,

quote: Anything you say will be used against you in the court of law.
before: You are now under arrested. You have the right to remain silence.
after: I just got out. Right.
ru: Все, что вы скажете, может и будет использовано против вас в суде.

quote: It's in the butter I was using to make cupcakes.
before: The pot! The pot is in the pot!
after: Maybe this is the universe's way of telling you to stop doing drugs. Or is it telling us to sell them?
ru: Она в масле, которое я использовала для кексов.

quote: You mean, you'll have the tools to use a soldier's soul.
before: Certainly not. But if we ever are, we'll have the tools to understand and care for a soldier's soul.
after: No, ma'am, the role of the Valkyrie is to take a fallen warrior's soul and deliver it to Valhalla. And what if I told you the true role of the Valkyrie is not to play nursemaid, but to intercept soldiers in battle and win wars.
ru: Ты имеешь ввиду, навыки, чтобы использовать душу солдата.

quote: I started traveling less, doing less, using less.
before: It's brought huge volatility in prices, so much so that in 2011, your average European car manufacturer saw a raw material price increase of 500 million Euros, wiping away half their operating profits through something they have absolutely no control over. And the more I learned, the more I started to change my own life.
after: It felt like actually doing less was what we had to do. But it sat uneasy with me.
ru: Я стала меньше путешествовать, делать, использовать.

quote: Six months ago, Analie Domingo used a blockchain application called Abra.
before: It costs her around 10 percent; the money takes four to seven days to get there; her mom never knows when it's going to arrive. It takes five hours out of her week to do this.
after: And from her mobile device, she sent 300 bucks. It went directly to her mom's mobile device without going through an intermediary.
ru: Полгода назад Анали Доминго использовала приложение на основе блокчейн, Abra.

quote: We've used tools of computational creation to unlock immense wealth.
before: Are we factoring in fairness as we're developing systems? And finally, why we code matters.
after: We now have the opportunity to unlock even greater equality if we make social change a priority and not an afterthought. And so these are the three tenets that will make up the " incoding " movement.
ru: Использование компьютерного творчества открыло нам невероятное богатство.

quote: In the field of molecular biology, wiki technology is increasingly being used.
after: For example, two biochemists and Wikipedians, Professor William J. Wedemeyer and Tim Vickers, MSc, PhD, hosted a Wikipedia workshop last Tuesday at the American Society for Cell Biology Annual Meeting.

quote: Consistency between seasons may vary.
before: Some episodes too conceptual to be funny. Some too funny to be immersive, and some so immersive they still aren't funny.
after: Viewers may be measured by a secretive obsolete system based on selected participants keeping handwritten journals of what they watch. Show may be cancelled and moved to the Internet, where it turns out tens of millions were watching the whole time, may not matter.
ru: Согласованность между сезонами может различаться.

quote: Utility can apply to anything from the basic need for food to the pleasure of hearing a favorite song, and will naturally vary for different people and circumstances.
before: After all, it doesn't matter how much you could get from selling the diamond if you never make it out of the desert. Most modern economists deal with the paradox of value by attempting to unify these considerations under the concept of utility, how well something satisfies a person's wants or needs.
after: A market economy provides us with an easy way to track utility. Put simply, the utility something has to you is reflected by how much you'd be willing to pay for it.
ru: Понятие полезности применимо ко всему: от базовой потребности в питании до удовольствия от прослушивания любимой песни. Естественно, полезность меняться в зависимости от человека и обстоятельств.

quote: Wheelchairs vary somewhat in design, depending on the sport.
after: Those for wheelchair basketball and rugby have cambered wheels so they can spin around. Aluminum and titanium parts are used for strength.

quote: I'm just here visiting a buddy of mine.
before: You? Nah, man.
after: But it's not a bad place to kill a little time? I'm Nat.
ru: Я здесь просто навещаю своего друга.

quote: Why are we visiting an offensive establishment?
before: Because it sounded like he said his fiancee was helping out a lot. Hey!
after: - Because Carp owns it. - No, he does not. We saw his holdings in his file.
ru: Почему мы посещаем это оскорбительное заведение?

quote: She and the kids are visiting her sister Louise in Ann Arbor, so we're good.
before: - When does she get back? A week from Thursday.
after: And you're very pregnant. W-which is okay, 'cause, you know, I've been there, done that.
ru: Она с детьми навещает сестру Луис в Энн Арбор, так что, всё хорошо.

quote: This girl ever visit Tony here when he was by himself?
before: - He ever here on his own? - Sure.
after: Don't ring a bell. You wanna leave that?
ru: Эта девушка когда нибудь посещала Тони, когда он был тут один?

quote: Right? Well, actually, statistically speaking, if you only visit porn sites, you're safer.
before: We will see 30,000 new infected websites. And, just to kind of tear down a myth here, lots of people think that when you get infected with a computer virus, it's because you went to a porn site.
after: People normally write that down, by the way. (Laughter) Actually, about 80 percent of these are small business websites getting infected.
ru: Да? На самом деле статистика говорит, что если посещать только порносайты, шансов подхватить вирус гораздо меньше.

quote: We visit Kibbutzim that were established by Holocaust survivors.
before: That's where Joshua descended and crossed the Jordan and led the people of Israel into the land of Canaan 3,000 years ago in this final leg of the journey from Africa. And so, perspective and context and history play key roles in the way I plan my rides with the kids.
after: We explore ruins of Palestinian villages, and we discuss how they became ruins. And we go through numerous remnants of Jewish settlements, Nabatic settlements, Canaanite settlements — three-, four, five-thousand years old.
ru: Мы посещаем Кибуц, основанный оставшимися в живых жертвами Холокоста.

quote: I'd visit my father on weekends as a teenager to help him sell sneakers and jeans.
before: They took my family into their home, they mentored me. And they helped my dad start a clothing shop.
after: And every time business would get bad, he'd remind me of that mantra: no condition is permanent. That mantra and my parents' persistence and that community of supporters made it possible for me to go through college and eventually to medical school.
ru: Подростком я навещал отца по выходным, чтобы помогать ему продавать кроссовки и джинсы.

quote: Members of the police force visited Robert twice on the day that the murder occurred.
before: I stabbed him. He has been winding me up all day."
after: The court heard that, during the attack, a person who lived nearby heard the sound of glass smashing at 1400 BST on the day of the attack. The resident also heard Joseph proclaiming: "Help, stop this".

quote: Before we vote tonight, I have something to say.
before: You have to ask for Bennet Ahmed's resignation. This specially called session of the Seattle city council will come to order.
after: There are people who deserve punishment, who deserve to have something they value taken away, something they treasure. Maybe me, maybe you, maybe Mayor Adams over there.
ru: Прежде чем начнётся голосование, я хотел бы кое-что сказать.

quote: Many of the parties bribe people to vote for them.
before: - Honey where do you think you are? - Yes, but...
after: In fact, they all do. And when you see thousands of people at a rally all of them were paid to be there.
ru: Много партий подкупают людей, чтобы за них голосовали...

quote: Tell me, between us, I voted 3 time for No. 5.
before: You're pushing it! - The dossier is at a standstill.
after: What's her name again? Ting Ting.
ru: Между нами говоря, я 3 раза голосовал за кандидатку номер 5.

quote: She believes I voted for Hillary Clinton in the primary and Obama in the general.
before: God, no. Good. He's spiking at 30.
after: You're thinking I'm secretly a Republican, right? Wrong.
ru: Она верит, что я голосовал за Хилари Клинтон на первичных выборах и за Обаму на основных.

quote: And the many get to vote once every couple of years.
before: First of all, it's designed for an information technology that's over 500 years old. And the best possible system that could be designed for it is one where the few make daily decisions in the name of the many.
after: In the second place, the costs of participating in this system are incredibly high. You either have to have a fair bit of money and influence, or you have to devote your entire life to politics.
ru: А большинство может голосовать один раз в два года.

quote: And the pious Muslims in Turkey saw that they could change the political system by voting.
before: Secondly, and most importantly, Turkey became a democracy earlier than any of the countries we are talking about. In 1950, Turkey had the first free and fair elections, which ended the more autocratic secular regime, which was in the beginning of Turkey.
after: And they realized that democracy is something compatible with Islam, compatible with their values, and they've been supportive of democracy. That's an experience that not every other Muslim nation in the Middle East had, until very recently.
ru: Все религиозные мусульмане в Турции поняли, что они могут изменить политическую систему голосованием.

quote: But then the rain stopped, people went to vote.
before: And this is a rainy election day in a small country — that can be my country, but could be also your country. And because of the rain until four o'clock in the afternoon, nobody went to the polling stations.
after: And when the votes had been counted, three-fourths of the people have voted with a blank ballot. The government and the opposition, they have been simply paralyzed.
ru: Но потом дождь прекратился, и люди пошли голосовать.

quote: This comes after California lawmakers voted down a budget worth US$40 billion last weekend.
I'm so sorry to keep you waiting, officers.
before: - You said that twice. - Yes.
after: This whole ordeal... since it happened, I'm just beside myself. I find it difficult just getting out of bed.
ru: Мне очень жаль, что заставила вас ждать, офицеры.

quote: There was no waiting at the Squatter Inn.
before: I'm so glad you waited. You actually bought that in there?
after: Let's just say, been there, done that. Are you sure you're not moving a little too fast?
ru: Не ждать же, пока сможем оказаться в отеле Сквотер Инн.

quote: But you will not wait for her, will you?
before: Wait for me, Leonardo. I will be with you soon.
after: Why would Rome send two such as you to parley with me? We were chosen so none would suspect our mission as we travelled.
ru: Но ты не будешь ждать её, не так ли?

quote: You need to wait and see how it goes.
before: No, you're not. They would have fired you if they wanted to fire you.
after: He basically said I care too much about my clients and they notice it. How could that be bad?
ru: Тебе нужно ждать и следить за развитием событий.

quote: But he did not seem so very sure, for he sat down to wait with me.
before: And he said, " Don't worry. " He was sure that Catherine would be safe.
after: And for the next two hours, they all waited with me: taking turns, going up to their room, coming back, telling me jokes, distracting me. Two hours, they gave me a message.
ru: Но он не выглядел таким уж уверенным, поэтому он сел и стал ждать вместе со мной.

quote: I couldn't just wait passively for happiness to come and find me.
before: I thought if I had the right house or the right car or the right man in my life, then I could be happy. But when I wrote that obituary exercise, I actually grew up a little bit in that moment and realized that I needed to create my own future.
after: And I suppose I'm a selfish environmentalist. I plan on being around for a long time, and when I'm 90 years old, I want to be happy and healthy.
ru: Я не могу просто пассивно ждать, что счастье придет и найдет меня.

quote: America cannot wait another 50 years to get this right.
