ru: И он был крепким. Настоящий разведчик.

quote: See, the Dean of Medicine acts tough, but she's not really.
before: I'm not better, but you're kicking me out? Which is why it'll only be 20 minutes.
after: She'll step in, readmit you. So you're saying that she cares more about his treatment than the doctor who's actually treating him.
ru: Понимаете, местный главврач действует жестко, но она не такая.

quote: Yeah, well, it's tough when your parents chaperone one of these things.
before: So I guess that was fun. But I don't think Daisy and her mom are.
after: I get the feeling it's tough with Daisy's mom, period. Mm.
ru: Да, это трудно, когда твои родитеди сопровождают тебя в таких мероприятиях.

quote: She's just trying to stay tough for their mission.
before: She seems pretty tough to me. I'm not sure how innocent she really is.
after: They believe it's an important one, don%they? Yes, they do.
ru: Она просто пытается оставаться крепкой на миссии.

quote: Knowing how to identify what is deeply real is tough and important work.
before: Since we can be fooled by perceptions as basic as speed, maybe every perception deserves careful scrutiny. This is what inspired Einstein to his incredible insights about the speed of light and forward time travel.
after: If a police officer ever pulls you over for speeding and asks, & amp; quot; Do you know how fast you were going? & amp; quot; an insightful, though perhaps unwise, reply would be, " Relative to what? " And then, as you sit in the backseat of the police car and feel it accelerate toward jail, you can add, & amp; quot; But some things are absolute! & amp; quot;
ru: Выяснить, что реально на самом деле — трудная и важная задача.

quote: Many parents face tough questions and tough decisions.
before: It's not an easy question. Today we have adoption, stepfamilies, surrogate mothers.
after: Shall we tell our child about the sperm donation? If so, when?
ru: Многие семьи сталкиваются с трудными вопросами и трудными решениями.

quote: So three very tough problems that might be solvable, and so, should be worked on.
before: Although it's not very large, there are a lot of concerns about that. People need to feel good about it.
after: The last three of the five, I've grouped together. These are what people often refer to as the renewable sources.
ru: Вот три очень трудные проблемы, которые в принципе решить можно, а потому, следует работать над ними.

quote: "Funding is tough to come by these days," he says.
after: "The biggest downside to a war in Iraq is what you could do with that money. What does a war in Iraq cost a week?

quote: One foot is toward her husband, one foot is away from her husband.
before: This is a marriage that can recover. Now let's look at Alicia Florrick's feet.
after: It just signifies ambivalence. It's not going away.
ru: Одна ступня направлена к её мужу, другая - от него

quote: Toward the end, Arthur knew that his disease could steer him wrong sometimes.
before: But you were a civilian, right? So why would an analyst at MI6 tell you about his work?
after: He started telling me things to help him prove that his theories weren't just delusions, to help keep him sane. My brother ever come up in these conversations?
ru: Ближе к концу, Артур понял, что его болезнь может направить его не в том направлении.

quote: Ambassador Underwood and the State Department are working with all interested parties toward that end.
before: And while I disagree with this action, I understand the reason behind it, and we must stand with our ally. Our chief goal remains de-escalation in the region.
after: Our utmost priority is guaranteeing civilian safety. - And Israel has confirmed--
ru: Постпред Андервуд и Госдепартамент работают в этом направлении с заинтересованными сторонами.

quote: Charles, I'm gonna start heading toward the big rock.
before: Mandy first. Roger that.
after: Copy that. I'm over it. All clear.
ru: Чарльз, иду в направлении большого камня.

quote: Saudi Arabia today is taking small steps toward enhancing women's rights.
before: We sent a petition to the Shura Council in favor of lifting the ban on Saudi women, and there were, like, 3,500 citizens who believed in that and they signed that petition. There were people like that, I just showed some examples, who are amazing, who are believing in women's rights in Saudi Arabia, and trying, and they are also facing a lot of hate because of speaking up and voicing their views.
after: The Shura Council that's appointed by the king, by royal decree of King Abdullah, last year there were 30 women assigned to that Council, like 20 percent. 20 percent of the Council.
ru: Саудовская Аравия сегодня делает шажки в направлении расширения прав женщин.

quote: Notice, too, that the knife blades are both pointed toward the plate.
before: Here's a helpful tip: You always eat outside-in, so to set for salad, we'll put the salad fork to the outside of the dinner fork and the salad knife to the outside of the dinner knife. We'll have salad first, then our main course.
after: This is an old tradition from a time when dinner knives were quite sharp, and it was a sign of politeness and nonaggression to keep them pointed away from other diners. We might have some soup, and since soup usually comes first, the soup spoon goes outside the knives since we use our right hand to hold it.
ru: Обратите внимание — лезвия ножей всегда направлены к тарелке.

quote: And this is actually what it looks like, hundreds of blood vessels, all growing toward the center of the wound.
before: During pregnancy, they form the placenta, which connects mom and baby. And after injury, blood vessels actually have to grow under the scab in order to heal a wound.
after: So the body has the ability to regulate the amount of blood vessels that are present at any given time. It does this through an elaborate and elegant system of checks and balances, stimulators and inhibitors of angiogenesis, such that, when we need a brief burst of blood vessels, the body can do this by releasing stimulators, proteins called angiogenic factors, that act as natural fertilizer, and stimulate new blood vessels to sprout.
ru: И вот так это выглядит на самом деле. Сотни кровеносных сосудов растут по направлению к центру раны.

quote: On the back cover spidery hands are outstretched toward Harry.
before: "The structures around Harry show evident destruction and in the shadows behind him, we see outlines of other people," David Saylor, Scholastic's art director, said in a statement describing the U.S. version. "For the first time, the cover is a wraparound.
after: Only when the book is opened does one see a powerful image of "He-Who-Must-Not-Be-Named", his glowing red eyes peering out from his hood."

quote: Look, if the women of this family leave town and we fall apart, game over.
before: N-no, absolutely not. That's like admitting defeat.
after: Ah, speak of the devil. Bad news?
ru: Видишь ли, если женщины в этой семье покидают город, и мы не справимся, все пропало.

quote: Walk back into town, pay for the next ship returning to England.
before: This is no place for a boy like you. Take it.
after: Surely you could explain to Lord Benton that this is not the life for you! I can't go home.
ru: Возвращайся в город, заплати за поездку в Англию. Возвращайся домой! Я не могу.

quote: My father has that, and he is out of town.
before: I will get it to you right away. With Eric's juvenile record.
after: You will get it when he returns. Is he in Boone with your brothers?
ru: Они у отца, а его нет в городе.

quote: Well, then if you're in town permanently you should think about applying.
before: You got your degree, right? Yeah, uh, one last class, but I'm testing out.
after: We would love to have you back. That is, unless you've already gotten a job somewhere else.
ru: Ну, тогда если ты в городе постоянно ты должна подумать об этом.

quote: This is a small town in the Amazon, imaged with the CAO.
before: Although we flew straight over this bridge, we imaged it in 3D, captured its color in just a few seconds. But the real power of the CAO is its ability to capture the actual building blocks of ecosystems.
after: We can slice through our data and see, for example, the 3D structure of the vegetation and the buildings, or we can use the chemical information to actually figure out how fast the plants are growing as we fly over them. The hottest pinks are the fastest-growing plants.
ru: На этом слайде показан небольшой городок в Амазонии, изображение которого получено с помощью ВОКа.

quote: Otherwise you'd flood your entire town with warm porridge.
before: We had stories like " The Seven-League Boots ": the giant who had these boots, where, once you put them on, with every stride you could cover seven leagues, or 21 miles, a kind of travel completely unimaginable to people without that kind of energy at their disposal. Stories like The Magic Porridge Pot, where you had a pot where if you knew the magic words, this pot would just make as much food as you liked, without you having to do any work, provided you could remember the other magic word to stop it making porridge.
after: There is the story of " The Elves and the Shoemaker. " The people who make shoes go to sleep, wake up in the morning, and all the shoes are magically made for them.
ru: иначе весь город будет затоплен тёплой кашей.

quote: Gregory had been living on the streets, drifting from town to town for over 30 years.
before: I wanted to test my hunch that dignity and design are uniquely related. I listened to Gregory, a resident of this cottage community designed specifically for the 50 most chronically homeless people in Dallas.
after: A broad coalition of social service agencies, funders and designers, created this place. Each 400 square foot cottage is designed beautifully as a permanent home.
ru: Грегори жил на улице, переезжая из города в город на протяжении более 30 лет.

quote: Rachelle's older brother, Geoffrey, lives out of town and is a student at Tacoma College.
before: Her mother, Lauri, was a teachers' aide and served on the board of the Little League and the town library. Rachelle Waterman's 60-year-old father, Carl "Doc" Waterman, is a real estate agent and serves as president of the Craig School Board.

quote: Oh, it's so sweet that you're keeping track of my uterus for me.
before: Hey, hon, look. According to my fertility app, eggs a poppin', tomorrow is the next shot we have at getting you pregnant.
after: It's a little creepy you're high-fiving your friends about it. I'm just really anxious.
ru: Это так мило, что ты следишь за моей маткой вместо меня.

quote: Well, every federal prison has a running track.
before: Why'd you run? I like to keep in shape.
after: I'm sure you'll utilize that. We found unauthorized pills in Connor Rutnam's bed.
ru: Ну, во всех федеральных тюрьмах есть беговая дорожка.

quote: Mm. All four sets of tracks in the woods are from the same vehicle.
before: Aww. - Hi. - Hi.
after: We I.D.'d them as 22-inch Achilles Desert Hawks. They're used in '04 and '08 Ram trucks.
ru: Все четыре пары следов, обнаруженных в лесу принадлежат одному транспортному средству.

quote: Maybe it was one of you covering your tracks.
before: Where Bennett Nealy and his partner flew you to America. A few nights ago, Mr. Nealy was murdered.
after: Make sure your husband's enemies couldn't find you. No.
ru: Возможно, это был кто-то из вас, заметая свои следы.

quote: Eventually their conclusions get absorbed into the common sense of decency, erasing the tracks of the original argument that had gotten us there.
before: Time and again, a thinker would lay out an argument as to why some practice was indefensible, irrational, inconsistent with values already held. Their essay would go viral, get translated into many languages, get debated at pubs and coffee houses and salons, and at dinner parties, and influence leaders, legislators, popular opinion.
after: Few of us today feel any need to put forth a rigorous philosophical argument as to why slavery is wrong or public hangings or beating children. By now, these things just feel wrong.
ru: В итоге их умозаключения станут общими принципами благопристойности, стирая следы доводов, приведённых ранее, с которых всё и начиналось.

quote: And from a couple of bars of existing music, it actually tries to infer what notes should come next in those tracks.
before: And here's what 30,000 scores, written by the likes of Mozart and Beethoven, look like in a single frame. So, using deep neural networks, AIVA looks for patterns in the scores.
after: And once AIVA gets good at those predictions, it can actually build a set of mathematical rules for that style of music in order to create its own original compositions. And in a way, this is kind of how we, humans, compose music, too.
ru: И на основе пары тактов существующей музыки она фактически пытается угадать следующие ноты в этих треках.

quote: So the Yap just keep track of who owns part of what stone.
before: Now, the Yap don't actually move these Rai stones around or exchange them the way we do with our coins, because Rai stones can get to be pretty massive. The largest is about four tons and 12 feet across.
after: There's a story about these sailors that were transporting a stone across the ocean when they ran into some trouble and the stone actually fell in. The sailors got back to the main island and they told everyone what had happened.
ru: Поэтому япцы просто следят за тем, кто владеет той или иной частью камня.

quote: September this year is on track to be the lowest month by complaint volume.
before: JPMorgan's complaint volume by month spiked in January and March of this year with 504 complaints. April of this year was the next highest month with 493 complaints, edging out May of last year with 488 complaints.

quote: Just tell him what you want, make the trade.
before: Consider them burned. Can you forgive me?
after: As long as you can really get what you say you can. Huck's pretty good at hiding people.
ru: Просто скажи ему что мы готовы торговаться

quote: The Khan and our trade routes slip away while you make amends for your fatherly sins.
before: We have lost three days. We haven't lost a thing, Maffeo.
after: He is our blood. Mark my words.
ru: Хан и торговые маршруты ускользают он нас, пока ты замаливаешь свои отцовские грехи.

quote: My wife and daughter with her father, made it out through the Andorran trade routes.
before: Exiled? Escaped.
after: My brother and I... found false passage on a labor ship. Our final port...
ru: Моя жена и дочь, вместе с отцом жены отправились по торговым путям Андорры.

quote: But if it makes your ego feel better you can always pay me back in trade.
before: My father's been trying to buy my love lately and this seems a good place for him to start. It's a gift.
after: Trade? That's gonna be a lot of sex.
ru: Но если это заставит твое эго чувствовать лучше, ты можешь всегда платить за меня в торговле.

quote: Then we banned the plume trade, and their numbers started rebounding.
before: And why? That's because women thought they looked better on their hats then they did flying in the sky.
after: And as their numbers started rebounding, scientists began to pay attention, they started studying these birds. And what they found out is that these birds' behavior is intrinsically tied to the annual draw-down cycle of water in the Everglades, the thing that defines the Everglades watershed.
ru: Потом торговлю перьями запретили, и их численность начала восстанавливаться.

quote: The trade relies to 95 percent on a single variety which is grown on large plantations.
before: A more current example to show that monocultures are only short living is the banana. It may well be that in a few years, you will not be able to eat one anymore.
after: These are now threatened by the Panama disease. There is no other variety to replace it at the moment.
ru: Торговля бананами на 95% зависит от одного вида, который выращивается на больших плантациях.

quote: Trade is 10 times as old as farming.
before: In the same valley there are modern human remains from about the same date, 30,000 years ago, and some of those are from local chert, but more — but many of them are made from obsidian from a long way away. And when human beings began moving objects around like this, it was evidence that they were exchanging between groups.
after: People forget that. People think of trade as a modern thing.
ru: Торговля в десять раз старше, чем фермерство.

quote: The UK is moderately-well-aligned with the World Trade Organization.
after: There was a view, a few years ago, that Britain suddenly having an independent voice in the World Trade Organization would suddenly dynamise the organisation and solve all its problems: it was just immense . That has clearly not come to pass, as, frankly, the whole international trade profession predicted it doesn't work like that.

quote: And I'm sure she has similar tradeoffs with me.
before: I agree with her when she's calling him a Saint. And in exchange, I get to have sex with her.
after: Relationships are hard. You have to make sacrifices.
ru: И она наверняка так же идет на небольшие компромиссы со мной.

quote: I mean, yeah, the new job starts a little too early, but, uh, the trade-off?
before: I don't miss city life one bit.
after: There's no cabs, no subways, no stress, quiet streets and actual wildlife. Nice!
ru: Да, конечно, новая работа начинается слишком рано, но есть и плюсы.

quote: It's really rare that you don't have trade-offs between health and economics, or environment and economics.
before: They can generate income from this. They can save the money that they were going to spend on charcoal and they can produce excess and sell it in the market to people who aren't making their own.
after: So this is a project that I just find extremely exciting and I'm really looking forward to see where it takes us. So when we talk about, now, the future we will create, one of the things that I think is necessary is to have a very clear vision of the world that we live in.
ru: Это правда редкий случай, когда вам не нужно делать выбор между здоровьем и экономикой или между окружающей средой и экономикой.

quote: That's how you think about security: in terms of the trade-off.
before: The question is: Was it worth it? And you can make your own decision, and then you'll decide whether the invasion was worth it.
after: Now, there's often no right or wrong here. Some of us have a burglar alarm system at home and some of us don't.
ru: Именно так нужно думать в области безопасности — в терминах компромисса.

quote: It's going to be a more complex calculation, but it's still going to involve trade-offs, and trade-offs often require ethics.
before: Of course no accident is going to look like this; no accident has two or three options where everybody dies somehow. Instead, the car is going to calculate something like the probability of hitting a certain group of people, if you swerve one direction versus another direction, you might slightly increase the risk to passengers or other drivers versus pedestrians.
after: We might say then, " Well, let's not worry about this. Let's wait until technology is fully ready and 100 percent safe. "
ru: Такой расчёт будет довольно сложным, но так или иначе будет включать компромисс, а компромисс — это часто вопрос этики.

quote: We need to master speed, and that means thinking carefully about the trade-offs of any given technology.
before: Culture and rituals around the world build in slowness, because slowness helps us reinforce our shared values and connect. And connection is a critical part of being human.
after: Will it help you reclaim time that you can use to express your humanity? Will it give you hurry sickness?
ru: Нам нужно освоить скорость, то есть хорошо подумать о плюсах и минусах любого технологического новшества.

quote: I gotta go reroute traffic for the Bridgehamptons Polo Semifinals.
before: I am not going at Cardano without proof. Look, I gotta run.
after: But remember... we'll finish this later. I call the shots.
ru: Я должен контролировать движение транспорта на хэмптонском полуфинале по поло.

quote: So I turned off. We hit a traffic jam.
before: When he heard that, he yelled: "Anywhere but the Champs!"
after: Of course, we missed our meeting. What I'm trying to say, is... all his life, he's held his head high, no matter what happened,
ru: Я свернула и мы час простояли в пробке.

quote: We have to pull the traffic cam footage of the area.
before: According to this schedule, next pickup's not for another three days. We don't have time.
after: If Paul was picking up drugs, someone was dropping them off. Do you think this is where our target surfaced in the real world?
ru: Поднимем записи камер дорожного движения в районе.

quote: The ransom call that we received.. ..we could hear traffic at the back.
before: He cleaned everything. No, no.. I am saying something else here.
after: But..there was no traffic around the PCO from where the call was made. But the service provider confirmed the location. "that's where the call came from.
ru: Во время звонка с требованием выкупа были слышны звуки дорожного движения на заднем плане.

quote: They come up with questions like, "Why can't cars fly around traffic?"
before: So my last piece of advice is to think younger. Every day, I'm confronted with interesting questions from my three young kids.
after: Or, " Why don't my shoelaces have Velcro instead? " Sometimes, those questions are smart.
ru: У них возникают такие вопросы, как: «Почему автомобили не могут облетать пробки?»

quote: And all this against incredible logistical odds, like heat and traffic jams.
before: In 2007 and 2009 I did stories on the Delhi Fire Service, the DFS, which, during the summer, is probably the world's most active fire department. They answer more than 5,000 calls in just two months.
after: Something amazing happened during this shoot. Due to a traffic jam, we were late in getting to a slum, a large slum, which had caught fire.
ru: И все это сопровождается невероятными транспортными проблемами - такими как жара и пробки.

quote: And also, in traffic, the policemen give you condoms -- our "cops and rubbers" programs.
before: (Laughter) And then we gave condoms out everywhere on the streets — everywhere, everywhere. In taxis, you get condoms.
after: (Laughter) So, can you imagine New York policemen giving out condoms? Of course I can.
ru: И в пробках полицейский давал вам презервативы -- наша программа "менты и резинки".

quote: He is accused of involvement with drug traffic.
before: Edson Cholbi Nascimento, also known as Edinho, son of the Brazilian former soccer player Pelé was arrested by Brazilian police.
after: He and another 17 persons according to local newspapers and O Estado de São Paulo were arrested on Monday during a operation of Denarc, the anti-drugs police department.

quote: That's how we keep the trains running on time.
before: If the ticket says 2A, then 2A is where I'm parking my posterior. Real stickler for the rules, this guy.
after: Choo choo. - Nice to meet you, Hank.
ru: Именно поэтому поезда приходят по расписанию.

quote: Train napkin you used to mop up the spilled coffee.
before: You're showing off. I am a show-off, that's what we do.
after: Strength of the stain shows that you didn't take milk. There are traces of ketchup on it and on your lips and sleeve.
ru: Салфетка из поезда, которой вы вытерли пролитый кофе.

quote: You left that train so quickly, I turned around, and you were gone.
before: It's for walking while being a person of color. (Danny) Rabbi, what brings you here?
after: It was just like you were, I don't know, a Batman. Oh, you know, praise really... It just... it embarrasses me.
ru: Вы так быстро покинули поезд, я обернулся, а вас уже и след простыл.

quote: You slaughter a train full of innocent people, and you talk of redemption?
before: Why, then? To save your soul.
after: Oh, not for me. I'll writhe in the fires of hell.
ru: Ты убил полный поезд невинных людей, и говоришь об искуплении?

quote: On the train back to London, I couldn't get it out of my mind.
before: As I walked through their impressive, glass-covered atrium, in front of me, emblazoned on the wall in letters of fire was Marcus Aurelius's famous injunction: If it's not true, don't say it; if it's not right, don't do it. The head teacher saw me staring at it, and he said, " Oh, that's our school motto. "
after: I kept thinking, can it really have taken us over 2,000 years to come to terms with that simple notion as being our minimum expectation of each other? Isn't it time that we develop this concept of a duty of care and extended it to include a care for our shared but increasingly endangered democratic values?
ru: Сидя в поезде обратно в Лондон, я никак не мог выкинуть его из головы.

quote: So most of them, they choose the train.
before: Now, the most strenuous of these trips are taken by the country's 290 million migrant workers, for many of whom this is the one chance a year to go home and see parents and their left-behind children. But the travel options are very limited; plane tickets cost nearly half of their monthly salary.
after: Their average journey is 700 kilometers. The average travel time is 15 and a half hours.
ru: Поэтому большинство выбирают поезда.

quote: Right after the train crash, authorities literally wanted to cover up the train, bury the train.
before: But itself — the Chinanet — but itself can create very powerful energy, which has never happened in the Chinese history. 2011, in July, two [unclear] trains crashed, in Wenzhou, a southern city.
after: So it angered the Chinese Netizens. The first five days after the train crash, there were 10 million criticisms of the posting on social media, which never happened in Chinese history.
ru: Сразу после аварии руководство хотело буквально похоронить поезд, закопать с глаз долой.

quote: A bullet train travelling from Tokyo to northern Japan also derailed, however no one was injured.
before: Snow has accumulated to record depths, in excess of five metres, in the Hakkoda mountain range of Aomori Prefecture in Northern Japan. More snow fell in northern Japan over the weekend, and at least eight people died as people become trapped in their cars and buried underneath the heavy snow.

quote: The sooner we have a viable treatment option, the sooner we get Julia back.
before: I have the DNA sequencers going 24/7, and I'm running multiplex ligation-dependent probe amplifications for all known virulence factors. Good.
after: Just remember that. I'm gonna check on my brother.
ru: Чем быстрее у нас будет способ лечения, тем быстрее мы вернем Джулию.

quote: What did we do to deserve this treatment?
before: Why do you hate us? Answer the question, Liv!
after: I'm talking to you, Liv! Liv!
ru: Чем мы заслужили такое обращение?

quote: There are a few treatments, but there's no guarantee.
before: Prion disease. And if that's what I got, how bad?
after: I'm sorry. And you won't let me have a piece of cake?
ru: Есть несколько курсов лечения... но гарантий нет.

quote: At this point, the treatment options are limited.
before: Over a dozen malignant tumors. Well, I guess it's too late, then.
after: Well, now, you know why I never liked doctors. I'm sorry.
ru: В данном случае, варианты лечения очень ограничены.

quote: Today, there isn't a single girl out of school in my village.

quote: He'll jump at the chance of some ritualised violence.

ru: Он не сможет отказаться от участия в ритуальном насилии.

ru: Является ли порнография причиной насилия в отношениях?

before: I was planning on it. So was Ron.
after: We were each taking positions, building arsenals. And that's why you created the fake profile?
ru: Наш брак был войной, наш развод был бы холодной войной.

quote: This is going to be a long war.
before: I'm a little old for Macho optimism, Mr. President. Here's the truth.
after: Every war is longer than you think it's going to be. You'll be strongest on your first day, And every day after that, you'll get weaker And they'll get stronger.
ru: Все войны длятся дольше, чем мы предполагаем.

quote: War is coming to man, Michael, whether you wish it or not.
before: And if you defy him you'll anger him for the last time. Only if I fail.
after: The dogs of heaven will be unleashed. Sandra.
ru: Грядёт война Михаил, хочешь ты того или нет.

quote: The war came when I was still a baby.
before: There is no hatred allowed in my class. My story is like that of so many other refugees.
after: And my father, who had been absent in most of my early childhood, was doing what other men were doing: fighting for the country. He had two wives and many children.
ru: Когда началась война, я была ребёнком.

quote: But just imagine the drug war nightmare that would result.
before: Now, could we reduce smoking even more by making it totally illegal? Probably.
after: So the challenges we face today are twofold. The first is the policy challenge of designing and implementing alternatives to ineffective prohibitionist policies, even as we need to get better at regulating and living with the drugs that are now legal.
ru: Возможно. Но только представьте кошмар, который станет результатом войны с наркотиками.

quote: "What I Will" I will not dance to your war drum.
after: I will not lend my soul nor my bones to your war drum. I will not dance to that beating.
ru: "Я буду" Я не буду танцевать под твой барабан войны.

quote: War veterans also demanded that he say he was sorry.
before: Mr. Bush said Kerry's comment was "insulting" and "shameful" and that he should apologize to the U.S. forces.

quote: One near-death experience and you go warm and cuddly on me?
before: You know, we have become very close. Did you say gotten very clo... we've gotten very close?
after: Come on. You want to hug me now?
ru: да. Одна клиническая смерть и ты Стал теплым и приятным для меня.

quote: Whoever said warm milk does the trick obviously never tasted it.
before: Mmm. Can't sleep?
after: You know, pretty soon, late nights are gonna be a regular thing. You ready?
ru: Тот, кто сказал, что теплое молоко помогает, определенно никогда его не пробовал.

quote: Can I interest you in a warm cookie?
before: Mm-hmm. Hello.
after: You need to put some meat on those bones, or you'll blow away. Right?
ru: Могу я предложить вам теплого печенья?

quote: Takes several months of warm, wet conditions for it to form.
before: What? Adipocere, grave wax, caused by hydrolysis of fats in the body.
after: Air ventilation shafts are blocked. Yeah.
ru: Нужно несколько месяцев в теплых и влажных условиях, чтобы он сформировался.

quote: So actually, children can be protected by warm, secure parenting during and after conflict.
before: But there is good news. The quality of care that children receive in their families can have a more significant effect on their well-being than from the actual experiences of war that they have been exposed to.
after: In 2011, I was a first-year PhD student in the University of Manchester School of Psychological Sciences. Like many of you here, I watched the crisis in Syria unfold in front of me on the TV.
ru: Детей можно защитить тёплым, хорошим воспитанием во время и после конфликта.

quote: But when left in warm conditions for several hours, that fresh milk began to sour.
before: As early as 8000 BCE, the earliest Neolithic farmers living in the Fertile Crescent began a legacy of cheesemaking almost as old as civilization itself. The rise of agriculture led to domesticated sheep and goats, which ancient farmers harvested for milk.
after: Its lactic acids caused proteins to coagulate, binding into soft clumps. Upon discovering this strange transformation, the farmers drained the remaining liquid – later named whey – and found the yellowish globs could be eaten fresh as a soft, spreadable meal.
ru: Но если молоко оставить в тепле на несколько часов, то оно начинает скисать.

quote: This baby is so tiny he doesn't have enough fat on his body to stay warm.
before: What you see here is a premature baby. He looks like he's resting peacefully, but in fact he's struggling to stay alive because he can't regulate his own body temperature.
after: Sadly, 20 million babies like this are born every year around the world. Four million of these babies die annually.
ru: Этот малыш такой крошечный, что ему не хватает собственного телесного жира для поддержания тепла.

quote: The breakaway floe is just more evidence conditions are still too warm, the ice too soft.
before: While many places are experiencing cold temperatures, much of the Arctic has had an unusually mild winter. Too much so for professional hunter and hunting guide Idlout, who was out checking if conditions had improved after a cold snap.

quote: And Clean Water, but you can't have whales without water.
before: - There is. - Let's see, Save the Whales, of course.
after: Gosh. You know what?
ru: И "Чистая вода". Но какие киты без воды?

quote: The water won't be cold, will it, Granddad?
before: There are sandwiches in the pick-up, aren't there? Yeah, but you can't hunt sandwiches, can you?
after: Course not, it's only the North Atlantic. Why on Earth would it be cold?
ru: Дедушка, вода же не будет холодной?

quote: It's nice to have running water and drapes and stuff.
before: - Oh, wow. - Which is really nice.
after: My Aunt Helene, you may remember, is a decorator for restaurants out in Syosset, so she's really helping me get the place all slicked out, looking legit. - Right. - So that's nice.
ru: Хорошо, когда есть вода, и шторы, и все такое...

quote: She had a demon wound, maybe that's what the water reacted to.
before: We can't let you inside the Citadel. No, this has to be a mistake.
after: But she's fine now. She's healed.
ru: У нее была рана демона, может быть вода реагировала на это.

quote: We might divide it -- the plumber would say, "Well, where's the water?"
before: And so your body is probably cancering all the time, but there are lots of systems in your body that keep it under control. And so to give you an idea of an analogy of what I mean by thinking of cancering as a verb, imagine we didn't know anything about plumbing, and the way that we talked about it, we'd come home and we'd find a leak in our kitchen and we'd say, " Oh, my house has water. "
after: " Well, it's in the kitchen. " " Oh, you must have kitchen water. "
ru: Мы могли бы поделить его на зоны - сантехник-бы спросил: "Где вода?"

quote: A third is that I wanted hot water for tea -- that's an intentional argument.
before: One answer would be: because the kinetic energy of the water molecules is high and they bounce against things rapidly — that's a kind of physical science argument. A second argument would be: because it was sitting on a stove with the flame on — that's an historical argument.
after: And, since this is coming from a moral philosopher, the fourth would be that it's part of God's plan for the universe. All of these are possibilities.
ru: И третий возможный ответ: Мне нужна была горячая вода для чая. Это ответ с точки зрения цели.

quote: It's a pool of water, and the protocell starts moving itself around in the system.
before: In this protocell model, it's just an oil droplet, but a chemical metabolism inside that allows this protocell to use energy to do something, to actually become dynamic, as we'll see here. You add the droplet to the system.
after: Okay? Oil droplet forms through self-assembly, has a chemical metabolism inside so it can use energy, and it uses that energy to move itself around in its environment.
ru: Это вода, и протоклетка начинает двигаться по этой системе.

quote: According to the boy's mother, Shirley McDevitt, the gun was a squirt gun filled with water.
after: She also said that the boys are friends with each other. She has asked school officials to "expunge" her son's permanent school record of the incident.

quote: It will help to block the heat wave, when it hits.
before: Good? Yeah. Better then I expected. We need to shut this door.
after: Ok Mykaela, are you sure that this is alright? In 1902 a volcano erupted on martinique.
ru: Это остановит тепловую волну, когда нас накроет

quote: They barely had time to film the boat before it sank beneath the waves.
before: I remember dad telling me about the dramatic shipwreck. They couldn't save any possessions when they abandoned ship.
after: My sisters and I were disappointed that dad didn't rescue the jacket mom had knitted for him before the fishing season started. We didn't understand that if he'd tried to retrieve it, dad would have vanished in the deep along with the boat.
ru: Они едва успели заснять то, как оно скрывалось под волнами.

quote: He's already tried several times with the microwave oven's waves.
before: Yes, speaking. I'm calling you because my husband wants to kill me.
after: So... can I have your name? Mrs Lambert...
ru: Он уже пытался убить меня с помощью волн микроволновой печи.

quote: You know, there's always like five or six minorities wearing their T-shirts in the wave pool.
before: As long as there aren't any minorities. What are you talking about, Eric?
after: Pisses me off. We're here!
ru: Ну ты знаешь, всегда пять или шесть эмигрантов, не снимая футболок, входят в бассеин с волной.

quote: If light is a wave, then it must have a frequency. Right?
before: So enough about bobbing corks... What about light and color?
after: Well... yes, it does. And it turns out that we already have a name for the frequency of the light that our eyes detect.
ru: Если свет — это волна, у него должна быть частота, не так ли?

quote: You see it's a log there, often referred to as a traveling wave reactor.
before: So instead of worrying about them, you just take that, it's a great thing. It breeds this uranium as it goes along, so it's kind of like a candle.
after: In terms of fuel, this really solves the problem. I've got a picture here of a place in Kentucky.
ru: Это как свеча. Вы видите запись процесса, который часто называется реактором двигающейся волны.

quote: These have similar wave forms. They're both sustained instruments.
before: And the second one. (Violin) That's a violin.
after: Cochlear implant users cannot tell the difference between these instruments. The sound quality, or the sound of the sound is how I like to describe timbre, tone color — they cannot tell these things whatsoever.
ru: Они имеют похожие волновые формы. Оба — инструменты с непрерывным звуком.

quote: A huge wave shattered a bridge window, damaging control systems inside.
before: A passenger ship, the Voyager enroute between Spain's Balearic Islands to the Italian island of Sardinia, radioed a distress call earlier today after getting into difficulties in heavy seas.

quote: And no matter how difficult, you have always found the graceful way to handle it.
before: Baby, you are incredibly strong. Think about everything that you have faced.
after: Well, you are going to have to find that strength now. I don't want to.
ru: И как бы не было сложно, ты всегда находила верный способ справится с этим.

quote: Not because it was funny, but because it's the easiest way to make him go away.
before: You pushed him off. Maybe even laughed.
after: Then I went back to my office. And I wasn't afraid until he followed me there.
ru: Не потому, что было весело, а потому, что это самый простой способ заставить его уйти.

quote: Come with me, Chay-Ara, and I will find a way to prolong your life.
before: Unless we un-fuse, you'll end up killing us both! Rip Hunter must be a fool to send you into my arms.
after: We will live together in eternity. No.
ru: Пойдём со мной, Шэй-Ара, и я найду способ продлить тебе жизнь.

quote: In theory, they could get lost along the way.
before: I... like all birds. look, what Frankie meant to ask is, why would these criminals risk such value in the mail?
after: Because they don't get lost. "Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night stays these couriers from the swift completion of their appointed rounds."
ru: В теории, посылки могут потеряться по дороге.

quote: I could see and understand everything, but I couldn't find a way to let anybody know.
before: But no one realized that I had come back to life. I was aware of everything, just like any normal person.
after: My personality was entombed within a seemingly silent body, a vibrant mind hidden in plain sight within a chrysalis. The stark reality hit me that I was going to spend the rest of my life locked inside myself, totally alone.
ru: Я мог видеть и понимать всё, но не мог найти способ дать остальным знать об этом.

quote: And they are starting to interact with us in significantly more personal ways.
before: Now here's a secret: as an engineer, I get really excited anytime I can reduce something to the matrix. From self-driving cars to smartphones to this holographic computer on my head, machines are becoming capable of understanding our world.
after: Now, imagine having granular control over everything in the world. Move the dial one way, and you get reality.
ru: И они начинают взаимодействовать с нами существенно более личными способами.

quote: Come love come, the road lies low, the way is long and hard, I know.
before: So I wrote a song based on some of those narratives that I read, and it's called, " Come Love Come. " We're going to do it for you now.
after: Come love come, the road lies free, I'll wait for you in Tennessee. (Music) (Sings) When I was four, my loving mam was cornered by the boss's man.
ru: Приди, любимый, приди, дорога лежит низко, долог и труден путь, я знаю.

quote: Many employers are finding creative ways to cut costs, including scaling back operations.
before: U.S. businesses are getting ready to face their own set of economical obstacles caused by the lack of cheap labor.
after: In Cape Cod, for example, the local chamber of commerce reports that town employers will only receive 15 of the 5,000 visas requested. In response, local Cape Cod business owner, Williman Zammer, has called the situation "a major crisis," and states that what the Hispanic Caucus is doing is "ruthless."

quote: The only thing that creates wealth is wealth.
before: -All bullshit? You honestly think hard work creates wealth?
after: And we have it. You don't. Okay.
ru: Единственное, что создает богатство - это богатство.

quote: Wealth, my lord, is the foundation of any temple of power.
before: The unrest that grows on this damp rock... I need to make my gains now, while I still hold the king's trust.
after: We need to fortify our resources. Steeper taxes and tariffs.
ru: Богатство, милорд, есть основа любой власти.

quote: He's impressed by Strand's wealth and wants to know how much it cost.
before: We have to hide. One of them is saying they like the boat.
after: And Strand says he'd prefer not to discuss money. Careful, Victor.
ru: Его впечатлило богатство Стрэнда, и он хочет знать, сколько она стоит.

quote: Jesus had told people to abandon wealth, not to ally with the rich and powerful.
before: But in the East, many Christians were unimpressed by the new alliance, even hostile. At stake were fundamental disagreements about the direction the faith should take.
after: Remember his joke about a rich man wanting to enter the kingdom of Heaven was like a camel trying to get through the eye of a needle? Some Christians actually listened to what Jesus had said.
ru: Иисус направлял людей отказаться от богатства, и не объединяться с богатыми и сильными.

quote: Well, the lessons aren't about wealth or fame or working harder and harder.
before: (Laughter) So what have we learned? What are the lessons that come from the tens of thousands of pages of information that we've generated on these lives?
after: The clearest message that we get from this 75-year study is this: Good relationships keep us happier and healthier. Period.
ru: Так вот, эти уроки — не о богатстве или славе и не об усердной работе.

quote: Years passed, and while Pohjola prospered, Ilmarinen and Väinämöinen were without wives or great wealth.
before: Louhi was so delighted with the object’ s limitless productive power that she ran off to lock her treasure inside a mountain. But when Ilmarinen tried to claim his prize, the promised maiden refused to marry him, and the smith had to return home alone.
after: Bitter about this injustice, the bard proposed a quest to retrieve the Sampo, and the two sailed north with the help of Lemminkäinen — a beautiful young man with a history of starting trouble. Upon arrival, Väinämöinen requested half the Sampo’ s profits as compensation — or they’ d take the artifact by force.
ru: Шли годы, и пока Похьёла процветала, Ильмаринен и Вяйнямёйнен так и не женились и не добились богатств.

quote: So in these countries, more economic transactions occur and more wealth is created, alleviating poverty.
before: Why? I had shown in the early 2000s that countries with a higher proportion of trustworthy people are more prosperous.
after: So poor countries are by and large low trust countries. So if I understood the chemistry of trustworthiness, I might help alleviate poverty.
ru: В таких странах совершается больше экономических транзакций, так что создается больше богатства и снижается бедность.

quote: His estimated $4.5 billion wealth was believed to be the highest in that American state.
before: James LeVoy Sorenson, a Utah-based philanthropist and medical inventor, died of cancer on Sunday.
after: His inventions included one of the earliest computer-automated heart monitoring devices. His charitable work included the establishment of the Sorensen Legacy Foundation which supported a variety of educational, religious and medical places and programs.

quote: Weapon is hot and live fire exercise in five, six, seven, eight.
before: Get in position. I really need a better health plan. Shut up.
after: Tango, tango, tango. Scan the ballroom of the Cuban embassy for the agent you're supposed to meet.
ru: Оружие готово, упражнение начинается и-и-и... 5, 6, 7, 8.

quote: But he buys his weapons from artigas, So he's still very tapped in.
before: Tamil warlord. Well, he used to be until the tamil's surrender.
after: Who gave him the name "lone star," you? - Yes.
ru: Но он покупает своё оружие у Артигаса, так что он ещё может сообщить что-нибудь.

quote: I must say, whoever installed your car's secret weapons did a great job hiding them.
before: No, you give them the coupon, and they give you the hamburger. I knew that.
after: Yeah, Dr. Cain, the thing about that is... uh, there aren't any weapons. What?
ru: Я должен сказать, кто бы ни установил в твою машину секретное оружие, он сделал прекрасную работу, чтобы скрыть его.

quote: He's got a secret weapon that's going to help him win.
before: You'll find out. He said it to my face, Jing.
after: Yeah, but what's consilium? Um, what does it sound like?
ru: У него есть секретное оружие, которое поможет ему выиграть.

quote: It strips it away of its strongest weapon: fear.
before: We started a hashtag on Twitter mocking the study, and it made headlines around the world. [BBC News:' End of virginity' if women drive, Saudi cleric warns] (Laughter) And only then we realized it's so empowering to mock your oppressor.
after: This system is based on ultra-conservative traditions and customs that deal with women as if they are inferior and they need a guardian to protect them, so they need to take permission from this guardian, whether verbal or written, all their lives. We are minors until the day we die.
ru: Оно лишает их сильнейшего оружия — страха.

quote: Exosomes are the newest early-warning weapon, if you will, to emerge on the liquid biopsy front.
before: An automated system for rapidly sorting these important biomarkers is not currently available. We've created a technology that we call nano-DLD that is capable of precisely this: automated exosome isolation to aid rapid cancer diagnostics.
after: And they're really, really small. They measure just 30 to 150 nanometers in diameter.
ru: Экзосомы — новейшее оружие раннего предупреждения, если хотите, которое появится на переднем крае биопсии жидкостей.

quote: It's two people, two warriors, dropping their weapons and reaching toward each other.
before: Because ubuntu work is slow, and it's difficult. It's two people dropping the pretense of being know-it-alls.
after: Here's how the great Persian poet Rumi put it: " Out beyond ideas of wrong-doing and right-doing, there is a field. I'll meet you there. "
ru: "всезнаек". Когда два человека, два воина, складывают оружие и начинают двигаться навстречу друг другу.

quote: Automatic weapons and rocket propelled grenades were fired.
before: The Atalanta naval mission of the EU, which operates off the coast of Somalia, released a statement regarding the incident. "This was the longest range of a pirate attack off the Somali coast ever.
after: With increasing speed and evasive maneuvers the master managed to evade the attack. No casualties were reported," it read.

quote: If thou shalt go to such weather, fall with pneumonia.
before: I'm going a little run. A rest.
after: The day after tomorrow you encounter! Do what you want.
ru: Если будешь бегать по такой погоде, свалишься с воспалением лёгких.

quote: Either David Estes makes the weather, Carrie, or we do.
before: Well, that's a big if, Saul. You're screwing up my rug.
after: Your choice. This can't be good.
ru: Либо Дэвид Эстес делает погоду, Кэрри, либо мы.

quote: Anyone who's going, we're gonna leave at dawn, weather permitting.
before: That's the way, thank you. Mal's team are gonna go up, they're gonna mount a search as soon as they can.
after: - Of course, Helen. At dawn.
ru: Все, кто пойдет, - выходим на заре, если позволит погода.

quote: I'm here to gather data on weather patterns in metropolitan areas.
before: I'm here to get... Hi, I'm a Librarian.
after: Hi, I'm a Libr... Hi, okay.
ru: Я собираю данные о погодных условиях в городе и пригородах.

quote: The first night and day went smoothly, but by the second night, the weather turned.
before: No one was allowed up on the top. We all paid 6,000 dollars each for this part of the trip.
after: Waves tossed the boat around, and the timbers groaned. People below deck were crying, praying, recalling their loved ones.
ru: Первые день и ночь прошли нормально, но ко второй ночи погода изменилась.

quote: So all of these scores are made up of weather data.
before: I also translate weather data into musical scores. And musical notation allows me a more nuanced way of translating information without compromising it.
after: Every single color, dot, every single line, is a weather element. And together, these variables construct a score.
ru: Так что все эти нотные записи состоят из данных о погоде.

quote: Osorio: The weather is fine. We have fair weather today.
before: I've already told the people that we have tropical rain this time of year. So how's the weather in Rio now?
after: Let me get you our weather satellite radar. You see just a little bit of moisture around the city.
ru: Озориу: «Сегодня отличная, ясная погода.

quote: The National Weather Service confirmed Saturday morning that it was a tornado that struck the city.
after: After reviewing the aftermath of the storm, they classified it as an EF2 tornado on the Enhanced Fujita scale. Atlanta mayor Shirley Franklin says she is beginning to apply for federal disaster aid.

quote: His Majesty will be in residence at Holyrood Palace in eight weeks' time.
before: Doctors, professors, gentlemen, please take your seats. Your attention, gentlemen.
after: The King has decided that, in his wisdom, he will create a competition to further the progress of medical science. Accordingly, His Majesty has decided that during his visit, he will listen to presentations from Scotland's leading physicians.
ru: По прошествии восьми недель в Холирудский дворец приедет погостить Его Величество.

quote: We had that funny little man that plays the banjo last week.
before: Sorry! Sorry! It is rather ridiculous.
after: What's his name? I told him the best things come in small packages.
ru: На прошлой неделе у нас был тот веселенький коротышка с банджо.

quote: And, besides, he was real busy the last few weeks trying to sell the house.
before: Well, not really, considering he hadn't worked there in years. Pop wasn't one to brag.
after: [ Inhales deeply ] Excuse me.
ru: И кроме того, он был очень занят в последние несколько недель пытаясь продать дом.

quote: Which is why you've seen me in suspenders all week.
before: I would like to announce that I have lost a bit of weight lately -- Thank you, elliptical machine --
after: - boo! - That is all.
ru: Поэтому вы видели меня в подтяжках всю неделю.

quote: God bless them, Vanderbilt in one week found 40 such patients, same trend.
before: And we said, let's call our friends at Harvard and Vanderbilt, who also — Harvard in Boston, Vanderbilt in Nashville, who also have electronic medical records similar to ours. Let's see if they can find similar patients with the one P, the other P, the glucose measurements in that range that we need.
after: Harvard found 100 patients, same trend. So at the end, we had 150 patients from three diverse medical centers that were telling us that patients getting these two drugs were having their glucose bump somewhat significantly.
ru: Слава богу, в Университете Вандербильта за неделю нашли 40 таких пациентов, динамика та же.

quote: Doctors recommend exercising a few times a week, doing both aerobic activity and strength training.
before: And the good news is that you can change your lifestyle. Exercise, a healthy diet, and weight loss all lower the risk of heart attacks, whether you've had one before or not.
after: A heart-healthy diet is low in sugar and saturated fats, which are both linked to heart disease. So what should you eat?
ru: Врачи рекомендуют тренироваться несколько раз в неделю, комбинируя аэробные и силовые упражнения.

quote: It made for a heck of a profile picture on Facebook for a week.
before: Don't get me wrong. Like I said, it was great moment.
after: (Laughter) But I had been extraordinary all along, and I wasn't alone. You see, even though my story was featured in this film, I was just one of a hundred interns who worked their tails off to make this happen.
ru: Моя страница на Facebook за неделю приобрела бешеную популярность.

quote: It has been happening for several weeks now.
before: But this is a regular practice for the toads.
after: According to environmental technician Kate Paul, 25,000 toadlets per day have been rescued from becoming roadkill.

quote: I've probably slept with more than that on a busy weekend.
before: Must think I'm some kind of slut. Mam. I'm a 21st century type of guy.
after: You know, birds, obviously. Tits and stuff. Flange.
ru: Я из 21 века. Я, вероятно, переспал с большим количеством, чем это, за одни выходные.

quote: We spin the story right and we hope it fades over the weekend.
